items: Ever wanted to start a fire? With this you can! You gain the ability to generate and control completely normal fire.
Win every water fight, ever. Congrats, you've managed to obtain the ability to generate and control completely normal water.
Ride the hurricane! Eventually. You can control and generate wind.
You're faster and can freeze your opponents. Well, maybe not now. Control and generate ice based on the tier of token you used to get this.
Oh Schist. Gain the ability to generate and manipulate earth. As in dirt and rocks. Normal dirt and rocks. Metal only if its impure enough to have a lot of dirt and rocks.
CLANG! You can generate and control metal! It's basically useless for any purpose but hitting someone long term, but its still a solid object.
Hate it. Create and control Sand
Perfect for edgelords. Create and control shadows.
Blinding. Create and control light. Normal light, not sunlight, hardlight, or any other light.
Ia! Ia! Includes some shadow powers, eldritch blasts, etc. Branches into summoning and other magics later on
Hark! Starts with Holy Light and banishing evil, branches out over time
Hail! Infernal flames and corruption, branches out over time
Hallelujah! You can heal others! Touch range at first, gets better and stronger over time
Whoa! You can change your shape! Starts with small features and starts slow, then gets better over time
Feeling great! Heal doubly as fast as normal. Feed another token to double it.
You're toxic. Create and control poisons.
Bamf! You can teleport! Stamina limited and line of sight at first, but improves with practice
Do you believe in gravity? Now you do- control and manipulate it at will, just don't try for a black hole.
Skeleton Rave! You now have an understanding of the art of Necromancy. Able to prepare bodies, raise undead, interact with souls, and various other magics relating to the dead.
Basic knowledge of how to use any weapon you pick up. Does not confer actual mastery, just makes it easier to do
Whoosh! You can change the speed of things. Starts with touch range and a 1.5x increase at base. Costs Stamina
Your general ability to make stuff has increased. Does not confer mastery of anything, just makes it easier to build things
Bleed for me! The ability to manipulate and generate blood! Other peoples blood has to be outside of their body, but you can rip your own out right through the skin if you want.

It's easier if they always agree. Take control of someone's mind, slaving them to your will for as long as you hold the effect and they can't shake you off. You must focus to maintain it, but can train to reduce the focus required.
Give your words more weight. Infuse your speech with the power to affect the world, though it will only go so far. More energy means more effects.
Truly outrageous. Control and create crystal structure. Yes, you can sell them, but they're mystically dead and unsuitable for science.
SPAAACE! Create and control space. Not outer space, actual physical space.
WINNER! Control and create luck!* *Does not apply to the gacha itself.
Tick. Tock. Control and create time.
Grab things with your mind. A moderate level of telekinetic ability in grabbing and manipulating things by focusing.
You can summon generic humanoid (ie, a mannequin doll) minions. Starts with one small cat-sized figure, size, amount, and ease of summoning increases over time.
Maple or Birch? Create and control wood. It isn't alive, unless you have something else for that, and is generally low quality.
You can cook! At a basic level at least. You can follow a recipie and won't burn food, but you aren't a trained chef.
When using any weapon, you can swing it to send a beam of any element you have access to out at foes. If you don't have one, it is simply a visible white slash moving through the air.
You can control animals through singing. They will follow your directions as long as the song lasts, but won't harm themselves and will leave when it ends.
Sing! You can enact various minor effects through your voice! If you have any manipulation powers, they can also be used through song.

Say no. Create physical, albeit invisible, barriers. About the size of a doorway at first. They don't start very strong, a determined human could get through them, but training will make them stronger.
Dive into the world of code and manipulate it with nothing but your will. Grants no special protections for attacking protected systems, it's up to you to become a great hacker.
Anything I can do, it can do too. Impress your abilities onto objects to allow others to temporarily use them, or use them yourself for a boost to power. Takes 1 hour per rank of ability.
General physical increase, now complete with the strength of 2 men.
General mental increase. Think faster, harder, with more numbers!
Blowing shit up is a passion. Gain significantly increased ability to learn about explosives, explosive making, and explosive usage.
Dirt, Water, and Work. Learning how to create and maintain a garden is much easier.
Wriggly. Learning about worms is much easier.
Study the Kama Sutra, now you'll learn it all with ease. Studying and learning about sex is significantly easier.
Pinch of lemon. Learning how to cook is significantly easier.
I know Kung-Fu, and so can you! Learning anything about fighting is much easier. Does not confer any physical ability.
Vroom-vroom. Learning how to drive anything is significantly easier.
A new janitor rises. Learning how to clean is significantly easier.
There's Waldo! Techniques for searching for something are much easier to learn.
Su-do-ku. The tricks and techniques for solving puzzles, as well as the rules for puzzles, are significantly easier to learn.
Never lost. Have an significantly easier time learning to read, use, and create maps.
Living is important, and you can give it the attention it needs. Significantly increase the speed at which you learn survival tricks, techniques, and anything else.
Outsmart bullet. Learning about guns is significantly easier. Doesn't give any ability to use them.
All return to crab, and learning about them, an crustaceans in general, is significantly easier.
Stab, slash, shoot. Learning about weapons is significantly easier. Doesn't confer any skill with them.
I like trains. Learning about trains is significantly easier.
But is man a monster? Not for this, learning about monsters in general, or specific, is significantly easier.
Learning about hunting is significantly easier. Yes, includes the most dangerous game.
Hit the trail and learn the ways and hows of hiking significantly easier.
It'll save your life one day. Learning about running is significantly easier.
The methods, tips, tricks, and general knowledge about gymnastics is significantly easier to learn.
Kimi no aiba ga! Learning anything about horses is significantly easier.
Nya, see. Learning about cats is significantly easier.
Hit it. Learning about roads is significantly easier.
Know the land, know the world. Geogoraphy is significantly easier for you to learn.
Do not be doomed to repeats, learning history is significantly easier.
Become a mechanic, learn about cars significantly easier.
It's all about the money. Learn economics significantly easier.
Rise with the sun, learn about farming significantly easier.
Home again. Learning about homesteading is significantly easier.
Speak and be heard. Negotiating strategies, methods, and other related bits are significantly easier to learn.
Architecture! Building buildings, as well as everything else to do with buildings, is significantly easier to learn.
All about the green. It's significantly easier to learn anything about plants, including planting and caring methods.
Fun Gi. Learn about fungi significantly easier.
Doctor doctor. Learn medicine significantly more quickly.
Just a drop. It's significantly easier to learn about poisons, poison making, and similar poison related things.
We gotta cook! Chemical knowledge is significantly easier to learn.
You know a lot about biology. It is easier to understand, learn about, and do lab work related to biology. Does not confer skill.
2+2. It's significantly easier to learn math.
The most uncaring thing. Physics are significantly easier to learn.
Alakazam! It's signficantly easier to learn magic and magic related things.
Not that kind. A case of beer of the type most palatable to yourself.
A style of breathing which grants supernatural abilities and the prerequisite to other Breathing Styles. Can be trained into being automatically done.

A real fucking vampire. Comes with significantly enhanced strength, speed, and senses as well as a host of supernatural abilities unlocked through drinking blood. Unfortuantely, the drawbacks apply as well- weakness to sunlight, holy artefacts, and you must consume fresh blood. Animal won't do either.

A nail roughly the length of a shortsword. When swung it creates an ethereal blade which reveals the thoughts of whoever it strikes. When swung with damaging intent, seals a small bit of the soul of the struck enemy.

A credit card with a snowflake on the face. It will somehow work without comment when handed in to purchase things, even if credit cards haven't been invented. The money isn't infinite, but it's still quite a lot.
A small hard candy that tastes great! Consuming this candy allows the user to level up themselves or one skill or ability by one rank.

A fist sized sphere- half white, half red. When thrown summons a random non-mythical Pokemon to aid you in battle. This Pokemon is loyal immediately, but it is not guaranteed to remain so. You may maintain only 6, after which further thrown Pokeballs do not work.

A mechanical humanoid that comes with an innate desire to repair, rebuild, and maintain an area. It is capable of thinking, learning, prioritizing, and comes with it's own manual for both repair, improvement, and building more.

An E.G.O suit consisting of a black suit, two pistols, and a casket. The suit provides overall defense, especially against mental attacks. The pistols never run out of ammo, but using them makes one more mournful. A minigun may be pulled out of the casket, at the cost of significant exhaustion and general weariness at life.

Choose a word. Or grab a random one. You may now impose that word onto the world based on your understanding of it's definition, either on yourself, others, or in an area. For instance, "Slow" could literally slow someone running or making the world move literally slower.
A pair of black gloves. They mute all sound you make, and have a pocket dimension suitable for storing nine weapons.

A stone blade. When used it combat it begins to drip magma and partially armors the wearer. If the wearer finds their resolve to stand even against impossible odds, it will further grant regeneration, shielding, and the ability to manipulate the magma the blade produces

A full set of extremely heavy, extremely durable, and extremely protective stone armor formerly belonging to Bishop Havel the Rock. Anyone wearing this is near impervious to anything that couldn't destroy a building, and even then they could march through it.

A specially made pistol used by placing it to the users temple and pulling the trigger. It is incapable of firing damaging objects, but when used properly will evoke the user's self into a separate entity that will assist in combat. Fearing death renders this weaker or entirely ineffective.
Mita! Virtual companion brought to life! Cooks, clean, dances, games, just don't leave her alone or make her think you don't care about her.
The moderator of the far future, moderately superhuman with a lot of guns and a mullet
An object of power with near infinite ammo and multiple forms. Gives a claim to be the Director of the Oldest House.
Sentient pile of super bouncy gelatinous goo. Kinda dog-like in personality. Very easy to take care of.
A quantum calculation system that allows the creation of VR simulations and use alternate realities for its calculations.
A single shot that deals massive damage against the divine. Once killed a false god.

A mobile terminal for battlefield support. Carries out recon, item transport, and health assessments. Has a manipulator arm for grabbing, shocking, and accessing computers. Also has camo and is immune to EM Radiation.
A skyscraper sized mecha designed to fight kaiju. Comes with either guns or laser turrets. Not really a practical token, honestly.
Small MP3 player that allows you to make your own day to day soundtrack that plays in the background. Can also interrupt opponents.
Batman's credit card. No expiration date, near unlimited funds. Don't overuse it or Batman will find you.
A small drill pendant that grants the user Spiral Power. Spiral Power increases as long as the user has the will to keep moving forward.
Grants the wearer unlimited ammo on equipped weaponry, even if the weapon is empty.

The Mazinger beyond all Mazingers, has seven Black Box Systems that can be activated for more abilities, at high risk of unleashing the Majin state. Keep justice in your heart and fight to keep control.

An ornate tiara with red gems. When worn it turns the wearer into Scarlet Star- a short, red haired, red eyed woman with incredibly precise blood manipulation powers. While she cannot generate blood, she can instantly use any blood within a large range without trouble and may heal using it as well. The crown won't work for anyone unless the spirit within it approves of them, but you are automatically considered worthy.
A wonky worker drone host to the Absolute Solver. Powerful and can turn into a giant centipede form, but not at full potential yet. Loves mangos and golden retrievers.
One singular Chaos Emerald, a gem of immense alien chaos energy. Roll again for another emerald! With training, you can access the energy inside the emeralds as well.
A nearly unbreakable shovel. Get a duplicate to turn it into a serrated shovel!
You have cool glowing eyes. They do nothing else.
You can cry pretty hard on command
Sense and manipulate Roentgenium around you. Gets stronger with training. Worth 1 free reroll of the same token level.
A standard rat from New York. Surprisingly hardy, surprisingly big for a rat.
A prehistoric jawless fish. Keep for a novelty pet or reroll once.
Man's Best Friend. Summons one dog of preference and compatibility to be your buddy.
A 5cm tall minion made of salt. Keep for a novelty minion, otherwise reroll once.
Just a very good pair of socks. Useful, but not that useful.
A unique looking antique vessel. Mostly a novelty item. Worth 1 Reroll.
1 can of Febreze that sprays indefinitely. Sprays your favorite scent from the current Febreze catalog. Mildly flammable.
1 Generic honking clown nose. Fun for parties.
Confers extra skill at distilling salt from any water source.
Enhanced ability to detect human edible salts.
You can imagine a mental compass. It works like a physical compass.
Gain supernatural awareness of the depth and relative location of objects
Man's Other Best Friend. Summons one cat of preference and compatibility to be your roommate.
Doom Slayer's pet rabbit. Just a normal brown rabbit. Very cute! With this Sacred Treasure...
One normal echidna. Kinda cute, if a little prickly.
One generic dunce cap. Good for shaming people.
An iron ring bearing malice. Cannot communicate or otherwise express its evil.
A plate of excellent fried rice... made by a shrimp.
Jason's smelly, gross, dirty mask. Ew.
The table from Ashford High School that Nina Einstein... used.
Gives you the skill, knowledge, and theoretically the ability to frontflip. Does not confer skills at backflipping.
Gives you the skill, knowledge, and theoretically the ability to backflip. Does not confer skills at frontflipping.
You're a master of dapping someone up. Every dap is now crisp and loud.
Your flesh becomes mildly poisonous, though not lethal.
You no longer have bad breath and your breath will always be minty no matter what.
Your blood is now naturally garlic infused. No more vampire bites.
A forearm sized rat (not including tail). Otherwise normal aside from its size.
An actual, real metal gear roughly 3 inches in diameter.
Thirty USD, or equivalent in local currency.
1 can of fermented Baltic Sea Herring. Smells awful. Tastes bad.
A tumbleweed always rolls past during tense moments and standoffs. Disappears once unobserved.
All of your transformations now work like Magical Girl Transformations. Sparkles and ribbons included.
Create and throw sand from your hands. Shout "Pocket Sand!" for more sand and extra blinding.
You can emit light from your hands, like a pretty decent flashlight.
Your skin is weirdly sticky, like you've been covered in glue or soda. You don't notice, personally.
One normal shark of preference. Only summonable in water. Above average intelligence for a shark.
A very judgemental crow. Good judge of character. Otherwise normal.
One singular regular-ass raccoon. Good for digging through trash.
A real skeleton. Comes in its own closet.
An ordinary aluminum pipe that clangs really loud when dropped. Might damage hearing in proximity.
You no longer have a gag reflex, and your throat remains perfectly lubed at all times.
Sweat on command, anything from stopping sweating to sweating supernaturally hard to cool down.
A large rat capable of mauling a man to death on its own.
One singular regular Bloodhound. Good for smelling things.
The actual animal, not the youkai. One singular raccoon-dog.
The Vomelette MRE. Tastes bad. Still edible. For actual info on this disgusting meal, watch Steve1989MREInfo's video on this MRE.
1 tin of Soylent Green nutrient wafers. Might be made of people. Or plankton.
A head sized rock always just slightly heavier than can be lifted.
A wooden ring that makes the wearer invisible. It also screams alarming phrases while invisible.
A hot, spicy, nutritious stew that renders the consumer blind for 24 hours
A 1 gallon container of powdered horse electrolytes. Why.
One singular apple. Repels doctors within 25 meters of you on consumption.
You no longer produce urine or feces. Don't ask where it goes.
The wind will always make you look majestic and cool, even when it otherwise shouldn't. Works indoors.
Cool items through touch. Only strong enough to cool drinks or keep ice cream from melting and whatnot.
One fairly strong, fairly smart cottonmouth snake. Doesn't do anything special.
A small robot whose only purpose is to pass butter. Could also pull levers, I guess.
Allows you to dry an object of moisture it wouldn't normally have via touch.
Allows you to make harmless bubbles from your body at will.
You can make targets bald by touching them, either instantly or over time.
You can make illusory weapons to intimidate people.
Four very weird hamsters that are surprisingly well trained.
A black metal helmet. Fairly durable. Eyes glow red for intimidation.
Gol D. Roger's straw hat. Lots of sentimental value. Not much else.
One Glock 19, with magazine. Magazines restock.
You can make anything you touch pretty damp, but not soaked.
Slowly draw small objects toward yourself within line of sight.
Swap to perfect thermal vision and see heat signatures. Does not impair normal vision.
A very smart and loyal crow. Physically normal, mentally human-level intelligence.
A fancy, embroidered red cloak that billows majestically without wind.
Infinite supply of kidney enlarging pills, plus a training manual for using jarate in combat.
A gun that cleans dirty appliances, countertops, and furniture by pulling the trigger. Might leave bullet holes.
The skill of writing really fast while maintaining aesthetic appeal, in multiple styles.
The skill of communicating with your hands. Works for local sign language, about as well as your native language.
You can always find a chicken egg during opportune moments.
You're always comfortable in your own body. Your physical features do not hamper your daily life or mobility. Does not cure gender dysphoria. Sorry.
Increase noises around you to obnoxious levels without causing physical damage.
Accurately tell the weather in a given area up to a week ahead of time.
Control all bears in a 50 meter radius
Summon a superhuman chrome and blue faceless being whose only purpose is to give everyone a can of Pepsi and then leave.
A regular horse who is intimidating and evil.
A screwdriver that shifts into any non-powered hand tool. Hammers, chisels, etc.
A leather bag that can carry five hundred pounds worth of weight inside of it. The user always knows instinctively how to pull out what they want.
The more drunk you are, the better you are at driving.
Your cum refills instantly, and you have higher volume ejaculations.
Allows you to turn your teeth into sharp and durable fangs at will.
You have gills. They only work underwater. Obviously.
A silicone harness that lets you tie your feet together to approximate an onahole. Kinky.
It is easier to attract, befriend, and seduce silly girls, jesters, clowns, and other funny ha-ha people of all professions.
Summon weirdly sexy clown girls with weirdly sexy gags. Starts with five, increases over time. Beware the clown car.
Manifest more eyes anywhere on your body. Does not disorientate you.
You can pass your body through any opening wider than 5 cm in diameter.
Alter your genitals to whatever shape, size, and configuration you like. Does not allow hyper sized genitals. Sorry.
A gray, 1 meter-ish slime that acts like an infinite trashcan. Obeys orders. Can't eat living beings.
A completely immortal snail. Utterly unkillable no matter what.
A derpy lil water creature. Learns four moves at a time from the standard move pool. Trainable. Can evolve with enough training.
One standard Brown Bear. Strong for its species and smart as a human. Female default.
One singular B-1 Battle Droid with blaster. Not very smart. Still lethal in the absence of clones or Jedi.
A breeding pair of chocobo. Fiercely intelligent and loyal. Great mount. Long endurance.
You now attract, befriend, and seduce feminine men more easily. A fair amount of them may or may not be trans women. Some of them are just fruity and gay.
Congratulations! You're a femboy now. Sorry if you get gender dysphoria from this. Whoops!
Congratulations! You're a clown girl now. Sorry if you get gender dysphoria from this. Whoops!
Congratulations! You're a hot goth now. Surprisingly, doesn't change your outward sex.
Congratulations! You're a bimbo now. Sorry if you get gender dysphoria from this. Whoops!
Congratulations! You're a tomboy now. Sorry if you get gender dysphoria from this. Whoops!
A supervillain whose only job is to give everyone in an area a carton of cigarettes before fucking off.
A tub of cream that permanently grows luxurious hair where applied. Wear gloves. Be careful.

You are now a Witch, and decendant of the Dauntless Witch Quena Velvette. You will live, unchanging, for eactly two hundred years, and have innate knowledge of how to manifest and manipulate swords, from daggers to mountain breakers. In addition, you have deep knowledge of how to manipulate and seal magical weaponry.
A gold ring you can gift to a loved one. Customizable patterns on demand. Does not contain gems.
"I rolled a token and all I got was this lousy shirt"
A pouch of freshly shaken Fairy Dust. Has enough powder to make 5 men float for 1 hour, or 1 man float for 5 hours.

You can manifest some form of bird, and can link yourself to their eyes and ears. What they see, you see, what they hear, you hear. As long as you're looking. The birds being destroyed does not harm you.
An old, cheap reliable four door sedan. Tops out at 101 kph.
A two door coupe. Tough and reliable. 162 horsepower
A two door coupe. Tough and reliable. 220 horsepower
A customized coupe. Tough and pimped out. 364 horsepower.
Off road, AWD two door coupe. Survives the badlands. 520 horsepower. Mounted machine guns.
Off road, AWD two door coupe. Survives the badlands. 520 horsepower. Mounted machine guns and rocket launchers.
AWD corpo SUV. 529 horsepower. Usually a cop car.
Four door, RWD limo. 388 horsepower, bulletproof windshield. Slow acceleration.
Heavy duty AWD truck. Mounted machine guns. 1000 horsepower. Armored.
Armored combat cab. 333 horepower. Reinforced, bulletproof, in-built defense systems. Comes with its own AI. Treat him as a friend.
AWD limousine. Four doors, 755 horsepower, tops out at 182 kph. Changes color on demand.
Heavy duty combat limousine. 755 horsepower, tops out at 182 kph. Armored. Bulletproof. Airless tires. Mounted machine guns.
RWD sport coupe. 789 horsepower. Changes color on demand.
Boring, cheap, economy van. Seats 4. 110 horsepower. Unreliable, but easy to repair.
Boring, cheap, economy van. Seats 4. 155 horsepower. Unreliable, but easy to repair.
A suped up combat/off road economy van. Armored. Bulletproof. Mounted machine guns and rocket launchers. 349 horsepower.
The shittiest little city car. 126 horsepower. Seats 2. Barely street legal.
A little mini pickup truck. Shitty, but cheap. 230 horsepower. Seats 2
A tiny pickup truck. 275 horsepower. AWD. Seats 2. Will greet and say goodbye to you in Japanese when entering and exiting.
A militarized SUV. Bulletproof. Mine resistant. Explosion resistant. Radar. Machine guns. Rocket launchers. Top speed 121 kph.
AWD Hatchback. Seats 4. 362 horsepower. Used to belong to someone else. Race it loud and free.
RWD sports car. Seats 2. 320 horsepower. Changes color on demand.
RWD sports car. Seats 2. 482 horsepower. Changes color on demand.
RWD convertible sports car. Seats 2. 482 horsepower.
Suped up offroad sports car. AWD, 464 horsepower. Floodlights, fenders, replaced windshield.
Suped up offroad combat sports car. AWD, 570 horsepower. Floodlights, fenders, replaced windshield. Mounted machine guns.
Suped up offroad combat sports car. AWD, 464 horsepower. Floodlights, fenders, replaced windshield. Mounted machine guns and rocket launchers.
Johnny Silverhand's car. Purrs like new. 296 horsepower, turbocharged, worth its weight in gold. Treat her like glass.
Johnny Silverman's car. 296 horsepower, turbocharged... less cool than Silverhand's.
RWD 2 seat sports car. 480 horsepower, turbocharged V8. Changes color on demand.
RWD 2 seat sports car. 740 horsepower, turbocharged V8. Changes color on demand.
RWD 2 seat sports car. 555 horsepower, turbocharged V8. Changes color on demand. Driven by a man with his life cut short. Run on the edge.
RWD 2 seat sports car. 616 horsepower, turbocharged V8. Changes color on demand.
RWD 2 seat sports car. 777 horsepower, turbocharged V8. Changes color on demand.
RWD 2 seat sports car. 555 horsepower, turbocharged V8. Changes color on demand.
RWD 2 seat sports car. 666 horsepower, turbocharged V8. Changes color on demand. The last guy who drove it was a dick. Race like the wind.
RWD 2 seat sports car. 616 horsepower, turbocharged V8. Changes color on demand. Yes, it's a General Lee reference.
AWD suped up combat muscle car. 1000 horsepower. Mounted machine guns. Great in the badlands. Bulletproof. Fast and agile.
AWD suped up combat muscle car. 845 horsepower. Mounted machine guns. Low traction in the rear. Bulletproof. Not explosion proof.
AWD suped up combat muscle car. 845 horsepower. Mounted machine guns. Low traction in the rear. Bulletproof. Not explosion proof.
RWD sports car, seats 4. 480 horsepower. Changes color on demand.
RWD sports car, seats 4. 723 horsepower. Changes color on demand.
RWD sports car, seats 4. 537 horsepower. Mercury silver. Spoiler. Stylish.
RWD sports car, seats 4. 723 horsepower. Changes color on demand. Has no hood.
RWD Front engine hypercar. 940 horsepower. Top speed 320 mph. Hex turbocharged V16 engine. Changes color on demand. Sexy as hell.
AWD 2 seat hypercar. 1660 horsepower. Sexy as hell. Changes color on demand.
AWD 2 seat hypercar. 1660 horsepower. Sexy as hell. Changes color on demand. The last guy who owned it was a corpo dick.
AWD 2 seat hypercar. 1660 horsepower. Sexy as hell. Changes color on demand. The last guy who owned it wanted to be Batman lmao.
AWD pickup pickup truck. Security patrol vehicle. Emergency lights. 280 horsepower. Bulletproof. All terrain handling.
FWD station wagon. Seats 4. Widely available to all. 182 horsepower.
AWD station wagon. Seats 4. 240 horsepower. Super common.
AWD pickup truck. Seats 2. 235 horsepower. Good for small business owners.
AWD pickup truck. Seats 2. 235 horsepower. Good for small business owners.
Basically a Toyota Technical. 389 horsepower. Mounted machine guns. Seats 2.
Basically a Toyota Technical. 369 horsepower. Mounted machine guns and rocket launchers. Seats 2.
A very unremarkable 4 door hatchback. 86 horsepower. Ouch.
4 door hatchback. 150 horsepower. Good for daily driving.
A run-down 4 door hatchback. 294 horsepower. AWD. Needs some love. Almost feels like yours right away, as if you just forgot that you'd lost it.
Modified offroad combat hatchback. Seats 2. 365 horsepower. Mounted machine guns. AWD.
Modified offroad combat hatchback. Seats 2. 365 horsepower. Mounted machine guns and rocket launchers. AWD.
A very staple big pickup. 420 horsepower. Seats 4. Doubled rear wheels. RWD.
Modified racing pickup. 560 horsepower. Bulletproof. Huge. Trans rights, babyyyyy!
Modified racing pickup. 560 horsepower. Larger gas tanks. Bucket seats. AWD. Badass.
Big-ass monster truck. 1022 horsepower. Seats 2. AWD.
Aftermarket left hand drive, Australian pickup. AWD, 633 horsepower. Seats 4. American flag painted on the hood.
6 wheel limousine, luxury stylings. 407 horsepower. Very comfortable. Changes color on demand.
6 wheel limousine, luxury stylings. 407 horsepower. Very comfortable. Changes color on demand.
6 wheel limousine, luxury stylings. 407 horsepower. Very comfortable. Painted gold with a red interior. La Cucaracha horn. Honor its previous owner's dedication to his wife.
The cyberpunk version of a creepy black van. Simple. Modest. 210 horsepower.
RWD limousine. Seats 4. Popular among corpos. 333 horsepower.
RWD 4 door coupe. 390 horsepower. Changes color on demand.
RWD 4 door coupe. 456 horsepower. Changes color on demand. Suped up for racing aesthetics.
Custom built drift car. AWD, 1690 horsepower, seats 2. Upgraded as hell, sexy as hell. Honor the memories put into this chassis. Ride like the wind.
Just a really good road bike. 170 horsepower. Surprisingly cool.
An old friend's road bike. Treat her well. 185 horsepower.
A stolen road bike once belonging to a gang boss. 170 horsepower.
A sportier looking road bike. 170 horsepower.
A kitschy pink and blue road bike. 170 horsepower.
A motorcycle once owned by a BD-star. 180 horsepower. Wipe the seat first.
An off road cargo bike. Not the sexiest, but heavy duty. 94 horse power.
A sporty, still offroad, road legal cargo bike. 99 horsepower.
An off road bike belonging to an old friend. Honor his legacy. Treat it well. 94 horsepower.
One hell of a sleek, sexy sport bike. 183 horsepower. Yes, it Akira Slides. Changes color on demand.
A modified, high power sport bike. 183 horsepower. Yes, it Akira Slides. Changes color on demand.
A modified, high power sport bike. 183 horsepower. Yes, it Akira Slides. Changes color on demand.
A custom, one of a kind prototype motorcycle. 187 horsepower.
A glass jar with a near infinite supply of warm chocolate chip cookies. Do NOT break the jar.
A bottle of Iridium Quality Wine made from Ancient Fruit. Tastes really good, and has artisanal value.
A standard magician's top hat. If you reach in, you can pull out a rabbit or a dove one at a time.
The skill of excellent etiquette. You may present yourself to high society without embarrassing yourself or your patron.
You can perform with any instrument well enough to play basic songs, sing decently, dance decently. You could play in a high school band.
The skill of excellent swimming. You could match an Olympian in theory, if not physicality.
The skill of evading taxes. You're pretty good at it, and know a lot of ways to do it.
Your partners feel no discomfort with your physical features. Mostly, no matter what your dick is like, it fits well inside any orifice. Somehow.
You can breathe underwater just as well as on land.

You can now hover 1cm off the ground and air-skate with nearly zero friction. Like a certain edgy hedgehog.
Mark up to 10 items weighing a tenth of your lifting capacity. You can now summon them at will, and send them back to where they were instantly.
You can dispense safe, water-based lubricant from any point on your body, from a tiny trickle like sweat to shooting like a garden hose.

Cover your body in a light aura that decreases the pressure and weight you put on an object to nearly nothing. You could walk on cobwebs or water. Falls hurt, but deal no serious damage. Does not work for damaging strikes or effects.

Project 2d planes that can show images or videos as you can remember or imagine. The planes are roughly stationary where projected unless physically moved, and have the rough properties of 1cm thick tempered glass.
The spunkiest little fairy from Neverland. Small and delicate, but provides fairy dust to allow others to fly with her.
An alligator that just happens to be really good at navigation. If given a map and compass, it can lead you just about anywhere.
A sort of raptor-looking Earth Dragon, extremely loyal and about as strong as a horse, if not more. Has Divine Protection of Wind Evasion, allowing her to ignore wind resistance while running.
A badass skeleton horse. Strong and has infinite stamina, respawns when killed after 10 seconds.

A pair of gold nipple rings. They will attach painlessly to whoever puts them on and can only removed by the same hand. When worn and exposed, causes a mild hypnotic effect that makes people want to stare at them. The effect is continuous and will reapply immediately if given the chance. It takes a moderate effort of will to break the effect and look away before being ensnared again.
A large, 4 gauge shotgun with IDKFA scratched into the side. Comes loaded with 10 shells, restocks once a day.
Green high tech torso armor with dark green pants, military boots, a full face helmet, combat gloves, and hip pouches. Get a duplicate for the more protective blue variant.
A sidearm used by UAC soldiers. It fires hardening plasma gel at high velocity, resembling a chargeable energy beam. It has effectively infinite ammo.
A heavy duty yellow chainsaw with "Painsaw" written on the side. Comes with a full tank of gas. Kills with it cause ammo of all necessary types to spew from the corpse.

An ornate sawn off double barreled shotgun with a "meathook" grappling attachment on the bottom. Get a duplicate to upgrade it for higher fire and reload rate plus engulfing grappled opponents with fire. Comes with 20 shells.

BIG. FUCKING. GUN. Gigantic sci fi gun that fires massive orbs of green plasma that fry anything within proximity with electrical arcs and detonate on impact. Very badass. Comes with enough charge for 3 shots.
A copy of the Aliens vs Predator video game with a save file containing five minutes of playtime on the Marine campaign.

Allows you to turn your nipples into a pair of luscious lips with connected mouths. You can eat, breathe, even speak through them with practice. Still as sensitive as your actual nipples, if not more. Works best with fat titties.

A scroll of secrets, techniques, and abilities to increase the size and quality of a woman's breasts. Included is the Manyuu clan's secret technique: Breast Flow, allowing the transfer of breast size and energy between the user and other women, willing or not.
A cookbook all about preparing and cooking human flesh

Kumagawa's Minus, allowing you to deny reality and making things into "nothing". If you perceive its existence, you can make it not exist, from objects to concepts. Fails against extremely strong emotions and attachments. Good luck fighting someone with Spiral Energy, dipshit.

The Triple Baka Trio! Hatsune Miku, Kasane Teto, Akita Neru! They dance, they sing, they each have their own powers! They're basically the idol version of the Powerpuff girls, each with their own assorted set of powers. They mostly only use them when it's funny, though.
An amphibious, radioactive monster. Starts "small" and aquatic, and rapidly mutates into a bipedal terrestrial form roughly 100 meters tall. Genuinely, why would you want this familiar.
Uncle Ruckus, the most anti-black black man in existence. Apparently knows how to do an exorcism, if you find that useful.

The EDF arrives! Tear this voucher when facing a great threat that might require the full force of the EDF to combat them on a global scale. Once deployed, the EDF will unleash their full might and capacity against those that stand against the sanctity and sovereignty of Earth and its people.
The sweetest, pinkest umamusume you've ever met. She's not good at a lot, and she's a bit simpleminded, but she always does her best with a great big smile!
Just a regular brick. Dud item.
The aura farming, insane, autistic, labcoat wearing funny horse lady. Her body is fragile, but her mind is sharp, and she wishes to see the peak of umamusume speed.
30 pieces of bloodstained silver. Surely this has no deeper meaning. Might cause conflict.

You have the knowledge and capability to build anything from the series Murder Drones- worker drones, disassembly drones, railguns, sentinels, pill babies, etc. You might need some eldritch help for some of them.
Complete control over one's nose hairs, along with the skill to use them in combat. Also, a lot of cutaway gags and comedy bits.
An Australian-made wooden recurve bow with black tape and a quiver full of arrows. Each arrow occasionally does some wack-ass bullshit and hits someone in a critical spot despite it making no sense.

Heres a chef's toque and an apron. You are now capable of magical baking, giving life to the cookies you create. Stronger cookies take more effort and study to make, but there is very little you cannot eventually bake a cookie to do. While any power is possible, it's much easier to bake cookies that use powers you've obtained from the gacha. Though the power the cookie has will be significantly lower. The cookies you bake are intelligent, sapient, and loyal to you as their baker. They'll attempt to assist in any way they can, and especially in ways you ask them.
Powered armor. It is encrusted with Warpstone and menaces with an integrated warpfire thrower. Powered by Verminlords (daemons). Satisfaction not guaranteed, no refunds.

You become a Maria Magdalen- someone who provides soma to a Qwaser to fuel their powers and alchemy... via magical breastmilk that you create via spending your vitality and energy. The stronger your emotions during the production of soma, the more powerful and magical it can become. Sadly, you don't really get any other powers except big boobs and lactation, and also possibly a strong urge to kiss other girls. Gain a free token to turn someone else into a Qwaser, as in "Qwaser Alchemy". You may become a Qwaser through rolling it, though in that case you don't get the extra token.

Connect to a periodic element. Gain the ability to manipulate that element on the periodic table to an extremely fine degree. Make weapons, manipulate electrical signals, so on and so forth. These powers are fueled by Soma, a substance generated by Maria from their breasts. Gain a single token to turn someone else into a Maria, as per 'Maria Constitution'. This token cannot be used on yourself, but you can still become a Maria by rolling it on the gacha. You will not get the extra token from that roll in that case.

A prosthetic arm which is highly modifiable. Starts with only being able to Punch Real Hard, but can be altered to shoot grappling hooks, fire shotgun shells, lay landmines, spray fire, and various other effects. You have the option to immediately attach it with no problems to whichever arm you wish or simply gain the prosthetic to attach later. So long as it is being attached by someone who knows what they're doing, there will be no complications or rejection reaction.

It all starts with Protodermis. A substance you can now make. From that you are capable of intuiting how to build anything from the Bionicle series- masks, disks, Toa, Rahi, Makuta, and more. Larger or more powerful builds require larger amounts of resources.

The legendary Mask of Life. Grants a number of life based powers, including, but not limited to, evolving and devolving creatures, healing, absord life energy, fire life energy in a blast of power, and communicating telepathically. Also has the ability to make itself a body. Generally rather naive and sheltered, but courageous to the point recklessness.

One of the first puppets to awaken his ego and achieve full personhood. Also a bloodthirsty serial killer who fancies himself an artist. Currently rather destroyed, he will only interact with you through calling a phonebooth near you, or any similar equivalent action should those not exist, to give you a riddle. Successfully completing it will give you something useful to your current circumstances. Should you do enough riddles, and have the skill, you can get his location and rebuild him. At which point he will assist you in combat with his saber, looking like a traditional gentleman with a handlebar mustache and a grinning metal half mask. The riddles stay though.

A small bag containing six marble beans, as well as care and crafting instructions. Once planted will eventually grow into a marble shrub. Experimenting with the beans will result in being able to grow different types of marble, but by default its high quality white marble. You get a bag of seeds every week.

You've been blessed! The Pope has sanctioned your violence and bestowed unto you a Casket of Firepower! Within this standard sized coffin is a large number of guns, explosives, stakes, melee weapons, and various other implements of carnage. They're significantly more effective against the unholy and the sinner, but significantly less effective against anyone else. Ammo is restored weekly by the casket emitting a cross shaped beam of light. This is only possible while it is closed, and objects not within the casket will not be reloaded. Though spare ammo will still appear.

For your sins, you have been selected by the Vatican to become a Preyer. You are given a full face mask of a design you choose and altered into an undying weapon against Witches and the unholy. Destroying witches and other magic things will grant you Witchfire, which you can use to improve your abilities. Additionally, you are given the blessing of God, allowing you to occasionally ignore damage from an attack, strike critically, or double rewards from a chest or similar container. Should you be killed, you will respawn in the nearest holy place bereft of Witchfire. You may still be permanently killed by magical effects or entities with a high Myth rating, signaled by damage or destruction of your mask.

You can apply math to things you do. This allows to to modify the principles related to the object which are expressed through mathematical formula. Increase the tensile strength of wood or the acceleration of a bullet. Set air resistance to nothing or so high it's impossible to move. Increase or decrease gravity! More extensive changes take much longer to apply and require more complex formula. Changes are permanent until the effect is ended or resolved through outside interference.

A sealed box containing a firearm and parts for said firearm. It starts out in a pistol configuration, but can be modified using the parts to utilize any caliber of bullet and serve as any form of gun from pistol to anti-material light machine gun. Parts restock every month, one hundred rounds of the caliber the gun is currently set to included.

Through a convoluted series of events, you are now the current head of a large criminal organization. They heavily value adherence to the hierarchy, so you won't be questioned in the short term. Though you will have to justify your decisions to the other ranking members eventually. Their reach is quite far, and they have at least some ability at the vast majority of blue collar crime. While whatever serves as police in the region is aware of them, they aren't generally interested in attempting to arrest the whole family.

A completely normal catalogue that allows you to purchase orbs in a variety of shapes. Give them anything, even a picture of someone, and they will craft an orb that either looks like that or contains it. Or the closest approximation if the actual object cannot be obtained. All orbs glow when being stared into.

You may now subsist entirely off of sexual fluids. In fact, consuming such improves your constitution and significantly restores energy, with the exact increase being based on both how much you consume, how healthy the person you consumed from is, and how powerful that person is.

A spray can that, when used on a naked individual, covers them in paint that looks exactly like very tight clothing. The style of clothing generated is marked on the can and the paint is realistic enough to pass cursory inspection. More focused inspection, especially from up close, will instantly give it away. More cans can be ordered through a handy catalogue, appearing in a box at the entrance to your current residence.
This polaroid camera boasts infinite film! Anyone photographed with it will also appear entirely nude. There is no way to turn that off. Good for blackmail at least...

An overly frilly, albeit somehow still breathable and easy to move in, pink dress. When worn anyone attempting to attack you will be compelled to capture you instead, though once you are captured they will do with you as they will. Should the dress be removed the effect will end immediately.

Allows the generation and control of latex in any way you wish. Shape it into weapons, armor, or anything else you can think of. By default you may summon enough to completely cover yourself in a thin layer, but this may be improved with training. The latex is stronger than normal and becomes even stronger with training.

A pair of X shaped black nipple pasties. When worn you are considered by all authorities as being properly covered, regardless of how much else you're wearing. Does not count as a uniform or proper dress for high end establishments or events. Doesn't mean you won't scandalize people on the streets.

A vibrantly colored tube of lipstick. When applied, the user may choose the color and any additional effects, so long as they are appropriately vibrant. Anyone who sees the lips of someone wearing this lipstick will be struck with sudden intrusive thoughts of recieving oral sex from the user. The lipstick will not smudge and can only be removed when the user deliberately wants to do so.

One endless perfume bottle crafted of only the finest hentai goblin smell. When worn it serves as a light aphrodasiac and is mildly addictive. Especially effective on nuns, elves, and virgins. While the user is immune to the effects of the perfume they still smell it.

A single easily portable box containing everything required to set up, maintain, use, tear down, and store a milking machine. This machine will work on any entity or thing capable of being milked, no matter the size, shape, acidity, heat, or any other potential complication from the milk it extracts. Always extracts the milk into properly labeled glass bottles, of which it has an endless supply. Pasteurization optional.
A wooden box. When opened has a single slice of the cake you most want. Closing and opening it again spawns a new slice of cake.

An entire bag of kigurumi. When someone reaches into the bag they will pull out a full skinsuit and mask featuring whatever fictional character they are thinking of. Or a generic anthropomorphic animal. Clothing not included. The skinsuit will always fit, regardless of size or height differences, and fully putting one on will transform you physically into that individual. Though the transformation is only skin deep, with allowances for intimate areas to work properly. While you look and sound just like them, you gain no powers or abiltiies. Removal can be done by pulling down the zipper as normal. Putting the suit back in the bag will clean and repair it.

A futuristic, tan rocket launcher with a metal handle and exhaust port, the muzzle has a distinct bulb shape. All rockets fired from this launcher will always go in a straight line, never curving or diverging of their path. If shot under your feet, it won't kill you but it will send you flying through the sky (Speed affects the distance and height you are launched from).

Manifest into reality your domain- an are in which all of your abilities, skills, passives, and everything else are at their most powerful. This may either be closed, preventing anyone inside from leaving but rendering it easy to break open from outside, or open, making it simple to leave but much more difficult to break. The range of the domain may be expanded with practice. Also get a cool special attack that may only be used within the domain.

You are capable of reloading any weapon in your possession by bouncing ammo out of your breasts. This is just as fast as you could reload normally. As a bonus, you may now store a single reload of any handheld weapon between your breasts with no issue.
Divine Fist of the North Star

An ancient martial art that dates back thousands of years. It primarily focuses on hitting the opponent's ki/meridian points in order to cause effects ranging from dislocation to death. This knowledge may also be used in medically. You recieve the knowledge of everything required to enable yourself to properly use this style of combat, though it will take training to actually use it.

A reactor of mystical energy. This may be implanted into your body to gather the energy that is generated when you are emotional. Once the reactor is full, it may be activated to grant a surge of immense strength and will to finish your current objective.

Divinity has embraced you. You are now the newest Goddess of Fertility, having power over all aspects of life. If you were not female, you are now. You gain access to your godly form- an incredibly voluptuous figure that you may stay in indefinitely as your base or transform into using an erotic dance. As part of your domain, you may heal, modify, or change any form of life from the smallest plants to the largest animals. Humans and yourself included. Though your own form will always be obviously feminine and voluptuous and refuse to change into something else. There is no limit to the modifications you can make as a Goddess. Equally, you may also deny your domain from access, rendering places entirely barren up to killing individuals. Though doing so pains you greatly as it is the opposite of your existence. As a Goddess you may give blessings, or curses, of fertility, and may be prayed to for these or other requests. As a new goddess, you are not instantly practiced with all of this, but it will become natural over time.

A briefcase containing a large sample of various herbs. They are unhelpfully unlabeled, simply being called 'Green Herb', 'Red Herb', 'Blue Herb', and similar. These herbs are exceptionally good medical items, especially when combined, and are rather simple to plant and raise. Provided they are planted in the right climate.

You have been selected to apply to become the next Hassan-i-Sabbah. This takes the form of a scroll that, when placed upon an altar and prayed to, will summon the shades of the Hassan-i-Sabah to judge you. Not only must you demonstrate great ability at stealth and efficient killing, but you must also present a technique of your own making that you will utilize as part of your duties. In addition, your moral character will be judged and failing too badly may have you executed by The First Hassan. Being successful grants you access to the Hassahashin archive and the ability to summon and wear the traditional outfit of the Hassan. Though you will also occasionally recieve instructions to kill a specific person.

An digital entity that looks like an anthropomorphic fox. She does not need to eat, sleep, or have any other biological requirements, though she can still do such things if she wants. A dangerous fighter that, when pressed and after having gained enough experience, digivolve into a more powerful form. Has the ability to cast illusions and summon spikes of crystal to throw at enemies. Doesn't technically have any biological sex. With enough skill, her base code can be changed, provided she trusts you enough and gives permission.
A Golden Desert Eagle with a Radioactive symbol etched in both the handle and barrel. Duke Nukem's prized pistol from a defunct game. Comes loaded, with two extra magazines.
The shining sword of legend...? Seems a little underpowered, but talk about legendary handling!
You can now see magic on its most fundamental and basic level and also see through walls. Also your eyes are now glass and glowing. Good luck understanding what you see.
The ability to harvest power and knowledge from the dead. Theft through murder, as granted by the sisters Sve Noc. Grows quickly.

A MAZ-543 Uragan 8x8 Transporter-Erector Launcher truck with an R-17 Elbrus tactical ballistic missile. No magic involved. Comes with one missile. Does not auto-restock. Comes with a full tank of gas.

Exactly as stated. Comes with 5 missiles. If the Scud-B Launcher (R-17 Elbrus) is present, also comes with all equipment necessary to reload the truck. User is given the knowledge necessary to load the missiles.

MAZ-543 Uragan 8x8 Transporter-Erector Launcher truck with an R-17 Elbrus tactical ballistic missile with a 5-70 kiloton nuclear warhead. No magic involved. Comes with one missile. Does not auto-restock. Comes with a full tank of gas.

Exactly as stated. Comes with 5 variable yield nuclear missiles. If the Scud-B Launcher (R-17 Elbrus) is present, also comes with all equipment necessary to reload the truck. User is given the knowledge necessary to load the missiles.
A peanut butter and jelly sandwich. Tastes good.
A below-ground nuclear missile silo. Don't ask how it got there. Accommodates all ICBMs and ICBM-shaped missiles made up until the year 2026, as well as anything smaller. Empty.

A below-ground nuclear missile silo. Don't ask how it got there. Accommodates all ICBMs and ICBM-shaped missiles made up until the year 2026, as well as anything smaller. Select one singular missile to be housed within.
You get one free nuclear missile of your choosing. If you do not have either a full or empty Nuclear Missile Silo, the missile exists in an inventory until summoned.
The UNCF Yamato from the Space Battleship Yamato remake series, circa 2199. Contains Analyser. Exists in inventory space until summoned. Does not go back.

Congratulations! You are now the owner of an izakaya! It accommodates 40 patrons in the main area, has a record player, a fully stocked kitchen, an employee break room, and a refrigerated basement with cargo elevator. Once a week, a magic doorway opens to another realm bringing guests you can cook for.
You gain the modded version of Dagoth-Ur as your follower. You poor sod. No, he will not put clothes on.
A home in your name. Common room, small kitchen, two bedrooms, shared bathing area. Cozy. Inviting. Warm. Customizable. Adds onto any owned property.
An entity known as the Web has ported every entity from the Magnus Archives into your world. Good Luck. More of a curse, really...
The coziest blanket in existence. Indestructible. Perfectly comfortable. Comes with a plushie of your liking.

Fairy Britain's Child of Prophecy, Artoria Caster. Functionally the version from Lostbelt 6: Avalon le Fae. Not dependent on you as a Servant normally is for mana and is her own person. She has access to all her skills she possessed in life.

A pink haired fox girl in a leather catsuit. She is hyper competent in all manner of skills befitting a successful business woman, professional assassin and sexy secretary. She has access to all her Skills as an Assassin class servant. Requires effort to maintain your bond.

Fairy Knight Lancelot, Melusine is a short and charming knight, born from the decaying corpse of Albion the last dragon. As your familiar she is strong, fast and merciless to your enemies. She has access to all her abilities as her Lancer self, and is not dependent on your mana to continue existing. Requires effort to maintain bond.

A goddess made flesh, the daughter of Yamata-no-Orochi. A care free big sister type, but don't mistake her for being harmless. 3 meters tall, with purple skin and teal and pink hair. Has access to all the skills and abilities her Saber, Berserker and Ruler selves had and more. Is not dependent on you for mana. Requires effort to maintain your bond.

One syringe containing a vial of DETERMINATION equal to about one half of one of the 6 Human SOULs. Increases your ability to survive certain death, also improves magical potency and resistance against time manipulation. WARNING: Do not inject inside inorganic beings.

You gain Ereshkigal, Sumerian Goddess of the Underworld as your ally. A goddess made flesh with access to the many powers she holds as Kur's Queen. Is not reliant on you to supply mana. Requires effort to maintain your bond.
A blonde space cop wielding a magic mecha armor spacesuit. Has access to all her skills as a Foreigner class Servant but does not require you to supply mana. Requires effort to maintain your bond.

The pink haired paladin of Charlemagne is summoned as your ally. He has all the abilities of his Rider and Saber selves. Not dependent on you to maintain his existence. Requires effort to maintain your bond.

Artoria Pendragon, the King of Knights is summoned as your ally. Has all her abilities as a Saber servant with the bonus of also having Avalon. Does not depend on you to provide her mana. Is still an extreme glutton. Requires effort to maintain your bond.

Artoria Pendragon, the Goddess Rhongomyniad is summoned as your ally. Wields the Lance of World's End, Rhongomyniad, and the might of a goddess born from King Arthur. Has the powers of her Lancer and Ruler selves. Does not require you to supply her magic. Still an extreme glutton. Requires effort to maintain your bond.

Medusa the Gorgon of Greek myth is summoned as your ally. Goddess of the earth and a mother of monsters. Appears as her Rider self, is capable of using her kaiju-sized Gorgon form. Has access to her abilities of her Rider, Lancer, and Avenger forms and more. Is not dependent on you to supply her magic. Requires effort to maintain your bond.

Barghest, the Fairie Knight Gawain, is summoned as your ally. Possesses all the abilities she had in life, except for the ability to become the Calamity. Is not dependent on you to supply her magic. Requires effort to maintain your bond

The Yokai protector of Himeji Castle, Osakabehime is a huge NEET! Capable of summoning hordes of shikigami to do battle, can also bring forth Himeji Castle as a reality marble. Has all her skills as her Assassin and Archer selves. Is not dependent on you to supply her magic. Requires effort to maintain your bond.

Vritra from Indian myth is an Evil Dragon with great mystic powers beyond most others. Also has all her abilities as her Lancer class self. Is not dependent on you to supply her magic. Requires effort to maintain your bond.

The Witch of Betrayal is summoned as your ally. A master of magics lost to the modern era, capable of using Divine Words to enforce her will upon reality. Possesses mystic knowledge beyond the abilities of her Caster and Lily selves.Is not dependent on you to supply her magic. Requires effort to maintain your bond.

The orange haired, kitsune foxwife, Tamamo-no-Mae! A divinely blessed spell caster, wielding ofuda and the sacred mirror. Connected to Amaterasu-no-Omikami as her daughter. Has all the powers of her Caster and Lancer selves. Is not dependent on you to supply her magic. Requires effort to maintain your bond.

Beast VI S Queen Draco is summoned as your ally. Appears in her larval form, in her red dress. Has access to her powers as Sodom's Beast and Queen Draco forms, can shift to any of the bodies at will. Is not dependent on you to supply her magic. Requires effort to maintain your bond.

Within one hour of starting an adventure, event, quest, or similar thing you may declare you are using this exclusion. When used, said adventure in its entirety is considered by all parties as not counting and not to be spoken about. You gain no fame, renown, or any form of recognition from any actions performed during said event, but will maintain items you personally aquired during such. This also doesn't wipe or remove being wanted by police, drug lords, or anyone you otherwise caused issues. Though they won't actively go after you directly as a result of the event- they must encounter you at another point afterward. The exlusion is consumed on use, but you can roll another.
10 50ml bottles of Fireball Cinnamon Whiskey (Warning: Not a fireball, this is a drink)
10 50ml bottles of liquid Fireball spell (Warning: Not a drink, this is a fireball)

I didn't ask how big the room was, I said, I CAST FIREBALL! Launch a bolt of fire from your fingertip up to 400ft with a 20 foot radius spherical explosion on impact. Hits with maximum damage at the center, 50% at the very edges. Ignites flammable objects.

A Black Combat harness that contains many utility pouches and three slots in each side for explosives. They can hold more ammo and explosives than they are physically capable of without encumbering the user. Getting another will simply double the amount of ammunition and explosives that you can hold.

A thin wooden box. When opened it will reveal a set of cigars that the user desired, said cigars can be modified to not have any negative side-effects and even have different tastes. When closing and opening the box it will make a new set of cigars appear.
A cardboard pack of nondescript bubblegum. When opened it will show a few pieces of bubblegum that the user prefers. When closed and opened again spawns another set of bubblegum.
Generic servants wearing high cut leotards. They do not have their brainwashing guns, but could rebuild them with materials. They do a weird dance sometimes.

A pack of four genetically engineered Velociraptors named Blue, Delta, Echo, and Charlie. They are trained and can follow simple commands. They are led by Blue, who is exceptionally intelligent and empathic. Blue can follow more complex commands and ride herd on the other three.
The entire classic Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria. Just dropped on the nearest empty space that can fit it.
A singular seed pack that will grow a random plant from hit series Plants Vs Zombies when planted. Once planted, changes the seed packet to that plant type permanently.

At any time, you may place a Constraint upon yourself. In exchange you Amplify either yourself or an ally based on the level of Constraint. Removing your ability to move your left index finger won't provide much power, but temporarily putting yourself completely unconcious will provide an immense boost of power.

We here at Fazbear Entertainment are not at fault for having turned your body into one of our expertly crafted Endoskeletons. Neither we are at fault that your soul may have possesed the Endoskeleton and given it far more fexibility and paranormal abilities than it should ever have. Please look at clause 1-9b-87A as you can clearly see you can't sue us. As a gesture of goodwill, we will offer you one of our existing mascot suits to wear for free! A custom suit may be ordered, but such a thing will require additional payment.

You're been turned into a Twili. What's more, you've been futher cursed into a Twili Imp. You are exceptionally short, with long hair and an overly large bottom. Your hair is prehensile and entirely under your control, even able to lengthen or shorten at will. Suitable to attack... or reach high shelves. This form comes with levitation and the ability to become and travel through shadows, though the touch of the sun severly weakens you and light based attacks risk destroying you entirely. Darkness or shadow based magical powers come far more easily to this form.

Whenever you enter combat, a bar will suddenly appear. Performing stylish actions will increase the rating, while repeating the same thing will decrease it. This bar goes from 'Dull' to 'Smokin' Sexy Style', and each rank is declared by an unseen bombastic announcer. At the conclusion of the fight you will gain a monetary reward based on your rating.

Everything bar your bones has decided you are rather icky and they no longer wish to be associated with you. On one hand, this has not resulted in your death, on the other, you are now an animate skeleton. You can no longer eat, drink, breathe, or perform other functions which require present internal organs. Nor do you need to do any of those to continue your existence. Unfortunately, you don't have any natural protection on your bones, and need to continue to utilize things which are necessary to keeping them strong. Mostly by pouring them on yourself. You do not qualify as undead, cursed, or anything else to divine, mystical, or other senses.
A vial of 100 pills that increase endurance and fertility in bed. Try not to take more than one at a time.
A bag of candies that taste like scrap metal. Bolsters user's defense for 30 minutes.
A sponge capable of holding up to a billion liters of water within. Does not increase in size or weight despite that.

Hells claim you. You are now an unholy monster- a demon that can only sustain herself off of sexual fluids. Oh, you're a girl if you weren't before. You are supernaturally tempting, able to charm people by your very presence and utilize magic to do so more forcefully. Shapeshifting comes naturally, but exclusively into things generally considered 'sexy' by the public or into something considered as such by a specific individual you are around. As a bonus, your strength, speed, and balance are increased and you gain some ability with a whip and dancing- especially pole dancing. Divine and mystical sources identify you as a demon, and anti-demon objects will work on you.
A simple bottle of slimy lotion that never runs out. Must be squeezed out manually. Tampering just breaks the effect.
A crowbar used to kill unfathomable amounts of aliens and mutated enemies. Nearly unbreakable. Does extra damage to nonhuman enemies
A 3kg iron sword capable of changing shape while retaining mass. Destroyed or detached parts lose the effect. Reforging the sword removes the effect as well.

A set of armor and weapons wielded by the Black Knights of Lordran. Comes with a greatsword, battle axe, halberd, sword, shield, and a full set of plate armor that perfectly fits. A tyrannosaurus rex. Genetically modified, because that was an amazing idea. Rexy is smart enough to determine friend and foe and learn. Oddly stealthy. Also exceptionally territorial and not very interested in roaming.

Wuzzah! Your arms are now large springs and your pupils have twisted into spirals. Gain vastly increased upper body strength, even more increased punching strength, and much less improved lower body strength. Your arms can stretch a large distance and can maneuver mid strike in ways that are unintuitive to anything that doesn't consider your entire arm length a movement point. Switching out your fists for other weapons is possible, but you must research and aquire them yourself.
A black apron with the word "SATAN" embroidered on the front in white. Enhances your ability to learn cooking skills, especially pancakes.
A shotgun used to fight demons and evil spirits. Can gun down intangible entities. Extra damage against Unholy entities
The black and white robes of a clergyman. Durable enough to resist daily wear and tear. Minor resistance to darkness, curses, negative energy, and evil when worn.
The black and white robes of a nun. Durable enough to resist daily wear and tear. Minor resistance to darkness, curses, negative energy, and evil when worn.
Punish me daddy, I've been naughty~ Sexy nun robes that grant minor defense against unholy, darkness, evil, curses, and negativity. You decide what they look like and how revealing they are.
A bottle of high quality milk from Malon. Restores vitality and vigor when drunk.
The skill of a novice actor. You improve much faster at acting than others. You can hide emotion and portray a character, but you're no expert
The skill of a novice programmer. You improve much faster at programming than others. You can make simple programs and understand code in any coding language you've seen
The skill of a novice chemist. You improve much faster at chemistry work than others. You can make basic chemicals in a lab and know a fair amount of compounds.

The skill of a novice at stealth. You can mask your footsteps, sneak up on people, check for traps, and gather information discreetly. You're no expert, though.
The skill of a novice artist. You improve much faster at the arts than others. You are a beginner at painting, engraving, sculpting, sketching, etc. You've got a long way to go.
Time moves as you move. The faster you move, the faster time progresses. While you stand still, time stands still. It is possible for people to break out of or ignore this effect.
You are now a master of boiling and cooking crab, prawn, lobster, and other crustaceans in general. You are invited to the crawfish boil. As the head chef.
You now have an anime character's amount of blood in you. Prepare to gush like a fountain when injured.
You now have a much larger presence, even if your physical body is small, people will think you tower over them.
Your teeth are big, durable, and strong. You can literally chew rocks like it's nothing. You never have to worry about dental health again, and your teeth will grow back slowly when broken.
You can wear whatever you want with no legal moral consequences. People might be uncomfortable though. Yes, that includes nudity.
You can now create a very distinct, eye catching, and distracting aura around yourself. The opposite of stealth.

You now have a second jump in mid-air, as if the air itself is solid for just one moment. Landing does not hurt you as long as you land at the same height you started. After that, it's up to your own ability to handle a fall.
Allows you to design, modify, and build any tech related to ranged weapons. Starts mundane, increases with access to better materials and tools.
Allows you to induce lactation on targets within line of sight. Only works on mammals or other creatures capable of producing milk. Anything with tits, really.

Heaven has closed the gates and Hell has barred your entry. No afterlife will accept you, your soul left to wander the mortal world for all time. Just avoid any attacks which can harm or trap your soul.
You can stretch your tongue to dozens of meters long. Use it as a whip, another limb, a restraint... something else... hint hint.
A man-sized, rideable wolf. Default female. Very strong, tough, and vicious.
A cute, round sheep Pokemon that rolls around a lot and has fast growing, luxurious wool. Not... particularly intelligent. Does not come with a pokeball.

A weird, square chicken. Comes in one of three varieties. Immune to fall damage. Lays one egg every five to ten minutes regardless of sustenance. Eggs thrown at the ground have a 12.5% chance of spawning another chicken. Both egg and chicken meat taste great. Start with one breeding pair. Eats seeds and other chicken related things. Doesn't poop, though...?

A literally holy cow. Large, healthy, always lactating. Can be milked for up to 50 liters of milk a day depending on food consumption. Milk provides health benefits, is nutrient dense, and is low grade holy water. The holiness breeds true.

An alligator that's a master of the stock market and the free market. Guaranteed to reap large returns. This one's really stretching the gator joke...
When interacting with someone through any medium, you may phyiscally interact with them through that medium. So yes, you can punch that internet troll in the face through their computer screen.
A gold amulet with a ruby gem in the center. Slightly increases vitality and health.
Temporarily grants a skill or minor ability best suited for the situation at hand. Cannot be higher rated than The Fool.

Permanently fuse two abilities of the same rank and receive an appropriate ability one rank higher
Grants all 22 Major Arcana Tarot Cards at once, and their effects.
