A bowl containing an endless amount of hot and fresh spaghetti that you can always take more servings from. Comes with sauce, meatballs, and all the parmesan on top you could ever want.
A can of unbranded cola that causes anyone who drinks it immense agony for five minutes straight. Only really good for pranks?
A briefcase with lightweight metal armor, a double barreled shotgun with 20 packs of 20 shells, 4 basic repair kits, and 5 stim packs
Affection in a token. Rip it and the person you think about likes you a little more via retcon and causality bending. No side effects but your own guilt.
A bottle of pitch black perfume that erases all scent from the user and moderately muffles all movements and actions for 1 hour
A Shen Gong Wu coin as a simple pendant. Flip the coin and you gain incredible acrobatic skills, even jumping multiple stories at once.

A really tactical, cool, durable, high quality trench coat guaranteed to not make you look like a loser. Has pockets that are ten times bigger on the inside. You always know what you're looking for in them.
The rock that Arthur pulled the sword from. Indestructible to anything below A rank damage. Also still a big heavy rock just about 3 feet tall and wide at the base. Makes you more kingly, supposedly.
A king's sword. High quality, proof of your divine right to rule the British Isles. Emits flashes of light when drawn in combat. Onlookers will inexplicably think of you as both a king and Welsh.
A king's sword. High quality, proof of your divine right to rule the British Isles. Emits flashes of light when drawn in combat. Onlookers will inexplicably think of you as both a king and Welsh.
A king's sword. High quality, proof of your divine right to rule the British Isles. Emits flashes of light when drawn in combat. Onlookers will inexplicably think of you as both a king and Welsh.
A magic, holy scabbard. Its owners wounds do not bleed, preventing exsanguination in battle.
A job application form that, when filled out properly, guarantees hiring at any job you choose. Not guaranteed to keep it though. One use only.
A fishing rod that lures in fish automatically, no bait needed. More likely to attract powerful sea dwelling creatures more than not.
A frosty, bitter metahuman with powers of cold and ice, seeking revenge for a wrongful death (Hers). Very good at killing people in multiple ways with her powers.
A frosty, bitter metahuman with powers of cold and ice, seeking revenge for a wrongful death (Crystal's). Very good at killing people in multiple ways with her powers.
A frosty, bitter metahuman with powers of cold and ice, seeking revenge for a wrongful death (Her own, kinda). Very good at killing people in multiple ways with her powers.

A set of black and red armor with rose heraldry originally used by Maple in New World Online. When destroyed the armor will automatically reform on the wearer stronger than it was previously. Give excellent boosts to defense and vitality. Also grants the ability for the user to turn into a massive four-armed demon that oddly resembles a pillbug. This form serves as a second life, and dying in this form will simply return you back to your state immediately prior to using the ability. You gain no equipment bonuses while in this form.

Congratulations! You have now become a mass of dark energy/matter born from a condensation of negative emotions! You can fly, possess people, copy elemental abilities, shapeshift, and more! However you are significantly more prone to spiraling into darker emotions and will be far weaker to attacks that use positive or heartfelt emotions! Don't let the Power of Friendship erase you from existence!
Whenever a fight begins a song begins playing. Acting in time with the beat of the song enhances your actions.

When in a fight, you will see a white flash or similar indicator on occasion. Hitting that spot, or acting at that specific timing, will result in your attack dealing double damage! Though your enemy can notice these flashes as well and even figure out what they mean. Potentially allowing them to use them to trap you or predict your movements.

Breasts are large, women are lesbian, and the men are generally unseen. Welcome to Kuugenland, enjoy your stay. Oddly less skimpy than expected. Expect opportunities for (boob) growth, lesbians, people starting businesses for passion, universal basic income, and lesbians. Yes, it really does have to be stated twice.

Originium is a semi-transparent black stone-like substance with a glowing yellow core that can be used as an immensely potent power source and incredibly large data storage. Within the mass of Originium is the Assimilated Universe, where all of the information Originium records is stored, preserved, and can be altered or restored. Now it is under your control. While Originium can serve as effectively a variant of stone control, it's true power is in the reality altering properties and information storage. Properly using Originium, typically through a medium, allows people to use Arts- magic that can be studied, understood and taught. When Originium comes into contact with biological matter, it will assimilate that matter into itself, creating a record of the entirety of that entity within the Assimilated Universe that you can do what you wish with- people included. This is not a fast process, and you can control or stop it. Being infected in this way allows naturally casting Arts without study, potentially to an extremely powerful degree. Though at the cost of worsening Oripathy and eventually leading to death. Your body is also stored there, and can be altered just the same as anything else, as well as serving as a backup should you be horrifically injured or die.

A Sarkaz subrace- the Nachzehrer are generally slender, favoring robes and flowing fabric. They are most known for their predisposition to cannibalism and magic relating to causing necrosis in living organisms. While it is possible to resist this instinct, the hunger will never fade and you will eternally smell of decay should you partake. Often called 'Lords of War', a practived Nachzehrer is a terrifying opponent that rots and consumes their enemies to continually get stronger.

Roll a number between 1-65. You are now the Protoframe of that specific Warframe. The transformation will be painful and take days, but you will be blessed with the default abilities of whatever Warframe you've become. You can train to improve those abilities beyond their in-game use. You keep your fun bits, btw, but they might be a little weird looking after the transformation. Choose your own appearance.

Boku wa Docutah! Tony Tony Chopper! The Doctor of the Strawhats, Tony Tony Chopper is a genius in medicinal and pharmecutical work, and can also transform himself using his Rumble Balls. With the correct materials and modifications, he can improve his Rumble Balls to increase their effects. He comes with Nine Transformations, or Points. But Monster Point should only be used in an emergency. You'll have to work for him to consider you Nakama, Chopper has a hard time trusting.

A small leatherbound booklet that smells of the sea. It is filled with many strange recipes for food that grant the consumer the knowledge on how to use incredible barehanded techniques! The ingredients can be a bit exotic, but you can still find them.

Two water buckets that when splashed on the ground will create a seventy five centimeter deep pool of water. If both water buckets are used in a specific pattern, it will create infinite source of water. The buckets can also be used to contain any form of liquid from powdered snow to milk to lava.

A result of perfected alchemical process, a blade held delicately in the twilight of light and dark. Prevents curses and blindness from ailing the user and does both light and dark damage. Its true purpose is to kill what cannot die.

A 'magical' longsword used by an old royal wizard, capable of blasting waves of magic born from the moon. Its time under the well of madness has increased its potency against those that neither dream nor remain logical.
A dark steel hilt that, when held with conviction, will emit a flaming blade from the ricasso. It can illuminate any area you are in, except underwater.
A ring with that enhances the caster's jump ability for 2 seconds per jump. Be cautious of where you land.
A sentient pair of shoes/horse. Suppresses bloodfiend characteristics and maintains the illusion of humanity.
When you roll a race change on the Gacha, it now becomes a physical card. Anyone holding the card can use it to apply the race change to themselves. Single use per card created.

Gives you a single use Evoker with a pawprint on the side. Yes, you must shout "Fursona!" when using it. Changes you directly into your fursona. If you don't have one, it assigns a random animal to be your fursona. You get to pick the design, at least.
A spear made of crystals that are stronger than steel. Can be used to cast magic, like a wand/staff
A bunny ear headband and matching tail buttplug. Increases charisma and sex appeal.
A hip bag woven from bronze thread, able to contain a thousand pounds worth of items. You automatically know how to find anything inside.
You have a decent talent at any martial art you try. You could beat most people in a fight outside of professional fighters. Improves learning speed
You can solve any math problem up to the level you've already learned in your head. Might take a bit, but it's not hard.
You have a decent talent with any blunt weapon you try. You could beat most people in a fight outside of professional fighters. Improves learning speed
You can fuck pretty well and know what a clitoris is, putting you solidly above the average person at sex.
You can perform first aid, apply medicine, know what most medicines do, and improvise basic medical tools for field procedures. Improves learning speed.
You're very healthy. Increases vitality, virility, and removes previous health complications prior to gaining this token.
Your blood functions as high quality fuel/power, allowing you to run anything that requires its own power source. Including electronics.
You can now substitute full body exercise with sex. Applies benefits after sex has ended, effect scales with quality of sex.
Telekinetically control water with enough strength to remove moisture and act as a water gun
Create and control winds strong enough to injure or knock someone off their feet
You can detect metals around you like a mental radar. The more valuable, the more distinct its presence. Starts with a 10 meter radius.
You can change any cosmetic thing about your appearance, ability color, hair color, pupil shape, skin tone, etc.

Conjure a longsword sized leaf blade. Abnormally durable, razor sharp, still not as durable as normal steel. Also conjure smaller leaves as projectiles. Leaves are permanent, but lose lethality over time.

Encase targets in bubbles that slowly float upwards or hover in place. Each bubble is roughly as durable as 1cm thick glass (scales with power level). Damaged bubbles pop and vanish. Encasing yourself allows you to control movement direction.
Augment your fists with energy, allowing even a normal man to shatter bricks and punch through stone walls. Not very efficient. More energy spent means more power.
Control your own hormones at will, increase concentrations or lower them, regulate mood, cause bodily changes, so on and so forth. Be careful with your regulations.
Use your soul's energy to fire a mildly homing arrow at enemies. Power scales with soul's power and energy levels.
Grow ethereal roots into the ground to drain energy and nutrients from the soil and increase vitality/energy regeneration. Roots you in place while in use.
A powerful snowy white tiger. Powerful and smart, larger than lions, big enough to ride. Default female.

A group of skeletons that can play any instrument and comes with its own equipment. Cannot enter combat, cannot be harmed. Summon and pick a playlist for them to play. They fall apart and reassemble comedically when struck.
A regular looking goose that lays a golden egg every 24 hours. Will be gold unless the egg is fertilized.
A giant angry rectangular boulder creature that moves in straight lines. Really likes crushing things below it. Summon as a hazard or a wall. Repairs itself when desummoned.

A massive ant colony of literal carpenter ants. When provided with proper materials, they can build a house in a single day and expand by recycling wood waste. Might even build a town in a day when big enough.
A bag of endless shitty copper. Contains 1000 tons at a time.
An exact replica of your body. Has no DNA or genetics. It's just a flesh puppet that looks exactly like you.
10 boxes of 20 pink strawberry wafer cookies each. Eating one cookie swaps your sex for 24 hours. Eating 20 in one day makes it permanent.
Both a serrated saw and a massive cleaver. Great at slaying beasts. Extra damage against beasts and beastlike enemies.
An indestructible MP3 player with great sound quality. Plays any song you've heard of before and records automatically.

A piece of paper that makes anyone who looks at it see what they expect or want to see, such as ID, permits, badges, etc. Doesn't work on smart people, people with no imagination, or anyone far more powerful than you.
Rip the voucher to receive a detailed doctor's note about your physical condition, plus several possible treatment plans for any conditions you might have.

Tear the voucher to teleport to a 4 cubic meter bunker in another dimension for 8 hours. The bunker is fully stocked with water and MREs and resembles a prison cell. You can be tracked by spatial manipulation abilities. You cannot escape without spatial manipulation. Teleports you back after 8 hours.
Tear the voucher to receive a real life (2026 or prior) gun of your choice. You receive one magazine for that weapon every 24 hours.
A pair of stylish glasses that suppress eye based abilities and magic. Makes the user resilient to eye based abilities as well. Doesn't work if the ability is too powerful.

Somewhere in your world, probably Japan or the closest analogue, is a secret ninja academy/headquarters of the Taimanin, demon slaying ninjas. Most of them are women, and all of them dress in really sexy latex suits. Also, there's a lot of horny demons now. Good luck with that.

Administrator [Naive Faust] cordially invites you to join The Gesellschaft, a space for Fausts to share knowledge and compile it together to know it all. Snaust is a strange small snail-like being with a human head that resembles Faust. She may not be the smartest, but Snaust likes learning about many things, she also likes reading (and people reading things to her), sweets, and fruits.
Propeller Hat with a Large Lollipop

A propeller hat and a large rainbow lollipop of your favorite flavor. Putting on the hat and licking the candy will result in you regaining whimsy and remembering that the world is a kind place and everything can always get better.

From now on, all your pockets, bags or objects that are meant to hold something will have a larger space than what they should realistically be capable of without encumbering you. The space inside each will become larger the higher your base stats get.

Almost a curse, but not quite- pollution and negativity in your world now form into thematically appropriate demons straight from Okami and Japanese myth. Defeat them and their boss monsters in the area and regrow guardian saplings to purify the area and return both life and peace to the land.

Somewhere in your world is a largely defunct company that specializes in creating mass produced sex bots either modeled after attractive celebrities, or left faceless and visibly robotic. Also, there are a lot of security bots, some of which have titties too. Take control and reactivate the facility to gain an army of big titty thicc bootied robot women.

Somewhere in your world there is a village named Ingnam, near which is a portal to the Demon Realm of Mareth- a world of corruption, lust, sex, mutation, magic, violence, and conflict. Entering is easy. Leaving is nearly impossible. Beware how long you stay. You may not want to return anyway.

Somewhere in your world is a gateway to the world of Savarra- a whole plane and world of its own with empires, magic, gods, corruption, and marauding demons from Mareth- and all worlds connected to it. Take care how long you stay- you might not want to come back, even if given the chance.

Your world is now just one new planet within the entire United Galactic Confederacy- though you don't exactly know it yet. Once you or your civilization reach the level of space travel, the entire galaxy and all its wonders, drugs, sex, weirdness, mutations, corruption, and weird mutant corruption sex drugs are at your fingertips.
Hell is real, and it is horny as FUCK. It's still a demon invasion, but at least you get to fuck them instead of just getting ripped to pieces or tortured for eternity, right?

Bundle of Minecraft Food and Seeds

A green leather bundle that contains one of each food, seed, plant and sapling in Minecraft. Their growth speed is the same in game, taking less than a week to fully grow (less if you are using compost/fertilizer or Bone meal), and guarantees you will always get more of it when you harvest.

The evil organization Dark Mother appears in your world, ruled by the mysterious (and always lactating) Phantom Lady and her many sexy female minions and generals! Their goals are mysterious, evil, and usually involve a lot of women getting sexually assaulted. Fighting them as well are the Angels! Angel Blade, Angel Ender, and Angel Beretta, the mostly naked (extremely lesbian) heroines of justice, love, and flashing their holes for literally everyone to see! Every human or sapient being in the world is now a thematically appropriate, usually quite sexually attractive and horny, anthropomorphic animal. Usually their own fursona, unless they didn't have one. The world is also way more sexually charged and open to public kink and sex as a result. You are the only one aware of the change. Every time you purge a place of unholy, dark, evil, or negative entities, you receive one Guardian Sapling. Plant it and allow it space to grow, and it will prevent further incursions from such entities. It even clears up pollution and sickness.

All of your gacha tokens now take the form of playing cards shuffled in random order at the start of each combat, allowing you to use ability combos faster and more easily than before, at the cost of randomness in your draw pattern. Standard deckbuilder rules apply during combat- discard pile, graveyard, draw pile, etc. The more tokens you get, the more cards you can play.

A tube of Saibamen pods. When grown in high quality soil, they become far more powerful, even enough to rival beings capable of blowing up planets. These ones are modified to be slightly more intelligent and less likely to attack those that grow them.

A 1 cubic meter metal cage with faces decorating all six sides. When some kind of egg, juvenile, or other small creature is placed within, the spawner will light up with flames and begin creating fully grown duplicates of that creature en masse. Creatures must be less than 6x the size of the user. Once placed, it cannot be moved again. Killed duplicate creatures drop "XP" orbs that slowly rank up your stats as well as appropriate items for their type, ie sheep drop mutton and wool, cows drop beef, zombies drop rotten flesh, etc.
You can now recreate and, eventually, improve upon the technology of the Gem Empire provided you have the tools and materials. Ships, warp pads, buildings, weapons, etc.

You are now a big, lesbian, probably gigantic rock with a hardlight body and all the challenges that come from being 20+ feet tall in a world of humans. At least you can sing, dance, and have demigod-like powers. Pick a color, try to be original about your Diamond powers.

You can recreate the technology of the spiral races- Gunmen of all sizes, city ships, moon sized robots capable of FTL, ships that can target the universe itself. Grants a spark of Spiral Energy. Cultivate it well, or you won't get anywhere. Your starting point is a single handheld digging drill, once used by a little boy in a hole.
You are smart enough to know when you're not built for a situation, and when your plot armor is paper thin. You have an easier time running from fights.

In any situation in which you are outnumbered you may call for your crew. Upon doing so a number of generic thugs, themed after yourself and fitting your preferences, will step out of any available cover until you now outnumber your enemy. These crew members have no special powers, but scale between half to three quarters of your own physical ability. They may carry simple melee weapons, which they can use to similar scaling to your own skill.

One single opponent and yourself are sent to an alternate dimension completely separate and unassailable from the outside. Once there you will continue whatever challenge is happening completely free of any interference. The dimension will supply all necessary objects, but these objects cannot be removed from the area. Bar completed products, should they need to be judged by a separate party as part of the challenge.

This allows you to transform into a Bakudan. Short, stubby legs, horns shaped like hooks, and the ability to create balls of explosives, these little guys pack a mean punch, but not much else. It'll take a lot of creativity to make good use of this form.

You have a signature weapon! This weapon can be anything you want, from a pair of knuckle dusters to an orbital kill sat, and everybody knows its yours. If it shows up, everybody will be convinced that you had a hand in it, regardless of the truth. You innately know how to make it, repair it, and care for it. It isn't immune to being destroyed, but you will quickly find yourself obtaining just enough resources to remake it and are incapable of using those resources for anything else.

This allows you to transform into a Krock, an armored lizard creature that can roll itself into a spiked ball to gain momentum. This momentum can build up hard enough to strike through walls, and if you can find yourself on two rails, you can increase your speed even further. Very defensive, but the offense is lacking.
No Kings, No Gods, No Masters

You cannot be held to any agreement, bound in any manner, or otherwise be forced to accept the words or actions of another. This doesn't prevent you from getting harmed or temporarily imprisoned, but you'll always get out eventually. Even the one true God couldn't keep you trapped or force you to do anything. You can still sign contracts, they just don't mean anything to you.
Allows you to eat food to actively heal your body from any damage you've taken. Doesn't fix limbs, but does fix stabs or blunt force trauma.

To be a Shaman requires many things, but the most important of all is Furyoku. Through Furyoku, you may follow at least one of the Schools of Shaman training, gaining the ability to commune with long dead spirits as the bridge between the human world, and the world of Gods and Spirits. Oversouls, Shikigami, Necromancy, Witch arts. These and more are all possible.

You are now entirely composed of ink. Your base form is that of a squid or octopus, but you can transform into a humanoid form. Naturally generate ink, which is venomous, and can be used to paint things or create objects and weapons with training. You can fit through incredibly small spaces and submerge yourself in ink, which significantly increases your natural ink generation and rapidly heals you. Falling into enough water will kill you, anything pool sized or larger.

All of your bodily fluids are now neon colored, UV reactive, and glow in the dark. This has no effect on your health or biology beyond the cosmetic. You may choose colors when you roll this, but the choice is permanent.

A magical top hat. When you reach your hand inside you can pull out anyone or anything you know the exact location of, so long as it isn't too large. This does not give you the strength to actually pull them through the hat, just the opportunity.

A 450m long flagship and migratory spaceship with a full complement of weaponry, fighters, and other resources needed to fly a long expedition. Resides in a pocket space until removed, at which point it can no longer be recalled. Being removed on a planet will put it in a safe orbit above such planet and place a landing craft in the nearest free space that can auto pilot you into the ship.

The more intense the bond of trust, friendship, and love between you and your companions, the stronger you both are. Starts small, but can achieve the impossible so long as you believe you can do so. Also makes you capable of concieving children together, regardless of potential impossiblity.
An exceptionally large dildo with a handle. Useful as a baseball bat. It wiggles menacingly.

The Ultimate Despair. An extremely perceptive and intelligent teenager capable of enacting an apoctalyptic scenario with nothing but the two aforementioned skills. Consistently bored with people, being capable of figuring out how someone will react in most any circumstance- bar when in despair. Completely fetishizes the emotion as a result, both wanting to feel it and have others feel it. To the point of self-sabotage. Otherwise often switches her personaliy and presentation as the mood suits her and she gets bored with her current one. Will react positively to being told how she died in her world.

Gain access to the tech tree as given in the "Create" mod. Including all add-ons, such as aeronautics, estrogen, and etc. Automatically comes with a wrench, a set of cog wheels, some casings, and some shafts.

Beasts are for hunting, and now you have the tech to do it. Gain access to the technology and inventions of the Hunter's Workship, primarily featuring trick weapons. Uses a lot of blood and equally allows refining your own blood into an injected regenerative supplement.

The world is now a much more interesting place. No matter where you are, legends, rumors, and other oddities will exist. Some are fake, but a lot more are real. Be careful, and never trust a triangle.

A few curious seeds that, when planted, will grow into a single can of white Monster. Altering the seeds will make other types of Monster grow. More seeds can be obtained by letting the Monster grown by this seed bloom.

Become as tree. The Neti are a species of shapeshifting sentient plants that by default look like trees. You may survive through photosynthesis and water and can alter your size and shape at will, though you will always have bark for skin and a number of thin, branching arms. Lifespan is measured in thousands of years. You are Force Sensitive, and can train this into abilities such as mind reading, emotion reading, seeing the future (immediate or long term), manipulating or pushing things from a distance, and more.

You are now a short catgirl creature. As a comedic character, you are nearly indestructible and possess a wide range of powers including eye beams and fire breathing. Your voice is also squeaky and you have an irresistible urge to add 'nya' into your speech. As a bonus, the cafe Ahnenerbe will appear in the world, a place where parallel worlds converge. It's strawberry pie is considered unmatched.

You become an Affini, a biologically immortal alien plant being with some shapeshifting capability and incredibly enhanced multitasking. Also you can graft any plant to your body and synthesize drugs within your tissues as well. Increases compassion and desire to tentacle-fuck a drugged up transgender puppygirl. No, that is not a joke.

A magical artifact resembling a purple magnifying glass with three prongs along the top, the Lens of Truth will allow the user to see perfectly through all illusions and reveal the invisible. Using the Lens will slowly drain energy.

A carved and painted wooden mask depicting a Gerudo warrior. When worn the mask will fuse with the wearer's face and transform them into a Gerudo, an all female race of exceptionally tall amazons. The wearer can easily remove mask at any time.

A carved and painted wooden mask depicting a Goron. When worn the mask will fuse with the wearer's face and transform them into a Goron, a race of strong and friendly rock eaters. The wearer can easily remove mask at any time.

A carved and painted wooden mask depicting a Zora. When worn the mask will fuse with the wearer's face and transform them into a Zora, an amphibious race of fish people. The wearer can easily remove mask at any time.

A carved and painted wooden mask depicting a Rito. When worn the mask will fuse with the wearer's face and transform them into a Rito, a race of flying bird people. The wearer can easily remove mask at any time.

A carved and painted wooden mask depicting a Deku Scrub. When worn the mask will fuse with the wearer's face and transform them into a Deku Scrub, a small humanoid plant able to spit nuts from their mouth. The wearer can easily remove mask at any time.
A plastic pacifier sized for an adult. When suckled upon, it will cause a calming feeling of mindless serenity to infuse the user, dispelling all fears and anxieties.

A magic sword, that when drawn will split the wielder into four aspects of themselves. The aspects can act independently, but still maintain the goals and drives as the original. The aspects can fuse back together by all sheathing the sword.

Generate a Slime Core, the central (and only) organ of a slime. Your body melts, turning entirely into slime. You may choose what color/s you have as well as whether or not you have simple patterns. Gain the ability to alter your entire body and grow bigger when intaking water. So long as your core is not damaged, you cannot be injured by anything which targets your physical body. The interior of your body is highly acidic, though you can turn that off, and you can consume anything. Also you're biologically immortal, don't need to breathe, and float on water.
An unbreakable frying pan. Still a good cooking utensil. Hits really hard.
A cat tail buttplug. When worn properly, increases reflexes, agility, dexterity, and acrobatics. Reduces fall damage. Use lube.

These Prayer Beads signify your devotion, granting you increased holy power, and even an adjustment to your temper. You could reach Nirvana, provided you channeled your chakras to the right place, and yanked them out like you were ripstarting a lawn mower.

A magic peach tree. Every part of it is warded against evil, curses, and demons. A sword made from its wood could kill a ghost or a demon like steel through flesh. You receive one tree and 5 saplings.
You shoot guns as good as the average soldier. You improve faster with training, though.
You can do physics as well as a physics grad student. Mostly good for lab work.
You can manage your time and schedule enough that you could get a job as a secretary.
You have moderately increased reflexes and speed
Flying becomes instinctual. Flying abilities are more efficient. Does not actually grant flight. Sorry.
Your eyes are now very, very pretty. Does not actually make them magical.
Create and control ice with enough precision to make ice cubes or ice knives.
Conjure and control multiple bright light points. Consume more energy to make the lights semi-permanent
You now have four arms, obviously. You can control the new ones like you've always had them.
Receive detailed information about a target on touch
You have abnormally slippery skin, like you're constantly coated in oil without being oily. Makes you hard to grab.
Anyone you look at, you know their full inventory, what they're wearing, and what's on their body. Also, you know the approximate value of each item.
View the dreams of anyone in your sensory range. You can influence them by whispering in their ears.
Create delicious fruits, vegetables, and other harvestable crops by spending energy
You can make, modify, and design any mundane level of vehicle at current world's tech progression

Perform a gesture or action lasting longer than half a second to recover energy and stamina. Can only be done in combat. The longer the action, the better the results. Aggravation equals effectiveness.
A massive, mutated, four eyed wolf larger than a tank, capable of swallowing a grown man in one bite.
A cat that teleports freely and cannot stay dead. Like the nazi catboy, but less problematic. And less useful.
A seemingly immortal Dog that appears all around Post Apocalypse America, Dogmeat is a German Shephard, a very loyal friend, and a very good boy. Treat him well.
A minotaur lady with huge tits, big biceps, and a 7'7" tall frame. She's ridiculously strong, resistant to moderate heat, and lactates a lot. She's quite emotional and bad with names.
An alligator specialized in provocation and starting conflicts. Really good at enraging entire crowds with words alone.

An otherwise normal tortoise with the Stand "Mr. President", allowing anyone to access a room inside its shell with the right key. The room is pre-furnished and has a functional living space, but you must bring in your own food and equipment.

A bag of effectively endless fresh meat. You can take 100kg of any normal animal (ie, anything purchaseable from a real life meat market (as in, on an actual real meat catalog) (yes, this includes fish)) meat from the bag every 24 hours. Reach inside and grab it. Try not to think of where it comes from. Human meat is not available unless you're in a setting that explicitly allows it. Don't get prions, folks.
Invoke the scroll to call a 1km wide blizzard centered on you. Lasts 30 minutes. Does not affect you or allies.

An ornate fountain/spring that flows perpetually. Any water taken from the spring turns into a high quality liquor of your choice after 1 hour. Returning the booze to the fountain resets it to water again.

Retrieved from the Dungeon after the defeat of the Guardian, this Flail can extend far further then it should, and hits quite hard, hard enough to dent metal, crush stone, and shatter metal. Used correctly, it could be a powerful tool, but used incorrectly, and it's you who shall be the fool.

Tozama, or Slaughter Demon, is a Cursed Tool, containing enough Cursed Energy that even a non-Jujutsu Sorcerer could use it to Exorcise a Cursed Spirit. Though basic, it is a reasonably useful weapon, both for a novice or a skilled wielder.

A Trick Weapon crafted by the Hunter's Workshop. The bladed cane may be decoupled to turn into a whip. Though using it solely as a cane was considered an act of ceremony- a way to say that the bloodlust of the hunt would not consume them.
A can of soda that increases dexterity for one hour. Does not stack. You must drink the whole can. Do not drink more than 3 different buffing drinks at once. You will die.
A smart automatic handgun capable of firing homing shots. Also comes with an onboard AI that can and will judge you. He's a bit annoying, but means well. 5 magazines to start.
Clip on earrings that boost hearing to the level of a barn owl
3 ingots, 5kg each. Nichirin has absorbed sunlight and is super effective against all things weak to the sun. Amplifies heat and fire based abilities. Can be superheated without deforming.
Blades crafted of ciphers and light, they float above the fists of the wearer and lend strength to them. The greater your Myth, the more powerful they become.
You can make any basic weapon and tool in a forge (with dubious quality). You can accurately gauge the quality of any metalwork you have in person.
You're a damn good hairstylist, enough to get a job working for celebrities and the 1%. It's second nature at this point.
Passively increases all physical defenses slightly
You have a perfect internal clock down to the millisecond with perfect timing and memory for dates.
You are more flexible than an expert contortionist.
Heat up any object by touching it. The more energy you put in, the faster it heats up, and the more it heats up.
Create a sandstorm around yourself that hides your location and presence. You can see out of it fine.
Create and fire silent shadow darts with bullet-like force
Create balls of light that act as flashbangs. Extra painful for dark-aligned enemies

Ultra fine control over your own blood- pressurized bursts, guided arrows, knives, bullets, etc. You can only create more blood by having a physiology that converts energy to blood. Be careful not to die of blood loss.
Jump super high and super far at will. Leap tall buildings and such. You are also passively immune to fall damage.
If you know the location or address of where you want to go, you can see a line guiding you there
Cover your skin in a stone-like layer to increase durability and mass
Design, modify, and create technology based around augments and implants. At this level, you're limited mostly to medical grade implants at best.
Design, modify, and create technology based around physical defenses and shields. At this level, you're limited mostly to mundane barriers and bulletproof glass at best.
Allows you to make others think what you're saying is true. While active, you also cannot speak with intent to lie or deceive. Manifests as a glowing white choker.
Put a mark at your feet. While the mark is active, you can teleport back to that mark anytime. The further you go, the more energy it takes. Only one at a time.
View people in grayscale according to your morality- the darker the shade, the less moral they are by your own reckoning.
Expend health and energy to remotely detonate your blood into a conflagration. More vitality means more fire and force.
A pair of Alpha Deathclaws that, somehow, listen to you. They are a breeding pair. They're also incredibly strong and absorb radiation.
A gray slime creature that melts all things referred to as clothes. The more clothes melted, the stronger it gets. The Apex Predator of all clothing.
A reprogrammed Securitron capable of interfacing with tech and writing code. Armed with its own guns. Incapable of telling you no.
An android sent by Cyberlife. Strong, competent, really good at detective work, odd habit of licking things. May go rogue when under high stress.
The workhorse of the Clone Wars. Big, heavy, huge, strong, deadly. Armed with wrist blasters on both forearms. Start with 4, summon more as time goes on.
The apple shaped keepers of the forest. Supernaturally good at maintaining wilderness, forests, and farms. Start with 50, increases over time.
A wardrobe of fancy clothes that suit your tastes. Mends clothes automatically when not worn for 24 hours.
A pitcher that can pour out an endless amount of clean drinking water.
Inhale the powder to instantly be put into a deep sleep. Injury wakes the inhaler up instantly. Does not work on stronger foes.
It'd take a nuke to deform this baseball bat.
An infinite wardrobe full of any normal clothes you desire. Nothing too expensive or heavy, sorry! 50 outfits can be removed per day.
Really cool shades that detect when someone believes they're lying to you.
A can of soda that increases stamina for one hour. Tastes really sour. Does not stack. You must drink the whole can. Do not drink more than 3 different buffing drinks at once. You will die.
A Shen Gong Wu monocle shaped like a falcon's head. Grants super vision: X-ray, far sight, and dark sight all at once.
An M1 Garand that always shows up right when you need it and it ends up being useful. Can be modified without losing properties. Always shows up pristine and fully loaded.
Regular glasses that grant the metaphorical visual acuity of a hawk
A red dog collar that enhances olfactory abilities to bloodhound-like levels

A leather pouch containing 50 explosive tags. Each one goes off like a hunk of C4, enough to bust through walls and injure or kill enemy combatants from up to 15 feet away. Imbue with energy, then throw or set on a surface and RUN. Can be remote detonated with practice.
A bow once belonging to the Heroic Archer Pharis. Has a very long range, and slightly guides your own aim. Comes with 30 arrows.

O Lord, bless this thy hand grenade, that with it thou mayst blow thine enemies to bits, in thy mercy. Take out the Holy pin, count to three, then throw. Will snuff out thine foes who are naughty in God's sight with 1 kiloton of force.
A ball gag that silences all noises produced by the wearer. Good for spies and ninja. Still humiliating.
A green spandex suit that harnesses the power of YOUTH! Proudly wear it to gain extra bonuses to physical training and stamina recovery.
A platinum ring with a pink diamond. Increases comprehension and dexterity in all medical matters.
Rub the fumo against a sword to bless it with sharpness and anti-spirit properties
A fumo that never stays damaged, repairing itself instantly no matter what. Rub it against stuff to set that stuff on fire.
You can drive anything with a fair amount of skill, from cars to planes to boats
You just got your teaching degree! Good luck getting your students to engage.
You can use any polearm with decent effectiveness, but anyone who knows how to fight with one will beat you
You're more graceful and know how to dance properly now. You can fall with grace and dignity.
You're a damn good bartender and mixologist, good enough to get hired anywhere at a mundane level of skill. Still not as cool as that one japanese guy, though.
You're damn good at architecture to the point of designing entire cities aesthetically. Engineers hate you.
You're damn good at kidnapping people for... some... reason...?
You have slightly increased passive strength. Grows over time and applies to all strength buffs.
The opposite of the NSFW tag. Keeps everything around you PG-13 and hides the worst of reality from sight. Mostly your junk.
You always have your relevant papers and ID with you for whatever situation you're in. Extends to all allies when in the same group.
Your transformations, race changes, and body changes all stay aesthetically pleasing. To you, at least.
You always know your own condition, mentally and physically. Poison, depression, illness, injury, etc etc. You always know what's going on with you.
The great teachings of John the Boptist. You know the perfect way to headbutt someone, and your forehead is strengthened for that purpose. Shoebody BOP! Increases acapella skill for some reason.
No, not the trade. You just get higher electrical resistance and higher electric ability efficiency
I Can Quit Whenever I Want
You are immune to getting addicted to any substance, no matter how much it affects your brain.
Your spine is abnormally durable and hard to injure. Even if completely shattered, your spine heals properly far faster than any normal human

Every part of you is poison- flesh, bones, blood, energy, soul. The potency depends on your own stats. You are, thankfully, immune to your own poison. You might need something to regulate all this at will.
You can be sticky enough to cling to walls or prevent people from unsticking themselves from you. You can control your own stickiness. You're still no Spider-Man though.

Your body has been implanted with a Nameless Worm, transforming you into a Deadman. Your body has gained a 'Red Diamond' inside of it, and you've gained access to a Branch of Sin ability. What your ability manifests as will be random, and could be long range, close range, or even allow you to create Hexagonal Wires connected by Blood. You'll need to train to prevent Anemia, and may even be able to evolve your abilities to crush entire cities.

A black sticky orb that when attached on someone's crotch, will cover either their body or underwear in a layer of the same colour, making the orb gain a customizable symbol and turning it into a really sensitive part of the body incapable of getting release. The orb can only be removed by the one that placed it in the first place.

In your world there is an alternate dimension born from the cognition of all living beings, resembling more a desolate office space with half-working ceiling lights and half-wet carpet floor that smells of almond. The only way to enter here is by 'No-clipping' on a random space in the world, you will neither suffer hunger nor thirst, but returning will be a challenge on itself.

Now in a forest in the world, resides the Slenderman and its pages. Anyone unfortunate to enter the forest and grab one of the pages will incur its wrath. If you find all of its pages without dying, it will occasionally aid you at odd times.
A can of cola that increases resilience for one hour. You must drink the entire can. Doesn't stack. Don't have more than four buffing drinks active at a time, you'll explode.
Root beer that somehow increases fire rate for one hour. You must drink the entire can. Doesn't stack. Don't have more than four buffing drinks active at a time, you'll explode.

Everybody do the flop! Grants immunity to explosions and fall damage for one hour. When you drop to the ground from a small height, makes you explode and harm everyone around you. Tastes like prunes and chemicals. You must drink the entire can. Doesn't stack. Don't have more than four buffing drinks active at a time, you'll explode.

When attack, you will always naturally aim for the head for one hour. Tastes sweet, like strawberries. You must drink the entire can. Doesn't stack. Don't have more than four buffing drinks active at a time, you'll explode.

Somehow allows you to carry one more weapon than you normally could without issue for one hour. You must drink the entire can. Doesn't stack. Don't have more than four buffing drinks active at a time, you'll explode.

For one hour, if you are severely injured or killed, you will not lose anything you would normally have lost as a result. You must drink the entire can. Doesn't stack. Don't have more than four buffing drinks active at a time, you'll explode.

For one hour weapons shoot or arm faster and each bullet inexplicably becomes two at no cost. You must drink the entire can. Doesn't stack. Don't have more than four buffing drinks active at a time, you'll explode.

For one hour, if you are injured to the point of unconciousness or killed, a doppelganger will spawn. You control the doppelganger, who only has a pistol and clothes, and if you get back to your body you may revive yourself, keeping everything but this perk. The doppelganger spawns near, but not in sight of, your body. You must drink the entire can. Doesn't stack. Don't have more than four buffing drinks active at a time, you'll explode.

Reloading any weapon causes a small shockwave centered on yourself for one hour. This shockwave stuns anyone too close to you. You must drink the entire can. Doesn't stack. Don't have more than four buffing drinks active at a time, you'll explode.

For a single hour, you may see anything helpful to you through walls, such as unusued weapons. In addition, you have a much higher chance to somehow obtain ammo for your weapons or money from defeated foes. You must drink the entire can. Doesn't stack. Don't have more than four buffing drinks active at a time, you'll explode.

If you're hit, an explosion of webbing will occur that binds anyone near you. Further, any explosives you use also send out these webs in addition to their usual effects and melee weapons will equally bind foes. This effect lasts one hour. You must drink the entire can. Doesn't stack. Don't have more than four buffing drinks active at a time, you'll explode.

Perks just keep coming... you may activate the effects of any perk soda at will for the standard hour, with a cooldown of four hours after use. Further, you may drink any number of perk sodas, or activate any number of their effects, at one time without suffering any negative effects.

An ancient family tome passed down through history, the Thievius Raccoonus has been filled out by generation after generation of the Cooper Clan. With this book, you can learn the skills of a master thief, and eventually see the blue sparks. Remember to jump and hit the Circle button.
A four pack of ice cold Royal Crown Draft Cola in glass bottles. Kind of a dud, but it tastes nice.

You're bigger. You're stronger. You're more resilient. You have a health bar constantly visible to anyone that tries to fight you. You have a theme song that plays whenever you fight. You can use fog to block an area and force anyone entering to confront you. You're the fucking boss, and nobody is going to forget it.

You're a god. Not metaphorically or anything- legitimately a god. Choose something, you're in charge of it. Choose a couple more things if you want. You aren't in charge of them, but you can still do some stuff with it. Be careful- you can still die, and the games gods play are always the most dangerous.

Under a wheat field and an outhouse lies the abandoned and partially destroyed main HQ of Aperture Science, overseen by GLaDOS. Should you find yourself here and complete the tests you'll find the documents necessary to declare yourself the CEO and sole owner of the entire company. The company maintains its excellent, if insane, reputation.

A Utah based megacorporation reponsible for many extreme advances in robotics and artificial intelligence, all driven into attempting to making chain mascot resaurants. They own their entire supply chain, from the restaurants to the contruction companies to the mining companies. Currently overseen by a board of directors infected by the Mimic- a hostile memetic/roboic entity based on child murderer WIlliam Afton. Solving the mysteries of the various murders and haunting of the company will grant you documents allowing you to take control of the entire company. Provided you have any ability at seeing into Hell, you can find William Afton himself, if you want to stab him or something.

The teachings of a group of spiritual seekers known as the Dryleaf Sect, revealed only to those of worthy valor and character. The practice of this martial art marks the dawn of an ascetic's journey. You now know both the common version of the art and the version used by Dryleaf Dane.
A normal Australian emu with intelligence close to that of a human. You may choose the sex.
A normal pidgeon with intelligence close to that of a human. You may choose the sex.

Cast and cry, cast and cry~ You are now a Sentient battle form, ranging anywhere from the size of a large dog to almost 20 feet tall. You can fly, are an inhumanly shaped mass of robotics with a central core, have cool glowy bits, energy projectiles, and probably a laser beam. Also, you can hack into just about any tech you find.

A mutation on both copies of the myostatin gene that removes limits on muscle mass. You have the idealized form of this, now getting larger and stronger muscles, and rapidly enhancing any gains from training. Just make sure to eat a lot of protein.
A single use card that can reflect anything. Attacks, insults, debt, you name it!

Spaceball I's warp drive compressed into a pocket sized button! Guaranteed to get you anywhere you need to be before you need to be there! (Warning: Using this will cause you to go plaid and possibly slam into a wall when trying to slow down)

Congratulations on starting your Pokemon Journey! Here's your complementary Egg! It will hatch anywhere from 5 to 120 days (depending on egg cycle) into a random non-Mythical/non-Legendary Stage 1 pokemon and will bond with whomever the owner of said egg is upon hatching. Roll a random number for your new companion!

A one-time use disk that will teach the recipient one random Pokemon move from the list of available TM moves. As TM numbers shift between each generation, the generation this disk will draw from will be randomized.

A special operations micro radio system that can transmit images and whole conversations in less than a second with the reciever manipulating the small bones in ear for an incoming call. Every restock grants an additional pair.

A storage container that creates one-time use disks that will teach the recipient the pokemon move it contains. These disks will be generated at a rate of 1 disk per 1 week and can be stored in the container for future use. Every disk's imprinted move is randomized on creation from the list of available TM moves. Roll a random number to decide the generation it draws from.

The Omnipotent Orb is an a sphere made of an unknown material that bends the laws of the universe to nullify damage from any and all attacks, physical or magical, with the sole exception of 'Almighty' attacks capable of erasing something from existence.
This little mallet will slightly increase the strength, dexterity, vitality, agility and luck of whoever it hits.

A large scythe that innately freezes an enemy on contact. Somehow always slashes the opponent no matter where they are struck with it, though more damage is done when the actual blade hits. By using a bit of energy a second, smaller, scythe may be summoned that inflicts magic damage. Together they are extremely aggressive and can send out sheets of ice that explode a second or two later.
FACTORY IS GOD. You gain knowledge of the entire tech tree of Factorio starting from Nauvis all the way to Space Age. Makes you violently murderous towards large bugs. The Factory Must Grow.
Mark a target on touch. All highlighted targets have a colored outline you can see as long as they're within visible range, even through walls or while blind.
Mark a target within line of sight. All attacks while active will only deal damage to that target.
A dessert themed pokemon, sweet and cute. Comes in 9 cute varieties. Not always great at fighting, but she'll do her best! Extra damage against dragons due to Fairy typing

The steward of the Church of Vows. A gigantic tortoise wearing a large white mitre, Miriel is a gentle soul who will happily assist you on your journey. Miriel can be given scrolls as well as prayerbooks, and will readily teach new spells to the player for an appropriate fee. The best dog
A headless chicken with a bowtie. Never stops joking around. As a Devil, he can form contracts with others and heal via blood. Not very strong, though, because people aren't afraid of chickens.
A crate of prospector's TNT. Use it wisely, and don't let anyone think it's a weird candle brand.
A pair of X-Ray goggles that do all that fun stuff you saw on TV. See through walls, see through clothes, see through things you really don't want to. Comes with a dial to adjust the depth.
A single use cell phone. Call the number within and describe your lost item. It will be delivered in less than a week.
A horseshoe on a necklace that grants the leg strength and stamina of a well bred horse. Kimi no aiba ga~!
A 55 gallon drum containing an endless supply of medium quality crude oil. When tipped, oil pours at a steady 10 gallons per minute. Do not damage or modify the drum.

A highly potent anabolic steroid, popularized during Pre-War America's hey-day by professional athletes, this drug will act incredibly quickly, granting you increased strength, reflexes, and endurance. Be careful, it's addictive.
Highlander rules. Take someone's head with this zweihander to steal their energy and strength to add to your own.

A belt sash that acts as a third arm, the Third Arm Sash is an incredibly useful Shen Gong Wu that grants the user an item that acts as a grappling hook, a swing, or a third fist. It can be infused with elemental power, and when combined with several other Shen Gong Wu can become the great Heylin Demon Mala Mala Jong.
You're reasonably skilled at any bladed weapon you pick up. Not enough to win fights, but enough to actually use it.
You're more charismatic now, more attractive, nothing fancy but you could probably get a couple thousand followers as an influencer.
You're good at taking care of your hair, hygiene, cleanliness, etc. You always know how to be presentable
You have an easier time comprehending and understanding mystical and esoteric forces, not much more than the average person though.
You are slightly better with your words, and could probably win an online argument with an intelligent opponent
You could actually run a farm without looking like an idiot, and could compete with fairly experienced farmers
Dude what the fuck are those Tibetan monks teaching people. You are not quite immune, but can fool most telepaths and mind readers with false images and memories
You are naturally hygenic, both intentionally or otherwise.
All mundane animals adore you, and non-mundane ones will take a shine to you more easily
You can control your own metabolism at will, speeding it up or slowing it down to a crawl.
Your looks have now all been enhanced. You're basically the prettiest version of you as you are now.
You always have pretty, perfect skin. No more scars or unwanted marks. Your skin and superficial injuries heal faster now too.

Your stats largely depend on the type of kaiju you pick, but by and large you are a city destroying monster capable of changing between human scale at rest and kaiju scale when active. You may only pick kaiju that are a species, not a lone individual. Rodan, Kamacuras, Kong, Mothra, etc. Yes, Godzilla counts. No, you do not get Godzilla's plot armor. Your kaiju type is heavily influenced by the Passives and Abilities you already have when this item is rolled.

You are now an Xilien, an alien being capable of disguising themselves as human (usually wearing lots of leather and a trench coat), with great psychic powers and beyond human strength (usually). You have a literally one in a million chance of being a Keizer, an even more powerful psychic being capable of, theoretically, becoming near "omnipotent" in strength.

The one in a million chance- you are either a Xilien or a human mutant with great psychic powers, the ability to manipulate energy in multiple forms, and greatly enhanced strength and power. You also like wearing leather and cool polymer body armor now. You might also now look Japanese.

Pick a Jaeger. You now own a Jaeger. You must now find a companion whom you are Drift Compatible with in order to actually use your Jaeger. Also comes with its own Jaeger bay and support equipment upon first summoning. Jaeger bay does not move. You cannot unsummon either. Best put it near a coastline.
You are an absolute master of eating someone out. Contrary to the name, also includes analingus. You also get an extra long tongue for extra pleasure.

A corrupted Night Sentinel turned into a murderous parody of the Slayer. Wields a super shotgun and an Argent double bladed battle axe. Fast, powerful, deadly- a much higher challenge for the Slayer than most demons could possibly be.
A backpack filled with every in-game weapon from Team Fortress 2. Only weapons and other items from the setting can be pulled in and out of this seemingly bottomless backpack.
A seemingly infinite backpack that contains every Team Fortress 2 Hat and Cosmetic. Can only hold TF2 Hats and Cosmetics.

A hovering Koopa Clown Car with unlimited ammo, fuel, and bag of tricks (Throwable hammers, Mecha Koopas, and giant Iron balls). The Koopa Clown car is capable of turning into a racing go-kart and producing large Boxing Gloves or Drills with arms.

An alien drone that fuses with a host body to bring out their full weaponized potential via linking with objects or beings to enhance their abilities through assimilation. Ultralinks are designed to absorb and control their host's energy, and, once bonded, the host and the alien's connection is unbreakable.
A perfectly form fitting piece of underwear made of pure white lace and ribbons. Will make even the most intimidating phallus look cute, dainty, and delicate. Self cleaning and resizing.
You are a good enough cosplayer that you can make your own outfits, and even sell your cosplays for money. You work best with references, still.
You can understand all non-magical languages and have an easier time learning magical or esoteric languages as well.
The minor inconveniences of sex no longer exist for you. No STD, no extra hygiene procedures, no unwanted pregnancies, nothing. Also, bonus to sexual performance.
Your luck conspires to get you into horny or otherwise pervy situations straight out of an Ecchi anime. Does not come with a free pass to stay in those situations.
You have a natural talent at sewing clothes, you can easily spot flaws and make new clothes for yourself and others.
Manipulate the wind and air with enough force and precision to kill with sharp wind blades or fling people around in the air.
Cloak anything you hold in razor wind, effectively making it a sword. You can launch that wind blade for a flying slash.
Cloak yourself in whirling wind that carries you into the air and allows you to fly.
Share your senses with the wind in a radius of 1km, allowing you to map out everything the wind can reach and memorize it as such.

Directly mess with someone's bioelectric signals by touch, allowing you to stun or paralyze them for a time. With more practice, you might even be able to puppet them. The stronger the opponent, the harder this is.
Control metal on a microscopic scale within 10 meters. Your mass limit is roughly 200 grams, but you have atomic precision.
Banish all light within a 100 meter area, blinding enemies and, honestly, yourself if you don't have other forms of vision. More energy means a bigger area covered.
Create shadowy claws on your hands or fingertips capable of slashing through flesh and metal alike. You can train to enhance length and sharpness.

You can make your flesh and entire body become poisonous by spending energy. The more energy spent, the more lethal the poison. Higher vitality ensures higher potency. Turning it off removes all poison instantly.
Swim through any physical solid object as if it's water. Does not effect the state or integrity of what you were swimming in.
Emit an aura of despair capable of causing weaker targets to collapse with unbearable fear and panic
Whisper into someone's ear while they sleep to influence their dreams or manipulate their opinions as if through hypnosis
See other people's emotions as an aura of various colors surrounding their body. Does not come with a manual, so you gotta figure out what color does what yourself.
Transmute any solid material you touch into any mundane gun, fully loaded. Potency of bullet scales with the material used.
Create a bow and arrow with your own energy, works like a normal bow and arrow. The more energy you use, the more damaging the arrow.

Reinforce your entire body to the point that it resembles metal more than flesh. Increases your mass as well while enhancing durability and lowering speed. Even a car crashing into your body would barely hurt you.
Transform into a bat or bat hybrid at will. Gain enhanced senses, sonar, flight, agility, claws, teeth, etc. Might cause extreme light sensitivity.
Mark any object or creature via touch, allowing you to monitor their physical condition and relative location to you. 10 marks to start with, though it increases with time and training.

Heal others on touch by expending energy. Works for stabs, slashes, broken bones, etc. More severe wounds take more energy, stronger targets are harder to heal. Does not cure aging or status effects or genetic defects, just physical wounds.
Increase the speed of all movements by spending energy. Reaction speed does not increase with your own speed. The faster you are, the more energy it takes.

Create and shape rock constructs within 20 meters of your body. You are not an Earth bender, so you don't get to control them after they're made. You can make weapons, obstructions, building blocks, etc.

Sprout and control supernaturally strong vines from your body capable of whipping, grappling, binding, etc. Higher energy means stronger, longer, and more durable vines. Also can sprout thorns if you want. All vines vanish once you deactivate the ability.

A yellow line on the ground that leads you to an adventure if you choose to follow it. Ranges from finding a new good restaurant to stumbling on a murder scene and beyond. Guarantees an interesting day, if nothing else.

A set of 10 floating disembodied eyeballs capable of sending their sight to you and following complex commands. Any eye that dies can be resummoned within 24 hours. They have no combat power and are quite squishy.
A standard griffon the size of an elephant- lion lower half, hawk upper half. Very vicious. Very loyal. You get one mating pair capable of breeding.

From your shadow or nearby shadows, summon an elephant shikigami capable of conjuring and spewing massive volumes of water from its trunk. It weighs as much as a real elephant so it can crush things it's dropped on too. Scales with your energy levels.
A massive, malformed, lightning wreathed, skeletal beast raised from the dead. It can demolish walls, ignore all conventional bullets, and generate and release electricity at will.

Gigantic elite guards that once served Anor Londo. They're several times bigger than humans, immensely strong, and are akin to unbreakable walls in terms of durability. They can also heal themselves. Start with 2.
A ring with a flower decoration. Increases stamina regeneration and recovery after exhaustion.
A gold ring with an icy blue rectangular gem. Boosts defense against ice and cold. Roll this again to upgrade the ring, up to two times.
A magic apple with a skin made of gold. Eating it grants enhanced regeneration for one hour, and increased ability to survive attacks
A necklace with a little pendant shaped like a pair of wings. Allows you to fly at 10 km/h in any direction, mostly horizontally with some elevation capability.
One of the Deathly Hallows, allows for invisibility, immunity to clairvoyance, and could let you hide from Death itself if you wanted. Provided you're not murdered.
A white full face mask that, when worn, makes you look like someone else, allowing you to make exactly one second identity.
A waterfall populated by lesser Nymph. The waterfall itself spawns more Nymphs regularly, all of which will follow your orders. Waterfall can be summoned and desummoned at will.
A pair of arid daggers that allows you to spawn and launch 10 arid shivs every 30 seconds in a deadly barrage.
The most iconic wrist-mounted piece of technology from Vault-Tec, allows you to monitor your health and inventory, connect to radio and info networks, map areas, shine a light in dark spaces, etc.
A cane sword belonging to Brook of the Straw Hat Pirates. Extremely sharp, does not dull. Very fashionable. Carries just the slightest imprint of its past user's skill.

The blade wielded by Annalise, Queen of the Vilebloods. Its runes allow you to sink the blade into your own flesh and sacrifice blood and vitality to amplify its strength. Amplifies necromantic and blood-based abilities.
A deed that, when ripped, gives you legal ownership of a plot of land of your choice, in any currently purchaseable size.
A fumo of Erza Scarlet. Shake it violently to instantly change your clothes to any other set you own at will, swapping their locations.
The Hammer of Vordt of the Boreal Valley. Very large. Very heavy. Freezes over things it hits.
A single use landline phone. Call anyone you're thinking of in the universe you're in and speak with them for an hour before the phone disappears entirely.
A hip bag woven from silver thread, able to contain two thousand pounds worth of items. You automatically know how to find anything inside.
You're a skilled enough actor to get hired in an actual movie, or enough to fool most non-detectives or familiar people
You're good enough to be a blue or red belt at actual karate, knowing kata, training techniques, strikes and kicks, you might even learn how to harness your internal energy for stronger attacks.
You're great at wilderness survival- you can build shelters, find food and water, track animals, secure belongings, orient your direction, so on and so forth.
You can motivate people decently enough, but like... at a school group project level. No one will follow you to hell, but they'll do what they tell you to as long as it makes sense.
You're now stealthy enough to be a generic ninja grunt- set traps, sneak up on people, gather information, move silently, so on and so forth.
You're damn good at throwing all your dignity away to get what you want. People are more receptive to your begging and will actually accept your requests on a regular basis.
You're an accomplished artist in drawing, painting, sketching, sculpting, etc. You could definitely get a high paying job as an artist with a patron, but you're not era defining.
You now know enough about Total Concentration Breathing to increase blood oxygen and activate your muscles as long as you maintain that breathing cycle. You're not very good at it yet, though...
You've got the vibe of a great, kind, innocent person. It's way easier to convince someone that you're a good person now.
You've got the vibe of a cool, edgy, delinquent kinda person. It's way easier to convince someone that you're cool and brooding. Emos love you.
You're very good at spotting treasure and valuables to the point that anything valuable in line of sight gets highlighted for you.
Upgrade to Perfumer. You never have to worry about smelling bad ever again. Your scent and sweat smell like fine perfume- not too much, always pleasant to whoever smells you.
No, not the cool one. You're just really resilient to horrible conditions- sleeping in stressful situations, enduring stress and strain, pushing through wounds and exhaustion. So on and so forth.
Your legs are stronger and tougher now, enhancing speed and kicking strength by a significant degree
You naturally attract alt, goth, emo, punk, and edgy people. Most people will also excuse your less social actions as just being an edgelord or plain weird.
Toggle your ability to kill. When on, no matter how hard you hit someone, no matter how much damage you do, your target or victim will survive. Not always whole or recoverable, though.
Enhance your health and vitality, increasing your healing speed and making you healthier overall.
You have a higher chance of finding something useful or valuable when scavenging around any given area.
You're now much better at learning things, being a student, and taking information from people with more experience than you at any given subject.
News of your exploits and accomplishments always reaches somewhere ahead of you, increasing your reputation slightly. Your reputation is always well known in populated areas.
Your energy and health recover faster when sleeping
You are a friend to all arthropods- insects, arachnids, crustaceans, isopods, etc. Also increases the strength and efficiency of your physical durability and armoring abilities
Every time you're injured, you gain the exact amount of money you'd need to get it treated at the nearest medical professional. No, you are not allowed to commit insurance fraud with this one.
Your lungs are stronger, tougher, and more flexible. You can process oxygen faster and better, giving you more energy to work with.
Unleash a concentrated beam of flame from your hands. You can dial the power up or down by spending more or less energy. Not really a kamehameha, but it sure looks cool.
Unleash a constant stream of flame from anywhere on your body. The more energy spent, the hotter the flame gets and the further it goes.

Create and control mist within 100 meters, allowing you to obscure vision, hinder movement, smother flames, even generate icy mist to freeze surfaces or enemies, or create solid mist to attack after enough practice.
Create and control whirlpools of water, using them as barriers, projectiles, traps, nuisances, or party tricks even.
Create and launch ice spikes like bullets, or have them impale up from surfaces within 20 meters. The more energy you spend, the stronger and bigger they get.
Create and control compressed air whips capable of lashing, grabbing, or slicing with enough speed. More energy expended creates longer and stronger whips.
Telekinetically move the earth around within sensory range, though it doesn't have much lethal power beyond making pitfalls.
Turn yourself invisible by bending light around you and anything you're touching.
Every single attached part of your body can be strengthened and sharpened into a natural weapon- fangs, claws, spines, quills, spikes, etc etc.
Breathe out a cloud of lethally toxic gas that also corrodes solid matter with its potency
When lethally injured, automatically teleport to the nearest safe area within a 1km radius. 30 minute cooldown.
Toggle on your third person camera to see the world like you're playing an RPG. Allows corner peeking too.
Turn objects within 100 meters on and off. Does not work on anything living. Works great on electronics and abilities.
Augment your physical abilities by expending energy, boosts strength, agility, durability, etc. Scales with your own base stats and energy expenditure. Not very substantial.
Transmute matter on a macro scale. No complex constructs or anything smaller than a shed, but you could turn flat ground into an apartment complex in an hour. Not a combat power.
See through any kind of physical deception that is not magic based- sleight of hand, pitfalls, disguises, mirages, one way mirrors, etc.
Adjust your viewpoint from first person, to second person (using a targeted person), to third person at will.
Shed blood to create blood golems from the puddle on the ground. Strength and number depend on physical stats as well as blood shed. Minimum requirement of 100ml
Sense allies as spots of light in your vision, allowing you to transfer their physical and mental conditions to yourself, or transfer them between willing allies.
Send a wave of psionic energy through your eyes to cause mental damage to any target hit, confusing them and causing headaches. Efficacy depends on mental resilience and magical power of the target.
When activated, anyone who can see you visually is highlighted in red, with a line connecting their field of vision to the part of you they can see.
You can create, modify, and design anything related to slow, clunky, large mecha capable of construction work, industrial lifting, or slow combat with existing armor and guns.
A roughly six foot tall winged firebreathing lizard. Ornery and quick to anger, but also powerful and fast and extremely loyal. Female, and lays eggs every now and then.

The generic blue RPG slime, a blue blob immune to physical strikes, capable of spitting acid globs and corroding items with its body fluids. Grows stronger by eating organic stuff, and evolve when fed powerful magical foods

A Stand made of jigsaw puzzle pieces, capable of tracking any person or object via scent when exposed to a pertinent object. Will automatically pursue until the target is found. Can also disassemble itself at will and use its pieces to mock up shapes and locations.

Owner of the Valentine Detective Agency, a synth specializing in information gathering and detective work. He's good at hacking, ranged and melee combat, and investigations. A bit of an old model synth, though.

More bullets always works. So long as you are using it or directly in charge of the people using it, guns and other completely mundane weaponry will work on anything. It doesn't matter if they're a god, an eldritch entity, or have some sort of crazy power- put enough bullets into them and they'll die. Though you have to have enough bullets first...

A pocket dimension full of the armor and armaments used by Corporal Flynn Taggart, aka the Doom Slayer. None but you may enter. Also comes with a voice activated guide and user manual for everything in the warehouse. All weapons are upgradeable. Unmaykr, BFG 9000, Crucible Sword, and Sentinel Hammer ammo takes 1 week to restock. Everything else takes 24 hours.

A large glass tank containing several dozen soulless clone bodies of Rei Ayanami. They can be decanted, but will swiftly degrade and dissolve into LCL if removed while lacking a soul. Try not to look at it too often.

You evolve to become magically and physically perfect, allowing you to create life and cast magic more easily. You start with fire magic, a single fire breathing raptor summon, and the ability to grow via conflict and time. You become more alien the more you evolve, though this can be mitigated with the right evolutions.

You have the skills of an introductory Shaper, including the ability to manufacture Life utilizing Essence. You start out knowing what tools you need, the initial Shaper infrastructure creations, and the knowledge of how to improve as a shaper. Improves your magic slightly.
A fully stocked and fueled RV filled with enough food and water to last a single person a week. The RV's gas tank and fridge refills automatically after a week.

Create cavitation bubbles in any material by snapping your fingers, clapping, or otherwise striking something very hard. The surroundings will quickly collapse around the bubble again, and cause a plasma flash from the impact.
A large bundle of red yarn. When this yarn is laid down, it cannot be removed unless reeled/raveled back into its spool. Perfect for finding your way out of mazes or to prevent from getting lost.

If something tries to possess you, you can instead trap it inside you and force it to help you against its will. You gain a small portion of the would be possessor's powers and can gain even more of theirs depending on what deals you make in exchange with them.

A large disembodied armored gauntlet that is capable of shooting lasers that can puncture through concrete from the palm or fingers. If worn the gauntlet will begin to rebuild the rest of its body back into a techadon robot around your body within a couple of days.
At the time of your death, your body self destructs with all the energy you have gained up to that point. If you are out of energy, treat the explosion as if you had a full tank

Nine robotic replicates of the mercenaries from Team fortress 2. They only have their default/stock loadouts of the classes they are made up of. Restocks upon destruction. Any upgrades applied to the robots stay upon being restocked.

A large robotic duplicate of the Scout from Team Fortress 2. It is rather fragile compared to what its size may suggest, but is also incredibility fast and mobile. Bats baseballs with the force of a cannon, at the rate of pistol fire. Requires 100 USD or equivalent currency to function for an hour.

A giant, self repairing, robotic duplicate of the Soldier from Team Fortress 2. It is an incredibly resilient and durable robot with a rocket launcher capable of shooting out crit-boosted rockets at the same rate of a machine gun. Requires 100 USD or equivalent currency to function for an hour.

A large robotic duplicate of the Pyro from Team Fortress 2. It uses an equally giant Flare gun that is incredibly accurate and fast firing with quick reloading time. Requires 100 USD or equivalent currency to function for an hour.

This mechanical monster is a Giant Demoman wielding a cannon that shoots out large grenades that have the same smoking effect as the Sentry Buster's explosion. It is incredibly durable and has great destructive potential. Requires 100 USD or equivalent currency to function for an hour.

A humgonus robotic duplicate of Heavy from Team Fortress 2, armed only with Fists of Steel. Has incredible resistance against all long range attacks and is overall incredibly durable compared to other robots. Requires 100 USD or equivalent currency to function for an hour.
