An incredibly durable robotic duplicate of the engineer. Has most of the intelligence and blueprints of the Engineer's design. Capable of quickly setting up sentry nest and large teleport that can teleport dozens of units. Requires t00 USD or equivalent currency to function for an hour.

A mini sentry made into a sort of childish humanoid form. Carries the same capabilities as the normal building, but far more deadly due to being a sapient, mobile robot. Rather quiet and deadpan. Doesn't really talk, but makes expressive noises. Defaults RED, every duplicate grants one in another team color.

A mini sentry made into a vaguely teenage humanoid form. Carries the same capabilities as the normal building, but far more deadly due to being a sapient, mobile robot. A prankster and vicious little gremlin. Doesn't really talk, but makes expressive noises. Defaults RED, every duplicate grants one in another team color.

A sentry turret made into a very dangerous humanoid form. Carries the same capabilities as the normal building, but far more deadly due to being a sapient, mobile robot. Vivacious and vicious in equal measures. Doesn't really talk, but makes expressive noises. Defaults RED, every duplicate grants one in another team color.

A dispenser made into a motherly humanoid form. Carries the same capabilities as the normal building, but far more deadly due to being a sapient, mobile robot. Very motherly, but still a prankster. Doesn't really talk, but makes expressive noises. Defaults RED, every duplicate grants one in another team color.
Entela and Exodus the Teleporter Twins

A teleporter set made into a pair of humanoid twins. Carries the same capabilities as the normal buildings, but far more deadly due to being sapient, mobile robots. Both of them are fun loving gremlins. Don't really talk, but they make expressive noises. Defaults RED, every duplicate grants pair in another team color.

A teleporter set made into a pair of humanoid twins. Carries the same capabilities as the normal buildings, but far more deadly due to being sapient, mobile robots. Both of them are cutesy gremlin types. Don't really talk, but they make expressive noises. Defaults RED, every duplicate grants pair in another team color.

A repair node made into a cutesy, young adult humanoid form. Carries the same capabilities as the normal building, but far more deadly due to being a sapient, mobile robot. Cutesy, but also incredibly vicious. Doesn't really talk, but makes expressive noises. Defaults RED, every duplicate grants one in another team color.

An Ambassador revolver made into a mature, refined humanoid form. Carries the same capabilities as the normal weapon, but far more deadly due to being a sapient, mobile robot. Rather quiet and smug. Doesn't really talk, but makes expressive noises. Defaults RED, every duplicate grants one in another team color.

A sapper made into a tiny gremlin form. Carries the same capabilities as the normal building, but far more deadly due to being a sapient, mobile robot. A very cat-like gremlin. Doesn't really talk, but makes expressive noises. Defaults RED, every duplicate grants one in another team color.

A minigun made into a one-armed, very sturdy humanoid form. Carries the same capabilities as the normal building, but far more deadly due to being a sapient, mobile robot. Rather quiet and deadpan. Doesn't really talk, but makes expressive noises. Defaults RED, every duplicate grants one in another team color.

A bomb tank made into a gigantic, burly humanoid form. Carries the same capabilities as the normal building, but far more deadly due to being a sapient, mobile robot. Quiet, but extremely deadly. Doesn't really talk, but makes expressive noises. Defaults BLU, every duplicate grants one in another team color.

An Aperture Science turret made into a cute humanoid form. Carries the same capabilities as the normal building, but far more deadly due to being a sapient, mobile robot. Has an innocent, cutesy personality. Every duplicate of this token grants another turret, but you can build more on your own if you want.

A Combine turret made into a cute humanoid form. Carries the same capabilities as the normal building, but far more deadly due to being a sapient, mobile robot. Has an aggressive, militaristic personality. Every duplicate of this token grants another turret, but you can build more on your own if you want.

A machine gun turret made into a cute, skeletal, usually one-armed humanoid form. Carries the same capabilities as the normal building, but far more deadly due to being a sapient, mobile robot. Has an aggressive, sadistic personality. Every duplicate of this token grants another turret, but you can build more on your own if you want.

A berry that, in exchange for lowering EVs, sharply raises the estrogen levels in any given pokemon, turning them more voluptuous and feminizing them into something more sexually agreeable. Start with 30 berries. No more than one a day, unless you want things to get VERY interesting.

A pokeball that turns any pokemon caught within into a voluptuous, horny, sexually available anthropomorphic version of that species, turning males into estrogenized femboys, and females into breeders. You get 6 on a standard pokeball belt.

A pokeball that turns any pokemon caught within into a voluptuous, horny, sexually aggressive anthropomorphic version of that species, turning males into musclebound fuckmonsters, and females into... musclebound fuckmonsters, also with included giant penis. You get 6 on a standard pokeball belt.

It works the exact same as a normal rare candy, but the extra hormones within estrogenize the human body and have an aphrodisiac, psychoactive, and feminizing aspect to the point that taking too many will almost entirely feminize any male or female into a mindbroken fuckpet, including the ability to get pregnant even without a vagina.

Seraphim of the First Sphere, shapeless and spiritual, they take female form when in the mortal plane, and can even duplicate themselves if they wish. Yes, the stripper dancing before battle is normal.

You are an Umbra Witch, a practitioner of the Dark Arts, overseer of history. Your hair itself is a conduit for your magic, and your magic comes from the defeat and contracting of demons to serve your will. Also, you're a girl now, retroactively. Although this token starts with high stats, you don't get access to any of it until you start subjugating demons to your will. You start with an Umbran Watch and knowledge of Bullet Arts.

You are a Lumen Sage, a practitioner of the holy arts, overseer of history. Your robes are a conduit for your magic, and your magic comes from prayer and the beseeching of angels to grant you power. Also, you're a guy now, retroactively. Although this token starts with high stats, you don't get access to any of it until you start contracting angels for more strength. You start with a Lumen's Watch and Divine Robes.

A giant robotic duplicate of Sniper from Team Fortress 2. Is immuned to being stunned and fires large arrows, with an even larger wonky hitbox, at the rate of a machine gun. Requires 100 USD or equivalent currency to function for an hour.

A large robotic duplicate of the Medic from Team Fortress 2. Its medigun can repair both man and machine, but lacks the original's ambition. Requires 100 USD or equivalent currency to function for an hour.
A functioning commercial airliner that is completely out of fuel. Can only be summoned at ground level, and once summoned is stuck until refueled
A Ak-47 that has infinite ammo. The magazine can not be removed nor can attachments be added. This gun cannot break under its own power

A device with 3 green buttons and one red one. Has a 1 in 6 chance of actually working properly, and a cooldown period of 24 hours. If it doesn't work as intended, will teleport the user to a random location without their safety in mind.
Grants the user access to the Spook Fortress Spells but only in October or the equivalent month. Can be improved to working all year round, if rolled again.
Congrats on your new tattoo! Each time you avenge a wrong done to you or your family (or close friends), the tattoo gets bigger and increases your physical abilities.

A Dark Eldar specialized in ritual duel. She seeks to maximize the suffering of her foe and act as sensually as possible while doing so. Her lack of clothes and protection is both to incite desire and frustration by showing she doesn't need any protection to take a foe down. They are actively evil and will attempt to corrupt their master with promises of pleasures and delicacies, or as thanks from freeing their soul from being eaten by demons.

A massive robotic beast of gold and ivory, a symbol of power from an empire long since destroyed. A monstrous creature capable of breathing deadly flame, has the strength to destroy castles and dig through solid stone. Kinda looks like a worm on a string.

You can create, modify, and design anything remotely related to NERV or its offshoot WILLE's technology. This includes Evangelions, Reiquariums, plugsuits, the Lance of Longinus, Angel/Eva hybrids, etc etc. Comes with a free AT Field, albeit it starts extremely weak and barely able to block a 9mm bullet. Starts with a chunk of Lilith DNA just big enough to clone repeatedly for raw material.

An extremely powerful entity bound in cards. All five of which are now yours. It takes effort and will to draw a card, but should you manage to get all five in a single fight (you always start with zero) Exodia will manifest and instantly end it. Or at least serve as an effective combatant in the extremely rare case you're fighting something that can actually stand against him.

Hail, King of Sarkaz. A floating crown of black crystal, the Civilight Eterna marks one as King of Sarkaz, and inheritor to the memories and emotions of the entire species. In exchange for bearing this, you are granted immense power- capable of casting prophecies over entire bloodlines, manipulating emotions, and seeing the memories of others. Further, you may establish the Sarkaz in the world- simply allow one to pledge to the crown and stab themselves on it and they will find themselves as one of your people. This comes with increased physical abilities and special magical abilities, depending on the bloodline they get.

You are now a Quincy, a Spiritually Aware human that can manipulate Reishi, and use it as a weapon. This weapon is particularly effective against Spiritual existences. You also can use techniques such as Blut, a defensive tool, and Hirenkyaku, an advanced movement technique. There are other techiques a Quincy can have, but you'll need to learn them.

A Quincy that holds a Schrift has been granted a letter of the alphabet, A-Z. These letters all correlate to a unique ability for a single Quincy to use. (You probably want to put all the letters in a spinner or something.)

An evolved Quincy Technique, this replaces the previous Letzt Stil, removing the drawback of a complete removal of a Quincy's power, and allowing them to directly manipulate the Reishi in an area at a much higher level. You also get a decent amount of Drip with the transformation, but it can't save someone with no fashion sense.

The manipulator gun from Garry's Mod. Allows you to manipulate, change, and modify anything shot, or fling them into orbit with the push tool. Or any other usecase you can think of with this ridiculous thing.

Your subconscious mind is connected to a reservoir of hyper advanced scientific knowledge, gaining intuitive knowledge of math, science, technology, engineering, and one specialization that you can choose. Awaken your powers with training to unlock the ability to communicate with other Whispered via telepathy. Try not to do it for too long, though.

You are a descendant of the legendary vampire killers, the Belmont clan. You have increased aptitude with holy weapons and artifacts, and have an easier time facing and combating the undead and unholy, especially vampires. You are naturally talented with using whips and can jump better as well.

You are a calm individual, and therefore you have the ability to utilize Sei Ki. This Ki specializes in predictive and understanding based fighting, with an emphasis on remaining calm being important for the art.

The legendary whip used by the Belmont clan to slay Dracula. Repeatedly. It usually only allows members of the Belmont bloodline to wield it, but will tolerate you. A holy weapon created by voluntary sacrifice, this weapon will inflict deadly injuries on the undead and unholy, dealing increased damage to vampires and those of Dracula's bloodline.

You are a Martial Artist of the Dou persuasion. You specialize in using your passions to enhance your strikes and endure longer in a fight. Explosive power, the more heated you get, the stronger you are.
A red, yellow, and white flower with black eye like spots in the middle. Can be used to shoot small fireballs from your hands. Taking a hard blow will dispel the effect.

You are a preeminent artist, capable of giving life to anything you shape with your hands, including giving purpose and meaning. You can also use this ability to destroy so long as you can get your hands on the thing in question, so long as it can be used for artistry
A blue and white flower with black eye like spots in the middle. Can be used to shoot small balls of freezing ice from your hands. Taking a hard blow will dispel the effect.

You gain the knowledge of how to create, modify, and design any technology produced by GATE- Garrick Advanced Technology Enterprises, a company that specializes in exploring, studying, and safeguarding various entities, and unusual, often hazardous phenomena.
A leather bound book that contains all the various spells that you know. Also increases magic capacity and potential output by a exponential factor of five while within 5 feet of the holder.

A 1 cubic meter empty block made of some kind of transparent material. When attached to an energy source, or fuel is poured into it, converts said fuel into a universal energy. A full cube can safely contain a year's worth of power made by a nuclear power plant.

Your physical strength is rooted and powered by its absurdity in use. The more ridiculous the use in strength the more likely it will occur, such as playing whack-a-mole to create a pitfall, making a splash of water to cause tidal waves, or bending steel girders into origami shapes. Etc.

By making your hand into a gun shape you make it work like a functioning gun that shoots invisible bullets. When pointing one finger you shoot like a semi-automatic 9mm pistol, by pointing out two fingers you shoot like a magnum revolver.
By miming an object, you bring it to invisible existence. The object or structures have to be considered mundane other than being invisible. If you speak, the mimed object disappears.
A large box filled with half used hair care products.
A living copy of the largest known T. Rex. Roughly 13 meters long, 4 meters tall at the hips, and weighing nearly 20,000 pounds.
The largest known triceratops. Big John is 3 meters tall and 8 meters long, and weighs over 13,000 pounds.
A group of 5 utahraptors. 3 male and two female. They are able to breed to make more raptors.

When/if you die, your consciousnesses is instead transferred to your highest ranking familiar. You lose all of your previously gotten passives, races changes, skills, and abilities but keep your familiars, items, and unused tokens. You keep the Omni Gacha system but lose most of everything else.

By expending energy, you can project a solid hologram into a pattern of projectiles ("bullets") or an entity that attacks autonomously (with more bullets). These attacks will do less damage the more unavoidable they are. The higher your energy pool or wider your pool of energy sources, the more dangerous this ability becomes.
A token that summons a large wardrobe with enough mundane clothing in it to last you a whole year. Nothing considered armor and nothing magical, but lots of daily outfits that suit your tastes.
"What are ya buying Stranger?'" A blue hooded man with easy access to tons of weaponry and ammunition of all types. Will offer wares but only if they are properly bought off of him.

A metallic black attache case that makes it easier for you to find tinkering supplies. Stocked full with the best weapons of every type from Resident Evil 4. Attached to the case are 3 random charms that give assorted benefits based on the ones chosen.

An extremely large mobile base and garage, with cloaking and high powered missiles for defense. Using nano technology, it is capable of reformatting any vehicle into a super version using the templates of Scout, Leader, Special Operations Officer, Artillery, and Technological and Tactics Support using sentient Battle Chips. Contains 5 Battle Chips to start, you'll have to figure out how to get more.
Turns your heart into a functioning cartoon heart. Your heart does not need to be attached to any arteries and even when removed from your body, will pump blood through your body like it wasn't.

A single 60 meter long battleship meant to comfortable carry a contingent of 800 marines, fully stocked with uniforms, armaments, kitchenware and supplies for said 800 marines. The ship has paddlewheels and a Seastone-coated bottom. The ship can only be summoned in a sufficiently large enough body of water. Does not come with a crew complement.

Your right eye fires a cold beam that drains kinetic and thermal energy from objects that it hits. Your left eye burns things with the energy stored from the cold beam. Drains 10 degrees F per second from anything targeted. Heat storage is capped at 50,000 degrees F

A bulky vest and helmet that fires red energy beams from its twin horns. When targeting a living animal, it can mutate them into massive battle forms that you gain innate control over. When fired at dead animals, it resurrects them (mostly) and also allows you to control the reanimated corpse. The two functions are separate, and you must turn the dial on the chest harness to swap between mutation and resurrection modes.

A canister of active EVO Nanites capable of self reproduction when introduced to a living organic being, insuring they never run out of nanites. High stress or excessive amounts of nanites will cause massive mutations, colloquially referred to as "going EVO", sometimes resulting in kaiju-like forms, sometimes granting wild superpowers. Sometimes both. It's a coin toss if you retain your sanity or not.

The diary of Albrecht Entrati, an ornate book of arcane secrets and Void-borne devilry. The pages within this book contain great and vast knowledge of Void energies in such concentration that the secrets themselves become deadly. Deals innate electrical damage in the form of bullet-like energy bolts as a primary fire, or a massive sparking orb with its alternate fire. Can be modified to produce additional effects, with the right tools and conditions.

A whole gang of roughly 30 year old Italian American men who all look vaguely like generic mafia guys, either in suits, blue collar clothes, or overcoats with flat caps. They're not particularly smart, but it's a whole gang of goons to do whatever you need doing, usually grunt work and hits. Start with 50, increasing as your energy pool increases.

A prim and proper Centauride with really big boobs. She's honorable, chivalrous, traned in the ways of knighthood, and also very kind and modest. She likes carrots and eats a lot, though she tries to hide the latter. Comes with her full knight's kit and several sets of dailywear, including a bikini.

The presumed last of the Sky Bison, a massive six legged creature with a flat tail, an arrow pattern in his fur, and a gentle, surprisingly intelligent, and a bit snarky personality. Eats lots of hay, grass, fruits, any vegetation he can get his mouth on, really. Can fly and carry roughly six teens and their meager traveling supplies with ease.

An army of emaciated, barely human hollows. They're not very strong, but they know how to use a weapon and beat the shit out of anything you point them at. General armaments include swords, shields, spears, and crossbows (but only one per Hollow). Start with 50, gain more as you become stronger.

A standard furniture catalog filled with every form of purchaseable furniture or home decoration within your current world. Upon selecting one to purchase, the manufacturing price of that item will be deducted from your cash or accounts, and the item itself will teleport to you. Cannot be accessed in combat or while in hostile territory.
A gold ring with a brilliant red rectangular gem. Boosts defense against flame and heat. Roll this again to upgrade the ring, up to two times.
A fumo of the perfect and elegant maid, Sakuya Izayoi. Any house this fumo is placed in will act as though it is being cleaned and maintained by a whole household's worth of maids 24/7.

A pillow that, when slept on, allows your spirit to explore the world at will. Your astral form can pass through solid objects and you are undetectable to most other creatures, though if you don't return within 24 hours you WILL die.

A stone that acts as a key to link the Astral World to the Physical World. Usually used to summon the God Hand and facilitate sacrificial ceremonies. The Crimson Behelit allows you to exchange your flesh and blood to become a member of the God Hand and grant you the world... once every 216 years during the Eclipse. Activate this during an eclipse to end the fucking world, you fucking idiot.

A survival kit for a true Courier. Contains Elite Riot Gear, an anti-materiel sniper rifle, a riot shotgun, a .44 Magnum revolver, a bowie knife, 5 repair kits, 10 stim packs, 5 doctor's bags, and 200 ammo for each gun. Also comes with a really snazzy trenchcoat.
Affection in a voucher. Rip it and the person you think about likes you a fair bit more via retcon and causality bending. No side effects but your own guilt.

An enchanted golden powder that repairs weaponry and restores durability as long as the item is in one piece still. The stronger the item, the more powder you need. Some items might need multiple bags of powder to fully repair.
A completely nondescript black metal ring that erases your energy signature when worn as long as you do not actively cast abilities or spells or other energy intensive techniques.
An extremely durable bracelet that becomes a divinely durable round shield when activated. Said shield also works as a bludgeon if you want.

An ornate red vial that produces an endless amount of fresh, healthy, clean O- blood when poured out. Yes, you can use this to feed vampires. Does not carry the essence of any pre-existing person. Might taste like your blood, actually.
One million buzzsaws stolen from the White Palace. Each 3 meter saw spins perpetually when deployed, and can be returned to item storage if you're careful to not cut yourself doing so.

A holy ring that gains one spell charge every 8 hours for a maximum of 3 charges at a time. Allows you to cast one of three effects with each charge: Smite - charge your body or weapons with holy light to empower your next strike, Blessing- increase one chosen physical stat for yourself or a target for five minutes, Purify- purify a target of all affliction with strength proportional to your own energy levels.
A can of very plainly branded coffee. Every swig will cause an orgasm, drinking the whole thing in one go will have you cumming uncontrollably for hours.
You have enough martial arts skill to learn any art at increased speed and put any normal person on the ground in an instant. Pros will still beat you, but it's harder now.
You know enough chemistry to be a professor, and you can remember most mundane compounds and formula off the top of your head.
You're a skilled and experienced masseuse, you can relieve pressure, cause pleasure, untense muscles, and loosen joints with ease.

You're a damn good apprentice in kung fu, knowing all of the basic and some of the intermediate level techniques. You might even be able to use your internal energies to enhance yourself with enough training.
You are well versed in meditation, clearing and calming and cleansing your mind without distraction. While meditating, energy recovers faster.

You have a remarkable amount of discipline. You can endure discomfort and pain with stoic ease, train when you don't want to, get out of bed when it's really cozy, and maintain focus. You have excellent work ethic.

You're an experienced lawyer. You have a great grasp of your local world's laws based on nation and locale. You can easily defend yourself or a client in court. You could buy a billboard at this point.
You are skilled at leveraging your skills to get into networks and get past digital and cybernetic defenses.
You are very skilled in haggling, buying, selling, figuring out prices, and getting good deals on any transaction you make

You have perfect control over your own strength- if you don't want to break it, you won't break it. Even if you could shatter a planet you could still punch a pillow and not even dent the surface if you desired.
You are a master of riding- any vehicle or mount you take, you can drive, ride, or pilot as if you've been doing it for years and years.
Married women and MILFs of all kinds are now more attracted to you and consider you a potential romantic interest.
You gain the ability to turn your fingers into exceptionally strong claws capable of cleaving walls, steel, even diamonds in twain. All claw-based abilities and attacks are enhanced threefold.
Birds and all kinds of avian creatures like you a lot more now. You make friends with all avian beings far more easily. Flight effects are now easier to learn and more efficient to use.
You have incredibly enhanced hearing, much like an owl. You can distinguish quiet noises, differentiate multiple sound sorces, and adjust your hearing sensitivity on the fly.
Your strength is enhanced, adding a threefold multiplier onto your existing strength and allowing you to exert far more force
Your charisma draws the eye and pulls people in, making you the center of attention in a room and probably everyone's favorite friend if you put in the effort.

Your gacha now comes with its own relationship tracker. How the menu displays is up to you, but it allows you to track your relationship with the people around you, and what they think of you. Also logs their likes, dislikes, interests, and relevant information. Does not give you hints on how to romance them. This is a tracker, not a dating sim screen.
Unga bunga time. You have enhanced physical strength and endurance, plus increased skill in blunt instruments and wilderness survival. Also, you can rock a wild beard and chest hair if you want.

There is nothing strange about you. Nothing at all. Nobody ever notices anything strange about you, no matter what. Skipping class, talking strangely, going weird places, kissing relatives on the mouth... it's all pretty normal, isn't it?

Congratulations on rising from the grave! Pick either a zombie or a skeleton to come back as. You have no stamina and consume energy to stay alive and doing stuff. Best figure out how to restock on energy faster than you use it. Cannot be turned off. More of a curse really...

It says girls, but it really means the gender you're attracted to. Monstergirls, beastfolk, hybrids, etc all like you more and find it easier to build relationships with you. More monsters in your world end up compatible with you and your shape and proclivities.
I Am Not Paying My Taxes!
You're now immune to taxes and rent from any government or local rulers. Also, authority figures and law enforcement will overlook your minor crimes entirely.
You just have better luck with your romantic life. That's about it. Go get 'em tiger.

Sweet Home Alabama~ You find it easier to fall in love with your family and vice versa. Society at large doesn't much care if you do it either. You and your kin are now immune to inbreeding, and conceived children will now inherit your race changes and passives more easily and are guaranteed to inherit at least two abilities on birth. (You can reroll this for free if it's not your kink)

We love older women in this house. Your preferred partners that are significantly older than you (and are at least 40 years old) are more attracted to you and it's easier to earn their favor. You and your partners's looks will not degrade with age, though this doesn't remove the physical effects of aging.
Gain extra resistance to heat and fire based attacks. All fire and heat based abilities, spells, and attacks are more efficient.
You are a friend to all of mouse and rat-kind. Lesser and mundane rodents will automatically be friendly, and might do stuff for you- clean floors, bring shiny things, so on and so forth.
If you're significantly more powerful than your opponent, you get buffs to your physical stats and energy efficiency. Jerk.

Coat your fists in flame to enhance the power of your strikes while also burning anything hit by said strikes. You can also launch the flames as a fist shaped fireball that hits three times harder than a normal strike.
Coat any object you hold in your hands with flames. Or yourself, if you want. The flames do not harm the object being coated, but burn anything you strike
Conjure a spear of deadly lightning and hurl it at high speed (no, it does not actually move at lightning speed). Deals extra damage against dragons
Create claws of lightning over your hands to rend enemies apart and electrocute them at the same time. Extra effective against robots or gooey beings
Fire a burst of small stone pellets with the speed and force of a 12 gauge shotgun
Launch a stream of sand capable of boring through metal, flesh, or stone with high pressure and even higher velocity
Form stalagmites out of the ground to impale enemies. You can control their shape as they come out, but they only come from the ground
Create generic crystals from your energy and fire them at targets. The larger the crystal or stronger the impact, the more energy it costs.
Create a shadowy orb and launch it as a fast moving projectile. Deals extra damage to spiritual beings and ghosts
Inflict a curse of deafness on an opponent by touch or ranged hex. Duration of deafness depends on target's magic resistance. If magic resistance is minimal, the curse is permanent.

Grant a minor blessing to any target by suffusing them with Holy energy. The blessing buffs a chosen trait for one hour: Vitality, Strength, Resilience, Agility, or Stamina. Only one blessing per target.
Grow a tough carapace over your body to serve as armor. Toughness and defense scales with physical stats.

Flood your body with pluripotent stem cells to start rebuilding your body and healing wounds at the cost of a whole lot of stamina. If drained of nutrients, the process will harm you instead. You may exchange fluids with others to transfer the cells to them.
Piccolo's best spell, you can fire a beam or channel energy to dress anyone in the clothing of your choice- also includes weighted training gear, but does not include magically enhanced clothing.
Remove all friction from the target you're touching. With a high enough energy level, might have really bad results for the target in question. Also works on yourself, if you wanna move really fast.
Exactly what it sounds like. 200m sonar based on echolocating pings, allowing you to map surroundings in your mind.
Transform into a cow or a cow hybrid at will, with all the physical abilities and traits that a cow possesses. Or a bull. Ox. Either or.

Increase your olfactory sense to the point of being able to track week old scents across a city, pick out single targets in a room of a hundred, or tell apart any amount of smells even in a dumpster. Effect increases with energy expended.

You can design, create, and modify anything whose primary purpose is repairing or maintaining assorted technology. Also gives knowledge on weakspots and repair methods for almost any tech you find. Yes, a basic forge counts as a repair facility. So does a roll of duct tape.
Send a one way telepathic message to anyone within your sensory range, up to a few dozen at a time.
You can design, create, and modify technology and items related to sex and eroticism. Sex toys, aphrodisiacs, baby oil, lotion, lube, contraceptives, fuck machines, sex dolls, sex bots, etc.
You can design, create, and modify high tech vehicles and their surrounding items and infrastructure. Any car from Cyberpunk 2077, flying motorcycles, trains on hardlight rails, etc etc.

You can place restraint levels on yourself or targets who are willing/unable to resist. The restraint levels prevent the target from utilizing their full powers, and can even seal away entire abilities and racial traits depending on how many there are. Can be lifted temporarily by speaking the command phrase, or by you releasing the effect entirely
Summon part (ie a limb or any other body part) of any of your familiars to attack. Your familiar does not take damage while being summoned this way.
Imbue your body or weapons with necrotic energy that leeches health from enemies and amplifies your own attacks. Deals extra damage to living targets. Can be flung as a projectile.
Enhance the properties of your own cooking, imbuing nutrients and making the ingredients used more powerful and high quality. The better you cook, the better it tastes and enhances
Increase the speed that your brain processes information, allowing you to plan and strategize faster. Can also be used in combat, though overuse can have negative effects.
Reinforce and strengthen your muscles to superhuman level, allowing even a base human to tear apart cars and fling them like nothing. Overuse will cause extreme soreness and muscle tearing.
A Branch of Sin that allows you to spend vitality and turn your blood into sickle-blades across your entire body. The stronger the blades, the more health and blood it takes to maintain.

Turn yourself into a weapon that suits your disposition. Anyone wielding your weapon form can use your abilities alongside you and their own powers. Damage taken in weapon form translates to your normal body. No, it doesn't come with Soul Resonance, sorry.
A white winged lion with the tail of a scorpion. A fierce guardian, she will defend any place you ask her to until death.

A female ogre and member of M.O.N., she is massive, extremely strong, and extremely skilled. She's very gentle and motherly, and has a lot of girly habits. Comes with her full set of armor and a few changes of clothing.

A breeding pair of a Lightfury female and a Nightfury male. Both are semi-aquatic, highly agile, and are capable of firing plasma blasts in contrast to a normal dragon's flame breath. Extremely stealthy, extremely deadly, extremely fast. Also, very cute. Might as well be giant intelligent cats.

A multi-eyed living shadow digimon that haunts other digimon or humans and feeds on their despair. It has powerful illusions, and a fairly sadistic personality. Depending on the despair consumed, may evolve into different forms.
An advanced surgical droid equipped with a vast database of medical procedures and medicines. Is extremely precise and capable of operating on nearly any organic lifeform.

Bulletproof quadripedal extraterrestrial life forms that have super hearing but are otherwise blind and not very smart. They are strong and fast, but get tricked by flowing water. Start with 4, summon more with extra energy reserves.

A three meter tall bronze automaton with six arms, capable of designing and constructing just about any building or home within a day when provided proper materials. Don't ask how it's powered. Not a combatant.

A nondescript phone with a single number inside. Call the number to summon a generic detective to start investigating any target you know the appearance and face of. Will investigate with high level stealth and spycraft, but is otherwise normal human across the board. You may call for updates on the investigation at hand, or give orders to the PI.

A giant, violent creature somewhere between a bear and a Namahage. It can freeze its own bodily fluids and fire icy blasts from its mouth, or freeze its arms to make blades and bludgeons of ice. It is very strong, very fast, and very dangerous.

An otherwise normal alligator that is a master of detective and investigative work, capable of getting just about anywhere, extracting any information, being entirely undetected, and looking really cool while doing so.

A normal sized energy drink can with some kind of green juice inside. Drinking the entire can restores about a third of your energy and mana. Drinking more than three in a day will cause a heart attack and possibly other deleterious side effects.
A golden cross blessed by an angel. Burns demons, wards evil, and removes curses in your surroundings when worn openly around the neck.
The basic Infinity Gauntlet. It um. Doesn't do much but hold the Infinity Stones, which are not included.

A refined bar of Aerialite infused with sky energy. Capable of releasing wind and emulating various weather phenomenon in the right conditions. Synergizes well with lightning and air based effects. Can be used to craft a variety of armors, weapons, and other items.

That thing was too big to be called a sword. Too big, too thick, too heavy, and too rough, it was more like a large hunk of iron. A massive sword too big for a normal man to wield. Having bathed in the blood of countless spirits and demons, it is nearly unbreakable and kills the immaterial just as well as the material.
A vial of holy, blessed antidote that can cure all diseases and ailments below S rank
A set of pre-Great War power armor capable of shrugging off low caliber bullets and lifting cars. Automatically refills its own fusion core ever 24 hours.

An ingot of a mythical metal capable of killing monsters and magical beings while being utterly harmless to anything mundane. Nonmagical beings will see Celestial Bronze items as something ordinary and disguised, usually. Get 3 10kg bars

A vial with a single dose of Venom capable of turning any normal man into a musclebound giant via steroidal injection. Lasts twelve hours, after which the user is left weakened and in withdrawal. Extremely addictive. Might cause rage induced crash outs.
The spear of Ornstein the Dragon Slayer. Imbue it with your energy to wreathe it in lightning and increase its attack power. Does extra damage to draconic beings.
A bow wielded by Gwyndolin, goddess of the Darkmoon. Empower the bow with energy to imbue your arrows with moon energy. Comes with 24 moonlight arrows in a quiver.

Need someone dead? Need something stolen? Need an entire space station crippled and all its occupants turned to ash? Rent a Tenno! Upon activating this throwable and reusable beacon, you may pay any amount of applicable currency and/or esoteric materials and object rewards to hire a Tenno for any job you may need. The more you pay, the more experienced, lethal, powerful, and swift your hired Tenno will be. No, they will not give you any of their stuff. Only useable once every twelve hours.

The Former 22nd Head of the Shihoin Clan, Yoruichi is the former captain of the 2nd Division of the Gotei 13, and former commander of the Onmitsukido. As a Captain Class combatant, she would easily be able to tear through a country with little able to stop her in a Normal World, and her skill is centuries strong. Has a fondness for cats and strawberries.

MUAHAHAHA! LISTEN UP, FOOL! I, DR.ROBOTNIK, THE GREATEST GENIUS IN THE WORLD, HAVE DEEMED THIS PALTRY ROULETTE SYSTEM AN ACCEPTABLE TOOL FOR MY PLANS! FROM NOW ON I SHALL LET YOU GAIN MY MIGHTY INTELLECT AND MECHANICAL WONDERS SO YOU CAN SPREAD THE JOY OF MY EMPIRE! You will begin with the knowledge of my first rodeo against that BLASTED RODENT!

One of the Four Heavenly Knights, and the second strongest among them. Granberia is a dragon warrior who fights for honour and duty. Prove your strength and valor to earn her respect. Otherwise be ready for a hell of endless training until you satisfy her, either in battle or in the bedroom

Looking like a talking black cat with a crescent moon symbol on her forehead, Luna is actually an alien from the planet Mau. Luna is able to sense magic and the presence of evil, and can temporarily assume human form with great effort. She has access to a pocket space and has minor telepathic powers.

Ana and Una Puma are twin catgirl androids originally created as pleasure droids and strippers who instead turned to a joy riding life of crime. They are strong, fast, beautiful, and deadly, and enjoy explosions, fast cars, and making cops look like idiots.

An ice elemental who appears as a blue skinned woman. Her signature attack is Diamond Dust, which usually creates a massive amount of ice to smite her enemies. Not particularly social, but very very pretty
A bright pink cow that produces strawberry milk. That's, um. That's it. It's a cow.

A Thundercat warrior, Cheetara is a speedster with a casual jogging speed of 120 mph. She also has a sixth sense that gives minor pre- and post-cognitive visions and a basic danger sense. She is skilled with a bo staff and carries a collapsible staff in her bracer.

A nigh unbreakable magic sword that cannot be used for evil, the Sword of Omens gets its name from the Eye of Omens, a powerful gem that contains a sentient all-seeing force of magical power. The Sword of Omens can scry far distances, fire ruby energy blasts, and emit a symbol to summon and empower your allies. Shrinks down to dagger size for easy of transport.

A canister of perfected nanites that, when injected, turns the target into a peak human in the prime of their life, as well as making them biologically immortal and allowing them to regenerate grievous wounds.

A large container containing blueish sludge like liquid. When exposed to a creature/person the sludge rapidly mutates and merges the creature/person with the last animal, creature, or object they have touched in the past few hours. The Ooze can also be used as a substitute for fuel. The mutagen refills itself as long as the container isn't broken.

One single Gnorp. Alone it is weak but extremely adaptable, and can be put to work to do basically anything; however be aware that it's pretty small. Do note they will require rock fragments (what they call shards) to make things. Also durable enough to slam themselves against rocks for hours without tiring.
Allows you to copy a skill, ability, or passive from any of your current familiars while active. If the familiar dies or is otherwise dismissed, the copy immediately fades away.
See the 1 Gnorp entry. But instead of just 1 Gnorp, you get a 5 pack of them.
See the 1 Gnorp entry. But instead of just 1 Gnorp, you get a 25 pack of them. The more Gnorps there are the stronger they get!
Your body is practically slime-like. The harder and faster something physical hits you, the less impact and injury it will cause. Does not fully account for slashing or piercing attacks.

A weapon that takes a form of your preference. Starts as the weakest variation of that weapon (ie, a sword made of a weirdly shaped twig, nerf gun, etc). With more use, it self-modifies based on your experiences, training, and any special resources you feed it. Grants extra money every time you defeat enemies with it.

You are now able to create, modify, and design technology and items related to restoring ecosystems and local ecology. Reforest the area, purify water, depollute the air, rebuild an entire ecosystem and environment if you have to.

You can now create, modify, and design technology and items used in the study, understanding, discovery, and modification of all things biological and living. Starts with a basic understanding of mundane creature biology and knowledge of what lab equipment you need to improve your skills.

Gain a boost to movement speed and dexterity whenever no one is looking at you. If you are pursuing someone, you gain the ability to phase through objects and ignore the optimal path to catch them from the most unexpected and irrational places.

The world's magic has awoken where you landed, and will slowly return around the entire world... or infect it, if it didn't have magic before. Whatever happens in the aftermath of that, happens. Magic surges through the earth, plants, animals, and all sapient beings over time.

A seed from a world tree big enough to tower over any skyscraper. Plant it. Care for it. Make sure it survives any fire, sickness, drought, or other hardship in order for it to reach its full potential. As it grows, mana will spill from its wood and roots and strengthen the natural world around it.
Allows you to copy a skill from any of your current familiars while active. If the familiar dies or is otherwise dismissed, the copy immediately fades away.
Allows you to copy an ability from any of your current familiars while active. If the familiar dies or is otherwise dismissed, the copy immediately fades away.
Allows you to copy a passive or racial trait from any of your current familiars while active. If the familiar dies or is otherwise dismissed, the copy immediately fades away.

Make a tunnel just a bit larger than you are tall and wide by walking into the ground. The tunnel will not collapse under normal circumstances, though any dirt or stone removed will appear on the surface in a continuous mound as long as you're walking. The better your movement speed, the faster you can tunnel.

You gain super strength, high speed flight, a nearly completely invulnerable body, and an eidetic memory with enhanced cognition. You still need to breathe, though. Also comes with the prerequisite heroic body shape, of course.
Any bullet you manually load into a gun can be imbued with as much energy as you want, enabling it to strike with truly devastating power. Really useful if you have other gun based abilities.

You may grab any spell or otherwise non-physical attack as if it is a physical object- provided it looks solid enough. While being grabbed, the attack in question does little to no harm to your body, though if your grip slips or any part other than your hand triggers a detonation, you're still screwed. Scales with physical strength.

The Cyberdemon as seen in the UAC Mars Facility during the Slayer's reawakening. If the demon is killed, resurrect it by offering the souls of freshly slain sapient beings, or by pumping its corpse with demonic/unholy energy.

A single Doom Hunter, a cybernetic demon monstrosity modified from an old, extinct species. Comes with flying tank body, chainsaw arm, plasma gun, energy shield, and rocket launchers. Every hundred people you kill grants you the ability to summon another Doom Hunter. Yes, familiar kills count too.

Your attacks follow a cycle of elemental natures: Fire, Water, Wood, Metal, Air, Poison, Light, and Dark. Each turn consumes extra energy to empower your attacks. If an attack already has an elemental attribute that matches the turn, the potency of that attack increases even more- ie, throwing a fireball on the fire cycle will cause an inferno instead of a small explosion. Deactivating this ability will not restart the cycle.
Summons a group of 5 basic Imps from DOOM. Increased numbers and variety based on your own strength and energy pool.
A small cooler packed with your least favorite foods. Great for survival. Not so much for a barbecue. For you, at least. Someone else might like it.

Your digestive tract now functions as either a straight line or an empty squiggle for the purposes of taking something in one end and having it fully pop out the other. This will not hurt, and will never result in waste material coming out where it shouldn't. Your insides are also now always properly lubed and both anal and oral sex are extremely pleasurable

Every single hole in your body can be fucked with no side effects whatsoever, even the holes that normally wouldn't fit anything in them. Ears, nose, eyes, urethra, bellybutton, anything. Every hole is clean, tight, stretchy, and thoroughly lubed in case something happens to enter.

Calculus class made manifest. By manifesting functions, numbers, operators, symbols, and understanding how they work together, you can create weapons and nigh magical effects using the various schools of math. Be wary- the higher level you get, the stronger it is. There are strange things hidden in the depths. You must figure things out via your actual math knowledge.

Geometry class made manifest. By manifesting the shapes, angles, and curves of geometry, you can create weapons and nigh magical effects. Be wary- the higher level you get, the stronger it is. There are strange things hidden in the depths. You must figure things out via your actual knowledge of shapes, ratios, and angles. The golden ratio is especially powerful.

Physics class made manifest. Manifest the symbology, terms, effects, and lessons that you learn in physics class. Starts with basic physics and only goes up from there. By manipulating those manifestations, you create their real effects in the world. The higher concept you go, the stronger it gets. Beware that it relies entirely on your intelligence to get that far. The universe is the limit. Good luck.

Programming class made manifest. By typing the commands present within your programming language of choice, you may manifest them into reality and create an assortment of effects with them- weapons, sapient beings, neural networks, magic-like attacks, so on and so forth. Draws on your actual programming knowledge to use. The deeper you go, the more powerful it gets. There are strange things at the bottom of those functions...

A bakeneko who spends a lot of time as a very pretty witch lady. Not actually a Witch. She's flirty, cute, fun, and really, really good with pumpkin based magic, able to make bombs and minions and floating platforms and such. She also has nine lives and really nice boobs.
The little chameleon witch whose powers allow her to turn invisible at will. Her hat also has a tongue, like a chameleon. She is small, adorable, and an actual literal child.
The cowardly frog witch, she revels in destruction but also begs for mercy easily. She wields powerful calculation magic, as well as more frog themed attacks and general magical talent.

The spider queen witch, eldest of the Gorgon sisters. She's cold, sinister, pragmatic, and arrogant. She wields powerful spider themed magic, mind attacks, Madness attacks, and can make a variety of Demon Tools as well. She enjoys the finer things in life, and demands luxury

Former adversary of Shinra Kasukabe, the first witch in existence. She wields the ability to sense the path of flames, can cast powerful fire and explosion magic, and has the Adolla Burst. She's kind, cheerful, and outgoing. Might be a little baby crazy.

The witch of the girls' dorm. Specializes in regeneration and calculation magic, as well as a variety of sexy spells. She can transfer magic to others, and is also an accomplished weapon meister with her partner, Jacqueline O'Lantern Dupré. Surprisingly timid and anxious despite her outwardly nasty and strict facade.

The serpent witch. Cold. Calculating. Cruel. Not particularly good at caring for other people. Surprisingly good at pretending to be a caring school nurse. Utilizes vector magic via the manipulation of the 1000 "snakes" in her body. She's very, very good at researching magic and Madness.

The queen of the Witch Order. A caring leader who does want the best for Witch-kind, though without her left eye she's a bit less... grounded in reality. She is highly proficient in spatial magic and ice magic, and has centuries of experience

A descendant of the Valk family and named after her ancestor. She's outwardly quite nice and friendly, but is in truth vengeful and quite heartless in her pursuit of revenge. She's quite powerful with spatial magic, necromancy, and several forms of high level magic. She's also a pilot, stewardess, and tour guide.

The scorpion Witch, youngest of the Gorgon sisters. She's intelligent, sinister, cold, heartless, and extremely powerful. She specializes in mind control magic, but has a wide variety of other spells at her command. She usually attacks with scorpion themed magic.
The Thirteenth Witch, the woman who made the church quiver. Mysterious, unknown, still a powerful witch to the point that the other members of the Witch Order executed her for her actions.

The mice witches. A family of six identical witches with mouse themed magics and attacks, with the ability to merge into one greater form. Each one starts as a tiny gremlin. The more that merge, the more mature and filled out the resultant combination gets. They're excellent as espionage, though they're also a bunch of little shits. They all answer to Mizune and might just be one witch split into six bodies? Who knows for sure.

The embodiment of Madness, the physical form of fear itself. A whole group of clowns from the moon bearing powerful magics and the ability to reform themselves after death so long as they're connected to the appropriate Madness wavelength. All of them look different. Some of them almost look human. They each have their own personalities, though. Does not include artificial clowns.
The Grim Adventures of Billy and Mandy

You gain an incredibly buffed physique, and the ability to shoot strawberry yogurt from your armpits. Your stomach can also transform into a yogurt dispenser that will proceed to shoot them out rapidly. With sprinkles. Also you can fly through space.

Medusa Gorgon's man-made artificial clowns, bearing a fair amount of the stats and abilities as a real clown, but nowhere near as much. Capable of transformations, Black Blood attacks, Madness attacks, and vector magic. Shape it as you wish, they're yours to create more of.
The Grim Adventures of Billy and Mandy

Exactly what it says. The Grim Reaper's Scythe. It can do basically anything- reap souls, cast powerful magic, tear open portals, curse people, save people, scare the shit out of literal demons, so on and so forth. Just don't lose it.

Incest on a global level is seen about as normally as any other relationship. There are no side effects or inbreeding problems associated with incest now. It is seen as perfectly normal to start dating relatives. Open relationships are far more common too, but that's a side effect of it, really.

For whatever reason, your world only contains women now. Magic, an old virus, maybe the local sapient species never developed a "male" side. However it works, there's only women now. No, there is no risk of population die out, they can all still have kids somehow, however you want it to work. Yes, this includes you too.

For whatever reason, your world only contains men now. Magic, an old virus, maybe the local sapient species never developed a "female" side. However it works, there's only men now. No, there is no risk of population die out, they can all still have kids somehow, however you want it to work. Yes, this includes you too.

For whatever reason, your world only contains horny, slutty femboys now. Magic, an old virus, maybe the local sapient species never developed a "female" side. However it works, there's only femboys now. No, there is no risk of population die out, they can all still have kids somehow, however you want it to work. Yes, this includes you too.

For whatever reason, your world only contains horny, femme presenting hermaphrodites now. Magic, an old virus, maybe the local sapient species never developed distinct genders. However it works, there's only hermaphrodites now. They possess both sets of genitalia, breasts, prostates, and a fair amount of traits of both sexes including the ability to impregnate each other. Yes, this includes you too.

You may retroactively re-adjust the balance of the world's sexual demographics. You yourself will not remember doing so either. All males, all females, adjusting the mix... you could make a world of equal percentages women, hermaphrodites, and femboys if you wanted. Your imagination is the limit. This token blanks itself out completely after one use.

During the full moon, you now become a bipedal shark monstrosity rather than a normal Werewolf. You may still assume full shark form in the water with training, and with effort you may be able to transform even without the moon- albeit, with less power

Slam your fists together to produce a shockwave capable of knocking someone off their feet and sending them flying several meters away. The stronger the opponent, the less affected they are by the impact.

Activate your inner rage and go berserk, powering up your strikes to the point that any normal human would be utterly obliterated by a single punch to the chest. Comes with a red tint, an overwhelming desire to punch the shit out of someone, and the ability to instagib weakened foes regardless of protection. The stronger the enemy, the less effective it is. Lasts three minutes and drains stamina and energy significantly.

Imagine Venom, but it's a horny mess of tentacles instead. A skin tight latex suit full of tentacles that'll fill all of your orifices and fuck you silly while also granting massive physical enhancements. Hope you like trying to fight while cumming your brains out.

For 90 seconds at a time, time seems to slow down and whoever you point at with a finger gun will be smote- surrounded by a largely impenetrable barrier for a few moments until a beam of light from the sky rends them apart. Stronger foes may end up as living skeletons and in severe pain. Severely drains energy for every smiting.
If there exists a specifically numbered group in the world, they now have an extra member that is stronger and more competent than the rest.

Summons a table with the Eggscellent Challenge meal and timer set for one hour. If you complete the challenge you are teleported to another realm and must take the appropriate hat to prove your Eggscellency. Choose wisely. Refreshes every 24 hours if the challenge is failed in any way. You get to keep the table and food until you finish it, even after failure. Waste not, want not.
Your world now has a randomly scattered assortment of yellow boxes with white question marks on each face. If you tap the box, a random power up from Mario emerges and the block becomes inert.

The default Fortnite Battle Bus. Comes as a standard blue school bus with a large hot air balloon on top. Flies about twice as fast as a normal bus could drive... but can't drive. Every seat comes with a situationally appropriate glider for the passenger who claims it. Fits 100 inside... somehow.

If sunk in lava or have your flesh otherwise entirely incinerated, your skeleton will animate itself and your mind will repossess the bones. You will, from then on, be an undead skeleton and largely incapable of truly dying.

A set of 4 big red suction cups that can be worn on the hands and feet. Allows you to climb any vertical structures that have enough surface area for the suction cup to grab onto. You feel the need to shout "LOOK AT ME GO!" if someone spots you while climbing with them.

Somewhere in the world, a circle of tracks appears along with a train made entirely of boxcars resembling a dragon. Inside the boxcars are dungeons of ever-escalating difficulty and loot. Staying too long on the train will make you just another enemy for an adventurer to loot.
An egg for a dragon, it will hatchand bind itself to you if properly cared for. It shall be your other half, and enable you to become a Dragon Rider.

Being soaked or submerged in water allows you to heal incredibly quickly- within seconds if in heavy rainfall or underwater. With enough water in the area, you could even heal instantly while being injured.

A cubic meter sized blocky pumpkin. If carved out and worn on the head, prevents eye based abilities from working on the user and lowers certain creatures' aggression. A carved pumpkin also creates golems from large enough snow piles, or from a large enough heap of iron. Or you could make a jack o' lantern. Carving a pumpkin produces enough seeds to start a pumpkin patch.
A large and sharp combat knife. Other than being unbreakable and permanently sharpened, very mundane.

A headband that makes you the "second" greatest swordsman in the world. Even without wearing it, someone will always try and duel you for the right to wear the headband, or challenge the owner of the Number 1 Headband. The headband can only be lost, not given.

A move created by the first two founders of the Foot Clan. It focuses all the attacker's energy into a single devastating attack that damages an opponent inside and out. It is risky however, as the move does recoil on the attacker and leaves them temporarily weakened

A snail shell-like item capable of toppling structures on impact. It multiples the kinetic energy of any strike by over ten times, sending a wave of damage into an opponent from the inside out. Also comes with immense recoil to the point that baseline humans would die from a single use.
A bow custom-made by Jack Krauser himself. The laser sight allows the wielder to shoot accurately in all lighting conditions. Comes with a small quiver with 30 explosive tipped arrows.

A magic amulet created by the wizard Merlin for his Trollhunters. Summons a suit of magical armor and a large sword when the incantation "For the glory of Merlin, Daylight is mine to command!" is spoken. Adding additional magical gemstones unlocks unique powers and variations of the armor.

A double-bladed sword that can be used as a sword as well as a spear. Amplifies all magic channeled through the blade- the stronger the magic, the stronger the effect. Also contains cryomantic abilities, and the ability to summon Erebus Minotaurs.

All of your current abilities become reversed in the way they work mechanically or conceptually. Heat vision turns to ice vision, high speed flight could be high speed running, sword skills turn into shield skills, so on and so forth.
Any clothes you put on will automatically accommodate size and abilities without being damaged or torn. Congrats, you can never be unintentionally nude again unless cursed to be so.

A third of all normal snails, slugs, and other mollusks around the world turn into various Slugterra slugs based on their environment. Different ecosystems result in different slugs based on the 5 elements: Earth, Fire, Water, Wind, and Energy.

A giant robot shaped like a T. Rex. It's big, heavy, not super fond of humans usually, and armed to the teeth with a radar scanner, a laser in its mouth, jaw cannons, and Disc Cannons- laser guided cluster artillery- on its hips. It has increased resistances to electric and ice damage, with fair resistance to fire and plasma. Not strong against acid, though.
When you are swallowed whole, you cannot be digested, drown, nor suffocated while inside. You have to either get out the way you came, take the natural route, or gut your way out.

An aged trench whistle that, when blown into under duress, will summon a squad of WW1 era riflemen from the British, American, German, Russian, Canadian, or French armies, plus one officer. They will charge your attackers and gun them down, and if successful will return, declare victory, salute, and vanish. If defeated they vanish anyway. Start with 100, grows with time to a maximum of 1000. Duplicate tokens increase the cap by 1000.
The powerful dragon Ravager, fresh from his conquest of the realm at the end of act IV of the eponymous game. Probably gonna be pretty horny and pissed, so good luck with that.

Hey, why are these seed packets so... thicc? You receive one of every seed packet in Plants vs Zombies, though they are now all an assortment of sexed up plant gals and guys. They still function the same, they're just fuckable now, I guess. Imbue the seeds with energy to grow the sexy ones, otherwise they grow as normal, farmable plants that carry the same properties.

Congratulations on getting one of the most stupid busted bullshit kinds of abilities. You now have an RPG system attached to your soul, allowing you to gain stats like a video game character and earn rewards for radiant quests that pop up every now and again. Do as the JRP protag does and become strong enough to fight god.
A generic token meant to test functions on the user side of things. If you get this, somehow, roll a d8 and then roll a new token matching the number the d8 lands on, you've earned it.
A fancy looking sword that is naturally intangible. Useless for melee combat, but provides powerful gusts of wind when swung. Spin for a stronger tornado! Also helps with wind based powers.
Somehow, some way, Hell owes you. This debt will be satisfied yearly with 666 envelopes each containing the soul of a sinner. Do with them what you will.
Lifes just... awesome man. You know quite a bit about life and those little things that make it up. Definitely not an expert, but you're well on your way.
Really work the shaft. Any weapon that falls into the category of polearms is something you're comfortable using. It would take a real master to give you trouble or teach you.
A martial art created for military application, and your newest skill. You aren't an expert, but the forms come easily with no mix-ups or issues. More than sufficient to handle most opponents.

Logistics is a killer. Good thing you can manage it. Your skills when it comes to managing people, resources, and similar are a step above the rest. Properly handling a small business or busy secretary position would be easy, just don't try to step into anything big without some learning first.
Make your own pet! You've got a good head for what it would take to domesticate any normal animal, but magical ones are outside of your expertise without some trial and error.
Deductive reasoning and ability to read cues have increased! Figuring things out and noticing stuff you wouldn't have before is simple now.
You know just the right words. People find you incredibly persuasive.
If you aren't doing anything to stand out, people just tend to overlook you. They'll see you just fine if directed, but otherwise you're just... another NPC. Nobody important.
Winter blesses you. Cold and Ice harm you less and come easier to your command.
Hug good. Good enough to pull someone out of a spiral and make the world just a bit brighter. Just be prepared to play therapist.
Increased endurance. Not too much, but being able to run longer is usually a good thing at least.
Balance? Easy. As long as you're trying, and don't happen to lose all of your limbs, you'll stay upright and moving straight. Or standing. Or just... generally where you want to be.
People think you're more attractive. You aren't actually more attractive, you just look it. Try not to let the subsequent revelation of the wishy washy nature of beauty standards get to you.

If it's on you to store things, it's bigger on the inside. A lot bigger. About ten times. This doesn't physically modify them, but as long as you're the one reaching in you'll find a lot more room than there should be.
Blood is power, and you've got quite a bit of it. Sacrifice your own vitality to power your abilities and spells. Don't go overboard and remember- only rest may return what has been burned.

You're some flavor of cyborg. Either a melding of flesh and metal or a full conversion, but either way greater than half your body isn't natural anymore. On one hand this makes you a lot stronger, faster, smarter, and better at working with tech than most, on the other... maybe avoid magnets. And lightning.
Theft is a thing of the past. Even if someone somehow manages to steal something from you, it'll just pop back up in a convenient location right when you're looking for it.

The right insult means a lot, and you happen to know it. It doesn't matter what you do, if you want to piss someone off chances are you're going to manage it. Though it may take more or less time depending on who you're doing it to.
Run like a wolf! You have a natural affinity with dogs, wolves, and other canids. They happen to like you back as well. As a bonus you can smell better than the average human.
Fuck Zeus. You can tank lightning like a champ and dish it out with ease.

Heat? Cold? Nah, it's always pretty nice out. Temperature extremes can still hurt, but if it's not to the point where it will literally hurt you it's easy to ignore. As a bonus, the colder it is the better your ice powers are and vice versa for fire.
Absorb water by touching it. Expel water by wanting to. There isn't really a limit, but too much water will make you slosh when you move and feel pretty bloated.

Wind blades! Yes, exactly what it says. Conjure and throw blades of winds. By default they're crescent slashes and you need to move your entire hand to make one, but with training you can make them look like anything and make them without moving at all.

Tornado protection. Surround yourself, or something else, with a tube of rapidly spinning wind. Good for projectiles, not so great for anything heavy or fast. With training you can make the barrier in different shapes or stronger.

Instantly bury things. So long as there is dirt under what you want to bury and you are physically capable of the act, you may simply touch something to bury it. What you touch doesn't need to be dead to be buried. Burial this way prevents necromacy or revival.
Create and launch spear of sickly, corruptive, dark energy. It distains the holy and divine, and will do more damage to both.

A fragile barrier of light answers to your will. It isn't particularly strong, but it can be placed near instantly and is particularly effective against curses, spirits, and similarly negatively charged entities.
Not technically a dragon. You can grow protective scales on your body. They're about as good as wearing plate armor at base and only grow stronger as you grow stronger.

Had a Red Bull? You can grow wings! These are capable of lifting you regardless of your weight, but they aren't going to carry you very quickly. On the other hand, they're really strong and more than capable of breaking anyone they hit.

Not quite Wolverine. You regenerate now, but not too well. Enough to close a stab wound or two before a fight ends, but you're not about to walk through a hail of gunfire. On the bright side, this means you're highly resistant to diseases.

Being trans not required, but helpful. You may create an incredibly temporary platform in the air. Only one at a time, but they disappear so fast you effectively have no cooldown. Excellent for double jumping. Or more.
When you choose to, you may begin recording. Anything you see and hear will be perfectly comitted to memory and is incapable of being forgotten or removed.
By willing it so while touching something, you may mark it. You are pefectly aware of the mark's location and how far away it is from your current position at all times.
The more skin you leave uncovered the more powerful you get. Up to doubling your own power when completely naked.
The basis of Danmaku. A simple arrow of energy. You may curve it after you fire, but it's not very good at changing direction.

You're now a wererabbit! Kinda. You can change yourself fully into a rabbit or into a hybrid rabbit-human. While this is active you gain significant leg strength, jump height, and other things associated with rabbits. Yes, including that.
For every ability you may now set conditions under which it will automatically activate. The abilties have their same limits and conditions, but will act exactly as normal otherwise.
You can transform into a pixie! This comes with vastly reduced physical abilities, but you can now fly, have more energy, are better at magic, and are far more agile.

Free reloads. While you are in possession of a weapon, you may conjure ammo for it using your own energy. This comes in the form of whatever is most convenient to reload the weapon and disappears after a minute whether or not it's used.

Little balls of sunshine! They're powered by your energy, but don't take much, and in all ways mimic the sun. You can move them by willing it and even give them extremely simple orders. Loading them with more energy lets them stay around even if you're not there.
An ancient fossil pokemon, somewhere between a pterodactyl and a dragon. If you can get your hands on some Aerodactylite, can be Mega Evolved. Can be trained in any of its learnable moves.

A vengeful ghost capable of interacting with the physical world via telekinesis and physical action. Strong enough to throw around furniture and rattle doors, immune to attacks that don't hit the soul directly. The more energy you give it, the stronger it gets.

A very generic, vaguely handsome, trust fund looking guy. If let loose into the world, he'll start building and managing a corporate empire in your name. Has high level skills in politics, management, negotiations, business, and corporate law. Not so great at empathy or being a real person.

A psychotically violent, aggressive and megalomaniacal toaster, bent on destroying the Earth with atomic fire. Great at disassembling small tech and imbuing certain weapons with superheating capabilities for... some reason.

A key that summons a cool, suave Celestial Spirit representing the constellation of Cancer. Extremely fast, extremely skilled, very good with scissors. A master of haircare and hairdressing. Can literally style your hair without you even feeling it. Largely immortal, and might change shape if passed between owners. Power scales with the owner's.

A set of stone gargoyles once directed to protect the Bells of Awakening. Indistinguishable from normal stone while inactive, upon someone entering they area they attack, using the axe on their tail or the halberds they have in their hands. They can also breathe fire or lightning. They're strong, can fly, and will guard an area with endless patience.

A humanoid, lanky machine painted in mostly yellow. A thing of scavenged scrap and self repair, its original appearance is long since lost to time. Regardless, it's a powerful attacker that wields a motorized sword in one hand, and a Core Eject Shotgun mounted to their other arm. Fast, violent, and deadly. Powered by blood.
A collar that compels whoever wears it to obey its owner. Cannot be used on someone stronger/more mentally resilient than you.

A school uniform with a 10% Life Fiber weave. Shapes itself to suit whoever puts it on, either in male or female form. Its power is enough to make even an overweight teenager into someone capable of boxing Captain America. You get to choose its colors.
A large, jagged, black and orange dagger that gains a damage boost against armored enemies. Damage boost scales with your own strength.
The standard issue Stormtrooper blaster. Fires generic red blaster bolts capable of killing, knocking unconscious, or stunning enemies depending on setting. Ammo cartridge holds 500 shots.
A pair of glasses that allows you to read books extremely quickly without sacrificing reading comprehension or understanding.
The generic smoke bomb. Throw it down for instant smoke. If you obscure yourself from everyone in the cloud, you can teleport anywhere in 25 meters that you'd be able to reach normally.

A bloody edged katana capable of extending its slashing range with bloodflame. Incredibly durable and sharp despite appearances. Every cut made by this sword bleeds unnaturally fast, and those caught by the burning blood it creates are both set on fire and start bleeding heavily

A pot of eternally hot, spicy soup. If someone were to drink a whole bowl while knowing its effects, they would drop dead immediately regardless of strength or abilities. They must consume the entire serving. Only works on things that can naturally die.

A seemingly normal straight sword imbuned with the power of the sun. It's strikes are electrified, and holding it aloft while praising the sun will grant increased power and a small bit of protection to the user and all allies within a small radius.
You know enough about physics to be a professor. You understand how most natural phenomena work and what equations define those interactions
You're a good enough leader to not only tell people what to do and have them follow efficiently, but also boost morale at the same time
You're steady on your feet and agile enough to practice parkour casually. You can dance, flip, maneuver, and perform with grace and dignity.
You're good enough at persuading people that you could be a used car salesman or a pretty decent lawyer. You've got a good idea of what the person you're talking to wants to hear.

A grappling based martial art meant to deal with larger or heavily armored opponents. Focuses on throws, sweeps, trips, and grabs to get someone on the ground and finish them off. Might not work against all martial arts styles
You've got a good eye for people's moral character, and whether or not they're about to do something either bad, stupid, or evil.
Your body is far more efficient at processing nutrients and regaining energy from eating, sleeping, even breathing. All abilities now cost less energy to use.
You're incredibly resistant to all mundane diseases, though some might slip through on occasion.
You have a functioning sense of empathy that allows you to care about other people and recognize that they have inner worlds just like you.
You're great at organizing, managing, delegating tasks, and prioritizing. Great for school projects or an office job.
Your body now stores 10 times its normal blood volume and regenerates blood ten times faster.
Society no longer cares if you're building a harem, and any potential harem partners will mind the idea far less. Doesn't actually help you get their attention, though...
Anyone with a neutral or positive opinion on you now thinks you're far more trustworthy and dependable, making it easier to get into their good graces.
You can now fuck for days on end without rest. While performing sexual actions, stamina recovery, endurance, and resilience are massively boosted.
You're pretty damn lucky. Not supernaturally so, but luckier than most. Does not affect your Gacha rolls.
You're blessed by the goddess Bast. Gain feline agility and reflexes as well as night vision and the friendship of all cats.
People in general are far more loyal to you now. They'll put themselves on the line and won't betray you... mostly. Unless it's really bad.

You're now Brazilian and the descendant of one Samuel "Jetstream Sam" Rodrigues. You get to double jump, have massively improved sword skills and swordsmithing, and might even one day be able to fight kaiju sized mechs one on one just like your gene donor.
You recover your energy and health faster by eating food. The more nutritious or magical the food, the faster you recover.
All reptiles are now easier to get along with and will befriend you more easily. Regeneration is now more potent for you, no matter the source.
Evaporate the moisture in objects on touch. You could desiccate a tree to dust in seconds if you wanted. Less effective on living beings since they can move and try to run.

Freeze just about any object on touch. You could turn an entire street into an ice skating rink if you wanted. The bigger the area, the longer it takes to freeze. Can be trained to freeze faster, though.
Call lightning from the sky to strike anything in your sensory range. Not great indoors, especially not in a city.
