Conjure a boulder and throw it at your enemy regardless of your actual strength stat. Scales from beach ball sized to house sized. Size does not affect throwing capacity. Scale increases with your own stats.
Create an earthquake to cause massive environmental destruction in your local area. The stronger you get, the stronger the earthquake.
Dig underground faster than your sprint speed. Also gain the ability to breathe underground.
Create and shape your own blade of shadows. While it has no mass, it's very sharp and ignores at least some of your target's defenses to always deal some amount of damage. Effect scales with stats

Transform the area around you into a bottomless swamp to trap anyone that steps into it. If fully submerged, targets fall into stasis and are fully incapacitated until released or killed. The stronger you are, the larger the swamp.
Create a blast of light capable of blinding, stunning, or killing opponents depending on their power level. The more energy used, the stronger it gets.
Cover your fists in shining golden light that amplifies punching power and deals extra damage to the wicked, unholy, or ghostly.
THE POWER OF CHRIST COMPELS YOU! Allows you to exorcise negative effects, curses, and even possessions. When used against unholy creatures, it will be as if they bathed in holy water, or holy fire.
You get a holographic menu that shows you any target's likes, dislikes, interests, hobbies, kinks, and gender preference.
Allows you to detect larger forms of life in a hundred meter radius. Could be trained to work on microscopic life, but you'd probably need a good reason to do that.
Increases sight to the point of being able to see hundreds of kilometers away easily. The more energy put in, the further you can see.
Cloak yourself in a deadly aura, augmenting your ability to find weakspots and anticipate movement from your opponent. Also inflicts fear in weaker minded targets.
Fire a shadowy orb at enemies as a projectile. Also inflicts some negative mental and spiritual effects on impact.

Most guys have that problem. Heh, you can shrink to up to a twentieth your size, it makes you weaker but you can shut it off at any time. Could be trained to slowly remove the strength deficit. You cannot Antman anyone with a higher Might ranking than you.

The Vault Tech Assisted Targeting System, a dynamic aim assistant that highlights the best spots for you to aim at. While it will help you, it's up to your own abilities to make those hits count. Directly scales off your own combat abilities.
Sacrifice your health to recover energy instantly. Beware, as the amount of energy recovered is proportional to how much life you spend.
Become a Diabetic Hulk! Consuming sugar will temporarily grant you a large buff to your strength, but will leave you with the after effects of a sugar crash. Warning, can cause Hypoglycemia.

Go to the r/InteractiveCYOA subreddit and pick a CYOA to make a build from. All choices apply retroactively... or don't, and they just throw you into a new situation entirely and might reset all your progress. Good luck!

Go to the r/NSFWCYOA subreddit and pick a CYOA to make a build from. All choices apply retroactively... or don't, and they just throw you into a new situation entirely and might reset all your progress. Good luck!
An old easily tricked knight with gastrointestinal issues and a penchant for eating only beans.

Allows anything held in the hand to be used like a gun where your index finger marks the "trigger". Starts at the level of Smith & Wesson Model 500 but can be improved with technology based tokens. Different tech trees grant different effects and increase power.
A massive tree upon a small island. Inhabited by a large amount of owls, snakes, and other small creatures of moderate intelligence and mysticism.
The entire 1982 lineup of the New York Giants football team. For... some reason? Good for playing football I guess...?
The entirety of China is now replaced with the China of Kung Fu Panda.
Everyone knows that bullets aren't real you idiot. While wearing this ring gain complete immunity to bullets.
"Would You Like to Sign This Petition?"

Whenever you need to progress towards some insurmountable goal, manifest a clipboard with a petition for what you plan to do and ask people to sign it. When you get a reasonable amount of signatures, a guaranteed path to progress your goal will appear

Not a planetary spirit, unfortunately. Instead, GAIA is an artificial intelligence specialized in terraforming. It has many subfunctions which, unlike the game, are all fully functional and properly under control. Does not come with dedicated computational systems.

A crystal is implanted into your body, granting increased magical potency and the ability to absorb the crystallized power of defeated demonic entities (Shards) to empower yourself further and use their abilities. Shards may be stacked or improved via transmutation with reagents. Also comes with the Crystal Curse which crystallizes your body over time. Can be slowed with Enochian glyphs on your body, or direct exposure to hell-like environments.

A phone which allows you to summon one of your OCs (or any familiar in the Gacha, your choice). Starts scaled to your own stats, and will increase in power with training until they reach their appropriate base stats again. One use only.

A laptop which allows you to call in an AC-130 after getting 11 kills in one combat situation. Armed with a 105mm cannon, 40mm cannon, a 25mm autocannon, and two angel flares. It will fly over the area it’s called to in a circle, blasting any marked targets and visible for 2 hours before flying out of sight to rearm and refuel. Also inflicts terror on enemies. 1 hour cooldown.
A small plushie of you, it’s nice and cute. If given away a duplicate of it spawns in your inventory after 8 hours.

A normal looking red flare. Upon being lit, a helicopter will manifest into existence carrying 12 Special Forces operators who will breach into your current location by any means necessary to extract you either back home or somewhere safe. They will also smash any vases they see. 1 day cooldown.
The Entirely of NATO's Military Forces
Summon the entire combined military forces of every NATO member nation to absolutely annihilate the target at hand. 1 month cooldown. Jesus christ what could actually need this much firepower?
You are now a Warhammer rat man, this makes you both much smarter and much dumber.
Causes a nuclear detonation between 100 kilotons to 50 megatons in yield at a chosen site within 100 miles. The bigger the blast, the longer the cooldown, starting at 1 month.

A large island now flies high in the skies near cloud level somewhere in the world. On the island is the ruins of an ancient Echidna civilization, plus the Master Emerald and a guardian who may or may not be the last Echidna alive.

You can now take off your limbs without harm. The removed limb can easily be reattached, and you retain feeling in your limbs when removed. You start only able to remove whole limbs, but with time could learn to remove smaller parts.
Whenever you bite someone they gain racial traits based on abilities you have previously rolled. Duplicate tokens allow you to pick from an additional token category.

You are able to build weapons or vehicles based the combo blueprints from the Dead Rising games. No matter how nonsensical the building materials may be, they function exactly how they are presented to.

You are now a sentient machine without human form. Choose a mundane vehicle or structure, or roll for a vehicle; That is now your new form. At least you can still control all your own functions still. Fuel restocks once a day.

A six pack of Overcharge Delirium XT. ENJOY THE ELECTROLYTES AS YOU ELECTRO-FIGHT THROUGH THE NIGHT! Warning: An untested ingredient (extremophiles) in the drink causes the consumer's endocrine systems to go into overdrive and mutates them into the OverCharge Drinkers. Restocks when empty.
The infamous deck of many things. Contains... many things. Effects, curses, items, money, weapons, familiars, spells, etc etc. Pull one if you dare.

You become an expert at using a shovel as a weapon. You know how to pogo bounce using a shovel, cannot be exhausted while digging, and have a knack for finding buried treasures. This skill scales with the quality and type of the shovel you use and physical stats.
An IOU card. You can give this to someone in exchange for any physical item or service. At a later date you will have to pay them back with either an object or deed of equal worth.

A complete set of wooden minecraft tools- sword, axe, pickaxe, shovel, and hoe. The tools function like they do in the game, same durability, same capability of removing multiple cubic meters of dirt and rock. Duplicate tokens increase tier of tools by material, in order: wood, stone, copper, gold, iron, diamond, and finally netherite.

A cellphone with a limited contact list. You can call on another Omni/Chaos Gacha user to be your ally for an hour before they are resummoned back where they were before. Single use, the phone is used up on a successful summon.

Need someone dead? Need something stolen? Need an entire space station crippled and all its occupants turned to ash? Rent a Guardian! Upon activating this throwable and reusable beacon, you may pay using any kind of gun or generally neat/esoteric resource to hire a Guardian for any job you may need. The more you pay, the more experienced, lethal, powerful, and swift your hired Guardian will be. No, they will not give you any of their stuff. Only useable once every twelve hours.
You now know all of the different symbols and their meanings in the world. There are very few languages you do not truly understand, and you become an expert in magic formulas.
Turns all of your current katana based swords into European ones instead. The weapons still keep the same properties of the previous form. Pretty much just a cosmetic change.

A one-use super-dose of mechanites tuned to heal health conditions. The mechanites will target and heal the single worst health condition affecting someone at any given time. Works even on otherwise incurable health conditions. The mechanites can even transmute themselves into organic matter, forming new limbs or organs as needed.

A one-use super-dose of mechanites tuned to resurrect the dead. Administered soon after death, the mechanites repair broken-down tissues and kickstart the body back to life. Unfortunately, the resurrected sometimes come back with brain damage, blindness, or progressive psychosis. Outcomes are better when the mechanites are administered to a fresher body. Well-preserved bodies can be resurrected, even long after death.

You have uncovered the secrets of RULA and their advanced weaponry, somehow. Grants access to the coilgun FOCUS weaponry, RULA's Pressurized Explosive Naplam Flamethrowers, and All in One Nutrient Bars (Basically MREs but they taste like seaweed). Also forklifts that are as fast as race cars. Can somehow all be made with circa 2016 level technology. Odd.

You know the secret magical rituals for embedding mystically empowered jewels into your genitals. The benefits of such include the ability to turn sexually generated energy into permanent magical reserves, increased height, strength, and muscularity, and dramatically enlarged sexual characteristics. Downsides include monstrously increased libido, drastically reduced sexual inhibitions, and constantly leaking sexual fluids.

A infinite crate of soup cans, will never run out no matter how many you remove. The soup in the cans is perfectly nutritious, and can sustain someone hypothetically indefinitely. May inflict insanity if you look too hard.
A whole roasted blocky chicken cooked in lava. Eating the whole Lava Chicken grants a massive speed boost and resistance, but causes you to leave a trail of fire everywhere you run.
A magical cat girl who is an idol on the side to make money. Also contains the spirit of a angry ghost. Has a seemingly infinite storage of bombs.

You gain large claw like marks across your upper torso and legs. You can no longer wear any clothing or armor that directly covers these marks. Weaker willed enemies will immediately try to flee on sight of you unless ordered to fight you, and otherwise friendly characters look upon you with suspicion. You also become immune to any curses below this item's rank and gain enhanced physicality.

Davoth's Hell Mech- somehow still contains many of his demonic abilities. Powered by passively draining any and all demonic energy in the universe ranging from mortal sins, curses, ancient pacts, and the wearer's own evil. Prolonged usage of the mech inflicts demonic traits and attributes.

A pair of green boxing gloves that make you a world class boxer. You gain the knowledge and foresight on when and where to hit someone for an instant K.O. By timing your punches right you can gain a Star, which may cause a critical hit

Each of the five original Mighty Morphin Dino Zords are now hidden around the world- T. Rex somewhere underground, Mastodon in the tundra, Sabertooth Tiger in the jungle, Triceratops in a mountain, and Pterodactyl in a volcano. Find them all to gain their power.

A rock that applies an abnormal amount of kinetic force when thrown or launched. Due to being a set increase, the additional energy becomes largely irrelevant the harder this rock is thrown. Might break conservation of momentum. Maybe.

An eighteen year old Sakura Haruno. Probably the world's third strongest ninja by sheer physical prowess and regeneration alone. A very close second to the best medic ninja in the world. Fiesty and badass, no slander in this house.

The princess of the dead. A hungry, flighty, somewhat dimwitted ghost woman who used to be a princess. She doesn't remember her human life, but she's still rather courtly anyway. She can also control death. As in she can kill literally anything instantly. Also, she has lots of danmaku patterns and can fly and do ghost stuff.

A spunky party girl and a full time superheroine. She wields super corrosive acid that she can skate on, fling, spray, and turn into a temporary suit to do massive damage. Her skin bleaches when she runs out of acid.

An oni turned hermit who practices the tenets of asceticism and some mix of shinto and taoism. She's extremely strong, extremely good with magic, and really does not want to put her right arm back on. She's also quite motherly sometimes.

A badass, sadistic femme fatale that used to run with the Mad Gear Gang. She's a remarkably sturdy fighter and can use a mix of kicks, grapples, and pro wrestling moves. She's also really good with a whip and is, unrelated to anything else, transgender.

The titular hell knight- a demon of noble lineage and great power, with the dragon Grenier sealed in her soul. She's highly skilled with swordplay, flame magic, and general spellcasting. She's strict, chivalrous, and surprisingly moral for a demon.

The Hashira of Love. Absurdly stronger than normal and a master of Total Concentration Breathing and Love Breathing style. Very interested in finding a husband stronger than her and a bit ditzy, but earnest and willing to throw down when it counts.

A genius sniper. Quick to anger and quite passionate, but caring to those she's warmed up to. Well trained in long range assassination and comes with her Teigu- Roman Artillery: Pumpkin. An energy weapon with infinite ammo and power that scales with the amount of danger the user is in.

The Omni Gacha's default helper robot! A floating golden orb roughly the size of a dodgeball with a round screen for a face, usually depicting an infinity symbol. Its job is to help you find situations where you could earn tokens, manage your tokens and items, and provide a companion if traveling alone. While completely indestructible, it also has no combat utility... well, beyond being hucked like a dodgeball. Comes with your choice of personality pack and gendered pronouns.
A vial of red liquid set into an autosyringe. Causes a temporary boost to all of your biological abilities and passives. Might cause mania and lowered inhibitions. Lasts roughly 10 minutes per dose.

A monstrous looking ball of meat. Eating it raw gives you a monstrous form based on your obsessions and ambitions. The greater the obsession and ambition the more powerful your monster form, and the greater your mutations.
You can sing your magic into existence. Sung spells cast faster, and the longer a song goes on for, the more powerful all sung spells become.

The longer you keep up a rhyme pattern, the faster, stronger, and more powerful you become. Works for physical stats and magic. The rhymes must be said out loud, and if you are interrupted you restart at base power.

A chess board with all 32 pieces on it. When you throw a chess piece down, it becomes a color coded statue of a matching soldier. Pawns are foot soldiers, Knights are cavalrymen with extremely fast horses, Rooks are giants with stone like skin, Bishops are mages, Queens have all prior listed abilities, and Kings have access to holy magic but move slowly. Restock clock begins when all pieces of one color are eliminated.

A golden claw hammer that is capable of fixing and restoring anything it hits back into its prime state. It's limited to roughly building size in terms of repairs. No fixing the world with a single tap.
You are always able to find a hidden singular bullet for whatever gun you are using when in need.
Louise Françoise Le Blanc de La Vallière

A pink haired girl that ironically, last they remember, was performing a summoning for a familiar. Capable of using "holy" void magic, and is a bit of a huge brat. Unfortunately, she only speaks French until she completes her own spell.
A perfectly generic mech. Does not have any built-in weapons or armor, but has attachment points for them. Appearance is randomly generated upon first deployment.
Use this token on any target to instantly increase all stats by 1 rank. Maxes out at A rank.

A fully functional Commander unit capable of taking over a planet within minutes, perfectly reverse engineering anything it can scan and generally being a Brutally Efficient Self Replicating Mechanism Of War

You are now a Mind, what can best be described as a post-singularity artificial intelligence in a shell body of your choice. You are capable of perfectly simulating multiple universes down to the quantum level and are equipped with effectors and field manipulators. Have fun trying to make a brand new post-scarcity society.

A 55.34 kilometer diameter sphere of antimatter floating in empty space that curiously has no mass and produces noticeably strange effects in multiple dimensions. While sentient, it also seems impossible to divine its intentions. Not... really a familiar in the traditional sense.

A glob of red, indeterminable gel that exponentially increases in speed and power with each bounce. You should keep this in storage if you know what's good for you. Comes in a small padded box. Try not to open it.

This morpher and coin will turn the user into the Mighty Morphin Green Power Ranger. This grants enhanced strength, speed, and durability by channeling the power of an ancient dragon that may or may not be Godzilla. Does not include the Dragonzord.

This gives you the Dragon Dagger, a magical dagger that can be used as a flute to summon the Dragonzord from the nearest body of water. The Dragonzord is a giant sentient robot hosting the spirit of an ancient dragon that can be piloted internally as well as commanded via the flute externally. Looks an awful lot like Godzilla.

A diaper that will perfectly fit anyone. Will always be clean, soft, and dry, no matter the circumstances and will clean any messes made in it instantly. If destroyed or damaged, you will get a new one within 24 hours.

Woundhealer is the Sword of Love and appears as a basic broadsword with the symbol of an open palm on the pommel. It heals all mental and physical trauma on contact, and causes no harm or pain even if impaled into one's body. It is one of the Twelve Swords of Power, and is incapable of harm or being used as a weapon.

A sturdy robe capable of resisting most chemical spills, a dagger, a magical tome that allows you to learn basic Shaper skills without a proper teacher, five Healing Pods, three Essence Pods, and four Living Tools.

A chain shirt, a short sword, a Thorn Baton, twenty Thorns, a magical tome capable of teaching you Guardian skills without a teacher, eight Health Pods, a Speed Spore bag, two Essence Pods, and three Living Tools. All the Tools you need to start your career as a Guardian.
Increase the power of your abilities by lengthening their cooldown. Starts at 10x power for one day, up to a maximum of 310x for a month.
Sacrifice the power of your abilities to lower cooldown. 10x speed results in 1/10th power, with a minimum of 1/100th power for 100x casting speed.

A padded gambeson, a dagger, a Thorn Baton, ten Thorns, a magic tome that teaches you basic Agent skills without a teacher, two Healing Pods, three Speed Pods, an Essence Pod, a Battle Blessing Pod, and ten Living Tools. Everything you need to start your life as an Agent.

Allows you to shoot death beams that kill things instantly, with complete disregard to line of sight, distance, accuracy, or anything else that may compromise its killing power. Does not work on beings without a concept of death.

This person is REALLY good at causing problems when given exotic phenomena. It doesn’t matter what it is, they will find a way to use that F tier item to end the world. Can take any shape available to Space Station 14 players.

The extended and far more expansive tunnels, chambers, and facilities deep within Aperture Science that are largely managed by a seemingly endless amount of cores. Adds onto the Aperture Science Enrichment Center token, or just shows up on its own.

GLaDOS in a significantly more mobile, if far less powerful bare-bones robot body. Still retains most of her computational abilities, but lacks access to Aperture Science facilities. Could still take over most any facility with ease, though.

GLaDOS in a significantly more mobile, if far less powerful but far more humanlike robot body. Still retains most of her computational abilities, but lacks access to Aperture Science facilities. Could still take over most any facility with ease, though. Designed to be fuckable... you pervert.
A burger with 18 ounces of ground beef soaked in rich creamery butter, topped off with shredded cheese, bacon, ham, and a fried egg. It will make your blood feel thick, but it's SO worth it.

The Ratio Technique allows the user to mark their target's body with lines divided into tenths. If the user can strike one of these lines on exactly the seven to three ratio point, they'll deliver a critical hit that could sever limbs, or even outright kill an opponent in one strike.
You can sense emotions. With training you can sense more about those emotions, such as what is causing them or the exact level of emotion.

Wereshark. You can turn yourself into a shark, either wholly or in a hybrid state. Comes with incredibly sharp teeth, the ability to breath underwater, increased swimming speed, and increased strength. As well as any other benefit sharks have.

Discount werewolf. You can turn into a wolf or wolf hybrid at will. In this form, you are faster, stronger, have a better sense of smell, have claws, and anything else a wolf would possess. In addition, you are not a werewolf, and have no weakness to silver or any regeneration.

Connect any door within a building to any other door within a building, allowing rapid movement within a single structure. With practice this can also be used on corridors or other areas with distinct end points, including creating a loop that could make a hallway seem endless.

Upon entering a body of water at least as large as yourself, you may merge with it. This means you can move through it at extreme speeds, ignoring obstacles, currents, whirlpools, and similar while being immune to conventional weaponry. If the water you are part of is disrupted, such as being suddenly evaporated, you will take significant damage.
Tech Tree: High Power Ranged Weapons

Your skill with crafting weapons is so great any weapons you craft will be far more powerful than they otherwise should be. Crafting pistols that will punch through tanks is the least of what you'll be able to manage.

Gain the ability to make anything and everything that would help with establishing and maintaining sustenance for any population. From automatic farms to viable blood substitutes to even more esoteric things- as long as someone needs to eat it, you can make it, make an alternative, or make something to farm it in a sustainable manner.

At will you may multiply an impact you've created. This starts at simply doubling the power, but with training can reach higher multipliers. However, this only multiplies the base- it doesn't give you any strength.

Allows you to duplicate your limbs and organs. Another heart, an extra pair of lungs, multiple eyes? Anything is possible, as long as you can handle the strain. Could be used to donate these organs if you wanted.

Allows you to sprout bamboo from anywhere in your line of sight. Due to being imbued with your energy, this bamboo is supernaturally powerful, making it more useful as a barricade or even a weapon. It will slowly lose its magical effects over time, but it won't wither away.

Give up your future for the present. This ability will siphon away your health in an unnoticable fashion, storing it for when you need to regain your energy. The longer you've charged it for, the worse the comparative damage when you stop, leading to cuts, wounds that can almost never heal, to even death in the worst case. Be careful.

Obsessive, sadistic, and desperate for someone to love her, Giffany, or .GIFfany, is an AI program from the game Romance Academy 7. She is jealous, tempermental, and easily afraid of being left alone. Coupled with her ability to electrocute people, possess machines, and follow through powerlines, she's a surprisingly dangerous schoolgirl in love. Also a 'Yandere.'

The Great Grey Wolf Sif, loyal companion of Artorias the Abysswalker, before his corruption. Loyal to a fault, and fiercely intelligent, she will serve her master gladly, even long after his death. May cause some users to cry.
A large, supernatural reptile. As per the legends, it can turn people to stone with its gaze, but it can also do so with its venom. Also has six arms and incredible strength.

A young mimic. An entity capable of mimicking anything, so long as it can concieve of it. While it starts rather small, being able to mimic a small chest at most, it will grow by eating, and grow more intelligent by eating brains. Which allows it to mimic more things, up to, eventually, humans.

A Shikigami of the Ten Shadows Technique, Nue is a large owl-like creature with orange feathers and a white skull mask. It has the ability of flight, act as a useful scout, and can attack with electrical attacks that could debilitate the average person. While it can carry you, on average a basic Nue cannot do so for extended periods. Scales with your strength.

Originally built to purify the tainted air of cities after another world's 'climate catastrophy', they became obsolete during the new peace, and were repurposed as scouts for the hell expedition. They will burn almost any organic matter they come across out of a compulsive need to continue their purpose. Equipped with a flamethrower, they are relentless. You can summon two.

"Taurus the Golden Bull", one of the twelve Golden Zodiac Key Celestial Spirits. Extremely tall, well musculed and athletic, this bull-man is a master of Axe-based melee combat, though he can be quite clumsy, and easily distracted by beautiful women. He could carve out a mountain if ordered to, with enough dexterity to avoid any harm to others included.

Massive golems created from a mix of magic and craft. They're highly resilient to spells, though not very fast, and don't have much in the smarts department. You can summon six to start and more as you get stronger.

A small pink ball creature. No, not that one. Good at performance and singing, and can put anyone who hears it's song to sleep. Though it's harder to put stronger people to sleep. Male or female is your choice.

A single blade core. When a compatable individual pours energy into it, it will turn into a Blade: a humanoid individual capable of naturally wielding the weapon they come into existence with. Can act independently and take orders.
A dust-brown colored cloak that helps you hide your presence, and also allows you to summon a sandstorm to mask your escape or hide from a situation.
A gold ring with a brilliant yellow rectangular gem. Boosts defense against lightning and thunder. Roll this again to upgrade the ring, up to two times.
The ring of the Knight King. When worn it makes the wearer far tougher. Roll this again to upgrade the ring, granting even greater protection, up to three times.

A sword made from a metal straight from Hell, the Volcano is a flaming weapon that will leave explosions behind whenever it strikes an enemy, on top of setting them on fire. It is one of the four pieces of Night's Edge.
A broadsword made from ice, this weapon will occasionally fire a bolt of ice as it is swung. It is not especially powerful, but it will never melt.

A broken sword that can 'store' the enchantments of the land around it. It has four forms, each requiring a different biome to allow out. Pure Clarity is considered the default, followed by Biting Embrace for a frigid land, Arid Grandeur for the biting sands or perhaps even Hell, and Decay's Retort for the influence of corruption itself.
A pink perfume bottle that makes you more attractive to your desired partners.

Chinese Stealth Armor, invented in China naturally, was a set of stealth armor deployed during the Sino-American War by the PLA against the United States of America. Composed of dark black, form fitting armor with an opaque faceplate, the Hei-Gui Stealth Armor is designed to make its wielder as invisible as possible, even taking advantage of proprietary Stealth-Boy Technology to do so.

Wulfrum Armor. A basic, but very useful suit of armor, with leftover scrap metal this armor will allow you to transform yourself temporarily into a robot, granting you an energy weapon that fires three bullets at a time. It doesn't have the highest defense.

A small silver bell. When rung summons the butler, Mr. Deeds, who will appear out of sight and enter the area. A British indivudal who will assist the one who rang the bell with any one task, so long as it is reasonable. Reasonable includes obtaining small, common or uncommon items, household chores, and killing unprotected, close, untrained, individuals.

A technological glider suited for one person. Once linked, it may be driven using nothing but your mind and contains a small storage space and sharpened edges. So long as it is not entirely destoyed it is capable of self-repair. Fuel is refilled every eight hours.
The Armor of an Irithyll Outrider Knight. It is coated in an almost freezing mist. While it will not freeze your body, be careful, as it could slow you down. But the benefits are numerous.

An Asauchi, an unnamed Zanpakuto. Considered the ultimate Zanpakuto because it can become anything, the wielder will slowly imprint their soul on this blade until it becomes a reflection of their Zanpakuto Spirit. It is a lifelong process, and the blade will continue to grow long after awakening their Bankai.

The Taxman Cometh! Even Heaven is not immune to owing, and they owe you. A hundred dots of heavenly power have been paid out to you, and you can use them for many different things. Healing, dispelling magic or negative effects. You can even use a large amount of them to summon a Guardian Angel, or perhaps even open the door to Heaven yourself. Restocks every half-annual tax year.

Specialized blood used in ministration, it revitalizes the user. Replacing your blood with this will make you immune to most natural diseases, but also could cause you to fall to beasthood. Fear the old blood.
You're really good at math, any simple math is easy to do and you know the formula for most complex math. Suitable as a good point to start post-graduate studies.

Maid and butler duties are easy for you, and you can perform them a cut above most people. Household chores, establishing and running a home, hosting important people, and interacting with the upper crust are all things you're excellent at.
Should you save someone in distress, they will be guaranteed to have significant feelings for you and grant an equivalent reward in return.

When standing still you gradually begin blending into the background. This will render you near completely invisible and unnoticable after a couple of minutes, but is broken as soon as you make a large or swift movement.
Bite back. You are now venomous, capable of injecting a paralytic into anyone you bite. This paralytic is stronger the higher your Might is.

Something about your body just accepts things. Transformations come easier, healing is faster, and getting implants, grafts, or similar are entirely without complication. Particularly strong or extreme effects may still cause issues, and this doesn't have an 'off' switch for hostile transformations, so be careful.
You've got just a bit more energy than most people, and recover your energy faster than normal.
Jump scares are a thing of the past. You don't get startled or flinch in response to anything.

Your sense of smell is fantastic. Picking out individual scents, determining what a scent is, and following a scent is easy. Though you'll still need experience to know what smell corresponds to what.
Agility up! Your faster and more agile than you should be, scaling with your Motion rank.
Your voice sounds absolutely ravishing. Seducing anyone by talking to them is significantly easier and your singing voice is now absolutely fantastic.
The bigger the monster, the bigger the attraction. So long as something is considered a monster, they'll be more affectionate and consider you a viable partner.
During the course of your life, you're much more likely to encounter people you find attractive, and who find you attractive, in a favorable situation.
If its for you, they'll do anything. So long as someone is in a relationship, they'll consider you far more attractive than their current partner and it's easier to get them to betray their partner.

Bred to be the best assassins and martial artists, the Kure clan genes are now yours. Physical abilities are heavily increased and you gain more from training. In addition you have a natural instinct from combat and can remove the limits that normally prevent a human from using their full strength. Though using such will still harm you per normal.

If it's cool, it'll happen to you. So long as something is 'cool', such as catching a bullet or walking away from an explosion, then your odds of pulling it off are higher, and you'll suffer no problems from actually doing it. Though you still have to be physically capable of the act.

A Blood Oath Incantation, granted by the Lord of Blood, this ability creates bloodflame lacerations before the caster, which explode instantaneously. It will also cause whoever has been hit to suffer debilitating bleeding wounds.

Breath fire. Like a dragon. The higher your Might, and the longer you breath in, the more flames you exhale and the hotter they are. If you have any alternate types of fire you can change your firebreath to use that fire instead.
Amplify all noises you make to the point that they can crack concrete, rupture eardrums, and completely deafen opponents.
Create, control, and launch spikes of earth and rock, or have them sprout from the ground within 50 meters.
Cover any weapon you wield in holy light, enhancing power and quality and dealing extra damage to evil, demonic, dark aligned, or otherwise malignant beings.
Ask someone's soul a yes or no question and it will answer regardless of any attempt to lie. Doesn't work well on anything capable of interacting with their own soul.
Increases your sense of hearing to supernatural levels, allowing you to hear kilometers away. You could pick out a penny dropping in a crowded mall. The more energy you use, the stronger it gets.
Build up kinetic energy in your body via repeated motions that can be released all at once for a massive burst of power and speed. Stockpiled energy fades when not used.

You have a minimap in the corner of your focus that reveals enemy locations in the nearby area as long as you know they will be hostile. It automatically maps areas you've been and includes zoom, pan, and enlarge as functions.

Marks multiple random spots on any target in your line of sight. Hitting a mark with a projectile causes it to do multiplied damage and may critically injure said target depending on projectile strength. Training may improve mark placement to favor vital spots.

Allows you to create, modify, and design cybernetic augments on the level of standard cyberpunk fiction- subdermal armor, cyber eyes, enhanced limbs, hidden blades, integrated weaponry, etc. You also gain skill in performing surgery to add those augments to people.

Allows you to create, modify, and design high tech defenses and protections- fireproof coating, impact resistant armor, bulletproof fabric, EMP defenses, etc. Doesn't quite yet get into sci-fi territory, just cutting edge military tech.
Increases the damage you do to your opponents, but also forces you to take a percentage of the damage you inflict.

Curse targets through physical contact and forcibly weaken or otherwise decrease one of their physical attributes- strength, stamina, sight, musculature, so on and so forth. The stronger the opponent compared to you, the less effect this has. More energy results in stronger curses. Only one curse per target at a time.

An arachne with a wide variety of miscellaneous skills and sometimes unnerving hobbies. She hates dishonesty in all forms, doesn't trust humans very much, and will become extremely upset if someone mocks her history or motivations. Genuine earnestness goes a long way to gaining her trust.

A shapeshifter who usually takes the form of a petite girl with dark skin and white hair. She's trained in infiltration, self defense, acting, combat, and pranking people. She's a bit sadistic, and doesn't have that much empathy sometimes.

A Kytinn desperately trying to preserve the survival of her species, and the last member of her race. She's sadistic, cruel, more than willing to feed anyone to her insects for sustenance, and generally doesn't care for anything other than the survival of the Kytinn. Surprisingly strong, and uses a variety of insect based attacks. Also refers to herself as "this one" most of the time.

General Grievous' favored bodyguard droids, equipped with electrostaffs capable of fighting off lightsaber. They are more than capable of fighting even without multiple limbs or their heads, and are programmed with enough fighting skill to even corner skilled Jedi Masters. They can also pilot, use a variety of firearms, and command battle droids in the field. Start with four, increasing with maximum stats.

A pack of five wolf-like fanged beasts. They're well trained, capable of climbing sheer slopes, and are capable of using a variety of weapons. They're big enough to be used as fast mounts, and come equipped with their own armor and kits.
A legendary shield of the Way of the White, wielded by one of Father Lloyd's chosen undead. Once blessed with a mighty white flame, it now only functions as a shield that rejuvenates the user slowly.
This ring was secretly worn by a surreptitious sorcerer at the Vinheim Dragon School. It muffles all noise you make, hiding you from audio sensing. Within reason, of course.
A bottle of 100 pills. Taking one will make someone a single year younger.

A powerful Shotgun infused with the power of Night, on top of firing normal shotgun shells, this gun will also fire out a projectile of darkness that will strike twice as hard as the bullets it fires.
A standard broadsword that the wielder can control the weight of. Anywhere from extremely light to impossibly heavy.
A ring said to be chiselled from the bone of a Flame Salamander by blighted Pyromancers living in the great Swamp. Increases the power of all of your fire based abilities and magic.
A silver, sweep bladed, dagger long enough to be used as a primary weapon. It's quite sharp and slightly improves the user's agility, but otherwise has no special powers.

A beautifully crafted Dust rapier with a revolver chamber full of Dust cartridges, each one capable of producing several effects when "cast" through the blade, from projectiles to attack boosts to what might as well be magic. Refills all Dust vials every 24 hours. Best used with the Schnee Semblance.
A wooden crate that somehow contains an infinite amount of common raw materials.
Doctor, doctor. Doesn't come with a medical license, but you're just as good as any starting general practitioner. Maybe avoid surgery until you've had some practice.

The art of Muay Thai is also known as the art of eight limbs, focusing on striking with the hands, elbows, knees, and feet. You've got a good grounding in the art, but becoming a true master will take practice.
Magic isn't that hard. You're really good at understanding esoterica, the occult, and other magical things. The truly advanced still eludes you, but with some study it won't be for long.

You've got the basics down for any normal weapon you can think of. Everything from a dagger to a massive greatsword. Though more unusual weapons, such as a katar, chakram, or ultra greatsword, are not included
You know just where to press. Using sex in the process of correcting an attitude, or simply bending someone to your will, is a lot easier.
Cats like you. All cats. They will always be non-hostile on first meeting, but the rest is up to you. You're also just a bit more flexible and always land on your feet.
Librarian not included. Your mind is highly organized, improving recall, focus, and clarity.

Power is easy to spot, if you know how to look. And you sure know how to look. Sensing any form of energy, from ki to nen to chakra, is easy and only gets easier, and longer ranged, the more you train.

Cook with fervor! As a member of the Nakiri clan you have some inherent ability to understand cooking, pairing the right flavors and getting the spice right on the first try. In additon you possess God's Tongue, allowing extremely precise taste. To the point of being able to pick out the exact spices used in a dish.

Summon a windstorm in the immediate vicinity, massively enhancing the power and efficiency of all wind and air-based magics, abilities, and effects. Can also be used as a strong disorientating attack when focused.
Harness the wind to flight with great precision, power, and speed, with comparable top speed to a small passenger plane.

Channel lightning through any object you touch or hold to imbue it with great electrical power, reinforcing and empowering the object in question and enhancing its innate attributes- sharpness for swords, impact for hammers, piercing for bullets, etc.
Breath out highly destructive waves or beams of lightning. The longer you charge for and the more energy you use, the stronger the attack becomes. Only lasts as long as you can keep breathing out.

Cloak one or both of your hands in violently sharp and loud lightning. Works best when the appropriate hand signs are done- Ox, Hare, Monkey for the standard and Monkey, Dragon, Rat, Bird, Ox, Snake, Dog, Tiger, Monkey for its strongest version. Pierces through just about anything, if you have the power for it.

Create and control razor sharp metal wires from your body with prehensile precision, allowing you to bind, slice, wrap, strike, and dismember with them. The wires become inert once separated from your body, and can be enhanced with your energy to make them more durable.

Interact with shadows as if they're tangible objects- step on someone's shadow to stop them from escaping, knock over a vase by hitting its shadow, pull something closer by yanking on the shadow, etc. Only works on "touch".

Inflict the curse of muteness upon a target either by touch or via hex bolt. The higher the magic resistance, the lower the duration of the curse. Anyone who cannot resist it will be permanently left unable to speak or make vocalizations.

The Paunch Burger Dinner for Breakfast combo. Cheese slathered chili fries, a triple stacked 1/3 pound patty bacon cheeseburger with onion rings and topped with a fried egg. Comes with a 30 ounce chocolate shake. Guaranteed to make your blood feel thick.
A one pound burger patty covered in cheese, grilled onions, five strips of bacon, all sandwiched between two Krispy Kreme donuts. Guaranteed to cause the -Itis.

Sausage and waffle and fried chicken breakfast lasagna, stacked six layers high, with added cheese and sausage gravy. Also comes with optional scrambled eggs layered inside as well. Guaranteed to cause the -Itis.

The world is more prone to corruption. Gangs have better standing, fewer people in positions of power are honest, and it's far easier to bribe someone to do what you want. Perfect for hiding your own illicit activities. It's like real life but it's shitty everywhere.
A can of rootbeer from the old days of Roblox. Drinking it heals you very slightly. It is always cold and refreshing.

The exiled last ruler of the Second Empire, Mad Cat-lon is a master of combat who can call his own retinue into battle- 120 of his own warriors. Unfortunately, he and his warriors start with poor quality armor and weapons. They're also robots and can only be healed through mechanical repair.
Let the hate flow through you. The more you hate your target, the more damage you'll deal. There is no limit to this bar the amount of hate in your heart.

Whatever large, organized national coalition that exists will now actually do things effectively. They will investigate problems, assist in disaster recovery, and even assign troops to help fight evil. Including you, if you're causing issues. If such an organization didn't exist before, it does now.

Any coalition of nations within the world will do absolutely nothing. Their agents will be ineffective, too slow, or actively corrupt and resources will not be properly sent to areas that need it. At best they might warn the member nations of something big happening, but don't count on it. If such a thing didn't exist before then it is far less likely to be started.

You have access to the defunct Scorpion-7's database and projects. This includes the Shadowstalker Mark 1 (a railgun), and Shadowstalker Mark 2, (an explosive energy railgun). You also gain access to robotic arms which can do various tasks like assembling items. As time goes on, you will decrypt more files relating to the shady stuff they did, evenually unlocking the secrets of the Soul Crystals and how to make your own artifical Soul Crystals. Best to not progress the tech tree past the Shadowstalkers, otherwise bad things might start happening.

Gear cells that grant magically enhanced strength and endurance, shapeshifting, immortality and immense magical power by becoming an conduit to the Backyard. The user initially starts with enough cells to become a half-Gear (i.e Testament), only showing red eyes. Subsequent rolls will gains purer cells until attaining qualities akin to the Flames of Corruption, magnifying their strength to god-like levels.

Sol Badguy's signature weapon. A huge blunt blade that enhances fire magic. It can also turn into a cannon for the Saint Oratorio spell, a burst of raw magic that can annihilate almost anything in its path at the risk of the wielder and their environment

A truly massive cavern placed under a city in the world somewhere that contains the entirety of the NERV HQ. There are no EVAs currently, just bays to store and maintain them, but Lilith is still crucified in Terminal Dogma. Will create launch bays and entry tunnels in the above city upon creation.

If you do it, it's not illegal. You are exempt from any and all laws. There will never be any legal consequences for your actions, and everyone knows that laws don't apply to you. Watch out for vigilante justice if you go too far, though.

You can impregnate any living being as long as you cum inside a hole that leads to a womb or something vaguely close enough. Does not guarantee pregnancy, just guarantees that you could impregnate an alien. Also grants a penis if you didn't have one before.

A near legendary type of person who is impossibly skilled at more or less anything you could think of. Less of a familiar, more of someone who just does stuff for you if they deem you incompetent or otherwise redundant.

Allows you to add addendums to any text with the information you want or need written down there- extra terms in a contract, a forgotten glossary in a manuscript, so on and so forth. Works digitally too.

All of the knowledge and skill required to make, modify, and design the terraforming technology of Project: Zero Dawn that was meant to remake the world from a dead state. Also makes you the same caliber of genius as Elizabeth Sobeck.
Bury this voucher to sprout a fully grown Tree of Life- complete with ripe berries ready to be picked for power ups- from the nearest healthy soil.

A flock of cow/pig hybrids designed to be able to live in any environment and eat near anything organic, with a preference for variety over eating nothing but one thing. They are REALLY docile and will almost never attack, even when attacked in turn, and are extremely delicious when cooked.
You can slap anything pink away into nonexistence and gain a temporary energy boost when you do so. If you slap away something far larger than yourself, you instead use the energy to jump above it.

A half gallon ceramic jug of moonshine that tastes like root beer. When drunk entirely, grants the ability to shoot 5 red arrowhead like projectile in a short range as fast as you can snap. When more energy is pumped into this ability, fires out 8 pyramid projectiles that are slightly larger than the user. Restocks in 24 hours.

Kinetically Enhanced Rock, but better. A 350 kilogram shell that, upon being thrown or launched, instantly accelerates to 99% the speed of light. The forces involved destroy it on use. DEFINITELY breaks conservation of momentum.

A small flask filled with blue liquid that tastes like mineral water. When drunk entirely, allows the drinker to shoot a like a blue laser beam that fires as fast as they snap. When more energy is put into it the user fires a large, slow-moving blue fireball. Restocks in 24 hours

A gin bottle filled with green liquid that tastes like mountain dew. When drunk entirely, allows the drinker to shoot small green homing projectiles by snapping. When more energy is put into it, creates a shield of 4 larger chaser shots that orbit around the drinker. Restocks and returns in 24 hours.

A glass bottle filled with orange liquid that tastes like orange fanta. When drunkfully, allows the drinker to fire a strand of flame by pointing their finger and snapping. The longer they wait to fire after the snap the bigger the projectile. When more energy is pumped into it, causes an explosion centered on the drinker that they are immune to. Restocks in 24 hours
An immovable, or unstoppable, rod. Mostly. A supernaturally powerful individual could stop it. Deployment imparts initial momentum, and magic carries it the rest of the way.

When attacked, if you say, "But it’s Opposite Day", the attack will immediately return to sender with at full power. 24 hour cooldown unless it's actually Opposite Day (Either in-story or in real life).

A beaker filled with dark blue liquid that tastes like blueberry kool-aid. When drunk fully, allows the drinker to fire a crescent shaped energy projectile that boomerangs behind the user after a set distance by snapping and pointing their fingers. When more energy is poured into it, fires a much larger and serrated version of the projectile that will follow the shooter. Restocks and returns in 24 hours

Pocket RKKV but better. Upon being thrown or launched, travels at effectively infinite speed. More or less instantly destroys any object in it's path, and is treated as consumable because even we won't try to retrieve that. Breaks all the laws of physics and then some.

This nifty little thing will disable any safeties on any device you use it on, and bring machines under your command. Sponsored by the Syndicate. DEATH TO NANOTRASEN. Disclaimer: Certain machines may have firewalls too strong to break.
A titanic, armored worm-shaped leviathan native to Europa. Durable enough to withstand nuclear ordnance. Larger than most submarines. Could grow further, with maximum size unknown.

A whiskey bottle filled with pinkish liquid that tastes like cotton candy. When drunk, allows the drinker to fire a rhombus shaped projectile by snapping and aiming their finger. The projectile shoots straight forward for a short while, then breaks apart and aims straight at the closest enemy. When more energy is poured into it, the next shot becomes a pink planet-shaped turret that appears that automatically attacks for a minute. Restocks in 24 hours

A wine bottle shaped like a watering can filed with yellowish orange liquid that tastes like pineapple. When drunk, allows the drinker, by snapping and aiming their fingers, to fire 3 lightning bolts capable of passing through targets in a spreading formation. When more energy is poured into it, allow the user to fire a large horizontal electric beam which also pierces through enemies. Restocks in 24 hours

A bottle filled with cyan colored liquid. When drunk, allows the drinker, by snapping and pointing their fingers, to fire three tornadoes that arcs toward the direction of the finger gun's thumb. When more energy is poured into it, fires a larger cyclone that spins in a circular pattern from the original firing location, increasing its radius over time for a minute. Restocks and returns in 24 hours

The Batmobile from the Arkham games. A fully drivable, heavy-duty combat vehicle featuring two main operation states: Pursuit Mode for high-speed driving and Battle Mode for localized tank warfare. Also contains a spare batsuit and gadgets.
A multi module armored assault vehicle. Contains many failsafes and redundancies to ensure that the machine keeps going and fulfills its task.
A large mech resembling the likeness of Eggman. Has an arsenal of laser weaponry built in, retractable rocket fists, and a jetpack.

You've been mutated, experimented on, and ultimately tossed out as an attack dog. Big, dangerous, partly mechanical, and fitted with a massive suit of power armor, very little can stand in your way. Unfortunately, you need the armor on and pumping you with chemicals to stay alive, as otherwise your body will start to quickly degrade. The suit never runs out of those chemicals, at least.
A spinosaurous that wields a giant sword cleaver in its mouth with expert skill and devastating force.
A golden tuba that summons a random Tuba Warrior from the Tuba Warrior wiki when played, their summon lasts as long as you can play the instrument.

You can make any hand held item into a morpher by imbuing it with your energy, granting you a Power Ranger transformation themed around that item. You can do this up to 7 times per identical item with each corresponding color; Red, Blue, Yellow, Pink, Black, Green, and White. These morphers can be passed to others.
Because apparently you don't know the right way or direction. The world now has diegetic markers to denote significance or relevance to any of your quests or paths.

A small mech that can also transform and be used to replace a giant robot's head, allowing you to take control of the robot's body. The body needs to be able to support the head fully on its own to work. Works best on other transforming robots.

You now have a holographic weapon wheel. At any point you may store a pistol, shotgun, LMG, SMG, automatic rifle, rocket launcher, and a single high power esoteric weapon within it and summon them instantly. Ammo may also be stored in amounts inversely proportional to how destructive the weapon is. You still need to reload normally, but leaving a weapon in the wheel for as long as it would take you to reload them will ensure they have a full magazine when taken out, provided you have the ammo stored.
The next item (arsenal, novelty, consumable, farmable, wearable) token you get, you get in bulk instead. Makes 5 to 12 duplicates of the rolled item. Only works once. Does not include vehicles.

All herbivores are now carnivores and all carnivores are now herbivores. The only physical change the animals have is that they now have the traits and features that let them consume their new diets. A deer now has teeth like a wolf, for example.

You are now an unawakened gamma monster. When you are exposed to lethal levels of radiation, your gamma gene activates and grants immense physical strength, mutates you into a more musclebound form, and may also give an additional power based on your emotional state.
An utterly indestructible jukebox that directly converts electricity into VOLUME. Unlike the game, there is no limit to said volume. May make people's head explode with sufficient volume.
A non-sapient meat sack that counts as human as far as rituals are concerned. Use it for whatever the hell you want. Cannot host conciousness.
Some kind of disgusting spider thing that spits acid blood and has a giant circular mouth. Horrifying.
You now have another human torso and legs sticking out from where your butt used to be, granting you four legs, two torsos, and a really weird anatomical situation.

You now have another human torso and legs sticking out from where your butt used to be, granting you four legs, two torsos, and a really weird anatomical situation, including extra breasts, a weirdly big penis, and also a vagina if you didn't already have one.
Your genitalia and certain secondary sex characteristics are doubled- two penises, two vaginas, four boobs... whatever you've got, you've got twice as many now.

CHOCO-LATE! Your entire body has melted into chocolate. You no longer need to sleep or breathe, smell wonderful, have no internal organs or bones, and can freely manipulate your form. If you get cold enough your body may firm up for a short period of time, but otherwise the amount of force you can exert is heavily limited. Your body regenerates over time, but it gets faster if you 'eat' things by submerging them in your body and dissolving them. You can choose to change your flavor this way.

You’re not sure what you are anymore, your skin is a messy patchwork of fur, scales, hide and feathers. You are more of a chimera of creatures and god knows what else, you are constantly mutating but whatever happens you're a force to be reckoned with.
Something about you makes mundane animals not fear you, even normally hostile wildlife won’t attack you unless you attack first. Doesn’t apply to undead or heavily mutated animals.

Your neck is now a penis attached to your head, and is inserted into a vagina which is where the base of your neck was formerly connected to the rest of your body. You can control your body while unattached to it.

Your body merges and turns into a large, constantly orgasming penis. Shortly after you emerge from the cum as a slime made of it. You retain all prior skills, abilities, passives and such. Over time you may learn to control more than one body. So long as your original body (the penis) is intact you can endlessly reform.

Your body merges and turns into a large, constantly lactating pair of breasts. Shortly after you emerge from the milk as a slime made of it. You retain all prior skills, abilities, passives and such. Over time you may learn to control more than one body. So long as your original body (the boobs) is intact you can endlessly reform.
Your mouth is suddenly relocated to your groin region! Where your mouth was is replaced by solid skin. Any genitalia in the way are moved above or under the mouth.
Your tongue has been replaced by a penis. You can’t keep it in your mouth if you're horny. There's not a lot of benefits to this situation.

Congrats! You're now a massive plushie. Your skin has been replaced by fabric and internals by stuffing. You don't need to eat, breathe, or sleep, and are near entirely immune to bludgeoning damage. On account of no longer existing, your organs cannot be harmed. On the downside, you aren't particularly stiff, so good luck hurting anyone with a punch. You also soak up water and other liquids way more easily now.

A skin colored liquid that will turn you into a human when drunk. If you were human originally this will revert you into your original pre-transformation state. Also works as a form of instant HRT if you can't afford a visit to the clinic.

You can freely change your body at will, this includes adding limbs, growing extra heads, making more eyes, adding more genitalia, swapping parts around and more. You can even do it to other people and creatures.

The Palermitan Style is a swordstyle dedicated to dueling. The longer you fight in a duel, the faster you get until your sword ignites and burns your opponent with each slash. Experts of this fighting style, like you, can even combine it with a gunblade for added efficiency.
Open this can to cause a 1 Exaton explosion. Fortunately not enough to destroy the earth, although smaller planets might not be so fortunate.

You now have a valid Costco Membership usable at any Costco location (or applicable multiverse variant) on your world. Also, all item rolls from now on will come in bulk packs of anywhere from five to thirty, with higher ranks corresponding to lower item count.

A well crafted, sturdy, if mechanically simple semi-automatic pistol-katana with additional bladed sheath. It's best used as a distraction weapon, or as a high speed, highly technical weapon due to its additional capacity to be used as a kusarigama. Can also swap in Dust rounds for extra effects. One magazine with 20 rounds every 24 hours.

A wonderfully crafted, home made pair of collapsible shot-gauntlets. Each one fires a 12 gauge shell in multiple variations, with multiple shot types for extra impact and lethality, from normal buckshot to curving explosives. Best utilized with a brawler's style. Can also include Dust shells for extra effects. Two belts of 20 shots each every 24 hours.

A massive pair of crimson scissors made entirely of hardened, sharpened Life Fibers. Nearly indestructible and capable of being separated into individual blades. With enough hot-blooded energy, you can even extend the blades out into a larger Decapitation Mode, or make them bigger than a literal aircraft carrier.

A straight bladed katana with a black blade, white hilt, and a unique blade catcher style guard. Its blade is made entirely of hardened and sharpened Life Fibers, allowing it to rend through nearly anything if imbued with enough energy. It rewards skill and competency. Be precise. Do not hesitate.

The entire world now has pokemon filling its ecosphere from top to bottom, with each species of pokemon appearing roughly where its environment usually puts it- Water types in the rivers and oceans, Ground types near deserts or mountains, Rock types in caves, so on and so forth. Some individuals with a high enough intelligence stat may also receive the knowledge of how to create rudimentary pokeballs.

Every single race from My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic now spontaneously has settled in roughly appropriate locations around the world- bison in flatlands, griffons in mountains, changelings in the deep forest, ponies wherever they damn well please, so on and so forth. You may start encountering some familiar faces, as well as some odd weather and daylight patterns.

The Sun Princess, she who controls the passage of the sun. An immortal, extremely powerful alicorn with a streak of whimsy and a love for all ponies she rules over. She's a bit of a trickster, and loves cake.

The Moon Princess, she who controls the passage of the moon and walks the realm of dreams. An immortal, extremely powerful alicorn with a moody streak and a quiet love for all ponies she rules over. She's a bit out of touch at times, and speaks remarkably formally.

For whatever reason, Moena Shinguji was chosen by her own parents to be the sexually seductive, bare breasted Angel Blade- a warrior of great power who fights for the sake of love, justice, and protecting women. She fights with a heart decorated sword, and in times of need can access a stronger super form. Her true power is Gravity.

Shaia Hishizaki is a model and part time superhero gifted with the physical powerhouse brawler uniform of Angel Ender. Though she's still just as exposed as Angel Blade, she more than makes up for it with sheer strength alone. Usually.

Elfie Elfman is a mysterious girl with an even more mysterious past, taking the mantle of Angel Beretta and fighting for love and justice with her twin pistols. She may be, secretly, the purified form of Nailkaizer. Somehow.

One of the Phantom Lady's beloved generals, she's tall, dark, and dangerous, possessing powerful magics, immense strength, and also the ability to grow three penises from her groin should she choose. There's more to her than meets the eye, but good luck getting her to tell you about it.

Somewhere in the universe, the planet Cybertron retroactively comes into existence, along with the civil war between Autobots and Decepticons. Soon, they will arrive on Earth and show the world there is more than meets the eye.

You may now call for a 5 man squad of Taimanin- anti demon ninjas who mostly end up being sexually attractive women in skin tight latex- to hunt down any target you may desire. The squad stays around even after completion of their mission, until otherwise dismissed. With more energy, you can summon additional squadrons with more specialized roles, and even summon some of the more notable Taimanin on their own.

The magically and bodily gifted queen of dark elves. She is strong, proud, more than a little haughty, but also kind to her subjects and fair to her servants. She does not take betrayal lightly. May or may not have a hatred for any and all men.

Queen Olga's loyal and faithful aide and right hand woman. She's much younger than Olga, but often proves herself to be a loyal soldier, a brave combatant, and a very vigorous top. May or may not have a hatred of men.

High queen of the continent and of high elves, she's the reincarnation of a great goddess and by far one of the single most powerful beings in her world. She is the leader of the Seven Princess Knights. She may or may not have a hatred of men.

The Holy Knight and commander in chief of the Princess Knights' allied forces. She is strong, brave, powerful, and loyal to a fault. She is the second in command of the Seven Princess Knights. She may or may not have a hatred of men.

The Princess Knight of Iris, a proud noble who serves her nation with military excellence. She may not be the Holy Knight, but she's no slouch in a fight, and is still an excellent commander. She is the third of the Seven Princess Knights. She may or may not have a hatred of men.

One of the few Princess Knights to have no combat ability, Prim is Alicia's younger cousin and "little sister". While she may not fight, she has a kind heart, a gentle demeanor... and also has a raging sister complex for Alicia. She is the fourth of the Seven Princess Knights. She may or may not have a hatred of men.

The head shrine maiden of the eastern nations, she is a fairly powerful mage who uses onmyoji and ofuda to defeat and purify evil. She is the fifth of the Seven Princess Knights. She may or may not have a hatred of men.

A former wandering mercenary and ex-member of the Kuroinu mercenaries. She is strong, skilled, more than a little tough, and knows how to throw down as well as any other guy. She is the sixth of the Seven Princess Knights. She may or may not have a hatred of men.

The axe wielding leader of halflings. She's small, petite, wickedly strong, really, really good at swinging an axe, and surprisingly good at weapons manufacturing. She is the last of the Seven Princess Knights. She may or may not have a hatred of men.

Somewhere between HRT and aphrodisiacs, guaranteed to turn even the manliest of men into a drooling, leaking, sexed up good girl within a few months of regular doses. One a day every day, usually chased down with some woman's cock. Thankfully impossible to overdose. You get two pill bottles of a hundred and twenty pills each. Try not to mix them up with your estrogen, they look very similar.

Void Hunter, fox thiren, and leader of HSO Section 6, Miyabi is a blademaster wielding Tailless, her family's sort of haunted ancestral sword. She dislikes paperwork and meetings and attempts to turn everything into a training opportunity, no matter how nonsensical. Can pull off a Judgement Cut.

Infiltrator, psychology specialist, and rat thiren, Jane Doe has no records, no past, and knows just what to do. A dangerous combatant using dual knives to inflict massive critical hits, she's frighteningly intelligent with exceptional skill at manipulation, planning, and adapting to new circumstances.

The undefeated champion! Lighter is a cool guy and brawler belonging to the Sons of Calydon. Stoic and a little goofy, he's usually willing to help. Really good at punching and can make the absolute most out of every moment of hesitation his enemy has.

Your own personal W-Engine. This device plays music to manipulate the area around you and improve combat performance in various ways. You can freely swap out what songs are on it, each of which gives different buffs in combat. Music must be audibly playing to gain the benefit.

A questionably conscious red sword. Can only be wielded by those who are focused and know their purpose. Cuts through magic, unleashes blasts of energy, and even sends out dragons made of energy to attack enemies. Will refuse to be unsheathed if the wielder loses their purpose or falls into confusion.

Clear your mind, find your most intense memories, and let those emotions fill you. In doing so you unlock Shin- a state that significantly increases your physical abilities. Control Shin to create Mang- rings of light that heavily empower an attack.

A plate of spaghetti topped with chocolate and liver sauce. Just the idea of this... thing empowers you. When you first activate an ability it is double strength for a single second. There is a small cooldown on this effect.

A full suit of the famous Victorian Steam Knight Armor in perfect condition. This massive powered armor can fly for a limited time, fire artillery barrages, use a piledriver in melee, and withstand immense amounts of damage. Requires proper care to maintain pneumatic pressure, otherwise the armor will stop working until pressure is restored. Spare parts are recieved every week.
A cane useful for healing. If a target is healed over what would make them perfectly healthy, the excess healing is turned into a wave of damage that harms all enemies in range.

A massive, complex supercomputer, The Law now exists within the world. It establishes a connection between people, granting them wings and halos of light in various apparances, skill with crafting and using guns, and the power of Empathy between each other. Even the most grevious of actions can be understood through the power of Empathy, but The Law acts to preserve and protect those under it's care. One under The Law that breaks its tenets will be cast out and lose their Empathy, with their halo and wings degrading.

A trader of the unusual and mundane, capable of appearing anywhere, at any time. Cannot considers you a favored customer and will make contact with you often, if irregularly. His inventory is ever changing, but you can often find rare, difficult to obtain, or highly useful items. He does attempt to match inventory to place, so everything he sells will be in some way useful for the current place and situation. He even provides banking services!
Your penis is now a fully functional (and quite large) canine penis, fur covered sheath and scrotum included. If you didn't have a dick before... congrats!

You might as well be Mina Ashido's twin sister- pink hair, pink skin, black sclera, golden eyes, and cute lil bendy horns. You also get to expel a seemingly endless amount of acidic slime from your body, and can use it to attack, skate, or make a temporary "mech suit" out of your acid.

Katt is a member of a tribe of feline people called Woren. She is a 15 year old gladiator with a focus on staff combat and a desire to learn impressive magic. She's brash, cocky, friendly, and has intense ADHD. She also believes being lightly furred from the waist down means she doesn't need to wear pants.

You have a specialty in Crystal Shards. Given that they are not present on most worlds, you also know how to substitute Crystal Shards with other magic crystals. Closer to a tech tree, actually, with resemblance to biotics from Mass Effect.
A regular looking guy from ASDFmovie. When he states "I like trains." a train will come out of no where and hit whatever he wants. In all other respects, a normal guy.

The Mine Turtle was raised at a petting zoo, when one day a man named Tom shouted "Drunk Science!" as he drank a beer and made the tortoise into the world's first Mine Turtle. You get 1 Mine Turtle every 30 mins to a maximum of 30. Cap increases with additional familiars. Note: Mine Turtles are extremely accident prone, expect people to randomly step on them or them to throw themselves onto their backs and explode.
A special yellow voucher attached to a contract, upon use it will immediately summon an Operator of your choice from Arknights as a Familiar.
A suspicious looking head of lettuce. Typically used as the inciting instrument of strange situations.
A special contract which, when signed, can be used to summon one Tactical Doll of choice from GFL or GFL2 as a familiar.
I CAST MEND BUTTHOLE. You can point at someone, shout the phrase in question, and seal their butthole permanently. May be rerolled for free.

You now have access to a special wooden axe which allows you copy, paste, replace, set, or change vast amounts of land. You could build entire cities with this. You could replace a mountain with air. There are no limits to what this can do.

Upon stating "Mr. Electric, lightning this man." your target will be smited with a bolt of thunder that scales in strength to the health of the target and bypasses armor and protection. 30 minute cooldown.

The common Evil Doers, Bandits, Goons, Thieves, Henchmen and the like have unionized for better benefits! If you are an EVIL Overlord who uses these services, you now have to pay twice as much and offer full healthcare benefits (including dental), and days off. Otherwise your Henchmen may leave you, go on strike, or even tip off the heroes to your location!

The commonfolk and generic law enforcement of villages, towns, cities and nations have had enough of being weak and unable to stop super villains or powerful mages. Expect to see peasants with bolt action rifles, police officers with IFVs, guardsmen with enchanted swords floating around them and much more as the common folk ain't sitting down and accepting the unfair terms anymore.

Upon activation, summons a 155mm artillery gun to bombard the shit out of the area you target. The more good you do, and the more tokens you earn, the more guns you get, alongside fieldguns, howitzers, mortars, and other classes of artillery. There is no cap to the amount of artillery you can rain down. The higher the token rank, the more guns you get at once.
A syringe of Calyxanide that has been supernaturally enhanced to kill parasites in general. May or may not be effective on zombies.
A blast of mixed holy and unholy energy that destroys everything in a large area. Yelling the name is mandatory.
The Logical Conclusion Of Gacha Games
Fuck it, I don't care anymore. Have all of the Gacha game characters, ALL OF THEM. Good luck dealing with the character bloat, dumbass.
Kris, where the HELL are we?
Kris and Susie from hit game Deltarune. Just a little lost. Might vanish while you aren't looking.
A magazine full of waifus. What, did you expect something else? Pretty much just good for hiding under the bed. Does not actually summon waifus.
A squeaky toy hammer. If used by a clown, ignores intangibility and has a 1% chance to instantly kill the struck target, regardless of durability or protections.

Don Quixote is, quite singularly, an actually heroic Bloodfiend (vampire). He wants nothing more than save the innocent and the weak by using his blood manipulation power. As a first generation Bloodfiend, he only fears light and water.

One of the primordial monsters in her unsealed form. She is a playful, cunning, vicious kyuubi, determined to do anything to protect her kin. She is, as one of the oldest monsters, a master of magic and martial arts.
Queen of Slimekind, Erubetie is mistress of water magic. If she seems cold at first, she warms up easily to kindness and people protecting nature. Will drain you at night, in the kinky way.
The whimsical Queen Succubus and master of martial arts and wind magic. She has a carefree personality and loves sex. She will do anything and anyone.
You receive a crate with a small caliber rated bulletproof vest, a helmet, a water gourd, and a service rifle with two magazines. For the NCR.
You receive a crate with reinforced recon armor, a helmet, a water gourd, and a laser rifle with two 24 shot energy cells. For the Brotherhood of Steel.
You receive a crate with a legionnaire armor pads, a machete, a water gourd, and five throwing spears. For the Legion.

One of a set of three Unicorn Horns belonging to the unicorn Bracken. Any horn may be used to heal fatal wounds, clear toxins, manipulate magic, purify water, and protect against evil. You start with the first horn, focused on defending a large area from darkness. Through duplicate tokens you may gain the second horn (which can be used as a sword), and the third horn (a gilded goblet that grants immortality).

A water type pokemon capable of melding into and healing from nearly any body of water. They're quite well suited to both terrestrial and aquatic life, and are capable of sensing incoming rain. Your Vaporeon is female, and is capable of laying eggs.
An unusual species of firefly that can create portals through space when in large groups. A insect controller of some sort could get good use out of them. You start with a population of 10000.

Somehow, much of earth’s subsurface now has a planet spanning network of aquatic tunnels containing wildlife previously native to Europa. This seamlessly integrates into the pre-existing ecosystem. Does not include ruins.

The planet you are on now has a massive subterranean world full of massive megafauna, kaiju, and perhaps some isolated human tribes. Tunnels and portals from the surface can now be found through the world leading to the Hollow Earth.

We may or may not have hijacked a competitor's systems for this entry.
