You can spend tokens, money, rare resources, weapons, or anything of high value to summon the men and women (and their variants) within these pages. Warning: Does not come with mind control. You wanna have a slave army of brainfucked anime girls, do it yourself, ya weirdo.

You have the ability to heal, capable of mending even grevious injuries with nothing more than your hand and a prayer. Upon healing twelve indivduals, become WhiteNight- An Angel in the classic sense. You are incredibly difficult to kill, prevent all time manipulation, and can emit soul harming energy rings. Your twelve apostles are blessed with incredible strength, immortality, and a inclad connection to you. Incapable of not following your order. Except One. Should the Twelfth Apostle confess their sins, in all sincerity, to a figure of authority, you will be bound to your normal form once more.

A pecular head replacement that you may elect to have put on instantly. Replaces your head with that of a burning clock. You do not need to breathe or eat and cannot speak except for ticking. You may connect with up to twelve people. Those people have their abilties hampered initially, but may grow back to their original strength. In exchange you may now bring them back from death instantly an endless number of times. But it is immensely painful to do so.

You automatically take any mundane loot from an opponent you defeated. Any and all loose change or currency on their person is added to your pockets. Upgrade this passive by rolling it again, or gaining a inventory-like power.

You are able to use both the Light and Dark side of the Force. Not particularly well, you're effectively a Padawan or an Initiate in terms of skill, but you can slowly grow over time. You can also be overwhelmed by the Dark Side without adequate discipline and meditation. This is a life long skill to commit to. Does not come with a lightsaber.

A large and long curved blade constantly surrounded by red godly magic. This weapon is said to be one of the most powerful weapons of Olympus by Zeus himself, as it was capable of slaying a Titan. This weapon can easily cleave through armored and large foes alike.

Big Brother of the Middle, Ricardo is all about family. Touch it and you get into his book of vengeance and nothing will stop him. Similarly, this man is absolutely loyal, shirtless and will bond you over perfect her AND he applies true gender equality by kicking ass.

It's Spyro! Also his buddy Sparx the Dragonfly. Spyro is a Dragon that hasn't fully grown yet, but he's already strong enough to handle a lot of threats to his home, or Avalar, without any issues. He's a surprisingly good pilot as well, can breathe fire, breathe underwater, and charge or headbash through solid rock. Does not include the Super Powerups. He'll also grow stronger with age.
Wazuuuuup! You can exhale a cloud of extremely potent marijuana smoke, enough to get anyone without resistance high with just a whiff. Including you, if you don't have anything to stop it.

Unfortunately, all animal-adjacent characters and people in your world retroactively start going through two week long heat cycles every spring, causing intensely enhanced libidos and correspondingly lowered inhibitions and social norms. Yes, this includes you if you have any animalistic traits at all. Fortunately, someone will end up producing mass market heat suppressants within a couple years, so good luck waiting until then.

A pack of nine violent weirdos who are theoretically professional mercenaries who work for money, under the supervision of TF Industries. They come with their default equipment and can be paid off with either hats, money, or new weapons. Pick whether they come in RED or BLU. Not much difference either way.
THE CEO OF MANN CO.! COMING HERE DIRECTLY TO HELP YOU PUNCH OUT ANYTHING OUT OF EXISTENCE! NOW COME HERE AND EAT THIS GRILLED MEAT!

A wrist mounted morpher with AI assistance, a communications device, and a voice activated controller for the Q-Rex. The Quantum Morpher also comes with the Quantum Ranger Powers, weapons, and suit. Does not come with the Q-Rex, sadly.
You gain the ability to do an air combo on the ground or a ground combo in the air. It's fresh baby.
Breasts now have unrealistic bounciness, straight out of an ecchi anime. Breasts (and their new jiggle) will no longer get in the way of other actions regardless of how big or bouncy they are.

You can challenge someone to a children's card game and they will treat it as life or death without refusing. They will somehow have on hand, and be capable of playing, anything they personally require to play the game. Though you will be required to provide things like tokens and boards, if those are necessary to play.

You have mastered the basic set of the Six Powers from One Piece, a superhuman level martial art. You can easily use Shave, Moonwalk, Paper Art, Finger Pistol, Tempest Kick, and Iron Body. Train on your own to develop the combination attacks, further your mastery of the original techniques, or recreate the Six King Gun.
You now have the skill of a master when it comes to using any weapon with a chain- kusarigama, anchors, rope darts, chain whips, so on and so forth. Doesn't include chainsaws, sadly.

The act of deliberately setting stuff on fire. Grants the user knowledge on how to set anything on fire, how to best start a fire, keep fire going, critical locations to expand a fire, how far fire can spread unimpeded, and how to discern weak points in buildings likely caused by fire.

The cybernetic dog of the Soviet Union. An absolute menace to any infantry and vehicles, quickly tearing both to bits in a matter of seconds. Immune to radiation and toxins, though its cybernetics put it at a disadvantage against EMP weaponry. It can't swim. At all.
Replaces the user's original heart with that of a Mega Baboon's along with the Ubercharge valve attached to it. This new heart grants faster healing and the potential to be Ubercharged.

A sentient endoskeleton capable of contorting itself into any animateonic shell, or costume. It will act as the costume it's inhabiting. It is also, unfortunately, a violent and sadistic serial killer that's only barely on your leash.

Use your willpower to armor your body, hardening it against attacks and strengthening your own to the point that you could break a building in a single punch. The more Haki you use, the darker the parts of your body using Haki become, and the more metallic you look. None without spiritual abilities can see Haki coating, though. Does not defend against attacks that hit from the inside out.

Use your willpower to strengthen your mind and senses, allowing you to see long distances, hear from far away, feel people's emotions, even see the near future when utilized at a high enough level. Works independently from your physical senses, so even if your eyes are torn out you can still sense the world around you... good luck reading books in that case, though.
The Noble Phantasm of Arash, a shot from a bow so powerful it sacrifices the person making the shot in order to do the impossible. Comes with Arash's signature red bow.

A gargantuan airborne fortress capable of freezing time within a localized area and teleporting entire armies across the globe. Despite its already immense size, its interior is far larger than its exterior suggests, housing an expansive extradimensional space.

The Raki Raki no Mi is a paramecia Devil Fruit that grants the user the ability to steal good luck from others with a touch, making the user super lucky and the victim unlucky. Its effect is temporary, as you can "use up" all your good luck and then be stuck without any.

A heavy attack/support gunship capable of generating lightning strikes out of nowhere to destroy enemy lines and bolster the defensive capabilities of allied units. Each one is armed with a complement of "Mjolnir" drones and loudspeakers, and can serve as either anti-infantry, anti-air, or ground support in battle.

An eccentric man who owns a ukelele, has neutralized many hostile and hazardous SCPs, and may or may not actually be literal actual Lucifer and/or the biblical Serpent. Very slimy personality, loves his daughter, may or may not be able to alter reality, completely unable to be photographed normally because his head gets replaced by a random animal photo.

Deploys a pack of four Terror Drones. These compact, blindingly fast machines are no larger than a standard infantryman, yet are among the deadliest close-quarters units on the battlefield. Equipped with monomolecular cutting tools capable of shredding armor and flesh with equal ease, a single Terror Drone can tear through its prey before most enemies have time to react.
A passive ability that increases skill training speed to the point that you could reach master level in less than a year. Also allows you to craft or farm huge amounts of items at once.

A superweapon capable of manipulating atmospheric conditions to generate a devastating lightning storm. Upon activation, summons colossal bolts of lightning that strike designated targets with overwhelming force, capable of obliterating even the most heavily fortified structures. Few defenses can withstand the sheer destructive power of its artificial tempest.

A stealth combat vehicle armed with a high-powered laser and equipped with Reactive Camoscanner technology, allowing it to disguise itself as nearby objects such as trees or civilian vehicles. Its camouflage is capable of fooling both the naked eye and most electronic scanners. However, the disguise is broken whenever the tank moves or fires its weapon.
A superweapon capable of teleporting entire armies across the globe in an instant. Its chronoshift technology allows friendly forces to bypass enemy defenses and strike anywhere on the battlefield.
A small ring that inexplicably generates twice as much power as it takes to turn on. Can passively take in energy to power itself.
Alexander the Great, as an adult. Excellent tactician, strategist, and combatant. Very independent and lively, so don't expect perfect obedience.
Irish Hercules, an absurdly skilled and strong warrior with knowledge of runic magic as well. A blood knight who has a sense of honor, and fights with a spear that breaks causality.
A man who desires to be a hero above all else. Has the ability to replicate any weapon he sees, and deploy a Reality Marble known as Unlimited Blade Works. Do not watch him attempt the High Jump.

An incredibly prodigious mage with equally incredible close combat skills. Also terrible with money and technology. Despite being a magus, Rin is a surprisingly good person. She is also capable of learning nearly any form of magic.

A Purple Dragon, considered an omen of change, Spyro is friendly, kind, and a bit foolish. Raised by Dragonflies, he knows how to fight and wrestle, and his elemental attacks are quite powerful. He can even fly, or use an ability called Convexity, which can purge corrupted power from someone. He could repair a planet on the brink of Destruction if needed.

Choose any Mobile Construction Vehicle (MCV) from the mainline Command and Conquer or Red Alert series. This unarmed support vehicle can deploy into a construction yard, which contains the blueprints, fabrication systems, tools, and engineering equipment needed to construct the chosen faction's technological base.

You may summon a meteor to strike a designated target once per week, during the day. Your involvement in the event is rendered completely undetectable by any conventional or supernatural means unless you personally admit responsibility.

Once per month, you may cast an artificial total solar eclipse that lasts for the remainder of the current daylight period. While the eclipse persists, only you and your allies may use active abilities.

A jury-rigged armored tractor equipped with improvised chemical sprayers that unleash highly lethal toxic agents against infantry. Though crude in design, it is devastatingly effective at clearing enemy personnel.

Once per night, you may frame a target by conjuring convincing incriminating evidence on or around their person, or by shrouding them in a sinister aura that makes them appear suspicious. While the evidence and aura are believable enough to sway most observers, they are not infallible, and exceptionally perceptive, intelligent, or experienced investigators may recognize the deception through careful scrutiny or deduction.
Conjure a loaf of bread. It's tasty. You can do this whenever you want, it's fine.
As long as this item remains on your person, the next attack or effect that would kill you instead restores you to full health. The item is consumed after triggering. Restocks once per month.

Once per night, you may inflict one of the following conditions on a target: Blinded, Deafened, or Silenced. The chosen condition lasts until the end of the following night. You cannot target the same creature with this ability on consecutive nights.

This mirror absorbs the first attack that strikes it, storing its power. The stored attack may then be unleashed against a target of your choice, after which the mirror must absorb another attack before it can be used again.

Once per month, you may cloak yourself and all allies in an unbreakable illusion of your choosing. The illusion is highly convincing, and can conceal any incriminating evidence as well as mask suspicious or malicious auras with one that radiates complete innocence. The effect lasts for 24 hours.

Once per night, you may cast an unbreakable, highly convincing illusion upon a single target. The illusion conceals any incriminating evidence on or around the target and masks any suspicious or malicious aura with one that radiates complete innocence. The effect lasts for 24 hours.

Once per month, Incite widespread panic within a large area. Until the end of the following day, affected creatures are plagued by relentless false illusions, causing them to misidentify people, perceive nonexistent threats, and mistake harmless objects or events for dangers. While under this effect, they become fearful, irrational, and prone to poor judgment. Allies are unaffected by this.
You’re a human now. If you were already human, all your stats have been doubled. If you were not human, you are human now. You keep your previous stats and abilities and whatnot, at least.
You grow stronger with every kill. Each kill permanently grants a slight increase to all of your physical attributes.

Once per night you may invade a target's dreams, gaining complete control over the dreamscape until they awaken. Within the dream, you may torment the target in an attempt to drive them insane or weave a blissful, lifelike experience so convincing that they awaken believing it truly occurred.
You are an intelligent woodsman with a knack for traps. You gain skills in trapping, trap detection, and also a variety of trades relating to wilderness survival.

A large structure that generates a powerful psychic field, allowing its controller to influence the minds, thoughts, emotions, or commands of those within its range, gradually bringing them under its control. However, the influence is not absolute, as some individuals possess natural resistance and others can train themselves to resist its effects. Prolonged exposure can overcome even strong resistance, but the process requires time.

You receive three fully operational M1 Abrams tanks, each with a trained crew. The tanks require no ammunition resupply and their crews do not require food or other supplies to operate. They do get bored without anything to do, though, so be wary of that.

A Cryoshot smoke signal. Throw the smoke signal to designate an area for a Cryoshot strike, after which a powerful cryobeam will fire from orbit onto the marked location, freezing anything caught within the blast zone and leaving them completely immobilized.

The original modified bulldozer used by a man with hatred and vengeance. It includes a new feature to enter and leave and never seems to run out of fuel. Still comes with a pistol, just not for self termination purposes.

A Backwarp smoke signal. Throw a smoke signal to designate an area for a Backwarp support effect, after which the marked area is bathed in temporal energy, rewinding the state of anything caught within it to a previous point untill all damage, injuries, and other physical deterioration are fully restored.

Grants the wearer the complete armor and weaponry of a Chrono Legionnaire, including long-range teleportation. The farther the teleport, the longer it takes to phase back into reality, leaving the wearer vulnerable while rematerializing. Its chronal weapon erases enemies from time itself rather than damaging them, with stronger targets taking longer to erase and becoming invulnerable during the process.

The Soviet Union's premier cyborg super soldier, Volkov is equipped with an endless supply of tesla grenades and an experimental tesla rifle capable of arcing electricity between multiple targets, a weapon so dangerous that no ordinary human can wield it without being incinerated. As a cyborg, Volkov is immune to radiation and toxins, but remains vulnerable to EMP blasts and magnetic-based weaponry.
A very small submarine. Not very good in any category, but it's also easy to modify.

A Chronoboost smoke signal. Throw a smoke signal to designate an area for a Chronoboost support effect. The marked area is bathed in temporal energy, doubling the speed of all units within the affected area.
A small submarine. Ineffective in every category, but still able to traverse underwater.

An anti-kaiju multipurpose warship. The Gotengo can fly, dive like a submarine, and even tunnel through solid rock. It's equipped with a prow drill, Freezing Maser Cannon capable of freezing kaiju solid, plasma cannons, missile bays, and carries a single high maneuverability fighter jet it can deploy mid combat. It's durable enough to survive a direct attack from Godzilla's breath weapon. Does not come with crew. Restocks weekly.

Fire a powerful laser beam from orbit onto a designated target area. The strike is highly effective against infantry and light vehicles, but its effectiveness is reduced against heavily armored targets.

A Force Shield smoke signal. Throw a smoke signal to designate an area for a Force Shield support effect. All nearby buildings within the marked area are covered in an invulnerable force field, rendering them completely immune to damage for one hour.

A small crewmate roughly the size of a toddler, capable of performing a wide variety of everyday tasks. It can handle mundane chores such as cleaning, fetching, gardening, and even complex duties like spaceship maintenance and basic repairs.

An Impostor roughly the size of a toddler, capable of performing swift assassinations using various methods, including knife attacks, firearm attacks, and other lethal techniques. They can traverse vents at incredible speeds and perform sabotages ranging from minor inconveniences to potentially life-threatening disruptions. However, their attacks leave behind obvious and messy bodies.
A card depicting a Goblin Barrel. Activating the card summons a barrel filled with three stabby goblins and launches it toward a target location, where the goblins emerge and attack nearby enemies.

The ghost of Chuckles, a spectral clown that you can release to haunt your chosen enemy which will relentlessly annoy and torment them. Should Chuckles successfully possess a host, it will unleash the full wrath of an eldritch clown, granting you control over a far more powerful and terrifying entity.

A 19th century American abolitionist. He is a man of faith that made it his mission to end slavery in America by any means necessary, including incredible violence. His ideas led him to become an icon of future uprisings

A free voucher to summon a Kamen Rider for 30 minutes to kick someone's ass. While they don't have to actually honor it, they usually will if you're fighting an appropriately dangerous villain. Each Rider summoned appears in their most powerful form, and there are no limits as to which may be summoned, from Ichigo all the way to Ohma Zi-O and beyond. Resets once a day. Summoned Rider vanishes without any memory of being summoned when time runs out.

An ancient, immortal lamia sorceress that may actually be a goddess, Deis has fought along side heroes to save the world multiple times. She is fond of flashy explosive magics, strong drinks, partying hard, and sleeping as much as she can get away with. Despite coming across as scatterbrained, irresponsible, an incorrigible flirt, quick tempered, and lazy, she is dedicated to helping her friends and fighting tyranny.

A princess of Wyndia, Nina is a flying winged warrior and white mage. She is proficient with a rapier, but excels with her healing magics. She is generally kind hearted and compassionate, but tends to hold on to petty grudges over being slighted or dismissed. Can turn into a giant bird big enough for multiple people to ride on.
An RPG-7 which fires shovels instead of rockets. It will accept any shovel as ammo. It doesn’t matter if it shouldn’t fit, it just works.

Nina is the beautiful hidden princess of Wyndia, shunned and denied her birthright due to being born with black wings, supposedly a sign of disaster. She is shy and reserved, with a self sacrificial streak that occasionally leads her astray. She's spent her life studying magic and is skilled in powerful elemental attack magics.

The rarest form of Haki which allows one to assert one's will over others to dominate them, causing those of inferior spirit to be intimidated or (if much weaker) to lose consciousness. The ability to affect someone depends on the Haki user having greater strength of will than the person the Haki is being used against.

Mogura is a trident with a pink haft, with three prongs forged as a single, blocky piece. The middle prong is a full diamond shape, while the two on the sides are more triangular. The spear will perfectly resize itself according to wielder. Mogura is extremely durable and sharp, capable of puncturing through stone pillars multiple times without being dulled.
An extremely long scarf with feather trims on the edges, this scarf was used to hide his scary mouth from foe and friends alike to prevent people from making fun of him.

When you abandon all reason and give fully into your emotions and nothing else, you are able to break all of your limits and use all of your current abilities and powers at once. You become a pure fighting machine that runs only on instinct. It may just kill you. Or put you in a coma.
A golden katana with a dragon shaped hilt. Capable of coating and casting primordial fires. Also turns into a motorcycle if you are attuned with it.

A golden scythe with draconic theming where the blade comes out of the dragon's mouth. Capable of causing large earthquakes and easily splits rocks and stone. Turns into a assault dune buggy if you are attuned with it.
A pair of large, tri-bladed, dragon themed, golden shurikens. Able to conjure and cast sprays of primordial ice. Also turns into a snowmobile that doesn't need snow, if you are attuned with them.
A pair of golden nunchucks with draconic theming, the pair is connected by a strand of pure lightning. Capable of casting primordial lightning. Turns into a jet if you are attuned with them.

You become a High Demon of the Demon Clan. You gain 7 demonic hearts, the ability to easily reattach your limbs with some effort, an immense physical stat increase, better magical senses and affinity, and an innate ability to cast shadow and hellblaze magic.

Starting from sunrise, your power begins to increase. Your body grows larger, and you generally become more arrogant and prideful with the sun. The process reverses as the sun sets. You are additionally capable of radiating intense light and heat easily capable of melting metal and vaporizing stone. Exactly at noon for one minute, you can activate The One and become a nearly invincible manifestation of the power of the sun.
All females now have fully functional dicks in addition to their usual vagina and breasts.
You point at someone and shout "Fired!", they are immediately fired from their job and lit ablaze for a minute. Damage scales to health.

A potion that when drunk will turn the drinker into a slime. Drink half for a temporary change which lasts for 24 Hours, Drink the full potion for a permanent race change. Your slime form becomes more humanoid the higher your base stats. Or more shaped like your original self, if you weren't human.

While having sex, you can steal abilities, health, mana, passives, skills, and at higher levels even the soul or mind of your partner. With practice, you can learn to copy instead of steal, or share in turn.
With a sharp gaze you can literally turn people into stone statues! Can be toggled and only happens when you want it to. Improving this lets it affect more people at once and affect stronger foes.

With a sharp gaze you can literally turn people rock hard, literally, by turning them into naked lewd stone statues! Can be toggled and only happens when you want it to. Improving this lets it affect more people at once and affect stronger foes. Can also be used for less lewd purposes, but lewdness is the default.

The local moon is transformed into a Bloodmoon once a month, granting increased stats to vampires, blood manipulation abilities, darkness, dark creatures, evil beings, abominations, and so on and so forth. Monsters are more powerful and numerous at night, and far more active. Despite this, the Bloodmoon is yours to draw power from, and you may even enhance your allies during its length. The Bloodmoon follows you wherever you go, and will always choose some kind of orbiting body to possess.
The more male allies you have, the stronger you get. Intersex and transgender people count.
The more female allies you have, the stronger you get. Intersex and transgender people count.
Radiation heals you, boosts your stats, and gives beneficial mutations.

A nondescript individual who possesses the skills, authority, and legitimate credentials of an official auditor recognized by any government or organization as needed. Once per person, the Auditor may permanently confiscate or "audit" a single item or ability from them, returning it only upon the Auditor's death. The Auditor resurrects approximately one week after being killed.
Your blood, sweat, tears, and even saliva are considered Blessed and Holy.
All of your bodily fluids are considered Blessed, from your blood to your breast milk, to your cum, any and all fluids count.

You possess an inexhaustible supply of Black Keys stored within a personal dimensional vault accessible only to you. At will, you may summon or launch these Black Keys directly from the vault as high-speed projectiles, much like Gate of Babylon.

Enshroud a target in a malevolent aura that causes others to instinctively fear or distrust them. If the target comes within range of a person you have marked for death, the shroud manifests as a hostile entity that relentlessly attacks the marked victim until they are dead before returning to its host. The evidence and circumstances surrounding the attack are twisted to implicate the shrouded target as the apparent killer.

A monstrosity made to reveal the ugly truth hidden by The Order of The Stone. Unlike in the game it’s from, this one will actually listen to your commands. It’s not exactly sentient but boy it can grow. Nothing Built Can Last Forever.

A nondescript, usually play gray metal briefcase. When thrown it will home onto your target, forever, until it hits them. When hit, it will knock the target out. While in motion the briefcase is not considered suspicious or even remotely notable, only when first thrown and upon hitting its target.
Alan, Please Add Details. (Any descriptions of you are replaced with 'Alan, Please Add Details' unless you permit otherwise)

A Pack Attack smoke signal, Throw a smoke signal to designate an area for the Pack Attack support effect. The marked area is struck by four kamikaze UAVs carrying highly radioactive payloads, devastating the target zone and contaminating it with intense radiation.

Release a powerful electromagnetic pulse over a targeted area within 10km. Unshielded electronics are instantly fried, while shielded systems are temporarily knocked offline for several seconds to minutes. Heavily hardened or specially protected electronics are resistant or completely immune to the pulse.

A stealth assault vehicle capable of rendering itself completely invisible, even while moving. Armed with twin Dissolver Beam weapons effective against both infantry and armored targets, it reveals itself whenever it fires. Although highly advanced, its stealth is not infallible and can be defeated by radar, specialized detection equipment, or exceptionally observant and well-trained personnel.

A dedicated anti-air support vehicle cobbled together from salvaged parts haphazardly welded and bolted into a functional machine. Capable of traversing both land and water, it fires capsules filled with a highly corrosive mixture of hydrogen peroxide, hydrochloric acid, and nitric acid that rapidly eats through aircraft and other aerial targets. If destroyed, will be replaced within an hour.

A colossal prototype assault walker built for prolonged frontline combat and overwhelming firepower. Armed with twin-linked T800 cannons, Hellfire missile pods, four 330mm howitzers, and a tactical nuclear missile, it is capable of leveling fortified positions and even entire cities while withstanding tremendous punishment. Designed to spearhead assaults, it also includes living amenities for its crew, allowing it to remain operational for extended deployments.

A Magical Bar of Soap, it will never shrink or run out. It can get the toughest smells out of the most smelly objects. Your charisma will go up after prolonged use of the soap. Maybe getting this is the universe's way of telling you something? (STINKY)

A Behemoth-class battlecruiser equipped with ATA/ATS laser batteries, a Yamato Cannon, Tactical Fighters, nuclear missiles, and Gauss point-defense systems. You are now made of rather durable glass and your insides are now whatever soda you like the most. Your hair is now an ever flowing foam and a bottle cap looking hat is stuck to your head. You also now have a pair of boobs with taps on them, allowing you to dispense soda from them, which is mildly arousing. Repeated consistent consumption of your soda will result in the drinker becoming addicted. You refill by a quarter a day. If emptied you will go unconscious!
An alcoholic cider that when drunk will permanently transform the drinker into a centaur.
A bottle of vodka that when drunk, will permanently turn the drinker into a vampire.
A bottle of wine that when drunk will permanently turn you into an anthropomorphic cat.

You now are double sided, as if someone took a photo of you and applied it to the back of your body. The effect is a little trippy at first but this doesn’t impact your movement. You can move your arms 360 degrees now and your mouths are connected, meaning if you open them both you can see out the other side. Great for body horror.
An alcoholic cocktail that when drunk permanently turns the drinker into a woman with cow features, including an udder and breasts. They will additionally be stuck in a haze of constant horniness.

You can turn your target into a large living penis (and reverse said transformation). The longer the victim stays in the form of a penis the more their mind fades until nothing but a large horny penis remains. The resulting penis can also be attached to people for kink use.
You’re now a mimic! A fake treasure chest which preys on foolish adventurers! You may choose what form your true body takes.
Hey! My eyes are down here! Your nipples are replaced with eyes. If you didn’t have breasts, you do now.

You’re a catgirl now, anyone you touch turns into a catgirl as well, and they will be naturally loyal towards you, even if they were literally trying to kill you before being turned into a catgirl. Stronger beings may resist this, making the time to catgirl (TtG) longer. You may choose not to turn someone into a catgirl, but why would you?

For some reason, you are now irresistible to people of your preferred gender who are already in love with someone else. It's up to you to abuse of this power and steal them for yourself. If their initial loved one actually tries to save them from your clutches, you will inevitably overpower them. Also comes with a big, fat cock.
A bottle of thirty (30) pills. Take one and for one day, you have a now fully functional dick of your chosen size. If you already have a dick, you get another.

A pink diary titled "Sex Note" on the cover in sparkly gothic font. Write the name of two or more people whose names and faces you know and they will have sex within the hour if it's physically possible. You may also decide the scenario, timing, and a number of other commands. In other words, it's a Death Note but for sex.
In this inconspicious bottle is a lotion that will destroy anything one can identify as clothing, armor or other. It also acts as an aphrodisiac upon skin contact.

JUST WHO THE HELL DO YOU THINK I AM!? Kamina, former leader of team Dai-Gurren and most bullheaded idiot in the universe has decided you're a friend in need of some help. He's hotheaded, a little stupid, and the second most determined being in all of creation, just behind Simon. With him on your side there's nothing you can't manage!

Martial Artist and Feline from Lungmen. Committed to Justice and improving her own Kung Fu. Exceptionally helpful, exceptionally skilled, and exceptionally motivated. She'll be glad to help anyone and won't hestiate to face down evil. Though she understands just how murky morality can sometimes be. Skill in blocking opponents from utilizing special abilties and in hampering their offense.

JUST WHO THE HELL DO YOU THINK I AM!? Simon the Digger, leader of Team Dai-Gurren. He never stops drilling forward even if the heavens themselves put a wall in his path. Appears as his 14 year old self with a Core Drill and his trusty tunnel drill and goggles, no other equipment.

Amaterasu has judged you worthy of wielding her most powerful Divine Instrument. It is weakened, though, and only contains the thirteen Brush Techniques and their sub-techniques, all of which you must unlock by completing quests related to those techniques. With time, and approval from the goddess, you may increase its strength by doing good works. Does not actually move the sun or moon around, as a result of being weakened. Starts with three Divine Ink Pots attached to your soul, which increases as the Brush gains power.

Become a Chemical X mutated abomination in the shape of the so-called perfect little girl. Grants super strength, super speed, flight, near invulnerability, laser eyes, super screaming, and a whole host of other generic powers, plus one extra power based on your previous rolls. Also installs a preference for wearing a sleeveless mono-color dress with a black stripe around the waistline, leggings, and mary janes. Fortunately, does not also turn you into a "bug-eyed freak". You look like an ordinary little girl and age normally until you hit your prime.

A blonde, busty police girl with some experience in mundane British crime and a tragic, repressed backstory. She's... utterly normal, but has an iron will to live, even if she does sort of just look like a harmless puppy. Comes with standard late 90s British police gear and uniform and not much else.

A freshly turned Seras Victoria. She's good with massive guns, is pretty bad at killing things unless she flies into a bloodrage on accident, and largely feels like a harmless sidekick despite being a theoretically powerful Draculina. She usually drinks her own blood, or only takes the bare minimum necessary to survive. Weakens in sunlight, sleeps in a coffin, all that. Comes with a yellow Hellsing uniform, her own coffin, and a singular Harkonnen rifle and enough ammo to kill a dozen or so fake vampires. Passively emanates Rob Zombie when in a blood rage.

A real fuckmothering vampire. She has potent shadow magics, is fully unleashed in rage and fury, and has the soul of her dead beloved hiding in her boob. Probably the strongest motherfucker in the world, ever since her Master "died" and hasn't come back for thirty goddamn years. Comes with two really big guns, a red Hellsing uniform, and a LOT of issues. Passively emanates Rob Zombie when in combat.

You now have the ability to spend vast sums of money in order to guarantee that any token you roll lands on an item that you want without needing to actually rely on luck. Starting with 10000 USD or equivalent in currency/item value for a 1-star token and escalating exponentially from there. Not exactly easy to pay for an EX-star token with an entire star system, but I'm sure you'll figure something out.

At any point, should you not enjoy the result of a roll, you may return the item to the gacha in order to auto-roll a gacha item of the same rank as the returned item. This works on any category of gacha item, though you can only do it once a month.

You are now a Disasembly Drone. Built for murder, you have wings, claws, can change your hands into various weapons, a tail with nanite acid, regeneration, and extremely sharp teeth. Unfortunately, your systems run really hot, so you need an outside source of blood, oil, or equivalent to keep active. Eldritch entities will also notice you far more easily.

A high class mage skilled in hand to hand combat. Can use any element of magic, but specializes in light magic that allows for flight. Weak to mind-magic, relatively speaking. Has extreme trauma regarding slavery and brainwashing.

A mage focused almost entirely on her arsenal of magic items. Exceptionally skilled with swords, but can use just about any weapon. Is loyal to a fault and values her own life little. Has trauma involving slavery.
An ice mage with a horrible habit of losing his clothes randomly. One of the best Ice-Make mages in the world, highly resistant to cold and mildly resistant to heat.

A fire mage who loves a fight, has immense pride, and cares little for anything not involving food, fights, fun, or family. Also loves to be a gremlin and mess with people. Gets motion sick on vehicles, but not living mounts.

A young half devil, capable of insane regeneration, surviving even being stabbed straight through the chest. Has extreme physical attributes, and a latent demonic form that increases all of his abilities. Is a master of almost all weapons, and guitars. He starts with only Rebellion, Ebony and Ivory
Stronger form of Dante, who has mastered his demonic abilities and has much more experience. Has a shotgun, on top of Ebony, Ivory, and Rebellion.

Prime Dante, with Sin Devil Trigger, turning him into an even stronger version of his typical Devil Trigger. No longer has Rebellion, but has Devil Sword: Dante, with similar abilities, only enhanced.
A young Vergil, incredibly strong, and capable of using his Devil Trigger without issue. Has Yamato, Beowulf, and summoned swords.
A fully realized and resurrected Vergil, enhanced by the power of the Qlippoth fruit, giving him Sin Devil Trigger as well. Has Yamato, Beowulf, and his summoned swords.

Vergil may dodge all his paternity suits, but you still benefit. You may summon any character that could reasonably be identified as 'Vergil's Kid' given their appearance and powers for a single hour every day. This includes Nero, his canonical child, but also the likes of Hoshimi Miyabi and other similar characters.

Tactical genius! You have an extreme talent at war and strategy, but especially with flanking, deep striking, and similar maneuvers. To the point where any ambush or steath insertion is guaranteed to work, regardless of the impossibility of the task. Hide a tank behind a bush, secretly place a building sized mech behind a light pole, or even more absurd actions. Turn any seemingly hasty ambush into a stroke of tactical genius brought victory!

The hellhound receptionist of I.M.P. and adoptive daughter of Blitzo. Occasionally, she can turn into a much larger and more powerful feral form to rip anything to shreds. She can also take a human disguise to stay subtle in the human realm. In all other respects, she's just really good at fighting, killing, and doing dog things.

The powerhouse assassin of I.M.P. and wife of Moxxie. She's powerful, violent, deadly, great with weapons, has a wealth of hobbies and skills, and is a lot smarter than most people think. She REALLY likes pegging Moxxie. A lot.

The CEO of I.M.P. and adoptive father of Loona. Also, Stolas' boyfriend. He's immune to normal flames, great with weapons (guns, mostly), extremely flexible, a wonderful lover, a surprisingly decent father, and knows how to drive manual.

I.M.P's resident weapons expert and peggable femboy. He's the most rational and sane of the group, but still knows how to throw down. He's good at cooking, killing, fighting, disguise, music, getting pegged, and songwriting. Surprisingly sweet, even more surprisingly vicious when he needs to be.

The Radio Demon, Hell's strongest sinner, Overlord of Hell. Former radio host, former serial killer, current sadistic bastard. He's wickedly charismatic, carries a sense of 1920s smarm and charm, and is just... a huge asshole. While bound to you... do not take him lightly. Do not free him. And do NOT make any deals you do not extensively search for loopholes before signing. Good luck.

Changes your race to that of a Sangheili, highly skilled reptilian-alien warriors who served as the primary military commanders and backbone of the Covenant armed forces before the Schism. Sadly you lack an energy sword.

You turn into a Jiralhanae. Known to be large, aggressive, ape-like warriors that kinda resemble bears. You lose a fair bit of your emotional control and become more likely to fly into a murderous rage, but also gain strength and durability as a result.
You turn into a Kig-Yar. Avian-reptilian aliens known for using energy shields and functioning as sharp-eyed snipers. Sadly you lack the energy shields.
The next creature you are bitten by gives you its abilities and traits proportional to your size, stacks with other powers easily. Single use. Better hope you get bit by something useful.
A hidden gold mine where only you know its true position and worth. You may place it at a location of your choosing, and the ore veins within will replenish daily and never run dry.

A network of Cryo satellites equipped with powerful orbital cryoshot cannons capable of striking virtually any location on the planet has appeared in orbit. You gain complete knowledge of and unrestricted access to the array, allowing you to designate and coordinate cryogenic bombardments at will. While the array is active, the Cryoshot smoke signals are significantly enhanced, increasing its freezing power, area of effect, and duration.

A network of Mercury satellites armed with powerful orbital laser cannons capable of striking virtually any location on the planet has appeared in orbit. You gain complete knowledge of and unrestricted access to the array, allowing you to designate and coordinate orbital laser strikes at will. While the array is active, the Mercury Strike ability is significantly enhanced, increasing its power, precision, and responsiveness.

You are an acolyte of Death, entrusted with harvesting the souls of the fallen. Once per night, you may mark a single target; if that target dies from any cause before the mark expires, you immediately claim their soul. For every seven souls collected, you gain a substantial increase to your physical abilities, as well as your mastery over necromancy and death magic, with these bonuses stacking as your collection grows.

A sealed crate containing a single dormant Tiberium crystal. While the crystal remains inside, it is completely inert and incapable of growing or spreading; however, opening the crate releases it from containment. Think very carefully before breaking the seal. Warning: Tiberium is a self-replicating, highly lethal crystalline object that promises unimaginable wealth and power, but consumes worlds just as readily.

A sealed crate containing a large Originium crystal. While the crystal remains inside, it is completely inert and poses no danger; however, opening the crate releases it from containment. Do not open unless you know what you are doing.

The former headquarters of the Toppat Clan is now yours, a colossal orbital space station staffed by a loyal skeleton crew. Its vast vaults are overflowing with stolen treasures, advanced technology, artifacts, and valuables gathered from countless worlds and civilizations. Heavily armed and equipped with the infrastructure needed to support a globe-spanning criminal empire, the station serves as a mobile fortress, command center, warehouse, and launch platform for large-scale operations.
Every unique technological device, supernatural artifact, or unusual gadget you encounter is accompanied by a Gadget Gabe Review. I'm sure it's very trustworthy.

Lock eyes with a target to force them to experience the full weight of the suffering they have inflicted upon the innocent. Every act of cruelty, injustice, and needless harm is reflected back upon their mind and soul in an overwhelming surge of guilt and agony, with the severity of the effect increasing in proportion to the gravity of their sins. Hopefully you wont get worfed.

A secretive organization retroactively comes into existence, operating from the shadows with absolute loyalty to you, at least until you begin recruiting members of your own. The organization controls a network of front companies, shell corporations, criminal syndicates, and other affiliated groups appropriate to the setting, granting it extensive resources, influence, and intelligence. Until you choose to reveal your hand, the organization's existence is completely concealed; no one can discover or deduce it by conventional means, and even precognition, divination, or similar supernatural methods fail to expose it.

Fire a concentrated blast of pure chaos magic at a target. The effect is wildly unpredictable, ranging from absolutely nothing happening, to harmless oddities like conjuring bubbles, to catastrophic outcomes such as unleashing a nuclear-scale explosion or other reality-defying phenomena.

You possess the X-Gene, classifying you as a mutant with the potential for extraordinary powers. Let's just hope you aren't in the Marvel Universe. Upon gaining this trait, you immediately roll one random active ability and one random passive ability at any rank with no additional cost.

A launcher supplied with an endless reserve of sealed capsules, each containing chlorine trifluoride and a built-in ignition mechanism. Upon impact, the capsules rupture and release their contents, triggering an extremely violent chemical reaction against nearly any material they contact. Not really that good of a weapon to be honest.

A suit of heavily armored Soviet power armor designed for operations in extreme radioactive environments, providing exceptional protection against radiation and other hazardous contaminants. Included is a specialized radiation projector that bombards targets with intense radioactive energy, rapidly overwhelming and lethally irradiating most biological organisms while contaminating the surrounding area. Few can withstand prolonged exposure to either the weapon or the environments its operator can safely traverse.

If you choose to activate this enhancement, all of your poison- and chemical-based attacks, whether originating from abilities, passives, technology, familiars, or other sources, are infused with a highly virulent anomalous corrosive agent. This enhancement dramatically increases the lethality and persistence of your toxins while incorporating powerful corrosive compounds capable of rapidly degrading even exceptionally durable materials and compromising advanced protective equipment. In addition, all poison and chemical attacks you wield receive a substantial increase in potency, effectiveness, and lingering effects.

All workers under your command receive a significant boost to their movement speed and overall productivity while performing manual labor. Construction, mining, hauling, farming, manufacturing, and other physically demanding tasks are completed considerably faster.

A packet of seeds from the anomalous plant known as SCP-6880. When properly cultivated, they grow into carnivorous plants that produce fruit filled with an imitation of fresh blood, irresistibly attracting blood-feeding creatures. Those that consume the fruit suffer a violent internal reaction as the fluid rapidly superheats, boiling them alive from within. The plants can be harvested for additional fruit and propagated through cultivation, allowing a sustainable supply with proper care.

A devastating spell that unleashes a colossal explosion capable of engulfing castles and laying waste to everything within its blast radius. While simply uttering "Explosion" is enough to cast the spell, dramatically extending the incantation with excessively edgy, theatrical, and over-the-top lines greatly amplifies its destructive power. The spell's overall strength also scales with your available mana, magical output, and casting ability, allowing it to become increasingly catastrophic as you grow stronger.

Summon a nuclear bomb roughly the size of an average adult human directly into your hands or immediately beside you. You may choose whether it is configured for contact detonation or an airburst. The weapon appears fully armed and ready, but after that, it's your problem. Hopefully you have a delivery mechanism ready.

A seemingly ordinary dairy cow whose body is composed almost entirely of dairy products. Despite this, it is healthy, fully regenerative, and can recover from nearly any injury within hours. Rather than producing milk, milking SCP-4332 yields fresh cuts of beef, providing a renewable source of meat without harming the animal. Feeding it dairy products further accelerates its regeneration and growth.

You can shoot a beam of energy from your hand that will eradicate someone's dysphoria by changing their body into their preferred form. You have no control of their final form, it's all dependent on a mix of their conscious and subconscious to give them the body that matches their identity. The beam can work on you as well.

Whenever you destroy an object, vehicle, structure, or piece of equipment, there will always be a recoverable quantity of salvage left behind, regardless of how thoroughly it was destroyed. Even if the target is reduced to rubble, ash, molten slag, or scattered fragments, useful materials, components, and resources can still be reclaimed as though it had been carefully dismantled. The amount and quality of the salvage generally reflect the value, composition, and condition of the original object.

All propaganda, broadcasts, slogans, speeches, and other messaging produced by you or any group you belong to become significantly more persuasive and memorable. Individuals who already support or agree with your cause receive tangible morale and performance boosts while exposed to the messaging, increasing their motivation, resolve, and overall effectiveness.

You possess absolute control over existing explosions. You may reshape, redirect, compress, expand, halt, or otherwise manipulate any explosion within your influence with perfect precision, altering its blast, force, heat, and direction as desired. However, this ability cannot create explosions on its own.

You possess direct mental access to the original Wikipedia, allowing you to instantly browse and search all its contents entirely within your mind. Information can be accessed as though using the website itself. The knowledge available is limited to whatever exists on Wikipedia and is subject to the accuracy, completeness, and biases of its articles.

A friendly, sentient orange slime renowned for its playful and affectionate nature. SCP-999 instinctively seeks to comfort those around it, producing an overwhelming sense of happiness, relaxation, and emotional well-being through physical contact. Its presence can dramatically improve mood, reduce stress, and lift even the darkest spirits, making it a beloved companion to nearly everyone it meets.

You have awakened as a Psyker, granting you access to the Warp and the ability to channel its immense psychic energies. Through training and experience, you can develop a wide variety of psychic power. It would be very bad if you get this in a certain universe.

You are completely absent from all forms of precognition, divination, scrying, prophecy, fate-reading, and similar supernatural means of observation. Attempts to perceive your past, present, future, or location through such methods invariably fail, revealing nothing or producing meaningless results.

Foreign magic, supernatural effects, and reality-warping phenomena are greatly suppressed in your immediate vicinity. Powers originating from outside yourself struggle to function or fail outright while affecting you or the area around you, making you an exceptionally difficult target for hostile magic and other anomalous abilities.

A colossal underground clockwork factory dating from the 18th century, now under your control. Powered by anomalous machinery and maintained by tireless mechanical automatons, the facility is capable of manufacturing everything from mundane tools and household goods to sophisticated clockwork constructs, experimental implants, advanced weapons, vehicles, and other remarkable inventions based on design blueprints. New designs can be introduced into the production line, while the factory's autonomous workforce continuously repairs, expands, and improves the facility over time.

A small metallic dodecahedron capable of impossibly expanding the interior of any enclosed space without altering its exterior dimensions. Once placed inside a structure, it begins enlarging the interior, eventually creating entirely new rooms furnished as though they had always existed. Removing SCP-184 halts further expansion but does not undo any changes already made.
Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs

Whenever you become genuinely hungry or develop a strong craving for a particular food, the world may spontaneously respond by making it rain that food and related dishes in more than sufficient quantities to satisfy you and anyone nearby. On rare occasions, the phenomenon spreads across entire regions or even the whole world, and in exceptionally rare cases, escalates into bizarre food-based weather events.

Once per month, you may spontaneously generate an armed force bearing the uniforms, equipment, and identifying features of a faction of your choice. Their sole objective is to carry out a convincing attack against a designated country, clan, faction, company, or other organization, with the intent of making it appear that the framed faction was responsible.

You retroactively become a major shareholder in every publicly traded company that exists, granting you ownership stakes, dividends, and influence across global markets. If a setting has no equivalent stock market or public companies, you instead gain ownership shares, financial interests, or comparable economic influence over the closest equivalent organizations.

The Center for Chaos Containment (CCC) now exists within the world you inhabit. Whenever a situation becomes overwhelmingly chaotic beyond your ability to handle, the CCC will intervene and attempt to "help" resolve the crisis. They will respond to extreme non-war, non-political anomalies and disasters that threaten to spiral out of control, with the exception of events with the potential to cause an apocalypse, where they will intervene regardless of political boundaries or consequences. Their methods, however, may be just as unpredictable as the chaos they are attempting to contain.

Create and control shadowy eye-shaped familiars that can relay information they see back to you. They have no combat ability, but blend perfectly with any and all shadows and have an extensive movement range.

Create a gaseous paralytic agent inside of your body and either emit it from your pores like sweat/vapor or store it and expel it in a stream of gas from your throat. The higher your stats, the stronger the opponents it can affect.

At will, take the physical appearance of someone whose blood you have ingested down to the smallest details. The more blood you drink, the longer it lasts- up to several hours at a time. If you have a strong emotional connection to that person, you might also be able to use their innate genetic abilities.

As long as this ability is active, you may stockpile your own strength and power to use at a later time, granting you thrice your stats for roughly an hour after 24 hours of charge. The longer you charge, the stronger the boost and the longer it lasts.
Suppress all of your emotions and work with complete indifference and logicality towards your goals. Also prevents mind manipulation and telepathic effects from working on you.

Conjure and control threads made from your energy. The strength and number of threads depends on energy expenditure. Each thread can be manipulated as you please, but fade instantly when separated from your body. Threads can be used to bind, throw, latch, grapple, tie, swing, blind, distract, stitch, etc.

Your abilities, passives, and stats are proportionally increased by your level of health- at full health, your abilities are doubled, or +100%. For every percentage of health you lose, you also lose that amount of boost.

Place restraints on yourself to amplify other parts of your abilities- sacrifice sight to amplify hearing, sacrifice one arm's strength to boost the other, sacrifice one ability temporarily to make another stronger, etc etc. The more severe the restraint, the greater the amplification.
The Disastrous Life of Saiki K.

Read the history of an object by touching it and spending your energy to discern its past. The more energy you expend, the further back that reading goes and the more extensive the reading becomes, to the point you could even watch how an object was constructed and the environment in which it was formed.

You may make a wager with someone for their soul. Should they lose the wager, they lose their soul to you, allowing you to manipulate it into the form of your choosing- commonly either stuffed into a cursed doll or trapped as a set of coins. Even if they don't truly lose, if they acknowledge their loss in their soul, that's enough to take it.

Inflict a curse of bad luck via either touch or launched hex bolt. The more energy you expend, the more unlucky they become. Also works on inanimate objects. If an opponent is weaker than you, you may be able to permanently curse them with bad luck.

Less of a tech tree and more of a passive- you gain the ability to reliably create technology out of scraps and trash, scrounging materials out of anywhere you can manage to turn rust and junk into advanced technology.

Anything that makes a sound within your hearing range creates a subtitle you can read, along with an arrow telling you which direction it is relative to your body. This works for spoken word, actions, sound effects, so on and so forth. It even comes with tags such as [Thief's footsteps] or [Mugger's gun cocking]. Works best if you're trying to pay attention to your surroundings.
Apply a curse to a target, spawning an ethereal eyes above them. You know where the eye is at all times, and can look through it to observe your target and the surrounding area.

Gain the ability to transform into an adult Vulpimancer- a quadripedal, blind, truck sized canine alien with a keen sense of smell and hearing, and the ability to echolocate with the "gills" on its neck. It's also extremely strong, acrobatic, and capable of firing quills from its back. Just try not to hump the furniture.

The Draconic language taps into the base truths of the world, and now you know three words of it. By incanting all three words you may manifest a massive force in front of you to push anyone away. Using fewer words lessens the power, and the power scales with your Might stat.
You may create, expel, and control acid. The power of it scales to your Might stat, while the amount scales to Magic. At start it can melt through iron quite effectively.
You are a Morbius style vampire, with all the benefits and drawbacks of such. Except in order to use your powers you must shout 'It's morbing time' or 'I'm, beginning to morb'. Have fun with that.

A homunculus created by the mysterious "Father", representing the sin of Lust. She is sadistic, cruel, calculating, and holds no special regard for human life. She is also surprisingly personable with other homunculi. She is also almost immortal, does not need to eat or sleep, does not need to age, and also possesses the "Ultimate Spear", allowing her to turn her fingernails into nearly unstoppable blades with a ridiculous reach and strength.

A homunculus created by the mysterious "Father", representing the sin of Sloth. He is lazy, sleepy, a bit simpleminded, and surprisingly not too biased against humans. He is also capable of using his full effort when frustrated and unable to sleep. He is also almost immortal, does not need to eat or sleep, does not need to age, and also possesses incredible physical strength and speed to the point that it'd take tank shells to pierce his skin, along with being the fastest of homunculi.

A homunculus created by the mysterious "Father", representing the sin of Pride. He is the first of the created homunculi and is boastful, biased, selfish, and considers all humans inferior. He's even an asshole to his own brethren. He is also almost immortal, does not need to eat or sleep, does not need to age, and also is actually a shadowy, monstrous creature hiding in a human shell, capable of slicing and devouring nearly anything and assimilating its abilities at the tradeoff of not being able to manifest in pure darkness and being unable to stand bright light.

A homunculus created by the mysterious "Father", representing the sin of Greed. He is avaricious, arrogant, charismatic, hot headed, and a surprisingly good friend. He really just wants true companions that care for him as much as he cares for them. He is also almost immortal, does not need to eat or sleep, does not need to age, and also possesses the "Ultimate Shield", allowing him to manipulate the configuration of his body's carbon atoms to become nearly indestructible.

A homunculus created by the mysterious "Father", representing the sin of Pride. He is surprisingly personable, has a sense of humor, is generally calm and pleasant, and also extremely easy to piss off into a violent rage. He is, additionally, the former Fuhrer of Amestris. He, unlike other homunculi, has the body of a normal 60 year old human with incredibly enhanced speed, strength, stamina, and durability. He possesses the "Ultimate Eye", granting him extremely enhanced eyesight and extrasensory vision of his surroundings.

A homunculus created by the mysterious "Father", representing the sin of Gluttony. He is usually fairly docile, childlike, surprisingly kindly... and also a frenzied cannibal who wants to eat most humans he sees. He doesn't really understand death, though, and will also not eat anything he's told not to. He is also almost immortal, does not need to eat or sleep, does not need to age, can eat just about anything with ease, and can expand into a false Gate of Truth that swallows things from a distance, and whose rib bones can extend and impale things so fast it seems like a beam attack.

A homunculus created by the mysterious "Father", representing the sin of Envy. He is a sadistic piece of shit bastard, hates humans, is jealous of humanity's inner strength, and gets really pissy about being confronted about his envy. He is, sometimes, just a bit silly and rambunctious. He is also almost immortal, does not need to eat or sleep, does not need to age, and can shapeshift with extreme proficiency into any form less massive than his true self, though his mimicry needs work. He also has an unleashed true form resembling a massive lizard, and a weak, parasitic form that can only puppet bodies.

The Dwarf in the Flask created by Van Hohenheim's blood and the essence of the Eye of God. He possesses vast knowledge of Alchemy and the world's secrets, is a huge asshole with a god complex, and can create more homunculi by breaking off bits of the Philosopher's Stone within his body. He's also not infallible, and is prone to arrogance that leads to his downfall.

A homunculus created by Edward Elric and named by the mysterious "Dante", representing the sin of Sloth. She is apathetic, emotionless, indifferent, and holds no special regard for human life. She resembles Trisha Elric, and gets really sad when those memories are brought up. She is also almost immortal, only needs to eat Red Stones, does not need to age, and also can transmute herself into water to kill, spy, and transport herself secretly.

A homunculus created Izumi Curtis, then empowered and renamed by Envy into Wrath. He is childish, was once kind and playful, but is now spiteful, kinda depressed, and really just wants a mom to lean on. He also considers Sloth a secondary mother but not really. He is also almost immortal, only needs to eat Red Stones, does not need to age, has his own powerful self-taught martial arts style, and can perform Alchemy without a transmutation circle. He can also merge with nearly any matter to enhance Alchemy and surprise others in combat.

A homunculus created by the mysterious "Dante", representing the sin of Pride. He is calm, collected, patient, extremely intelligent, and good at pretending to be a benevolent leader. He also has no qualms in sending people to die, and is generally a sadistic asshole with no remorse for any atrocities he commits. He, unlike other homunculi, can still age, despite having extremely fast regeneration to the point that he can fix his entire body after it's been burnt to a crisp. He is, in all other respects, still extremely strong, fast, and skilled with a blade. He only needs to eat Red Stones to survive.

A shadowy entity hiding behind a stitched together Pikachu costume. It's very lonely and will eagerly accept any affection, to the point of changing its costume if it thinks there's a better one. Has a bunch of shadowy powers, with its ultimate move pulling the target beneath the costume to do extreme damage to them.
A heavily mutated bug. Can fly, shoot poisonous darts, and being an annoying little shit. Not very smart, but loyal to you. You get two breeding pairs, try not to let them breed too much.

The White Lamb. A Celestial Spirit representing the constellation Aries, she is incredibly polite and has magic that controls the wool she naturally forms. It's incredibly soft and easily lures opponents into a distracted, relaxed state. She can generate enough to cover multiple people and even use it underwater. Additionally, she is moderately experienced at hand to hand combat.

A set of 5 8-foot tall human-like droids specialized for security. They are intelligent, versatile, can wield a variety of tools and weapons, and are generally extremely effective at guarding, fighting, and throwing smaller beings around. Some of them are quite deadpan and personable. You receive more droids with increasing stats.

A massive lizard-like creature completely covered in massive crystals of titanite. They are fully capable of ripping a grown man in half with a single attack, and just as capable of eating one whole. The titanite on its body can be mined for resources, and will grow back if harvested slowly and if the lizard is fed well.

A massive, autonomous suit of armor animated via magic. It wields a massive, electrified greataxe and has an even more massive shield. It is accompanied by a pair of Pilgrim Butterflies that actually keep it animated, but are otherwise mostly passive. Be warned: Pilgrim butterflies are not actually butterflies, but rather tree-like monstrosities with backwards ribcages and branch-like wings.

A legendary swordsman, an apostle of the God Hand, and a battle hungry, lion-like inhuman who has killed thousands on the battlefield and returns to slaughter more every 300 or so years. He takes no sadism or pride in his actions, and only seeks the thrill of honorable combat. He is incredibly strong, incredibly durable, incredibly skilled with swordsmanship, and can also fly in his true form.

A key that vibrates with absolute fury. Use it to enter the Infinite Tower of Pissed Off Dudes. Waiting for you is a gauntlet of enemies that gradually gets harder and harder. Upon finsihing a room you may leave or continue, and once you leave you will be able to choose an Arsenal, Wearable, Vehicle, or Novelty from the gacha with a stat value equal or below the floor you ended at times ten. This item is single use.

An absolutely massive cruise ship. The staff are entirely robotic, and incapable of performing anything but their assigned duties. The ship has infinite fuel, but needs to 'restock' food and other objects by entering port, which happens automatically and costs no money. While some of the robots are security, they aren't very strong, and the ship has no weapons attached when you recieve it.
A simple blade in any style you like. It is completely unbreakable and cannot be damaged. Remains perfectly sharp as well, but only to the extent a normal blade would.
The bo staff of the Saiyan Son Goku. Incredibly resistant to damage and capable of extending when given energy.

A folded up construction contract. Simply write what you wish built, the area you want it built in, and enough money to pay for the construction on the contract and sign it. The structure will promptly have been built at some point before now, ready for immediate use. Note you must own, or have claim, to the land you want built upon and must have exact change at the time of signing. The contract will properly calculate and display the cost. The constructed building will be as close to your specification as possible and contain the most up to date appliances possible to obtain with the allotted money.

One of the fingers of Ryomen Sukuna, King of Curses. It reeks of Cursed Energy, and will constantly attract curses if not properly sealed. Consuming the finger will grant access to, or improve, Cursed Energy, at the expense of taking in a portion of Ryomen Sukuna himself. Who will be very interested in regaining all his fingers and taking over his new body. Though killing a twentieth of him is quite possible...
A full half of Ryomen Sukuna's fingers. Don't eat them all at once.
All of Ryomen Sukuna's fingers. Good if you want to incarnate the King of Curses, otherwise it'd probably be best to get rid of them slowly.

A mass produced Knightmare Frame straight out of Britannia's military. A bit obsolete, but still effective at most roles. Designed to be piloted by a single person, it features a cockpit ejection sensor, a Factsphere Sensor, Landspinner propulsion system, IFF transponder, a Float system, and a Blaze Luminous energy shield. Comes armed with two chest mounted Slash Harken wire guided projectile launchers, one torso mounted anti-personnel machine gun, a mech sized assault rifle, and two elbow mounted stun tonfas.

Well, what did you expect? Anyone who opens this suspiciously shaking can will promptly be subject to an immense, unceasing beating that they cannot possibly fight back against. The beating lasts for an hour or until they're crying on the floor, at which point everyone summoned by the can disappears.

A excessively heavy double bladed single handed axe. As a Teigu, it has some ability to choose its wielder, quickly exhausting anyone who tries to wield it as a weapon unless they are strong enough to satisfy it. Any proper wielder can split the axe into two, and when thrown those blades will continue to follow their target until they hit.

You can drive. What's more, you can drive really well. It doesn't take much to be capable of driving any vehicle you find yourself in, and winning anything less than a professional level race isn't even a question.

You gain the knowledge and techniques of Lingshu Chin Na, the oldest variant of Chin Na. It is a style specializing in joint locks and pressure points, allowing you to strike certain parts of the human body with minimal force and still cause critical damage, to the point of even causing terminal nerve damage to the neck.

Monogamy? Sounds boring. Polygamy and multiple partners are not only common, but entirely normal. It's far easier to convince potential and current partners to enter polygamous relationships, be they harems or polycules.

Dirt can't hurt you. You have a natural resistance to earth based attacks, ignoring sandstorms, quicksand, and thrown rocks easily. This resistance gets stronger the stronger you are, scaling with your Might. To the point where you could take a meteor to the face, or more, and laugh.

Ghost and spirits and souls, oh my! You've got a real talent for handling things of a spiritual nature, ghosts like you and even poltergeists might hesitate before they throw a lamp at your head. Learning how to handle spirits is far easier and any abilities related to the soul are simple to puzzle out.

All that matters, kid. Your deeds will resound throughout the realm- anything you do will somehow be known and talked about. If you claim to have done something, most people will automatically believe you, and spread that on to others. You'll never have trouble claiming credit or getting proper reward for anything you do, from the smallest to the largest.
You've got a head for this sort of thing. You start further along a Tech Tree and it's easier to figure out the next step. The things you create are more effective and are easier to build.

Breath weapon! You can breath in and charge a cone of frosty breath. The longer you charge the wider and thicker the spread. By fault its like walking into a blizzard, but it scales with your Magic to the point where it can freeze a grown man in an instant.

You may now mess with electromagnetic waves. At first you can only send out a pulse that temporarily freezes all technology around, but with training you can focus on what you want to stop or even manipulate tech from afar.
Call into your hand a crackling spear of lightning. It isn't thrown at the speed of lightning, but punches easily though armor and even more easily through dragons.
Fire a bolt of lightning. An actual, literal, bolt of lightning. At the speed of lightning.

Manifest a full set of metal armor onto your body. The higher your Might, the stronger the armor is, and the more you know about metallurgy the more you can customize the armor. You don't need to summon the same armor every time.
Charge your blows with divine power! Which basically just makes it hit a bit harder. Maybe if you have a specific God in mind you can get extra benefits...

You can entirely reshape your body! Over time. And not outside of human possibilities. Perfect for infiltration, hiding, or just getting rid of that dysphoria but not great for combat. Works regardless of whether or not your body is currently something else as a result of a Race roll, though in that case you are limited by the possibilities of that form instead of human.

Swap the locations of any two objects that are of either approximately the same mass, size, or price within your sensory range. You must be touching one to swap it with the other. Also works on yourself.
You may now control all glass and glass-based objects within your sensory range, all the way down to silica crystals.
Change the color and texture of any object by touching it, allowing you to disguise its true nature... if... a bit poorly. Lasts until structural integrity is compromised.
Emit a powerful despair aura that makes weaker targets immobile and unable to retaliate, and makes even stronger opponents than you feel unease and nervousness.

Utilize your energy to analyze every part of an object via touch- structural makeup, chemical makeup, blueprint, weaknesses, flaws, etc. With enough practice, you might even be able to read its history in a form of psychometry.

You can tell the level of danger that someone would pose to you going from safe all the way to certain death. With effort, you can even tell how immediate that threat is. You can also tell your own danger level towards someone else, but that's not particularly useful.
Transform into a snowy tiger or hybrid at will, gaining all the strengths and abilities of a white tiger. Not exactly groundbreaking, but it does boost your physical stats above any normal tiger.

I'm meeelting! You can turn yourself wholly or partially into a slime. As a slime, you have no internal organs, breathe through your slime, float on water, and can freely alter your own shape. While this won't automatically heal injuries, it's useful for dodging them, and you do gain faster healing while in liquid.

You're a far more convincing liar while using this ability, to the point that you could waltz right into a secured area with the right lies. The stronger or more perceptive the target, the less effective your lies are. Unbelievable lies work far less than realistic ones and cost more energy to make the ability work.

Conjure and launch paralytic spores in a pale green cloud that affect targets upon landing on bare skin or being breathed in. The stronger an opponent is, the weaker the effect. Depending on energy used, effects can range from mild limb stiffness to knocking someone out for a whole day. If not maintained, the cloud dissipates fully within five minutes.

Gain the ability to transform into an adult Pissciss Volann- a bipedal angler fish-like alien with massive ripping jaws, sharp claws, a bright lure on its forehead, and the ability to merge its legs into a mermaid-like tail. It's also extremely strong, acrobatic, and capable of biting and clawing through steel with ease. You will suffocate without sufficient water over your gills, though.
While active, all earth, metal, rock, and other ground related powers, spells, abilities, and other effects are massively boosted for yourself and your allies.

A massive minotaur-esque demon wielding an equally massive greataxe. It doesn't have much of a personality, but it's big, tough, strong, and dangerous as hell. The more energy you have, the more demons you can summon.
A massive stone elemental usually found deep within caverns. It can fire shotgun blasts of rock, huck boulders, hit like a truck, and fly. It also looks kind of like a giant bulky gladiator.

Some might call her best girl. A Quarian in an environment suit and a mechanical genius even among her own people. She's cute, quirky, kinda sounds Russian when translated into english, and also has a very weak immune system that can't stand being outside of her environment suit for long. She also can only eat foods of the dextro-amino type. Good luck with that.
