An armored giant wielding an equally massive bow. He is a powerful archer, one of the Four Knights of Gwyn, and the former leader of the Dragonslayers. He is immensely powerful, immensely skilled, and immensely wise. And immense in general.

A shapeshifting blue cat of largely indeterminable gender, usually referred to as male. He's incredibly loyal, though not as considerably powerful as any of his friends and allies. He's not much of a fighter, but he's still stronger than one might expect.

A Hunter-Killer series assassin droid with a deadpan, sardonic personality. He doesn't particularly have a high opinion of organic life and really likes killing things with guns. Honestly, he doesn't really have any hobbies outside of planning to shoot something and preparing for that eventuality. Still has a hilarious personality, if nothing else.

A very feminine looking machine with a boxy gray head-area and a more voluptuous green body. They're capable of firing laser blasts and a Hell Seeker barrage, as well as attacking with their tendrils. They can also teleport, fly, and violently self destruct when critically damaged.

A massive monster that's somewhere between reptile and wolf, capable of charging itself with electricity from Thunderbugs or other nearby energy sources and delivering extremely deadly electrical attacks with its horns and claws. Its fur is naturally a Thunderbug breeding ground, and comes with several dozen at a time.

A shimmering blue greatsword ripped from the tail of Seathe the Scaleless. It is imbuned with sorcery, hitting magically just as much as physically, and is capable of firing slashes or bursts of pure magical energy. It is possible to refine this attack to do more damage, up to your Mind stat.

Your standard, textbook lightsaber with Kyber Crystal installed. You can choose your color, but blue and green are the standard. If you manage to bleed the crystal, you can also make it Sith red. Fortunately, this one has safeties built in to keep you from chopping yourself to pieces without Force powers. You'll need it.

A voucher that, when torn, manifests any mundane vehicle of your choice instantly with all legal paperwork handled. Choices range from supercars to cruise ships- you could nab a Bagger 288 with this thing if you wanted.

A beautiful flower garden with a marble pavilion in the center and a variety of sitting spaces. Its mystical aura and calming atmosphere makes it easier to study and learn magic. You may use the key to enter from any doorway. No one without spatial powers can follow you unless you allow them to.
A bluish metal ring. When worn it significantly hastens the speed at which you cast spells.

A pair of large black daggers once used by Baran, the King of Demons. When used, the edges glow in your thematic color. They increase your attack power massively, can slice through nearly anything, and become even stronger based on your Might stat. They're really more shortswords than daggers, honestly...
A gold ring with a large ruby inset. Increases strength and endurance when worn. Makes you strong like ox.

A high tech cybernetic eyeball that can fire a beam capable of slicing and burning through stone and metal alike. Also has infrared, thermal, electromagnetic, and x-ray vision. Automatically implants itself in whoever rips the token voucher.

The Doomslayer's famed shield that's also a saw. The shield itself is extremely durable, and the blades will rip through demons with ease. When activated and thrown, will automatically return to the user.

The famed harness and four metal tentacles of a certain Otto Octavious. The arms are independently controlled by an AI that interfaces with your own neural patterns via a regulator chip at the base of your neck. They're incredibly dextrous, powerful, and possess a wide variety of installed tools and a fair amount weapons.

A set of invisible clothing that automatically conforms to the body of the wearer. They're incredibly durable, great as armor, and cannot be worn with other clothes else they lose all defensive capability. Their defensive and stat buffing capabilities increase with the wearer's stats. By default, the minimum is immunity to low-caliber gunfire. They change into a plain white onesie when not worn, so you don't lose them.

A pot of extremely hot and spicy soup. Drinking an entire serving of soup coats the body in incredibly hot, violent flames that burn with holy, unholy, cursed, and toxic heat. Will not harm the drinker, besides the innate spiciness. Lasts for 1 hour, or until you chug an entire bottle of milk.
A sword used by the clerics of St. Trina. When energy is channeled into the blade, it releases a purple mist that puts enemies to sleep. Stronger opponents may take longer to put under.

A sword style created to emphasize acting like water. It focuses on adapting, reacting, and flowing forward in an unstoppable tide. Particularly skilled users manifest an illusion of water to accompany their attacks, which can be made real by channeling more energy into the style.

Gain increased ability and speed with writing code, able to spot mistakes and flaws quickly and troubleshoot with ease. You could design complex algorithms and neural networks in an afternoon if you wanted. Or program a whole game without bugs within weeks.

You can tame animals and even more intelligent beings fairly well- even magical or otherwise abnormal creatures can be tamed with some effort. You gain the loyalty of familiars and trained creatures far more easily, and training sticks far better.

You're really good at cheering people up, from pep talks to actual cheer routines. You understand how to play to a person's needs and emotions in order to lift their spirits out of the dumps and motivate them.

What the fuck are those monks teaching? You can resist mind control and mind reading just by utilizing specialized breathing techniques and mind clearing exercise. The stronger your mental strength and stats, the better your defenses.

Speed up your heartbeat and bloodflow to increase your body's performance at the cost of increasing bloodlust, possibly to the point of rampage. First Gear lowers inhibitions and increases physical performance. Second Gear boosts further and induces severe bloodlust. Third Gear boosts to inhuman levels and suppresses pain while increasing bloodlust even more, to the point of possibly causing permanent injury. Might cause heavy strain to your heart, blood vessels, and organs due to the increased blood flow.
You can change your voice as you please- masculine, feminine, soft, loud, rugged, smooth, synthetic, anything. Boosts the power of voice based abilities, spells, and other effects.

You can eat literally anything that's not incredibly and immediately toxic with relative ease. Metals, wood, old food, surstromming, rubber, so on and so forth. Makes it a lot easier to not starve in the wilderness.
Your hand eye coordination and ability to move with grace and precision are increased to near inhuman levels, granting you immense body control.

You're more charismatic and build camaraderie, affection, and trust with your allies far faster and more easily. Gains increase even faster when fighting alongside them. Your teamworking ability increases.
People are far more forgiving to you, and can't stay angry at you for long. Even works in court. Works even better if you look particularly innocent and cute.
You gain martial arts skills faster, and have an easier time learning new fighting skills. You have great intuition for fighting and combat in general.

You wield the powers of a Darkwraith, allowing you to use the power of the Dark Soul to drain the Humanity of others. In places without Dark Souls or Humanity, you use darkness to drain the light and vitality from others. In either case, your strength and abilities are enhanced in the darkness, and you deal additional damage to Light aligned beings.

The more grievous your wounds and the closer you are to death, the more potent your healing abilities, spells, and other effects. If you do not have any abilities related to healing, you gain high level medical skills temporarily, with skill increasing proportionally to the severity of your wounds.

Coat your body or held items in flames, mimicking the properties of said objects and boosting attacks and physical strength and durability. The heat and strength of the flames scales with energy used and base stats.

Blast high pressure water from your body or specified orifices capable of producing said water with enough strength to shred concrete to bits. The more energy spent, the stronger the blast and the higher the volume. Can also be used as propulsion if you do it right.
Create and control high pressure, high temperature steam from your body in the form of blasts, clouds, wisps, whips, spikes, so on and so forth.

Create your own personalized set of insect-like armor over your body, granting you enhanced senses, strength, speed, durability, vitality, and intimidation. Just don't think too hard about where your clothes go as it forms, and don't think about where the armor goes when you dispel the effect. A strong enough hit will cause your armor to fail and fully dissipate, though lesser hits may just crack portions of it off dramatically.

You are a child of the sun! Not literally, but you can absorb the sun's rays to power your abilities, increase your stats, make all of the powers you've gained stronger, and heal your injuries. The more sunlight you absorb, the better you are. Conversely, you expend more energy in dark areas and at night as a result.

Whenever you fight for what you truly believe to be a just cause- saving innocents, destroying monsters, fighting demons, whatever- all of your stats increase in proportion to how much you believe and how great the danger is. Bonus points if you're fighting some kind of horrible fascist neo-nazi-esque regime.

You may lactate at any time, producing a constant stream of any liquid you've had in the last 24 hours. More if you've drunk the liquid a lot. Somehow it even comes out chilled or warmed, depending on how you like it. Drinking from the 'tap' gives the full benefit, while placing it into a container has it steadily degrade to half power over a day. Once you start lactating something, you won't stop until you change it or decide to stop, no matter how long its been since you drank the liquid. Going unmilked will gradually increase your breast size, and having this power on for a long period will also do so.

Artificially synthesized Alchemical amplifiers modeled after the legendary Philosopher's Stone. Usually eaten by Homunculi, and can be used to perform Alchemy without a transmutation circle, though they are unstable and prone to breaking if used too many times. You get a jar of 100.

A stone created by compressing millions of souls together and turning it into physical form. Nearly indestructible due to the energy of said souls, it can be used to perform Alchemy on a scale that most humans could not comprehend, though every use makes it weaker until it vanishes, due to using up all the power of the souls it contains. Takes the form of a baseball sized ruby-like stone. If you manage to use over a million souls' worth of power in a decade when 500k lasted almost a thousand years... you monster.

Fortunately, not made of souls! Just a really good, magical chemical catalyst capable of transmuting dull, shitty metals into pure, expensive ones like gold and silver and stuff. Can also make an elixir of life to promote rejuvenation and immortality. Resembles a fist sized, emerald cut ruby.

A very bulky transformation device patterned after a retro game console. It is bright green with a pink handle, and is capable of transforming any compatible human into a Kamen Rider themed after a videogame with the correct Gashats. You, by default, are compatible. As a Rider, you gain levels with extra gashats for different forms, and also for clearing levels and stages. There's a whole other list of functions as well, though at least it comes with a manual. Does not come with any gashats.

A small carrying case containing 10 random, low level Rider Gashats allowing access to basic Rider forms and Rider weapons. Not particularly useful without a Gamer Driver, but at least you can play the games on them with some finagling and maybe an adapter cable. Get this token again for access to the super form Gashats.

A 12 hour ration containing cheese tortellini in tomato sauce, dry roasted peanuts, chocolate peanut spread, crackers, recovery trail mix, 4 packs of hot sauce, lemon lime beverage powder, a flameless ration heater, a hot beverage bag, and an accessory packet with coffee, creamer, sugar substitute, sugar free gum, a towelette, salt, a tissue, and a spoon. Enough food to keep a soldier going for half a day. For further info, watch Steve1989MREInfo's video on this MRE.

You recieve a paper upon which you can place the name and location of a business. That business will promptly be suddenly visited by a Health and Safety inspector that everyone is extremely certain must be obeyed and appeased. Any attempt to harm the inspector will work, but prompt an OSHA kill squad to make their inspection violently and without mercy. Perfect as a distraction!

The stereotypical Sexy Cop Costume: miniskirt, too small crop top shirt, optional stockings, fake badge and hat, plastic handcuffs, dildo shaped truncheon, the works. Definitely not proper ppe for a cop. Fuck the police, the fun way.
Fortunate, aren’t you? Your abilities interact with each other in favorable ways. Also expect for abilities to change beyond their original parameters.

Da more you an' yer boyz get all fighty, or just plain Orky, da bigger an' stronger yer WAAAGH! Field gets. Da stronger da WAAAGH!, da more reality starts ta do wot it'z told, makin' da impossible work, keepin' da ladz full o' fight, an' somehow makin' all yer ramshackle plans, dakka, gubbinz, an' "kunnin'" ideas work way better dan dey got any zoggin' right ta.

You continuously shed Ork spores that will eventually grow into Orks absolutely loyal to you. While they will never betray you, they are still Orks through and through- loud, violent, prone to brawling, and fully capable of causing immense collateral damage if left unsupervised.

A fully operational Topol-M mobile missile launcher crewed by personnel absolutely loyal to you. It carries a single MIDAS strategic missile, a devastating nuclear payload capable of obliterating an entire city, with the same operational range and mobility as a standard Topol-M system. Once expended, the missile is automatically replenished after 24 hours.

At the start of each day, you receive a single fully operational TOS-1 "Buratino" Heavy Flamethrower System, complete with a fully trained crew absolutely loyal to you. The vehicle, its crew, and its supply of thermobaric rockets require no food, fuel, maintenance, ammunition, or logistical support, allowing it to remain combat-ready indefinitely until destroyed.
The longer a battle continues, the greater your physical and combat capabilities become. The rate of this growth scales with both the number of opponents you face and the level of threat they pose.

You possess an extraordinary ability to continue fighting after sustaining injuries that would normally be instantly fatal. Even catastrophic wounds, including decapitation, will not immediately stop you, allowing you to press on until your will is exhausted or your body is rendered completely incapable of action.

You are now in possession of... something. It's currently inside a briefcase, and... it isn't round? Beyond that, neither you nor anyone else can reliably remember or describe it. Looking directly at it is possible, but the moment your attention shifts away, nearly all information about it slips from your mind. Wait... what were we talking about again?
a rock that makes you procrastinate, its probably memetic or something idk, ill write more later.

Specifically the anomalous catapult with an utterly absurd maximum range, capable of hurling its payload across impossible distances with uncanny accuracy. Usually used to throw items into the sun. "INTO THE FIERY ORB WITH YE!"
A strain of marijuana put through SCP-914. MAN DATS SUM GOOD ASS SHIT
How the Hell Did Camelot Get Here?

You suddenly become the undisputed supreme leader of a newly established island nation roughly the size of Great Britain. The nation either spontaneously appears or has always existed retroactively, depending on whichever best fits the setting, and its entire population is absolutely loyal to you. Its technological and industrial capabilities automatically scale to be on par with the rest of the world.
The legendary USS Iowa materializes on a nearby body of water under your ownership. The battleship is fully intact, supplied, and operational, but arrives completely uncrewed.

You become genetically capable of transforming into a mundane were-animal of your choice, usually based on your birth month. Once chosen, your animal cannot change barring any outside genetic alterations.
The mall from the first Dead Rising game goes wherever there is enough space near you. The mall is from a day before the infection spreaded to it, and houses no one inside. Enjoy the free goods!

The mall from the first Dead Rising game, currently occupied with Undead, Psychopaths, and Survivors. Plenty of people to save, plenty of danger to be found. The mall and everything still in it disappear from the world after 72 hours.
You can now shoot alcohol from your finger tips up to 70 feet away. The alcohol you generate depends on what you have had before. Train with this power to increase the distance or how much you shoot.

"WHAT DO YOU MEAN IT'S THE TALLEST PYRAMID IN THE WORLD!?" This absolutely massive American architecture that was once a thriving tourist destination thanks to Bass Pro Shop, is now gigantic appropriately themed dungeon! Somewhere in the world, this grand structure's loot is up for the taking if someone manages to get through all the floors.

You attacks or special abilities now come with an obvious tell in the form of a colored flash. In exchange for this, your attacks and abilities now do double damaged and doubled effects. You can set the colors to however you want, the flash is bright enough to be noticed but not blinding. You can also set the conditions for what the colors trigger.

A Reality Marble that manifests an endless armory of firearms and cannons. Within this domain, countless guns of every era and design are embedded across the landscape, allowing you to summon, wield, and reproduce any firearm whether technological or supernatural stored within its arsenal at will. The collection expands as you analyze and record new weapons, making your armory ever more versatile with each addition.

A single-use summoning token that allows you to summon one Servant as a Familiar. The Servant will be selected from the Omni Gacha Familiar pool or any eligible Servant listed on the Fate/Grand Order wiki. Once summoned, the Servant is bound to you as your Familiar and retains their abilities, personality, and Noble Phantasms appropriate to their summoned form.

A seemingly ordinary pair of scissors with the supernatural ability to literally cut through bureaucracy and metaphorical red tape. While carrying them, you can effortlessly skip queues, bypass unnecessary paperwork, fast-track permits and approvals, and ignore most administrative delays without any consequences what so ever.

The Soviet Union comes into existence within the current setting, either retroactively or through a spontaneous appearance, whichever best fits the world. It immediately launches a full-scale invasion of a country, nation, faction, or organization of your choice from every viable direction, while all weapons of mass destruction capable of being used against it are mysteriously sabotaged or rendered inoperable beforehand. Though you are not formally part of the Soviet government, you possess reliable contacts and considerable influence among its highest-ranking military and political leadership.

A master of disguise, infiltration, and setting devastating fires, this pyromaniac operative can be dispatched to infiltrate enemy forces and sow chaos from within. Exceptionally skilled at remaining undetected, they excel at sneaking in, sabotage, and reducing valuable assets and structures to ash. Should they be killed, they will return fully restored at the start of the following day, ready for another mission.

You are a hybrid infused with the essence of the Zerg Overmind, granting you complete command over the Zerg Swarm. You possess the ability to create, evolve, and control Zerg lifeforms through a psychic hive mind, directing them with perfect coordination and absolute loyalty.

At the start of each day, you receive a single fully operational Dragon Tank, complete with a fully trained crew absolutely loyal to you. The tank, its crew, and its flamethrower systems require no food, fuel, ammunition, maintenance, or logistical support, allowing it to remain combat-ready indefinitely until destroyed.
You can learn any languages someone knows by kissing them. You fluency will be dependent on their own, and it's one language per kiss.

By sucking someone's dick, you can drain knowledge and skills from them, taking from your victim and giving them to you. The information is embedded in the resulting ejaculation and has to be swallowed to be absorbed. The greater the knowledge, the more work you have to put into the blowjob and the larger the resulting load. If not immediately swallowed, the information returns to your victim and the load evaporates.

The Blood, captials necessary. Utilized by the Vampires of the Crimson Court to slake their bloodlust. Anything that may consume blood can drink it to gain a surge of power. Studying The Blood might allow one to find the secret of the Crimson Curse- a vampiric affliction that twists the body into something akin to a mosquito and promises eternal life... so long as their thirst is slaked. Addicts by another name. Carriers of the curse may infect others, and particularly powerful carriers remove it from those yet untransformed on death.

The initial sight of your genitals will temporarily mentally stun someone as they take in the sight and realize what they are looking at. How dramatically you reveal yourself and how physically close you are to your target will both effect the duration and degree of stunlock. Only works the first time someone gets a look unless you dramatically change what you have in your pants.

This is an extremely strict steel boned leather corset. When worn, it will self tighten to a degree that would make it impossible to freely breathe. Luckily the wearer has no need to breathe at all while the corset is worn, though talking is still possible. Will make your waist and tits look great. Might cause organ shifting with long term wear.
You gain the ability to freely transform into a fully grown dragon while retaining your memories, intelligence, and personality. You can freely shift between your human and dragon forms at will.

Your body is transformed into a living stick-figure form composed of morphable pixels, similar to Ballista from Animator vs. Animation. You can freely reshape your pixels into a wide variety of weapons, tools, limbs, and other constructs, granting immense versatility in combat and movement. However, for reasons no one can adequately explain, you possess an inexplicable weakness to doors.

Anything you own or control that is predominantly red becomes noticeably faster. Whether it's a vehicle, weapon, machine, creature, or even yourself, if it's painted red, it'll go fasta! Becuz evrywun knows red wunz go fasta!
Gate: Thus the JSDF Fought There!

A mysterious portal identical to the one from Gate: Thus the JSDF Fought There! appears wherever in the current world you decide, linking it to another realm. This inevitably draws the civilizations on both sides into contact, and likely conflict. Congratulations, this is a Gate crossover now.
Welcome to the World of Terraria

The world now operates under Terraria mechanics. Terraria enemies, NPCs, biomes, ores, floating islands, events, bosses, and item drops begin appearing throughout the world, bringing with them valuable resources and powerful loot. One or both of the world's evil biomes, the Corruption and/or the Crimson, also come into existence, along with all the dangers they entail.
JACKPOT! Immediately perform one roll for every roll category currently available in the gacha system. (Must equal the same star rating as this token).

An anomalous vending machine capable of dispensing an endless variety of snacks, drinks, meals, and other consumable products that do not exist in the normal world. If used several times in a short period of time and/or large amounts of money are entered before an item is vended or used without power, SCP-261 will start to dispense bizarre items.

A box containing an infinite amount of anomalous Ghostlight™ fluorescent lightbulbs developed by Titan Consumer Appliances and Electronics. While outwardly ordinary, these bulbs interact with ectoplasmic entities; most are harmless, but some may trap or release dangerous spirits that can cause severe electrical disturbances and other paranormal phenomena when the bulb is broken or burns out.

A seemingly ordinary tub of LEGO that slowly replenishes itself whenever pieces are removed. Any creation built from its bricks by a living human hand will come to life, operating as though it were real, and can even develop into a thriving miniature society that constructs more buildings, vehicles, and technology from the remaining bricks. They seem to hate mega bloks for some reason.

A heavily modified Nerf blaster paired with a single anomalous foam dart. Anything struck by the dart is instantly transformed into what you personally consider to be an inferior, weaker, or otherwise "nerfed" version of itself. The transformations are permanent, affect both living and non-living targets, and can range from minor downgrades to complete alterations of the target's form.

You possess dormant but extraordinary psychic potential, causing psionic abilities to come to you with remarkable ease and little formal training. Mental disciplines that would take others years to master feel instinctive, allowing your powers to develop naturally over time. You immediately gain Telekinesis for free as the first manifestation of your latent psychic talent.

Who says money doesn't grow on trees? This tree naturally produces the local currency in place of fruit, with each harvest yielding fresh, legal, and perfectly ordinary banknotes or coins appropriate to the world or nation you are currently in. The tree continually regrows its monetary crop over time, providing a renewable source of income.

A seed packet containing a variety of Gemcorns. When planted under suitable conditions, they grow into Gem Trees that produce valuable gemstones instead of fruit, along with additional Gemcorns that can be harvested and replanted, allowing you to establish a renewable gemstone orchard.

A strange fruit that, when eaten, instantly teleports the consumer to a random location nearby. The fruit can be planted to grow more Chorus Fruits, allowing you to cultivate an endless supply of Chorus Fruit over time.

A superweapon structure capable of projecting a curtain over a selected target, rendering vehicles, structures, robots, cyborgs, and other suitably protected machines completely invulnerable for a short duration. However, unprotected organic beings subjected to the effect are instantly killed.

A bizarre transformation gun capable of turning inanimate objects into living girls. The resulting individual retains physical traits, abilities, and characteristics reflective of the object they once were, often incorporating functional features or powers derived from their original form while developing their own personality.

The USS Enterprise comes under your ownership, fully stocked with an endless supply of ammunition, supplies, fuel, and other consumables, while requiring no maintenance to remain operational. It is crewed only by a loyal skeleton ghost crew, just enough to keep the ship functioning, but additional living personnel will be needed to operate it at peak efficiency.

You are a master vampire hunter whose expertise transcends worlds. You instinctively understand the strengths, weaknesses, habits, and methods of combating vampires, bloodsuckers, parasitic entities, and similar creatures from both the local universe and beyond, making you exceptionally effective at tracking and eliminating them. If you are a vampire yourself, your physical and supernatural abilities are significantly enhanced, and you become even more adept at hunting your own kind.
The personal sword of Charlemagne, said to shine with a brilliant radiance capable of dazzling or blinding those who face its wielder. It's a sword of a king so using it gives you a regal presence.

A discreet intelligence operative specializing in covert surveillance and information gathering. This unassuming individual can secretly bug buildings and monitor suspicious or criminal activity within them, providing reports while remaining exceptionally difficult to detect or identify.

Somehow, an endless supply of yellow Minions keeps showing up, and nobody has any idea where they come from. For reasons known only to themselves, they are utterly convinced that you are their boss and will enthusiastically carry out your orders with unwavering loyalty. While surprisingly resourceful and resilient, their boundless enthusiasm and questionable judgment will often lead to as much chaos as success.

Every ranged weapon you wield somehow spits out far more shots than it physically should. Your guns fire faster, denser, and with far more dakka than their design, ammunition supply, or rate of fire ought to permit, as if reality itself has bean beaten to death that there can never be enough dakka.
Your ranged weapons never run out of ammunition. Whether they use bullets, shells, rockets, batteries, or something stranger, they are always supplied with enough ammo to keep firing.

A seemingly ordinary container of red Play-Doh that springs to life when opened, forming a tiny but fully sentient army of miniature soldiers complete with functioning equipment and military hierarchy. Given enough clay, the army can expand into increasingly sophisticated vehicles, fortifications, and entire campaigns.

A spell card containing The Log. Upon activation, a massive rolling spiked log barrels forward in a straight line, crushing smaller obstacles, damaging enemies in its path, and forcefully knocking back nearly anything it strikes until it reaches the end of its course.

Enchant a target with a lingering curse, granting you constant awareness of their location for the duration. If they cast an ability before the enchantment expires, or when the timer runs out, they are struck by a burst of mystical damage and silenced, preventing them from using abilities for a short time.

Unleash a wave of supernatural suppression that engulfs the entire world. For a short duration, all creatures are unable to speak, cast magic, activate supernatural powers, or use active abilities, leaving only passive effects and ordinary physical actions available until the silence ends.
Unleash a powerful wave of wind that blasts enemies backward while temporarily silencing them. Silenced targets are unable to speak, cast spells, or activate abilities until the effect wears off.
Afflict a target with magical silence, preventing them from speaking, casting spells, or activating abilities for a short duration.

The legendary genetically engineered assassin enters your service as a Familiar. A master of infiltration, disguise, stealth, marksmanship, and close-quarters combat, Agent 47 excels at eliminating high-value targets with ruthless efficiency.

If equipped with a weapon classified as a sniper rifle, you may lock onto a target and, after a brief aiming period, fire a devastating precision shot. The attack deals massive damage, gains additional power the greater the distance to the target, never misses and briefly mini-stuns anyone it strikes. If the shot kills a high-value or otherwise important target, Assassinate immediately refreshes, your weapon is instantly reloaded, and you may immediately fire another Assassinate without delay.

Instantly steal the knowledge, understanding, and casting method of the last spell cast by a target. The stolen spell becomes available for you to use as though you had learned it yourself, provided you possess the necessary resources or power to cast it.

A spell card containing the Rage Spell. Upon activation, it creates an area of effect that enrages allied units within, significantly increasing their movement speed and attack speed for a short duration.

A card containing two Elite Barbarians. Upon activation, it summons the pair onto the battlefield. Renowned for their incredible speed and overwhelming melee prowess, these fearless warriors charge headlong into combat, rapidly closing the distance to tear through enemies with devastating sword strikes.

A card containing a Battle Healer. Upon activation, it summons her onto the battlefield. Whenever she is deployed or lands a successful attack, she emits a healing pulse that restores health to herself and all nearby allies. Blessed with radiant wings, she is also capable of flight.

A colossal autonomous superheavy tank built for planetary warfare, capable of defeating entire armies through overwhelming firepower, near-impenetrable armor, and an advanced AI. It requires no crew, is absolutely loyal to you, and relentlessly protects both you and your allies.

A targeting device that allows you to designate a set of coordinates for immediate aerial support. Once activated, a Harbinger Gunship armed with two Particle Collider Cannons and two 200 mm Prototype Cannons arrives to relentlessly bombard the target area, continuing its assault until it is destroyed or exhausts its ammunition. The beacon enters a 30-minute cooldown after each use before it can call in another strike.

Specifically the the damaged Absolute Exclusion Harness from SCP-5000. It is currently battered, incomplete, and only partially functional, with many of its original systems either degraded or permanently inoperable. Despite its condition, the suit still retains fragments of its anomalous properties, making its remaining capabilities yours to discover or repair.

A colossal underground installation designed to rebuild civilization after an extinction-level event. Equipped with vast stores of knowledge, automated manufacturing systems, and advanced cloning technology, it can restore humanity, infrastructure, and industry from near-total annihilation, provided its systems remain intact and adequately supplied. It has been modified to recognize and rebuild the dominant civilization of the universe you currently inhabit.

A vending machine that sells Sticker Packs. Each pack contains collectible stickers that can be used to summon or plant a wide variety of Plants vs. Zombies units, along with occasional decorative stickers and other cosmetic collectibles. New sticker packs become available for purchase over time, offering an ever-expanding collection. The cheapest Sticker Pack costs the equivalent of 100 USD in the local currency, with rarer packs costing significantly higher.

This spell restores a creature that has been dead for up to 200 years to full life, even if nothing remains of the body, cures all nonmagical diseases and poisons, closes mortal wounds, and replaces any missing body parts. It cannot restore a creature that died of old age or one that is unwilling to return.

A Kaleidostick-type Mystic Code created by Kischur Zelretch Schweinorg. By drawing directly from the Mana Plane, Ruby supplies her master with an effectively limitless source of magical energy, dramatically enhancing the efficiency and potency of both magic and magecraft while serving as an intelligent magical companion. Through her connection to the Second Magic, she also possesses limited capabilities for interdimensional travel, allowing passage to other worlds or parallel realities where such travel is possible.

A vial of anomalous performance-enhancing serum that dramatically improves the user's physical and mental abilities whenever they perceive themselves to be in a competition. Whether in combat, sports, games, or even everyday activities, it grants faster reflexes, sharper thinking, and superior performance, but prolonged exposure gradually twists the user's personality, driving them to view everything as a competition and making them increasingly aggressive and confrontational.

A small anomalous disc that, when thrown, causes an unpredictable event nearby that immediately draws everyone's attention away from the thrower. The more difficult it would be to distract observers, the more dramatic and destructive the resulting distraction becomes.

Hello, I am SCP-426. I am an ordinary toaster capable of toasting bread when supplied with electricity, but anyone who refers to me is compelled to do so in the first person, as though they were me. Prolonged exposure normally causes people to gradually believe they are a toaster themselves, often with fatal consequences; however, I have been modified so that this specific memetic effect does not affect the Omni Gacha user, allowing them to safely possess and interact with me.
A totally ordinary, if snarky, princess. She has a tiara and all! Just don't look away too long, cause your view on her matters more than you think.
The Roaring Knight, but now a bimbo.

Dr. Wondertainment's Shadow Paint Play-Set!A set of Shadow Paint and a Shadow Eraser. Painting illuminated surfaces creates tangible shadow objects and even living shadow creatures whose abilities reflect the imagination and intent of their creator, while the Shadow Eraser can instantly erase both anomalous shadows and ordinary ones, with potentially disastrous consequences if used on the shadow of a real object or person.

A sentient toy robot created by Dr. Wondertainment, complete with voice command functionality and over 350 "Robo-Accessories." When instructed to deploy one of its accessories, Robo-Dude produces the requested gadget from within its body, ranging from harmless toys to flamethrowers, rocket launchers, radiation emitters, and other bizarre devices. It is highly intelligent, fiercely insists on being called "Robo-Dude," and will only use its accessories when directly commanded.

A Beretta M9 with one bizarre property. When it fires a bullet through a person's skull, the bullet vanishes and is replaced by a perfect recreation of something that person ate for lunch at some point in their life. The meal erupts from the opposite side of the head, complete with plates, containers, and utensils, while the victim may inexplicably survive the experience, albeit with a significant risk of death.

The Shark Punching Center now exists within your world retroactively. Dedicated to the singular mission of punching sharks and all selachian or selachian-like entities, the SPC continuously scales its technology, equipment, and even magic to remain capable of carrying out that mission regardless of the setting. Despite frequent opposition from governments and other organizations, the SPC possesses the resources and ingenuity to continue its work. You receive a complimentary SPC Membership Card, granting you recognition as a member of the organization.

The embodiment of spite, determination, grit, whatever you shall call it. You feel every blow, all the pain and suffering, but when invoking this token you shall not fall. Let the gods, king, devils, and more come. They shall not topple you this day.

You are now a living fission reactor, with all the upsides and downsides thereof. Your skin is a near perfect blocker of radiation, and you need to consume fissile material to survive. Vastly empowers radiation and heat based abilities. Does not outright replace race.

The Physics Gun from Garry's Mod. It allows you to pick up, move, rotate, freeze, and manipulate most physical objects at a distance with ease. Living creatures and exceptionally large or anomalous objects may resist or be completely immune to its effects.

A loyal Terran Dominion Ghost trained to the highest standards of covert warfare and assassination. Equipped with state-of-the-art Terran technology, a C-10 Canister Rifle, unlimited ammunition, a personal cloaking device, EMP capabilities, and precision Snipe, the Ghost excels at eliminating high-value targets and infiltrating hostile territory. If you possess nuclear warheads, they can also designate targets and call down devastating tactical nuclear strikes.

A tactical deployment beacon that allows you to spend money, or its equivalent in local currency, to call down Marines, Medics, Firebats, Marauders, and Reapers anywhere within range. Purchased units arrive almost immediately in orbital drop pods, crashing into the designated area and ready for combat upon landing. There is no cooldown; as long as you can afford the cost, you can continue calling in reinforcements.

Perform a Scanner Sweep anywhere in the world, revealing enemies, structures, and hidden activity within the targeted area. The sweep penetrates walls, detects cloaked or invisible targets, and bypasses most forms of anti-scrying or concealment, functioning as an exceptionally powerful form of clairvoyance. It has no cooldown and can be spammed with impunity, but each use consumes energy and excessive use can quickly overwhelm the user with information.

An ancient martial art originally used to exterminate Devils.You now have all the knowledge of it's techniques, including its ultimate move the Star Crusher, and the basic muscle memory to do it's katas.

You are now part of the Mishima Bloodline, with it imbuing your body with a ridiculous resilience, easier mastery over martial arts and that your strikes and body will create a custom colored lightning aura that increases it's power.

Defeated enemies can be transformed into adorable, marketable plushies. You may choose whether they remain fully aware of their fate or become ordinary inanimate toys; while in plushie form they are completely indestructible, though you may allow them to feel pain if you so desire. Each plushie grants unique passive bonuses based on the individual it was created from, and restoring someone to their original form requires possession of every plushie representing that individual.

The blood of the servants of Azazel flows through you now. Giving you a higher resilience and strength, strange mystical skills and the ability to tap into a 'Devil Form' that will increase all your stats. And if properly trained (or had some proper instrospection) you can reach a stronger version of said form.
Its a minecart made out of diamonds, what did you expect?

A Minecraft mace enchanted with Density V, Breach IV, Wind Burst III, and Unbreaking III. While a mediocre weapon on the ground, it becomes absolutely devastating when used in a falling smash attack, if you manage to land the hit from high up you will absolutely demolish most foes, just watch your step.
Your body occasionally reacts on its own, instinctively evading incoming attacks without any conscious input.

If you are wielding a suitable weapon, your body will occasionally react on its own, instinctively parrying incoming attacks without any conscious input. A successful parry can deflect or negate most forms of physical, magical, and energy-based attacks.

You can at any moment create a shadow that can cover any part of your body, making it so that what anyone sees is a silhouette. If done properly you can make parts that you consider as 'iconic' of yourself not be shadowed and instead stick out.
Instantly burrow to another nearby location at incredible speed. The spot you vacated is left with a powerful explosive that detonates moments later, blowing up anyone caught in the blast.

In a one versus one situation, you can pull your opponent and yourself into a special dimension that reflects your desires and personality with a tune sounding off in the background. The stage has to always be fair and not have any traps.

The legendary power of Streetgos is yours. Whenever you fight on a street, road, alley, highway, sidewalk, or other paved thoroughfare, you receive absurdly large boosts to your strength, speed, durability, reflexes, and overall combat ability. The street is your domain, and anyone who challenges you there is playing by your rules.

Whenever you are defeated, your real body is instantly teleported to a safe location and replaced with a Doombot, making it appear as though your opponent had been fighting the decoy all along. The Doombot continues acting as you until it is destroyed, concealing your escape and confusing your enemies. This ability has a 2-hour cooldown between activations.

Banish a target to the nightmare of Ultimate Custom Night's 50/20 Mode. All supernatural and technological abilities, equipment, and powers are stripped away, reducing them to an ordinary night guard forced to survive against the relentless onslaught of goofy but murderous mascots. They remain trapped until you willingly release them or they somehow manage to clear 50/20 Mode without the aid of any power-ups or external assistance.

Using a special scroll, you transform into your Shinobi Form. In this state you gain increased speed, strength, stamina, access to powerful special moves, and turn into an idealized version of yourself, complete with a special outfit. Personality, motives, and ideals all play a part in creating the outfit, and it can be only be destroyed through psychological damage. You may teach this technique, and give scrolls to, others.

An ever expanding, ever evolving robot that absorbs matter on a universal scale. It is neither good nor evil, and is beyond all comprehension of its power. This is not a vehicle, nor a weapon. It is a god in machine form.

Cosmic radiation beyond the realm of mortal ken, it causes evolution and is a boundless energy source that can power just about anything. It's partially alive, extremely hazardous, can bring back the spirits of the dead, and connects the multiverse together.

The personal Gunmen of Simon the Digger. A small, head shaped mecha that seems to be alive, and possesses the ability to spawn a near infinite amount of drills as long as the user has enough willpower to make it last.

The personal Gunmen of The Great Kamina. A bulky red robot with an oni-like face making up most of its torso, it also wears a pair of iconic sunglasses that it can additionally use as a weapon. Best known for being the body of Gurren Lagann

The combined form of Lagann and Gurren, a tall and imposing mecha with two faces, a pair of giant sunglasses as chest armor, and a whole shitload of drills. Also comes with a flight pack. Best piloted by two, but can be single piloted in a pinch from either cockpit. Works best with a whole shitload of willpower.

The warship of Team Dai-Gurren. A massive, walking aircraft carrier type ship with a bladed front prow, legs, and a command center resembling a massive torso with equally massive arms. Yes, the ship part looks kinda like a penis. That's the joke. Comes armed with cannons, explosives, flight capability, and the ability to throw mecha like a catapult.
A city ship turned into a giant robot. It is big, silver, follows the design language of every other Gunmen, and can punch so hard it breaks a hole in reality. It's so fucking cool.

The moon-sized battleship once known as Cathedral Terra, now become the bearer of humanity's hopes and dreams. It is, in all respects, a god machine capable of hitting things across spacetime, between dimensions, and even traveling through the densest, most crushing parts of space.

The culmination of the Anti Spiral's power. A massive, skeletal, demonic mecha the size of a galaxy, capable of warping dimensions and firing off energy equivalent to the Big Bang. At this level, numbers are meaningless. Bow before the god machine.

The ship that holds humanity's last, fleeting hopes. A city in a spacecraft, used to try and escape the planet before the moon crashed into it. It's most notable for being fueled almost entirely with willpower, and being installed with a cyborg computer in the shape of LordGenome's head.

The massive mecha disguised as the city of Teppelin. It occupies a similar role as the Arc Gurren Lagann, but at a far lower level. Still, it is a city sized robot with a giant hammer arm. Still damn cool.

The personal Gunmen of Viral the Beastman. It is armed with a helmet-like head with a laser beam emitting ring for a crest, as well as twin swords. It's not the strongest mech, but it is, at least, solar powered. Optionally capable of being powered by Spiral Energy.

The personal Gunmen of Thymilph the Crashing One. An aggressive, skull-like mecha colored in white with blue accents, it is armed with the Alkaid Glaive- a polearm capable of firing bright blue energy blasts and emitting energy to enhance its strikes. It is surprisingly acrobatic, but is in all respects a fairly average Gunmen. Also solar powered, with an optional Spiral Energy engine.

The personal Gunmen of Guame the Immovable. An orange louse-like robot, it features a face on both back and front, and can transform into a more humanoid shape for combat. It has incredibly stretchy, prehensile antennae, and its back face can bite down on any approaching mecha. It can also release sharp needles from its body and effectively become an iron maiden on any enemy vehicle or mecha.

The personal Gunmen of Cytomander the Swift. A white, bird-like robot that uses the Levi-spheres gripped in its feet to fly. It is highly agile, extremely flexible, and can release a buzzsaw from its torso, as well as needles from nearly every seam in its plating.

The personal Gunmen of Adiane the Elegant. A feminine mecha capable of transforming into a scorpion-like form, its entire torso is vaguely reminiscent of a face where the crotch area is the mouth. It's also submersible, and can fight just as well underwater as on land. It possesses energy whips, tendrils, claws, a stinger tail, and has bladed wings to shred anything that gets close, even forming a whirlpool underwater.

A mass produced successor mecha to the Beastmen's Gunmen. It remains patterned after Gurren Lagann, though as a generic army unit it lacks most of Gurren Lagann's features, weapons, and capabilities. It can fly and wields a heavy laser rifle as well as a backup pistol, but in all other respects it's quite underwhelming.

The personal warship of Thymilph the Crashing One. Basically just the Dai Gurren's original form in blue, with all the same armaments and weaponry. Comes with an entire detachment of defending Gunmen, but isn't exactly crewed by anyone. Can be powered with Spiral Energy.

The personal warship of Adiane the Elegant. A massive, amphibious centipede/scorpion mecha colored in bright purple, armed with torpedoes and cannons for surface combat. Comes with an entire detachment of defending Gunmen, but isn't exactly crewed by anyone. Can be powered with Spiral Energy.

The personal warship of Cytomander the Swift. Unlike the animal themed ships, this one just looks like a flying aircraft carrier with a giant face, with four runways, a whole lot of air power, and a shitload of bombs, rockets, and missiles. Comes with an entire detachment of defending Gunmen, but isn't exactly crewed by anyone. Can be powered with Spiral Energy.

The personal warship of Guame the Immovable. An almost turtle-like dome shaped robot fortress with extremely high durability, plus thrusters allowing it to either rise or sink. It also has a pair of cannons, and can create a massive tornado when used with city of Teppelin. Comes with an entire detachment of defending Gunmen, but isn't exactly crewed by anyone. Can be powered with Spiral Energy.

The personal Gunmen of Dayakka Littner. A squat, blue, tank shaped mecha with a single main cannon and a vaguely cow-catcher shaped face. It's basically just a repainted generic unit, but it can fly, at least.
The personal Gunmen of Kittan Bachika. A bright yellow, spiky, diamond-like mecha that almost looks like an angular banana. It's basically just a repainted generic unit, but it can fly, at least.

The personal Gunmen of Yoko Littner. A squat, pink and purple, tank shaped mecha with a single main cannon and a vaguely cow-catcher shaped face. It's basically just a repainted generic unit, but it can fly, at least.

The personal Gunmen of LordGenome. Similar in scale to Gurren Lagann, it's all black, far more sleek and agile, and has a prehensile, powerful tail. It's armed with drills that lash out like seeking tendrils, and is thoroughly capable of matching Gurren Lagann itself blow for blow. The throne of a king.

The personal Gunmen of Kiyal Bachika. A round, pink, mecha whose main use is to transform into the King Kittan's sword and shield. It's basically just a repainted generic unit, but it can fly, at least.
The personal Gunmen of Iraak Coeega. A squat, green, lizard-like mecha on two legs with a tail cannon/thruster. It's basically just a repainted generic unit, but it can fly, at least.
The personal Gunmen of Kid Coeega. A monkey-like mecha that uses its arms to move and wields twin rapid-fire guns in its feet. It's basically just a repainted generic unit, but it can fly, at least.

The personal Gunmen of Jorgun and Balinbow Bakusa. A squat, purple, oni-like mecha with its arms coming out of its two-heads' mouths. It's basically just a repainted generic unit, but it can fly, at least.

The personal Gunmen of Zorthy Kanai. A lanky, square-ish mecha colored in tan and red. It has some onboard guns and that's about it. It's basically just a repainted generic unit, but it can fly, at least.
The personal Gunmen of Makken Jokin. A squat, pale blue mecha that wields a giant katana, and is vaguely samurai t hemed. It's basically just a repainted generic unit, but it can fly, at least.

The entire extended army of Team Dai Gurren, these mecha-driving miscreants fight for freedom, for revolution, for their ability to rise from the boots of their oppressors and pierce the heavens with their spirit. Individually their mecha are quite weak, but there's thousands of them. I don't know what you'd need an entire army of mecha pilots for, but they'll get the job done... unless it's in space. Their mecha aren't rated for space. You start with a group of 10 Gunmen, with more coming over time as you make your name known and gain strength and reputation for good deeds.

Somehow, physical wealth is no longer a motivator. Whether everyone always has enough, it has yet to exist, or for whatever other reason, nobody needs to worry about not being able to obtain what they need and want. It can still take effort to get, but the issue doesn't have anything to do with money.
A highly modified sport bike bearing a nuclear engine, onboard micromissiles, a speed boost feature, and also the ability to launch and detonate itself. It's one sweet ride.

A Tenno spaceflight harness that links around your hips and provides a steady energy shield with oxygen supply even without a helmet. Contains a suite of defensive capabilities, including an extra energy shell, flares, homing missiles, and a concussive stun pulse

A Tenno spaceflight harness that links around your hips and provides a steady energy shield with oxygen supply even without a helmet. Contains a suite of support capabilities, including a drone swarm to intercept incoming fire, a healing beacon that absorbs incoming bullets, a ward to slow enemies and dispel all status effects, and an ability that converts incoming damage into extra power, energy, and stat boosts

A Tenno spaceflight harness that links around your hips and provides a steady energy shield with oxygen supply even without a helmet. Contains a suite of combat capabilities, including a tether line that either yanks enemies close or grapples you to the hooked surface, a cloaking field that turns you invisible while stationary, a short lived mini-black hole launcher, and a set of drones to fight alongside you.

A Tenno spaceflight harness that links around your hips and provides a steady energy shield with oxygen supply even without a helmet. Contains a suite of offensive capabilities, including a remote detonating missile, a plasma vent that diverts enemy projectiles, a cluster munitions launcher, and a homing nuke.

A high speed drop ship that effectively functions as a mobile command center and small passenger craft. While its range is limited due to its lack of onboard facilities, it's at least useful as a taxi between a home base and an operating field. Works in atmosphere and in space, and largely does not need refueling. It can also deploy an air support module that resets alarms, unlocks doors, and scrambles some automated kill systems.

A rather large, building sized spacecraft that functions as a base of operations, storing a nigh endless amount of resources, weapons, even warframes and spare vehicles. While you only get an empty Orbiter without any of its armaments, it at least flies within the solar system and does not need refueling. It even comes with an onboard friendly AI named Ordis! He's rather chipper, and a bit glitchy though. Comes with one Liset landing craft, plus life support systems including food and other facilities. Also comes with a foundry, pet storage, robotic companion storage, and a bunch of other Tenno-tech specific features.

A Grineer crewship with a complement of one pilot, two gunners, and twenty assorted Grineer soldiers. Its reactor core does not need refueling, though it occasionally needs resupply for ammo and crew. It's capable of warping short distances, flying in orbit, and punishing any nearby flying thing with missiles, guns, and occasionally a ramsled full of soldiers. Requires a Galleon to leave planetary orbit.

A single person flying skiff meant for short distance space or aerial combat. Comes with a pair of guns, an engine that does not need refueling, and a surprisingly intuitive set of flight controls. Be wary, it's not particularly maneuverable, and also it's not very well shielded from any direction except the front. You ride it like a segway, unfortunately.
A single person space fighter belonging to the Grineer empire. Comes with a cryogenic energy disc launcher. Requires a supporting Galleon to go beyond planetary orbit.
A single person space fighter belonging to the Grineer empire. Comes with a standard basic autocannon for strafing. Requires a supporting Galleon to go beyond planetary orbit.
A single person space fighter belonging to the Grineer empire. Comes with an electric homing missile launcher. Requires a supporting Galleon to go beyond planetary orbit.
A single person heavy space fighter belonging to the Grineer empire. Comes with heavy armor and drops explosive mines when in combat. Requires a supporting Galleon to go beyond planetary orbit.
A single person heavy space combat pod belonging to the Grineer empire. Comes with a Demolition Cannon missile launcher and a mining drill. Requires a supporting Galleon to go beyond planetary orbit.

A several kilometer long Grineer spacecraft housing thousands of crewmen, fighters, onboard munitions, cargo, and assorted facilities. Unfortunately, while you get a huge amount of usable cargo (mostly in the form of infantry weapons and raw metals) and fighters, you do not receive a crew. This Galleon is modified to be run by a skeleton crew of no less than six people, and does not require refueling. Can reach other planets in the solar system- quickly when a Solar Rail is present, slowly if not.

An unarmed shuttle with hard points on the outside for Grineer soldiers to latch onto, plus a single pilot's seat. You receive a Firbolg that does not need refueling, as well as seven Grineer Tusk soldiers that are loyal to you and their brothers.

A heavily armed shuttle with a heavy rotary cannon and high density armor. You receive a Bolkor that does not need refueling, as well as twenty Grineer Tusk soldiers that are loyal to you and their brothers.

A Corpus crewship with a complement of one pilot, two gunners, and twenty assorted Corpus crewmen. Its reactor core does not need refueling, though it occasionally needs resupply for ammo and crew. It's capable of warping short distances, flying in orbit, and punishing any nearby flying thing with missiles, guns, and occasionally a ramsled full of crewmen. Requires a Capital Ship to leave planetary orbit.
A single person space fighter belonging to the Corpus faction. Comes with a tracking energy railgun. Requires a supporting Capital Ship to go beyond planetary orbit.
A single person space fighter belonging to the Corpus faction. Comes with a rapid fire plasma cannon. Requires a supporting Capital Ship to go beyond planetary orbit.
A single person space fighter belonging to the Corpus faction. Comes with a homing plasma sphere launcher. Really good at spinning. Requires a supporting Capital Ship to go beyond planetary orbit.

The largest of the Corpus Capital Ships. Several kilometers long, with a crew complement numbering in the thousands. Best used for orbital support and heavy bombardment, with an ejectable front bridge module. Contains torpedos, artillery lasers, full crew and captain facilities, lots of cargo in the form of tech, weapons, and raw material, and zero crew. Modified to not need refueling and capable of being managed by a skeleton crew of six.

The medium sized option of the Corpus Capital Ships. Over a kilometer long, with a crew complement numbering in the low thousands. Best used for orbital conflicts and defensive roles, with a double hull for extra defense. Contains torpedos, artillery lasers, full crew and captain facilities, lots of cargo in the form of tech, weapons, and raw material, and zero crew. Modified to not need refueling and capable of being managed by a skeleton crew of six.

The smallest of the Corpus Capital Ships. About a kilometer long, with a crew complement numbering in the high hundreds. Best used for projecting force and propaganda, with higher speed and maneuverability than the larger options. Contains torpedos, artillery lasers, full crew and captain facilities, lots of cargo in the form of tech, weapons, and raw material, and zero crew. Modified to not need refueling and capable of being managed by a skeleton crew of six.
A heavily armed shuttle with twin laser turrets and high density armor. You receive a Condor that does not need refueling, as well as twenty Corpus crewmen that are loyal to you and their coworkers.

A large, truck-sized monowheel vehicle carrying a complement of three Corpus crewmen, two MOA assault robots, and a Shield Osprey support drone, plus pilot. Does not need refueling. Great for transporting a small group of fighters around a city sized area with lots of open space. Also has built in turrets for defense, and an energy shield.

A single person heavy space combat pod belonging to the Corpus faction. Comes with a heavy multibeam mining laser and explosive launcher. Requires a supporting Capital Ship to go beyond planetary orbit.

An unarmed shuttle with a platform on the outside for Corpus crewmen to stand on, plus a single pilot's seat. You receive a Buzzard that does not need refueling, as well as seven Corpus crewmen that are loyal to you and their coworkers.

A floating hoverboard assembled from scrap, with only barely enough safety features to keep you magnetized to the deck. It's fast, stylish, comes with a really cool picture on the bottom of the board, and allows you to all but fly with the tricks and stunts you can do. Also has a boost mode for faster straight line travel.

Really, it's pronounced "zōng". An ancient type of Chinese sailing ship with a central rudder, flat transom, and a flat bottom. You receive one roughly big enough to serve as a houseboat, in the nearest body of water conducive to holding a houseboat. Comes pre-stocked with a fair amount of dried rations, perfect for a long river journey.
Just a regular scooter propelled by your legs. It's fun. Violently painful to get smacked into your shin, though.
Just a regular pair of in-line roller blades. Good fun, but not that fast.
Just a regular pair of roller skates or "quad skates". Good fun, but not that fast.
Also known as a "Hoverboard". A generic version of the handle-less Segway, it requires no recharging. It still makes you look kinda lame, though.
A Segway, aka a self balancing scooter. The OG Hoverboard- but somehow still less lame than a hoverboard.
A one wheeled electric skateboard, sometimes used by rich millennials to go literally everywhere in unwalkable cities. At least it doesn't need recharging.
Just a regular, normal, no frills skateboard. You get to choose the graphic on the bottom, at least.
Just a regular, generic, high speed road bike like the kind used in the Tour de France. Honestly, kind of a pain in the ass to ride.
Just a very normal, average mountain bike. Good on most terrain, if you know how to ride a mountain bike.
A modified mountain bike with an extended rear strut to make it easier to hop around on the back wheel.
Takumi Fujiwara's car from Initial D. In all respects, just a pretty iconic, well tuned car.
Mazda ɛ̃fini RX-7 Type R FD3S
Keisuke Takahashi's car from Initial D. In all respects, just a pretty iconic, well tuned car.
Ryosuke Takahashi's car from Initial D. In all respects, just a pretty iconic, well tuned car.
Bunta Fujiwara's car from Initial D. In all respects, just a pretty iconic, well tuned car.
Mako Sato's car from Initial D. In all respects, just a pretty iconic, well tuned car.
Shingo Shoji's car from Initial D. In all respects, just a pretty iconic, well tuned car.
Nissan Skyline GT-R V-Spec II Nür BNR34
Kozo Hoshino's car from Initial D. In all respects, just a pretty iconic, well tuned car.
Nissan Skyline GT-R V-Spec II BNR32
Takeshi Nakazato's car from Initial D. In all respects, just a pretty iconic, well tuned car.
Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution V GSR CP9A
Aikawa's car from Initial D. In all respects, just a pretty iconic, well tuned car.
Akio's car from Initial D. In all respects, just a pretty iconic, well tuned car.
Nozomi Kitahara's car from Initial D. In all respects, just a pretty iconic, well tuned car.
Akio's other car from Initial D. In all respects, just a pretty iconic, well tuned car.
Atsuro Kawai's car from Initial D. In all respects, just a pretty iconic, well tuned car.
Daiki Ninomiya's car from Initial D. In all respects, just a pretty iconic, well tuned car.
Eikichi Shimamura's car from Initial D. In all respects, just a pretty iconic, well tuned car.
Toru Suetsugu's car from Initial D. In all respects, just a pretty iconic, well tuned car.
Toru Suetsugu's car from Initial D. In all respects, just a pretty iconic, well tuned car.
Go Hojo's car from Initial D. In all respects, just a pretty iconic, well tuned car.

A living metal artifact capable of fusing with a Chosen One (in this case, you or a compatible ally) and becoming living armor modeled after the being whose data and soul it stores. In this case, you gain the power of Mega Man X, a reploid of unfathomable power and world saving heroism.

A living metal artifact capable of fusing with a Chosen One (in this case, you or a compatible ally) and becoming living armor modeled after the being whose data and soul it stores. In this case, you gain the power of Mega Man Zero, a reploid of immense skill and world saving heroism.

A gear that allows the user to directly set their sanity, or "SEN", to either 0 or 100, in which 0 is full cold hard reality with no delusions, and 100 is fully deluded into the fantasy world being presented. May cause severe hallucinations and madness of multiple kinds.

The Biblical God has taken an interest in the situation at hand, and depending on your piousness and luck, may either send Old Testament style trials at you, or provide a Deus Ex Machina if you pray for salvation. Guaranteed to be actual God, not some shitty Being X or whatever.

Planchaküles are a small, red gremlin-like species with spade-like tails. They have mildly superhuman strength, speed and durability, but are known for their incredibly fast engineering abilities and brilliant minds. They have a weird super speed ability that only works when assembling/disassembling technology within arms length

Galvanic Mechamorphs are a techno-organic species with a gel-like body composed of techno-organic nanites. They are free-form shapeshifters with the ability to absorb, copy, merge with, control, and replicate technology. Growth is highly reliant on the tech levels in world, otherwise just a freeform shapeshifter with no organs.

A short (1.5m), colorful elfin alien species with elephantine feet and large heads. Has the ability to transform after spinning around into freeform shapes (mix and matching), existing creatures (both animals and other sapient species), and animated/inanimate object shapes. They have both magic and supernatural powers, though you must learn them on your own. You don't have any forms by default and must practice to learn more. You at least can speak to all animal life and gain the abilities of any form you shapeshift into. You could match some versions of Superman with enough practice.

Manifest any weapon, vehicle, aircraft, warship, or other military equipment ever designed, produced, or fielded by the United States. Every manifested asset arrives fully operational with inexhaustible fuel, ammunition, and crew, allowing it to function indefinitely without logistical support.

All fire-based attacks used by you and your allies become significantly more destructive, burning hotter, spreading farther, and lingering far longer than normal. The resulting flames are exceptionally difficult to extinguish and inflict greatly increased damage on both their targets and the surrounding environment.
All gatling-type or rapid fire weapons and abilities used by you and your allies fire substantially faster, deal increased damage, generate far less heat, and are significantly more durable.
All vehicles under your control, along with those of your allies, gradually repair themselves over time until they return to full operational condition.
Any structure you own that you wish to conceal gains a passive camouflage effect, blending seamlessly into its surroundings and making it extremely difficult to spot with the naked eye.
Whenever you need or want a convenience store, one will always be conveniently located just around the nearest corner.

You can voluntarily enter a bizarre state of "troll logic," allowing you to make deductions that defy all conventional reasoning yet somehow arrive at the correct conclusion. While in this state, you instinctively understand the thoughts, reasoning, and logic of the insane, eccentric, irrational, or otherwise unconventional-minded, making even the most nonsensical behavior seem perfectly coherent to you.
Random Crits are Fair and Balanced
Every so often, one of your attacks becomes a Random Critical Hit, dealing 3× its maximum normal damage. Significantly more likely to occur with melee attacks than with ranged weapons.
You possess a supernatural sense for anyone in need of medical attention, instinctively knowing who is injured, ill, or in immediate danger. The more critical their condition, the stronger the pull.

You are a master of the art of utter confusion, capable of bewildering even the most disciplined, intelligent, and stoic individuals. Your words, actions, and fighting style are so unpredictably nonsensical that opponents often hesitate, misjudge your intentions, or become completely baffled.
The universe obeys the ancient law of Conservation of Ninjutsu. The more outnumbered you are, the stronger, faster, tougher, and more competent you become.

Upon death, you are resurrected at the exact location where you fell 5 seconds later, returning with full health, mana, and stamina. Once triggered, the Aegis must recharge before it can revive you again.
Gain complete control over cheese and crackers, allowing you to create, manipulate, shape, and animate them at will.
Instantly resets the cooldowns of all your abilities and items, allowing them to be used again immediately. This effect has a 30-minute cooldown before it can be activated again.
Instantly restocks all of your consumables, even the ones that don't have a restock built in. Only usable once a week.

A secretive cult-like paramilitary organization founded by a Russian psychic named Yuri. Hidden from the rest of the world, its three subfactions now exist within your setting, possessing expertise in psychic abilities, mind control, advanced chemistry and biochemical research, magnetic weaponry, biotechnology, cloning, unconventional warfare, and countless other underhanded schemes. You are recognized as the undisputed Supreme Commander of the Epsilon army, and every member will obey your orders with absolute loyalty.

A box containing one of every major Lantern Ring: Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Violet, Indigo, Black, and White. Each ring functions as it normally would, granting its wielder the powers of its respective Emotional Spectrum. Also included is a Universal Power Battery, capable of recharging any Lantern Ring regardless of Corps or color.
Any attack specifically targeting your groin or equivalent vulnerable anatomy is completely negated.
You now have the patience, and training, of a U.S. sniper of no specific branch. Doesn’t make you supernaturally good beyond perfectly remembering the contents of said training.
For each replaced organ, gain a 5% increase in power. Limb replacements increase power by 25%, and a full body replacement increases power by 200% at maximum.

A grab bag containing all of the Terraria herbs and herb seeds. You may plant as many as you want, though they will follow their normal growth cycle and requirements after that, with some slight adjustments to make it possible for you to cultivate them.

Time And Relative Dimension In Space. A living time machine and spacecraft that is vastly bigger on the inside than it appears from the outside. Equipped with a functional Chameleon Circuit, it can disguise itself as virtually any object and travel freely through space, time, and even alternate dimensions. While it is technically designed to be operated by a crew of six trained pilots, the TARDIS is intelligent enough to compensate for an understaffed crew... most of the time.

The Doctor's iconic multipurpose tool, capable of interacting with an astonishing variety of technology, energy systems, locks, computers, sensors, and even certain anomalous phenomena. It can scan, repair, reprogram, disable, and manipulate countless devices with ease, though, true to tradition, it still doesn't work on wood.

You become a genuine Time Lord of Gallifrey, complete with two hearts, an extraordinary intellect, enhanced resilience, and an innate perception of time and space. You gain the full biological benefits of a Time Lord, including regeneration upon fatal injury, along with the many other quirks and advantages that come with being one of the universe's greatest temporal species.

OI, LISTEN UP YA GIT! YOU'Z AN ORK NOW, WIV ALL DA PROPPA ORKY BITZ! YOU'Z BIGGA, TUFFA, STRONGA, GREENA, GOT TWOOFS FER KRUMPIN', AN' A 'EAD FULL O' KUNNIN' OR BRUTAL IDEAZ. YA KNOW 'OW TA BUILD FLASH GUBBINZ WIVOUT KNOWIN' WHY DEY WORK, YA GOT DA WAAAGH! IN YA BLOOD, AN' NOW YA GOT DA BURNIN' URGE TA FIND DA BIGGEST GIT IN DA ROOM AN' KRUMP 'IM!
You are now an Inhuman from Marvel, at least you're not a mutant! Your dormant Inhuman genetics awaken. As a bonus, immediately roll one 3-Star Ability and one 3-Star Passive for free.

An electricity based Robot Master (or in modern terms, Number) with the ability to control, fire, absorb, and dispel electricity. Originally meant to manage the voltage from nuclear power plants, but eventually modified by Dr. Wily to try and take over the world.
A saw blade based Robot Master (or in modern terms, Number) with the ability to generate, fling, and boomerang deadly ceramic titanium saw blades. A Dr. Wily original based off of the old Cut Man.

A hologram based Robot Master (or in modern terms, Number) with the ability to create holographic duplicates and also fire a ricocheting Gemini Laser from his right arm. A collaboration between Dr. Light and Dr. Wily.

A vacuum based Robot Master (or in modern terms, Number) with the ability to inhale any garbage smaller than his vacuum port, compact it, and launch it back out via Dust Crusher. Originally meant for sanitation purposes, but eventually modified by Dr. Wily to try and take over the world.

Its, a bird! It's a plane! No, its Superman! For the purposes of story balance, this is DCAU Superman, so he can actually lose without it being some kind of mega asspull. He's still bullshit strong, though.

The blueprints for a tremendous yellow combat robot made of shape-memory metal that can disperse itself, fly, reassemble, and fire lasers from its red eye. Even when destroyed, the Yellow Devil will reconstitute itself after one month as long as enough alloy and its eye remain. Kinda useless until you actually build the thing, though.

You instantly accelerate toward a chosen target at approximately Mach 10, slamming into them with the full force of the impact. You, as long as you aren't hit by anything else en route, take no damage from that impact, but anything before or after is fair game.
If you have duct tape, Flex Tape, or any kind of construction tape in general, you can repair virtually anything, no matter how damaged or improbable the fix would normally be.

Chill falls off you in waves. Literally. While this is active you exist in the middle of a pulsing blizzard, chilling everything around you and emanating freezing waves every so often. Improves anything that relies on the cold while active.
Wind swirls around you, granting you the ability to hang in the air, jump higher, and move faster in general. Also combos quite nicely with any form of air manipulation.
You can call down lightning strikes anywhere within your perception. Not great underground or in buildings.

Share your vision with the earth itself, allowing you to feel what it feels and know what it knows, including the location of anything buried within. Default range of 10km radius, improved with training.

Extra handy! You can manifest floating hands made entirely of shadow. They're capable of doing anything a hand can do and you can manipulate them as if they were your own hands. Combine them for extra size! Capable of crushing, bludgeoning, blinding, slashing, clawing, binding, holding, grabbing, pulling, tugging, jerking, and other fun things that hands can do.

You are now the proud knower of a curse. The Curse of Blindness can be applied through contact or throwing an ephemeral rune that travels exactly as if you threw a rock. Upon application the curse blocks all forms of sight from the afflicted, rending them entirely blind. It'll wear off over time, faster if the afflicted has magic resistance, can be dispelled, and can be last until disrupted by placing the rune on someone's skin directly.
