Generate an darkened area that abhors the holy and divine. Infernal beings and those affiliated with Darkness are stronger in this area, as are abilities and items aligned with such.
You've grown an Exoskeleton! This chitinous/bone/whatever you've chosen armament shall cover you in a protective layer that also increases your stamina. Scales with your strength.

A type of Kagune that takes the shape of a tail and erupts from the body somewhere around the tailbone area. It has solid speed, offense, defense, and range, but otherwise doesn't have much in the way of special features. Usually you only get one, but with practice and increasing strength you might get more.

This ability allows you to refine a body, removing things such as impurities that would impact their growth, or even outright increase the size of their muscles. Very useful, though the stronger someone is the harder it is to affect them.

Any form of status effect, ailment, or other potentially negative effect can simply be shrugged off. You must be aware of the effect to do this, but you can, in fact, just get over it. The level of things you may shrug off scales with you Moxie and Memetic stats.
GOOOLD! You may now control and manipulate gold freely. You can manipulate more gold, and more finely, with training. No, you can't generate it.

Exactly what it says on the tin- grants the most generic form of super strength when active. Punch through reinforced concrete, throw cars, bend I-beams like rubber. The stronger you are, the stronger this ability gets.

Design, build, and modify anything related to prosthetics- bionic arms, mecha legs, hidden weapons systems inside the prosthetics, cyber eyes, so on and so forth. The more rolls you have, the more inspiration you can draw for this tech tree.

Sharpen any object you touch to a ridiculous degree- sharpen a sword for a monomolecular edge, sharpen a bat for slashing and bludgeoning damage, sharpen the air coming off your hand to launch razor wind blades. If you can touch it, you can sharpen it.

Upon activation, gain complete immunity to all negative mental effects and a huge boost to all instincts at the cost of losing most of your inhibitions and becoming incredibly likely to go on a bloodlust fueled rampage.

Transform into an octopus or octopus hybrid at will. Gain enhanced stats that get further boosted while underwater. Most of your body becomes prehensile and can move on its own instincts and motives. Plus you gain enhanced regeneration, gills, color changing, bonelessness, and any other ability an octopus would possess.

You can use literally anything as a walking surface- light, air, water, space, darkness, enemy attacks, fire, smoke, whatever. It doesn't take away the danger of the attacks, but it means that you can always find a surface to support your body weight no matter how much you carry.

Transform into a drake or drake hybrid at will. You gain firebreathing, armored scales, claws and fangs, and the imposing nature of a lesser dragon. Sadly, as a lesser dragon, you don't get access to the really good magic or powers.

Take a glimpse of the near future within a few seconds to hours. The future you see isn't guaranteed, but is very likely to happen. The more you train the ability, the further you can see. The more knowledge you have on a situation, the more accurate the reading becomes. Glimpses of the future may be misleading due to their short nature.
Weaken all effects and abilities by contact either with the caster or the thing in question. The weaker an ability is in relation to you, the less time it takes before it's completely nullified

Summon or create lesser air and sky elementals using your own energy. They can take the form of sprites, living clouds, miniature storms, etc etc. Each one can use D rank or lower magic and similar effects. The power of the elementals depends on your own energy levels and power. The elementals vanish the moment you stop supplying energy, though with practice you can form elementals with set durations or even permanent summons. Summoned elementals are not considered Familiars.

The signature ability of Kitsune. Shape, summon, and wield ghostly Foxfire that lingers far longer than any mundane flame, and can be shaped to form disguises, illusions, traps, and lures. Foxfire deals extra damage to souls and spirits.

Overclock any technology by imbuing it with your energy and force it to perform far beyond its physical and programmed limits at the cost of speeding up deterioration and potentially causing catastrophic failure. The more energy poured in, the stronger the effect and the more damage builds up.

Anything you build has a number of redundancies built in nearly automatically, allowing it to keep functioning even in dire circumstances. Even the most fragile piece of technology that you build can still function in some capacity even after being broken in half, dunked in water, set on fire, and had half its circuits ripped out. Less of a tech tree, more of an addition to your existing tech trees.

Consume poisons to grant massive boosts to your physical stats, awareness, alertness, and pain resistance, at the cost of literally consuming poison (with reduced effects so you don't instantly die). The more dangerous the substance, the stronger the boost. Different poisons may grant different buffs if you consume enough to start discerning the differences.

Summon a rain storm of burning, flesh melting acid that can eat through steel. The storm, while active, amplifies all poison and corrosion based effects within its range. The range and potency of the storm depend on energy expended and your own magic stats

A Branch of Sin that allows you to spend blood and vitality in order to create highly durable blood armor over your body and both protect yourself and enhance physical attacks. The more blood you condense, the stronger the armor.
When activated, boost the potency and efficiency of all fire and heat based effects, spells, and abilities for yourself and allies.

A chimera of a lion, a scorpion, and a bat. They're massive, dangerous, fully capable of killing a whale with the venom from their tails, flight capable, and a threat even to heroes ordained by gods. This manticore is also capable of asexual reproduction via egg laying.

An ancient sword and shield combo that comes with its own sheath. Aegislash is strong, fast, smart, and fully capable of wielding a spectrum of ghostly and steel-based attacks. You, as its wielder, can use both sword and shield without getting your soul ripped out.

An immortal human dressed as a shrine maiden with great command over teleportation gates and magic. Should enemies attempt to utilize the gates she commands, she can easily divert their course or subject them to a fate most foul. She seems to think you're some kind of "Great One", and will follow your orders as long as you live up to that image. Quite possibly the most sane member of the Pleiades, and their hidden leader.

A largely human looking dullahan dressed as a head maid and a master of hand to hand combat. She's both a capable servant and deadly fighter, and is fully capable of breaking through diamond hard walls with a single strike. She seems to think you're some kind of "Great One", and will follow your orders as long as you live up to that image. She is the vice leader of the Pleiades Seven Sisters group of battle maids.

A normally human looking werewolf battle maid who serves as a high level battle cleric with high levels of healing magic. She also possesses great strength, speed, and martial skill due to her racial abilities, and is no slouch with melee weapons. She seems to think you're some kind of "Great One", and will follow your orders as long as you live up to that image. She is a loyal member of the Pleiades Seven Sisters battle maid group

A completely human looking doppelganger dressed as an armored battle maid. She is competent in both higher level magics and physical fighting, with a specialization in spellcasting over weaponry. She seems to think you're some kind of "Great One", and will follow your orders as long as you live up to that image. She is a loyal member of the Pleiades Seven Sisters battle maid group.

An almost entirely human looking automaton dressed as a military tactical battle maid, with high skill in gun based combat and. She makes for a great assassin and sniper, and is no slouch in hand to hand either due to her mechanical body. She seems to think you're some kind of "Great One", and will follow your orders as long as you live up to that image. She is a loyal member of the Pleiades Seven Sisters battle maid group

An extremely buxom battle maid who's actually a man eating, amoral slime capable of easily dissolving human bodies in an instant, and destroying fairly high level magical items and objects with similar speed. She can control her acidity, thankfully. She is also well versed in a variety of assassin skills, but she's a bit less powerful in a straight fight even with her innate strength. She seems to think you're some kind of "Great One", and will follow your orders as long as you live up to that image. She is a loyal member of the Pleiades Seven Sisters battle maid group

A level 51 Insect Master Arachnoid monster disguised as a cutesy maid girl. She speaks using stolen vocal cords, utilizes a variety of monstrous and magical insects in a fight, and is actually a terrifying monster bug that loves eating human flesh and feeding corpses to her bugs. She seems to think you're some kind of "Great One", and will follow your orders as long as you live up to that image. She's one of the Pleiades Seven Sisters group of battle maids.

An 800 year old kitsune who still looks a bit like a very cute child in a miko outfit, she came down from Kitsune heaven to remove darkness from your life and pamper you as if she was a very loving mother. She still acts like an 800 year old grandma, funnily enough. She is also, not-so-secretly, a kami of agriculture.

You gain access to the entire goons, mooks, and hoods roster of the Glasshearts Gang- a whole bunch of largely identical looking rough and tumble 1930s gangsters either in flat caps and turtlenecks or dressed up slightly fancier in suits. Some of them have knives, some of them have guns, some fight with fists and thrown bricks. They're not very smart, but they're great for grunt work, shaking people down, holding territory at a street level, and can be freely summoned and dismissed at will. You receive the ability to summon 100 at once, increasing as your stats go up.

A gromflomite assassin who just really loves killing. He's highly skilled in all manner of infiltration and murder skills, is a master of many forms of weapons, tech, and vehicles, and is in general a very personable guy who really, really likes killing. A lot. He has no morals or standards and will kill literally anyone or anything for money.

A large green crystal mass attached to flowering roots, now in handy dandy pendant form for easier carrying. It enhances the effects of all healing sources while in use, makes grappling and tethering effects faster, and may spawn flowers that, if touched, will explode into pollen that increases healing speed even further.
A gold ring with an iridescent purple rectangular gem. Boosts defense against all elemental attacks and magics. Roll this again to upgrade the ring, up to two times.

A large, mysterious pond forms near you. Any fish you place into the pond will mysteriously have another fish of the same type show up the next day. Any fish may be released into the pond regardless of if they live in salt or freshwater. They will coexist for the most part, as long as they're fed. Make sure to cull the population often, otherwise the pond may overflow due to exponential growth.
A cloak once worn by Arsène Lupin. Increases maneuverability and evasion by a significant amount. Also makes it harder to catch you in general. Great for thieves.
An exploding flaming flail found deep in the Underworld that may set its targets on fire. While it is powerful, it's also not particularly fast due to its weight.

A 500ml glass vial of holy water that can be used in divine rituals, or splashed on dark aligned, evil, or unholy beings to severely burn them or even kill outright if they don't have enough resistance.

A kit that allows you to grow your own golems. Comes with a 12 pack of golem cores, a watering can, a notebook full of requisition slips, an instruction manual, and a bag of magical fertilizer. Also contains an optional comically large pot. Plant the cores in a sunny spot, fertilize and water them, choose what attributes you want your golem to have on the requisition slip, plant the slip, and within 7 days of care and attention, a fully grown golem will sprout. If you leave them to grow, they will produce more cores ready for planting.
A headband with cutesy devil horns on it. Boosts all dark, infernal and generally unholy or evil aligned abilities, spells, powers, and effects of the wearer.

An ornate fountain forms near you, granting anyone who bathes within its waters their youth and vitality. Every hour in the bath reverses your biological clock by about a decade, washing away old wounds and hurts in the process. Best use this token in a secure location.

A hammer that honestly looks more like a hunk of concrete on a stick than anything else, due to having broken after destroying the Elden Ring. When channeling energy, allows you to leap up high, imbue the hammer with light, and smash down onto the ground with devastating impact.

A satchel marked with a healer's symbol, containing everything that you could possibly buy at a normal, modern pharmacy. This includes medical supplies, first aid supplies, over the counter medicines, and all of the random stuff inside said pharmacy. Yes, that includes Redbull, school supplies, laundry detergent, pet supplies, toothpaste, and during appropriate times of year, holiday decorations. And more. There's a LOT of stuff in this thing.

A green, baseball sized glass-like sphere containing powerful spatial energies. Teleports the user to where it lands when thrown. May cause some damage due to the violent and rapid nature of the teleport.

A simple green ring that keeps you sustained as long as it's worn. No matter what dietary requirements one has, as long as they wear the ring, it is as if they're feeding with optimal nutrition at the pace that's best for their body.

An ornate key that can open a doorway into a 125 cubic km volume pocket dimension containing a harsh, violent desert with very little water. Can be used anywhere there's enough space for a doorway sized portal. The inner portal remains open as long as you or your allies remain in the desert. Only beings with potent spatial abilities can break in.

The Zanpakuto Shinso, plus the ability to release its Shikai form. It takes the form of a wakizashi and, when the command phrase "Shoot to kill, Shinso!" is uttered, allows the blade to shoot out at incredibly high speed with incredibly far range. Also grants a trickle of Reiatsu so you can use it and bond properly. The more you train, the stronger it gets. May eventually be evolved to its Bankai form, which improves all aspects and makes the dust created when the blade changes sides extremely poisonous.

A Teigu taking the form of a microphone. Amplifies the user's voice into ultrasonic waves capable of pulverizing bones or even cause enemies to hallucinate and become disoriented. Its output can, thankfully, be controlled.

A Teigu taking the form of a giant pair of scissors. It can cut through just about anything, though the more durable the material the more resistance there will be. It's also extremely durable and can be used for both offense and defense. Can also emit a blinding flash of light as a trump card.

You're a good enough mechanic that you can repair just about any mundane technology you have in front of you, you could even build a car from scratch if you wanted. You can also build and design technology faster than should be possible without sacrificing build quality.
You're a damn good teacher, to the point that you could teach anyone literally any of your C rank or below skills as long as they're physically capable of it.
You're good enough with blunt weapons that you seem to hit with supernatural strength and skill, to the point that even masters have a hard time fighting you.

You have a fair level of expertise in all blue collar or artisanal trades, though you're by no means a master. Does not extend to combat skills. You could get an entry level job in any trade, basically.

You're a good enough performer and entertainer that you could draw a damn good crowd, gain international fame, take any acting role and absolutely kill it, play any instrument with great skill, and earn riches on performance alone.

You're a senior artist in just about every artistic field- drawing, painting, engraving, etc. If this were historical times, you could get hired to paint the Sistine Chapel. You're basically Michaelangelo but more.

You have increased resistance against all water based attacks and effects, allowing you to withstand high pressure, water cannons, water cutters, drowning, so on and so forth. Doesn't make you immune, just makes it easier to push through. Scales with stats.
You're far more aware of your surroundings and self. It's pretty damn hard to sneak up on you, and you always know what's wrong with your body.

Nature favors you. It's far easier to forage for food in the wild, grow a garden, take care of animals, so on and so forth. When in wild or untouched areas, your energy recovers faster. Yes, this includes more than just forests. Deserts are natural too.

You have far more energy and recover that energy with unheard of speeds, allowing you to use spells and abilities with higher power and for far longer. With efficient enough spells, you might be able to cast basically forever.

It's far easier for anyone serving under you to have a favorable opinion of you, and it's easier to earn their affection. May or may not subtly make you act more likable in that regard. Works on animals, hired staff, familiars, sentient constructs, and generally submissive people.

People in positions of power find your lack of decorum and your crass boldness charming instead of highly offensive. You can get away with more shit, and also attract people in high positions far more easily.

You are blessed by the goddess of the Hearth, allowing higher resistance to mental and physical status effects. You're healthier, and people will naturally consider you to be more comforting and homey

You're very, very good at multitasking, you can divide your attention across as many tasks as you're physically able to do at once without decreasing efficiency. The more tasks you pile up, though, the harder that becomes.
You're a great learner and student. Your teachers like you more, and you learn both more easily and far more quickly when receiving personal instruction from someone with higher skill levels.

You're an esper of high talent, granting you increased efficiency and strength with all psychic abilities or anything related to extrasensory perception. You don't get a specific esper power, though. You just master all your powers faster.

Unstable, crazy, dangerous, insane, mentally unwell, and otherwise abnormal people like you a lot more, for better or for worse. Sometimes you can fix them, sometimes you can't. At least it's easier to reason with them now.
When defending any area you own, have claim over, or have pledged yourself to, you gain a boost to all physical stats and use less energy in combat. Extends to all allies in the area.
Gain fairly high level flame control and generation, allowing you to make blasts, bolts, whips, arrows, walls, blades, etc out of fire.

Your sweat is now an explosive compound almost like nitroglycerin. Your body adapts to handle the explosive power of your sweat, though too much force will overcome that resistance. The only place you can detonate said sweat is on your hands, though you at least have a high degree of control over how it detonates. Can be used for general explosions, high power detonations, armor piercing, flashbangs, flight, cluster munitions, etc. May require specialized equipment for some applications.

Create and control ink the same way one might use water. With training, you could create hardened ink constructs, whips, walls, blades, duplicates, even different types and colors of ink ranging from cosmetic changes to toxic pigments.
Manifest and control powerful air jets, air currents, and wind blasts. A very simple ability, given that all of its attacks move in straight lines.

Channel and discharge extremely high voltage electricity. With some practice, you can even choose where the electricity goes and be more than a human taser. Though, overuse might fry your brain for a bit.
Assign a magnetic polarity to any object you touch, making opposite polarities attract and same polarities repel. The more energy used, the stronger the force applied

Create and launch metal projectiles at supersonic velocities, mostly in the form of the various calibers of bullet. The more energy you expend, the stronger the impact and caliber. With training you might be able to start making specialist or novelty ammo like dragon's breath and incendiary rounds.
Call down the light of Heaven to buff the physical stats, mental resistance, vigor, and courage of all friendly units touched by its rays. The more energy you spend, the stronger the effect.

Create a spotlight to shine down on any target you choose, forcing them to speak the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth when questioned. The user is immune to the effect. The stronger the target, more they can resist the effect.

A type of Kagune that takes the shape of a pair of feathered wings and erupts from the body around one's shoulder blades. They are lightweight, fast, highly deadly, and great at high speed attacks via launching "feathers" like blades. With enough training you might be able to fire lightning bolts from your Ukaku.
Shout a rallying cry that bolsters all allies and yourself, granting courage and renewed motivation strong enough to turn even cowering civilians into mighty warriors.

Remotely steal the most valuable item on a person's body as long as they're within roughly 10 meters of your position and the item is not physically or magically tied to their body. The more valuable the item, the more energy it takes to steal, especially if it's magical. May or may not grab underwear more often than it should.

Heal others of their ailments and negative status effects via sexual intimacy. Can wipe away scars, old wounds, genetic conditions, and general diseases. The more intimate you are, the greater the healing. Does not work on immediately dangerous wounds. You cannot fuck a gaping axe wound out of someone's chest, sadly.
Automatically regenerate all of your energy or magic reserves or other applicable energy source, at the cost of your physical stamina.

Assess and reinforce the structure of any item you touch, turning even a simple wooden bat into a club worthy of a mythological hero. The more energy used, the stronger the reinforcement. Overcharging reinforcement may break an item. Also works on your own body.

The more danger you're in, the stronger your physical stats and abilities, scaling to the threat you're facing and increasing the more danger you're physically in. In general, it will always augment your stats enough to have a fighting chance of surviving or winning, but it does not guarantee winning in any shape or form.

You can turn into, or manifest the tendrils of, a hentai-style tentacle monster. This enables you to either become a writhing ball of tentacles, or latch onto walls or the inside of a cave or pit. You gain all sorts of tendrils- phallic ones, ones with eyes, ones with needles, ones with suction cups, ones with ridges, ones with bumps, ones with mouths, so on and so forth. Also comes with a variety of secretions from semen to aphrodisiacs to body modification drugs to general lubrication to clothes melting, etc etc.

Summon both real and projected skeletal arms, limbs, or other bones from the ground near you, allowing you to grab with hands, impale with ribs, defend with femurs, so on and so forth. Bone size and durability depends on energy spent.
When activated, boost the potency and efficiency of all water and ice based effects, spells, and abilities for yourself and allies.

A massive ccloud elemental usually found high in space during rain storms. It can throw tornadoes, summon cloud minions, create lightning clouds, teleport, and fly. It also looks kind of like a giant armored woman.

The once proud Silver Knights of Gwyn, now become disembodied spirits with charred black armor. They are tall, dangerous, powerful, skilled, and specialize in hunting demons and infernal beings. Start with 10 knights, with more summonable over time, each one wielding a random weapon within the Black Knight set.

An event has been summoned! Within half an hour's travel is a person wielding a briefcase containing a 3 Star Gacha token guaranteed to roll something you've been wanting from that tier. If you kill the token carrier within an hour of them appearing, you gain that token. If you fail, they leave and you get a consolation voucher for 50% off your next meal at the nearest restaurant of your choice. The carrier must die, you cannot revive them or dispatch them in any other way.

A massive mammoth-like monster larger than a siege engine and far more deadly. It bears the ability to coat its legs and trunk in ice for devastating attacks, as well as fling massive snowballs to disorient, knock down, or crush foes. It is said to be capable of causing blizzards and avalanches from sheer strength alone.

A set of six standard pokeballs capable of capturing magical creatures and housing them in an energy form for easy storage. Any creature you catch is registered as a Familiar under the gacha system. You may only have six active creatures at once, all others may be put into inventory storage until swapped out- however, you can keep more around as long as they stay out of the pokeballs. It's easier to catch creatures if you defeat them in combat or gain their trust.

An invaluable tool for any Pokemon Trainer, this tool can scan any Pokemon and tell you a bit of mythology, its abilities, and statistics. It has reduced effectiveness on non-Pokemon Targets, but can still provide information on them, and even display their health.

A book containing information on every species of monster girl both within the world of Monster Girl Encyclopedia and beyond. Its primary purpose is to turn any sentient "monster" it touches into an appropriately themed monster girl of its same type. Does not alter their strength or abilities in any way, and the target always feels that they have always been the way they are now. It's effectively just for aesthetics. Usually transforms monsters into a form that is attractive to the user, though if it's too young, you just get a regular child form.

A Purely defensive stand, you become impervious to all phenomena as long as you are kneeling, this includes explosives, fire, or any other form of energy. The downside is that you can only use this while kneeling, and if you are trapped, you'll need to make the choice whether to leave this Stand active and leave yourself to slowly stop thinking, or deactivate it and run the risk of death.

Achtung Baby is an invisible stand that grants its user the power of Invisibility. This doesn't preclude you from being found or displacing things, but you can render things around you invisible as a trap or as a way to disguise yourself. It has plenty of potential, but discovering that potential is up to you.

A battle oriented stand, Aerosmith possesses a wide variety of powerful weapons, in a very small package that makes it difficult to hide. Also equipped with a radar that detects carbon dioxide, this stand makes up for its lack of precision with overwhelming firepower. It is also the size of an RC plane.

A Userless Stand that can be wielded by anyone, Anubis relishes combat and will actively memorize the abilities of opponents that it faces, taking their techniques as its own. It can be very fickle, but also encourages its wielders to push further, telling them they are the greatest swordsman in the world. Anubis can also choose what it cuts, allowing its blade to pass through anything it doesn't want to cut.
A Stand made completely of water. It can disguise itself as any liquid and, should it enter a person's body, possess them.

A dark Polaroid camera. You may enter any picture taken by the camera and manipulate everything inside as if it were entirely real. Make calls from phone in the picture or search the web. Any damage done to anything within the picture will be reflected on that thing outside of the picture. Be careful- the camera always exists and anyone can use it to take pictures.

A soul-stealing Stand. When someone admits or recognizes defeat against the user, this Stand may steal their soul. Additionally, it has the power to read the souls of others, detemining whether they are telling the truth or not.

This Stand has perfect control over Vectors, and can use all directions to manipulate them. A single upwards arrow can launch something into the air, or remove substances from the body. Multiple arrows will increase the force that the Vectors exert, allowing for more widespread usage.

Baby Face is an automatic Stand taking the form of a computor with very little combat capability. As a tradeoff, it can create secondary Stands for the user to wield against their enemies by 'Impregnating' a suitable target. The target is not actually violated, but their body is used as a template to create 'Junior' the secondary Stand of Baby Face. Junior can manipulate vacuums that can break an enemy appart without killing them, and break itself apart in a similar process.

A Stand in the form of a miniaturized army of 60 soldiers, 4 helicopters, and 7 tanks. Each soldier is armed with a rifle, a combat knife, and a parachute, and can lay down landmines for traps. The helicopters have missiles and cannons, and the tanks can fire shells. Despite being miniaturized, Bad Company is still lethal in a fight, though if the user is knocked out all forces and projectiles will disappear.

This Stand is a visualization of a concept known as "Spin", the rotational force of the universe. It's full capabilities are unknown, but it can go through dimensional barriers, age anything it's targeting to dust, and even create Miracles.

A Stand that resembles a standard, if ornate, electrical outlet. When placed on a surface, it can magnetize any target that touches it via moderate electrical shock. The magnetization only grows stronger over time, starting with small objects and moving up to attracting even entire cars towards the target at high speed. It has no direct combat advantage. You must stay near a target for the magnetization to not wear off. After a certain point, even a handful of screws can turn into lethal bullets.

A Stand that takes the appearance of a Fishing Rod, Beach Boy is a remarkably deadly long range stand, able to fly through walls until it hits its target. It can hook on to an enemy and reflect any damage the line takes back at whoever has been hooked, and if the hook strikes a vital organ, it can immediately be reeled back to rip that open. It might have other uses that require the user to find.

An automated Stand that follows its orders to the letter, thus not having its own personality beyond the orders its given, Black Sabbath's main ability is to draw power from shadows. Inside of a shadow, Black Sabbath is incredibly powerful, able to overpower many Stands by itself. In the light however, it is basically useless. Being partially exposed to Sunlight will damage it considerably, and it must escape to another shadow as quickly as possible. Does not transfer damage to the user. It can also pull out someone's Soul, or store objects inside of itself.

Blue Hawaii is not a combat oriented Stand. Despite this, it is still an incredibly dangerous Stand, able to completely control someone if they've come into contact with even a piece of the user's body. This person will be rendered into a Zombie-like state, and will relentlessly perform the specific instruction given to them, such as pursuing a target. That person also becomes a catalyst to spread the 'infection', spreading the Stand using their own body as well. It's main weakness is that its zombies can only move in a linear path, and cannot climb or avoid obstacles.

A Stand with no shape that affects the entire world by having fictional characters come to life from any media containing their image, causing them to disappear entirely from all other media with that image. The manifested character will act as they would within their story, but can also take advantage of the medium they came from to avoid attacks. It's entirely indiscriminate, though, so if someone creates a character to stop its effect, it will bring that to life as well. Destroyed characters will not reappear in their source. It can also force people to live out fictional stories and take certain character roles, including ones that lead to their death.

A shoebill-like Stand with the ability to attach tiny bombs to anything the user touches. Each bomb takes the form of a small pin with a clock for a head. They can be placed on literally anything- solid objects, water, animals, people, the user's skin, smoke, dirt, etc. The highly sensitive pins explode when they spring into the air, and the Stand itself can move fast enough and drop enough bombs to attach a pin to every bee in a swarm.

Born This Way is an automatic stand defined by a constantly activated power, independant from its user, and is unusual in the fact it rides a motorcycle. Equipped with a helmet and motorcycle gear, it is more durable than most stands, and the bike itself is durable enough to withstand most impacts or attacks from other high strength Stands. It can be connected to someone through that person opening any doorway, appearing in front of them immediately. It also has the ability to conjure freezing cold gusts of wind powerful enough to throw people and objects around, and is cold enough to freeze a person's eyes, or create snow.

A Stand taking the shape of an armored humanoid figure with no lower body aside from a wispy cloud. Its ability is to steal the energy of anyone who loses to the user at rock paper scissors in a best of five. A draw nulls the round. Every win takes a third of the opponent's energy, If the opponent wins three times, they regain their energy entirely. Unfortunately, people are, in fact, allowed to cheat- however, if the user wins three times, the user can steal the primary ability of their opponent forever.

A Stand made of a swarm of tiny little cuboid burrs. Its ability is to melt the flesh of anyone touching its components by causing hemolysis and tunneling through the body indiscriminately. If they have not yet dug in, though, they're easily washed away with water.

A Stand with no form that allows the user to see, touch, and use the ghosts of objects and rooms that have been destroyed. Weapons and food harmlessly pass through people, though objects can still be picked up and interacted with- a ghost computer can still do research. Ghost objects may be stored in any container regardless of size.

The evolved form of Whitesnake. It's quite curt and polite. Its ability is to manipulate gravity around the user such that their position defines which way objects fall away from them in a radius of 3km. It can also manipulate gravity of specific objects, even going so far as to turn them inside out. It has a weak ability to accelerate time, though only things that come near the user are affected.

California King Bed allows it to steal memories under certain conditions, rules set by the user. While fairly harmless, it can be used to great effect against people with no memories, or issues with their own cognition. Most memories are mundane, but those with few memories will have their entire life ripped away.

Chariot Requiem is a living Stand that seems to display no combat capability, but is one of the most dangerous stands ever seen. It has the ability to completely alter Life and the Soul, and will do so to follow the order given to it. The only way to defeat this Stand is to discover what its Shadow means.

Just... the worst. A sentient little gremlin Stand whose only ability is to make the user desperately afraid of other people seeing their back. If someone sees the user's back, Cheap Trick jumps to that person instead, taking a huge rectangular chunk of the user's back with it and killing them from the injury. Cheap Trick also provokes the user and others around them to try and achieve this goal. Nasty little asshole bastard. More of a curse, really, but if you have regeneration you can pass it to someone you hate just to be a dick.

A vambrace that generates a grid around the user, allowing them to transport projectiles, objects, and people between the grid squares by pressing the buttons on the vambrace. In all other respects, it's useless in a close range fight.

A feminine robotic Stand with no lower body. Its abilities are solely focused around cosmetic work, and allow you to replace the body parts of people with enhanced or more aesthetically pleasing versions after picking the right shape via computer program. The effects are temporary and only last 30 minutes, but with the right changes to phyisognomy it can tug at the strings of fate to affect someone's love life. It can also permanently swap features, but the target must apply a special lipstick every half hour for 24 hours except when sleeping. It can also take parts from one person and graft them to another permanently without lipstick.

A vaguely cowboy-like robotic Stand. It manifests objects or people that its target has left behind, given up, or felt guilty about. The manifestations can come from anywhere and, on contact with a target, cause them to remember how and why they feel guilt in the first place while engulfing them in a membrane that slowly crushes them. Anyone killed in its range may be resurrected if the killer feels guilt, and is then invulnerable to the killer's attacks. Water washes away the effects of this Stand in a form of purification.

A Long Distance Stand, Clash is fragile, but very skilled at deadly ambushes. It can appear inside of any mass of liquid, and its size will shift appropriately based on the size of said liquid. It is also a fish, and that means it requires water on a regular basis. It cannot teleport into sealed bodies of liquid, or more then two to three meters from its current position at any given time.

A powerful humanoid Stand with a definite heart theme. Its ability is to heal, or rather restore damage done to an object or person. While it can't fix death, spatial erasure, or sickness, it can manipulate the things it restores to change their shape, fuse one thing with another thing, use its restoration as a grappling hook or projectile, or trap enemies inside containers. Its ability does not work on its own user.

An incredibly destructive Stand capable of eating its own body to produce a void portal sphere that cuts through literally everything. While the user may hide within the dimension inside of Cream's mouth, utilizing the entire void sphere prevents you from seeing anything outside of it, so targeting becomes difficult. As a void, the sphere is nearly indetectible, only seen by the trails it carves onto anything it touches.

A Stand in the form of a spray can that dispenses liquid flesh that hardens into solid consistency over time. It can be used to heal, block orifices, decompose bodies on contact, push out foreign objects, create perfect flesh masks for disguises, inject drugs or other chemicals, or add the user's flesh to someone else's body to manipulate them from the inside in various ways. The user can transform their entire body into fuel for the spray, allowing them to move in liquid form though they still feel pain.

A phenomenon more than a Stand, formed as a wall of light surrounding the user's body that deflects any and all misfortune away from them and onto somewhere else on Earth. Even open wounds can be redirected elsewhere. The light forms effectively a pocket dimension, allowing the user to move around freely, as well as draw in all neutral objects from trees to oceans to the land itself. The only thing that can break through the wall is the power of the infinite.

A blue, fish-like humanoid Stand boasting solid range, and the ability to fight even better in water. Its side property grants you an incredible six minutes and twelve seconds of lung capacity for underwater fighting. It can also create whirlpools by swiping its arms or legs hard enough, summon strength sapping acorn barnacles, and use its own scales as razor sharp projectiles.

A Stand that resembles both a clown and a reaper, its only ability is to manipulate the dreams of nearby beings with impunity, with anything it does in the dreams being reflected in real life- injuries, deaths, even healing wounds. None under its influence can wake normally, but they can be woken by others. You can shape the dream world to your will.

A rabbit-like Stand with massive ears. Its ability is to travel between alternate realities via being pressed between two objects- water, dust, doors, flags, etc. The user may emerge from just about any position in that alternate reality and draw others in- either entirely or partially, with the exception of certain dimensionally distorted effects. Should two identical objects from parallel universes come in contact, they will destructively annihilate into Menger sponges, the sole exception being the user. D4C may be passed to alternate versions of the same user in order to continue the original's goal, will, and mind.

A Stand resembling a person in a diving suit. Its ability is to store its strikes inside of any surface to be released later. It can also be used to defend someone by hiding in their body and absorbing the force of attacks. Its second ability is to enter any solid and freely change their insides to either destroy them or piece them together, even grafting new items into a person's body or fully removing things that should be impossible to take out.

A Stand that manifests as the ability to turn oneself into gravel or even dust to float around in the wind. Anyone who inhales the dust will have an allergic reaction, and can be controlled via the user possessing their bones, ligaments, and tendons. The user can even utilize some of the victim's abilities while possessing them.

Doggy Style has the ability to peel the user's body like an apple, allowing one to change their body into wires that can be manipulated. The primary usage of this allows the user to form weapons, or send these wires fast enough to cut through trees or even buildings. The user can even entirely unwind their body to escape death. The rotational ability could be developed further.

A Stand inside of a tornado. Its ability is to manifest a tornado to pursue its target at long range. The tornado manifests from the target's exhalation and chases them until it shreds them apart while continuously growing from the target breathing out. It's capable of pursuing multiple targets at once.

A dragon-like compass Stand that discerns lucky spots via Feng Shui, and is largely neutral during a fight no matter what. Anything that attacks it while divining Feng Shui will have their own body part "disappear" on contact before showing up to attack their unlucky spot and conspires to injure them even if the attack is blocked. While its divinations are neutral and can be used by anyone, it grants you advanced Feng Shui knowledge that you can use in combat.

Not so much a Stand as it is an incredibly potent shapeshifting ability, allowing you to take the form of anything that does not require greater energy than what your body possesses, along with the properties of that object. You could turn into a pair of dice, sneakers, other people, create ice cream, etc etc. If someone wears your transformed body, you can also add your strength to theirs for a combined boost.

A Stand resembling a bronze figure from an ancient civilization, its primary purpose is to bind to a doll and work remotely with the tools and weapons in its area. It is fueled by hatred anger towards its intended victims, and thus gains strength and speed the more anger you feel. The doll isn't particularly strong, sadly, so you need to feel a lot of resentment to make it strong.

A green, turtle-like Stand first resembling an egg. It has the unique property of having three Acts, each granting a different power over sound. Act 1 allows the user to paint a sound or phrase on a target and have it repeat endlessly at high volume. Act 2 allows the formation of onomatopoiea to form effects like heat from "Sizzle" or wind from "Fwoosh". Act 3 seemingly only has the ability to increase gravity on a target on contact, drastically increasing weight and immobilizing it via "Three Freeze". Act 3 also swears a lot. S H I T

A very impractical but cool looking revolver. Still not visible to normal humans due to being a Stand. It fires bullets that you can directly control the trajectory of with almost no limitations. It has a surprisingly high range for manipulating its shots, though not much further away in radius than the normal range of a gun.

A parasitic Stand that must be placed on a target to work. It grows slowly as a tumor by consuming nearby nutrients, gradually taking a more humanoid form capable of speaking, being seen and heard by ordinary humans, and even using tools. It also grants the ability to disguise oneself by assimilating and hiding in the skin of another person. It's a very sadistic ability

A purple humanoid Stand covered in pinkish markings and swirls. Its ability is to turn any object into paper, including the user and other people. However, to turn a person into paper, the user must discover the habit that the target shows when afraid with 100% certainty. There are otherwise no real limits to what you can turn into paper- fire, guns, taxi cabs, shredders, etc.

A Stand made of a colony of plankton inhabiting the corpse of a dead girl. Her ability allows her to be largely unkillable as long as the colony itself survives, though the body she inhabits may be destroyed. Additionally the Stand itself may infiltrate other bodies to control them and gain their memories, at which point it has roughly full control over the body and its shape. She needs water to survive, though parasitism allows her to reduce that intake. Being in a host reduces her utility massively, but lets her blend in easily.

A Stand resembling a jellyfish and a lemon juicer. Its ability is to puppet the bodies of any target that the user stands directly above via their wounds- the more wounds accumulate, the stronger the control until all four limbs are in the user's possession.

A Stand made of water, it's capable of being used from kilometers away and is fully capable of decapitating grown men, shooting through flesh and metal, and defend against projectiles. The more water is available, the stronger Geb becomes. You also gain the ability to sense people's movements for kilometers around via the vibrations in the earth, as a secondary. It's weak to fire, and evaporation will be reflected as damage to your own body.

A close range stand with a max effective range of two meters from you, Gold Experience is fast, and has control over the manipulation of Life. Reflecing damage, creating pieces to replace damaged parts of the body, creating clones, and even heightening the senses of someone's body or detecting life itself. Strong enough to punch through a car or a motorcycle, but it won't be winning any strength awards. Creativity is the key.
Return to Zero. Gold Experience Requiem has all of the abilities of Gold Experience, but also gained the power to prevent any action. Including the action of Death. It does not, in fact, just work.

A gremlin-looking Stand with a feral personality and the ability to shrink anyone within its range, as long as the user feels like they want the victim's subservience. The change is near instantaneous, and can shrink a person down to the size of a mouse. Anyone who leaves the Stand's range will slowly begin to grow back to normal size, or instantly if the effect is dispelled.

Green Day is an overwhelmingly deadly stand that has the power to produce an incredibly potent mold. It rots and destroys the flesh of those that it infects once they drop below a certain altitude, with the only way to stop this being to continue upwards or not move at all. It can only target living things however. The user can also implant the mold in their own body, allowing them to survive dismemberment and put themselves back together.

A humanoid Stand with turbines on its head. It is an automatic Stand that protects its user by shrinking any perceived threat that approaches them. Starting at a certain distance, halving the distance halves the enemy's height, and should they get close enough the Stand itself will manifest and attack. If a victim gets close enough to the user, they will become infinitely small and vanish. If the user becomes interested in something and goes to touch it, it returns to normal size.

A Stand resembling a desiccated mummy with the ability to produce blades from its wrists to stab and slash its targets. It exists almost solely within reflective surfaces, and can attack reflections to kill the reflected subject. Should the reflection be covered or otherwise be destroyed, Hanged Man must jump from that surface to the nearest reflective surface. While traveling, it is vulnerable, though it moves at absurd speed to minimize risk.

A Stand in the form of a swarm 500 insect-like creatures each about 3 inches tall. They don't have much individual combat power, but they're collectively quite strong and very fast, with a very high range. It's very good at finding things autonomously, like coins and pieces of lottery tickets.

A Stand resembling a small, white and gold child dressed in a dapper uniform. Its ability is to unfurl people into books with which you can read the history and memories held within. Removing pages also removes all of the information within from the victim's mind, and causes them to lose weight and vitality. It can also write commands into the pages that must be followed, ranging from "I cannot attack the user" to "I will fly backwards at 70km/h" to "I can speak Italian".

A Stand that manifests as a set of prehensile, purple, thorny vines. The vines themselves can be imbued with Hamon, the energy of sunlight gathered by breathing properly, though their main purpose is to function as a powerful tool for divination and psychic photogrammetry. They are strong enough to be used as a grappling hook, or shred items to pieces if wrapped around and pulled with enough force. Also grants a touch of Hamon, just enough to get your breathing right.

A tiny gremlin of a Stand that rides on your back and gives you really good pep talks. It does literally nothing but put you in a good mood and encourage you to keep going. If you're particularly lucky, things will work out great.

A Stand that takes the form of an armored green humanoid covered in web-like lines in brighter green. It is capable of unraveling its body into extremely long, prehensile tendrils that can become almost invisible with how thin they are. Its tendrils are still strong and flexible, though, and can be used as grappling lines, a tripwire web, or even to control the bodies of people the Stand infiltrates. Its other attack is the Emerald Splash, a shotgun-like blast of green crystals capable of punching through steel. It supposedly cannot be deflected.

A Stand in the shape of a scowling face, a shaggy mass of hair, and two arms. Usually small enough to fit in a man's mouth. Its ability is to assimilate and shapeshift into any kind of inorganic matter, being able to turn into steel harpoons, glass, plastic, even rocks. If it assimilates enough material, it can become gigantic.

A Stand that looks like a naked purple man with snakeskin patterns. Its ability is to split itself apart into dozens of feet shaped slices, and track people by scent at roughly 60km/h. Once it has tracked its target down, it can steal their energy and nutrients for the user to heal their injuries, all the way down to an emaciated husk. The stronger the target, the more energy Highway Star can pull out.

A Stand that manifests as four protrusions with propellers on them. Honestly, the only thing this Stand does is make it so someone else can die with you when you try to commit suicide. It doesn't really have a lot of power otherwise, and it's overall a bit of a macabre Stand to use anyway... Yikes.

A Stand taking the form of a demonic looking pterosaur-like sculpture of ice, though it does not need to be manifested to utilize its primary ability of ice manipulation. It can freeze and control vast amounts of ice, and near water becomes even more powerful. If the user can fly, it becomes far more dangerous just from the added vector of attack.

A very odd, spiky, robotic Stand. Its ability is to make its targets selectively attract a chosen object with exponential speed and strength as the objects get closer. Broken objects still get attracted to the victim, and become impossible to push away. It can affect multiple people at once, toggle its ability, and affect the user as well. It has a very short range, though.

A Stand resembling a mesoamerican warrior. It does best at long range. Its primary ability is to store sounds in object, which can be released later as a physical effect matching the sound. It can also make constructs of sound effects with the appropriate properties, and create homunculi out of sound to use selectively on its targets.

A humanoid Stand with a large exposed brain. It has the ability to lock targets and cause them to only be able to remember three things at a time, and every new item causes them to forget the oldest of the three things they knew. It can even cause someone to only be able to perceive three enemies at once. It is also able to integrate itself with its surroundings and travel through terrain and set up traps.

A large, humanoid robot Stand with a sort of abstract appearance. Its primary ability is to pretend it's granting wishes by shaping the surrounding dirt, earth, and clay into dolls and coins and whatnot. The constructs look, feel, and act almost identical to what the target wishes for, though human constructs may have a monstrous looking right side of their faces. It's best used to trick gullible people before ambushing them.

A Stand that can either be manifested or used as a suit. It possesses the ability of gravity removal when the user spits on anyone or anything. The gravity removal has a chaining effect to the air and eventually forms a 20 meter vacuum bubble that may suck out their blood from open wounds and cause it to boil in the bloodstream. Inside the vacuum, any fragile container with air becomes explosive due to pressure. The Stand also contains centrifuges on its wrists capable of launching small objects like screws like bullets.

A Stand in the form of a massive cloud of fog with a skull-like face and skeletal hands with a jeweled crown. It is utterly incorporeal, capable of becoming invisible, can cause hallucinations and create illusions within its mass, spread over entire towns, control the dead as puppet zombies, kill beings by sucking their moisture out of open wounds, punch holes into soft flesh, and puppet any body part that it's injured.

A Stand that functions more as an Ability than a Familiar- it allows you to perfectly morph your body into anyone else's, even including their voice and scent. It does not include their clothes, sadly, nor does it confer acting skill. Great for ambushes, not great for long term deception.

A robotic pink Stand vaguely resembling a cat. It possesses three bombs- its first bomb transmutes any target into a bomb, either allowing the user to detonate it, or the thing that touches it via a button pressing motion. Its second bomb is Sheer Heart Attack, an autonomous and indestructible tank-like bomb about the size of a cat that seeks out the largest heat signature in an area to destroy it. The third bomb is Bites The Dust, exploding anyone that hears the user's identity and resetting time by several hours, though the user retains no memory of the event.

A very powerful Stand, King Crimson is both incredibly strong and has a very powerful ability. Predicting the future, and erasing yourself from time temporarily to avoid damage or change positions to a better location for killing its enemies. Fate itself is on your side with this Stand. You are unable to attack while Time Erasure is active, but otherwise you can do anything else.

A humanoid Stand wearing a jumpsuit and shoulder pads. Its ability is to place stickers on objects that causes them to produce an exact copy of the thing they were placed on. There is no restriction on how far away the duplicate can be taken, but when the sticker is removed the objects smash back together into a single item, causing immense damage. No matter how far away or what conditions, the duplicate will always fly back to its original.

Kraft Work is a close range stand with above average abilities and capabilities. It allows you to manipulate and accumulate kinetic energy, freezing things in place by removing it, or accelerating things rapidly by increasing it. You can use this stand for stepping stones, or an immoveable weapon. Benefits from a creative mindset more then raw lethality.

A Stand that takes the form of a bunch of tiny creatures hidden beneath leaves. If there are enough leaves to form a path, anyone who steps on a leaf will be transported from one end of the path to the other near instantaneously. The path can be interrupted if something steps in the middle, causing the transport to halt there.

A Stand with no form that may persist after death. Its ability is to create and control invisible "zombies" from any corpse in its vicinity. This works on freshly dead and taxidermied creatures, as well as partial remains and the user. Every zombie created gains enhanced strength, wall clinging, and permanent invisibility. Any damage taken is reflected on the original corpse, though they also have the ability to survive even fatal wounds for a time. They also have a hunger for blood and human brains. The user can somewhat track the zombies as well.

With mediocre physical capabilities, Little Feet is not a stand made for a direct fight. Overall it is considered a weak stand, but its ability can make up for that in extreme ways, by shrinking anything it cuts with its index finger. It will make other Stand users functionally helpless, and has a high level of velocity when objects or people unshrink.

A Stand that takes the form of prehensile hair. It doesn't have any real abilities beyond telekinetic control over one's own hair, allowing rapid growth, binding, grappling, and using hair as needle-like projectiles. Should the user take too much damage at once, their hair will turn white and Love Deluxe will deactivate entirely. It's surprisingly strong, despite only being hair.

A feminine Stand with a huge afro puff. Its ability is to control other people's hair and make it grow wherever someone touches. It can be used to figure out pin numbers, grow people's hair back, or be used as a fuse in a gas tank. It has zero direct combat application and only works within 80 meters of the user.

A microscopic Stand resembling a humanoid bug. Its primary ability is its tiny size and ability to infiltrate the brains of others. It has incredibly high range, enabling the user to kill from even kilometers away. Any damage the user takes while Lovers is inside another person is amplified and reflected onto that person. It can also utilize brain cells to make decoys of itself, though that's not particularly useful unless fighting something similarly microscopic. It's kind of a little asshole.

A Stand resembling the front half of a horse and rider. The perfected form of Whitesnake. Its ability is to manipulate gravity to cause intense time acceleration to the point of resetting the entire universe. The longer that time remains accelerated, the faster the acceleration becomes. The only things immune to the acceleration are living things and Stand powers. The user may also move at an incredibly accelerated rate as well, perceiving other living things as moving in slow motion. The speed of inanimate objects invariably becomes lethal. This is the end of the universe.

A powerful Stand with a bird-like appearance, akin to a red phoenix. It possesses power over fire in many forms- blasts, fireballs, walls, bindings, life sensing flames, even the extremely intense Crossfire Hurricane attack, forming an ankh from flames and setting all enemies ablaze.

Man in the Mirror makes up for its lackluster power by having access to a world inside of Mirrors. It can trap an enemy inside, dragging them in using its own ability, but otherwise requires the user to take advantage of it for any real usage. Be careful to not get fooled yourself.

A Stand made of nothing but a head and shoulders and a bunch of wires. By turning the hand on one's wristwatch, Mandom resets time by six seconds in the past. The user does not need to turn the hand directly, as anything that causes it to turn will work. Everyone affected keeps their memory, and will be disoriented from the sudden change in position and circumstance. Anyone prepared for it can adapt quickly, though.

A Stand resembling a four winged satellite. Its ability is to read the wind currents around its user, floating on said currents and moving with enough swiftness to avoid falling water drops. It can also redirect the trajectory of fired projectiles from the user, allowing them to shoot around cover and blind spots by aiming at the Stand itself.

A Stand that might as well be wearing a fur outfit. Its main ability is to enforce debt collection when the user and a target settle a bet, win or lose. Should the target lose, the Stand takes whatever is on the person to pay the debt. The user is allowed to cheat to win, but the target cannot otherwise they lose instantly. It can take organs, gold teeth, or the loser's money, though it cannot take money that the victim had stolen, as it is not rightfully theirs.

An immobile Stand, Metallica has the ability to control the Iron in and around your body, up to a max range of ten meters. This is a particularly damaging stand, and has a high level of utility, even allowing you to turn invisible using fine particles of iron. It is not a stand that benefits from any level of direct fighting.

A Stand with a hole in its face. Its ability is to create and duplicate local currency out of thin air. Anyone targeted by the ability will gain wealth until they are literally crushed under the pile of tender. The only way to escape is to either dispel the effect, givve the money back to the previous owner, or have it all be destroyed by someone else.

Moody Blues is not a particularly powerful stand, it has low-ranked strength and speed. It makes up for this with its rewind ability, which allows it to replicate anything for a period of time decided by the user. You could recreate a crime scene, pilot a plane, or other things. Fool an enemy by disguising it as yourself.

A stand with no combat ability at all, Mister President gives access to a room when a key is placed into the user's back that has comfortable furniture, a functioning tv set, and a refrigerator stocked with drinks. It does not include a bathroom.

A Stand directed toward movement, Notorious B.I.G is a stand that has a good usage, as it can detect movement and alert the user. If the user should Die with Notorious B.I.G active, it will mutate, increasing its stats massively and creating a massive problem for anyone. The only way to stop the Stand after that point is to drop it somewhere that it cannot detect movement.

A humanoid stand wth nuts and bolts as its theme, Nut King Call can place nuts and bolts in a target, creating artificial joints that can be severed immediately to remove limbs. It also has the ability to do this to itself, leaving the user with complete control over that appendage despite the distance.

Oasis is a body suit that allows the user to liquify the ground as well as increasing the strength of the user's body. It allows the user to swim underground at great speed, or sink entire structures using its effect. You can also rebound your own body off of the liquified ground, magnifying your own strength.
A Stand without form that allows the user to control a rope and separate one's body to travel along the length of the rope as a scattered collection of body parts.

A very muscular, humanoid Stand almost resembling Handsome Squidward. Its ability is to turn the souls of anyone who loses a bet against the user into poker chips, as well as create blank poker chips to represent the souls of people it has not claimed yet- either in absentia, or as an opponent betting their own soul. One soul may also be split into multiple chips, though the default is one.

A Stand that starts as a replica of the LEGO 21006 White house set, then turns into a humanoid gremlin thing. Its ability is to dramatically manipulate the pressure of enclosed areas, like raising pressure in a room high enough to kill or cause depressurization. It has a very long range and can be used automatically as a trap.

An Autonomous, Long Range Stand, Paisley Park's primary ability involves assisting individuals that are significant to the user in finding and reaching destinations or escaping peril. She can manipulate a GPS to enhance her own efficiency for instance, or manipulate electronics. She can even hack into electronic devices if needed, or shapeshift.

A stand with no combat ability, Paper Moon King focuses on disorienting the opponent more than anything else, changing their senses or transforming objects into frogs. These abilities are useful, but very low powered.

A Stand that manifests as a bunch of tomato onion hybrid things with faces. They can be chopped up and mixed into high quality food in order to cure the physical ailments of the one eating the dish, albeit in a grotesque and mildly horrifying way. Each dish goes with a specific ailment, and to aid this, you also gain immense cooking skill, the ability to read palms to discern medical conditions, and the ability to select the right quality of ingredients to fix certain ailments. You could even cure cancer with the right dish.

A Stand that resembles a flayed man. Its ability is to attract meteoroids to the user from distant space with enough strength to rip chunks from a human's flesh. They will always disintegrate before hitting the user, but will smash through anything else in between. The meteorites are usually small, but larger ones can be attracted as well.

Purple Haze is a close range Stand with high strength, but a limited range. It's an incredibly dangerous ability to use, as the virus capsules on its knuckles can rupture and unleash a deadly virus that Indiscriminately targets anyone and anything, the user included, and will violently tear away at any living matter it touches. This virus thankfully will die upon exposure to Sunlight, or just regular light after thirty seconds, preventing the spread.

A Stand that's more or less just a gun turret capable of shooting flesh melting darts at bullet speeds. Anything struck by the darts will melt into an organic slurry- flesh, muscle, bones, and all- which can then be molded and shaped as the user pleases. It has a range of 60 meters and can shoot in bursts as well as ricochet its darts off of inorganic material.

A dinosaur-like humanoid Stand with powers over electricity- it can absorb, emit, be powered up by, and transform into electricity, even absorbing all of a city's electrical grid for more strength and speed. It has an incredible range, and can even drag other people into the power lines- which invariably kills them from the electrocution.

Rolling Stone is an Autonomous Stand that the user has absolutely no control of. It isn't malevolent, showing a target their fated death, but will attempt to euthanize them instead as an act of mercy. It gains its power from Fate itself.

An integrated Stand that allows the user to transform themselves as well as any living being into a dinosaur via a viral payload. Even fleas can be turned into ferocious tiny dinosaurs. The created dinosaurs may be controlled by the user, and over time can be fossilized into a dormant, rock-like state that may be shaped into various positions.

A Stand bound to one's right hand. Its only power is to transfer anything from one's left hand to one's right hand regardless of state or size, though it can manipulate the teleportation in advantageous ways- like transferring wires to bind an enemy on arrival. It can transfer gas, liquid, other people's body parts to force them to move, individual objects, glass panes, etc etc. May give your right hand a rock-like texture.

A Stand formed from toxic gas. It's purely toxic and has no physical power whatsoever, and is best kept carried inside a sealed soccer ball. The user is, sadly, not immune to their own poison. The toxin burns skin, cuases trouble breathing, and can kill over time.

A Stand taking the form of a mobile shadow with a birdlike head and visible eyes. Any weapon held by the user will be wielded by Sethan and fully capable of influencing real objects, though its real ability is to reverse the age of anyone who touches the shadow both physically and mentally, with longer exposure resulting in faster de-aging all the way down to even a fetus after ten seconds. Should someone be deaged past the point they received their powers, they will temporarily lose access to those powers.

Sex Pistols is a group of tiny living stands. They prefer to life in a weapon like a revolver, and each have their own individual personalities. While they aren't particularly powerful, their small size makes them precise, and they can even re-angle a bullet's trajectory without issue.

A Stand resembling a lanky, armored knight and carrying a rapier. It is extremely fast, precise, and powerful with its blade. If its armor is removed, it can move fast enough to attack from five places simultaneously. It can also shoot out its blade as a projectile, but it only has a single blade refill at a time and it must recharge after.

A Stand that's somewhere between a frog and a beetle attached to one's wrist. Its ability is to control swarms of cryptids known as Rods, allowing the user to suck away the heat from a target's body in various locations to force them into various actions, or even kill them outright. The closer you are, the more accurate the control. Requires, roughly, line of sight.

The original Soft and Wet of Josefumi Kujo, this stand allows you to create and manipulate bubbles with the power of Absorption/Plundering. This allows you to steal the attributes of your opponent, even their sight, but the power of the bubbles themselves is lacking. You can also fill the bubbles with bolts and screws, or use it to remove flecks of black pepper from your food.

The Fused Stand of Josefumi Kujo's "Soft and Wet", as well as Yoshikage Kira's "Killer Queen", this stand combines the bubble creation ability of both, granting explosive bubbles with the ability to "Plunder", stealing away traits and effects from it with explosive force. You can also use these bubbles to detonate the First Bomb. Your 'bubbles' are in fact incredibly fast spinning thin lines, and can pass through any barrier, even living things, to hit your target. Provided you have someone to help aim.

Soft Machine is a Stand that has the ability to deflate anything it pierces, allowing whatever has been pierced to be dragged through incredibly small areas. It also allows much larger things to be draped over another, allowing the user to hide between these two areas. It's not a stand that is well suited for combat despite its strength level, and is better suited for ambushing.

A Stand decorated in playing card imagery. Its ability is to hide nearly any object inside a deck of cards regardless of its size. It even works on people, and individual body parts without severing them. It does not harm the stored object unless the user wishes it to be crushed.

Speed King's primary ability is to store heat and temperature within a small localized point. This can be a coin, or a bill, or a table. The true effect comes when someone comes into contact with that item, as the heat will rapidly enter their body, boiling them from the inside. This power is hot enough to heat sodium chlorate high enough to produce oxygen. It has a very low range of ten centimeters, but items it has affected can travel very far without that restriction.

A sentient stand, calm and collected under pressure, Spice Girl is a fairly powerful stand, boasting high strength and speed, and has the ability to soften anything it attacks, giving it an elastic consistency. This can be used to prevent attacks, create difficult terrain, or many other things with the right application. Be polite to her, and she'll treat you right.

The strongest Stand in the world, theoretically. Boasts the power of time stop as well as immense strength, speed, durability, precision, and growth potential. As long as you keep striving to be better, Star Platinum will continue to grow. It has limited range, though, and loses power sharply after moving 10 meters away from you.

Sticky Fingers is a close range Stand with excellent strength and speed, making it very suitable for direct combat, as well as a versatile moveset involving its zippers. Unzip your body to store things inside, unzip someone's arm to remove it from the fight. Remotely zip things closed to sever anything caught between. There is certainly more.

A blue humanoid Stand wearing green sunglasses. Its ability is to turn itself and its user into string that cannot be seen by normal humans. The string is only as durable as regular thread, though. Stone Free loses a lot of range when taking humanoid form, and when only used to turn the user into string has a much longer range but less power. The user can unravel roughly 70% of their body harmlessly, as well as cut the string for a variety of applications.

A materialized Stand anchored to a smaller boat, capable of being seen by normal people as well. It takes the form of a massive freighter ship with all of the facilities involved. You have full control over everything in the ship, and can telekinetically manipulate it as if it was your own body. You can even phase through the ship as if it's liquid, giving you access to every part without question.

A Stand in the form of a large tree with a small spring between the roots and the bodies of its victims fused to the trunk. Its ability is to subject someone to a Trial of Greed and a Trial of Avarice. The first happens if someone drops something in the spring water, allowing the user to ask the victim if they dropped the object, or one of several valuable objects in the water. Liars have their innards pulled out by vines. Honest answers keep everything offered. Any riches gained by the first trial must be used up by sunset either through trade, selling, or gambling. Throwing away or giving away the riches does not count. Those who fail are absorbed by the tree.

THE FUCKING SUN. No, really, it's just a giant fiery orb that looks like the sun, turns night into day, projects deadly heat up to 80 degrees C into the area, and can launch light bolts with high precision and power. The user is immune to the heat, at least.

A Stand in the form of an electrical transmission tower. Comes stocked with enough essentials to camp out basically forever, albeit somewhat uncomfortably. Its ability is to trap the user permanently inside unless they trick someone into taking their place. In order to not be destroyed, it also reflects any damage done to its structure back onto the thing that did it, though with practice and timing one can take advantage of the slightly delayed reflection and utilize it as projectile attacks.

A Stand bound to a human sized wooden mannequin. It has no ability until it turns into someone else, at which point it gains that person's personality, voice, appearance, even fingerprints. The only tell is the screw in the forehead. Even while transformed, Surface is loyal to its user. It can control the movements of the person it mimics when they stand face to face via mirrored actions- moving its left arm moves the victim's right arm. It may also gain knowledge from the person it mimics that the user doesn't know.

Quite possibly the most useless Stand, not because it's weak, but because it's uncontrollable, automatic, and situational. Its only ability to spread a jellyfish-like colony across wet or watery surfaces that zaps any living being with just enough current to imbue them with mindless combative rage. Anyone caught in the effect will start attacking everyone else near them with no hesitation and reckless abandon. It also affects the user unless they're already naturally combative.

Talking Head is a weak Long Distance Stand, as its only ability is to force someone to lie. To that end, it will latch on to the victim's tongue. No matter how they communicate, it will be a lie. If you desire, you can deactivate the effect to force your enemy to say the truth at an opportune time to manipulate others. It can also manipulate the body for this end.

A Stand that takes the form of tribal tattoos on the back and arms of the body, plus a mask on the back of one's head. Its ability is to fuse and phase into anyone with the same tattoos and exist in the same space, allowing others to hide in one body to avoid attacks or still move to attack while inside someone. Unrelated to the Stand, gaining this ability splits you into eleven identical bodies that roughly exist as a hivemind, more or less.

A Stand with no real form, but is capable of generating building sized illusions and making even small rooms seem like infinite pocket dimensions. Does not hide scent, even if its illusions look and feel real.

A Stand that's one part giant dog, one part car, all robotic. It's made entirely out of manipulated sand, meaning that it's a bit situational, but it's powerful, versatile, capable of shapeshifting into multiple forms and convincingly mimicking voices. Due to being made of real sand, it's visible to anyone, not just beings with perception of spirits and souls.

The Greatful Dead's only ability is the ability to cause organisms to age at an accelerated rate, physically and mentally. There are two ways to use this power, directly and widely. The direct way is to grab someone, which allows the user to age the faster than one can react. The wide way is to deploy this Stand's Mist over a wide area, aging everyone, friend or foe, in the area. Those under the Grateful Dead will age faster based on their body temperature.
