A humanoid robotic Stand almost resembling a football player. Its ability is to scrape away anything its right hand touches, including spacetime. Anything slashed in two by The Hand will clap back together as if it had never been carved away, leaving two mismatched parts stuck together. Its space scraping can also be used for teleportation. The scraping requires a full swipe of the arm, though, so it can be blocked or evaded.

A Stand that manifests as a massive brass lock on a person's chest. Its main ability is to multiply the guilt of its victims over time while the user gaslights the victim into feeling more and more guilty to the point of suicide. It's kind of a huge asshole ability. It can also detect lies- it moves when it senses honesty, but not when someone is dishonest.

The strongest Stand in the world, theoretically. Boasts the power of time stop as well as immense strength, speed, durability, precision, and growth potential. As long as you keep striving to be better, The World will continue to grow. It has limited range, though, and loses power sharply after moving 10 meters away from you.

The perfected form of The World. It's nigh omnipotent, nearly unbeatable- thoroughly capable of changing reality on a whim just by punching the thing it wants to change. It has no limitations on most of its powers. It's quite appropriate to call this Stand a God.

A Stand that manifests as a concept that aids the user. Its main ability is to utilize the users tears as blades, though they cannot actually be used to harm someone. Instead, touching an enemy with the tear blade decomposes the blade and subjects them to the user's Divine Protection, causing luck and calamity to prevent harm to the user- usually targeting the enemy's left eye or feet. It also protects nonliving objects the user wants to keep safe as well.

A Stand taking the form of a hardcover manga bearing the title "(Your Name) Adventures". Even normal humans can see it and read its pages. It has a bizarre, distorted art style, but its pages always tell the truth- whatever happens in them is guaranteed to happen in the future, though perhaps in unexpected ways. With practice, it can also let you read, speak, and understand any language in the world, including ancient and dead languages. May make you dumber, will also represent you and anyone else incredibly ugly.

An anteater-like Stand with magnetic abilities. It directly manipulates and reshapes iron via magnetism, allowing it to shred apart metallic objects that come near the user. It can also move iron beneath one's skin to disguise one's facial features, or sprout blades from one's body.

An anteater-like Stand with magnetic abilities. It magnetizes anyone that comes in contact with its user's blood, causing all iron objects in the vicinity to be attracted to them. Even if the blood has been long separated from the user's body, it retains the same effects. However, if the target moves too far away from the user, the effect weakens. Afflicted individuals are also magnetized to each other, with the combined force of magnetism becoming even greater than before- strong enough to tear their bodies apart.

An anteater-like Stand with magnetic abilities. It uses magnetism to manipulate iron sand from the surrounding area. It's capable of binding enemies and physically attacking them via that sand. It can also rip the iron out of someone's blood, causing massive damage to their blood vessels and arteries.

A Stand that takes the form of a monstrous beetle-like creature. Its main ability is its sheer speed and range, allowing the user to stay far away while it kills its target. Best used for assassination, it's still strong and durable enough to rip through a human skull like tissue. It has a secondary mouth allowing it to rip chunks of flesh from its targets, usually tongues.

A Stand that allows one to turn metallic objects into balloons that can be shaped into animals. The balloon animals can be sent off to fight at long range, and take on many properties of real balloons while still being metal. They can additionally be imbued with simple commands. Upon reaching their target, they will deflate and embed the original object into their target's material to cause heavy damage.

A diminutive Stand with four Acts. Act 1 spins the user's fingernails to use them as cutting tools or transport or launch them like bullets while enabling fast regrowth. Act 2 imbues the spinning nails with Spin and the golden rectangle to leave void holes in shot targets, as well as have those holes chase a target to deal damage. Act 3 allows the user to shoot themselves and use the void as a wormhole, traveling quickly from place to place. Act 4 imbues the Infinite Rotation and generates infinite power, allowing it to do the impossible. CHUMIMIIIIIN!

A humanoid Stand with the power of digging up the memories of events and people from the ground, allowing you to summon any historical event that happened within a city-sized range. The memories of the people involved know of their impending fate and do not mind. Any victim caught in a summoned event will share the fate of everyone involved, unless they can find a point where no one was injured or killed. It can also create an illusory cavern in the ground where the memories of the earth manifest and can be used as traps.

A Stand that vaguely resembles a jester and a jellyfish. Its ability is to leave fingerprints on any surface using its many hands. Upon touching the fingerprint, it will soften the victim's organic tissue into a liquid state, to the point that champagne bubbles can visibly rise through and distort the victim's flesh. They also become disoriented and unable to move due to the softening, though its range is limited to only a few dozen meters and the effects instantly revert when the victim leaves the area. The softening rate can be changed at will.

A Stand with a simple ability, Walking Heart allows the user to extend the length of their heels or the heels of their shoes. These hardened heels can break through stone or glass, and allows the user to walk up walls.

A humanoid Stand made of clouds. Its ability is to manipulate the atmosphere and control weather within the area, to the point of making microclimates and macroclimates. It can also control air and wind with high precision and force, for sensing, attacking, and defending, as well as manipulate the concentration of gases in a closed area. Its Heavy Weather ability alters the refraction of the sun's rays to create rainbows that make anyone who sees them think they are a snail, including animals. Over time, the effect transforms their bodies too.

A Stand anchored to a physical car that can be seen by ordinary humans. It can take a monstrous form where its grille resembles jaws, and it gains the ability to morph its own chassis and wheels to repair itself, climb walls, fire gasoline bullets, hijack nearby car radios, grow spikes on its wheels, squeeze inside small gaps, and even create sparks using its internal wiring. In all other respects, it's just a car.

White Album manifests itself as a Suit of Armor made of very powerful ice to protect the wielder, and also grants very powerful Cryokinesis, including the ability to freeze gasoline solid. The user is kept insulated in the suit, at a nice warm temperature. The only weakness is an air hole on the back of the neck, but a creative user can seal it and obtain air another way.

A cold, condescending bastard of a Stand. Its ability is to extract souls and physical properties as a DISC, with very little limit as to what can be done. DISCs may be inserted with instructions that must be followed even if usually physically impossible (like exploding). Whitesnake can also directly mind control someone by inserting its hand into their head, and also insert music discs into people to make them play music. Extracted soul or Stand DISCs are indestructible. Also, Whitesnake has hallucinatory acid that puts people to sleep while slowly dissolving their bodies.

A Stand that manifests as a winch in one's throat, allowing you to manifest a pair of hooked cables that can lift and throw a rider with their horse. Its main power is to teleport its hooks- either via a plate of water that can be used as a viewing portal, or by having the hooks teleport through objects of the same type via attaching those objects to the hooks- ie, attaching feathers to make the hooks teleport from the bottom of falling feathers far away.

An autonomous Stand capable of persisting even after the user's death. It possesses a calm, detached personality and considers itself personally superior to all of humanity by way of its command over calamity. It can project illusions to make itself look human, confuse far away enemies, and seemingly do impossible movements. If anyone pursues you or it, they are subject to increasing calamity- bad luck so powerful that rain drops become bullets, cigarettes pierce through flesh and bones, etc etc. Calamity always manifests as an injurious collision.

A Stand made entirely of stretchy, gooey, nearly indestructible yellow goo that's fire proof, ice proof, shock proof, and mostly impact proof. Its main ability is to disguise the user as just about any other human, though that requires that the user be smaller than the person in question.

A green, squat, dwarf-like Stand that only acts on its own when observed by one person or less. It's kind of a masochist, and is pretty much indestructible. When ordered, it will start dissolving any indicated target with acidic spit. It has a surprising range and can also swallow objects to store them for later, though if something tries to take an item out, it emits a horrible stench. Its acid only affects humans, and is painless, soundless, bloodless, and nearly instant.

A simple bunny ear headband. When worn gradually turns the wearer into an exceptionally curvy, slightly dim, and rather horny bunnygirl, complete with outfit over eight hours. The new bunnygirl is exceptionally willing to believe anyone is their boss, and has no compunctions of showing off her body or having sex. The effects reverse over the same amount of time, but become permanent if worn for a full day.

A perky, sexy, sporty goth woman with an almost sadistic enjoyment of death and destruction in all its forms. She dances to the symphony of eternal violence and war. Don't mistake her for being cruel, though, she loves life in all its shapes and forms, because life is what gives her existence meaning.

A specialized terraforming device capable of cleansing or spreading corruption across the land. By using different solutions, it can purify areas tainted by evil, spread various forms of evil such as corruption or crimson, or even convert entire biomes into completely different ones. Has infinite solutions of any type.

Digi-See? Digi-Hear? Digi-Know it was coming? A Digidestiny starts today!! Here's your complementary Egg! It will hatch anywhere from 5 to 120 days (depending on egg cycle) into a random Baby-level Digimon and will bond with whomever the owner of said egg is upon hatching. Roll a random number for your new companion!

You receive the legendary USS Enterprise (CV-6), the most decorated aircraft carrier of World War II. She possesses an inexhaustible supply of fuel, food, ammunition, spare parts, and period-appropriate aircraft, ensuring she can operate indefinitely. The ship is manned only by a skeleton ghost crew, just enough to sail, maintain the vessel, you need more living crew to keep her at fighting efficiency

A handgun of unknown make, superficially similar to a SIG Sauer P226 that inflicts no physical injury, yet causes anyone shot by it to instantly believe they have suffered a severe traumatic wound exactly where they were hit. Victims experience convincing phantom pain, vivid false memories, and may even behave as though they are paralyzed, amputated, or otherwise gravely injured despite being completely unharmed.

You gain control of SCP-4217, the anomalous battleship Bismarck fused with a colossal cephalopod organism that serves as its living crew and engine. Fully restored and capable of operating both on the surface and deep beneath the sea, it retains its complete historical armament while its biological half grants it immense regenerative abilities and the power to survive where no ordinary warship could. SCP-4217 is absolutely loyal to you and will obey your commands without hesitation.

You gain command of SCP-2117, the colossal space ship station known as SCPS Solidarity. Vastly larger on the inside than its exterior suggests, it serves as a fully operational mobile fortress equipped with Faster-Than-Light travel, interdimensional transit, advanced anomalous technologies, powerful weapon systems, and enough facilities to function as a self-contained civilization. The station, its AI, onboard anomalies, and all attached systems recognize you as their rightful commander and will loyally carry out your orders.
If something would be genuinely funny, reality subtly conspires to make it happen.

A sacred artifact from Minecraft Legends that embodies the power of creation itself. By wielding the Flames of Creation, you can summon and command the various golems, bringing them to life to fight alongside you with unwavering loyalty.

A magical instrument from Minecraft Legends used to summon and command Allays through enchanting melodies. By playing different tunes, you can summon and direct Allays to gather resources, construct structures, cure corrupted land, free imprisoned creatures, and perform a wide variety of tasks.

A colossal tower the size of a mountain, designed to act as the catalyst for a worldwide psychic mind-control network capable of subjugating an entire planet. Protected by a buried Mental Dynamo, it is virtually indestructible, but it remains dormant because its intended power source, a psychic of unparalleled strength, is missing. You may place the Device anywhere you wish.

A compact power plant that generates inexpensive, renewable electricity through a self-sustaining electrical feedback loop. You gain the ability to spawn one Tesla Reactor each day, though you'll have to connect it to your own power grid yourself. While highly efficient and cost-effective, each reactor produces relatively modest power compared to larger energy sources.
I Know What We're Going to Do Today

You possess a supernatural ability to complete construction projects at absurd speeds. Work that would normally require months or even years can somehow be planned, built, and finished in the span of a single afternoon.

A universal suppressor that can be attached to virtually any firearm, artillery piece, or cannon. Regardless of the weapon's size or caliber, it completely eliminates the sound of firing, reducing even the loudest gunshot to near-total silence without affecting performance.
A trick card that when activated conjures three random Abilities, Consumables, or Familiars from the Gacha. The summoned items may be of any rank.
A trick card depicting weed spray. Upon activation, it releases a cloud of spray that instantly knocks unconscious any lower level or human-adjacent, while leaving stronger foes largely unaffected.
A trick card depicting a chickening. Activate it to unleash a chicken stampede that charges through your enemies.

A trick card that, when activated, transforms an unfortunate target into a random mook, stripping them of their previous powers, equipment, and status. The transformation lasts until dispelled or otherwise reversed.

A trick card that, when activated, transforms an unfortunate target into an ordinary goat. While transformed, they lose access to their abilities, equipment, and powers until the effect is dispelled or otherwise reversed.

A trick card that, when activated, summons a massive Zombot to crash down onto the battlefield with a devastating stomp. Enemies caught in the impact are knocked back, scattered, and may be briefly stunned by the sheer force of the strike.

The child-like android Rock, after being refit for combat by his creator into the Super Fighting Robot: Mega Man. He has a mega buster cannon in his arm, the ability to copy other robots' abilities, and the heart of a hero. Is mostly three laws compliant.

Roll is a child-like housekeeping bot. The sister to Mega Man, she mostly spends her time as a maid and lab assistant for Doctor Light. Kind hearted and empathetic, Roll has dreams of running a hospital to help people.

You have become friends with Faeries, allowing you to see the fantastical without supernatural milk, use a little bit of Faerie Magic if you're taught how, and learn Sylvan tongues easier than if you weren't Fairy struck.

Grab any form of radio communicator or walkie-talkie. The frequency it's on will always play or say something relevant towards your objectives. To change frequencies or turn the ability off you have to respond with "Copy That".

A book that continuously writes new laws into existence where offenders will be automatically punished. The laws become more and more strict over time, though if contradictions cannot be reconciled those laws will vanish. If given enough time or otherwise not handled properly, it may end up creating enough laws that no one can do anything without punishment. Not even the user is immune.

The magical and cursed dwarven blade in the Nord Tyrfing Cycle and the Hervarar Saga. It is blessed with an unbreakable edge that can cut stone and metal like cloth and never rust, and cursed so that whenever it's unsheathed it must take a life to be sheathed again and will bring "Three Great Evils" upon the wielder.

The magical and cursed dwarven blade in the Nord Tyrfing Cycle and the Hervarar Saga. It is blessed with an unbreakable edge that can cut stone and metal like cloth and never rust. Its enchantment is strong enough that it may even harm the gods.

Each day, you receive a fully operational Tesla Cruiser, a fast assault vehicle armed with powerful Tesla weaponry capable of frying infantry and temporarily disabling or stunning vehicles. Every Cruiser comes with infinite fuel, food, ammunition, and a loyal full crew, allowing it to operate indefinitely without logistical support.

A mobile war factory capable of producing a wide variety of Soviet vehicles. It automatically manufactures one random Soviet vehicle each day, though production can be greatly accelerated by supplying it with raw materials, and it can be taught to manufacture additional designs by providing it with compatible blueprints.

Activate so that all electrical, lightning, and Tesla-based abilities and weapons used by you and your allies become significantly more powerful for a short duration. Their damage, range, intensity, and stunning capability are all greatly increased.

Every country now has a physical manifestation in the form of a little ball with its flag slapped on it. These countryballs are alive, have the personalities and stereotypes of their nations, and just coexist with everyone else. As long as the nation itself still exists, its countryball can't truly die.
Get Out of Jail Free Card
Does exactly what it says on the tin. Use it to immediately escape or nullify any imprisonment, arrest, detention, or equivalent form of captivity, no consequence and questions asked.

Each day, you receive a fully operational Cryocopter. Armed with technology capable of freezing enemies to a halt or shrinking enemy units into smaller versions of themselves, every Cryocopter comes with infinite fuel, food, ammunition, and a loyal crew, allowing it to operate indefinitely.

Fae magic and enchantments have no effect on you, granting complete immunity to their supernatural tricks. You may also harm or kill fae without suffering the usual curses, taboos, or mystical consequences that would normally follow.

Whenever you face an enemy with an ability or power you have no effective answer to, you automatically gain a new ability specifically designed to counter it. The strength and complexity of the counter scales with the power of the target.
You are completely immune to stuns, knockdowns, paralysis, and similar crowd-control effects that would prevent or interrupt your actions.

As long as your will remains unbroken, you will continue fighting through any hardship or injury. Even if your body has died, sheer determination alone can keep you going until your resolve finally gives out.

Gift this token to someone else, granting them one roll of the Omni Gacha. In return, you receive three random Abilities, Consumables, or Familiars from the Gacha, with each reward capable of being any rank.

An ordinary white ceramic bowl that fills itself with warm, nourishing soup whenever someone nearby is sick or injured. Occasionally, after it is finished, a heartfelt message from a loving father figure may appear inside the bowl.

A strange green sphere that continuously secretes a miraculous slime capable of improving almost anything it touches, from machines and fuel to food and construction materials. The only rule is simple: under absolutely no circumstances may the sphere or its slime come into contact with a dead body

You become The Chosen One from Animator vs. Animation, gaining its immense physical abilities, flight, superhuman speed and durability, pyrokinesis, cryokinessis, laser vision, technopathy, and other signature powers.
An I O U issued by the Gacha itself. Redeem it after a two months have passed to receive three random rolls of the same rank as this token.

No matter what happens to you- corruption, mind control, mutation, possession, memory alteration, timeline erasure, reality rewriting, etc- you never lose your true sense of self. At your core, you're still you, and no force can permanently overwrite your identity or who you truly are.
You possess the knowledge and expertise to successfully recreate and manufacture technologies of the GUNDAM series, including Minovsky Reactors, GN Drives, N-Jammers, Ahab Reactors and etc.

A converted alien supply craft that serves as a mobile headquarters. Equipped with living quarters, research labs, engineering bays, manufacturing facilities, and a command center, it functions as a self-sustaining flying base capable of transporting your forces anywhere in the world while remaining hidden from most enemies.
An ordinary crate that continuously replenishes itself with Australium. No matter how much you remove, the crate will slowly refill over time, ensuring you never run out.
The Abyss Bar, fully stocked and ready for business. Spend money to purchase any of its beers, from ordinary brews to the special house selections, each with their usual effects.

The Fairy Queen has essentially adopted you as one of her human handmaids. Along with being the equivalent of minor nobility in Fairy lands, you also gain the ability to recharge any magical items, the chance to learn Fairy specific magic, immunity to Mind Control (Specifically Control, Alteration is a separate thing), and any Sylvan based language is immediately translated into the most convenient language you speak.

A box that continuously replenishes itself with Sentry Wards. When planted, these invisible watchers grant True Sight, revealing invisible, concealed, disguised, and otherwise hidden enemies within their area of effect.

A box that continuously replenishes itself with Observer Wards. When planted, these invisible watchers grant vision over the surrounding area, allowing you to see events occurring there no matter how far away you are.

A box of magical chalk from Chalkworld. Anything you draw with it becomes real, and drawing a doorway on a suitable surface lets you freely enter and exit ChalkWorld, where chalk creations can come to life. Warning: Chalk constructs are easily washed or erased away.

An anchor that can be dropped into a timeline, anchoring it firmly in place. While active, time travel, timeline rewrites, paradoxes, retroactive changes, and other temporal shenanigans cannot affect that timeline until the anchor is removed or destroyed.

Holding the high ground gives you a decisive advantage. While fighting from a higher elevation than your opponent, you gain improved accuracy, a greater chance to hit, and significantly increased damage.

A dark grey duffel bag containing a copy of any single mundane firearm or bullet magazine produced for public use on Basic Earth. Ranging from revolvers, sniper rifles, etc, with bullets included. You can only pull out up to 20kg of items per day from the bag.

Any failed attempt to read, control, influence, or otherwise attack your mind psychically rebounds onto the attacker. The backlash inflicts psychic damage proportional to the strength of the original attempt

You possess a supernatural talent for convincingly faking your own death, or someone else's. Your deceptions are so flawless that even clairvoyance, precognition, divination, and similar supernatural methods are fooled into believing the death was genuine.

Somewhere in the multiverse exists a universe overflowing with discarded items, vehicles, relics, and junk from countless realities. By opening portals to it, you can dump completely random objects into your current world, ranging from worthless trash to priceless artifacts, tanks, battleships, or even entire derelict space hulks directly onto your target. Gilgamesh will be pissed.

A reviled blade that bites deeper with every desperate struggle of its victim. Its ability is Soul Rend, which Silences a target for 5 seconds. When the silence ends, the target suffers additional magical damage equal to 60% of all damage they took during the silence.

You are a master hunter of dragonkind whose expertise transcends worlds. You instinctively understand the strengths, weaknesses, habits, and methods of combating dragons and dragon-like creatures from both the local universe and beyond, making you exceptionally effective at tracking and slaying them. You deal significantly increased damage to all dragons, and if you are a dragon, or otherwise dragon-related, your physical and supernatural abilities are greatly enhanced, making you an even deadlier hunter of your own kind.

A specialized piece of equipment designed to protect its wearer from psionic threats. It greatly resists mind control, telepathy, mental manipulation, memory alteration, fear effects, and other psychic attacks.
The Storm Border, Chaldea's Lostbelt-hopping flying submarine. Upgraded with advanced Greek nanotechnology, it comes fully equipped with the Hume-Barrel Rayproof, Captain Nemo, and the Nemo Marines.

A Kaleidostick-type Mystic Code created by Kischur Zelretch Schweinorg. By drawing directly from the Mana Plane, Sapphire provides her master with an effectively limitless supply of magical energy, greatly enhancing the power, efficiency, and versatility of all magic and magecraft while acting as an intelligent magical companion. Through her connection to the Second Magic, she also possesses limited interdimensional travel capabilities, allowing passage to other worlds and parallel realities wherever such travel is possible.

A sleek, high-tech wrist device with a futuristic holographic dial loaded with the entire Marvel Rivals roster. Select any character on the dial to instantly transform into them, gaining their appearance, powers, abilities, and equipment for the duration of the transformation.

A bizarre glass-like creature that resembles a walking pitcher filled with an extremely corrosive digestive fluid. Though normally docile, it can smash through virtually any wall or barrier by unleashing a reality-defying resonant shout, showering the area with lethal debris. Oh yeah!
The amazing tape that can patch, seal, and repair almost anything in seconds.

A mystical staff resembling the one from Animation vs. Minecraft, featuring an empty slot that can hold almost any object. Insert an item into the slot and the staff will grant abilities themed around it, for example, a log allows you to conjure and shape wooden structures, while a furnace grants the power to instantly smelt and cook materials. Swapping the inserted object changes the staff's powers accordingly.

A library card that grants you access to the Wanderer's Library, allowing you to travel there and back at will. The library is a planet sized repository of all information. Yes, all of it. Though finding a specific thing may be a bit of an issue, and anything beyond your universe's level isn't in available in a language from that universe. Just... try not to get yourself expelled. If the librarians ban you, not even we can help you.
A handheld device that duplicates almost any non-living object, turning one into two with a single shot. The Duplicator has 3 hour recharge time after use.

A strange headset capable of merging two or more objects into a single hybrid, combining their properties, functions, and occasionally their quirks. It does have a tendency to overheat after extended use... but that's probably nothing to worry about.

The Rabbids' infamous space-and-time-traveling washing machine is now yours! It can fling its occupants across time, space, and dimensions... assuming you can squeeze inside and survive being violently spun around during the wash cycle.

The universe is now infested with Lapins Crétins. Fortunately, they seem to have unanimously decided that you're their leader and will eagerly follow your commands. Unfortunately... everyone else now has to deal with the Rabbids.

Inflict a target with the eternal wrath of Truck-kun. For the rest of their life, or until the curse is lifted, they will be randomly ambushed by trucks appearing from seemingly nowhere, with no warning and no regard for logic, physics, era or their current location.

Activate this ability to make it rain Jarate over a wide area, coating everything unfortunate enough to be caught beneath the golden downpour. The smell lingers long after the storm has passed. "I am so, so sorry."
A peculiar wristwatch that equalizes the speed of everyone within a massive radius. No one is getting speedblitzed on your watch.

The ultimate anti-male technique. Unleash a devastating strike to a target's groin so powerful that every male within a wide radius instinctively doubles over, physically feeling an echo of the impact. No matter what, if the target is male they will receive massive damage. Warning: if you're a male you will also be hit by the after effect.
Fire a beam that forces its target to relive every traumatic memory they've ever experienced all at once. Has no effect on individuals with no traumatic memories.
Fire a beam that overwhelms the target with profound despair, crushing their motivation, hope, and will to act.
Fire a beam that forces the target to relive every embarrassing, awkward, and cringe-worthy memory they've ever had all at once. Has no effect on shameless people.
Call forth a random spaceship to make a high-speed crash or ramming attack on your target while unleashing every weapon it has during the approach.

You have an uncanny talent for building surprisingly effective gadgets, tools, and weapons out of whatever happens to be lying around, such as creating a bomb out of chewing gum, dental floss, duct tape, and a match.

You are completely immune to horrors beyond your comprehension. Eldritch beings, impossible geometries, cognitohazards, and other mind-breaking phenomena simply fail to affect you. If you can't comprehend it, then its clearly not a threat.

Cleanse a target of contaminants and impurities with a touch. Diseases, poisons, toxins, radiation, corruption, pollution, and other unwanted substances are removed, leaving the target clean and purified.

You can instinctively sense those who fear justice, people who dread being held accountable for their crimes or wrongdoing. The stronger their fear of judgment and punishment, the more clearly they stand out to you.
A nigh immortal Necron decked out with some of the setting's best tech. He is not known as the collector (or a Pokémon master) for nothing.

If the United States of America doesn't exist, it does now, complete with every over-the-top eagle, freedom, and barbecue stereotype imaginable. If America already exists, then either a second America appears, an American countryball manifests, or the Hetalia version of America shows up. Your choice.

Drop this onto any stretch of land to bless it with an inexhaustible supply of fossil fuels. Oil, natural gas, and other hydrocarbons will continually replenish themselves, ensuring the deposit can never truly run dry.

An endless bucket filled with liquid magic. Coat an object in it to imbue it with magical properties, enchantments, or mystical effects, or use the liquid itself as a potent source of magical energy for spells, rituals, and arcane creations.

A smartphone containing the contact information of superheroes from across the multiverse. It also features a Random Hero button that automatically calls a hero best suited to give you advice, guidance, or the occasional pep talk for your current situation.

A physical animator's toolbar capable of affecting the real world. Its tools let you draw, erase, reshape, duplicate, animate objects into existence and etc., with sufficiently detailed creations becoming fully functional, or even alive.

You possess an instinctive sense for betrayal. You can detect those who have become disloyal, or whose loyalty is beginning to waver, allowing you to spot would-be traitors before they make their move.
Pull a Tommy gun out of your ass and unleash an endless hail of bullets. The barrage tears through realities themselves, with rounds capable of passing through time and entire multiverses.

Lucky Blocks, their many variants, and Chance Cubes now randomly spawn throughout the universe. Break one open to receive anything from incredible treasures to catastrophically unlucky surprises. You also know how to craft them yourself. Good luck.
Roll 3 random World items ranging from F to B rank.

A special state that you can enter whenever you are holding a firearm, letting increase your perception, accuracy to near perfect levels and make it seem as if the world is slowing down to a crawl, then you can 'mark' the spots you will shoot as it deactivates making your body react as shoots all of them hitting the mark.
No One Is Ever Hurt Polska Again!

If Poland doesn't exist, it does now, instantly becoming more technologically advanced than every major nation in the setting (unless they're a precursor civilization). It also comes with an incredibly bloodthirsty Polandball who's held a grudge against Russia since... well, forever. If Poland already exists, it instead receives the same massive technological leap, and the very same vengeful Polandball shows up to "help." You also gain citizenship in poland.

You can toggle this passive on or off at will. While active, any nuclear weapon or nuclear attack you unleash is converted into a neutron blast, dealing virtually no damage to inorganic objects, structures, or vehicles while instantly lethally irradiating all organic life caught within the affected area.

An elite, veteran killteam who usually hunt down those who stole Steam accounts with nigh unlimited budget. They are ruthlessly effective at their jobs. Now available to use for any job requiring a highly efficient and lethal killteam, once per year.

You, your allies and all your scanners and detectors can see much farther than normal and have increased detection ranges. In addition, all of your and your allies' weapons, attacks, abilities, and powers gain significantly increased range.

You and all of your allies gain significantly increased resistance to chemical, biological, poisonous, radiological, and other hazardous contaminants. Toxins, diseases, radiation, corrosive agents, and similar threats are far less effective against you.
Instantly repairs all damaged vehicles and structures within a large radius, restoring them to full operational condition. 3-minute cooldown.

A walkie-talkie that lets you call in a leaflet drop roughly every 3 minutes. The leaflets can contain whatever message, image, or propaganda you want. A B-52 flies overhead and blankets the target area with paper, baffling, distracting, and thoroughly confusing anyone caught in the shower of leaflets.

Whenever you, your allies, or any of your land, sea, air, or space vehicles are targeted by a missile, a cloud of countermeasures appears out of nowhere to lure it away. Heat-seeking, radar-guided, laser-guided, it doesn't matter. If it's a missile, there's a good chance it'll get fooled instead.

No, not the superhero team, the American laser-based self-propelled anti-aircraft gun and support vehicle. This thing tears through aircraft and can shoot down an absurd number of incoming missiles, rockets, and other projectiles before they ever reach you, even swatting SCUD missiles out of the sky. You receive one fully crewed Avenger every day, complete with unlimited fuel, ammunition, food, and a loyal crew.

A sleek, high-tech wrist device with a futuristic holographic dial loaded with the entire Fate/Grand Order Servant roster. Select any Servant on the dial to instantly transform into them, gaining their appearance, abilities, Noble Phantasms, parameters, skills, memories of combat, and equipment for the duration of the transformation.

Youz got da cunnin' an' da skillz of a propa Ork Mekboy! Give ya a pile o' scrap an' you'll bash togevva sumfink dead-ard killy, guns, wagons, walkers, tellyportas, or any uvver mad contraption ya can fink of. Don't ask 'ow it workz... it just doez. Now stop askin' stoopid questions an' grab dat wrench!
Every time you defeat an enemy, you automatically receive a cash bounty in the legal local currency. The tougher the opponent, the bigger the payout.

Minecraft mobs have begun appearing throughout the world. Fortunately, you've been entrusted with the Banner of Courage. Raise it high, and Overworld mobs will unquestioningly rally to your side and obey your commands. Sadly, this only works on Overworld mobs, so tough luck on the Endermen.
A token that dispels one of the Curses in the curse gacha, can also be used to dispel actual curses. Can only be used once.

When activated, the GPS Scrambler grants stealth to all friendly units caught within its area of effect. The stealth persists indefinitely as long as the unit exists, but is briefly broken whenever the unit attacks or uses an offensive ability, automatically reactivating shortly afterward. It has a 3 minute cooldown before being able to be activated again.

Youz got da skillz of a propa Ork Painboy! You can patch up da ladz, staple gitz back togevva, replace body bitz wiv bioniks, an' perform surgery wot would make any humie dok faint. It ain't pretty, but it workz... most of da time.

Let nothing remain. Grants the ability to manipulate absence/annihilation/void/nothing. Attacks made of this ignore invulnerability, immortality, durability, and do not technically exist, thus ignoring hostile reality manipulation. No limit to scale of use, delete the universe if you want.

No, not like that. You are completely immune to any magic, psychic powers, or supernatural abilities originating from elves or elven races, including space elves like the Eldar. While fighting them, your physical and supernatural abilities are massively enhanced, you deal greatly increased damage, and any precognitive abilities they possess become unreliable or outright fail whenever they involve you.

You possess the knowledge, expertise, and technical mastery of an Adeptus Mechanicus Fabricator-General. From the simplest lasgun to the most complex Titans, voidships, STC-derived technology, and sacred relics of the Machine God, you instinctively understand how to design, build, repair, maintain, and improve them.

You gain ownership of an entire Forge World, dedicated solely to serving you. Its manufactorums, shipyards, and industrial complexes are overseen by loyal Magi of the Adeptus Mechanicus, countless Tech-Priests, Skitarii, and legions of servitors, all working tirelessly to manufacture, repair, and expand your technological might.
A single Blue Lantern Ring accompanied by an inexhaustible power battery. The ring has an onboard AI, but you'll need to activate it.

A storybook that transports anyone who reads it into a living fantasy adventure the moment they fall asleep. Inside, you'll become the hero of your own epic tale, embarking on quests, slaying monsters, making friends, and saving kingdoms in a dream that can feel like months or even years despite only a few hours passing in reality.

A briefcase stocked with a complete set of SCP Foundation amnestics, ranging from Class A to Class I. Whether you need to erase the last few minutes, wipe years of memories, or completely rewrite someone's recollection of events, you'll have the right amnestic on hand. The supply automatically replenishes over time, ensuring you never run out.

A briefcase containing a collection of the SCP Foundation's mnestic drugs, from Class W through Class Z. These compounds preserve, restore, or greatly enhance memory, allowing the user to perceive antimemes, achieve perfect recall, or even become incapable of forgetting. Be warned, the higher-grade mnestics are exceptionally dangerous, with Class Z being almost invariably fatal. The briefcase automatically replenishes its contents over time.

The Gunner is a bronze statue of a WW1 soldier, with a revolver at his side, and a horse bridle attached to himself. He's the epitome of what it means to have been a WW1 Soldier, with the caveat that he's a generalist to some other specialists. So long as he gets to his plinth by midnight, he can heal from literally anything and everything, and as such, you are provided with a wooden plinth that you can replace to work with.
A veteran Firebat armed with twin incinerator cannons and clad in heavy combat armor. Blaze excels at area denial, blanketing the battlefield in flames to devastate groups of enemies.

A big man with an even bigger gun. Encased in signature powered armor, Tychus wields a massive minigun capable of shredding infantry, light vehicles, and just about anything unlucky enough to stand in front of him. When the fighting gets serious, he can temporarily call down the Odin, a colossal combat walker armed to the teeth with devastating firepower, turning the battlefield into his personal shooting gallery.
A brass horn that can be attached to the barrel of a gun. When attached, amplifies the volume of the gun by 10 times. May cause acoustic trauma.
The sun (or whatever stellar object you are closest to) is now vastly more likely to fool heat-seeking devices. That is all.

Not actually the end of everything. This spell, when cast, creates a series of increasingly destructive area effects centered on you. Should you survive, you will be rewarded with a 3 star token. Can only be cast once every 10 years.

The great land of Sabu appears in a desert near you, ruled over by the all loving mother Kethra, the Goddess of Lust and Plenty. The land is rich, the people are fucking like animals, and the great gods are content. Sabu is a land much like ancient Egypt in aesthetics, though its population is made of a mix of humans, nonhuman anthropomorphic animals, animal-headed demi-humans, and other mythological creatures like centaurs and nagas. Its population is roughly 50% female, 40% female hermaphrodites, and 10% male. It is a time of plenty, where the waters of the Euphoris are rich and goods and sex are traded with equal measure. Pretty much everyone goes around basically in bikinis... or even less.

The great land of Sabu appears in a desert near you, once ruled over by the all loving mother Kethra, now godless and corrupt. The land is cursed, monsters roam the land, and cults kill each other for artifacts and influence. Sabu is a land much like ancient Egypt in aesthetics, though its population is made of a mix of humans, nonhuman anthropomorphic animals, animal-headed demi-humans, and other mythological creatures like centaurs and nagas. Its population is roughly 50% female, 40% female hermaphrodites, and 10% male. It is a time of fear, slavery, and death, and it might be up to you to fix the land's problems. Pretty much everyone goes around basically in bikinis... or even less.

The keeper and the key of the gate. The Outer God of the Threshold. Past, Present, and Future in one. An omniscient being from beyond the furthest reaches of the universe, usually appearing in the form of a congeries of iridescent globes, some of which have names. And you let it into your universe. What could you possibly be fighting that you'd think having this thing is a good idea? Free reroll, if you don't feel like unraveling the universe.

The monster that fell from the stars. The legendary rival to Titanus Gojira, usually known as Monster Zero. Once sealed in antarctic ice during a conflict with Godzilla, it now bows to you and you alone. Not that it's particularly happy about it. Good luck keeping the bastard entertained.

Youz got da powa ta call in da Boyz, along wiv Trukks, Battlewagons, Buggies, Kroozers, Roks, an' all sorts o' proppa Orky gubbinz. Don't panic, ya git, dey ain't gonna start sporin' an' turn yer planet into a Waaagh!

A peerless combat medict capable of keeping her patients alive long after anyone else would go down. A veteran of the Brood War and the destruction of the UED Expeditionary Fleet, nothing slows her down in her role. Comes equipped with power armor and all of her necessary kit to keep you and your allies in tip top shape.

A massive, affable, and friendly robot butler with a variety of functions, hobbies, and complicated feelings. He'll do anything you order to the best of his abilities and then some, though obviously maintaining a good working relationship makes him more likely to do so without too much back sass.
A handheld, vaguely chicken themed ray gun that instantly swaps whatever it hits with the nearest chicken. Also has a self destruct button on it, for whatever reason.
A large, human sized, nondescript ray gun that instantly wraps anything it hits into a neatly gift-wrapped present, complete with festive wrapping paper, ribbons, and a perfectly tied bow.
A peculiar little device that decides which direction gravity pulls from, regardless of physics, common sense, or reality itself.

The legendary rune-inscribed runeblade once wielded by Arthas Menethil. It grants immense power over frost and death magic, and unlike the original, this one is permanently bound to you and recognizes you as its rightful master.

Any of your melee weapons that don't already fire projectiles or supernatural beams can be transformed into a fully functional firearm without sacrificing any of their original capabilities, and while adding even more combat capabilities on top.

The final and most powerful incarnation of Titan Clockman that wields overwhelming mastery over time itself. Comes equipped with a sword that renders any object destroyed by it to be unable to be repaired or reverted via time manipulation.

You're immune to the classic villain speech about how "we're not so different," that you're just as bad as they are, or any other manipulative moral grandstanding. You instantly see through the hypocrisy and can effortlessly dismantle their arguments, though this is far less effective against people who are being genuinely sincere.

No matter how enraged you become, you never lose control of yourself. You gain all the benefits of righteous fury, greater strength, determination, and fighting spirit, without suffering the recklessness, clouded judgment, or loss of self-control that normally comes with it.
You Wouldn't Like Me When I'm Angry

The angrier you become, the stronger, tougher, and more unstoppable you become. At extreme levels of rage, reality starts bending in your favor, letting you pull off increasingly absurd comic-book feats worthy of the Hulk.

You have an uncanny knack for accidentally derailing even the most carefully laid plans. Whether through sheer coincidence, dumb luck, or perfect timing, your mere presence tends to throw complex schemes completely off the rails. Path to Victory can suck it.
With a single glance, you can perceive the crimes, atrocities, and injustices a person has committed.

Whenever victory is possible, you're given a step-by-step guide showing exactly how to achieve it. The guidance doesn't grant you the reflexes, skill, or physical ability to follow the instructions, however, and those immune to precognition can still catch you completely off guard.
You can conjure any kind of burger you can imagine. That's... that's the whole power. Make a burger.

A colony of flowering mimic vines that camouflage themselves as local plants while using chlorine trifluoride as sap and nectar. They rapidly spread by consuming carrion and reducing all other plant life to ash, though their fruit is perfectly safe and surprisingly delicious to eat.

A living orchard tree that actively tends nearby crops. It removes weeds, consumes dead or diseased plants, harvests ripe fruit for you, and even discards spoiled produce, making it the ultimate self-maintaining fruit tree and gardener. Given proper care, it can be propagated to grow additional SCP-824 trees.

A hardy anomalous fern that can grow on almost any surface and periodically releases floating hydrogen bladders that provide aerial reconnaissance. These have been modified so that their broadcasts are automatically translated and sent to your devices in your preferred language, though they can still be intercepted over normal radio frequencies. You may also harvest the hydrogen they produce as a fuel or lifting gas.

You become a Moogle; you may pick the variant. Moogles possess natural holy/healing magic, enhanced agility, senses, resilience, flight, and talent for crafting and enchanting. Their strength is humanlike but can greatly improve through training and magic.

You'll never be harmed by absorbing or channeling more power or energy than you can normally handle. Whether it's magical, electrical, psionic, or otherwise, your body safely contains the excess instead of suffering overload or backlash.

Place this structure down to receive an airdrop every 2 minutes containing useful supplies such as food, ammunition, spare parts, ores, scrap, medical supplies, or other valuable resources. If it is destroyed or you need to relocate it, simply place it down again, no biggie.
All bullets fired by you and your allies gain enhanced armor-piercing capability, allowing them to punch through tougher defenses while dealing increased damage to their targets.

Evasion? Dodging? Not actually there? Folded space? Afterimages? Gojo's Infinity? Jesse, what the fuck are you talking about? If an attack would have hit before they started pulling that kind of nonsense, it still hits anyway, because bloody hell, all that BS is just confusing.

Libra as she appears during Hamartia and Babel. An absurdly powerful psychic, she can obliterate unprotected infantry with a thought, hurl massive mechs and tanks with telekinesis, unleash devastating psionic lightning, and use her chrono-pack to teleport while remaining immune to time stop. She is also specifically designed to interface with and be the power source of the Mental Omega Device, should you possess one.

Your body now functions like a video game character's. Attacks deal HP damage instead of physical injuries, accompanied only by a brief burst of pain, with your maximum HP scaling to your natural toughness and other effects. Sleeping in a bed replenishes your HP, MP or the like while curing all status effects. Eating regular food also restores HP.

The Gamer skill Observe lets you view a target's approximate HP and energy, along with their attributes, status effects, and emotional state. The displayed HP is only an estimate since real-world beings don't follow game mechanics, they can be incapacitated before reaching 0 HP, but reaching 0 HP is invariably fatal.

An Omni Gacha branded stamp card. Every token from now on punches a star shaped hole in one of the ten boxes on the card. Upon gaining 10th token of any Star level, you get one free token matching that same token level. Failure to fill out the stamp card before its monthly reset still grants an extra 1000 USD or applicable currency per token gained.

You can easily determine a person's fighting style whenever they take their battle stance. You are able to glean the origin of the style, what school it would belong to, and what its purpose is just by the other person getting ready to throw down. Requires time and training to use the martial arts you have broken down.

You become a member of the Red Sentients, ageless immortals with crystalline bodies. Red Sentients are powered by Antimatter, which functions as their essence. By channeling your energy you can summon a super vehicle that fits your purpose.

You become a member of the Blue Sentients, ageless immortals with crystalline bodies. Blue Sentients are as physically capable as their red counterparts, but they are highly intelligent and are capable of telepathy that can reach across dimensions. If your shell is damaged, you can retreat into your core to recharge and reform at a later date.

Leader of the Red Sentient 5 and Sage's twin brother. Krytus possesses high amounts of strength, the ability to form blades from his hands, and can control robots, and turn them Red. As a Red Sentient he can summon his car, Syfurious, out of energy. Syfurious, alongside being a car, has large, exposed blades that can retract or be fired off at will.

A packet of Ancient Fruit seeds from Stardew Valley. They take an awfully long time to mature, but once fully grown they'll continue producing valuable fruit season after season with no need for replanting, as long as they don't die to the winter cold.
A remarkably convincing-looking atomic bomb whose only effect is a completely harmless pulse that physically swaps the biological sex characteristics of everyone caught within its blast radius.

A water gun filled with water from the Jusenkyo Spring of Drowned Girl. Anyone splashed with it is instantly afflicted with the corresponding Jusenkyo curse, transforming into a female form when soaked with cold water and reverting with hot water. Refills daily.

This tech tree specializes in the initial steps of colonizing planets through Rifts, which are a form of teleportation. Comes with a complementary Rift Jump and Exploration Mecha-Suit, Mark IV - Griffin Variant to jumpstart the process.

A muscular woman with a custom built sledgehammer, equipped with a knuckleboom augment which she can utilize to its absolute fullest potential, allowing her to jump into the air and attack from range. Also has a radio strapped to her playing Made of Steel.

You become a Koopa Troopa: a 3–5-foot-tall reptilian creature with a removable armored shell, claws, sharp teeth, and above-human strength, durability, agility, and jumping ability. You may choose any "frontline" Koopa variant, including Hammer, Boomerang, Magi, or Para, gaining their specialized abilities and whatever color shell you want. Their strength and magical potential can increase through training and growth.

You become a Koopa King: a 3.1 meter muscular reptilian creature with a heavily armored shell, horns, claws, and immense physical power. Koopa Kings possess tremendous strength, durability, jumping ability, fire breath, magic, and powerful shell attacks. Their fire breath can reduce defeated foes to Dry Bones, and both their physical and magical abilities grow with training.

You become a monkey-like Kong: a nimble ape with exceptional agility, a long prehensile tail, climbing ability, dexterity, and above-human strength. Monkey Kongs excel at acrobatics, using tools or weapons, and can steadily develop impressive physical power through training.

You become a gorilla-like Kong: a massive ape with immense strength, durability, speed, and jumping ability. Even untrained, you possess tremendous physical power sufficient to break rock with punches, and training can elevate your strength to monstrous levels.

You become a Yoshi: a dinosaur-like creature with powerful legs, a long prehensile tongue, and remarkable stamina. Yoshis possess superhuman strength, agility, jumping ability, and can swallow objects or enemies turning them into eggs and possibly gaining relevant powers from them. Training enhances their physical abilities.

You become a Boo: a floating ghost with a round body, sharp teeth, and natural intangibility. Boos can fly, pass through normal matter, turn invisible, possess ghostly magic, minor telekinesis, and can possess others. Though intangible to normal matter, their supernatural powers become stronger with training.

RS5's Strategic Tactical and Tech Support. Krylox is a large, hulking Red Sentient with incredible strength and the ability to duplicate himself. He is not very bright and prefers to solve all his problems by smashing things with his fists. Using his energy he can summon his vehicle, Synataur: a tank-like vehicle that can split apart.

RS5's Scout. Unlike the other Red Sentients, he has a tendency to speak in brief sentence fragments, due to his savage nature. Using his energy he can summon his vehicle, Vylirex. It possesses the ability to drive into the ground and reappear at a different location.

RS5's Special Operations Officer. Kyburi is a female Red Sentient, short-tempered and cruel, she is Krytus's First Lieutenant and Hunter. She has the special ability to drain energy from machines and living beings. Using her energy she can summon her vehicle, Venikus: a red all-terrain vehicle to aid in her hunting skills. It has a pair of "fangs" on its front that is capable of draining the energy of vehicles and has a stealth mode.

RS5's Artillery Expert. Kyrosys is an arrogant Red Sentient and a pyromaniac. Using his own energy he can summon his car, Synthrax, that can shoot off flare wheels of fire that can home in on enemies.
Allows you to summon a physical sheet(s) of paper that has your physical and mental stats, along with the various powers you have active and items you own.

If you possess any kind of shield, physical, psionic, magical, or technological, any single hit exceeding a set damage threshold is reduced to that threshold, roughly equivalent to the force of a single sword slash. Any additional shield upgrades or damage reduction are applied afterward.

You are permanently surrounded by a passive psionic shield that is always active and scales with your own psychic power. It only blocks incoming damage, leaving your own attacks and abilities completely unaffected.

You can deploy an unlimited number of Spider Mines. Each mine automatically burrows into the ground and waits patiently until an enemy enters its detection range, whereupon it unburrows and scuttles toward the target and detonates.

You can deploy an unlimited number of Widow Mines at a cost equivalent to $5 per mine. These burrowing Terran assault units stealthily lie in wait until an enemy enters their detection range, then fire a devastating Sentinel Missile that deals massive splash damage before entering a brief recharge period.

A placeable beacon that summons an IKEA storefront leading to the infinite IKEA dimension. You and your allies can, fortunately, always find your way back home no matter how deep you wander. You and your allies are free to take whatever you can carry, just make sure you leave before closing time because the staff don't appreciate late shoppers. You can pay at the registers, but that's just for brownie points.
Not the one you're thinking of. This book is merely a Choose Your Own Adventure book filled with plenty of twists, turns, and tawdry times. It's an adventurous porn novella, essentially.

A modified cursed seal with all of the benefits and none of the downsides. Stage one manifests as a series of flame-like markings across the user's body that massively boost energy output and volume. Stage two causes a number of physical mutations like gray skin, black sclera with yellow irises, and mutant hand-wings coming from the user's back while also granting an even more massive boost to the user's physical stats, combat instincts, and energy output. One of the strongest cursed seals.

A modified cursed seal with all of the benefits and none of the downsides. Stage one manifests as a series of ripple-like markings across the user's body that massively boost energy output and volume. Stage two causes a number of physical mutations like gray skin, black sclera with yellow irises, and a dinosaur-like tail while also granting an even more massive boost to the user's physical stats, combat instincts, and energy output. One of the strongest cursed seals.

A modified cursed seal with all of the benefits and none of the downsides. Stage one manifests as a series of triangular arrow-like markings across the user's body that massively boost energy output and volume. Stage two causes a number of physical mutations like red skin, black sclera with yellow irises, and toad-like warts while also granting an even more massive boost to the user's physical stats, combat instincts, and energy output. Additionally grants boosted earth manipulation and energy absorption abilities.

A modified cursed seal with all of the benefits and none of the downsides. Stage one manifests as a series of vine-like markings across the user's body that massively boost energy output and volume. Stage two causes a number of physical mutations like red skin, black sclera with yellow irises, and oni-like horns while also granting an even more massive boost to the user's physical stats, combat instincts, and energy output. Additionally grants a third eye, four additional arms, and the ability to spit webbing that can be used to form devastating arrows or traps.

A modified cursed seal with all of the benefits and none of the downsides. Stage one manifests as a series of lightning-like markings across the user's body that massively boost energy output and volume. Stage two causes a number of physical mutations like darkened grayish skin, black sclera with yellow irises, and a crown of horns while also granting an even more massive boost to the user's physical stats, combat instincts, and energy output. Additionally grants the ability to manipulate others via sound-based illusions and three demon-like summon creatures capable of consuming energy.

A modified cursed seal with all of the benefits and none of the downsides. Stage one manifests as a series of blotchy dot-like markings across the user's body that massively boost energy output and volume. Stage two causes a number of physical mutations like red skin, black sclera with yellow irises, and oni-like horns while also granting an even more massive boost to the user's physical stats, combat instincts, and energy output. Additionally grants the ability to merge with any organic matter on a cellular level. May or may not split you into two identical twins with one preferring to hide in the other's body.

Instantly create a tunnel exit at any location you can see, know the exact coordinates of, or view through a live feed, photo, or video. You also gain "Tunnel Network" for free if you don't already possess it.

Jack was a war hero famous for clearing enemy trenches all by himself during a great war called the Quite Big Affair before becoming a private investigator. Currently has all of the equipment and experience from the end of the game. The game’s toon logic applies to him and his attacks.

You become a larger, tougher, meaner version of your current race. You fairly closely resemble your normal counterparts, though in addition to your increased size and strength you also gain a feral, prehistoric, or even demonic countenance.

Throw an orb that creates a field reversing the effects of ranged attacks and support abilities. Within its radius, damaging projectiles heal instead, while healing and repair effects inflict damage for the field's duration.

A passive shield that converts all incoming damage into a reconstructive effect, healing and repairing you instead of harming you. However, prolonged use will overload the shield, causing it to begin damaging you until it recovers.

Some call him crazy. Others call him psycho. The iconic rooster man himself, with rooster mask, jacket, and baseball bat. Try not to think too hard about everything he's been through, both in his backstory and his recent past. Just know that if you need something dead- he's got a good chance of making it happen.

Unleash a storm of at least a thousand missiles, drawing from every type of missile or rocket-propelled weapon you've encountered. If you haven't encountered any, the attack defaults to a barrage of standard MRVs; the more missile types you've encountered, the larger and more diverse the barrage becomes, scaling further with your current power. Only works with actual physical projectiles, spells and energy projectiles are a different wheelhouse.

Unleash a storm of at least a thousand energy projectiles, drawing from every type of projectile-based spell, ability, or technique you know. If you don't know any, the attack defaults to a barrage of standard glowing orbs; the more projectile spells or abilities you know, the larger and more diverse the barrage becomes, scaling further with your current power. Only works with spells and energy projectiles, actual physical projectiles are a different wheelhouse.

The mystical eastern fantasy land of Gensokyo arrives in your world, all you have to do is find it. It attracts the lost, the fantastical, the dreams, the forgotten, the memories, and that which does not exist, allowing fantasy to exist as if it's real, and reality to become hazy and dreamlike within the bounds of its barrier. Its nature allows it to be found anywhere, though it naturally gravitates to important mountain valleys, especially the ones with large lakes in the middle. Its denizens are strange and varied, and feature interesting faces from all over mythology and history. Make friends, kick back, and have a party if you want.

Everyone's favorite big sister goddess of the sun. Might get strange looks for being a blonde white girl in Mayan garb. Still, she's incredibly powerful, incredibly strong, completely unbound by her servant rules, and also has a pet Quetzalcoatlus that she rides around on. God help you if you need something like Piedra Del Sol to handle whatever threat you're facing.

Quetzalcoatl may be the most powerful dragon by far, once revered as the goddess of the sun before an incident involving alcohol and her sister's naughty bits got her kicked out of the pantheon. She's really a several dozen kilometer long feathered serpent with genuine godlike power, though she usually takes the form of a big titty blonde onee-chan type in a tank top, short shorts, thigh high socks, sneakers, and a cap. She can do basically anything with her magic, though she much prefers getting into harmless day to day antics than actually showing her strength.

Quetzalpetlatl is the number 100 dragon within the Chaos Faction- powerful enough to decimate entire countries on her own, with some effort. She's Lucoa's beloved younger sister who had a pretty traumatizing incident involving her older sister's naughty bits and alcohol. While she's by no means the strongest dragon out there, she's still more than capable of handling herself as a former harvest goddess. She may or may not have some very complicated feelings about her sister and a certain past incident.

A second generation Bloodfiend that has her memories and powers sealed in the pair of sneakers she wears, giving her the strength of what she would be as a human. She's a dreamer of justice, heroes and doing what's right. Just make sure she doesn't cause too much trouble or remove the shoes or her original self will come out.

A second generation Bloodfiend, and a formidable fighter and user of blood arts. Usually coolheaded and a voice of reason on many things, but can be easily swayed by the flow of those more excitable or those she appreciates. She also enjoys the stories of heroes.

A mysterious blue haired woman holding onto a set of powerful futuristic looking armaments and many techniques. Usually quite stubborn when she has something as a goal, yet surprisingly kind and patient with others.

You now have access to a mental meter that fills when you land attacks, block hits, or are otherwise proactive in a fight. There are three levels, with each level granting higher level "super" attacks, either completely new abilities or a stronger variation of what you can already do. Each super move drains a level from your meter, though with training you may also be able to use super moves that only use half a meter at once. The more you train, the more super meter levels you get.

You can unleash all of your beam attacks and beam weapons simultaneously with greatly increased efficiency. Better yet, you can spam every beam-based ability you possess without consuming additional ability slots.

You gain the Overclock ability for free and can push machines, weapons, and devices even farther beyond their intended limits than regular Overclock could. Instead of immediately failing, they continue operating for a much longer time before overheating, bursting into flames, glowing red-hot, and finally detonating in a spectacular fiery explosion.
Is a machine acting up? Give it a good whack, it'll usually fix the problem. It has its limits, though; if the machine is literally in pieces, no amount of smacking is going to help.
A card containing one of Saitama's Serious Punches. Activate it to unleash the attack exactly once, with all the absurd power that entails.

You can literally punch, kick, or otherwise beat curses, mind control, corruption, possession, and similar afflictions out of a person. A thorough whooping won't hurt the victim any more than necessary, but whatever's controlling them is in for a very bad day.

This version of cheat engine will let you literally edit reality! Be very careful though, you don't get a convenient map of which values do what. The laws of physics are very volatile indeed, and may cause reality to crash if meddled with too far. Good luck!

Any damage you take or deal is now treated as a slapstick bit where you and your opponent take no permanent harm, though as a tradeoff you must commit to ongoing comedy gags and situationally appropriate skits. You now have a weakness to paint thinner and legally binding contracts, and might also be a little flatter and more outlined than you used to be.

A crystalline gemstone made from raw Chaos and Magic, it produces Magic ex-nihilo to the point where a planet that lacks magic can gain it within a single generation, while personalizing the magic to each individual. When bound to the user, it grants nigh-limitless capability to use magic, and an ease best described as "godlike". Be careful of an obsession with mushrooms.

Practically a walking skyscraper, this massive centaur-shaped robot is equipped with a shield generator and a energy lance able to both receive and inflict immense damage. Straddles the line between a Familiar and a Vehicle.

The rage fragment of the Alpha A.I. from Red vs. Blue. Omega excels at hijacking and possessing digital technology, allowing him to seize control of computers, networks, robots, and other electronic systems with frightening ease.

The robot built by Sarge of the Reds, who communicates exclusively in spectacularly broken Spanish. Despite the language barrier, he's an exceptional mechanic and technician capable of repairing, maintaining, and building almost any machine.
An unbelievably lovable idiot with absurd physical strength and a surprising knack for technology. Against all logic, he has a habit of being good with advanced machines.
A Super Soaker capable of firing water from any Jusenkyo cursed spring. Simply select the desired spring, and anyone splashed with the water is afflicted with its corresponding Jusenkyo curse.
Whenever you ram something with a vehicle, the maneuver always succeeds. Your vehicle remains fully functional and intact no matter what it crashes into, though everyone else is much less fortunate.

Whether through impossible talent or absurd luck, your aim borders on the supernatural. You can pull off seemingly impossible trick shots, ricochets that defy physics, and feats of marksmanship like shooting a screw loose with a bullet.

Unleash a storm of at least 10,000 physical bullet projectiles, drawing from every type of bullet or bullet-like ammunition you've encountered. If you haven't encountered any, the attack defaults to a barrage of standard AK-47 rounds; the more ammunition types you know, the larger and more diverse the barrage becomes, scaling with your current power. This ability only replicates physical projectiles, spells and energy attacks are an entirely different wheelhouse.

Fire every weapon and activate every projectile-launching ability you possess, number of hands, ammo, and energy be darned. Bullets, beams, missiles, shells, arrows, spells, energy blasts, and more are all unleashed at a single target simultaneously; if it shoots something, it's joining the salvo.

A Fire and Rescue goat-headed centaur machine capable of traversing rough environments and wielding tools, especially chainsaws. Its energy resevoirs are located in both the human and horse torso and can be pierced with roughly a 9mm bullet or a sharp knife in strength. Perfect for terrifying anyone at night. This one has been modified to be somewhat self-operated, if a bit dim.
An anthropomorphic wolf gal with a large posterior that likes eating a lot of greasy food and showing off her posterior fighting skills. Can easily be swayed with a good job and food.

An anthropomorphic fox lady from an old rich family, quite naive and honest but earnest in helping people. Quite agile and strong for someone wearing only a swimsuit. Her real name is really long, so she's just called Pool Vixen. Comes with a whistle for when you need to call her.

For reasons beyond mortal comprehension, cosmic entities, eldritch abominations, and horrors from beyond reality find you oddly endearing. Whether they want to adopt you, observe you, or simply keep you around is another matter entirely.

Like a Weeping Angel, you become an indestructible stone statue whenever you are directly observed by a sapient being. The statue can be broken apart, but you cannot be harmed this way and will fully reform once you are no longer being watched; however, while observed, you are completely immobile. As a bonus, gain much higher movement speed when not quantum locked.

A Dalek energy weapon capable of outputs ranging from nonlethal settings to enough power to level a building. Unlike standard Dalek doctrine, this version has been reconfigured for your use and features an adjustable power dial, allowing you to precisely control the intensity of each shot. Daleks usually use the dial to make sure the victim has a very painful death.

A Dalek travel machine modified for your use. It's a bit cramped, but you gain full control of the armored war machine, complete with a Gunstick, manipulator arm, force field, flight capability, and all the standard Dalek systems; just remember that the eyestalk remains its most vulnerable point.
A 1 cubic meter sized crate vaguely done up in some kind of scifi-ish aesthetic and stamped with an infinity symbol on its sides and top. When opened, grants four 1 star tokens and one 2 star token.
You are completely immune to damage from bullets. If it's a bullet, it isn't hurting you, no matter the caliber, velocity, or who fired it.

An ominous-looking present that, when opened, summons a Frost Moon event. The surrounding area is invaded by hordes of holiday-themed enemies, which you can use as a distraction, or defeat it for valuable loot and well-earned bragging rights. Has to be used at night, also the event will end once the sun rises.

Sometimes referred to as the Fissure in the Fog or Miasma of Night. A preshistoric Frost Dragon that seems to always appear at moments of great importance. Her mastery of frost magic seem to have no equal and if she's ever forced in a losing position, she will unleash her true might to destroy all before her.

An 9.8MB application called 'MalO ver1.0.0' is automatically installed in the nearest owned device capable of displaying text and images (or your mind if you have no device). For the next 90 hours, the app will regularly text you images of places you have gone before and visit frequently but with a furred being with a skull face slowly getting closer and closer in the background. It then will slowly begin to appear in your field of vision until it's always beside you. The creature is non-malicious and capable of comunication if properly taught. May or may not cause severe distress. Pick up a spiritual interaction power to pet the dog.

You have turned into an instance of SCP-1471-A: a bipedal, skull-faced, black furred creature whose only notable skill is becoming invisible and imperceptible to anyone except for the person(s) of their choosing. It's entirely up to you if you end up a scraggly mass of fluff and bone, or a thicc furry dog waifu in an orange jumpsuit or anything else vaguely in that category. The choice is yours.
