An ornate silver ring from Wonderland, blessed by a god of wind. It boosts the agility and reflexes of its wearer massively.

A vial of a highly contagious, extremely mutagenic virus that normally turns people into surprisingly hard to kill zombies, but sometimes grants superhuman abilities to people with the right resistance. It can spread via injection, water, air, and direct fluid contact, so be careful where you put the virus. By default, you and your Familiars have the right resistances to make full use of the T-Virus without dying horrifically. Other allies may not be so lucky.

Exactly what it says. A beginner's guide to learning the magic of Nordic Runecraft, penned by the Allfather Odin. Anyone who reads it will gain a rudimentary understanding of how to use Runecraft, and will subsequently be able to do so with enough study, even if they weren't otherwise capable of magic.

A sword forged in the depths of the infernal realms. Expend energy to coat its blade in violent hellfire and massively boost its attack damage. Passively boosts fire based abilities and spells. Deals extra damage to holy entities.

The legendary sword in the stone, with the stone still attached. Still a holy blade, with a slightly less holy rock on top that can be used as an indestructible bludgeon. If you're worthy, you could also pull Excalibur from the stone, eventually.

Anyone that signs this contract will be added to your Omni Gacha system as a Familiar, with appropriate stats and rankings. Cannot be forced or coerced, the signer must give informed consent in order for it to work. Does not guarantee loyalty unless the clause is agreed upon. Also gives the signer access to Familiar space. Refreshes monthly.

Your Omni Gacha interface now has all the functions of an incredibly high powered smartphone with internet and cellular connectivity regardless of location, nigh infinite digital storage and RAM, a nigh unbreakable firewall, and processing power that outdoes entire server banks. Can also be manifested as an actual smartphone whenever you want. It even has games.

A rare cyberdeck model capable of unleashing the worst of all quickhacks: Blackwall Gateway. While also being able slot in multiple other quickhacks, the Canto's Blackwall Gateway quickhack allows you to rip open a hole in the Blackwall and forcibly upload an enemy's neural net into the unrestricted net for them to be torn to shreds for eternity by all manner of hostile AI, which also burns out all of their neurons in a horrifically painful and not particularly quick death. Yes, you get to send someone to Hell before they die. Works best on foes with cybernetic implants, or are otherwise robotic. Also comes with its own mildly evil AI. Comes as a voucher that auto-implants the deck into anyone who tears said voucher.
A fumo of one of the strongest oni in Gensokyo. By holding this fumo, or allowing it to sit on your head, you gain access to a C rank strength boost without wasting an ability slot.

You can make decent quality magical and otherwise enchanted items. Any magic you already know can be imbued into your item construction with relative ease. You could make a living selling some of this stuff.

A sword style created to emphasize acting like fire. It focuses on strong attacks and flickering in and out of range of the opponent. Particularly skilled users manifest an illusion of fire to accompany their attacks, which can be made real by channeling more energy into the style.
You're very intimidating, and can make other people afraid without much effort. You're good at instinctively presenting yourself in a way that evokes terror and fear in the average person.
You're damn good at cooking- you could make almost any meal and imbue it with amazing flavor. You could get a job as a private chef, or open a Michelin star restaurant.
You're damn good at sex. There's really not much to it- you can make just about anyone cum and know exactly which buttons to push for an amazing night for both of you.
You have natural resistance to all ice based effects, such as being frozen, cold weather, or more direct attacks like ice spikes. The stronger you are, the stronger your resistances.

In your time of need, a mysterious stranger in a trenchcoat and fedora will aid you for a moment with the help of his trusty revolver and perpetually shadowed face. Will always just be slightly too far away for you to reach before he conveniently vanishes. He won't solve your problems, but he'll make it easier to do so by shooting an enemy in the leg or disabling an otherwise unreachable trap. By the time you move past the need for a mysterious man with a gun, his last appearance will be him tossing a 3 Star token to you as a refund.

You are the world's Hero in training. Whether or not you become an actual Hero is up to you, but while you train, all Holy and Light abilities are enhanced and all blessings from higher authorities last longer.
All infernally aligned beings find you far more interesting, and you curry favor and affection with them far more easily. Or in other words: Demon girl harem.

No matter how exhausted or injured you are, no matter what conditions you're going through, you have a high enough level of discipline that the impact on your mental performance is negligible, and your physical performance remains at high level even if you would, otherwise, be dead on your feet. Additionally increases resistance to mental effects and negative statuses. Only lasts for so long until your body entirely gives out, though. You can't go forever.
You're remarkably good at shrugging off fear and panic. Not even god could tell you to be afraid at this point, because you'd just give 'em the finger.

Every form of competitive person vaguely in your field of interests (but mostly comprising anyone looking for a good fight) is drawn to you like a moth to a flame. The more those people test themselves against you, the easier it is to strike up a friendship with them and grow your skills together. All of your skills in any give area increase faster when competing against someone in your chosen field.

You're wonderful at communicating with your loved ones and lovers. You can understand them far more easily, and they in turn understand you as well. It doesn't exactly directly increase your ability to make a relationship better, it just makes you better at talking to someone you care about.

You want a harem? You're on the way to getting a harem. All of your prospective and current partners find it far easier to engage in nonmonogamous relationships around you, and society as a whole doesn't seem to mind much either. Also works for standard polyamory as well, not just harems.

It's kind of the other way around. Everyone around you now tries to rationalize away the things you do as some kind of normal thing that people just do sometimes. The more heinous, inexcusable, weird, or just otherwise abnormal the action, the harder it is for them to do so, though. No, people will not think open murder in the street is "normal" for you.

Destiny itself seems to think you're the main character of life, with all the ups and downs and downs and downs and ups that implies. You have great luck in every form, especially with getting yourself into trouble or otherwise challenging circumstances. You will never live a normal life again, but at least you're probably gonna end up a hero because of it.

The more you try to act terrifying or scary or otherwise intimidate someone, the more aroused anyone you think is attractive becomes. Also works vice versa, so you don't go screaming your head off when the hot vampire threatens to bite your throat out.

You've started your first steps on your magical journey! You memorize all spells faster and can cast with higher efficiency than most normal mages. You can learn just about any magical system without penalties, even if it isn't native to what you're used to.

Congratulations, you've been tuned up! All your health complications and minor injuries or lingering problems have been cleared up. Your genetic profile has been enhanced to just about the peak of your species, enhancing your potential and granting a very fit and healthy body in general. You might need to eat more now, but at least you get way more gains from the same amount of effort.

Cloak yourself in a swirling aura of flame that burns anything that comes near you. You and your allies are immune to the flames, thankfully, so you won't friendly-fire someone just by standing near them. Damage scales with your stats. While active, all fire based spells and abilities are additionally enhanced.

Shape and control any and all water that you have physical contact with. Your control has a high level of precision and force, and you can do anything from make blades to hammers to even launching projectiles- though once the water leaves the controlled mass you're touching, you can no longer affect it. The more energy you expend, the more water you can control at once and the more force you can apply.
Create and control snow. The more energy you expend, the stronger this ability gets.
Create and launch massive boulders at your enemies regardless of your actual strength level. No matter how big the boulder, you can always lob it to roughly 100 meters with one hand.
Create and control mud. The more energy you expend, the stronger this ability gets

Sink into shadows and travel inside and between them as if it were a high speed liquid. If the sun shines over the shadow while you're in it, or the shadow is otherwise removed, you take damage as if burned.

Create and control tendrils of pure void, each one capable of crushing, binding, throwing, and otherwise doing anything a prehensile tentacle can do. Deals extra memetic damage due to their incomprehensible nature. The tendrils share their sensations as well, if you wish. The more energy you spend, the more tendrils you can summon and the stronger they become.

Fire a beam of pure light and heat from your hands. Unlike most beams, this one does travel at near lightspeed at the tradeoff of lessened power. Still, with enough energy pumped in even this attack can go from laser cutter to Kamehameha.

Bathe a target in purifying light, clearing them of negative status effects, foreign substances, poisons, and certain non-injury related medical conditions. The more energy you spend, the stronger the purification. Does not work on some types of neurodivergence that are not actually illnesses.
Call down a pillar of holy light anywhere in your sensory range that burns, sears, and otherwise delivers crushing force to anything it hits while also dealing additional damage to unholy beings.

Bend light to your will in order to create highly convincing optical illusions capable of deceiving sight and even touch if concentrated enough- though, without practice, anyone that touches an illusion (solid or not) will usually figure out it's not real.

Create and control biological tentacles from your body that you can shape to your whims and use as bludgeons, whips, bindings, spears, locomotion... other activities... etc etc. The more energy you expend the more tentacles you can create and control at once.

Teleport instantly anywhere within your line of sight that isn't completely blocked off from access. You do need even a small through hole to look through to teleport through solid obstacles, sadly. You carry momentum through the jumps and can spam it about as much as you want, though if you do it too much you may incur intense vertigo. The more you practice, the further you can go in a single blink, and the faster you can teleport.

Create a hook and line from your energy. Anyone you catch with the hook can be teleported directly to you by reeling them back in, regardless of distance covered. The hook can additionally pass through solid objects while searching out your target. You can only target one person at a time with this, but collateral damage isn't counted for that purpose.

Transform into an Oni at will, granting enhanced strength and combat ability at the cost of a severe alcohol addiction and quite possibly a desire to ravish the nearest person of preferred gender. You also get a healing factor, and a weakness to holy attacks. You do your best work at night- the sun is slightly irritating to you while transformed.
By touching a target you can destroy all their clothing or armor
Allows you to accurately gauge your opponent's abilities and power level. Have fun making over 9000 jokes.

While touching an object you may soften it. This doesn't change any of it's other properties, only allows manipulating it like a pillow or similar soft object. Once you stop touching it, or will it, the object will settle back into it's previous hardness in whatever shape you've set it in.

The Cursed Flames welcome your call. By default you may send out glowing green fireballs that set enemies alight, but completely ignore anything inanimate. Should you have any fire generation abilities those may also produce Cursed Flames now.

At any point you may call a bow into your hands. The bow, and the arrows that come with it, are composed entirely of your energy and may be freely manipulated. In the arrows case, just until it leaves the bow. While the bow is in your hands, you are an excellent shot and will hit anything you're aiming at... provided it doesn't dodge in a way you don't anticipate. The arrows, and bow, scale with your Magic or Might, whichever is higher.

Poof! You can explode yourself into a cloud of rose petals and rapdily travel to a nearby location. The petals constitute your physical body, and harm to them will harm you. Additionally, things which attack things which aren't corporeal can also harm you directly in this state. With training you can fly or bring other people into the cloud with you, though it will never not be straining to do so.

Make zombies. Or skeletons. Or other undead things. At first it will only work on small, recently dead corpses, but with training you can use dark energies to bring back even ancient giants... as long as there are ancient giants. The quality of the undead depends on how much power you use and the quality of the corpse. You may only keep an amount of undead around equal to your Magic.
You can create and control razor sharp leaves! They're somewhat more durable than regular leaves, but fire will annihilate them just fine. The amount and sharpness scale with your Magic.

You may manipulate your blood in order to make small orbs, regardless of where it is. Even your own severed limbs can provide the blood, so long as your blood is still there. These orbs are entirely controlled by you and are capable of detonating at will with about the power of an equivalently sized gunpowder bomb. Popping the orbs isn't easy, but if done the orbs will prematurely explode.
You're better at wind. Any wind/air abilities are stronger. You also have the ability to slightly mess with the air directly around you, just enough to control a fall or double jump.

A parasite that will replace the users hair. Samson is incapable of living independently and generally rather foul mouthed. He is capable of manipulating his body, which resembles hair, into various shapes to fight, including sharpening it and enlarging his mouth.

A curvy tanned woman, Libra is a capable fighter but claims gravity manipulation as her primary talent. Capable of manipulating her own or other's gravity to make them lighter or heavier. She's rather calm and ready to follow orders, but does enjoy the sight of a foe kneeing before her.

A warrior monk, Lucario is a bipedal, jackal looking Pokemon. They can sense Aura, the energy of living things, and with training read it to see others emotions, track it, speak telepathically using it, and manipulate it to attack. The more danger a Lucario is in, the deeper they can tap into their own well of Aura, becoming stronger as they get more injured. This Lucario comes complete in a Pokeball, of a gender you choose, ready to serve as you their trainer. Just don't be evil- they're genetically inclined toward justice and won't hesitate to stop you.

A premium assassin droid, if rather obvious. A master at marksmanship and sensing, as well as rather skilled at a variety of tasks that are involved in bounty hunting. Comes with their own weapons- guns suited for the time period which they are fully capable of keeping properly repaired.
A shining golden apple. Eating it will grant you a small amount of damage resistance and fire resistance, mild regeneration, and an immense surge of vitality. You get one a week.

Business ownership is a blessing, and now you've got it! You are the proud owner of a small onsen, located whever you decide to plant it. It isn't inherently magical in any way, but you can modify it however you like with the powers you get. Including turning the water into different water, such a Jusenkyo Spring curse water, so long as you have a sample.

A single syringe filled with a blue chemical. Taking Compound V will modify your body to produce more of the compound and grant a single random superpower. Roll a 2 star token limited to abilities to see what you get.

A flat white featureless mask. When worn there is no power capable of revealing the user's face- only physically breaking the mask will reveal them. The person wearing the mask can see through it perfectly.
A simple golden charm depicting a eclipse. It seems to absorb the sun's rays instead of reflecting them. While holding it, any enemy within a large range around you finds themselves slightly weaker.
A bag of infinite arrows fletched with angel feathers. Don't ask where the feather came from. The arrows are just all around better than normal arrows, but ultimately aren't special beyond that.

Money money mon-ey! This bag produces a thousand pure gold coins every single day. If you place a coin inside the bag, it will automatically make coins near identical to that one in quantity equivalent to a thousand gold coins as sold on the general market every day. Don't worry- nobody is going to call you on counterfeiting them.

A black war dagger with a bone hilt. Still dripping with the poison of the beast that dropped it, this dagger can paralyze foes and the venom will gradually ravage their body. Eventually resulting in death if not treated or overcome in time. Otherwise, the dagger has acceptable power, but isn't very special.
A complete, sterilized copy of Wolverine adamatium skeleton. It's... basically indestructible. And. That's all. You just have a metal skeleton.

A Grade katana with a white hilt, Wado Ichimonji is absurdly sharp and durable, able to cleave through steel and masses of ice without stopping or suffering damage. As long as the skill behind the blade is sufficient.

Several bars of Stygian Iron, a pitch black metal. Weapons made of this material devour the spirit as well as harm the body, capable of harming immortals and permanently trapping the souls of that which it kills. Perfect for dealing with liches and other foes that ressurect themselves.

A belt that once belonged to a master ninja. It entirely removes the noise you make when moving, ensures you always fall on your feet without harm, allows you to stick to walls, and even allows you to manage those sweet acrobatics you could never do otherwise.

Wish I had a portal gun. Now you do! This portal gun will fire two portals, one blue and one orange, that connect to each other. Modified to work on just about any white, solid surface, or anything not specifically meant to stop it from working.

Now with isotopes! Drinking Bonk! will give you about a eight seconds of total invulnerability and endless energy. Unfortuantely, you're moving so unfathomably fast that attempting to interact with anything will just break it. You can still punch your enemies at least. Comes in Cherry Fission or Blutonim Berry flavor.

Spider-Man's web shooters! Attach them to your hands and use the provided formula to fire out sticky strands of incredibly strong webbing. It'll take some practice to do the stuff Spider-man does, and does not come with superhuman abilities. You get one load of fluid every 24 hours, but you can figure out the formula and make it yourself.

A eye shaped glass charm with a blue stone, fashioned into a fashionable little pendant. Absorbs and resists curses targeted at you, though it can only manage so much power. The first time you're targeted by a curse Magic B or greater the Nazar will stop it, but break in the process.
Grow Your Own Darkroot Garden Kit

Your very own hostile garden in a box! Contains everything required to recreate Darkroot garden from scratch, including Purple Moss, Red Moss, Mushroom People, Ents, and various other flora and fauna. Comes with a bonus of quickly devouring bodies for nutrients! If you happen to need to get rid of some.

Your very own Yuuka Kazami fumo. When placed onto the bare earth will help crops grow within a small range around. Otherwise somehow improves the user's abilities with plants, both mundanely and in terms of any ability which manipulates or interacts with plants.

A heavy ornate key constantly covered in frost. When used as if unlocking a door opens a portal to a large area of tundra completely separate from the outside world. The area has frequent blizzards and snowstorms and remains cold year round. If you're lucky you might even catch the Northern Lights.

A small key on a chain. When used as if opening a door will create a portal into a small dojo. The dojo has both an indoor section and a well maintained outdoor garden. Within the dojo is everything required to practice any ability you are interested in practicing, including some low level beginner guides. Anything broken will be replaced or repaired every day and nothing inside the dojo may be removed from it. Any roll which grants knowledge will also improve the dojo, enabling it to manifest the things required to practice that skill no matter what it is.
A rather normal looking mace blessed by holy forces. Pretty good for smiting evil.

A ring resembling the head of a wolf. While wearing this any transformation abilties will be enhanced, allowing exacting control of the transformation and the ability to utilize it even when it would normally be impossible. Also grants the ability to transform into a werewolf.

The art of the blade. Or one of them at least. You've got a good amount of skill at utilizing the draw of your weapon as part of your attacks. Whether this is drawing your katana, pulling a revolver out of it's holster, or something even more esoteric, doesn't matter. You've just got the knack for making your first move their last.

You know how to act! Which includes all of the duties people don't usually think about. Proper makeup, wardrobe, lighting, and similar effects are within your knowledge and you've got quite the bag of trick to sell any performance.

Light the forge! Swinging a hammer to beat metal into shape is something you've got a good idea about. You're not going to be making any legendary equipment without some practice, but more common tools are no issue.
Has it got a long shaft? Then you know how to work it! Halberds, scythes, spears, and similar weapons feel right in your hands, and you can comfortably wield them against your enemies.

You know just how to work your fingers. Locks are no trouble, magic tricks are easy, and know just the thing to poke to get an engine to start. You aren't quite as good as someone who really studied any of that, but you've got a really broad range of things you're pretty good at. More than enough to get into places you shouldn't and keep things going for just a little longer.

Gentlemen. You're a full fledged spy, able to get in, get the information, and get out. Not the James Bond type either- you're the person who goes in to figure out who Bond should be flying out to deal with. Stealth, picking locks, breaking codes, impersonating, and the like are as easy as breathing.

One of any number of techniques that allows the user to quickly close with an opponent. It doesn't work for long distances, about the length of a room, and takes some effort to use, but it would take someone very skilled to react properly to this technique. The exact method you use will be unique to you, but you're guaranteed to have one.

People just seem to give you the benefit of the doubt. Anything you do they will attempt to justify, according to their own morals and understanding of the situation. This doesn't mean they won't attempt to stop you, but they'll likely not try too hard to find you while assuming you have a good reason. Though this will only go so far.

Whenever you win, you get something. That's just how it works. You may invoke this upon the completion of any form of competition or bet and obtain something from the loser proportional to what the competition or bet was. Of course, your opponent can do it to you if they know of this effect. No matter who this is used on they're compelled to comply with nothing more than some grumbling.

People are just calmer around you. Your very existence is one with a sort of unearthly grace and tranquility, enough that people are much less likely to get angry or annoyed when in your direct presence. Though on the other hand, everyone is going to notice when you walk into a room. So stealth is a bit of an issue.

The world speaks and you can listen. It isn't the clearest thing, but clear enough to help you avoid danger and find the exact thing you're looking for. Though beware- a city may not always have your best wishes at heart.

When you reach near death your body gets hardier. Skin thickens, defenses surge, and you have just a bit more to give. Once you're healed the state will go away, and its all or nothing- getting hit hard enough can kill you without this activating.
You really are an empath. You can easily tell what people are feeling, understand emotions better, and how to control your own far better.

You can smell magic and mysticism. You can decipher the scents of people to learn more about them from their magic. A necromancer might have the stench of death and decay on them. Ice magicians may smell like crisp winter air. Etc.

You are a natural with cold, your ice-based abilities cost less energy, and your natural ice and cold resistance are increased. You recover energy faster the colder you are but slower the hotter you are.

80 years ago in the Yggdrasil System, the maiden voyage of the Ratatosk Express departed. It was lady Odin's passion project, the trip through the bifrost was meant to cut a three month trip into three days. But instead it vanished. Now it's here, crashing out of a rainbow tunnel infront of you. The smart thing to do would be to leave it, but you know it has a blackbox on board. and it's calling to you to figure out what happened. Maybe you can even learn how to pilot it.

Not a literal maid, but close enough. Nobody is going to notice you enter a room and even if they do they're going to dismiss you quickly. You're just one of the help- nobody worth paying attention to. They won't even think it odd for you to be in normally restricted areas, though they might ask for identification if you make too much of a ruckus. Bad for when you want to dramatically say something, great for being sneaky.

Real Name Romeo F. Neumann, Bedman is a two for one deal, a reinforced hyper augmented model 7 autonomous Bedframe Device, and Romeo himself. An unabashed genius, arrogant, and with an incredibly verbose vocabulary, these aspects of Bedman can only show themselves in places where his dreaming mind is allowed to come to the surface without awakening his body, which will die without proper precautions. Ruthless and contemptuous, Bedman has lines he refuses to cross, and refuses to kill young girls out of a reminder of his sister. If his body should be augmented to handle his extreme intelligence, he will become a very loyal ally. Should he be reunited with Delilah, he might outright die for you without asking.

Though the body may die, the Soul lives on. Bedman's very essence has infused itself into his bedframe, with only one thought in mind. Protecting Delilah. Delilah herself is a kind though very insecure girl. She is highly intelligent, and will talk down to people similar to her brother in a lengthy manner, though she is also frustrated by her own child-like emotions. Without social skills, Delilah navigates the world with help from her Bedframe where she senses the spirit of her brother. Bedman? Will defend Delilah with its entire existence. As long as you can protect her, it will assist you as well.

The dinosaurs didn't die out, they simply evolved. Now you're proof of it. Pick a dinosaur, you are now a humanoid with the traits of that dinosaur, further augmented by cybernetic implants and mechanical battle armor. Only when near death do your abilities reach their peak, a state that you get closer and closer to as you use your abilities.
You've got the start of the technology utilized by the dinomorphia. This includes not only exceptionally powerful augmeted battle suits, but massive robotic dinosaurs as well.
Battle suits, battle suits, battle suits. You've got the knowledge to make an almost endless number of battle suits each focused on one specific thing that can be swapped between at will.

Focusing on police actions for and by mutants. Create restraints capable of holding superpowered individuals as well as battle armor perfectly suited to bringing out the absolute limit of the abilities of a mutant. This armor is by default locked behind an access code which only you have, but you may leave it permanetly active if you wish.

You have mutated. Pick a yokai or similar being- you now have powers similar to them. The more you use those powers, the more you transform into looking like that creature to the point where you leave behind your human form completely. This is distinct from being actually that entity in that it is purely a mutation, and cannot be stopped by things which suppress or remove magic abilties.

Not technically a race change. You have a much higher affinity and sense for spatial manipulation and magic to the point that you could sense portals opening from a kilometer away. All spatial abilities and effects are more potent and easier to learn.

You no longer suffer any penalties from race changes, augmentations, or anything that makes you deviate from your original birth body. All augments and changes integrate seamlessly and at higher efficacy. Yes, that includes HRT. You go girl. Or guy.

Hallelujah! You're now a bog standard angel- two fluffy white wings and a halo and everything. You have slightly increased stats in all regards, natural flight, and extremely boosted Holy and Light based abilities and effects. All dark, unholy, infernal, or otherwise "evil" powers are correspondingly weakened, and you now take extra damage from those same sources.

You possess vastly enhanced physical strength and stats, allowing you to exert more force with your body than you otherwise would have been able to- ie, you can punch, kick, grapple, crush, etc, way harder than you should be able to.

You've been deputized by the heavenly or otherwise holy realm to assist in purifying evil in all its many forms. You have increased affinity towards Holy and Light effects as well as some measure of spiritual affinity, plus the ability to sense unholy and otherwise evil spirits. It's up to you to either kick them out painfully or send them peacefully to the afterlife.

An adherent to Gravelord Nito. A Gravelord Servant is undead, needing no sleep or sustenance, and skilled in cursing others, able to inflict them with hallucinations of enemies that can harm them just the same as a real one. Beware- cursing them establishes a connection that will allow them to teleport to you once they find the curse mark, and the only way they can end the curse is by killing you. There is no distance limit to cursing others, and curses other than the hallucinations may be applied. Though you'll have to learn those yourself.

When in skin contact with water, you now passively absorb it to increase your energy recovery. The more powerful, magical, or otherwise energy rich the water, the more effective it is. Yes, that includes radiation, it's literally energy rich.

Set anything aflame on contact, either from the outside in or the inside out. Or just cause it all to combust at once. The stronger a target, the harder it is to set them on fire. With training, you can also ignite adjacent objects or spread it to entire groups of targets.

Unleash pure heat from your body in waves- either directed or omnidirectional- with enough temperature to instantly ignite or desiccate anything that the waves touch. The stronger the target, the more they can resist the effects, though.

Create ice constructs at will out of thin air or nearby surfaces. While you can impart momentum to launch your constructs or use them as traps, you lose control over them after they finish conjuring. The more energy you expend, the bigger the constructs get- weapons, projectiles, an entire iceberg, so on and so forth.

Conjure, shape and control powerful gales of wind and air strong enough to knock down small buildings if you wanted. The more energy spent, the stronger the gales get. You could even replicate a tornado.

Wield, control, create, and fire off frozen lightning- icy blue arcs of electricity that freeze whatever they touch at a temperature range so cold it shouldn't be physically possible. Might actually be more dangerous than regular lightning that way. Still works like regular lightning when used to power an item, though.

Create weapons, attacks, or shields from condensed sand and wind, each one thoroughly capable of matching up to any mundane blade. Make a sword, a shield, a hammer, or just throw a razor sharp mini sandstorm at someone. The possibilities are endless.

Granted unto someone your blessing. You may bless them with a general physical increase, a general magical increase, or any Passive or Ability under C rank which you have. Nobody may have more than one blessing active on them at a time, but you may grant multiple different people different blessings at the same time. The more energy you place into the blessing the longer it lasts.

Emit a healing light capable of repairing even severe or mortal wounds. Effect scales with your energy output and magical strength. Stronger targets need more energy to heal. With enough energy, you could put someone's head back on their shoulders if you get there fast enough.

While active, your body continuously improves itself as though you were constantly working out and recovering at the same time, just without any of the side effects of working out save the spent energy. With enough time, you can reach the absolute peak of your body's biology, or go even beyond that with more energy spent. If you actually work out with this ability active, you get roughly three times the gains for the same effort.

Sense and telepathically command any and all vermin creatures within your natural sensory range- mice, rats, insects, squirrels, anything that's generally considered either a pest or undesirable creature. The more energy you use, the further the range of the ability, and the more complex the commands you can issue.

Converts pain and injury into stored energy that can be unleashed via ability, spell, or any attack with devastating effect. The more injured you become, the stronger you get until you gain a roughly 50x boost in attack potency when you're on your last legs.

Telekinetically target and manipulate any item weighing less than your total lifting strength with high precision and ability, as if it were your own limb. Also allows you to use any of that item's features, abilities, built-in effects, or enchantments remotely even if you wouldn't normally be able to. Yes, you can bootstrap yourself with a broom if you wanted to and you had enough power to handle it.

Telekinetically manipulate anything you have direct contact with- either by keeping it together while lifting to make it look like you have super strength, or crush it instantly with a touch. The more powerful the target, the more they can resist with their own strength.

Build, design, and modify any technology or constructs relating to hacking, hijacking, interfacing, and otherwise manipulating technology in ways that others don't generally want you to do. What you use that hacking prowess for is entirely up to you, just pick an appropriate hat color when you decide.

Harden anything you touch or are vaguely in contact with, while still keeping its physical properties. Harden the air to make an invisible barrier, harden fire to make a burning hot projectile, harden water to make... uh. Ice? Items return to their normal consistency, shape, and physical state over the course of seconds to minutes when you dispel the effect.
Control and create bronze, allowing you to form weapons, armor, constructs, even buildings out of the stuff. The more energy you spend, the more bronze you can generate or otherwise control.
Your body absorbs kinetic energy like a sponge, reducing the effectiveness of physical attacks against you. It can be overwhelmed, though, so don't think you're invincible just with shock absorption.

You are able to produce and control silk that you produce from your body, you can use it to grapple around, restrain targets, fasten objects etc. The durability of the silk and the amount you can produce scales with your physical stats.

Every consecutive hit you make within 3 seconds of the last adds to a combo meter. The more you fill the combo meter, the stronger your hits get. Every hit adds roughly 0.1x additional power to your attacks, up to a maximum of 999x, which would take nearly 10000 hits. If you fail to land a hit in 3 seconds, your combo resets. Works with any attack that deals physical damage.

Store up energy to be used at your discretion, allowing you to vastly multiply the power of any single action- a punch, a kick, a jump, a fireball, etc. The more energy you store, the more potent the result.

Conjure a phantasmal compass in your hands. As long as you know the target you're looking for, and have something related to that target in your possession, the compass will point directly at the target no matter how far away it is.

You may instantly teleport to the location of your foresight, dispelling it, or otherwise leave it there until it dissipates either by damage, distance, or being left alone for one hour. You start with one, but can create more images and expand the range of travel with training.

Spawn a zone labeled as Icarus' Folly. Any sapient being that exceeds ten meters in height relative to the floor (that is, anyone standing inside a skyscraper won't burn just because they're high off the actual ground) will be burnt by a solar inferno. The higher that being gets, the more damage they take and the hotter the flames around them. All beings inside of the zone are aware of its effects. The more energy you expend, the wider the zone and the more punishing the heat. Starts with a minimum of 20 meters in diameter.

Heal yourself and others by expending energy with no technical limits to the injury you can resolve. The more immediately lethal a wound or injury, the more energy you need to expend to heal it. The stronger a target is, the more effort it takes to heal them, lessened if they willingly receive your healing.

Design, build, and modify any technology or constructs related to the manipulation of gravity. You could make anti-gravity thrusters, Zero-G fields, gravity anchors, increased weight training rooms, etc etc. It'll take you a while to get to the good stuff like black hole launchers and alcubierre drives, though.

Conjure spectral ammunition for any weapon in your possession. Spectral ammunition mimics the properties of the ammunition it's patterned after, with almost the exact same ballistic characteristics. The more energy you expend, the harder the ammunition hits and the more you can make. If you wish, you can even imbue the ammunition with your abilities for even greater effect.

The flames of Hell are now yours to control. Any flame you create may now instead be drawn from Hell itself, and you cause great pillars of fire even without any other pyrokinetic ability. Hell Flames seek out the sin in souls and burns according to how deep they are. Saints will be unaffected, but the vilest of sinners will burst into flame even with a small ember.

The gentle light of the Heaven's may shine down where you will. Any light manipulating ability may now instead use Holy Light instead and you may bathe an area in Holy Light at will. The Light of Heaven strikes down with unending fury, stripping away excuse and circumstance to lay bare and judge the sins of any soul that encounters them. The unrepentant will be annihilated, while others may be unharmed or given a chance to repent.

Temporarily summon a low-ranking (D rank or lower) Angel or Holy Spirit from the Heavenly Realm. The summon is bound to your will and requires a constant supply of energy to allow them to stay summoned or use their magic/abilities. If slain, the summoned angel will be restored in the Heavenly Realm and can be summoned again later. The more energy you supply, the more power they can exert. You may permanently bind an Angel to you by performing a long prayer ceremony and sacrificing an appropriate amount of valuables and energy.

Summon a lesser (D rank or lower) spirit of nature from a sufficient amount of fertile ground. The stronger you are, the stronger the spirit you can manifest. Summons require a constant supply of energy to stay manifested and use their abilities. The stronger a spirit, the more energy it costs to maintain them. Spirits will be unsummoned when not fed enough energy. You may permanently bind a nature spirit by expending enough energy and resources.
Share your emotions with someone by touch, and vice versa. Pain, happiness, anger, hatred, joy, love, etc etc. Unwilling and powerful targets require more effort to establish a stable link.

Conjure a spectral construct in the shape of a vehicle that you're familiar with the inner workings of. There's functionally no limit to this, though the larger and more complex a vehicle is, the more energy it takes to create and maintain. Also makes it easier to understand and familiarize yourself with the internal components of any vehicle even at a glance.

Temporarily convert one of your Familiars into a vaguely appropriate weapon of the same rank as that familiar, with the ability to use their own powers, magics, and spells through that weapon. Should the weapon be broken, your Familiar will return to their normal shape with a wound in roughly the same place and with roughly the same severity.

A bipedal fox-like pokemon capable of manipulating Dark type energy to attack and create incredibly realistic and potent illusions to either confuse up to hundreds of people at once, transform into other pokemon, or otherwise just play pranks.

An assassin of the Black Knife group, who slew Godwyn the Golden on the Night of Black Knives. She's not only an incredibly skilled assassin, but also carries a blade imbued with the Rune of Death, allowing it to fire off blade-like projectiles and reduce an enemy's health massively with a single blow. The wounds inflicted by the Rune of Death continue to do damage over time and fester without healing.

A light blue slime girl with green hair. She has a pretty innocent personality on the surface, but is also quite intelligent and capable if need be. She can absorb and digest most organic matter, is largely invulnerable to physical strikes due to her liquid body, and can shapeshift and change her body composition based on her fluid consumption. She also requires a fair amount of water, otherwise she dehydrates.

A pink haired maid with great power and skill in Earth Magic, allowing her to dig through the ground like she's swimming, throw boulders, or bury enemies. She can also transform to suit her user's tastes, manipulate the chains on her wrists, and fight in hand to hand combat. She's also a huge masochist.

A massive, canine-like alien roughly the size of a car. It possesses quill-like fur that it can launch out at will, extremely powerful muscles capable of shredding steel in an instant, powerful fangs that could bite through steel just as easily, and a surprising sense of acrobatics and vertical movement. While blind, it possesses an incredible sense of hearing and smell, capable of tracking targets for miles and echolocating their surroundings with extremely high precision.

A Leviathan type monster resembling an eastern dragon. It has fur, scales, fins, and the ability to move swiftly on land and in water. Its primary ability is secreting soapy fluid from its body that it shapes into slippery bubbles to cause opponents to lose their footing and make itself effectively frictionless. It can also spray high pressure water from its mouth and set its bubbles aflame when enraged. They get extremely pissy during mating season, so be careful.

A tiny organism (sealed in a glass vial) that burrows into living flesh and merges with it, allowing it to manipulate the portion of the body they're connected to and shapeshift it freely. If they burrow into a person's brain, they can control them entirely. If multiple embed into the same body, the resulting fusion becomes exponentially more powerful. Fortunately the one that you get is friendly, and will largely follow your own goals and ambitions.

The perfect Hollow vessel, child of the Pale King. Short and yet carrying god-slaying power within its body, it is an incredibly skilled fighter with its Nail, wields horrifically powerful magics both Void and not, and may or may not be a literal god stuffed into a 3 foot tall baby thing. It doesn't talk much, if at all, but it will bow to worth opponents before a fight.

The child of the Pale King and Herrah the Beast, and the daughter of three mothers. She's highly skilled with armed and unarmed combat, and wields a mighty needle as well as several dozen tools all tucked under her cloak. She is also capable of weaving divine silk from her own Soul, allowing her to bind enemies, grapple, traverse, heal her own wounds, and more. While she speaks in an alien tongue, you and your allies can nevertheless understand her speech, if not anything she writes down. She may or may not have a thing for a certain being woven from silk.

An Ox Shikigami of great physical power. Alongside being a very physically powerful shikigami, the Piercing Ox has the ability to get stronger the longer it goes in a straight line. In addition, as a Shikigami, the power of the Piercing Ox scales with your own energy levels.

A massive Djungarian hamster with a snake-like tail, known as the Wise King of the Forest. She's surprisingly strong and uncommonly durable, capable of killing a man in an instant even through armor. She can also cast roughly D-rank magic due to the sigils on her body. She'd really like to find a mate to continue her species, but hasn't had any luck so far.

A state-of-the-art autonomous six-legged walking tank armed with automated flechette cannons, a high power laser cannon, machine guns, a missile launcher, poison gas, smoke screens, explosive reactive leg armor, a sophisticated cyberdefense system, and automatic self-repair bots. Unfortunately vulnerable to attacks from above. This one has been modified so the pilot AI actually has a bit of a personality, much like an animal.

A potion in the form of a syringe. Upon injection, it grants extremely fast energy and mana regeneration for ten minutes, but results in mana sickness when the effect wears off, causing energy restoring consumables to damage your organs and reduce your magical or energetic output after said consumption.
A sleeping mask blessed by Hypnos, the god of sleep, when wearing this mask, your nights are perfectly restful and all of your energy recovers after 8 hours of uninterrupted sleep.
A pouch containing a bunch of magical bean seeds that when planted grow over the course of 24 hours to create a stem that is 50 meters thick and extends into space.

A magic tattoo kit. When used by someone it allows them to tattoo another perfectly and infuse that tattoo with an ability they have or know how to utilize. The granted ability is never as strong as the original and costs the exact same. Also can make really sick tattoos that move and stuff.

A double barrel shotgun with a cross serving as the sight. Any rounds loaded into this weapon will be charged with holy energy, increasing the damage they do to demons, sinners, and similar while reducing the damage they do to saints, angels, and similar.

A book which contains 1000 V.I.P Passes that allow to go anywhere and access any area as a V.I.P. for the price of a single pass. Each pass transforms to match the required specifications for an event and is destroyed after use. The book is destroyed when no more V.I.P. passes are left.

A masterpiece katana, it serves ably as both a weapon and a casting focus thanks to being made of glintstone. Swinging it with focus will send out slashes of blue light, and it works exceptionally well with iai techinques.
A crystal orb filled with almost glittering sand. When on your person it improves earth based abilities significantly

You are given a grand altar! This altar has water constantly moving within it, and when placed gradually takes in ambient energy to spawn water elementals. These elementals naturally resemble entirely reptilian lamia, but can be modified if you figure out how. The elementals are naturally loyal to you.

An overly ornate red ring. It sizes itself perfectly to the wearer and attracts wealth. You still need to actually act on what it brings, but you'll have plenty of opportunities to make money. Just be aware that the ring doesn't care how the money comes, just that it does. More than a few of those opportunities may involve some illegal or immoral things.
Affection in a voucher. Rip it and the person you think about likes you a whole lot more via retcon and causality bending. No side effects but your own guilt.

A staff that resembles a large flower. Or perhaps a large flower that serves as a staff. When used on dirt will cause grass to immediately grow. When utilized in the growing or harvesting of plants improves their yield and ensuring that the plant will produce enough seeds to plant another.

A vial of blood sourced directly from a Blood Saint cultivated by the Healing Church, contains potent traces of the Old Ones, granting it great healing power, capable of healing even severe injuries and illnesses. Beware that the blood of Yharnam can have addictive effects, and overuse can cause people who are susceptible to devolve into a beast.
The most genius ice fairy is now available in fumo form! Charge the fumo with energy and smack an opponent with it to freeze them solid! Results may vary based on the amount of energy used.

A most interesting fumo... so long as this is held healing abilities and skill will be just that much better, and when placed on someone's head will grant them the skill of a journeyman doctor for as long as it remains.

A large ornate key. When used as if opening a door, leads to a massive bath house sufficient to satify every need. Provided it's a need that is expected to be satisfied in a bath house. It's staff are entirely composed of female homunculi who are... acceptable at short conversation, but fantastic at running a bath house. Using the bath house signficantly increases healing and the speed at which energy recovers. The portal remains open where you opened it so anyone can walk in, and the homunculi will accept any guest without comment or question. If requested, any guest may be granted a personal attendant that looks like whatever they wish.

Force every cell in your body to work at complete one-hundred percent efficiency for hours to days. The longer you keep this up, the longer you'll suffer being weaker once you turn it off. While active you benefit from significantly increased stats, faster healing, and a general increase in efficiency.

You've got a good grounding in Bajiquan, a Chinese martial art focused on explosive short ranged hits utilizing the whole body. What it lacks in any ranged ability it more than makes up for in sheer destructive power.

Outsmart this. You're going to hit what you're aiming at, no matter the weapon you're doing it with. So long as it shoot something, you've got it down. Not enough to pull out crazy trick shots, but when it comes to putting that other guy down you won't suffer a single problem.

Why not stab them? Any weapons that has a blade now feels entirely natural in your hands. You aren't going to be pulling off super special moves or anything, but you've got practice in the basics and you know how to go about sticking the pointy end into your enemies.

Eating? Not for you! You may obtain any nutrients you need through the simple act of standing in the sun. This also slightly improves recovery and energy generation rate. You still need air and water though.

Magic hands! You know the exact right way to pat someone on the head to the point where it's magic. Giving someone a headpat with calm them, dispell possession, mind control, and similar effects, and make them feel relaxed. More if they're into that.

Wade through the fire. Fire, and other methods of burning, are far less effective on you scaling with your Might. This is lessened on special types of fire but still provides some protection. Does not extend to clothes.

Stick a fork into a socket! It won't hurt at all. Lighting and other electric powers have reduced effectiveness on you, scaling with your Might. To the point where you could take lightning bolts all day and end up fine. Naked though, since this doesn't extend to clothes.

The faint sounds of endless wards against curses echo around you. Attempting to curse you with anything less than a C rank Magic effect flat out doesn't work, and higher curses are less devastating and stick around for less time. Doesn't apply to curses obtained from the gacha.

When you're close to dying you start doing more damage. Your weapons are sharper, richocets inexplicably hit better, and in general anything you're hurting is going through more pain than expected. It's an all or nothing effect, but it lasts as long as you're pretty injured.

Building things is just... easy. You move faster through your tech trees, find it it simple to repair machines, and in general are all around just better at making things. So long as you put your mind to it and don't mind taking the steps, you can make things that defy physics and warp reality.
You drank your milk and now it's paying off. Your bones are a lot harder to break and can absorb shock far better.

The Divine know you're the one they can count on. Expect to recieve a lot more godly attention and support, to the point where receiving random blessings is a usual occurance, but equally be expected to help solve problems the gods are having. While you may reject a blessing know that gods generally aren't happy hearing 'no'.

The Heavens smile on you! Well, they smile on most people, but you most of all. Being aligned with the heavens and holy are more attracted to you and you find it easier to understand their intentions.

When hope runs out, your guns click empty, you've lost more blood than you should, and your backs against the wall just know- you aren't going gently. In any situation where you are nearly defeated you get a sudden boost in power just in time. It doesn't guarantee winning the fight, but you're going to be fighting at about a 150% power until the situation is finished.

This time the warranty actually does something! Should any item you obtained from the gacha, in the process of being used for it's intended purpose, be destroyed or rendered unusable we'll give you a completely identical replacement the next day for free. Does not apply if the item was given away, deliberately destroyed, sacrificed, or is intended to break on or after use.

You've got a lot. Lot of what? Whatever it is. Chakra, Cursed Energy, Qi, Mana, whatever! It's not an absurd amount but you've got more in the tank than most of your peers. About equivalent to someone who was born toward the top end of natural power.

Lewd things just happen to you. The school just went to co-ed, locks fail, sounds get muffled, and in the end you're going to get a lot of looks at the gender you're attracted to naked or in otherwise compromising positions. What's more is that nobody ever seems to blame you for it, while they may be temporarily mad or irritated nothing serious will happen in response to any of these incidents.

You're an exemplar of humanity. No, even beyond that. You are the peak of genetic achievement, the absolute limit of what humanity might be able to achieve. An unquestionable one person army capable of defeating modern military forces and punching the ground to stop earthquakes. What's more is that you are an exemplar of your gender as well, embodying absolute perfection so much that everybody else looks like cheap imitations.

Choose an animal. You are now part that animal. This may either be on the low end, resulting in simple physical changes like claws, fangs, ears, and some fur, or high end, resulting in you looking like a humanoid bipedal version of that animal. You gain increased strength, speed, and stamina, plus improved senses of smell and sight. Possibly more depending on the exact animal and whether you are on the low or high end.

You may manifest a rather fancy looking wooden wardrobe at any point that can store any amount of clothing, jewelry, and various other its worn on the body. Once inside the wardrobe you may choose to appear to be wearing that item overriding your current appearance. You still maintain the full benefits of what you're actually wearing and as a bonus it's made just as comfortable as if you're wearing what you appear to be wearing.
Marathon? No problem! Your stamina is sufficient to run two even!

Bound eternally in armor, you have become a Death Knight. As a higher level undead, you don't need to ear, sleep, or rest and lesser undead will listen to you unless already controlled by another. While you have some skill with necromancy, being able to raise corpses on your own and fire blasts of necrotic energy, your true skill lies in physical combat. It turns out being tireless and constantly using full strength is quite dangerous

Darkness? Nothing scary about it! You have a natural resistance to anything that uses shadows or darkness to attack, even metaphorically. This scales with your Might. You also see slightly better in the dark.

A small sapling of the Jewel Tree Adam. With proper care this can grow nearly infinitely, towering over the landscape and providing extremely durable wood. Able to ignore cannon fire with ease, though being wood it's still vulnerable to fire.

A sapling suspended in water. If planted and grown it can get tall enough to reach air even from the ocean floor. When it absorbs sunlight it actually transfers that light to it's roots, lighting up the area it's been planted.

A small patch that resembles that of watermelons. It will grow Weather Balls, orbs that can contain and manipulate the weather. If multiple are used the effects grow larger and larger, even able to manipulate the weather over vast swathes of the world. Though it takes time, experimentation, and training to use them to their fullest.

Arrows fashioned from a meteorite that also contained a virus designed to wipe out human life on Earth, the Stand Arrow will catalyze and awaken the Stand of any living creature they pierce, provided the target has sufficient spiritual strength. Without this strength, contact with the arrow is fatal, although the Arrows only seek out those who will survive in most cases. A second piercing can potentially awaken a new effect in a stand, or perhaps awaken it further.

Turn people into dinosaurs! You know the process to properly splice dinosaur DNA into anyone, either in part or in full, keeping their human form or making them truly monstrous. Also you can bring back dinosaurs, if you want. Also includes minor regenerative effects.

A mighty weapon only made to fight geologists as all their senses make it impossible to see this weapon when there are rocks nearby. It's a really sturdy wooden bat made of mahogany. Pairs well with an obsidian knife.

Every morning you will orgasmically lay between one a dozen eggs. These eggs are almost identical to chicken eggs in appearance, taste, and nutrition. This only functions if your womb isn't otherwise occupied by pregnancy or other effects and abilities. If you didn't have a womb and vagina before.... congrats!

You become a Mobian—an animal person, typically shorter than humans with large heads, hands, and feet. Choose any Earth-based animal, insect, or reptile and gain supernatural versions of its natural abilities. Mobians possess superhuman speed, agility, strength, durability, and healing, alongside abilities like the Spin Dash and Homing Attack, and can grow stronger through training.

You become a Zeti—a demon/devil-like humanoid alien with exceptional physical abilities and long-range mass technokinesis. Every Zeti also possesses one unique superpower of their own, while training can greatly enhance both their physical capabilities and their abilities.

An ominous-looking medallion that, when used, starts a Pumpkin Moon event in the surrounding area. Waves of Halloween-themed enemies will invade, giving you the perfect distraction or a chance to fight the horde for valuable loot and bragging rights.
You are completely immune to damage from explosions and explosive weapons. Grenades, rockets, bombs, mines- even massive detonations won't hurt you.

A bucket containing an endless supply of Shimmer- the shiny, pearlescent liquid from Terraria. It can be used to upgrade, transmute, uncraft, or downgrade items, while throwing coins into it increases your luck.

Place this down anywhere to generate a scrapyard that produces an endless supply of scrap, with the occasional useful item or unexpected goodie hidden among the junk. Most finds come from your current universe, but every so often, something from another universe turns up.

A tuning fork whose vibrations disrupt and cancel mind control, brainwashing, psychic domination, and similar mental influences in anyone who hears them. The effect breaks existing control and prevents it from being maintained while the vibrations are active.

You become a Nosedeenian—a living electrical alien with a battery-like appearance that's able to generate, absorb, and control electricity. You can fly and turn into electricity to travel through wires and electronics. Native to space, Nosedeenians can absorb enough electricity to undergo mitosis, creating an independent clone while increasing their electrical output and flight capabilities.

The flames love you, seriously. Whenever you're on fire or surrounded by flames, you gain healing, increased defense, and increased attack power, with stronger flames making the bonuses even more potent.

Activate this ability to turn your eyes into portals to the Punch Dimension, endlessly firing powerful concussive beams. You'll need ruby-quartz glasses or another suitable filter to control and safely contain the beams. Or just turn the ability off.

You become a Care Bear or Care Cousin—a small, colorful, humanoid bear (or other species) with a distinctive belly badge representing their personality or power. They possess powerful individual magic/supernatural abilities and the anti-evil/purifying Care Bear Stare. Their starting power is moderate, but friendship, compassion, training and emotional strength can greatly amplify their abilities.

You become a Yordle—a small, humanoid spirit with some animal-like features, usually 2–4 feet tall, and naturally ageless. Yordles possess innate magic, enhanced agility, resilience, and supernatural talents that vary by individual. Their starting physical power is humanlike, but training can make them remarkably powerful.

You become a Boss Monster—a monster species with a humanoid form, whose bodies stop aging once adulthood is reached. Boss Monsters possess exceptional magic and souls capable of absorbing human souls. Their starting magic abilities are formidable, but training and experience can greatly increase their magical and physical power.

You become a Jeep—a small, magical, dog-like creature with a long snout, large ears, yellow fur and leopard spots that eats orchids. Jeeps are 4th dimensional creatures with a wide range of powers including telepathy, clairvoyance, teleportation, invisibility, and reality-bending abilities. Their natural supernatural powers are considerable, but greater focus and experience can strengthen their supernatural abilities.
A spell card containing a barrage of arrows. Activate it to conjure and launch a volley of arrows at a target.
A large, six legged Sheikah golem with basic intelligence. It's incredibly durable, surprisingly fast, and capable of firing a highly precise laser that causes explosions upon contact.
Summons a set of Guardian Swords, from the basic one to ++. Guardian Swords do extra damage towards robotic and golem-like opponents. The blades are made of solid arcane magic.
Summons a set of Ancient Battle Axes, from the basic one to ++. Ancient Battle Axes do extra damage towards robotic and golem-like opponents. The blades are made of solid arcane magic.

You gain the ability to purchase units from the tribal faction using money or whatever equivalent currency or resources you have available. Build your own tribal army by buying these wacky wobblers armed with totally accurate prehistoric weapons.
Summons a set of Guardian Spears, from the basic one to ++. Guardian Spears do extra damage towards robotic and golem-like opponents. The blades are made of solid arcane magic.
You gain the ability to fire a generic Wave Motion Gun that scales with your current power. At its base output, each blast is already as powerful as a Casaba Howitzer.

A device that converts electrical energy into other forms of energy, including magic, psionics, exotic sci-fi energy, or whatever other nonsense you can plug into it. If you can define the energy type, this transformer can probably convert electricity into it and vice versa.

The blade of this ancient sword was made using an ancient power lost to this modern age. Its blade appears only when drawn, and its cutting power surpasses metal swords. It does extra damage towards robotic and golem-like opponents.

You fire beams that burn as hot as the Sun itself, bringing the power of sunlight with them. They also count as genuine sunlight, so anything strengthened or weakened by the Sun is affected accordingly.
This shield was made using ancient Sheikah technology. Its surface glows blue when raised in defense. Enhanced functionality allows it to deflect laser beams the size of a person.
A massive, two handed arcane chainsword. It does extra damage towards robotic and golem-like opponents.

A 1 cubic meter sized silver and cyan crate vaguely done up in some kind of scifi-ish aesthetic and stamped with an infinity symbol on its sides and top. When opened (by paying roughly 100 USD or equivalent currency), grants four 2 star tokens and one 3 star token.

Ancient Sheikah technology affords it heightened functionality. Arrows fired from it travel in a perfectly straight line. Arrows fired from this bow do extra damage towards robotic and golem-like opponents.

A set of armor made of hide and bones. Doesn’t protect much, but when wearing the whole set your attacks do 50% more damage. Can be upgraded to 100% more damage by ritually sacrificing strong monster parts to it.
A set of full body plate armor that has been fully upgraded by the Great Fairies of Hyrule.
You become immensely knowledgeable about how to use your other powers or surroundings for defensive armor.
Stormshocks now open high above tornados, leading to large pocket dimensions called BattleZones. Collect the battle key hidden in the dimension to return home and to reuse the portal at a later date.

The world you currently inhabit now has random islands suddenly floating mid air. This change happens overnight to various landmasses, either lifting them entirely from the surface or creating new ones over them. Yeah, they're not coming back down anytime soon. Good luck!
An ancient, soulless troll assassin, responsible for killing many past Trollhunters. Expert at using sorcery and comes with much knowledge about fantasy creatures.

Whatever you wear now works like it feels like it would. Culty robes allow you to channel dark rituals easier, heavy platemail armor makes you a effective walking tank, wearing a horse mask makes you as fast a horse, wearing fake vampire teeth makes them function like actual vampire teeth, and Etc. Scales with how authentic/realistic your cosplay is.
A wooden chest with golden banding reinforcements and inlaid with red rubies. In the chest are 1,100 solid gold coins.
A coral-encrusted treasure chest with a few cut rubies decorating the outside. In the chest are 1,925 solid gold coins.
A treasure chest with golden banding reinforcements, inlaid with red rubies, and with an ember-like, glowing appearance. In the chest are 2,080 solid gold coins.
A large stone treasure chest with golden banding reinforcements. In the chest are 3,900 solid gold coins.

A cursed treasure chest that makes the one holding it instantly drunk, making them sway and hear heavy drinking sounds. Using the tap attached to the chest allows up to 1,000 mugs to be filled with grog. Inside the chest are 2,600 solid gold coins.

A cursed treasure chest that bears the image of Poseidon. The Chest of Sorrow will periodically start crying, leaving a puddle of tears capable of flooding a ship if left completely alone. Inside the chest are 3,440 solid gold coins.

A wooden treasure chest with imagery of a lava diety emerging from the top. If left alone, or continuously damaged, will explode with fire. To prevent this, make sure the chest is constantly cooled off in some manner. Inside the chest are 3,440 solid gold coins.
A chest that has imagery of Poseidon. The Chest of Everlasting Sorrows will continuously cry salt water that can easily sink a ship if left unattended. Inside the chest are 6,800 solid gold coins.
The perfect organism for death. Sleek, and deadly. Acid blood, second mouth, bladed tail, great at getting into the air vents- you know the deal. We've all seen Alien.

You are now the perfect killing machine. Tall, with acidic blood in your veins and razor like claws at your fingertips. You might not visibly have eyes, but you can still see, mostly. Electromagnetic fields may make it hard to tell what you're looking at.
A small and nimble ship, designed for a crew of 1 to 2 people. It features a single mast, two cannons, and a split-deck layout. Comes with enough supplies to last a week’s voyage.

Tall, dark, deadly, and now with massive tits. What's the point of being a perfect killer if you can't play with your prey? You might not be able to fit in air vents anymore, but at least you've got nice tits now.
A towering woman beneath a towering Obelisk. Gently she paints numbers, warnings of those who shall perish next. It's a calm death. To stop it, you must go on a grand expedition.

The Brigantine is a medium-sized ship, designed for a crew of 1 to 3 people. It is a two-masted ship with one main deck and one lower deck. The main deck stretches from bow to stern and contains the helm, cannons, and mounted harpoon guns. Comes with enough supplies to last a week’s voyage for the crew.

A large ship designed for a crew of four people. It is a four sails ship with one main deck and two bottom decks, comes with eight cannons with four on each side. Comes with enough supplies to last a week’s voyage for the full crew.

A bundle containing 16 saplings of every unique tree from Minecraft. Contains the following tree types: Oak, Birch, Spruce, Jungle, Acacia, Dark Oak, Mangrove, Cherry, Azalea, and Pale Oak. They follow the in game growth cycle and look like they do in game when fully grown- ie, blocky, but at least they grow within 5 minutes or so.
Somewhere in the world there is now someone with comparable yet, distinctly enough, different powers to you and even kind of looks like you. The Knock Off scales with you.

Allows you to add, remove, or change one letter from the title of the result from rolling a token, allowing you to potentially change the meaning or working of the ability, item, familiar, race, or world. Once the change has been done it cannot be done again on the same title. Landing on this again lets you change an additional letter. Only works on future rolls, you cannot edit rolls from before you gained this ability.
Australian Kangaroo One Tonne Gold Coin
One ton of gold pressed into an Australian coin. Somehow, it's still considered legal tender in Australia despite being worth whatever a ton of gold is worth at that point.

You become one of the Stitch-like Alien Experiments (624–629)—a small, highly intelligent alien with immense strength, agility, durability, enhanced senses, and sharp claws. You possess superhuman physical abilities, resistance to extreme environments, the ability to lift 3000 times your mass, and other minor abilities. Your starting power is already formidable, but training can greatly improve your physical abilities and skill.

You become a Furon—a small, gray-skinned alien humanoid with large eyes, an oversized cranium, three-fingered hands and functional genitals of your choice. Furons possess human level strength, but have enhanced agility and durability as well as superhuman intelligence and powerful psychic abilities. Their starting psychic abilities are formidable, while training, mutations, and technology can further enhance them.

A circular shield decorated in the colors of the American flag and forged from near-indestructible vibranium. It can bounce and ricochet in seemingly impossible ways, allowing it to pull off throws and rebounds that completely defy the laws of physics.

This floating red heart-shaped object is in a time loop that you can't remember. While possessing someone, it can generate light, empower anyone's magic, or force commands upon their host (limited to ideas the host thought to do or say). It can't communicate, but it loves you in the way only a metaphysical horror could.

The space between realities, containing nothing, and extremely corrosive to anything. You are now able to enter and exit it at will. With time, you could bring it into reality as a weapon. Technically a world roll as well.

You become a four-armed, 2-2.5 meter tall axolotl/gecko alien possessing three digited hands and a long, chameleon-like prehensile tail. You possess a Wolverine-like regeneration ability that allows you even regrow your entire head in a few seconds without issues and are also immune to poisons and toxic gasses. You are a bit stronger, faster, agile and more durable then a human and are capable of superhuman leaps.
A very large fortress on legs, equipped with powerful artillery, missiles, and Normals. May or may not come with crew. Beware the badly designed ammunition feed.
A large aerial fortress, equipped with Assault Armor and various Kojima Particle based weapons. Extremely destructive to the environment.
A massive 14km long train nearly invulnerable to almost any conventional modern weapon. Equipped with large guns, and carrying Normals and inactive NEXTs.
The combined tech tree of all Armored Core games. Contains many weapons and technologies. Be careful not to render earth uninhabitable.
A large satellite equipped with an extremely powerful mass driver. Technically a world item given the lack of mobility.

You gain a Cloud Car—a magical, open-topped cloud vehicle used by Care Bears and Care Cousins. It can fly at extremely high speeds (Mach 4) while being nearly silent and requiring no fuel. Cloud Cars are durable, comfortable, and capable of carrying multiple passengers and cargo in the trunk.

You gain a Super Mario Coin Block—a magical block containing 10 Super Mario gold coins. Coins can be removed individually, and the block automatically resets after 24 hours, regardless of whether it was completely emptied or only partially used, restoring all 10 coins for continued extraction.

Speak your wish three times into something, then fold it to keep your wish safe (or use a variety of other wishing rituals). This empowers your opportunity, ability, or equipment's ability to accomplish your wish. Scales with how strongly you want your wish to come true, such as your own hopes being able to restore your body from death a couple times, or the hope of a country being able to put a city in a time loop.

You gain a Gatlian familiar from High on Life, chosen from the available in game Gatlians. Gatlians are sentient alien weapons with distinct personalities, natural combat abilities. Your Gatlian forms a loyal bond with you, functioning as both a companion and powerful living weapon.

You are a metallic lifeform that absorbs minerals to function. You are immune to suffocation and spacewalks, siphon oxygen from around you, can easily reshape metal, and can hibernate as long as it takes for a civilization to die and its scraps be free for the taking.

One random FTL capable spaceship from the list of playable ships in FTL: Faster Than Light. Comes complete with everything that ship starts with, including crew, fuel, scrap, systems, augments, empty rooms for more systems, etc.
This goopy triangle with anime eyes and a lil' fang is probably the most potent form of gray goo in fiction. Everything he bites becomes Mr. Frundles. He can move at speeds proportional to his size.

This mastermind supervillain can split the present into two identical timelines and do different things in each one, then close the one he doesn't want. He's kind of a huge creep and a weirdo, but he's got a good sense for running large organizations full of mercenaries at least. Just... don't let him go near superpowered children.

The Annihilarrgenesistoriathimiorgost. An otherwise small, metallic box with a button inside. When pressed, it will destroy the universe it is in, or create a new universe if it is not already within a universe.

This console was made with Dissonance, a chaotic reality warping energy extracted from Hell, and can utilize it in a manner that is highly controlled if a bit slow in execution. It can slowly adjust the numbers in the reality source code of anything within a state-wide radius of itself.

The corpse of Mannequin, fully cleaned and refitted into some damn good, damn stylish hazmat armor customized to fit your aesthetic sensibilities. Try not to think about how it used to be stuffed full of a bunch of organs in sealed environments.

A license for breeding Pokemon and close derivatives (see: Digimon), making them more receptive to your advances and allowing actual baby making between the user and the creature with the child leaning towards either of the parent's species with small chance of hybrids. It's all legal too. Doesn't do anything for ethics though.
