An anomalous gift box that shows up exactly when needed containing exactly what you need at that specific moment in time. Imagine that John Cena gif with him pulling a steel chair from a present, that’s basically how it works.

A normal looking military signal flare. Upon being lit, it will start an artillery bombardment centered around its exact position in the next 5 minutes. You should probably drop it and run after lighting it.

"You, alone, are the reason behind all these tokens. You figure if there were more of you... maybe you could earn even more." You can make a clone by spending an absurd amount of any resource, be it energy, money, scrap, cookies, etc. Each clone can earn tokens.
You can summon any mundane item as long as it's funny. Perfect for all your prop-based comedy needs! Toonforce not included.

You gain six pokeballs. Inside each one contains a random beastial or otherwise non-human 3 Star Familiar roll. If the Familiar rolls comes with multiple, either reroll them or the amount of single familiars takes the places in the remaining pokeballs. If you are out of pokeballs with multiple amounts, reroll till you get a singular one.
You can now just pay to upgrade any of your previous rolls in any way. Starts at 10,000 USD or equivalency for F-Ranked rolls, and grows multiplicative by a factor of 10 from there.
I Have a Coupon For That!

You may now pull coupons out of your pocket at will, as long as they're meant for anything that can be purchased using the local currency up to a 50% discount. These coupons are accepted without scrutiny and don’t have an expiration date. No, the coupons do not stack.

You cause a person’s wounds or injuries to spread and open back up, causing them immense pain while doing so. At first is done so by touch, but overtime can be trained to do so with a glance or within a radius around you.

A giant eldritch being that has indestructible bones and an incredible healing factor that is capable of reviving him from just his bones. He is incredibly grateful for you freeing from his eternal torment and now has undying loyalty to you. He might still try to destroy the planet, though.

You become a Lunarian, gaining at least a few feet in height, brown skin, white hair, functioning black wings, and a perpetual flame burning on your back. You can now survive in any natural environment and resist almost any attack as long as the flame on your back burns. If the back flame goes out, your durability drops, but you also gain a massive boost in speed. You also gain immensely powerful and versatile self pyrokinesis.

The Masamune is a legendary, two-part sword capable of ignoring most magical defenses and at half its strength is able to part mountains with a single slash. Move on from your past regrets to regain its full power.
As long as your body is touching the ground, you are completely invincible and immune to harm. Yes, you are still vulnerable to getting lifted off the ground, though.

A ninja mask and ninja-nomicon. The mask turns you into the Nourisville Ninja with all the skills and enhanced abilities along with a custom ninja suit. The Nomicon helps guide the new ninja, offering old wisdom and ways to learn ninjutsu spells through cryptic sayings.

A metallic suitcase containing figurines of every American made power ranger. By imbuing the figurines with energy you can summon a mindless copy of the Power Ranger that still holds all of their combat instincts and basic equipment and lasts depending on how much energy you put into it. If defeated, the figurines break and you have to fix them manually before you can use them again.
Any wounds or injuries you cause will refuse to heal. Doesn’t matter if it is a mortal or a god, the wound will never heal unless you stop using this ability.

A pair of golden brass knuckles in the shape of the Mcdonald's M. Strikes with the McKnuckleDuster cause enemies to start McFucking around, getting distracted by sudden urges and hunger pangs and resulting in 10% lower defense against psychological attacks. These effects increase when this token is rolled again

A firearm made from a Wii controller. It still functions as a controller, but don't pull the trigger too soon. The batteries are also the bullets. By holding down the trigger you shoot a charged shot.

The head of the Queen of the Gorgons. The Medusa's Head is capable of temporarily turning opponents into stone, but the effectiveness and quickness of it depends primarily on how big the opponent is. The larger the opponent the longer it will take for them to be petrified.

A slow but powerful close combat weapon originally wielded by the Barbarian King. With it, the wielder can deliver powerful slams and smashes, and also summon legions of souls. Those killed by this hammer can additionally be summoned as members of the soul legion.

The Spear of Destiny is a magical weapon with purple crystals infused in its ends, which can be used to pierce enemies and even create more explosive crystals. It also has the ability to extend and retract itself for greater range. It is said to have the power to kill Zeus, but none know how to unlock its full potential.

The Blade of Olympus, a large golden and white metal sword with blueish hues of energy flowing through and around it. A divine sword so powerful it was the blade that allowed Zeus to defeat the Titans in the First Great War. The weapon can be powered up by pouring all of the user's energy into the blade to increase its power and add new attacks.

A magical weapon consisting entirely of metal in the shape of a small bow where rapid winds make the extension of the bow's curves. It fires rapid blasts of wind from an open face carved from its center.

The sliced off head of Euryale. Much like Medusa's, you may use it to turn enemies to stone. The larger the enemy, the longer it takes to turn it to stone. However, due to being a larger head than Medusa's this one has wider range, if less power.

The Golden Fleece is a powerful golden armlet which once belonged to the Argonaut, Jason. When used, it briefly surrounds the user in a golden aura that blocks and counters enemy attacks and projectiles, throwing them back at your enemies or forming an energy ball as a counterattack.

Redeem this token to have Bobobo-bo Bo-bobo use his reality-warping shounen toonforce to briefly enter your multiverse about a month ago and set up an attack that will save you now, all without knowing why he did that! It will be the dumbest, impossiblest thing anyone will ever see. Cosmic horrors themselves would not believe their eyes.
Your stats now all gain a boost when facing down robots, androids, or any other hostile mechanical force.

You are now capable of snapping the neck of anything that has a neck (that you can wrap your hands around) as well as punching someone so hard their neck snaps cleanly just from the force. It also allows you to undo their neck snap on your opponent, bringing them back to life and reversing the injury in the process.

You are now capable of using various explosive methods to propel yourself around any battlefield while causing minimal damage to yourself with said explosive. It does not help with the landing, however, so you'll have to sort that one out yourself.
Kill Me, Come Back Stronger Pills

A small pill container that houses, 50 KMCBS pills. These pills have diminishing returns, starting at making the user 3 times as strong, then twice as strong, and finally caps out at 1.5 times as strong. This means if the user has died 3 times they will become 9 times stronger compared to their start. After that, you don't get any stronger from coming back.
The user now knows how to make Roboslugs from Quinten. This includes ways to program the little drones to counter abilities on the fly using previous combat data analytics.
You innately know or recognize when an object, item, or even being has great potential to be used for various arcane rituals or objects.
This person (not cat) is an adorable child trying to get home. They are the messiah, able to talk to God, and the lightbulb they carry is an immense source of light energy.

You may, using a source of supernatural power, whether magical or scientific in nature native to the setting you're in, design and build transformation belts and associated equipment. These belts are generally used to transform into heroic forms that amplify or add to the user's abilities. This ability will adapt to the setting you're in, taking on appropriate sources and thematics according to what fits best with your setting, and will require appropriate materials from the setting you're in. This version may only create transformations that boost capabilities up to Low C or High D level.

You may, using a source of supernatural power, whether magical or scientific in nature native to the setting you're in, design and build transformation belts and associated equipment. This ability will adapt to the setting you're in, taking on appropriate sources and thematics according to what fits best with your setting, and will require setting appropriate materials, though the forms taken will generally be either biological, technological, or magical. The upper limit in capability is decided by the wearer's capabilities and the materials or power sources used to enhance them.

This 2 meter tall mech comes with a giant grappling hook arm, giant sword arm, and weak thrusters good for dashing or jumping. The hook is strong enough to hold boulders like shields and throw them at enemies, grab enemies into swording range, or drag the mech up a cliff.

A Red Gavv taken from a Shouma Inoue who died in the line of heroism. Produces a token, that, when torn, automatically implants it into the user. After eating treats or food the user likes, produces small, sapient minions called Gochizo that mostly speak in gibberish that can be understood by the user and their allies, and can be assigned to tasks or used as fuel for a Rider Transformation

You are stronger when you fight for a cause you believe in, shaking off injuries that should kill you and reaching for power you didn't know you had. However, your devotion to this cause or ideal must be selfless. Something you are doing simply for your own sake cannot activate this trait.
A legendary detective who has a very specific set of skills. He is an absolute wreck of a man, and he's about to make all of your adventures quite a lot messier.
It is very difficult for people to link together your everyday self and your costumed identity unless you transform in front of them, admit to it, or make castastrophic levels of slip-ups.

You have bathed in the blood of a dragon— your durability and regeneration are massively enhanced, and all defensive abilities are boosted. However, there's one spot on your body that possesses proportional weakness in relation to your defenses— if you're practically invincible, your weakspot will be an instant kill. In return, abilities that weaken or destroy defenses cannot destroy yours— your opponent must overwhelm your defense on a conceptual level or burst through with raw power and penetrative ability.

Anything from Rain World, you can build- including all the machines and lifeforms. It's like magitech, except it utilizes karma and Buddhist philosophy instead of mana. You can recreate void fluid at the highest levels of this tech tree.

We here at Fazbear Entertainment are always aware of our fans' thoughts and demands, and we are glad to inform you that now you to can also get your own life endoskeleton operated Roxanne Wolf in either mechanical form or realistic fur variations! (Roxanne Wolf keypad sold separately) Warning: Here at Fazbear Entertainment we are not responsible for any injury involving bone crushing hugs, bitten off heads and pulverization of the lower extremities.

This harmless invisible gas can become solid objects in any shape or color in seconds. Constructs made by the gas are as durable as bricks and can fly. Perfect for avatar bodies or giant immersive amusement parks. Comes with enough gas to make a city block, restocking daily.
A powerful Machine Intelligence that once guided mankind from the shadows, although their methods were questionable at best. Loaded into the Nineball Seraph frame when first summoned.

Your blood is superheated due to your draconic ancestry, boosting your resistance to flame, heat, and temperature extremes. It also grants mild regeneration, just enough to replenish your blood and close surface wounds. If someone manages to harm you, your superheated blood bursts out in a gout of flame, harming the opponent in question if they're close enough. You may also choose to exhale your superheated blood through your mouth as a Breath Weapon, use it to enhance and empower fire-based abilities.

The Artificial Intelligence behind the mercenary support system. They are rather good at presenting a favorable public face while simultaneously managing large amounts of software. Comes loaded into a... Smartphone, apparently, when first summoned.

Through an elaborate ritual involving exchanging blood, you may create a permanent soulbond to another individual. This grants you a mindlink with your bonded, allowing you to draw on each other's abilities, traits, and (to a limited degree) skills, and granting various other benefits with physical proximity. Both parties must be willing, and you may only have one soulbond at a time. If one party dies, the other experiences death or at least severe physical and mental consequences.

Select one type of item (books, swords, pets, clothes, etc) as your Hoard. The larger and more varied your hoard, the more being closer to it empowers you. You may sense the location of your hoard at all times. As your hoard increases in size, you may gain conceptual abilities related to your hoard, such as the ability to summon pieces of it from a distance, and you heal faster and sleep better when in proximity. Storing your hoard in an Inventory or Pocket Dimension does not count as 'close', you must be actually physically close to it
Fruit of the Tree of Might

Eating this fruit increases your power level by 300,000. Its seeds can be planted on an inhabited world, growing a Tree of Might that will devour the world's entire life force just to produce one more fruit. You could also grow it somewhere that has the energy to handle it, provided you had access to such a place.
A pair of running shoes in your favoured color and style that utilizes minor space-bending and compressed air to allow you to safely move at high speeds and run for long distances without tiring.

The Ability capsule from Pokemon. When used on a non-Pokemon, it brings out an aspect of their hidden potential or awakens aspects of their abilites they're normally unable to access. Works best on familiars, but can work on people.

A root vegetable that resembles a radish and has a spicy flavour. Its extremely nutritious and delicious greens and roots both are edible by humans and animals. Birds of all sorts have an affinity for it, especially flightless birds and bird folk. Other varieties can be bred for specific effects. You get enough to feed a person or animal for a day.

A farm specialized for growing Ghysahl Greens. These root vegetables resemble radishes and are extremely nutritious and delicious, with a nutty and spicy flavour and crunchy texture. You start with one field with the basic kind of ghysahl, but can gain more by investing into the farm's growth and may harvest 100 Ghysahl a week from your field. Different kinds of ghysahl can be cultivated via selective breeding, and have various effects on avian and other monsters- like making it more likely for rare variants to be born after breeding, or strengthening them or their elemental affinities.

The gel of these adaptable slimes are an all-purpose fuel, food source, and healing ingredient. You start with 24 of them, perfect for ruining an ecosystem! They eat anything and reproduce through mitosis.
A tree that produces silver apples. Silver apples make the person who consumes them slightly healthier and heal slightly better- in game terms increasing max HP and granting slight regen.

A sack each of corruption seeds, crimson seeds, and hallow seeds. Perfect for irreversibly filling your world with horrifying ecosystems of monsters made of valuable materials! The monsters will start off weak, with larger ecosystems able to support stronger monsters.

Crystalline seeds that, when nourished with mana or equivalent energies and planted in the ground, may grow into the magical elemental crystals Remnant calls Dust. The more ambient magic is in the area, the bigger and faster they will grow.
Your mind actively retaliates against unauthorized mind reading, precognition, and mind manipulation. This can and will be invariably lethal if the unauthorized individual continues.

A crystal pendant that etches the ebb and flow of the energy of the wearer's soul into the crystal, capturing an echo of the wearer's memories and capabilities. Over time, this etches the wearer's signature skills and abilities into it, allowing the user to pass the crystal onto another so that they may use these techniques and abilities. You may choose to purposefully exclude specific abilities or techniques, and new users cannot automatically use what a crystal grants, requiring training and combat experience to harness them.

Spores of a mushroom that slowly transmute stone they grow on or near into Adamantite, a rare ore that is extremely durable and tough, contains holy power, and slightly increases the wearer's physical strength. The mushroom itself is edible, and can be cooked or used in defensive potions. Oddly, the fruiting bodies resemble tortoises.

A portable, solar powered device that opens a portal to the world of Pokemon, which stays open for 12 hours and can be reopened once per month. Can be retrofitted to use alternate power sources, though it's an extreme power hog in those cases. Any non-Pokemon familiar that cannot pass for a human summoned while in the Pokemon world will be temporarily turned into a Pokemon for the duration of your stay there, as Arceus would like to prevent widespread panic.
Punching a trauma-dumping foe will make them realize that they must stop their evil ways and become a better person. This has a 90% fatality rate.

A machine that can revive any fossil into the living creature it once was- but you need either at least 10% of its body, or a mostly intact head as the basis. Works best with supernatural creatures, and may imbue non-supernatural creatures with supernatural capabilities
An actual 4D object. It would be absurd for anyone to reverse engineer extradimensional movement from this... but could it be done?
You can open your stomach into a large fang filled maw with large lolling tongue to eat things directly. Can only be used to eat, and is not capable of speaking or breathing.
Roll thirty eight 1 star tokens. More of a curse than anything else, honestly... that's so many tokens to roll...
Summon a superhuman chrome and blue faceless lady whose only purpose is to give everyone a can of Diet Pepsi and then leave.

You have the body of a Minecraft player, allowing you to break and place blocks in cubic-meter increments and craft items using Minecraft's crafting system. You also can carry just... an absurd amount of weight.
You can install any gun component, including ammo, into any gun. The logical drawbacks of such nonsense are near-fully erased. Feel free to put anti-material rounds into a handheld SMG!
You gain the ability to purchase entire farmer unit factions using money, currency, or whatever equivalent resources you have available.
This little cricket stands on your shoulder and judges the morality of your actions and character. He's your conscience.

The classic bulky Omnitrix, with all its restrictions and glitches. Allows you to turn into 1 of the 10 classic aliens for 10 minutes. It can scan prime specimens or absorb forced mutations placed on you, adding them as additional transformations.

Wielding this chef's knife with hostile intention will cause the target and all witnesses to be unable to perform actions that would directly or indirectly save the target, even if they don't care about saving the target. This effect can be resisted by psychic resistance.

Newborns, dinosaur bones, meteorites, olympian muscles, singer voice boxes, octopuses, etc. You can freely open individual tech trees that require the collection of a specific painfully-difficult-to-acquire resource.
A perfectly ordinary-looking bottle of cola branded with the word “JoeJa” and featuring a bizarre cartoon drawing of some kind of robot on the label.
Your attacks can never harm you or your allies. Explosions, stray bullets, ricochets, area-of-effect attacks, and other collateral damage simply won't affect friendly targets.
All your enemies have janky hitboxes from your perspective, allowing your attacks to hit them even when it looks like they clearly missed.

A bizarre device that causes everyone around you, and potentially everyone, everywhere, to experience lag in real life. Movement becomes choppy, actions take longer to register, and reality itself starts feeling like the ping is well over nine thousand.

If someone attempts to hide behind an anonymous name, nickname, pseudonym, disguise, or similar identity online or in written works, you can instantly see through it and know who they really are. Their true identity and relevant information are immediately revealed to you, regardless of how thoroughly they've tried to conceal themselves.

If a major hidden conspiracy exists, or supernatural phenomena such as magic secretly exist, this forces a Broken Masquerade scenario by making the truth impossible to conceal. Whether through an impossible-to-cover-up event or the sudden dissemination of the information to everyone, the secret is exposed to the entire world and the masquerade is broken; if there are no such secrets to expose, reroll this reward using a token one rank higher than the one that produced it.

The dagger of the Witch of Betrayal. Rather than dealing physical harm, it nullifies magic, breaks magical contracts, and reverts magical creations to the state they were in before the magic was applied.

If someone trying to kill you is about to make a decision that would screw you over directly or indirectly, there's a random chance that some completely random-ass assassin will appear out of nowhere and try tto kill them by sniping them, stabbing them in the back, or whatever other method assassins use to kill people.
See that health bar? Item menu? You can grab them and beat the shit out of people with them now.

A machine capable of fully reviving people whenever they die, restoring them to a complete and functional body. It is coded to you and will automatically revive you upon death, and you can add more people to its database; it's currently fully functional, but be careful not to let it break, or else the revival process may take longer than you think. Place it wherever you like.
Every day, you receive a Kirov airship with infinite ammunition and fuel, complete with a full crew that requires no food or supplies and is completely loyal to you.

A self-destruct mechanism that Foundation scientists believe is powerful enough to destroy reality itself. It consists of a single circular red button set into a metal case. You may roll again and obtain that item in addition to this one.
Oh Jesus Christ that's a lot of pornography. Whatever fucked up perversions you can find on Lover's Lab are now available in your world. Go nuts and fuck everything that moves, I guess.

A Villainous Lair, you're allowed to pick between the classic, a secret island Lair, or the mystical, a Magical Castle Lair, or if you have another idea, you can go with that. It appears in the world, fully stocked, and with your choice of vehicle to get there. Use it well, Villain.
A base on the moon, and your choice of how to get there. Magic, technology, some third thing. Whatever you choose, the Moon Base is fully furnished, stocked, and oxygenated for your own usage.

If you are arrested in the quest for your villainous aims, something will happen to allow your freedom. A jailbreak, negligent police, or just a fantastic lawyer. Something will happen to allow you to continue your goals unimpeded.
The 3700th token entry! Kind of an odd milestone, but it's whatever. Roll two 5 star tokens because we're in a good mood!
You possess far more virtual mass than you should, making hits knock you back less and enhancing the power and weight behind your physical attacks without affecting your mobility.

Your lungs harmonize with the world with every breath, taking in energy from the natural environment and processing it in your body to enhance your energy and vitality recovery. Loses effect in highly built up or polluted areas.

Create and control the black flames, the impenetrable fires of humanity born from the abyss. They deal extremely potent darkness damage instead of burning normally, and seem to be heavy and solid despite being made of flame.

Emit beams of searing heat from your eyes, usually in the form of red hot lasers that burn and light aflame anything you want to set on fire. The more you concentrate the beams in one area, the more power they output and vice versa. Maximum range of 200 meters before the beam loses cohesion entirely, scaling with your magical prowess.

Generate volcanic eruptions by hitting the ground, causing lava to spray out with extreme pressure and force wherever you will it to. With some training, you can cause lava to erupt from any sufficiently large solid surface, even ones that shouldn't be able to spout lava at all.

Emit extreme volumes of water from anywhere on your body- hands, mouth, whatever. At a bare minimum, you can unleash enough water to flood an entire skyscraper. With training you could swamp entire towns or even cities with your output. You cannot control the water after it's emitted, but you can control the pressure with which it emerges.

Remotely evaporate any or all water in your sensory range by expending your energy. The more water there is, the longer it takes and the more energy you need to spend. With training, you could evaporate water inside of objects or beings too. The more magical the water or powerful the container, the more power it takes to evaporate water. You could dry up an ocean with enough sensory range.

Create and control Holy water. Works exactly like regular water manipulation, but also does extra damage against unholy, evil, infernal, or otherwise dark aligned beings. The more energy you expend, the more holy water you can make, either by creating it outright or converting normal water into holy water.

Turn your body into liquid water at will, allowing you to slip through cracks, avoid attacks, and generally gain higher physical resistance and mobility due to your liquid form. However, you also gain weaknesses to excessive heat, sponges, or anything that could drain away or freeze your mass.
Create and control large amounts of ice at will. Sadly, you cannot control ice you haven't created.

Unleash extremely destructive, explosive sound from your body by amplifying natural noises, allowing you to shatter buildings, bruise organs, deafen enemies, even cause minor localized earthquakes with enough power.

Manipulate any and all iron and iron-based items, objects, and masses within the range of your perception. The more energy and focus you put into it, the more force you can output and the more iron you can control.

Summon or create lesser Earth Elementals such as Mudmen, Stone Golems, Sand or Claymen, etc. Each one can use D rank or lower earth-based magic or effects. The power of the elementals depends on your own expertise and power. The conjured Elementals will vanish if you stop supplying them with energy, though with practice you can form elementals with set durations or even permanent summons. Summoned elementals are not considered Familiars.

Create a suit of armor from the ground or any material you touch. The armor itself comes alive as a golem that enhances all physical stats and also allows for greater combat perception due to its semi-sapient core. Dispelling the ability causes the armor to devolve into clumps of its constituent material.

Inflict a curse of numbness via either touch or launched hex bolt. The more energy you expend, the more dull their sense of touch becomes. If an opponent is weaker than you, you may be able to permanently curse them with numbness.

Conjure weapons of hardened light with almost no mass. The weapons formed share the same properties as any mundane weapon they take the shape of, but deal excess damage to dark-aligned opponents or anything else that's harmed by direct exposure to bright light and heat. The weapons are not extremely durable, though, and will shatter into fragments when damaged too much.

Bless any weapon in your position, upgrading it by one rank and granting the user a high level of skill with that weapon. Only one weapon may be blessed at a time, though you can change which weapon is blessed at any moment. With practice, you may be able to apply stronger or more blessings at once.

Your healing factor allows you to heal at visible speed, causing lesser wounds to seal up mid-fight and serious wounds to take less than a day to heal. As long as you have enough energy to keep the regeneration going, you won't die from anything short of an immediately fatal wound. The more energy you spend, the faster you heal.

Create and control vine-like constructs out of energy that you can use to bind, strike, whip, crush, or strangle your enemies. If separated from your body, you lose control and they fade away over the course of about an hour.

Cause enemies to feel their deepest fears by just locking eyes, making weaker willed enemies faint or run away immediately while stronger enemies are thrown off their game and become unnerved. The stronger the target's will, the more they can resist the fear.

Cause anyone within your line of sight to become aroused, with more energy and focuse allowing you to remotely induce pleasure and even cause orgasms. The more mentally resilient or otherwise magically resistant the target, the harder it is to cause arousal. You may end up being noticed quite quickly depending on who you stare at.

You're supernaturally durable to the point that you could take a semi truck to the face without flinching or taking any damage. Lower caliber bullets just bounce off, and higher caliber bullets only bruise at worst. The higher your stats, the more durable you can become.

For as long as this ability is active, any weapon you pick up you instinctively understand the full capabilities of and temporarily gain Adept Rank Mastery in whatever weapon category the weapon belongs in.

Gain the ability to speed up your perception and movements, but the faster you go, the less strength with which you can affect the world- at high enough speeds, flying gnats will feel like immovable obstacles and your punches will do nothing. Air resistance also becomes a bigger factor, making it imperative that you have as low friction in as light an outfit as possible.

You may surf the local internet of your world with your mind alone, looking up any information you want and even watching videos or playing games. It only functions as a web browser, though, so you can't download anything but raw information. No playing Doom on your own brain.

Build, design, and modify any technology or construct related to automated or otherwise non-piloted drones- construction drones, surveillance drones, turret drones, racing drones, Predator drones, etc etc.

Build, design, and modify any technology or construct related to the field of construction and/or the erecting of buildings/infrastructure. This includes cranes, excavators, cement, rebar, entire buildings, etc etc.

Project holy fire from your hands that can banish spirits and severely harm unholy, evil, dark, and otherwise infernal beings while leaving innocents and mundane creatures unharmed. Anything burned by these flames will not naturally heal.

Turn into a lion or a lion hybrid at will, granting you enhanced physical ability, a paralyzing roar, and natural weapons (ie, claws and fangs). Any mundane animal you meet will defer to you as the king of the jungle as long as you don't harm them.

Create generic translucent shield domes and walls and other simple shapes out of your energy to defend against physical attacks. The aesthetics are entirely up to you, but generally speaking they're durable enough to block a missile... if not too many at once. The stronger your magical skill and stats, the more durable your shields get.

Alter the shape and structure of any object you touch via scanning it on a fundamental level, allowing you to turn even the most basic of household items into deadly weapons should the need arise. You may even fuse multiple items together if you layer them properly. Stronger items may take more energy to change.

Skip all the drudgery of traveling- you may "teleport" back to anywhere you've already been as long as you aren't in combat. The further the distance, the longer that actually elapses in real life- though it's still faster than actually walking. If you're currently in a vehicle or riding a mount, they come with you, along with your companions.

Imbue any thrown object with your energy to make it fly faster, go farther, and hit harder. With enough power, you could lob a baseball at hypersonic speeds, or chuck a car battery hard enough to topple a skyscraper. Yes, this works if you bootstrap yourself too. Good luck holding on, though.

Rejuvenate either yourself or a selected target to restore health and vitality, and even turn back the biological clock. While it doesn't reset old wounds or get rid of scars, it can bring back someone's youth and cure most illnesses and ailments. The more energy you spend, the stronger the effect.

Sacrifice a significant amount of your blood to open a two way portal to any destination you can clearly picture in your mind, or have been before. As long as the portal remains open, the wound you made will not heal, nor will your blood replenish- though you won't bleed any more than you already have to create the portal.

Transform into a murder of dozens to hundreds of crows at will, each of which you can perfectly control as if they're your own body. Any crow that takes damage or is killed reflects on your own body in small increments. You may also partially transform to send singular crows to send messages or spy on people or poop on one specific person's car or whatever you want.

If you reroll any future token with this ability, it grants you the result of that reroll, plus another random roll of the same star value. Can only be used once, then vanishes from your list once used up.

It's just shapeshifting, but really really slow. As in, it takes upwards of an hour to completely transform. Silver lining? There's not really any limit to what you can turn into, just that the bigger or smaller the transformation relative to your body, the longer it takes.

Instantly break any curse on contact by expending the energy to do so. With training, you could even extend it into an area of effect. The more complicated or powerful the curse, the more effort it takes to break. Yes, this works on your rolled Gacha curses as well.
A mantle made of Stars, the Nebula Mantle is a magical conflux of Cosmic Energy, allowing one to fly into and through space, as well as increase the power of all magical effects.
Build, design, and modify any technology or construct related to resource acquisition- mining drills, logging machines, water pumps, excavators, so on and so forth.

Conjure tanuki leaves capable of shapeshifting you into just about any form you want, both living or otherwise. Transforming is partially physical, partially an illusion- the leaf on your head remains untouched no matter the disguise, and if knocked off or destroyed will reveal your true form. You can also place a leaf on someone else to transform. Once you stop supplying energy, the effect ends in a puff of smoke.
Project the energy and conviction of your soul into a powerful spear of light that homes in on targets and pierces them with vicious force. The stronger your soul, the more powerful the spear.

Temporarily redistribute all of your stats as you please in order to fit any situation you're in- for example, draining your speed or strength to increase intelligence, lowering charisma to increase accuracy, so on and so forth. Once released, all your stats reallocate to normal.

Mark a target to act as their Guard. For the duration of your ability, any damage they take is reflected onto you instead, at proportional severity and lethality. If your charge gets a papercut, you get it instead. If your charge gets shot in the head, you're probably going to die.

A sentient basketball-sized magical core that freely assimilates surrounding non-organic material to transform into a full golem and make itself stronger or shapeshift depending on available material. Don't mistake it for a dumb grunt- it's a full person too. The stronger you are, the stronger your golem becomes and the more material it can assimilate.
A large sand elemental usually found in deserts during heavy sandstorms. She can fling sandstorms, manipulate sand, and fly. She also looks somewhat like a ghostly woman made of sand.

A member of the Twelve Kizuki, bearing the position of Lower Rank Four. She, like all demons, has incredible physical prowess compared to normal humans, and regenerative abilities that make her very hard to kill in a straight fight. She's severely weak to sunlight (and sunlight attacks) and wisteria poison though. She's rather secretive about the rest of her abilities, and is also a bit of a coward.

You gain access to the forces of the Frost Legion, an army of sentient gangster-like snowmen wielding a variety of weapons like knives, tommy guns, or ice grenades. You start with 50, and can summon more with extra energy. Destroyed snowmen replenish at a rate of 1 per hour. A high affinity for frost, ice, or winter in general will empower your Frost Legion to greater heights.

The Twilight Princess, slightly suppressed into the form of an Imp. Even as an imp, she still has potent magical abilities- telekinesis, shapeshifting, cloud form, creating Twilight Portals, even merging with shadows. With an A-rank curse-breaking ability, you could break her curse and unleash her full form, drastically enhancing her abilities.

A tome containing a wealth of guides on how to brew minor yet useful potions from mundane or ordinary ingredients. Includes potions for healing, mana regen, stamina regen, enhanced vitality, so on and so forth. The Alchemilia must be read physically to create the potions detailed in its pages.
A tome belonging to one Medusa Gorgon, allowing the reader to learn and utilize her signature Vector Magic

A basic cauldron capable of filling itself with a potion of D rank or below once per day, including: Enhanced Strength, Enhanced Agility, Waterbreathing, Healing, Minor Regeneration, Stone Skin, etc. Any potion may be brewed as long as it meets the rank criteria.
An ornate gold ring symbolizing the favor and protection of the goddess Fina. Boosts your health, stamina, and carrying capacity quite a lot. Has been modified to no longer break upon removal.

A magic ring that recovers one charge every hour, up to a maximum of three. Each charge can be used to cast Steal on any person to take an item off their person and deliver it to your hands. The more valuable the item, the more likely it is to succeed. A charge may also be used to either muffle all sound you make for five minutes, or increase both dexterity and agility for five minutes.

An elegant rapier with a pink hilt and a glowing blue blade, created by the Empress of Light. Every attack made by this rapier sends out a high speed beam of light capable of piercing an endless amount of enemies, but stops entirely upon hitting the surrounding environment. It may also be used to massively boost light spells when used as a focus.
A set of simple leather combat armor. It will always fit you perfectly and placing enough raw material on it will allow it to upgrade itself using that material.

You managed to yoink your laptop with you before you got thrown into another world. It still has an internet connection and as a bonus has infinite battery. If you don't own a laptop one will be provided equivalent to the desktop you own. If you don't have a desktop then reroll the token.
When worn, prevents anyone from using any magic ability under rank B.
A burning red orb. Holding this will severely increase the power of fire abilities.
A large vial of red liquid. Drinking it will bless yourself and your followers with extra vitality, allowing them to fight just a little longer than previously.

A bag modified to fit around the waist of the wearer. Reaching inside will allow you to draw out any ninja tool, from kunai to a shuko to a ninjato. Using this too much will empty the bag, but it will restock the next day.
Tome of the Way of the White

A large tome containing the scriptures of the Way of the White. Within the scriptures are numerous spells related to healing, protection, finding your way, and sending out blasts of force. It will take some study to learn them, but it is possible.
A mark of a successful student of Vinheim Dragon School, the ring enhances all magic used by the wearer.

One of the 21 Great Grade swords, this weapon's blade has blackened to showcase it's incredible durability and cutting power. Sufficient to cleave the head off a dragon without issue. As part of becoming blackened, it also accepts and conducts energy from it's wielder exceptionally easily.

You recieve two neural implants capable of allowing anyone who has them to talk to each other telepathically. These may be instantly implanted in yourself and one willing companion or simply given to you.

A flamethrower that fires out clouds of horrific gas. When anyone is affect by the gas their brain begins to corrode, causing severe damage over time and making it difficult to heal them without magical abilities.
A special bow that always fires two arrows at once. When normal arrows are used it converts them into blasts of energy that may bounce off a surface once before being stopped.

A simple black cellphone with a single contact and no capability to do anything other than call them. When used you will be promptly kidnapped and transported to a location to undergo the ASTER procedure- a super soldier program that created the SPARTAN-IIs. You are guaranteed to survive this procedure and recover without any complications, granting you significantly increased speed, strength, reflexes, and speed of thought.

A Shinigami Zanpakuto shaped like a combat knife. In its released state it allows the user to control wind, sending out blasts of cutting air with every swing that can be detonated at any point. It also serves as a powerful booster to any wind based ability used while it is active. Grants a small trickle of Reiatsu to allow proper bonding. Training and getting along with the spirit of the weapon will eventually unlock Bankai. Bankai turns the weapon into two knuckle knives, who store immense pressure under their knuckles. A punch releases this energy as long as it is forced against a target. Or when the user desires

When worn, this ring will passively sense the danger you're in. If an attack hits you that would cause grevious harm the ring will take it all and shatter, conveniently also teleporting you to a safe location.
A duffel bag filled with everything you could find at a local hardware store. It can produce an infinite amount of these items.
A hip bag woven from silver thread, able to contain four thousand pounds worth of items. You automatically know how to find anything inside.

A Teigu in the form of gloves. When worn grants an impossible level of hand dexterity and prescision, fit to perfectly perform any surgery no matter how outlandish or difficult. It can also be used to diagnose anyone by running a hand over them.

A Teigu in the shape of... a shamshir. It's primary power is to create aerial slashes, crescents of cutting energy able to carve through flesh and bone without stopping. It's power waxes and wanes with the phases of the moon, peaking under the full moon but never becoming powerless.
Punch good. While you don't have an exact style, you know your way around using your fists in a fight. And elbows, knees, and feet. You're never without a weapon, because you are a weapon.
You know the body quite well. You're no expert, but naming every bone and where all the organs are is instant. Plus you can explain how it all fits together to make a wonderfully working whole.

Magic hands. You're pretty good at massage, being capable of targeting specific muscle groups, properly picking and using aids such as oils or heated coals, and identifying which method will work best with any given client. As a bonus you've also got a little bit of experience at various other spa activities, such as mud baths.

Breaking and entering? Well, why not. You're a dab hand at stealth, being capable of moving silently even while running or jumping and know just where to stand to avoid attention. Additionally you're great at recognizing and disarming traps, figuring out the best way to infiltrate a location, and silently eliminating guards, both lethally and non-lethally.

You can focus on something, which puts you ahead of a distressing number of people. It doesn't matter what is affecting you, you've got the discipline needed to focus on getting the task done. Comes with a bonus of better memory. Mind control, possession, and similar mental effects are also easier to throw off.

You've got the gift of gab. You know how to get your point across exactly as intended, with little room for miscommunication of misunderstanding. You've also got some ability at putting together concert stages, lecture halls, radio equipment, and similar. Not enough to build it yourself, but you can keep it running or identify if one is built incorrectly.
You've got a good grounding in Total Concentration Breathing. You're fully able to keep the state up at all times, even while sleeping, and the physical bonus it gives you is improved.

Make them fear. You don't just have a gift for spreading fear, you've written the paper on it. No matter how corny or absurd, everyone takes your threats entirely seriously and your mere presence unnerves people. You're also slightly better at remaining unseen when you don't want to be, but even if they don't know you're there you'll still unnerve people.

What can air really do? You've got more resistance to air. Any attempt to cut you with wind blades are going to have a hard time and suffocating you is much more difficult. Scales with your Might, to the point where even hitting you with entire force of a hurricane wouldn't cause a problem.

Healing isn't just an art, it's your art. Any healing abilities are now cheaper and heal more than they should. Further healing abilities are easier to learn and similarly work better. Even just bandaging an injury somehow conferrs better healing than it normally would when done by your own hand.

You know exactly what to do. When acting as the commander of any force, no matter how large or small, you understand their abilties better than they do and can perfectly order them into exactly the right positions. Conducting grand military campaigns is easy, but still subject to the people on the ground doing what you tell them. While you inspire confidence in your leadership, that doesn't always translate to your people actually managing to execute your plan.

Not quite a demon lord. You'll get there, but for right now you're growing into it. You've got access to the whole range of demonic powers, any power that uses darkness or is unholy is stronger, and you command respect from denizens of the hells. Unfortunately, this does mean you are a viable target for things that deal extra damage to demons, such as holy powers.

In bed, you are the master. No partner will leave unsatisfied, and you'll equally get all the pleasure you want. Not only can you learn weak spots easily, but figuring out a person's kinks takes only a little bit of attention and satisfying it takes only a little study at most.
Flying? Easy. Anything which put you or keeps you in the air takes almost no cost and you have an instinctive understanding of how to move while in flight.

No motion is wasted, no cast is inefficient. You have extreme control over your body and energy, to the point where you waste almost no energy when doing something and never make a movement you didn't intend.

Innovation and invention. You're not just a natural, you're the pioneer. If you can think of it, you can figure out a path to build it. Regardless of the tech level of the time or resource limitations. Any Tech Tree you get is near entirely revealed to you instantly and building the things to build better things takes almost no time at all.
You're just that sexy. It's in the way you walk, the way you talk, the way you exist. Spending time around you makes people more attracted to you so long as they aren't hostile to you already.

Your body is augmented proportional to the strongest weapon you own. You may also choose to apply any effect to your attacks that any weapon you own has. This power immediately stops as soon as you wield a weapon with intent to use it as a weapon.

Lucifer may be a terrible father, but it brings some benefits. The powers and attacks of Heaven work far worse on you and in turn your powers and attacks on them work significantly better. While demons and other creatures of Hell aren't compelled to follow you, they'll consider you one of their own and not be immediately hostile.

Somehow your arguments sound compelling instead of just silly. Regardless of how absurd the comparison or thin the connection, when attempting to speak to someone they're much more likely to actually consider your words instead of dismissing them. Especially when it comes to improving themselves.

Hungry, hungry. Your stomach and digestion are incredibly enhanced, obtaining more powerful effects from what you eat. This mean more nutrients from normal food but also better effects from potions and the like. Additionally you may always eat more, never feel bloated, and do not suffer from any digestive issues.

Congratulations, if you have plurality and a bunch of headmates, they're real now! They have their actual memories, and all their abilities, and can use them when they take the front! Might also cause some dysmorphia because it doesn't include shapeshifting.

Everything you need to kill your husband and get away with it!* Contains normal poisons, sabotaged exercise equipment, fake maps, and more! *Kill Your Wife kit sold separately, results not guaranteed.

You're significantly tougher now- tough as nails, in fact! You gain significantly enhanced durability and endurance, allowing you to resist strong blows and recover from pain faster (no, this doesn't grant a healing factor). Power through! You can do it!

The power to hold someone, and make them believe everything is going to be okay. Hugging you feels like a soft pillow, a warm blanket, or perhaps even a nice plush. It can banish lingering thoughts, temporarily deal with traumas, and help people see a light at the end of the darkness.

The enjoyment you get from inflicting pain on other people is now augmented- you gain health regen and energy regen for a short time every time you inflict damage on someone or something else. The amount of regeneration gained is proportional to how much you enjoy the act, and how helpless they are against you.

No matter how hard, how bone breaking, how spine shattering, how will breaking your training arc is- you won't falter. You'll push through and discard your habits, follow it to the letter, even if it makes you suffer. You won't shed a single tear. You also gain more from training, and recover from training based fatigue faster.

Change the weather of the local area to heavy downpour, massively boosting the potency of all water-based abilities, spells, and effects while weakening all fire-based abilities, spells, and effects by an equal amount.
Summon a fierce snowstorm within your local area that boosts the power of ice-based abilities, spells, and effects while weakening any effect that requires sunlight by an equal amount.

Increase air resistance around you to the point that flight becomes impossible and just moving feels like wading through mud. Opponents find it hard to breathe, fight, or escape. With training, you could cause anything moving to spontaneously ignite from air friction.

Hurl a spear of concentrated sunlight and lightning with great force and precision. The more energy you apply, the stronger the spear becomes. This ability deals increased damage against all things draconic or unholy and can pierce through multiple targets at once.

This ability gives you the power to sprout chains and shackles at will, where they will doggedly chase any target at speed before dragging them back. Perfect for non-lethal restraint, but they can be used dangerously.

The Nara Hidden Technique, Shadow Possession Jutsu. This allows you to use your shadow to hold an enemy in place, forcing them to copy your own actions. Perfect for planning or an ambush. With training you can split your shadow into multiple lines, or use evolutions of the ability.
Allows you to temporarily shift your body into a shadow state and dash forward, becoming completely intangible while doing so and allowing you to avoid any form of damage as long as you're dashing.

Not just mouth to mouth, this ability allows you to bring someone back from the brink provided it's been less than ten minutes since they've gone down. If you can infuse them with vitality, they'll even be up and about a lot faster.

Part one of the Cursed Technique Shrine, Dismantle is the default use of the technique. Making a hand sign or even just flicking your hand forward, you can cut any object you direct it to, or even cover your hand with tiny Dismantles to grab bladed weapons without touching them. Its power is dependent on the level of energy fed to the technique.
You can create a doppelganger of yourself. This copy can do just about anything you can do, for a given value, but their existence is temporary. The amount you can make is based on practice.
Ea-Nasir would be proud. This ability allows you to control copper in all forms, though without an adequate supply nearby, it will pull it from the body. Maybe you can take advantage of that?

You can share your vitality! This technique allows you to give someone else your 'lifeforce', bolstering them physically and healing their wounds. To start with, it requires physical contact, but eventually you might be able to train the technique to a remote activation, or perhaps even just thinking about this person. Provided you know they're still alive.

You now have a rubber body. Stretch and contort yourself, treat bones as suggestions, deflate even if you feel like it. You've gained a general, though not concrete, immunity to fall damage and blunt damage, and you can compress your body for increased physical attack. Be careful around fire.

Any contract you make with this ability active will enforce all of its terms and conditions by, well... force. Targets of this contract must comply with the terms as written, though it goes both ways- you have to comply with your own terms as well.

One of the abilities of the Mangekyo Sharingan, allowing you to form a massive warrior shell around your body out of your energy. It starts as nothing but a defensive set of ribs, then grows into the upper skeletal torso, then the full warrior as you train and expand your energy reserves. With effort, time, and training, you may also unlock extra features such as wings, a special sword, or even multiple arms.

A weapon embedded in your hand. When concentrated to just your hand, you may use it to drain the life force, soul, and vitality from enemies that you grab. When used as a shield, it blocks most damage that hits it and can be used to parry any attack you're strong enough to deflect.

Manifest a menacing, clawed energy arm over your own. With practice, you may manifest two (or more, depending on how many arms you have). Each arm is capable of grappling, crushing, grabbing, and slashing, and can additionally grow in response to more energy input. They can't be used as shields, though, and may also bleed energy when struck.

Snap your fingers to put anyone or everyone paying attention to you into a trance, allowing you to subtly influence or command them while they're under. Being harmed enough to bruise will snap them out of their trance. The stronger your targets, the more likely it is they can snap out of it with sheer will alone. Snap again to turn it off.

Exactly what it says on the tin- grow and command plants as you please, allowing you to bind, ensnare, impale, poison, or otherwise thoroughly savage your enemies. You may modify any of the plants you grow, but are limited to the plants around you for starting material. Make razor sharp ironwood blades, impaling bamboo, toxic exploding trees... or just grow your crops a lot faster. Keep seeds on you to maximize your combat usage.

Burn your energy to massively increase your attack power, speed, and fire-based effects while also lowering defensive ability and recovery speed. The more energy you burn, the stronger you get and the hotter your body becomes until you start shutting down and burning alive.
The Right to Bear Arms. And Bear everything else. You can swap between a full Bear transformation and a half transformation at will, gaining an increase to your body's natural strength and toughness.

Launch hard hitting energy projections of your fists by punching. The more energy used, the stronger the projection gets. Can be used at close range or long range. The base power of each projection is equivalent to your striking power.
Conjure and manipulate Bungee Gum, a substance with the properties of both rubber and gum. It can bind, slingshot, snare, deflect, and all sorts of other things if you use it creatively.

Predict the future of any target within your line of sight, allowing you to calculate what face a die will land on, or what a slot machine will roll. It can also be used on more abstract results like an opponent's next move, the movements of the stock market, or your chances of dating that hot person you just saw. The more information you can collect and the better your senses and memory, the higher chance of you making an accurate prediction.

Build, construct, and design any technology that takes the form of a miniaturized version of any other technology. Make a hyper compact fusion reactor, turn a supercomputer into a smartphone, so on and so forth. If the technology exists, it's far easier to make a smaller version of it without sacrificing quality, though you can still invent stuff on your own if you have an idea of how it works.

Build, construct, and design any technology related to industrialisation and automation. Create sprawling factories, efficient production lines, autonomous drone workers, assembly lines, so on and so forth. It's basically Factorio, but with mundane technology for the most part.

You can generate walls out of literally anything- ice, stone, water, wind, sunlight, bricks, literally anything you touch can turn into a wall- items in your arsenal, any object you find, the ground, the air, even an unresisting companion if you feel like a jerk. The size of the wall and its durability scale with the amount of energy you pour into making it.

Imbue any weapon you wield or your own limbs with necrotic energy that amplifies the power behind your attacks and inflicts necrosis and even rigor mortis into any target that touches the energy too long. Inanimate targets will start corroding and decaying upon being damaged. You may also channel the necrotic energy into a projectile or temporarily extend the weapon beyond its usual range.

Create drills out of your own energy that you can launch, wield as melee weapons, or control telekinetically. The strength and speed of the drills scales with the amount of energy you put in. You can change them to your preferred shape as well, either turning them into realistic drills, or big cartoonish conical drills. Sadly, does not even remotely grant you Spiral Energy.

The ability to Curse someone. This curse can negatively impact their defense, strength, speed, or even their health, provided the price is paid. Through simple cursing or through the sacrifice of the user's own blood, this effect will be interred. Weaker curses can be removed or dealt with fairly quickly, with more energy being required for stronger targets.

Your body is your weapon. Spikes growing out of your knuckles, teeth designed to rip flesh, a tongue that has a spike at the end of it, claws, bone spikes, improved musculature. Whatever you need for someone to consider your body an actual weapon, and for that to not just be an expression, this ability will give you.

Force allows the user to do as the name suggests, firing out a wave of Force from their body that can be used to knock enemies down or push someone back. Normally mostly harmless in a direct sense, but it can be trained or charged further to actually inflict damage.

A swarm of countless Rabbit Shikigami, unlike the other Ten Shadow Techniques, Rabbit Escape constructs can be destroyed without issue provided the lone rabbit engraved with a symbol resembling the Cloth of Various Things is not destroyed. This technique is defensive, but can be used offensively with the required knowhow.

A building sized Devil, this creature has a grotesque face, a cruel sense of humor, and a lack of honor. He has a habit of losing his left arm, and will generally lie and cheat to get what he wants without having to pay anyone back. Powerful but brutish, he's your problem now.
A loose cannon that goes overboard in fights, Iron is nontheless a loyal, if simple, minion that will follow your orders completely. Powerful and skilled, he is a useful minion to have around.

A vain and superficial familiar, Kon will decide how much of her body a summoner can bring out. Only those she considers 'beautiful' are allowed to summon her head. She isn't the most reliable summon either, fully willing to leave if the taste of what she's been ordered to eat/attack isn't up to her standards. Incredibly powerful, one has to decide if she's worth it.

A Greater Machine now lost in Hell, Guttermen were some of the first machines built to run off of Blood, though not the last. Designed for trench warfare, Guttermen will clear buildings or even cities with little issue. Guttertanks are their intended countermeasure, built off of their foundations to save time. Equipped with powerful explosives, they rendered Guttermen obsolete with their ordinance. They only run on blood, so good luck keeping them topped up.

A shrunk version of the Endbringer Leviathan, this tiny fellow may only have the approximate strength of a particularly aggressive chihuahua, if that chihuahua could drive a car, but he still retains his incredible hydrokinetic powers. Rather than drawing energy from a collection of Shards, it draws energy from you, holding back most of its power based on your own ability. Can be convinced to stop sandbagging, if needed.

If she invites you to her parlor, excuse yourself. Muffet is a spider woman with lavender colored skin, five eyes, six arms, and two legs. She is greedy, stingy, and intimidating, but has a courteous and sweet way of speaking. She has a very malicious side to herself, especially if crossed, and won't hesitate to cook someone if they anger her enough. A surprisingly good baker and cook, however. Has a Soul attack that makes you Purple.

The Nemesis-T Type is an experimental Bioweapon developed by Umbrella Europe. Based off of the Framework of a Tyrant, the Nemesis is implanted with a NE-Alpha parasite, granting it increased intelligence, much higher resilience, but also a much higher chance of mutation. Adapting to weapons used on it, the Nemesis can still be overwhelmed by powerful electrical shocks. It can also infect people with NE parasites, or just the T-Virus.

A Digimon that has clung to life through death, or perhaps simply digivolved into this state, Skullgreymon is a Powerful Digimon that also doubles as a weapon silo. The organic missile on its back can be converted to toxic, nuclear, or simply explosive ordinance. Considered Mindless, some Skullgreymon can become incredibly verbose. There'll be a lot of effort to cause its Digivolution, but the result will be worth it.

A bus sized monster with a monstrous appetite, Magnamalo needs a high level of consumption to keep itself running at one hundred percent, prompting a belligerent, aggressive personality constantly focused on eating. It can convert the bones of consumed prey into a purple gas known as Hellfire, and will fight any opponent it sees if it feels like it, even monsters it has no hope of beating.
Love Advice From the Great Duke of hell

A rather handy tome. While using this you may spawn hands on any surface. Only one to start, but with training you can spawn more, give them limbs to reach farther, and control them far more effectively.

A stylish black and red scarf. When worn allows you to swiftly dash in any direction, dodging all attacks coming at you during this period. The power of the scarf only works once every thirty seconds, but you may dash as long as you have the stamina for it.
A crudely made leather belt. When worn it grants you the strength of a giant! And exactly no more. Not particularly useful if you're already above the strength of a giant.

You now have a normal looking apartment key. When used as if you were opening a door, allows entry into a small studio apartment. Checking the windows reveals you are floating in an endlessly black void. The apartment has running water, wifi, and modern amenities, but is not otherwise stocked. Nobody may enter without your approval, and exiting puts you right back where you were.
One weeks worth of genuine Mad Scientist Steroids. Taken as perscribed, one vial a week, will grant you incredible strength! Without the usual side effects of taking steroids.

An excellent vintage. So excellent it grants you incredibly alacrity! And incredible drunkeness. Consuming this wine grants you an extreme burst of speed, but it only lasts for a single action. At which point the alcohol hits. Giving it as a gift to an eldritch entity makes them like you a lot more. This may or may not be a good thing.
The third and most iconic Ironman suit. Comes with an, extremely large, users guide, an implated Palladium arc reactor, and all arnaments fully loaded. You get reloads for everything every week.

A small amulet seemingly made of clay. When worn you may touch another creature to take their form, choosing whether you look exactly like them, like yourself as that race, or as another look entirely. This lasts for a single day before you are automatically returned to your normal form, though you may stop the effect at any time. The amulet may only copy one individual a day.

Your very own private jet. Complete with the facilities to use it and a state of the art AI pilot. Somehow has infinite fuel, but has no ability to do anything other than fly you, and your friends, around.

You are given a burning altar! This altar is massive bowl of fire covered by a cage, and when placed gradually takes in ambient energy to spawn fire elementals. These elementals naturally resemble feminine figures made of fire, but can be modified if you figure out how. The elementals are naturally loyal to you.

A very generic looking doll. Though it might resemble you, a little. The doll may be used in place of any form of sacrifice, taking injury and visibly degrading with each use until it eventually falls apart at being used for the equivalent of one human sacrifice.

Two guns, one white, one black. They're absolutely massive, Jackal more than Casull, and require great strength to fire without breaking your wrist. Their ammunition is specifically crafted to be highly effective against various monsters, taking advantage of most common weaknesses and impeding regeneration. You have two magazines for each, which are refilled every day.

The iconic 70s RV owned by one Max Tennyson. It comes equipped with all sorts of alien technology, including armaments, jet boosters, battering ram, and a whole host of random stuff that always seems to come in handy when it's convenient. It's not quite indestructible, but it's fast, reliable, and also has some really janky workarounds built in. Its gas tank refuels once a week, as do all of its defense systems.

A tome containing every single spell of the Destruction magic school found in Tamriel, though its initial pages only cover what can be found in Skyrim proper. The knowledge in its pages may be taught to anyone who reads the information inside. No, you cannot eat it to learn spells.

The guide of the underworld owes you one. You may exchange this favor for any one thing from whatever entity is responsible for guiding the dead to the afterlife. They can guide you to or from the underworld, allow you to meet a dead soul, or any other action that doesn't betray their purpose. If there is no afterlife then the nearest dimensional guide will answer you call and break the rules a little to repay the favor.
A ring given to those who learned the art of pyromancy. It is oddly hot to the touch and when wore improves the fires created by the wearer.

A fumo of Hong Meiling, gatekeeper of the Scarlet Devil Mansion. When doing any kind of physical, martial, or combat training in the same room as this fumo, your gains from training are highly accelerated. Hugging this fumo while you sleep greatly increases your physical recovery so you can get right back to it the next day.

You've become something of an expert in Taekwondo, a martial art specializing in speed, agility, and extremely powerful and flashy kicks. While you're by no means a grandmaster yet, you could fight just about anyone in an actual tournament and come out on top with some difficulty. With enough practice, you could even augment your strikes using your internal energy. If you don't have any, now you do!

You're one hell of a chemist. You can synthesize just about any compound, know what most things are composed of with just a cursory examination, and know how to manipulate the chemicals in your beaker to produce just about any mundane effect you could think of. You might win a Nobel prize if you try hard enough.

You're now good enough at management that you could run your own company top to bottom. You can multitask better, delegate better, handle your minions better, distribute tasks, and deal with any and all business and financial problems with a high degree of efficiency. Most CEOs can only pretend they're a fifth as smart as you.

Never waste an opportunity again! When something good comes your way you just know it. Find treasure, know which business is about to suddenly hit big, and know what is just about to fail. Doesn't give any hint of the amount of danger taking the opportunity may bring. You don't get warning far enough in advance to stop anything, but you'll have enough time to protect yourself from the failure.

Your bodily fluids are now a potent restorative. Sweat, blood, tears, and especially ejaculate. Perhaps a little awkward to use, but far more potent in small amounts compared to most anything else. Even grevious injuries can be healed with a bit of time... and a bit of cum.

You're just gifted. It doesn't matter what you try- you've got a talent for it. While it isn't instant mastery, you're going to start a cut above any other beginner and be well on your way to apprentice with a little bit of practice.

Being around people makes them start to accept your point of view. The longer they spend, the more often they agree with your outlook and opinions. This doesn't mean they necessarily always agree with you, but they won't find anything you do morally wrong.

You know just how to exercise. No matter the situation, you can not only put together a decent gym, but use it to it's fullest extent. Recovering from exercise is also faster and you don't suffer injury from overtraining or training with improper equipment. Combined you could be a peak human fitness in only a couple months.

The heavier, the bigger the bonk! You can wield anything, no matter how heavy, and use it to hit someone. Though you still need to actually swing it, which could be a problem for excessively sized things. As a bonus, the damage anything you're using deals is increased based on the weight of it.

777 forever lucky! You've got some great luck, more than enough to win any game of chance that comes your way and dodge the odd mugger. Though if someone is looking for you specifically your luck isn't going to duck them and you're not so lucky that inexplicable things happen in your favor.

You've got some good aim. Hitting your target with any ranged weapon is much easier, but you're still limited by the characteristics of your weapon. If your weapon can't shoot that far, it just can't shoot that far, and some people can dodge bullets no matter how accurately you fire them.

You've thrown away your humanity, JoJo! And you are now a vampire created by the Stone Mask. Your brain's potential is awakened, you gain massively amplified physical stats and regeneration to the point of near immortality, and you gain the ability to create ghouls and manipulate flesh as though it were clay. With training, you can also unlock ice powers by supercooling your blood, or even "laser" eyes by forcing ultra high power fluid from your eyes. Also, if you touch any amount of true sunlight or are hit by strong enough sunlight infused attacks, that body part will instantly disintegrate.

But what if you need it later? Any roll that requires a consumable will now restock even if it didn't previously. This includes racial changes that have you require eating something more esoteric than normal food and water. This restock takes one week and comes with enough stuff to use the item fully ten times. Any item which already restocks now has it's restock timer halved.

Zeus, Greek God of the sky and thunder, has decided he rather likes you and has granted unto you a blessing. The sky parts for you, allowing safe and swift flight, electricity flows more smoothly, doing more with less, and you've got quite the skill in picking out women. And in impregnating them. So good in fact that any child of yours will have a weaker variant of anywhere between one and all of your items. What? It's Zeus.

You've got some sin on you. As a full and proper demon you can call upon fire and darkness, know the sins upon others, are stronger, faster, more resilient, can influence the mind, and have a large grab bag of other powers. With some effort, and a bit of sinning, you can alter yourself into a form more suited to one sin, becoming a Succubus with lust and the like, which will provide different bonuses to your abilities while hampering others. This will also alter your looks and is difficult to undo. You primarily feed from sin, a process which doesn't harm anyone... more than already doing that sin does.

The weakness of the flesh... is a weakness you don't have anymore! You are now an android- a robot made to perfectly resemble a human. You no longer need to eat, breathe, or do any of that nasty biological stuff, though you do need to maintain an appropriate level of battery charge. Luckily you can intake nearly any energy instead of just electricity. You're stronger, faster, and tireless, but you don't have any special surprises unless you, or another, builds and installs them. At least your body is exceptionally modular, capable of incorporating nearly any technology- even magitech!

Moving is just easier. You instinctively take the fastest path to any destination, dodge obstacles easily, and are just overall faster than you should be. You're still limited by your own physical abilities and knowledge, but going fast is instinct enough that it'll only take a bit of training to start jumping from building to building.
Turn it off... Light and attacks using light are far less effective, scaling with your Magic. Note that Holy and Light are different things, though many Holy attacks use light as a medium.

Demeter, Greek Goddess of Agriculture, Nature, and Fertility, has granted unto you her blessing. Your lands are blessed with plenty, with plants growing faster and producing more, while the worst of winter will avoid you. You've a green thumb, plants flourish under your care, and you may extend fertility to any living being you wish to bless.

You're just sorta comforting and generally seem quite trustworthy. Being around people relaxes them, faster the closer you are up to happening near instantly when you physically touch them. Expect to hear a lot of secrets, though getting actually sensitive information make take actual effort. This doesn't work on people who dislike or hate you.

Got milk? Every time you drink milk your bones get stronger. The better the milk, the better the bonus. With enough effort, or just some very high quality milk, you could have bones that are nearly indestructible! Though the flesh around them is singificantly more destructible.

Bird up! Harpies are creatures of the wind, with wings in place of hands and arms and the lower body of a bird. They're also usually not very intelligent. You may fly without issue, manipulate wind directly around yourself, and have a wonderful singing voice.

The sunlight turns harsh. You either make the sun in the area turn more severe or create a ball of light that acts as a harsh light over the area. Under this light fire powers are enhanced while water powers are weaker.

Explode yourself! You may create an explosion of flame from anywhere on your body. It comes directly off the skin so clothing might be a problem, and it isn't very strong initially, but you can train to make it more forceful, hotter, or happen slightly off your skin

Any object you can hold in one hand can now be charged with your energy. At any point you may detonate anything you've charged this way, with the explosion scaling to how much energy you put in. Training allows you to charge more efficiently, charge larger things, and direct the explosion.

Send out discs of razor sharp teal blades that home in on your foes and rip them to shreds. They're very fast, turn quickly, and are capable of piercing an opponent and doubling back for another round. Only last a couple seconds initially, but this may be extended with training.

By focusing you may create a weapon entirely composed of swirling air. You may control it's shape and hold it just the same as any other weapon. The edge is extremely sharp and you can send out slashes of air of the same sharpness at will. However, it is extremely light and is not solid. A particularly strong opponent may swing through the air currents to hit you.
