You may cover your entire body in electricity, increasing your speed and reflexes, making lightning abilities easier, and... being on lightning. You'd be surprised how often that helps. The cloak can be improved with practice, being held longer and for less energy, and by obtaining alternate variants of lightning.

You may emanate a cloud of dust and sand around yourself and direct it as you want. While it isn't very fast to start with, eventually you'll be able to send your cloud forward so fast it sandblasts anything in the way.

Truly outrageous! You can use your energy to craft gemstones. It's difficult to do, but once you master it you may craft a gem looking and shaped any way you wished. As a bonus, they're excellent conductors and holders of the energy you used to make them.

You can make your own friends! Create beasts out of shadow, your own preferred, that will do the tasks you assign them. They are always flat black and oddly 2D, but otherwise look exactly how you wish them to look. Giving the more power makes them stay around longer and be more physical.

Your lands are you and you are your lands. Any physical location you have direct control over begins to embody you and you begin to embody it. If the land flourished you will as well, and if you improve your body so too will your land improve. The same goes if the land falls barren or you become injured or your health takes a downturn. Your abilities and stats will reflect in the land- those with high Magic might find it suffused with mystic energy and those with great Might may find it hardier.

Opulent and imperial. You somehow obtain the full ownership of a large estate. Within is a massive mansion, fully furnished but without current staff, a small town, currently occupied, and ample lands. With a bit of work the place could be entirely self sufficient. Beware- the previous owner may have been... tired of convention extravagance, the concequences of which now fall on you.
A full week of shot contained in a hand case. When taken for the full week will ensure the body changes into a prime example of feminimity.

Congratulations, you now have access to a Reality Marble, filled with copies of every blade you've ever seen, limited only by what weapons you've seen. Objects that are not weapons, but close, such as shields, are also able to be copied.

One of the world's foremost nazi killers. BJ Blazkowicz is a Jewish insurgent familiar with working under, and blowing up, a hostile regime. He has no patience or mercy for nazis but is otherwise an unflinchingly loyal man dedicated to truth, justice, and freedom. He comes with a full complement of traditional weapons- a pistol, rifle, SMG, machine gin, shotgun, LMG, and a rocket launcher. He can somehow find reloads for all of them in the oddest of places and can make them himself, if given the stuff to do so.

A robot created during World War II with the singular purpose of killing nazis. He is intelligent, if naive, and constantly sees suspicious behavior as evidence of the perpetrator being a nazi. He has machine guns in his arms, which can unfold into three machine guns each for heavier firepower, a good sensor suite, can detach his upper body to fly, and excellent accuracy. While he has a sadistic thrill while killing nazis, he is otherwise rather nice and a good companion.

Cloak your skin in the void of the Abyss in order to absorb and dissipate any and all energy that comes your way. While it makes it really easy to survive in harsh environments and move silently, strong blows may disrupt the field and leave you vulnerable until you can reapply it. The more energy you use to power the Abyss field, the more it can absorb at once.

A type of Kagune that takes the shape of armor or limbs and erupts from the body somewhere around the shoulderblade area. It has low speed and fairly low range, but makes up for it in massively augmented offense and defense. Due to its weight, it makes a better shield than anything, but can be shaped into all sorts of melee weapons should the need arise. Usually you only get one, but with practice and increasing strength you might get more.

Control any and all blood in your sensory range- your own and others. While you can't make blood, you can definitely use what's around to great effect. Quantities smaller than your perceptual ability are out of your reach, though, and anyone strong enough may be able to resist their blood being manipulated while it's inside them.
Control any and all plastic and/or plastic-based substances inside of your sensory range. Great in a city, just plain depressing that it still works out in the wilderness.

Every time you take a wound or an injury from an attack, you drain a portion of your enemy's vitality to recover your energy and stamina. Doesn't do much for the injuries, but it gives you a fighting chance anyway.

Conjure and manipulate gunpowder at will, allowing you to shape it into constructs, throw it out as a projectile, or detonate it on command. The more energy you spend, the more gunpowder you can summon at once.

You are now a Fishman- an aquatic hybrid of a chosen sea creature and a human. You may look either like a fishman proper or a mermaid, though by and large the abilities are the same- greatly enhanced physical abilities, breathing under water, high speed swimming, even greater strength when submerged, and also water manipulation via Fishman Karate.

Gain the ability to see spirits, souls, and other usually invisible spiritual entities- demons, shades, wisps, etc etc. Additionally, as eyes are the windows to the soul, you may read someone's intent and character by looking into their eyes. Tends to work better at night just because it's darker.

Gain the ability to run faster than a car and maneuver as swiftly as a dragonfly. The higher your base speed, the greater the multiplier to your movements when activated. The more energy you burn, the faster you can go- at the cost of being unable to maintain the speed for long. Also augments perception so you don't ram into everything.

Create a zone of silence that can either silence everything inside, or prevent any outside sound from getting in. Can also be used as a single target silencing ability at extra cost- including on yourself and your abilities, for extra stealth.

Delay any ability, spell, or effect that you wish to cast by any amount of time that you require. By default, delayed abilities cast exactly 1 minute after casting, from the same position the user was in upon activating the delay. You may delay and un-delay an effect at will, should you not have a particular time in mind. The longer you delay for, the more energy it costs to keep it delayed.

Collar any target that submits to you, either by defeat or surrender. Once collared, the target cannot hurt you or your allies, and must comply with any and all orders that you give. The stronger the will of the target, though, the more they are able to find creative interpretations of your orders, if they don't wish to comply. Obviously, making the target like you means less chance of that happening. The collar may be customized to your liking on cast, and you may remove it at any time.

Scan and create just about anything you understand the innate structure and history of- it's tuned by default to swords and any and all bladed objects, but if you've got a specific hyperfixation in mind, it may work with that too. Works on mundane and magical items, though the more esoteric or complicated the construction gets, the harder it is to understand and replicate. Items created by nonhuman or divine hands require a high level of understanding to even remotely get a scan of.

Infuse your blood with energy to grant it extra vitality and healing properties. Anyone that drinks the blood will have their injuries healed and their energy restored proportional to the energy imbued into said blood, and the amount drank. The more you drain yourself, the weaker you get... obviously. You're literally bleeding out.

Conjure and control barbed infernal chains coated in hellfire. Burn your enemies, bind them, whip them, rip them to shreds- the options are limitless. May or may not also draw the ire of any holy beings nearby.

Burn your own blood to increase your physical stats and imbue every attack and movement with an inferno of blood flames that poison and weaken enemies alongside the burning. The faster and hotter you burn, the stronger you get at the cost of getting closer to death at a far higher rate.

Clear away any and all negative status effects from someone by firmly slapping them. This includes fear, panic, despair, hopelessness, and most forms of mind control and hypnosis. You have to slap them on the cheek for it to work.

Pick a medium with which you can use to hypnotize someone- eyes, words, a coin, pocketwatch, so on and so forth. While under hypnosis, targets become easier to influence, and you may even be able to implant commands, change their minds and memories, or even make them act like a different person altogether. Strong willed beings may be able to shake it off during the initial hypnosis, or while giving commands they wouldn't normally carry out.

Place your palm on someone's forehead to read their memories. Stronger willed beings may be able to resist having their memories read, and might even fight you off entirely, or trap your mind in theirs. While reading memories, both you and your target are placed into a trance that prevents physical actions from disrupting the ability.

Create fruits, vegetables, and other edible crops from your own energy. Anything created this way is fully capable of being used as its real counterpart- eating, cooking, planting, anything- and may have special effects based on your own stats and effects. Farming your created crops allows you to imbue the growing plants with new abilities directly and enhance their growth by pumping more energy into this ability.

Instead of hurting you, negative status effects like poison, curses, illness, bleeding, fear, panic, etc do the opposite and promote rapid healing and energy regeneration. Positive status effects still do the same thing though, it's not a total reversal.

You can sense danger as it gets near to you, almost like warning bells in your head. The greater or closer the danger, the more powerful the sensation gets, and the more accurately you can tell its position and how soon it will hit you. Works on both physical and abstract threats. May or may not also cause anxiety if in a hostile location with no clear physical threat for a long time.

Directly drop your defensive stats into the gutter in order to amp your offensive stats by an equivalent amount. The more fragile you make yourself, the stronger your attacks become. As a bonus, the recoil of any attack does not affect you until after this ability turns off.

For ten minutes, massively boost all of your parameters- stats, regeneration, recovery, stamina, everything. After that ten minutes, you're reduced down below E-rank in all parameters for the next 24 hours to recover from the strain. Best keep this ability to a once a week activation tops, or you risk death from backlash.

Design, modify and build anything related to alchemical potions and products- potions of all kinds, acids, gases, brand new substances never before seen, etc etc. No, it does not cover Amestris style Alchemy, this is basically magic chemistry. The more powerful the product, the higher quality reagents and ingredients you'll need. Oddly enough- also makes you really good at cooking soup.

Design, modify and build any technology related to robotics, up to the level of the most basic kinds of sci-fi robots. Make drones, enforcers, auto-turrets, powered armor... you could probably make an army of B-1 Battle Droids, though you're probably not going to get to YoRHa tech unless you advance your studies outside of just the tech tree.

Read any and all information held by inanimate objects as if you were interrogating them. While inanimate objects cannot lie about the information recorded on them, they are limited to information on what's directly around them, and what they were used for. A door cannot give information on an event not within its line of sight. Still useful for reading crime scenes and figuring out how to use technology you've never seen before. The deeper the information you access, the more focus and mental energy it takes to retrieve.

Summon or create lesser Water or Ice Elementals such as Nymphs, Water Fairies, Ice Sprites, etc. Each one can use D rank or lower water-based magic or effects. The power of the elementals depends on your own expertise and power. The conjured Elementals will vanish if you stop supplying them with energy, though with practice you can form elementals with set durations or even permanent summons. Summoned elementals are not considered Familiars.

Summon or create lesser Fire Elementals such as Will o Wisps, Candleflames, Fire Sprites, etc. Each one can use D rank or lower fire-based magic or effects. The power of the elementals depends on your own expertise and power. The conjured Elementals will vanish if you stop supplying them with energy, though with practice you can form elementals with set durations or even permanent summons. Summoned elementals are not considered Familiars.

Weave your energy into a chaotically rotating, glowing sphere capable of dealing incredible damage on hit- both externally and internally. To create a Rasengan, you must focus and figure out how to spin your energy properly until you learn to do it on command. With training, you may unlock extra variants of the Rasengan- Oodama Rasengan, Rasenshuriken, Rasen Tarengan, so on and so forth. Also grants a bit of Chakra upon acquisition, though you'll have to train it up to start using it for jutsu.

Sacrifice your own health and energy to create a massive explosion from your body. The more health and energy you expend, the bigger the boom. Generally speaking, the bare minimum sacrifice is losing enough energy and health to knock you out. You may also imbue the explosion with extra effects, and if you use a blood or soul sacrifice it becomes exponentially more potent. Fair warning- if you go too hard this will just actually kill you and possibly shred your soul to pieces.

Create and fling out explosive mines made of your own internal energy. Each mine created drifts slowly through the air until disturbed, or until you decide to detonate, at which point they will unleash a powerful explosion. The more energy you expend, the more mines you can make, and the stronger you can make them.

A powerful and ferocious dragon whose entire body is covered in black with the exception of its red eyes. This dragon stands bipedally and is very strong, it can also unleash a breath of crimson flames. While it has quite the temper it is also rather intelligent.

A cute lil purple blob with a bit of a derpy face. It can transform into any creature it sees and adopt their abilities and stats one to one with the exception of durability. While they don't take the memories or intelligence of what they transform into, they're still pretty smart on their own. They can also breed with just about anything living.

A massive, mosquito-like Ultra Beast that almost resembles a bodybuilder. It's extremely strong, extremely fast, and can use its proboscis to drain the vitality and life from anything it impales. It's capable of using a variety of moves, though you'll have to train it properly to unlock them.

A high ranking demon without a real name. She has superhuman physical prowess, regeneration, and the ability to consume blood and humans in order to become stronger. She also has a Blood Art that allows her to create and control threads from her fingertips capable of puppeting her victims' bodies around, even unleashing their full strength while under her control. The closer the strings are to her, the more powerful her control. She can also create and command miniature spiders to attach her threads to her victims without them noticing. Like all other demons, she burns when exposed to sunlight and sunlight-based effects and materials.

You may summon a small fairy that takes the shape of a glowing ball of light with wings. It has the ability to find and uncover wealth, treasure, and valuables within its activation range. Sadly, it can't talk, but it can hover close to the nearest treasure it finds. For legal purposes, you are not allowed to name it Navi

A moody and ill-tempered Celestial Spirit representing the constellation Aquarius. While she's incredibly strong and fast, her main offensive and defensive abilities come via her powerful water magic, manifested from her urn. She can also levitate and can't die unless forced to stay in the mortal realm somehow.

A hollow bodied ghost Pokémon capable sensing and stealing souls from the living and dead to store in its body. It's remarkably strong and durable, able to resist both physical and magical damage due to its ghostly nature. It's also capable of using a lot of ghostly or dark-type moves, though requires training to access them consistently.

The last of the Cyber Lin Kuei and an extremely advanced cybernetic assassin android uploaded with the data, skills, and abilities of many Lin Kuei members, including Sektor, Smoke, Cyrax, and Cyber Sub-Zero. He has the abilities of ice manipulation, teleportation, flamethrowers, smoke manipulation, fighting style mimicry, plus a smattering of other powers. He can only use one of his four forms at once, though. He also seeks the genocide of organic life to ensure the supremacy of the Cyber Lin Kuei, and is kind of an asshole about it.

A 5 meter tall spider that consumes inorganic material and produces silk with its properties- consuming iron ore produces iron silk, diamond produces diamond silk, so on and so forth. The corresponding silk still retains all the advantages and properties of silk, and can be made into highly durable or even magical clothing. She also has the appropriate combat stats of a bus sized spider.

A tome containing every known Glintstone Magic to the academy of Raya Lucaria, and revolve around the ability to weaponize Glintstone. Using the Primeval Current, such as the final moments of a star, these sorceries can draw great power from the cosmos.
A still living branch in the shape of a wand, this wand assists in the casting of Druidcraft, and also some healing spells. Primarily used for plant-based spells.
A Hydrogen Bomb and detonator. You only get one. Try to stay out of the blast zone, and don't try to put a coughing baby up against it.
A Naginata that, once it pierces an enemy, summons a ghostly apparition which will immediately seek out another enemy, striking them and, if they don't die, filling them with a sense of fear.

The Space Dolphin Machine gun is a powerful machine gun dropped with the death of a great eldritch being. Boasting a high chance to not consume any ammo fired, it also has such an incredible fire rate that you'll likely not notice yourself saving ammunition. Can be used with any ammunition type.

A heavily modified, usually club or organization themed school uniform with a 20% Life Fiber weave. Shapes itself to suit whoever puts it on, either in male or female form. Its power is enough to take down an army in short order, or even decimate a large portion of a city. You get to choose its colors, style, and club-related abilities.

A divinely blessed sword that imbues its user with great strength and undying berserker rage against unholy and undead beings until they tame its urges. Boosts holy and light based abilities when wielded, and deals extra damage to all things evil and abomination.
A stylish red cape that makes the wearer quite a lot faster when worn.
A crystal orb glittering with the energies of water. When on your person it improves water and ice based abilities significantly
Create a bag that allows you to pull out any form of ore that isn't immediately toxic or harmful to you. You can only pull out fifty kilograms of ore per twenty four hours.

A ring forged by an old witch. When worn, it allows communication with those that would otherwise be impossible to understand. Through long exposure the pyromancy, it has gained a hint of the First Flame and increases the power of fire abilities.

A Sacred Gear known as The Magic Eye that Brings Shackles, it allows the user to increase gravity on anything within their line of sight- strong enough to crush buildings under their own weight or trap even extremely powerful opponents in place. When rolled, takes the form of a marble that integrates with whoever swallows it. The more you master this Sacred Gear, the more powerful it becomes.

A holy crucifix blessed by the divine. Its presence immensely weakens any unholy and dark beings within line of sight and instantly kills weaker ones. All holy or light abilities channeled through it are massively boosted in potency.

A retroactive contract for a lavish mansion wherever you choose- simply rip the voucher and you'll have all the paperwork in hand, ready for you to move in at your leisure. Comes with an invisible, possibly nonexistent workforce keeping it clean and maintained. They cannot be interacted with or spoken to, but there's no harm in thanking them for their service.

An electro bio-mechanical neural transmitting zero synapse repositioner, also known as a Neuralyzer for short. It has the ability to wipe the mind of anybody who sees the flash via isolating and editing certain neural impulses related to memory. Once people are neuralyzed, they seem to enter a trance that leaves their minds prone to suggestion to explain what they just forgot. The dials on the body allow you to edit how much memory gets erased. It is reversible, if not easily. Also comes with a pair of Ray-Ban sunglasses.

.30-06 and some bone dust. These bullets are exceptionally effective against mages, as they'll rip apart of sew back together whatever energy, and energy organs, they have into a complete and utter mess. Even regeneration won't stop it, though it might be able to fix the damage. Eventually.

A lump of... metal, maybe? Or is it rock? It's difficult to tell at least. When placed directly touching another raw material for at least two hours it will turn itself into a perfect copy of that material. The only material it won't copy is the box it comes in. You get more every day.

An insult to the Einzbern, this guide distills their long art into a very basic and easy to understand form. Following it's instructions will allow you to create homunculi, short lived beings that are created fully formed and do not age. Their knowledge is granted at creation and they will generally be content to follow your orders. Though they are properly intelligent and could refuse. All of them will have white hair with red eyes and the default look is human, though with practice you may make other types.

An incredible, out of this world fertilizer! Literally- it's made with eldritch stuff. Don't worry, it's safe. Probably. When used to grow anything this makes it grow significantly more quickly and much, much larger. Grow carrots the size of a grown man in a week! Maybe don't use it on anything that grows too big.
A single quarter. It may be spent on any roll to reroll it.

A massive swordspear fit for a god. It crackles with lightning and can be used to drop thunderbolts down by pushing energy into the blade and thrusting it toward the sky. When against a draconic foe it shows it's true power, being able to rip through any scales and leaving injuries that take ages to heal.

A wooden bucket filled with milk. It seems more vibrant than usual milk. When fully drunk this will dispell all negative affects, cure all illnesses, and whiten teeth. This does not affect anything applied by the gacha.

Get into a pissing match with the heavens themselves. Upon activating this token the sky will do it's very best to absolutely kill you with B rank Might, sufficient to crush the ground and spread craters over a wide area. Should you successfully ride the lightning you'll find your physical stats going up.

An extensive, extremely large catalogue containing anything and everything you could reasonably buy in a store on Earth. All prices are converted to whatever local currency you have the most of and seem to be highly inflated. By tapping an item you place it in your cart and going to the first page shows your cart. Simply place enough money to pay for everything on the page and the stuff will appear on the nearest surface suitable to hold whatever it is.
A plain crate filled with an endless amount of electronic scrap. None of it is guaranteed to be useful, but if you've got the skills to make use of it this is a goldmine.

The Knuckleblaster is a Robotic Arm 'generously donated' by V2, a Red Robot fueled entirely on blood. This item can come in either gachapon capsule form or just as the arm, and once installed will need to be regularly fueled with blood. Thankfully, the arm produces its own shells, removing the requirement for reloading. The damage is incredible for an arm mounted Shotgun, but be careful as it could rip itself from your body without appropriate strength.

A Teigu in the shape of a cosmetic case. When used this case allows you to take on the appearance and characteristics of any living creature, even breaking the conservation of mass. You gain the inherent abilties of these forms, flight as a bird, but not any magical or technological ones. While you appear to be the creature, you are not actually the creature and maintain your normal mind, albeit with some added instinct on how to move in your new form.

A sword style created to emphasize acting like wind. It focuses on powerful constant attacks, akin to being caught in a hurricane or whirlwind. Particularly skilled users manifest an illusion of wind to accompany their attacks, which can be made real by channeling more energy into the style.

You've got enough experience with pressure points to use them in live combat. Make your enemies nauseous, paralyze them, or simply mess up their blood flow to kill them. When not in combat you can do almost magical things if given full access to someone's body.

Walk up to a crowd and charm them with a smile and a few words. Yeah, there aren't a lot of people with charisma like yours, and you know how to make it work for you. It doesn't matter who you're talking to- you know how to present yourself to get the outcome you want.
Physics is the basis of many things, and you've got more than a good grounding in it. More than enough to get yourself a doctorate if you wanted.
You've got the moves. Jump, flips, dive, duck, and dodge with grace, alacrity, and a suave style that proves you're really just that good.

You are the one people go to for costumes. Everything you make is a bespoke costume meant to show off the unique traits of the wearer and be incredibly protective while not impeding any powers they might have. The things you make are impressive beyond the times, able to block bullets, take being set on fire, and anything else required to keep someone safe and stylish. Though you still need the facilities to actually make that stuff first.

Ninja! Just... the normal type. You really know what you're doing. A bit of planning and you can sneak into most places and determine what is and is not important for later. You're familiar with most ninja tools and can use them well. You aren't about to suddenly vanish from sight or break into a highly secure facility, but your skills are more than reliable for anything below that.
Milk replenishes energy. Milk from more mana rich creatures replenishes more. It also just makes you feel all around better.

Must have been the wind... You're extremely hard to track. Digital recordings corrupt, records are misplaced and destroyed, you leave no footprints, and people are quick to forget you. Good for hiding out, rather bad for being a citizen of a country.
Hug it out. Your hugs are just amazing, capable of calming people, removing corruption and other negative effects, and in general making someone's day just that much better.

Some say Cain was cursed by God into the first vampire. You now know that is true, and his bloodline runs through you. While you aren't a vampire you still retain the traces of the blood, and all vampires will consider your words carefully. The shadows obey you, and blood both nourishes and heals, though the ire of God remains- holy weapons will consider you one of the damned. Should you ever find yourself near your end and wish to go on, no matter the cost, partake of the blood that appears and rise as a true vampire as per any Vampire race roll on the gacha.

The God of Sleep, Hypnos, has gazed upon you and exclaimed 'yo, you should probably sleep'. And so you have his blessing. You fall asleep faster, sleep better, can sleep anywhere, and are fully rested in half the time it would normally take you. In addition, your dreams are protected and enemies will have trouble finding your sleeping form.

An RPG inventory of your very own! Store stuff in a space outside of everything, where it will never come to harm and you always have access to it. Comes with a handy dandy sorting feature too. Anything from the gacha will always fit, but other stuff is limited to twenty-eight slots. Though everything will only take one slot each and they stack up to 999.

Love... uh, finds a way. You're lucky when it comes to chances to impress someone and people you'd be attracted to, and who would be attracted to you, just keep popping up. If there's even a small chance for love, you'll find it's nearly a hundred. Just try not to fumble too hard? Cupid can only do so much.
Your vitality surges! You're healthier, heal a bit faster, can stay awake longer, and in general your body just works better.

You aren't the Avatar, but you do have all the elements. You may use any basic element from among the classical elements, which actually gives you seven- Earth, Air, Fire, Water, Aether, Wood, and Metal, to a simple degree. Throwing fireballs or storm winds and the like. You'll quickly gain more power and precision as you train, though you'll need to train each element separately. Additionally, other powers relating to those elements are easier to use and more intuitive.

No phylactery needed. Dark powers now animate your body, the life entirely gone from it. You are now undead, not needing to eat, breathe, or do any of that... living stuff. Necromantic powers swirl within your body, coming easily to your finger bones, though this power wears away your flesh to leave you physically weak. You gain the ability to use lower level necromatic abilities instinctively, raising corpses, commanding undead, rotting flesh, and etc. Further powers come with study, but you've got all the time in the world and are quite the natural.

Do you, by any chance, need a narrator? You've been granted the blessing of Beelzebub, Lord of Flies. Insects will no longer bother you, and listening to their buzzing may give away secrets they overheard. Poisons and venoms from such animals will also no longer harm you should you somehow be subject to them. Also comes with a narrator who will occasionally interject to explain or comment on the current goings on.
By chanting "Fuga", you can manifest a fire arrow with immense power behind it. Although the wind-up is slow, its sheer destructive power and heat more than make up for it.

Place a magnetic item in your palm. Focus on it. Aim (optional). Send it forward at approximately Mach 6. Or 4,446 mph/7,156kph. Accuracy will come with training, as will greater speeds and firing larger items.

Any shadow you cast can be weaved into a chain to bind your enemies. They can only be made from your shadow, but they're exceptionally strong except against light and sap the energy of foes as long as they stay on. With training you could even take that energy for yourself. They chains will disappear when no longer connected to your shadow and ultimately they are just shadow- they may try to keep someone in place, but someone determined enough could simply walk out of them.

Slip into the Void. With a simple twist you slide into a reality just a bit right and behind the normal one. The Void is a copy of a copy, a degraded existence that contains a shadow of what is and once was. While within it you are same from any attacks that cannot pierce dimensional barriers and can move around freely. Sliding back into reality brings you back where you were standing in the Void, effectively teleporting. Beware staying too long in the Void- its denizens are always hungry and every time you slide in they are alerted. Once won't cause problems, but they'll mass quickly.

You may infuse anything you're holding with light. Not the element or even the... actual light. What this light does is double up on whatever your weapon already does. Slash with a sword? Send out an awesome slash of light. Smash with a hammer? Get a bigger aftershock! Jab with a spear? A flurry of jabs of light! With training you can keep this up longer or even move to triple or quadrupling up.

You're immune! Well, to poison, diseases, and other biologically based things that can hurt your insides. Magic diseases will still harm you and you're just as vulnerable as ever to being stabbed. Parasites are also an issue, though your body will flush them out naturally before they cause any irreparable damage.

Kertain is the primary component of nails, claws, hair, feather, horns, and etc. It is also something you can now generate and control, shaping it any way you wish. Anything you grow on yourself will stay, healing and growing just as if it was a natural part of you. So give yourself feathers or claws if you want.

You may specify an area that you are aware of in some way, either through being there, seeing it on video, or simply know it's there from a map. That area is now locked, preventing any form of dimension shifting movement. This include teleportation and similar effects, but does not prevent speeding oneself up or just being that damn fast. You may lock an area the size of a room at first, but may improve with practice. Including locking more than just dimension based movement.

Your spine has been replaced. Mon3tr is a crystalline beast that is incredibly resistant to harm and extremely dangerous. It will listen to your orders and do its best to carry them out. Should it somehow be destroyed it returns to it's core and settles back between your shoulder blades, where it will heal and reform after some time.

You are a higher being- a bug, yes, but one of immense power and magic, capable of shaping entire kingdoms and influencing things long after your death. You hold great, nation building power within your shell, though it's entirely up to you whether you become a god, a king, a queen, a monster, or a devil. Whatever kind of bug you choose, you gain the ability to uplift the creatures around you and influence their minds with your power. Depending on the kind of higher being or bug, you might also get some kind of gimmick to your divine power- Silk, Void, Radiance, so on and so forth.

You are a member of the Hive- an anthropomorphic bee bearing the ability to fly, fling globs, needles, and blades of spike filled honey at higher power, and an armored exoskeleton allowing you to shrug off many attacks that would otherwise instantly kill a being with an endoskeleton. With enough power, you may be able to match the power of a Hive Queen.

You are a Deepnest Weaver- a six eyed, eight limbed anthropomorphic spider bearing a large, spherical mask on your head. You have the ability to weave your Soul into Silk, a substance capable of binding even gods. You are strong, fast, and can do whatever a spider can. Sadly, as an all female species uplifted from tiny spiders, you have a lot of trouble producing children.

You are a Mantis Warrior- a tall, strong, powerful mantis wielding bladed forelimbs, a lanky body, and the ability to move very, very fast if you want. Should you train properly, you may be able to fight with such power you could defend your home and village long after the rest of civilization crumbles.

You are a member of the Skarr- a fierce and vicious red ant decorated in bones and practiced in the ways of grounded and underground combat. While ordinary Skarr are locked into singular forms at birth, you, being special, may shape your growth and strength into a specialization you choose.

You are a member of the Moth Tribe, a magically inclined group of anthropomorphic moths bearing the knowledge of great magics due to an ancestral connection to the Radiance. While they aren't much for fighting, their ability to create enchanted artifacts- Charms- is second to none.

You are, somehow, a sapient entity connected to the deepest Void. You might not have much in the way of emotions or ability to talk, but you can still make connections, and your strength is enough that you could swallow the sun if the bitch came down to fight you. When cut off from the primal Void sea, you are weaker, but in the darkest dark and in the long forgotten places where the Abyss is found... you are nearly unstoppable.

A can of FXCF brand Soda. This one tastes like rasberry and gives the user a massive energy boost, guaranteed to let you keep on fucking all day. The flesh with which to do so is not included. All FXCF brand soda effects end after 24 hours without drinking another soda, and immediately end at the will of the user.

A can of FXCF brand Soda. Comes in both blueberry and strawberry. Changes the gender of the drinker to the opposite sex. Does work if already drunk, so drinking it again will return the drinker to their original gender. All FXCF brand soda effects end after 24 hours without drinking another soda, and immediately end at the will of the user.

A can of FXCF brand Soda. Tastes like frost. Increases the entire size of the drinker. There isn't any limit to how many of these may be drunk- it will always have an effect. All FXCF brand soda effects end after 24 hours without drinking another soda, and immediately end at the will of the user.

A can of FXCF brand Soda. Tastes like assorted berries. Give the user a dick if they didn't have one. If they did, increase the size of that dick. Potentially to massive proportions. All FXCF brand soda effects end after 24 hours without drinking another soda, and immediately end at the will of the user.

A can of FXCF brand Soda. Taste like grape. Gives the drinker boobs if they didn't already have them. If they did, increases the size of boobs, potentially to massive levels. All FXCF brand soda effects end after 24 hours without drinking another soda, and immediately end at the will of the user.

A can of FXCF brand Soda. Tastes like sweet tea. Transforms the drinker into an anthropomorphic animal best suited to them. All FXCF brand soda effects end after 24 hours without drinking another soda, and immediately end at the will of the user.

A can of FXCF brand Soda. Tastes like licorice. Transforms the drinker into living latex. All FXCF brand soda effects end after 24 hours without drinking another soda, and immediately end at the will of the user.

A can of FXCF brand Soda. Tastes like blueberry. Turns the drinker into a robot. All FXCF brand soda effects end after 24 hours without drinking another soda, and immediately end at the will of the user.

A can of FXCF brand Soda. Tastes like coffee. Transforms the drinker into a monster. One of the sexy kind. All FXCF brand soda effects end after 24 hours without drinking another soda, and immediately end at the will of the user.

A can of FXCF brand Soda. Tastes like cola. Transforms the drinker into a stone statue. Somehow you're still able to move. All FXCF brand soda effects end after 24 hours without drinking another soda, and immediately end at the will of the user.

A can of FXCF brand Soda. Tastes like cranberries. Severly drops intelligence, changes the drinker into female, gives them massive boobs, a big butt, and makes them really horny. A bimbo in other words. All FXCF brand soda effects end after 24 hours without drinking another soda, and immediately end at the will of the user.

A can of FXCF brand Soda. Green apple flavor. Transforms the user into a slime. No slime core included. All FXCF brand soda effects end after 24 hours without drinking another soda, and immediately end at the will of the user.

A can of FXCF brand Soda. The flavor's a mystery! Changes any genitals the user has into a latex null ball, preventing any attempt at orgasming. All FXCF brand soda effects end after 24 hours without drinking another soda, and immediately end at the will of the user.

A can of FXCF brand Soda. Tastes like pumpkin spice. Opens the drinkers body up to possession. Anyone could just push against them to take their body out for a test drive. Any spirits nearby are guaranteed to be horny and nothing else. Vengeful or malicious spirits are repelled. All FXCF brand soda effects end after 24 hours without drinking another soda, and immediately end at the will of the user.

A can of FXCF brand Soda. Hard raspberry flavor. Alters the drinker's dick to have a knot. If the drinker doens't have a dick it does nothing, but does ensure if they get a dick they'll have a knot. All FXCF brand soda effects end after 24 hours without drinking another soda, and immediately end at the will of the user.
A large cooler containing an infinite amount of every FXCF brand drink. Plus generic versions with no effects other than tasting quite good.
Extend the area of effect of any magic or effect that you cast without decreasing its power. The wider the area you expand your spell effect to, the more energy it takes to cast that spell.

Make a finger gun motion to blast anyone you aim at with a powerful burst of telekinetic energy capable of piercing just about anything. With training and focus, you could also modify the effects to utilize your own abilities or "swap ammo" to make the telekinesis act like explosive, hollow point, incendiary, or other specialist rounds.

A spell that causes a bright red vortex of damage upon any target you aim it at, causing the affected area to become lacerated, shredded, torn, yanked off, lopped off, or just have a hole blown straight through. The more you want to hurt someone, and the more energy you use, the more damage it does.

Manipulate any and all cement-based material by touching it. While you can't create new cement, any cement that's directly connected to what you're already controlling is yours to command, giving you a wide area of manipulation with lots of force options- spikes, walls, barriers, buildings, pits, so on and so forth. Works best in urban areas.

Convert any object or material you touch into a melee or otherwise non-automatic weapon. Fire sword, wind scythe, water whip, lightning bow, so on and so forth. The world is your armory and you will never run out. As long as the material you pull from has enough volume to make what you need, at least.

Send subtle telepathic impulses to any target within your perceptual field, allowing you to make them do what you want either by making them think the impulses were their idea, or by conditioning them into just doing what you want directly.

Become a large, hulking, possibly green skinned humanoid monster, usually with some kind of underbite and large teeth. Or you can become an ogre hybrid if you want. You gain enhanced strength, high speed regeneration, a smattering of magic related abilities, resistance to any and all swamp-borne diseases or medical conditions, and a taste for human flesh while transformed.

Create a variety of blades from your internal energy- throwing knives, katanas, sabers, greatswords, shuriken, chakrams, so on and so forth. Also provides a minor passive strength boost, allowing you to wield your weaponry more effectively.

You are able to take on the burdens of others by transferring their injuries, exhaustion, curses, sicknesses, and any other ailment onto yourself with a single touch. Might kill you if the damage is too severe... but hey, that's what a martyr does, right?

Summon or create lesser Demons such as imps, damned souls, lesser succubi, etc. Each one can use D rank or lower infernal magic or effects. The power of the demons depends on your own expertise and power. The conjured demons will vanish if you stop supplying them with energy, though with practice you can call demons with set durations or even permanent summons. Summoned demons are not considered Familiars.

Summon up to five Liaisons- perfect copies of you that you may either control remotely, or let act as you instruct them to- with which to act in your stead. Your Liaisons may use every Ability currently active in your list, expending your energy as if you were the one casting. With time and training, you may summon more Liaisons and allow them to use higher level abilities, spells, and other effects.

Imbue emotions and intent into your voice that allows it to resonate further and more intensely with whoever hears it. This effect is amplified when singing, and even further when singing skillfully. With the right vocal training, you could cause an entire army of people to obey your every word.

A princess of the tengu realm who's existed since the Heian era. She's well versed in martial arts, seduction, flight, and also creating massive wind storms that last upwards of a week. She's also quite loud and arrogant and very flirty. She also likes fighting, hates losing, and is about as much of an alcoholic as any other yokai.

A master of kung fu in all its forms, skilled with any and all melee weapons and a fair amount of improvised ones, he's easily capable of punching steel to scattered fragments, running up sheer cliffs, fighting through entire armies of extremely strong warriors, and making even the heroes of an entire nation look like inexperienced fools. He's as arrogant and self centered as he is intelligent and skilled, though if you manage to cool his temper he might end up the best possible kung fu teacher you could ever ask for.

An Onmyoudou digimon well versed in all manner of magics via its talismans and spells. It's also mastered the usage of hidden weapons, and does its best work in the dark. Its talismans may be used to create shikigami, bind enemies, create massive explosions, or even shield itself and its partner. It may also create an even bigger detonation using its massive brush during its unique skill of "Bonhitsusen", where it draws out a sanskrit character and sends it hurtling towards an enemy to explode on contact.

A draconic snake-like digimon wielding a parasol and styled much like a Victorian noble lady. It can synthesize and wield a variety of poisons to paralyze enemies, melt substances, shorten an enemy's life span, or just outright kill someone. It is a master of all poisons, and can easily break down toxic effects like digital viruses, diseases, or other poisons. It really enjoys watching its victims suffer.

A powerful fish monster and the leader of the underground royal guard, Undyne is strong, fast, and skilled- able to suplex boulders with ease and chase after targets for hours on end. Her signature magic allow her to conjure spears that either burst out of the ground or manifest in the air to impale her target. She's one hell of a drill instructor, though she's also impatient, hot headed, incredibly impulsive, extremely dramatic, and also bad with heat. Also, she's really gay for a specific yellow dinosaur lady.

A woven, wicker horn containing an unlimited amount of fresh, high quality, delicious fruits, vegetables, and other plant products. You may retrieve any item at any time, just think about how much you want or need before either reaching in or tipping the horn out. Also contains mushrooms, despite them not being plants. Any and all seeds or spores retrieved from the cornucopia may be planted and farmed at a higher speed than normal.

An altar of stone spikes jutting from the ground that collects mana from nature to give birth to spirits of earth. As the owner of the altar, the elementals will obey you, though your allies may use it as well.

A ring that generates a single charge per hour for a total of three. Each charge may be used for one of three effects: A blink teleport placing you anywhere within 1 kilometer of your position, five minutes of high speed flight, or five minutes of high speed movement.

A single use wrapped present. While it's otherwise entirely plain, it will give you exactly the item you need at any given point as long as the situation is C-rank or lower. Otherwise, opening the box just reveals an empty IOU before it closes again. Once you receive an actual item, the box vanishes.
A crystal orb filled with almost glittering clouds. When on your person it improves wind and lightning based abilities significantly
A metallic orb seemingly made of bronze. When on your person it prevents others from dispelling magic or abilities cast by you or your allies.

Upon placing this voucher down, a rocky spring forms regardless of location or water table. The spring water is mana rich and bathing in the spring will replenish all energy and temporarily double your mana capacity until the overflow is used up. The spring requires time to recharge after use, though, and can only be used twice a week.
A single Chlorophyte bar, an organic metal that spreads through mud. Magical, very durable, and farmable. Can be turned into homing bullets and other magical items.

Your very own walk in doctor. The Automatic Doctor is a creation of the Big MT, a research conglomerate, and is a large squarish object made of metal with a rather old looking computer on the side. This Auto-doc is capable of doing literally anything a doctor could do. From repairing injures to treating addiction to plastic surgery to implanting implants to swapping out organs to... well. You get the idea. It appears in a convenient location in whatever home you have and may be moved.

A packet of grass seeds that will instantly start growing a lush, vibrant garden full of all sorts of plants, crops, and living things regardless of the environment around them- even a blasted, irradiated wasteland will become rich with life in less than a few days. Once the initial garden reaches maturity, it begins to expand and continue enriching the soil and air and water around it- though you can stop the expansion at any time by just fencing it in with any barrier- chain link, barbed wire, even a line of spray paint will do. Anything grown within the area of the garden sprouts faster, and becomes far healthier and larger than anything outside. Any livestock raised within the garden are also larger and healthier.

A set of vampire fangs that take the place of your normal teeth. Doesn't turn you into an actual vampire, but it does allow you to drain people of their blood. The stronger the person, the more power you gain from their blood, though its ultimately a temporary boost. Should you wish, you can drain a person in seconds.

A set of two discs that float at the user's back. When activated they turn into large white wings, allowing for extremely swift flight with incredible mobility. In addition, you may fire off feathers at high speeds which can pierce metal armor. If you train with them enough, you unlock its final ability. Transforming the wings from feathery to energy, they gain the ability to block attacks and be used far more effectively at close range.

A fumo of Remilia Scarlet, mistress of the Scarlet Devil Mansion. Shake this plushie violently in order to imbue yourself with C-rank luck for 24 hours, or smack someone with it to jinx them for 24 hours. Can only be used once a week.
You're a mathematical savant- you're not doing calculations by the billions yet, but you can outthink a calculator and solve just about any math problem in seconds.

The magical and esoteric nature of reality is now yours to comprehend, understand, and imagine. You now learn magic far more quickly, and understand all things mystical and arcane far more easily. You may even understand eldritch horrors now, instead of being driven mad by the dimensionality.

You're one hell of a smooth talker. You could get just about anyone to agree with what you say, even if it's an outright lie. You've got charisma, eloquence, and rhetoric to spare. You could make a great politician, but that's kinda beneath you at this point.

You have a reasonable proficiency in any and all mundane, conventional weapons- guns, swords, flails, whips, chakrams, chains, clubs, whatever. As long as it doesn't have any magical effects, you can wield it about enough to put the business end on target and take out anyone that isn't a master of that particular weapon.
Your cells have the lifetime achievement award! They word far better than they should, preventing cancer, healing just a bit faster, and making you overall more energized.

You're immune to temperature extremes. Doesn't matter if its a windy tundra or a sunny desert, you never feel too hot or too cold. This does not protect you from what is causing those extremes. It would be recommended to stay away from lava, even if you can stand next to it without issue.
Tripping is for other people. You're steady on your feet, and throwing off your balance is just next to impossible.

Your fives senses work no matter what. Sand in eyes? Ignore it. Sonic scream? Ignore it. As long as you physically have the capability to see, hear, taste, touch, and smell, you can do so. Though this doesn't prevent any damage, so that sonic scream still ruptures your eardrums and the sand is still really irritating.

You're perfect. Without your explicit consent, your body refuses to change. It doesn't matter what tries it, nothing works. Any attempt to decieve, downplay, overplay, or otherwise not be entirely truthful ensures the process also doesn't work.

Shh, no peeking. Anyone attempting to obtain information on you through supernatural means get a whole load of absolutely nothing. As far as things like divination or scrying are concerned, you just don't exist.

Can you do it? It'd take a shorter time to list out what you can't do. Anything that doesn't take special training, magical abilities, or is otherwise esoteric is something you've got a pretty good grounding in. Even the things you can't do you know a little about, though doing them is beyond you. Consider yourself a Beginner in... most everything, really.

Control the very air itself. You have to move to do so, though you can still do a little without any movement, and you can control air out to a rather far range to a fine degree. Create an instant whirlwind or fly if you want.

You can call down more lightning! It comes from the sky and targets what you want it to hit, slamming home several times with only one use of the power. Not so great underground or in buildings that the electricity can't punch through.

You may generate and control electricity, though you can only control the electricity you generate personally. However, in addition to throwing it around, you may use it to boost your own physical abilities and sense electrical currents. With practice you can run as fast as a motorcycle or track a single phone across a city.

You can grow metal from any surface. Spike of iron, hammers of steel, arrows of copper, there isn't a limit to what you can create or how far you can manipulate the metal you make. Except one- you cannot create metal inside another living being.

You can make your own friends! By placing your energy into an inanimate object and willing it, you may create a golem. They aren't smart, are only as strong and the material they're made of, and are pretty slow. Still, they'll obey you without question. Using this on more refined things, such as a statue instead of a hunk of marble, improves the resulting golem. If you get a true masterpiece, maybe you'll find yourself with more than a simple golem.

Rough and irritating and it gets everywhere. Your body is a sandstorm, a whirling mass of sand that can solidify and discorporate at will. The more powerful you grow, the larger the storm you are. Even blanketing planets in your storm is possible, if extremely taxing mentally.

Doesn't eat people. You can now create clouds of unnatural darkness. Seeing into them from outside is impossible, and once inside sound becomes heavily muffled, abilities are suppressed, and no ability to see in the dark can pierce the gloom. Unfortunately, you can only make so much darkness, and while abilities are supressed they aren't disabled.

Breathe deep and unleash the universe. By willing it you may unleash a breath of the formless void, the thing before all. It rips and ravages anything that exists, grinding it away into powder and then less. You also gain the ability to breathe in longer in preparation to use this attack, making the resulting breath more damaging and allowing you to keep it up for longer.

You've taken a step on the path to becoming a dragon! You may grow dragon scales over your skin at will. It takes about a minute or two for full coverage, but a small area is nearly instant. Not only are they highly resistent to damage, but they also resist a single element to the same level. You may pull back and regrow the scales to gain resistance to a different element, losing the original resistance, at any point.

A type of Kagune that takes the shape of multiple flexible tendrils and erupts from the body somewhere around the waist area. It has high striking power, powerful regeneration, the ability to merge into a stronger tentacle, and the ability to shapeshift into claws or swords. However, due to its abnormally flexible and liquid-like constitution, it's rather terrible for defense. You start with only one, but with practice and increasing strength you might get more.
Geiger counter? More a food indicator. You naturally take in radiation and turn it into energy. A lot like a plant turns sunlight into energy.

The longer the fight goes on, the more dangerous you get. You being with a minor pyrokinetic ability, but the longer you continuously engage in combat the more your entire body begins to transform into an absolutely massive western dragon and the more impressive your pyrokinesis gets. This has no upper limit- so long as you can survive you'll keep getting tougher, stronger, and faster while healing quicker and sending out even more impressive, and hotter, waves of fire.

You may burn any receipt you have possession of. When the receipt is fully burned you will promptly recieve the item or service that the reciept was for. For instance- you may burn the receipt of a purchase of a knife to get a copy of that knife. Or a receipt for a spa day to suddenly be refreshed as if you had just had a spa day. Any item generated by this technique can be given a single command, and they will disappear after fulfilling that command. Those not given a command will last longer, but ultimately all constructs generated are temporary.

A little switcheroo. You may swap one of your powers for anyone else's power. Or swap the powers of two other people. Or swap your own power with another of your powers! That doesn't do anything, anyway- the powers must be roughly equal and all parties must have agreed to the swap. However, there is no other limit to what can be swapped, and 'power' is a very broad term. In a pinch- anything on the gacha can be swapped with anything else on the gacha.
Hugeify! You can make things bigger! You can make things smaller! But only if you first made them bigger! This effect can be permanent or temporary, though a permanent change is harder to make.

It's not technically stealing. When someone uses a move in front of you, you may copy that move. You only get one use of it, in the exact state it was used when you saw it, but otherwise there are no limits to what you can copy.
A massive skull projection that shoots lasers. Might be venomous, somehow. Point at genocidal child and fire away. With training you can make more, faster.

Time for a slaughter! You may enter ripper mode, a state in which you are surrounded by a blood red aura, gaining speed, strength, and an absolutely unhinged mindset. Stopping before the enemy are all dead is impossible, and pain just makes you want to keep going.

Accelerate your own body. You can make your entire body work faster, improving your speed, reaction time, healing, and everything else about your body specifically. Accelerating too fast will harm you, and acting a double time or more can be disorienting.

A parastie, Leviathan needs to enter a host in order to live. As it happens, he is rather fond of his hosts and acts as a proper gentlemen when possible. He can breathe fire and stiffen himself to be used as a spear.
One of the three legendary birds, Moltres reigns over fire. It can call forth massive firestorms and send out waves of fire at will.
One of the three legendary birds, Zapdos reigns over lightning. It can call down massive thunderstorms and fling bolts of lightning at will.

UB-01-Symbiont. A jellyfish like Ultra Beast, the Nihilego is a passive creature that simply floats around most of the time. However, it is actually a parasite, placing it's bell over the heads of other creatures and utilizing it's neurotoxin to force them to fight to protect it. While under the effects of the neurotoxin, individuals will find themselves constantly excited, with fewer inhibitions and with their bodies forcefully maintaining their most powerful state. They can also alter memories and heal.

Daki is a curvy woman with white hair and lime eyes. Sadistic, dismissive, and arrogant. As a demon she can only be killed by sunlight, wisteria poison, or having her head cut off, but can only consume human flesh. As one of the Upper Moons, Daki is a dangerous fighter, exceptionally fast with nails sharp enough to easily cut through a body, and can extend clothlike flesh tendrils that look like a standard obi. She can trap humans inside of it without killing them, fit to take out and eat when she pleases. She is also a fully trained courtesan and can shapeshift to an exceptional degree.

You receive a single Null Guardian- a gray skinned, bat-winged, fang-mouthed, tentacle-wielding monstrosity from the extradimensional prison from which there is very little chance of escape. They are capable of firing a beam weapon from their mouths, flying, grappling with their tendrils, biting, and also telepathically sensing the life energy of any and all creatures around them. With time and more energy capacity, you may summon more based on your stats. With enough power, you could summon entire armies of them.

An exceptionally intelligent, and rather ruthless, falcon. Pet Shop has the Stand Horus, allowing him to generate and manipulate large amounts of ice. He will work for you in whatever capacity you wish, but is best at being a guard, and being an absolute bastard motherfucker to your enemies.

The ultimate attendent. As a first era pearl, and a diamond's pearl, Pearl was crafted to the absolute highest standard, experienced in a variety of tasks to entertain, assist, and serve her assigned master. Pearl herself has learned to be far more independent, and is rather handy as a mechanic, but still tends to freak out if things don't go how she expects them to.

A Dragonkin Digimon. Medusamon has exceptionally large snakes in place of hair, and in combat these snakes attack her foes while she remains near entirely defensive. Should someone get past the snakes her stinger tail and knife boots present a dangerous threat. Can emit a flash of light that turns anything it touches to stone. As a top level Digimon she cannot digivolve further.

A Fanged Wyvern, the Lunagaron has a special organ which chills the air around it. Extremely aggressive, swift, and strong, should this great beast somehow be pushed to the limit it can stand up and shut off it's special organ to allow it's muscles to heat up and expand, granting it even more strength.

Snicker snack! A blade once used to kill an evil dragon, it glows orange and seems to burn with energy. Even blocked, the might within this blade may stun foes, and the wielder can gather their energy to slash three times faster than most can react. Focusing on the blade allows the user to reinforce themselves, improving the power of electric, frost, and fire attacks temporarily.

Crafted by Merlin to hide Excalibur, Invisible Air is a heavy mist that swirls around whatever weapon you're using, hiding it from sight. Should the time come to reveal your weapon you can dispel Invisible Air as a tornado against your foe. It'll take a little while for the effect to re-establish itself.
A tome with a number of nude figures on the front. Reading it will grant the secrets of Eromancy, magic that makes use of, and enhances, sex.

A single normal looking weapon magazine. When brought near a gun it will change itself to fit in it and provides infinite ammo to any weapon using it. Doesn't prevent any other issue that may arise from firing a gun too long, like heat.

A gold embossed leather tome teaching the secrets of Carian Sorcery. This study focuses on summoning constructs to attack foes, defying the usual idea of a mage as being a backline combatant by covering their staves in glowing blue swords to slash at their foes. At higher levels practitioners may create copies of the moon to float toward and crash against foes, summon floating swords to fire at any enemy that comes close, and turn incoming spell against their casters.
An ancient rusty crimson blade. Completely useless, except in satisfying grudges. The more deeply held the grudge, the stronger the blade.
A leather purse. Every day it will provide an amount of gold equivalent to 500 gold coins. Which is nearly 15 kilograms of gold. Damn.

A large form that contains a seemingly endless number of questions. Properly filling out the entire form will cause it to disappear and the next day the one who filled it out will find themselves with a weapon perfectly suited to them in all ways. You get one comission a year.
A ring granted unto the Princess of Oolacile. It drains the vitality from the wearer, but in exchange makes magic less expensive to cast.

Ah, my guiding moonlight. The blade wielded by Ludwig, it's a massive greatsword that seems normal until it gathers unknown energies from the cosmos. Once charged it emanates blue light and sparkles with glimpses of distant stars. Gazing into the blade may bring some guidance, but it may not be particularly straightforward. When properly utilized it allows the used to channel the cosmos with every swing, firing off cresents of energy that seems to contain distant stars.

A single vat filled with the Forced Evolutionary Virus. By default this will turn anyone that touches it into a Super Mutant- a sterile, radiation immune, masculine seeming beast with enhanced physicality- but can be modified with the right knowledge to produce any result. The vat is sealed, and includes an integrated computer that allows modifying the FEV within.

A single suit of incredibly advanced power armor. Made to be used by already augmented super humans, this armor holds a fusion battery that will never run out and utilizes multiple layers in order to protect the wearer. It is entirely sealed, unable to be affected by electromagnetic pulses and allowing the wearer to survive in space. It also filters the air moving through the helmet. A port in the back connects it directly to the mind of the wearer, ensuring that the armor moves at the speed of reflex. Though anyone not enhanced enough will only harm themselves in attempting to use it.

A somehow skeletal metal key. When used as if opening the lock on a door will create a portal into The Morgue. A vast space with seemingly an infinite number of corpses in various stages of preservation. While you never encounter any living denizens, the place changes every time you enter. Placing any biological matter in The Morgue will prevent it from decaying, and corpses will be properly preserved. You may leave instructions as to the exact method of preservation- no request too absurd. Just don't leave the living, you probably won't get them back.
A fancy iridescent cloak! When exposed to direct sunlight it goes invisible, hiding anyone under it.
An ancient lich's mask, granting the wearer incredible resistance to ice, while also boosting the wearer's affinity with ice abilities, both physical and magical.

An odd wooden mask that, when worn, allows the wearer to pull out 100% of their abilities. Every single bit of their potential is unlocked, providing great strength, speed, intelligence, and anything else they have access to. Unfortunately, it only brings out 100% of their potential, and someone who can scale higher can still defeat them.

A surprisingly cute looking dog thing. When dormant it looks like a harmless, if slightly dopy looking, white dog that walks on it's hind legs. When activated in combat it becomes an absolute monster, large enough to swallow a grown woman whole, very fast, and exceptionally durable. The dog is intelligent, completely capable of understanding speech and orders, though unable to speak. He's also quite hungry and prefers meat, eating vast amounts without issue and... not really caring if the meat is currently living or not.
Suika Ibuki in the convenient form of a fumo. By providing energy this fumo can get denser and denser, acting as a rather effective bludgeon.

A sword style created to emphasize acting like thunder. It focuses on single powerful strikes and extreme speed. Particularly skilled users manifest an illusion of lightning to accompany their attacks, which can be made real by channeling more energy into the style.

A sword style created to emphasize acting like stone. It focuses on using heavy weapons and proper grounding to defend and attack. Particularly skilled users manifest an illusion of dust to accompany their attacks, which can be made real by channeling more energy into the style.

A sword style created to emphasize acting like the moon. It is a perfected style, equally adept at defense and offense and focuses on crescent slashes. Intended to be used with an ability which allows the user to send out blades of energy. Particularly skilled users manifest an illusion of crescent moon to accompany their attacks, which can be made real by channeling more energy into the style. Something which the style is meant to be accompanied by.

A sword style created to emphasize acting like an insect. It focuses on fast speeds, numerous stabbing or piercing attacks, and utilizing poisons. This style is not suited to directly killing, but instead functions as a method of applying poison to the opponent. Particularly skilled users manifest an illusion of butteflies to accompany their attacks, which can be made real by channeling more energy into the style.

A sword style created to emphasize acting like a snake. It focuses on acting as a serpent would, with attacks that curve, wind, or otherwise strike in odd patterns. Unlike most other Breathing Styles, this style takes advantage of a specific sort of twisted blade. Particularly skilled users manifest an illusion of snakes to accompany their attacks, which can be made real by channeling more energy into the style.

A sword style created to emphasize the emotion of love. It focuses on wide, long slashes and acrobatics. Unlike most other Breathing Styles, this one makes use of a sword whip and is intended to be used by someone with unnatural strength, Particularly skilled users manifest an illusion of pink and green sparks to accompany their attacks, which can be made real by channeling more energy into the style.

A sword style created to mimic sound. It focuses on forcing a rhythm onto the opponent, using explosives, and moving extremely swiftly. It is intended to be used by those with exceptional hearing and makes use of multiple pebble sized explosives. Particularly skilled users manifest an illusion of sound waves to accompany their attacks, which can be made real by channeling more energy into the style.

A sword style created to emphasize acting like mist. It focuses on obscuring the opponent's view, confusing them, and striking from unexpected angles. Particularly skilled users manifest an illusion of mist to accompany their attacks, which can be made real by channeling more energy into the style.

A sword style created to emphasize acting like a beast. It focuses on wild, straightforward attacks and unpredictable movement. Particularly skilled users manifest an illusion of fangs and claws to accompany their attacks, which can be made real by channeling more energy into the style.

However you choose it to happen, you gain immaculate skill with iaijutsu to the point of being able to fling sword beams, Judgement Cut, Judgement Cut End, seemingly teleport, and do all manner of stuff usually attributed to a certain son of Sparda. You might even get a monstrous second form with enough training and power ups. Usually comes with a tragic backstory, an aloof personality, and occasionally white hair.

A sword style created to emphasize acting like blooming flowers. It focuses on fast, graceful movements and attacks. This technique makes heavy use of vision, with it's final technique heavily increasing the user's visual processing, to the point of seeing the world in slow motion, at the cost of potentially damaging their vision permanently. Particularly skilled users manifest an illusion of flowers to accompany their attacks, which can be made real by channeling more energy into the style.

A collection of Glowing Mushrooms, and also some Mushroom Grass Seeds. Both of them need to be grown on mud. The glowing mushrooms are good for you, and can increase your night vision or be turned into a potion to make you healthier.

Congratulations, you've rediscovered the stealth archer meta! All stealth and long ranged sniping abilities, effects, spells, and skills are enhanced by up to 10 times efficacy, while anything not tangentially related to stealth or archery gets largely left by the wayside in terms of combat enhancements.

Squash? Sirloin? Rare coins? Tombstone? Corn? Wizard hat? French horn? Battleaxe? Conjoined twins? Earth? Sun? Milky Way? Cornucopia? Mushroom cloud? End times? Four Horsemen? Seventh Seal? Stuff it all in the cornucopia.

A small pack of five black cats that seem to have evolved outward bony protrusions resembling the spine, ribs, and head of a T-rex, where the spine and ribs encompass their torso and backs, and the head "holds" their real head in its jaws. The bones, incongruously, can glow in the dark, though they don't do much else. It's really cute, though.

Seeds that allow you to grow the lotuses native to the Palpagos Archipelago: Might, Life, Speed, Carrying, and Stamina. These lotuses, when combined with materials from supernatural beasts, be used to create potions that enhance their related 'stat'.

Seeds for any undersea flora that exist on Earth... except the plants grown will be made of bone and bone marrow. They constantly produce blood that stays eternally fresh. Perfect for blood transfusions, ritual blood sacrifices, evil kingdoms sculpted entirely from bone, and blood oceans!

By Arceus' whimsy and might you have been turned into the iconic Ghost Trainer from Kalos along with the unique dress, swirly eyes and a complexion that screams to touch grass. However as a benefit, occult related things are easier to train and understand.

You may link active Abilities to a Transformation Belt, weakening them and restricting their usage normally but empowering them when transformed and potentially allowing you to express new aspects through the transformation. The transformation is temporary, scaling with your base stats and exhausting you when it runs out. The transformation comes with a snazzy armoured suit that also includes a cool weapon of some kind, the appearance and capabilities of which depends on which abilities you linked to this ability.
You will sneeze whenever somebody is talking about you without you being present.

Changes your race to that of a Protoss. The Khala is intact and untouched by Amon, assuming you're in a world he does not exist in. Your psionic talent and instinctive capabilities are enhanced, and you can access any of the major tribe specialties, such as Void Energy (your standard Psionic Energy), with training or even through inhaling Terrazine.

A stack of Wheat seeds- enough seeds to plant 64 square meters of wheat that grows from seedling to fully mature in a week, and instantly separates itself into usable product and extra seeds upon harvest.
A teardrop shaped red crystal that, upon being willed to activate, will vanish and permanently increase your strength by a noticeable but fixed amount.
A small pouch of glittering blue dust that, upon being willed to activate, will vanish and permanently increase your magical potency by a noticeable but fixed amount.
A small white feather that, upon being willed to activate, will vanish and permanently increase your speed and agility by a noticeable but fixed amount.

A small plastic crate the size of a milk crate containing ten plastic packets each of Moo-Moo and Chick-Chick, brands of synthetic beef and chicken. While each packet is nutritious and equivalent to a light meal, the taste is only vaguely similar to the real thing and has barely any seasoning.
At will, instantly explode with the full force of every nuclear weapon ever made. After one hour, you reform in the nearest safe location in the exact condition you were in before activation.

Whoops, seems like someone needed that token a bit more than you! Don't worry, as long as you accept this token and keep it on your person you'll be reimbursed within a month, with a little interest: Your reimbursed token is guaranteed to roll something you may find of use, instead of the possible junk a random roll would give.

You're descended from a dragon. This heritage grants you draconic physical traits, enhances your vitality and fertility, boosts physical and magical capabilities, and extends your own lifespan and that of those who drink your blood. Furthermore, your body parts, fluids, and excretions can be used as magical reagents, crafting materials, and the like.

A seed packet that produces an endless supply of Winter Seeds. When planted during cold weather, mature plants randomly yield a Crocus, Crystal Fruit, Snow Yam, or Winter Root; however, these seeds will only grow while the weather is cold.

Seeds used to grow Yumako and Jellynut trees, either manually or with an agricultural tower. Mature trees produce their respective fruits when harvested; Yumako provides a small health regeneration effect, while Jellynut grants a movement speed bonus. They also make good fuel.
Two sealed jars containing iron and copper bacteria. Once released, the bacteria must be carefully cultivated and kept alive to establish colonies that can be farmed for iron and copper.

A meaty, bioengineered mushroom grown for its nutritional value. It can grow on soil or fungal gravel, but only in complete darkness, as exposure to any kind of light, including darklights, will kill it.

Every so often, the Traveling Merchant may appear, or find you, and offer a bizarre selection of goods from the local reality and other dimensions.
