Their randomly changing stock can include novelties, weapons, consumables, and farmables from the gacha From Rank F to S, with prices that are somewhat steep but are still payable in local currency or through profitable barter.

A hydroponics basin with extremely fertile growing conditions that allows most crops to grow rapidly. It requires a significant amount of power to operate but does not provide sunlight, so suitable lighting is still required; it also comes with instructions for building more, although finding the necessary materials may be difficult.
A special brew that instantly cures drunkenness.
A tropical tree genetically engineered to produce naturally sweet chocolate while tolerating climates that are slightly cooler than those normally suitable for cocoa.

A fragile, genetically engineered mushroom that produces a silk-like fiber that is exceptionally difficult to tear while remaining remarkably soft to the touch. It takes an extremely long time to grow, but its devilstrand fibers are surpassed only by exotic ultra-tech fabrics.

A slow-growing medicinal plant that produces herbal medicine when harvested. Its delicate shoots make both sowing and harvesting labor-intensive, but centuries of selective breeding have made it highly valued for its five major medicinal properties; some tribes also call it “healer’s hand.”
A leafy crop whose leaves contain chemicals that produce relaxing psychological effects. The leaves can be processed into joints at a crafting spot, which reduce motivation and can be addictive.

A leafy plant that produces psychite, a chemical originally evolved as a defense mechanism against herbivores by overstimulating and sickening them. Its leaves can be harvested and refined into various psychite-based substances for recreational use, though they are addictive.

You gain all the seeds for the following farmable RimWorld plants: Bonsai Tree, Cocoa Tree, Corn Plant, Cotton Plant, Devilstrand, Fibercorn, Gauranlen Pod, Haygrass, Healroot, Hop Plant, Nutrifungus, Potato Plant, Psychoid Plant, Rice Plant, Smokeleaf Plant, Strawberry Plant, Tinctoria, and Toxipotato Plant.
A crate that refreshes weekly with RimWorld medicines and drugs, providing Go-juice, Wake-up, Penoxycyline, and Medicine.

You are now a Waster, an aggressive, toxin-adapted human engineered to survive in polluted and disease-ridden environments. You are immune to toxic pollution, highly resistant to disease, and can consume unlimited amounts of psychite and Wake-up without ill effects, though your metabolism requires you to regularly consume psychite such as flake or yayo. You are also given a Psychoid Plant farmable item for free, along with a month's worth of yayo.

You are now a Dirtmole, a gray-skinned human adapted to artificial light and cramped, dark environments. You are exceptionally skilled at digging and mining, but in open areas you suffer from light sensitivity, reduced movement speed, and poor long-distance vision.

You are now a Pigskin, a hardy human-pig hybrid capable of speech, tool use, and bipedal movement. You can eat almost anything and excel in close combat, but your trotter-like hands hinder precision and poor eyesight limits your range. Originally engineered as organ donors, Pigskins became far more humanlike than their creators intended.

You are now a Starjack, engineered for life in deep space. Your reflective, pressure-adaptive skin protects against extreme temperatures and allows brief survival in hard vacuum, making you ideal for spacewalks and decompression emergencies. However, low gravity leaves you with reduced muscle mass and strength compared to baseline humans.

You are now a Sanguophage, an archotech-enhanced xenohuman with immense mental ability, supernatural beauty, deadly spines, and the power to heal others. You never age, die naturally, or suffer disease or poison, but must regularly consume human-derived hemogen and enter a deathrest. Fire can destroy you, while UV light weakens and slows you.

An iron mine that will automatically place itself wherever you rip the voucher. You may place it at a location of your choosing, and the ore veins within will replenish daily and never run dry. Be careful, it will replace preexisting things below its entrance.

A futuristic wrist device containing robotic forms: Disassembly Drone, Gypsy Danger, R2-D2, WALL-E, C-3PO, Bender, Robotboy, Mecha Sonic, Prime Shockwave, and T-800. Select a form to transform into it, gaining its appearance, abilities, skills, combat memories, and equipment. You remain fully self-aware, feel alive, require no pilot, and can scan robots to add new forms.

You are an engineered soldier built for aggressive, precise combat. You heal rapidly, withstand extreme temperatures, and freely use military drugs, but are genetically dependent on Go-juice. Your blood-red eyes, emotionless “Hussar stare,” and aggression unsettle baseline humans. You also receive RimWorld Medicines as a free consumable.

You are now a Yttakin, a large, fur-covered xenohuman engineered for ultra-cold planets. You are hardy, resilient, and psychically connected to wildlife, allowing you to summon animals during battle. Though slow, lacking energy and precision, you can endure hardships that would overwhelm others.

You are now a Dwarf, a stout, strong humanoid with perfect darkvision and heightened senses. You are naturally gifted at mining, metalsmithing, and stonecrafting, with a deep appreciation for wealth and rare metals. Dwarves are alcohol-dependent and can enter a martial trance when surrounded by enemies, greatly increasing their combat ability.

You are now a Night Elf, an ancient and resilient race deeply connected to nature and primal magic. You possess keen senses, longevity, and a natural affinity for druidic abilities. You are also highly skilled with bows and capable of riding beasts such as nightsabers.

You are now a pure Fairy born from the Planet or its Inner Sea, completely independent of human civilization. You are an existence comparable in scope to a Divine Spirit, possessing immense elemental power and a nature closely resembling an Elemental or True Ancestor, while remaining free from rules imposed upon humanity.
You're now a stick figure, as seen in those fighting animations! Massive increase to your strength, speed, durability, skill, stamina, and energy reserves!

Your body is made of a crystalline flesh that gets exponentially more durable towards the core (your only vital organ). You have mild regeneration, are 15-45 meters tall, resist esoteric effects, and all of your powers are absurdly better by every metric.

A flock of anomalous “Thunder Sheep.” They are massive, metallic-fleeced sheep capable of generating powerful electrical discharges and manipulating electromagnetic fields to levitate. They can be raised for their wool, meat, milk, horns, and other useful by-products, but require careful handling due to their dangerous electrical abilities.

Potatoes capable of growing in almost any environment, extreme or not. They may take some time to adapt to their surroundings, but as long as there is soil, they can eventually grow and produce a harvest.

Plenty of Omninodes just got scattered across your world! And they're still connected to the Omninet of the Lancer universe! It won't be long before everyone starts making post-scarcity 3D printers, paracasual mechs, custom robots, and more!

A massive automated hydroponics facility that produces nutrient-rich vegetables tailored to local populations. It comes with a robotic workforce but can also provide jobs if desired. You receive one every six months, and it can be placed anywhere.

A large-scale energy generation facility housing power cells, plasma conduits, and high-output generator arrays. It comes with a robotic workforce but can also provide jobs if desired. You receive one every six months, and it can be placed anywhere.

A facility dedicated to shallow-surface excavation and ore collection, providing the resources needed to establish and expand mining districts. It comes with a robotic workforce but can also provide jobs if desired. You receive one every six months, and it can be placed anywhere.
The planet you are on gains a fully functional orbital ring with modules of your choosing, providing whatever infrastructure and capabilities those modules are designed to support.
A Dyson swarm is placed around the nearest star, allowing you to harvest vast amounts of stellar energy, provided you have the infrastructure needed to collect, transmit, and use it.

Through some means, all relevant nations and countries suddenly gain the ability to mass-produce and deploy practical military giant robots. If this genre already exists in the setting, reroll this using a token one rank higher than the one that granted this reward.

A colossal space station dedicated to the mass production of spacecraft, capable of constructing everything from standard vessels to enormous capital ships. Its vast industrial facilities can rapidly assemble and outfit fleets on an unprecedented scale. Plop it down anywhere on a solar system.

The entire world undergoes a sudden psychic awakening, with a small percentage of the population developing psychic powers. Existing psychics have their abilities doubled in strength. If the setting already has psychics, their total population is instead doubled.

Anyone attempting to copy your powers or create clones or offspring using your DNA without your permission is in for a very bad time. Any unauthorized attempt to replicate you or your abilities will trigger catastrophic failure. Any existing copies or clones of you are automatically afflicted with severe debuffs.

The world undergoes a genre shift into superhero comic-book logic. People can gain powers through various comic-book-style means, while superhero tropes, coincidences, and conventions become real and are enforced by the setting. If the setting is already a superhero genre, roll for 2 abilities and 1 passive of the same rank as the token instead.

A Reality Marble containing an endless armory of land, air, and space vehicles. You can freely summon, command, and use any technological or supernatural vehicle stored within it. The arsenal expands whenever you analyze and record new vehicles, making it increasingly versatile.

If the setting is dark or grimdark, the world is forcibly shifted toward Noblebright by manipulating events to favor hope, heroism, and the greater good, forcibly dragging the darkness kicking and screaming into the light. If the setting is not considered dark, reroll this using a token one rank higher than the one that granted it.
A crate containing Coral from Rubicon 3 that replenishes itself daily, providing an endless supply of the mysterious and valuable substance.

A crate filled with Xenium, a crystalline exotic-matter mineral unique to the alien borderworld of Xen. The crate replenishes its supply daily, providing a renewable source of this strange and valuable material.

The remains of the First Firmament made manifest into physical form. A green gem of immense power, the Time Stone allows the user near unlimited control over time, allowing time travel, rapid aging of enemies, time loops, and other temporal manipulation. Works best with the other Infinity Stones.

You spontaneously split into two bodies, sharing the same abilities and passives. Your new body is always your opposite gender; if you have no gender, it becomes a genderless copy. It takes time to adjust to controlling both bodies, but you now have two bodies to use simultaneously.

You become a Hypnobrai, a snake-like humanoid based on the speckled cobra with a hint of the rattlesnake. They feature blue and gray bodies with yellow accents, cobra hoods, and spiral eyes used to hypnotize enemies. You have legs instead of a tail unless the token is landed on again
You gain access to ICBMs equipped with harmless explosive payloads that trigger a gender-swap effect across an entire state upon detonation.

You become a Fangpyre, a snake-like humanoid that features a distinct red-and-white color scheme. Their signature power is snake transmutation, allowing them to turn people, vehicles, and objects into snakes through a single bite. You have legs instead of a tail unless the token is landed on again.
The history of this universe is inscribed into the Akashic Records and the Throne of Heroes, making its notable historical figures eligible to be summoned as Servants.

The collective will of humanity awakens as Alaya, becoming an active force within the world. Humanity’s subconscious survival instinct begins influencing events, guiding the species away from extinction and toward continued survival. If there are no humans, the closest equivalent sapient species takes their place.

You become a Constricitai, a snake-like humanoid that has orange, black, and metallic gray scales with large spikes. You have much greater physical strength than a normal human and can tunnel underground quickly for a surprise attack. You have legs instead of a tail unless the token is landed on again.

You become a Venomari, a snake-like humanoid that has lime-green and dark green scales with cobra-like hoods and toxic markings. You can spit a green fluid that forces targets to see vivid, terrifying visions of their worst fears. You have legs instead of a tail unless the token is landed on again.

You become an Anacondrai, a snake-like humanoid that has long purple and grey scales, and distinct tattoos. You now have natural combat leadership, enhanced speed, prehensile tail, and the power to turn invisible.
A large bag containing tree seed packets. These seeds will fully grow into their fruiting age after 3 months, at which point they will grow their various Paramecia Devil Fruits.
A large bag containing tree seed packets. These seeds will fully grow into their fruiting age after 3 months, at which point they will grow their various Zoan Devil Fruits.
A large bag containing tree seed packets. These seeds will fully grow into their fruiting age after 3 months at which point they will grow their various Logia Devil Fruits.
A large bag containing tree seed packets. These seeds will fully grow into their fruiting age after 3 months, at which point they will grow all the various Devil Fruits.
Extremely hardy coffee plants capable of growing in almost any environment while still producing beans that retain an excellent flavor when brewed.

You are a lithoid, with a body composed of rock, silicon, and crystals instead of organic tissue. You consume minerals rather than organic food and can metabolically generate other minerals, such as iron, within your body as needed.
You gain complete control over garbage and waste, allowing you to manipulate, move, reshape, combine, or otherwise control it however you wish.
The world is about to get weird. Expect bizarre powers, strange encounters, absurd situations, and increasingly unconventional adventures.

Any monster, eldritch being, or entity attempting to consume you or your soul finds you unbearably “spicy.” They immediately spit you back out completely unharmed and flee in disgust or overwhelming distress.
A Ghostbusters proton pack, complete with its particle accelerator and equipment such as ghost traps for trapping and containing ghosts.

You gain saplings for trees that grow and produce various ores, including iron, gold, diamond, redstone, and more. Once mature, these trees continuously provide their respective resources as they are harvested.

A magical chocolate factory now exists somewhere in the world, producing and selling Wonka’s fantastical candies. You gain access to the factory and can order its magical confectionaries completely free of charge.

A crystal pendant that grants access to the abilities and skills of a Paladin, a sword-and-shield wielding warrior with a specialization in defending themselves and others. Paladin abilities revolve around increasing defenses and redirecting damage. Access to what's within is gated by training, study, and combat- one does not simply equip the Job Crystal and become a fully fledged Paladin.
This 12th level spell, in a system which only goes up to 9th level, allows you to target one God and steal their divinity.

Design, modify, and build technology and technological constructs related to transformation and transformable technology. Such as a belt that becomes a suit of armor, a car that transforms into a jet, jets that form a mech, a transformation-inhibiting band, and themed armors that harness exotic materials to empower the wearer, depending on your skills, experience, and materials available.

You gain the fully upgraded High on Life bounty hunter suit, a durable adaptive combat suit with enhanced strength, durability, mobility, environmental protection, life support, recharging shields, and the loyal AI Suit-O. It includes a jetpack/Mag-Boots, Dodge Unit, Durahealth Tank, Slide Bash Unit, and Gatterall Compartment, enabling advanced traversal and access to otherwise unreachable locations. Remote access is disabled.

A crystal pendant that grants access to the abilities and skills of the Warrior, an Axe-wielding berserker warrior with a focus on drawing enemy aggro, powerful physical attacks against single targets or groups of weaker enemies, and sustaining oneself by damaging the enemy. Access to the abilities, skills, and traits within is gated by training, study, and combat- one does not simply equip the Job Crystal and become a fully fledged Warrior.

You become a Young Titan—a beast-like humanoid 2–10 feet tall, with a skull-like face, black fur, horns, pointed ears, and a tail; you may choose your height, build, and traits within range. Titans possess immense magic, superhuman strength, durability, heightened senses, sonic roars, ageless immortality, reality-warping immunity, and can emit glyph-enabling magic fields. Their power grows with age and training.

You become a young adult Titan—a colossal beast-like humanoid roughly 100–500 feet tall, with a skull-like face, black fur, horns, and a tail; you may choose your height, build, and traits within range. You possess immense magic, superhuman strength, durability, heightened senses, sonic roars, reality-warping immunity, ageless immortality, and emit a glyph-enabling magic field. Your size and power continue increasing with age and training.

You become an adult Titan—a truly colossal being capable of growing several miles tall, with a skull-like face, black fur, massive horns, and a powerful tail; you may choose your height, build, and traits within range. You possess nigh-omnipotent magic, immense physical power, reality-warping immunity, ageless immortality, devastating sonic roars, and a vast glyph-enabling magic field. Your size and power continue growing with age and training.

You become a Dry Bones—a skeletal Koopa retaining your full personality, memories, and free will, with none of the negative undead instincts. You can choose to be any standard Dry Bones variant. Your body can reassemble after destruction, making you effectively immortal— a perfected, fully sapient bone-lich.

You know Fishman Karate, a water-manipulating martial art invented by Fishmen. You can use water to enhance blows, disrupt the fluids inside your opponent with your hits or transmit the power of your fists through the moisture in the air. You begin as a White Belt and can train to reach higher mastery.
A strange weed that naturally suppresses magic and other supernatural phenomena.

A breeding herd of boomalopes capable of producing a steady supply of chemfuel. Their chemfuel can be refined into fuel, explosives, ammunition, and various other chemical products. Be warned, they explode when they die.

A breeding herd of Minecraft cows that reproduce extremely quickly, with only a few pieces of wheat needed for instant conception and birth. Calves mature into adults within a week, and all cows can be milked. Their milk clears all status effects. Don't ask any questions about how any of this works.

You're a master of concealing your presence and hiding away your true nature. Even if you had enough strength to challenge gods, you could make yourself seem no more impressive than the foliage. You could even walk around as if you were invisible with this level of presence concealment.

Your massages are straight up amazing- the pinnacle of the art. Relieve pain, soothe tension, remove stress, improve circulation, loosen joints- anything and everything at the highest degree of competency. Plus skills at a happy ending, of course.

You might as well be the king of the damn road- you're so good at driving you could compete in Moto GP on a tricycle and win somehow. Whatever the case is, you'll never be caught lacking in a car chase

Every time you find yourself in a dire situation, you can choose to restore all of your health, stamina, and energy at once to better face down the coming threat. However, immediately afterwards you will be exhausted to the point of falling into a short healing coma. Try not to use this more than once a week, or you will die.

You no longer need blood, organs, air, food, water, bathroom breaks, sleep, or even most of your body- your own mana will substitute it for you. However, it does mean you're going to need to replenish your mana faster than it drains out, otherwise you'll just die once it runs out if you haven't been taking care of yourself.
You gain an innate mastery of all things necromantic and undead. All death, soul, and undeath abilities are easier to master and are far more efficient and potent when cast.

Your gacha interface now updates with "daily" challenges- three challenges that appear as time limited quests that will stick around for 48 hours before resetting. Completing any challenge grants rewards in the form of resources, consumables, money, or, very rarely, more tokens. Failing a challenge wipes the board entirely for the next week.

Every time you receive a debuff, binding, or other negative status effect, your soul rebels and you instead gain an increase to physical stats and magic resistance. The more penalties you incur, the stronger the effect gets, though if the effects are cleared the effect resets entirely.
The more evil, villainous, or otherwise murderous someone is, the easier it is for you to attract their attention, affection, or favor. Not always a good thing.

You wield the blessing of the mighty goddess Durga, who rules over motherhood, strength, war, destruction, and protection. You have become immune to corruptive effects, negative statuses, and mental manipulation. Additionally, you become an expert in destroying that which is evil or demonic, restoring the cosmic order with the strength of your will. The more evil your opponents, the more powerful you become. You also become, somewhat secondarily, a really good mom. Yes, even if you're male.

Like the Helltaker before and the Heaventaker alternate reality, you find yourself far more able to earn the affections, attentions, and interest of all beings infernal, angelic, divine, or otherwise associated with heaven and hell.

You become either a succubus or an incubus, allowing you to invade the dreams of others to drain their vitality... or just suck it out of them directly the lewd way. You gain enhanced abilities in all infernal and sexual magics, and also gain increased physical and magic stats, flight, dream walking, arousal sensing, and a minor shapeshifting ability so your body suits your current partner. Note: Incubus and Succubus do not denote gender. Incubus just means you're a top, and Succubus means you're a bottom.
All of your Abilities now automatically rebalance to match the level of strength as your current highest rank Ability.

Manipulate the pressure of the atmosphere around you- make a hostile location match earth's atmosphere, make earth's atmosphere crush down like a hydraulic press, manipulate the weather by creating pressure cells, force a downpour during a cloudy day, make the clouds go away, fly with pressure differentials- the sky's literally the limit.

Call down meteors from the sky to strike any target you wish. The size of the resulting meteor and its speed are dependent on the amount of energy you expend. Trying to make a meteor come down too fast will cause it to burn up in the atmosphere, though.

Bathe a target in intensely powerful purifying light, cleansing them of negative effects, foreign substances, evil influence, mind control, or even lesser wounds. The potency of the purification scales with energy spent.

You're halfway unkillable- no matter what damage you take, no matter how hurt you are, your body finds a way to reroute your existing biology to keep going. Shredded lungs? Breathe through your skin. No eyes? See through your fingers. Perforated organs? Reroute the pipes a little. It'd take something splattering you into chunky paste in a single hit to actually kill you.

Speed up time for yourself and anything you're in contact with, effectively giving you superspeed without a lot of the problems of super speed. The more you accelerate, though, the more energy you expend and the more strain it puts on your body.

Envelope the area around you with an invisible sensory grid, allowing you to track anything that enters it with a high degree of precision. At will, you may also detonate the ground anywhere within the grid to devastating effect. The more energy you expend, the further you can spread the grid and the larger you can make the explosions.

Transform into a basilisk at will, either fully or partially. While transformed, gain a paralyzing gaze, armored scales, and a high resistance to most magics, but especially to curses. Only your transformed parts benefit.

Brand any target either unwilling or unable to resist you, marking them as yours right down to their soul. Once branded, you automatically know where they are no matter how far they go, and can summon them back at any time. Additionally, branded targets become more suggestible and willing to do what you tell them to the longer they stay branded.

Exert the full force of gravity upon any target within your sensory range, allowing you to yank them towards you or another target at high speed without them being able to resist. The range on this is incredibly high, and the force it exerts is both precise and incredibly fast and powerful.

This Tech Tree is dedicated to stealth, specifically through hiding things. Fool radar pings, create invisible armor, or materials that have an easier time evading detection. Even a cardboard box could be an efficient sneaking tool.

Turn into a massive, human sized cockroach or a hybrid at will, granting you extreme resilience to any and all crushing forces, high speed movement, flight, an ability to eat just about anything organic, and an excessively high radiation resistance and poison tolerance. You may do anything a cockroach can, and can also control large swarms of normal cockroaches around you.

While active, no one remembers your existence in the slightest- friends forget your name and face, enemies forget you were a target, even your family and loved ones won't know you ever existed. Even new people won't remember your name, face, or existence after a while, even if you tell them directly. Effects vanish once deactivated.

Sacrifice the heat of your soul in order to gain enhanced defense and cryokinetic abilities. The more you chill your soul, the more potent the effect gets, but the more your speed and physical statuses get. If you chill yourself too far, your heart and body will freeze over and you may die of hypothermia at that point.

Enhance your senses to the point that you could see clear across an entire country, track a scent across continents, or hear a pin drop in a typhoon. As long as you have enough energy, there's no limit on how far you can enhance your senses.

Convert all impact force or kinetic energy in your strikes into positive energy, allowing you to heal someone by hitting them repeatedly. The more strength or force you can exert, the more you can heal per hit. Every pulse of healing is equivalent to the amount of damage any one attack would have done- a jab does very little, and a kick that could break someone's ribs might bring them back from the verge of death.

Set it to the Macro Scale. This tech tree allows the construction of equipment, vehicles, and other assorted things at a much larger scale. A cement mixer? Now it would be considered a Cement Flooder. There isn't a set size, but most things need to be at least twice the size of the original item in question.

Design, modify, and build technology and technological constructs related to vehicles of nearly impossible make and manufacture- a ship that sails at supersonic speed, an airship that teleports between planets, motorcycles that can fly on ribbons of light, the sky's the limit. Or just build monstrously powerful war machines. You can do that too.

Your body hardens in response to physical trauma. Every single layer of your body interlocks upon any impact both blunt or sharp, physical or magical, and creates a brief layer of armor that negates almost any and all attacks up to B-rank in level.

Summon the abominations of the depths from any nearby body of water- even something as small as a spilled cup of water. Conjure tentacles, maws, spikes, fins, teeth, eyes- anything that gnashes and slashes with the unknown horrors of the deep. The larger the body of water, the stronger the monsters that can reach through, and the more strength it takes to control it.
The legendary bird of ice, it can create freezing temperatures, control ice, send forth blizzards, and causes snow to fall when it flies.
A massive, mature sea serpent. They're exceptionally poisonous, but that is second to their massive bulk and tendency to drown entire ships.

A water elemental born of the oceans. She has an amazing singing voice, able to entrall even the largest of underwater beasts. Alone she is a formidable opponent, able to fire a variety of magical attacks and fly. Probably will encourage you to drown the world so her domain is everything.
A voluptuous kitsune with purple hair and four tails. She is rather knowledgeable, has experience ruling, and is rather seductive. Has the ability to teleport.

An undead dragon from Tamriel, capable of incredible levels of necromancy, as well as Dovahzul. He is exceptionally pleased to be free from the Soul Cairn, and thus much easier to befriend than normal dragons.

An Elder Dragon that resembles a unicorn. The Kirin can summon lightning strikes, something which it does constantly to attack... in addition to attempting to gore opponents with it's horn. It may also cover itself in lightning to deter attacks, but only for a short time.

A golem crafted from diamond. They are slow, but strong and highly resistant to damage. More importantly they are near completely immune to magic. Even the greatest of magical attacks will only scratch such a golem.

Demure and introverted, Mipha is ultimately a kind woman with a strong center, and is courageous when she needs to be. She has potent magic, both water and healing, and has great skill with a trident. Though she is introverted, she does enjoy spending time with the people she cares for.
A powerful potion that grants impressive boosts to physical and magical abilities. There are no side effects, but take care not to take too many too fast.

The oaths of the White Mage. Contained within are the spells and abilities belonging to mages that primarily heal and buff their comrades. Though be aware that just because they are normally disinclined to fight doesn't mean they are without their own attacks.

A three-sectioned staff connected by three rings between each joint of the weapon, Playful Cloud is best used by someone physically powerful and highly skilled. Used for the purposes of exorcising Cursed Spirits, it is still an incredibly effective weapon against humans. It can also be sharpened, but this will damage or outright destroy the weapon. It has no cursed technique, but amplifies your power instead.
A small kiteshield that is completely and totally unbreakable
Those Who Live in Death Scriptures

The scriptures of those who follow Godwyn, Prince of Death. The powers contained within allow the user to summon shades of the dead to attack, both as full bodied warriors and as vengeful spirits that fling themselves against foes, and conjure ghostflame, the flame of the dead that burns cold.
A surprisingly festive spear. It is horribly chill to the touch and can be thrust to fire spikes of ice that drop razor sharp snowflakes as it flies.

This red trident is eternally hot to the touch. Taken from the diabolists deep within the dungeon, this trident can fire a fireball that explodes into a cloud of fire that burns anyone touching it with the fires of hell.

You are given a windy altar! This altar is massive swirling tornado kept in place by four pillars, and when placed gradually takes in ambient energy to spawn air elementals. These elementals naturally resemble multiple tornados stacked together, but can be modified if you figure out how. The elementals are naturally loyal to you.

An exceptionally intricate large key. When used as if opening a door will open a portal into a large hot springs. There are multiple pools, some of which might be mystical, and the entire place is properly built up and stocked to provide the best bathing experience. While you never see any staff, everything is cleaned and put away every time you leave and come back.

You now also know how to create the Arc Reactor, both small and large. Created by Tony Stark, this reactor provides an absurd amount of completely clean energy indefinitely. Can be miniaturized or maximalized, able to power a single suit or an entire city.

A massive hammer crafted in the deepest hells. It glows menacingly and you could swear screams echo out from it when you swing. Upon hitting a surface with enough force it will cause an explosion of hellfire and leave a small amount of lava.
An ancient lich's mask, granting the wearer incredible resistance to lightning , while also boosting the wearer's affinity with electrical abilities, both physical and magical.
An ancient lich's mask, granting the wearer incredible resistance to heat, while also boosting the wearer's affinity with fire abilities, both physical and magical.

Reimu joins the battle! As a marketable plushie. Shake it and a barrier will be erected in front of it, just enough to cover yourself and one other person. The barrier works on everything, but is particularly effective against attacks from supernatural beings such as yokai.

You know just how to use a scalpel, how to diagnose lupus (never), and in general how to make sure the human body keeps working properly. You aren't about to be inventing novel procedures without a lot of work, but you know where to start and what might require something like that.
Code just makes sense. You've got the skill to do make it work however you want, easily managing to handle even the craziest of tasks.

You know enough about biology to start a career as a supervillain. Solving the mysteries of life isn't easy, but you've got a pretty good head start. With the right tech you're perfectly capable of making extensive genetic modifications.
Crikey, look at this beaut. You can just look at an animal and know exactly the right steps to properly tame them. No challenge is too great, but it might take a while to do.

There is not a single show you can't put on, not a single role you can't perfect, and not a single step you can't take. Maybe you aren't the most amazing, but you are one of the most consistent. Any performance you do is guaranteed to be amazing.

Rikudo is a Soviet made martial art created by distilling down every martial art they could find to do exactly one thing- fucking murder that other guy. This branch of Rikudo focuses on using the arms like hammers, utilzing the shifting of ones center of gravity to bring strikes that can even cut bone.

You can read your opponent like a book. Understand their moves in the middle of battle and figure out counters. Identify their exact style of fighting just from watching them walk. With this every fight is a shogi match- and you're cheating.

Eh, you probably have a good reason. People are more likely to accept the things you do. While this doesn't extend to outright harmful actions, or things they are deeply against, being weird isn't going to get much more than a shrug and a laugh.

Whimsy, wonder, imagination, foreboding. Reality is silly, and you can read the flows. You may see things in patterns and react to the unseen, hidden things revealed, traps guessed, and the unknown laid bare. To get more of this is to fly even further, conversing with the inanimate to know what they've seen and gain insights impossible through the human mind. Just try not to get thrown in the looney bin.

Not that kind of magician, the magic kind. I mean- ah. You're really good at picking up the mystical arts. It just come intuitively, to the point where you're just a beginner's guide away from pulling off some really neat stuff.

Breaking bones? Not in this life. Your skeleton is absurdly durable, taking everything and then some before showing any strain at all. It'd take truly monstrous strength to have even a chance at breaking you.

En garde! In a one on one fight you've got all the tricks. While you aren't necessarily stronger or faster, you do happen to know just what you need to do to win. Unfortunately, this sense only works on one opponent at a time, and changes target every time someone attacks you. Fortunately, your challenges to a duel are far more likely to be accepted and respected- just don't expect everyone to be honorable. Especially if they start to lose.

You can learn. In fact, you can learn so well that you're an instant expert in whatever you're taught. Forgetting a lesson is a thing of the past, and putting them into practice easy. Unfortunately, you can't read ahead. You need a direct mentor to learn from in order to become an expert, and only learn what they teach you. If they didn't teach you something, you've gotta get it the hard way.

Not literally, but pretty close. Your body is now purpose built to match the steam engine. You require a fraction of a fraction of the food and water of another, sleep only once a month for a short few hours, can take heavy blows without flinching or breaking, and forget nothing.
You know how to dominate a room. Asserting yourself, taking charge, and taking no shit are things you're amazing at, though the results of you actually being in charge may vary.

You are blessed by Poseidon, gaining mastery of the seas and water- you can breathe underwater, swim super fast, and befriend all marine animals and horses including the supernatural ones. All of your water based abilities and spells are far more potent and you are near immune to water based attacks.

Jolly Cooperation! You've joined the Warriors of Sunlight! You are now supernaturally aware of individuals in need of assistance, and assisting them will grant you a medal. Get enough medals and you can throw spears of lightning! The more medals, the more powerful the spears! A few more medals and you can give yourself and your allies a general buff to your everything. The more medals, the more powerful the buff! You may invite others to join the Warriors of Sunlight, so go make some friends!

Set yourself on fire. I'm not kidding- do it. The hotter and better the fire, the more powerful you come out. Being on fire for an extended period of time tempers your body. The better the fire, the better the tempering, and unusual fires may impart their own unique effects. As a bonus, you're now immune to fire.

Call upon the typhoon! Small ones at first, but even a small typhoon is quite large and destructive. With practice you could be smashing cities with your own personal acts of god. How's that for insurance fraud!

You may change weather conditions over a wide area! Slowly. Still fast by the standards of weather, but certainly not fast enough to make use of in battle. If you know you're going to be in a fight you could probably set the weather, but otherwise keep to watering crops and making sure you have sunny skies for traveling.

Charge your entire nervous system with electricity, allowing you to react faster than the speed of thought. However, you must set up the condition and reaction to use for anything you wish to react to in this way, as moving faster than thought means having no time to formulate a response. Additionally you improve your own mind in order to properly use your improved speed. The electricity used for this technique leaks onto your skin, shocking anyone that makes contact. You may elect to discharge more energy on contact if you wish.

You obtain a relatively large gourd filled with sand. While this sand is around you it will automatically move to protect you from any attack. Though stronger than normal, it is still just sand and still needs time to move, allowing particularly strong or fast opponents to ignore it entirely. Any sand placed into the gourd gains this effect.
Create and launch arrows composed of your own internal energy. These arrows will have the properties of the energy used to make them, and can hit even flying creatures with incredible accuracy.
By touching any existing metal you may shape it to your will. The only limit to what you can do is how much metal you have access to and your own imagination.

You may craft weapons from shadow. The exact look of the weapon is up to you, but they're always oddly light for their size and difficult to look directly at. As shadows, you may decide what they interact with, allowing you to ignore blocks and armor with enough experience.

So long as something is completely covered by your shadow, you may have it sink into your shadow and be stored there until you decide to take it out. The space inside your shadow is completely empty, as if it was in outer space, but thankfully doesn't suffer from extreme temperatures.

You may create lances of darkness out of any shadow. These lances can be manipulated to look however you wish and can either be pulled out or fired from the shadow you are using this ability on. These lances are unholy and feel wrong to most people's senses. Not only are they oddly effective against holy beings, but any injury made by them seems to become infected far faster and resists healing.

Surround yourself in shadow to ward off attacks. The shadow armor is highly durable, lightweight, and can be manipulated into looking like whatever you wish. While it can resist nomal levels of light, high levels may strip the armor from you. As a small bonus, abilities which utilize shadows may be used from your armor.

They shall guide you through your burden. You may see ephemeral lines of gold which will lead you to your objective or something which will help you overcome your most recent obstacle. It does not guarantee success, merely that you will never be stuck wondering what next to do.

Clapping is a necessary condition to activate your power. Clap to swap the positions of any two items possessing internal energy- cursed energy, mana, life energy, so on and so forth. Only works within your sensory range, but you can swap things very, very quickly.

Instantly cut anything you touch, with the level of power automatically scaling to the durability or resistances of the target. The more power it takes, the more energy you must spend to actually cut. Anyone with a high enough resistance to magic may be able to shrug it off.

You may split yourself into several bodies, but each ability and passive you have may only be used by one body. Choose which body has which powers when you split. Clones may merge together to grant both their powers to the new clone. Any clone dying makes it so the powers it had are completely unavailable until you return to only one body or until a day has passed, whichever is longer.

After using any ability, your body adapts to make it more effective. You may only be adapted to one ability at a time using this, but you may choose whether or not to switch your Protean to another ability when you use it. The boost will only affect the second use onward, but it is a significant increase in power.
You may control and manipulate fibers. Denim is easiest, but anything that broadly falls under 'fibers' counts. Including steel fibers, if you can get some.

The eyes of a vampire. Anybody who makes eye contact with you may be hypnotized, enabling you to do what you wish to them while they are under your control. While they will fulfill your commands, the hypnosis doesn't last very long at first and they still decide how to fulfill it unless ordered to use a specific method. The hypnosis may be broken by having a strong will, and avoided by simply never making direct eye contact. With practice you may alter memories, implant commands, make the hypnosis last longer, and various other abilities.

Designate a target. Anything you throw, shoot, blast, or otherwise are responsible for sending out will automatically home in on that target, executing impossible turns if necessary. The only way for a targeted thing to dodge is to block the attack or get so far away it can no longer reach them before it runs out of energy.

Hunger consumes you. You may transform into a wendigo, a spindly long limbed creature with a ram skull for a head. As a wendigo, you may summon snowstorms, are stronger and faster than normal, and suffer no injury from consuming raw meat. However, you also lose any hesitance to engage in cannibalism, and will do so if given the opportunity.

You may 'lock' anything. These locks must have a key, but that key could be anything. Performing a specific action, having a specific item, or having a specific trait are all viable keys. Whatever you've locked is unable to be used unless unlocked, though someone might be able to brute force it, depending on what is locked. You cannot place a lock on living being that is resisting you.

If it can be inferred, you can see it. Through the power of observation you may make deductions about people and situations that seem to come from absolutely nowhere, but are also correct more often than not. It's near impossible to lie to you, and hiding a secret isn't any easier- regardless of whether or not the person knows the secret. Unfortunately, you can only work with what you're given. It's possible to deduce incorrectly if given imperfect information or should you misunderstand something.
The longer you stand still, the more invisible you get. Up to the point where it's impossible for anyone to find you unless they literally stumble into you.

You may emit a sleep inducing gas from your skin. The gas is invisible and exceptionally effective, inducing sleep for as long as it's breathed in without any further negative effects. However, it comes directly off your skin and is, in all ways, a normal gas. So wearing clothing and a lack of air movement will make it less effective. It's also less effective on women, needing a larger dose put them to sleep.
Light it up like it's whatever relevant fireworks using celebration! Craft fireworks and other pyrotechnic devices. Of which there are a surprising amount.
A roughly 1 cubic foot cube of lead. Weighs about 115 pounds.
Build, design, and modify anything relating to computers- small ones, big ones, with enough materials you could build a cutting edge modern quantum supercomputer.

Grow yourself up to ten times as large- either fully, or partially- with a proportional strength boost matching your new size. The larger you become, the more energy it takes to maintain. With enough training, you could get even bigger than that.

Heal people by kissing them, allowing your saliva to supercharge their own healing capacity. It has limits, but as long as the body is largely in one piece, it'll work fine. It will also exhaust the recipient proportionally to how much they were injured. Also makes your lips really stretchy and extendable.

Increase the density, mass, and size of your muscle fibers, allowing them to expand out of your skin and wrap around your body to augment your strength to mountain crushing degrees. The more fibers you make, the stronger you get- but the more it drains your stamina to maintain.

Design, modify and build technology and constructs relating to augments and implants- machine gun arms, laser eyes, high speed movement implants... you could turn someone into Robocop with ease. Or an Astartes. Or anything else that's packed full of implants and augments.

You can generate swords out of literally anything- ice, stone, water, wind, sunlight, bricks, literally anything you touch can turn into a sword- items in your arsenal, any object you find, the ground, the air, even an unresisting companion if you feel like a jerk. The size of the sword and its durability scale with the amount of energy you pour into making it.

Draw energy from your life and soul and shape it as a weapon, the power of the soul condensed, refined, and sharpened, and then even further empowered through crystallization takes the form of a crystalline spear that can curve mid-air and pierce with incredible power. As the origin of the spear is linked to the soul, its power scales with the might of one's soul in addition to their energy levels.

Cloak your body in highly corrosive acid, allowing you to chemically burn anything that comes near you and dissolve it into nothingness. The more corrosive you make your acid, the more power it requires to maintain.

A shark-like ground dragon that swims through water, air, and land like it's nothing. It's tough, strong, cool, and scary as hell when mad. It can be taught a variety of moves, and if it trusts you enough, could even keep fighting after taking what would ordinarily be a knockout blow.

A mythological unicorn capable of purifying objects and beings, healing people, running swift as the wind, the whole nine yards. Only appears to those who retain their purity and goodness. Much prefers that only innocent maidens come near, for whatever reason.

One of the four Nightmare overseers of Wonderland, mostly known as the Mad Bird for obvious reasons. She is charged with ensuring that cycles reach their end, capable of causing mass deaths via a wave of Madness. As an Old One, she is immensely powerful and eldritch, and is rather unknowable in form and motivation.

Your very own army of 30 skeleton warriors, 20 skeleton archers, 5 Skeleton Horse Riders and 5 Skeleton Mages, each one largely unkillable as long as there's still enough bones left to raise. The more beings this army kills, the bigger it grows. You may also summon additional skeletons without killing people as your stats grow.

This sure is a thing. It's an extraterrestrial creature capable of assimilating any and all organic beings into itself, making duplicates, monsters, doppelgangers, mutant horrors, and generally just being some kind of freaky-ass thing. It's really only weak to fire, electricity, and subzero temperatures. Fortunately, this strain is at least compatible enough with human desires and emotions to do what you tell it to do and won't spread rampantly... most of the time.

A shadowy familiar that was once the great high orc mage Kargalgan, now named Tusk due to having... tusks. While having incredible physical prowess due to being an orc, Tusk's true power lies in his powerful spellcraft and shamanic abilities, casting a wide variety of spells to aid you in battle. He's rather sheepish and shy, oddly enough.

An Upper Moon demon bearing immense physical strength, speed, and combat skills. He's capable of shapeshifting, regeneration, absorbing bodies, and manipulating ice with his Blood Demon Art. He's kind of an apathetic bastard, honestly.

The adopted son of George Joestar, the intruder on the Joestar family. He's a skilled lawyer, rugby player, poisoner, manipulator, jackass supreme, and also a very powerful, charismatic vampire with cryokinetic abilities, flesh shaping, and also "laser" eyes. Unfortunately weak to any and all solar based attacks, including UV light.

A Pillar Man well over ten thousand years old who once saw Rome in its prime. As an enhanced Pillar Man, he has the ability to manipulate his body at will- changing its shape, absorbing lesser beings for food, consuming dynamite with ease, and using his Flame Mode to directly manipulate his blood vessels and superheat his blood to the point it feels like lava.

An aristocrat and near feudal ruler of the peasantry around Castle Dimitrescu. She's nine and a half feet tall, deadly strong, and possesses a wealth of abilities as a result of being mutated with the Cadou parasite. She has high speed regeneration, agelessness, the ability to turn her fingernails into massive claws and rend metal like tissue, and the ability to become a massive monstrous dragon. Due to her physiology, she must regularly consume human blood and flesh to survive.

An Ultimate level Digimon, Hydramon is a Plant Virus attributed Digimon that primarily lives in swampland. It's primary attacks focus on poison, and it can flood an area with the substance very easily. It can also fire beams from each of its mouths, or uses its ultimate attack Division Break to shatter the earth and also an enemy as well. With the right circumstances, this Digimon can Digivolve further.

A strange, elephant sized, quadrupedal creature made of black rocks, with insect-like mandibles and patches of white fur. It is capable of using powerful gravity magics and unleashing great magical beams to attack its foes, though it is also weak to gravity magic and extraterrestrial weaponry as a result.

Toriel, a goat monster, and the kind former Queen of the Underground. She may be able to use powerful fire, but violence is hardly her first option, far more content to bake pies and try to protect who she can. Expect puns, baked goods, and motherly affection, not a combantant.

A massive, extremely aggressive creature resembling either a lobster or a crab with massive blade-like limbs instead of claws. It is strong, surprisingly agile, and incredibly tough due to the thick carapace covering its entire body. In additiona to physical might, it is also capable of blasting high pressure water from its shell and can climb walls and ceilings with ease. It may also urinate on things it sees as an enemy.

A legendary yellow spear wielded by Diarmuid Ua Duibhne, cursed such that wounds caused by its blade will fester and never close, even when exposed to healing magic- though a high enough skill in curse breaking may be able to mitigate or remove the effect. Should the owner die or the spear be broken, the curse will also end. Only its owner may face its blade and remain unharmed.

A legendary red crystal bearing the properties of amplifying and magnifying the power of any light that enters, allowing it to refract and condense even plain oil lamp light into a powerful laser. This specimen is a perfected Super Aja stone, allowing it even greater power that can amplify Hamon enough to erupt a volcano, or power a Stone Mask with enough strength to punch through even a Pillar Man's skull.
A powerful tome that enables any reader to learn ice magic, with lists of spells, formulae, exercises, and rituals within that anyone may learn with time and effort.

What looks like a bible with a nearly infinite amount of pages is actually a cover for the holy prayers of the Black Keys- pages of scripture that, when channeled with energy, can form into holy blades capable of dealing incredible damage to evil existences and spiritual entities by inscribing the rites of the dead into their bodies. When used as throwing weapons, they can home in on their targets with great accuracy and force. They aren't very good melee weapons, though. There several variants of Black Keys, inscribed with different rites to either cremate, petrify, summon crows to harass, or pin the shadow of a target.

A voucher that teleports you right in front of the door to Belethor's General Goods in Whiterun when torn. While you cannot go anywhere but into the store, you may also stay in the store as long as you want- only teleported back after you exit the store. While there, you may sell, buy, or trade any goods that Belethor might want- magic tomes, random clothes, assorted general goods, so on and so forth. You receive one voucher a month.

An armored diving suit that easily allows the wearer to handle just about any kind of underwater environment, granting enhanced speed and durability in water and on ice at the cost of lowering speed on land. It also provides a stealth buff against hostile underwater creatures.

A disgusting patchwork cloak made from the pelts of rats, also bearing the corpses of magically preserved insects along its seams. Whilst wearing the cloak, you gain enhanced smell, disease immunity, darkvision, and the ability to turn yourself into a giant rat. If Awakened, you also gain poison resistance and the ability to summon an insect plague and transform into a giant wasp. Once Exalted, gain enhanced climbing speed, razor sharp teeth, poisoned fangs, and the ability to transform into a giant scorpion.

A decorated, ornate cauldron capable of filling itself with any potion once a day. It can create powerful potions due to its innate magics, such as: Strength, Agility, Healing, Waterbreathing, Regeneration, Durability, Stamina, Fertility, Vitality, etc. As long as the user knows what potion they want, and its effects are B-rank or below, it can be brewed in an instant.
A ring that focuses its innate enchanements towards passively healing the wearer, connected to Gwynevere, the Lordran Sunlight Princess. The effects of the healing are increased with direct sunlight.

Under an eclipse, the Reaper Rises. The Death Sickle is a scythe taken from a Reaper, which contains the power of eclipsed darkness. It can be swung to fire out a copy of itself that can fly through walls, and will cut through almost anything it hits provided they can't resist the necrotic energy.

This blade, forged from four others, is a very powerful weapon that seems to absorb light around it, hence its name. It's wide swings will linger upon a strike, and its durability is such that it breaking would be very unlikely. If you manage to gain the right materials, it can be awoken as the True Night's Edge, and even fused further into other weapons.

A blood red cape bearing the stains of countless lives lost in the name of overthrowing tyranny. While wearing this cape, the more negative status effects you bear, the more your physical stats and regeneration are augmented. Additionally, grants extra buffs to you and your allies and followers when leading a grand rebellion against a higher authority, for whatever cause.

A blessed ring once worn by a great Paladin. It gains a magic charge per hour for a total of three, each of which can be used to either cast a B-rank heal on yourself or a target, grant a C-rank blessing to a target's physical stats, or bless an item to imbue it with C-rank holy energy.

A sword of envy that cannot help but want to be more. In its default state it is a simple, plain longsword with no great power. However, when activated with your energy, it temporarily turns into a weaker copy of the strongest weapon up to B-rank within a 1 kilometer radius for 1 hour before reverting back to normal.

A bar refined from ore infected with the Astral Infection, Astral Bars give off an energy similar to the Divinity of the Stars, and can be used to craft many powerful items and accessories, some that can even control the passage of time. Upgrading your truck with something like this would let it fly, be two times lighter than the original metal, and all of this without giving you space cancer.

A massive glowing blade that innately boosts its wielders attacking strength by a massive degree. Its ability is to summon a miniature lightning storm whenever it is swung, wreaking havoc on all enemies it strikes.

A voucher that, when torn, allows you to select an entire catalog's worth of cyberware to implant into your body ranging from cosmetic mods, bio-mods, implanted weapons, strength boosts, camouflage, speed boosts, etc etc. Upon finalizing your selection, an appropriate amount of currency or resources is removed from your position, and all of your selected implants are seamlessly placed into your body- though, you will have to suffer a several week to several month recovery period on first use, if you didn't already have implants. Good thing it boots you out with a supply of really good drugs, huh?

Formed from the essence of a powerful Ice Mage's prison, the Hoarfrost Bow's own frozen material will transform any normal arrow fired from it into a Mist Arrow, freezing the area around them. It can also fire two at a time without the wielder's needed input.

A voucher that, when torn, instantly puts you through the perfected and upgraded procedure to make you into an Astartes. Fortunately, due to the enhanced procedure, you gain all the benefits of being an Astartes without changing shape or appearance and won't suffer any downsides.

A tome containing every single spell of the Illusion magic school found in Tamriel, though its initial pages only cover what can be found in Skyrim proper. The knowledge in its pages may be taught to anyone who reads the information inside. No, you cannot eat it to learn spells.

A pair of thick, white, forearm length gloves packed full of highly compact and extremely potent Zero Point technology, allowing you to simply point at any target and immobilize it entirely, while also being able to move said target around as you please. While they can be charged with normal electricity, should you choose you may also feed your own energy into the gloves to keep the battery charged. Strong enough targets may also be able to break out of the field.

A Daedric artifact in the form of an enchanted, nigh-unbreakable, powerful hammer. The Volendrung can sap the strength of those it hits, rendering them temporarily weaker. By expending energy, you can activate the enchantment on the hammer that can paralyse those it strikes, the duration of the paralysis depending on the strength of the target.

Comprehension, Deconstruction, Reconstruction. The three facets of Alchemy utilized by Amestris, and created by Father. Through these, transmutation is utilized, allowing one to change the state of something from liquid, to solid, to gas, and back again. There are laws to Alchemy, atomic structures need to be adhered to, but those can be ignored through utilizing the ultimate 'payment'. One Human Soul. Yours, or someone else's. This book allows one to learn Amestrian Alchemy, and most of its facets. Most. You'll still need Transmutation Circles, however.

A sticker in the shape of a chibi Black Panther's mask. Applying it to any single outfit or set of clothing instantly suffuses it with vibranium to the point that it becomes almost the perfect armor- able to withstand nearly any strike without severe injury, and being able to redirect the kinetic energy into a powerful counterattack. There are limits, though- it has to be an ordinary outfit made of mundane fibers, and must weigh less than a total of 5 kilograms.

The breastmilk of the queen of the Gods. Should someone consume the entire bottle, their body's innate strength and potential become supercharged with divine might, allowing one to become superhuman without effort, or truly heroic in strength with a quick month-long training montage.

An ornate key that, when turned in any space large enough to support a doorway, opens into a 5 cubic kilometer space filled with a temperate deciduous forest. It has enough resources, water, and nutrients to support its living ecosystem, it also has several common varieties of forest life prowling within its depths- deer, squirrels, elk, wolves, etc etc. While you or your allies are inside, the gate outside remains perpetually open and leads to where the key was last turned.

Seed of the Great Erdtree. When planted, it will begin to alter reality around it, according to the runes inscribed within, and the materials/energy it is fed. Eventually, it may grow big enough to alter the entire world.

A small, plastic card bearing the exact legal permit allowing you to fuck monsters. When pointed at any monster, creature, or otherwise nonstandard being for sexual congress, it will immediately change them into a form that suits the user's preferences, while being fully sexually compatible with said user both physically and mentally. It also grants you legal authority to deal with monsters and monster girls, and imbues you with knowledge of how to handle all sorts of monstrous creatures no matter what they are.

A dragon priest mask, crafted out of Ebony and enchanted with great power. This mask, when worn, grants the user resistance towards Fire and heat while increasing their Fire affinity, increasing the potency of their Fire-based abilities and spells.
A hip bag woven from silver thread, able to contain eight thousand pounds worth of items. You automatically know how to find anything inside.

A Teigu in the shape of a recorder. When played, it can freely manipulate the emotions of any who hear it via hypnosis. It can raise morale, decrease willpower, induce depression, induce rage, and even be split into two halves to be used as a melee weapon. Its trump card is the use of self-hypnosis to increase the user's muscle mass and strength, though it may have some side effects.

A fumo of a certain Koishi Komeiji. Holding the fumo or wearing it on your head boosts the power of all stealth or memetic abilities and effects, and leaving it in a building or certain area will cause said area to be far more difficult to perceive by anyone who has not interacted with the fumo itself.

A fumo of a certain Earth Rabbit. Holding this fumo or wearing it on your head grants you B rank luck for as long as it remains in your possession, with extra effect on full moons. Also tends to make mochi disappear when left unattended, how odd...

You're a damn good leader, a really really good leader. You can secure loyalties with ease, build morale, manage and delegate like a pro, and handle interpersonal relationships like a champ. You'd be everyone's favorite commander in a war, or their favorite boss in a company.

You're an expert mechanic- beyond any kind of mundane expert, even. You can design, fix, build, modify, or tear down any machinery with speeds that would get you called an absolute prodigy. Even mundane materials can be turned into low level sci-fi tech with enough time and practice.

You have discovered the runes guiding the universe. It takes effort to translate them into something that can be understood by a three dimensional mind, but once understood they alter reality to grant a great boon to whoever holds them. Holding more than three will rip the mind asunder, rendering whoever was fool enough to try comatose. Comes with the tools to inscribe and remove runes from the mind.
So long as you can see a projectile, you can dodge it. Or block it. Or something even weirder if you have the option. Point is- shooting you is near impossible if you see it coming.

Curses are food, and you're hungry. When you have been cursed, or encounter a curse, you may begin to consume it. This takes some time, depending on the power of the curse, during which you must be within a certain range of whatever is cursed. Once you're done you get a boost to any one of your energy pools based on how powerful the curse was, plus a minor boost to physical abilties. This does work on gacha curses, but they take triple the time of normal curses of their level to consume.
Is it living? Then you can ride it. Not only that, but you can ride it so well it's like the two of you are one. Doesn't apply to any non-living vehicles.

When facing against an enemy you've lost to, you get a moderate boost to all of your physical stats. This also grants a smaller boost against anyone belonging to an organization you've lost to as well.

Blood donation? You're the whole bank! It seems you have a near endless amount of blood, sufficient to ensure you're never going to bleed out. As a bonus, you're immune to illnesses that affect the blood.

Get biblical with it. Plagues, disease, and the like come to you nautrally, and you can naturally spread them without issue. You have a natural store of plagues and add any that you encounter or create you automatically add to your store. Any of your stored plagues may be unleashed at any time, regardless of whether they're biological, mechanical, magic, or something even wilder. You're immune to disease, and can craft new plagues using the ones you already have stored using nothing but your body.
Oh, thats a lotta magic. You don't have infinite power, but you've certainly got enough to make most spells trivial in cost.

Nature blesses you. You heal and recover energy faster the more nature is around you, and wild animals are content to leave you alone in most circumstances. In addition, growing plants or raising animals is far easier and dryads and similar entities see you as one of their own.

Fly! The skies are your natural territory. Anything which allows you to fly is easier to use and maintain, you have a natural ability to pilot any vehicle that flies, and you have exceptional spacial awareness while in flight. Anything that uses wind is also easier to use.
People who interact with you know the value of sharing. Expect to recieve exceptional tips, extra compensation, and in general get more for doing the same thing you were already doing.

For you, the truth is self evident. Whenever you say something you believe is true, everybody around you will be aware that you unquestionably believe that statement. This doesn't mean they can't think you're wrong, just that they're certain you aren't lying.

Cannibalism! Ghouls can't eat anything other than human flesh, but coffee is acceptable to drink. Fortunately, they also possess impressive regenerative talents, are stronger and faster than humans, and have a special organ called a kagune. This may take the form of a heavy club from below the shoulder, a feathered wing from the shoulder blade, multiple scaled tentacles from the back at the waist, or a single tail from the tail bone. Consuming other ghouls or powerful creatures will improve your kagune and make it more powerful.

You recieve one token good for an adamatium bonding bath. Having adamatium bonded to your skeleton makes your bones effectively indestructible, but also heavily poisons you and makes you incapable of swimming. It's not advised to use the token until you have a significant healing factor or some other way to deal with the side effects.

The Heavens have accepted you. You are a Principality, the highest of the lowest orders of angels. With four wings, you may fly, speak with the authority of the Heavens, create and control holy light, bless people and areas, and a variety of other things related to being an agent of the Heavens.

Well look at that, you have a handy connection to the Omni Gacha itself. The primodial chaos from before all time (and nobody can prove otherwise) now obeys your command. A little. Mostly because it happens to really like fire. This connection changes your body in various ways, but mainly just makes you seem like a tasty snack for anything that happens to like eating souls. Fortunately, you can manifest fire. A lot of fire. Even turn into fire. It's even psychic, so ignores anti-magic and the like.

You are now from SPAAACE! More specifically, your body has adapted to the three dimensional nature of space, giving you and absurdly high level of spacial awareness and focus. Additionally, you may sense hostile intent well enough to act before the opponent even attacks you, and are minorly psychic. It isn't enough to get more than a vague impression of something, maybe, but in high stress situations or with enough emotion it can be used to do some extremely impressive things. It may also be trained, albeit it will never end up particularly impressive. More a daily helper than a combat technique.

The machine spirit is restless... You know know how to properly diagnose problems in machinery, as well as the perform the proper rituals to calm the machine spirit and return it to full functionality. These rituals tend to involve actually fixing the machine, but somehow the incense, sacred chants, blessed oils, and similar things make the machine work even better after you're done.

Somebody is looking at you, and you know it. Any time someone is actively observing you, in that they are looking at you specifically, you know and can pinpoint their location. This works even on clairvoyant abilities.

Become as dragon. The Path of Dragon is an enduring covenant that seeks to become eternal through transcendence into a dragon. Face challenges in order to gain your scales, eventually changing your entire body into that of a dragon. Nothing but death or lightning may remove your scales, and while you have your scales you are near impossible to kill. You're also immortal.

Machines are nothing compared to sheer human power! You have an instinct for the flaws in technology, allowing you to exploit bugs, abuse definciencies, and in general make any highly technological opponent regret thinking machines were the answer.
Kill enemies, gain style. Kill enemies in cool ways, gain more style. The more style you have, the faster you heal, even ignoring effects that would normally make an injury incapable of being healed.

You may absorb any fire within a small area around you. This fire continues to burn within you, getting hotter and burning more of your insides the more you take in. At any point you may expel fire anywhere you like, up to the amount you have stored. While you gain fire resistance, it may still be overcome if you store too much fire, signaled by the fire burning under your entire body. On the bright side, you'll never get cold.

Fire granted by the Lord of Blood. These burn eerily red and rip and tear instead of burn. Spending too long being harmed by these will lead to massive injury as your insides hemorrhage. Any fire power may now use these flames instead of normal ones, and as a bonus you get the ability to create and control these flames.

You cannot control ice. This doesn't matter, because you can generate enough ice to freeze a city block. Or more if you really push it. It isn't instant starting out, but the more you train the faster you freeze an area. To the point where you can instantly freeze even massive areas.

You may create and direct freezing winds. This can happen within a small area at first, but gets bigger and can be started farther out the more you train. You may also decrease the temperature further the more you train.

Any ability you have that generates or uses ice may now create Enduring Ice instead, a type of ice that is far better at handling heat and shear forces than normal ice. It isn't invincible, but it's definitely a lot better than the normal stuff. As a bonus you can create and control a small amount of black ice.

You may create vacuums. Spaces which contain absolutely nothing- not even air. It's straining to keep this up, because things really don't like that and air will instantly rush in to fill the space. Stop it immediately to create an implosion or keep it going to create a powerful sucking force toward the vacuum. Someone being at the center of either of those will be in a lot of pain at best.
Does cure cancer. At this level, your healing light is capable of reattaching limbs instantly, repairing even the most grevious of damage, and even reviving the very recently dead.

You may extend your nails into viscious claws with edges only a single molecule thick. Which means they cut through just about anything. Luckily, the fact that your cuts are only a single molecule thick actually matters, instead of the cut object just fusing back together because cutting at a molecular level isn't actually that useful without something thicker behind it. The nails may be entended up to a single meter.

By existing in time, you stockpile energy. About equivalent to quintuple the amount of time you experience. You may spend this stockpiled energy to rewind any living thing back in time, setting them back to what they were like at exactly that point. Make the old young, make the young babies, and make babies cease to exist. This will remove injuries, effects, and just about anything else not magical in nature, and cannot apply them.

Screw gravity. You may remove gravity from any target within line of sight, or yourself, at any point. With practice you may also change the direction of gravity, but you cannot make it more or less. It's all or nothing, of the gravity of the location you're in. Though if you happen to be in a place where the local gravity is very high..

Cease! You may dramatically point at anything and order it to halt. Which, for once, actually works, robbing the target of all movement. Bigger things are harder to stop, and all the force you just stopped directly saps your energy.

You may see the comments of those from before, yet to come, aside, or some other fourth thing. They appear as glowing letters on the ground, and are entirely unmoderated. Expect very little help and a lot of lewd jokes.

See the future! Only a little bit at first, but it gets better with training. Unfortuantely, your existence is one that clouds the future- any prediction you make is subject to change, and the further out the more likely it is to change.

The hands remember. When you personally assemble something, you gain the memory of assembling it. From then on you may automatically assemble that item instantly provided you have the required parts. The parts don't need to be the same quality as what you originally used, but using substandard or better parts won't have the Assembled item compensate or make use of that. You'd have to build it by hand again.

Day after day after day. The grind is endless and eternal, but luckily you don't have to do it! Activate this ability and for the next twenty-four hours your body will be recorded. At the end of that time this ability turns passive unless you activate it again. While passive you gradually gain everything your body got during that day again, at the same level you got it. Spend a day working out, or studying, and no matter how impressive your strength or deep your knowledge, you'll get that exact same amount of progress every twenty-four hours.

Your body is replaced, on a cellular level, with a virus that you have perfect contorl over, allowing shapeshifting as well as adaptation. You start as your normal body, but you have uncapped growth, done through both training and absorption. Eventually, you may be able to infect others with the virus, giving them this as well.

Temporarily fuse yourself and your familiars together to unlock new forms and abilities, boosting your power multiplicatively. The more powerful the resulting fusion, the more power it takes to maintain, though the cost can be mitigated with familiarity, practice, and efficiency.

Allows you to switch any fire you create to Brimstone Flames. Brimstone Flames burn slower than regular flames until they are hit with water, at which point they explode and seek out other heat sources to burn.
