As a bonus you may create a ball of Brimstone Flame at will. Feeding more power to the flame will make it larger, but if it gets too large it explodes in your hand.

You can manipulate the size of any single discrete object you can touch. So long as you can identify something as distinct, you may alter it's size, regardless of whether or not it's attached to something else. By default you may only double or halve the size of anything, but with practice you can go larger, smaller, affect more things at once, or affect things you aren't directly touching. Larger changes take more effort and last shorter periods of time, though all changes will eventually revert.

Dragon parts on speed dial. You may summon spectral dragon parts to attack or generally do things. Swipe with a massive dragon's claw. Smash down with a dragon tail. Breath fire with a dragon head. You still need to at least mime the action, but otherwise you're got the power of a dragon at your fingertips.

For exactly 777 seconds (or rather, just shy of 13 minutes), every single one of your attacks is imbued with enhanced luck up to B rank, allowing you to land critical shots and sneak through defenses with ease. Also applies to most other actions, just that it has to be a conscious action and not just some kind of serendipity. Only usable once per week.

You may enchant items with your abilities, skills, and passives. When enchanting something you may choose which thing you are enchanting it with and how powerful you want the enchantment to be. Trying to fit too much power, or too much information, into an object not capable of holding it will result in it being destroyed. Training will allow you to store more in lesser material and give multiple enchantments to an item.

Any choice you can make may now be visualized as a set of up to three different paths, with vague results stemming from those paths- ie, if someone asks you to follow them, your choices could be "follow", "stay", or "question", with corresponding results (reputation with X, danger, speech 20) showing up in parentheses. Essentially- you have RPG dialogue branches that handhold your choices a little. Not quite precognition for your next choices, but it might help.

Temporarily sacrifice all your abilities per rank in order to temporarily roll a familiar to fight by your side for an hour's time. Starting at D rank for the 1 star gacha, going all the way up to EX for the EX star gacha. Yes, you may summon multiple familiars by sacrificing multiple ranks of ability. Upon the last familiar's disappearance, it takes a week to recover all of the abilities you sacrificed.

Necromancy! Or at least the parts of it people actually care about. You may raise corpses. This is not the same as reviving people, but instead forcing their body to animate under your control. You may only raise simple zombies at first, but with practice you may animate more powerful undead and more powerful corpses.

Congratulations on motherhood! When active, you may produce eggs (either just poofing them into existence or... other means) that take several days to hatch, at which point a baby that looks like a random cross between you and a willing Familiar (or ally in general) pops out, bearing a random and weakened mix of both of your respective rolls, natural abilities, genetic additions, so on and so forth. The child will always be a viable and healthy hybrid no matter the parentage, so long as the egg is not damaged or forced open. Great way to start a family if you aren't reproductively compatible.

The ka of Mana. Dark Magician Girl is a rather cheerful, caring woman who knows a lot about Egyptian ritual, Shadow Magic (the magic that involves the Shadow Realm, not literal shadows), and the monsters of the Shadow Realm. She can help you create your own set of cards connected to the Shadow Realm, and is generally quite handy at magic.

Registeel is a golem created of some unknown, possibly space, metal that is far stronger than any known metal. Scratching it is impossible. Oddly, it's inside is hollow. While Registeel isn't particularly intelligent or fast, if can follow orders well and will help you with anything it can.

A massive Martian mutated cockroach. They have an instinctive hatred for humanity, much as humanity has for cockroaches, and while generally not quite as intelligent as a human are vastly stronger and faster. Rolling this multiple times grants you more of them, and their mutated forms.

A robot with a soul. Penny Polendina was created in order to be the ultimate anti-Grimm weapon, possessing rocket powered flight, short swords that can fire lasers she is capable of controlling by thought through wires, and improved strength and speed as compared to humans. She curious, eager, and very much wants to have a friend. Just keep her away from black haired pyrokinetics.

An unkillable, unshaped, unseen, and unformed mass of true inexplicable nature. A fragment of the great Nuclear Chaos that is Azathoth, so infinitesimally small that it almost seems comprehensible to human form. It may take the form, personality, memories, traits, and abilities of any C-rank or below Familiar as it pleases, and will act accordingly. Should its chosen image die, it will return to your side in a new shape within 24 hours.

A massive ape-like beast that is closely related to the Rajang. They are strong, agile, and this one can set itself on fire. Especially it's fists, which it uses to punch foes. Incredibly aggressive, it's not recommended to bring this one around without wanting something destroyed in short order.
A large book of pranks, japes, and other silly things! Or... more like a large book about using magic to craft illusions to trick your foes, decieve the sense, or play a couple pranks.
A powerful tome that enables any reader to learn fire magic, with lists of spells, formulae, exercises, and rituals within that anyone may learn with time and effort.

A mystical herb imbued with vibranium and blessed by Bast. It's been enhanced to provide all the mystical benefits, with none of the negative health implications or strings attached. Grants enhanced speed, stamina, durability, reflexes, agility, and instincts. Can also be planted to grow more, if slowly.

A miniaturized Tanden Engine the size of a human eyeball, which can also be used a cybernetic replacement for an eye. The artificial ki it generates grants immense speed, strength, and reaction time, plus the ability to utilize a variety of ki based attacks to deal even more damage. Manifests as a voucher that, when ripped, either gives you the Engine directly or implants it into your eye depending on what you would prefer.

A vial of vibrantly blue liquid known as Lifeblood, or Plasmium. Upon being injected into the body, it temporarily grants increased vitality and health along with slightly enhanced durability and regeneration, making it a potent medicine. However, it is also incredibly addictive and causes severe, horrific mutations if overused. Any life forms exposed to it for too long will begin mutating, shambling around, producing more Lifeblood as their vital fluids are converted into more of the stuff, and spreading its influence even further.

Roll out the red carpet.You may flick your hand as if rolling out a red carpet to spawn the entrance to The Casino. The Casino has everything you could ever want. Any gambling game on the floor, any drink at the bar, several restaurants catering to any style of food, a massive pool, hot tubs, recreational activities, normal games, rooms to stay in, and much more. All overseen by masked staff who are extremely competent, if silent. You own the penthouse, with free food, drink, and normal gaming. You may even request the staff attending you look a certain way- however you want. Anyone may enter once the entrance exists, and it only closes when you decide to close it.

The black keycard smells of fancy cigars, expensive alcohol, and old money. Swiping it in the air will open the door to the High Roller Suite. A massive set of rooms with a master bedroom, a secondary bedroom with two twins, a large living room with a high spec computer (with internet) and TV (with all the channels), two bathrooms, and all the room service you can order. It's cleaned instantly as soon as you step out. Nobody else may enter the Suite without your say so and the door closes as soon as you leave. Room service arrives on a little trolley that rolls into the room on its own.

The Zanpakuto belonging to Retsu Unohana. Acts as a katana that may cut the immaterial, but can transform into a large, one-eyed manta creature through Shikai release. This creature can fly, can become large enough for several riders, and can swallow up to six people whole. It's stomach is a blend of potent healing salves and herbs, sufficient to heal anybody within the stomach from even heavy injuries. Grants you a small amount of Reiatsu, sufficient to bond with the weapon. With training may enter Bankai- a state that floods the ground with red liquid which can be manipulated to cut or heal as desired.

A fancy looking bow and quiver. When firing any amount of arrows you may call out the name of a target and the arrows will automatically lock on and seek out that target for an infinite amount of time, performing impossible turns so that they may continue to do so. The arrows may still be intercepted.

Truly you've got magic hands. No lock can keep you out, you've got an endless array of workaround to a dying engine, magic tricks are simple, and you know just where to bump the soda machine to get a freebie. You aren't as skilled at anything as someone who has actually studied it, but that doesn't matter when you can breeze through basically anything with a knock and a smile.

You are a natural born (or "Gemstone") Esper, a being that emits an AIM field in order to affect and manipulate reality around you. While your powers start small, you could become a Level 5 once you figure out your specialty- or, perhaps, even go beyond. In addition, all of your mental abilities and psychic powers come to you more easily and you learn new techniques faster.

Upon receiving this token, flip a coin. If heads, the token goes up by one rank and you can roll it again. If tails, the token is destroyed. If you don't want to gamble like that, just reroll this token for free.

On occasion, you'll receive a precognitive vision right before you step into danger- stepping on a trap, getting shot, tripping on a rock, etc etc. The higher the danger to your life, the more likely it is you'll receive a vision. How well you manage to avoid the future of the next five seconds is up to you.

Running out of breath? Nah. You've got enough stamina to run a marathon and ask for more. It would take something truly impressive to make you feel tired, and you'll be right back on your feet just a little later none the worse for wear.

You are a Hamon Warrior by nature- you instinctively understand how to draw the power of sunlight via your breathing, and can channel that into great strength and vitality, healing, and smiting the undead. It extends your life, enhances your attacks, allows you to walk on water, heal others, heal yourself, and turn just about anything that channels the Ripple into a weapon. You may even teach it to others after manually correcting their breathing... via a solid strike to the diaphragm.

Anyone attempting to determine things about you through mystical means is going to run into endless loops, swirling spirls, pictures of abandoned malls, and recaptchas. Your existence as connected to the Omni Gacha is, frankly, too utterly chaotic to get a read on.

You're heart stills and ceases. Death claims you, but still you move and wander. You start as yourself, a simple undead still wearing their old skin, but the more death you encounter, the more you deal, and the more you surround yourself with the more you will evolve. Growing from a simple, normal zombie to something which could raise legions of dead and threaten entire worlds.

You can create and control flames to an absurd degree. Force them into physical shape to create barriers, sneak them under doors or through locks, immolate exact squares. There are few that could claim to be your equal in fire.

Tick BOOM! You may create explosions of flame. At first this is cast from your body, but with training you may cause an explosion at any location you can see. Similarly, you start with nothing more than a grenade's strength- more for sending shrapnel than actually hurting, but eventually can trail to annihilating fortresses in a single blow.
Bend the wind itself to your power and summon hurricanes and powerful storms to devastate your enemies. With some training, you could devastate multiple cities out of nowhere.

Spark your nervous system into overdrive so hard you just become lightning. As lightning you're... lightning. Immune to most attacks, but can be grounded by metal and resisted by rubber and similar things. You'll also have trouble holding things, but anything you were wearing is now also lightning. Move at the speed of lightning, and lightning now shocks anyone you touch. With effort you can make it worse! That's a lot of lightning.

Enter a shadow state that envelops you and your equipment, letting you phase through solid matter, jump as if weightless, become almost invisible in the dark, and even unphase objects inside of other people. However, you become incredibly vulnerable to aerosols, electricity, and darkness manipulating abilities.

Control every single part of your body to a sub-cellular degree, enabling you to change anything at will and reap all the benefits... or consequences... thereof. You have an instinctual level of knowledge so you know how to take advantage of your powers without immediately dying to what seems like a tiny change. Yes, you can use it to basically shapeshift.

Freely morph into any animal you've scanned via touch, inheriting their physical capabilities, characteristics, and instincts. You also become capable of telepathically communicating with any other sapient animals or shapeshifters in animal forms, and can freely use any of your abilities while in animal form. However, if you stay in one form for two hours, you become locked as that form forever and this ability vanishes until you roll it again... or get some other shapeshifting/race changing token.

Charge your lungs with any one elemental energy type- Fire, Water, Earth, Air, Lightning, Metal, Light, Dark, Ice, etc etc- and unleash it as a powerful breath weapon to annihilate everything in your path. Yes, your chest, throat, and mouth do that cool glowing from the inside thing while you charge up.

Extend your sight beyond your eyes, moving your field of view around at roughly the same speed as your average jogging pace and seeing things that would ordinarily be impossible- phasing your point of view through solid surfaces, seeing things from hundreds of meters away, even getting a look at something from the inside out.

Convert your very vitality, life essence, and lifespan into weapons made of blood that emerge from slashes in your palms. The more of your life you sacrifice, the stronger the weapons become- and should you sacrifice your own lifespan, you may imbue those weapons with the power of your other Abilities and effects, turning them from something as strong as a mundane weapon to things that could cleave entire mountains in twain. Once dispelled, the weapons lose potency until all that's left is a puddle of inert blood.

Activate the Byakugan in your eyes, causing veins to pop out around your cheeks and your pupils to vanish. While active, your visual prowess becomes a 359 degree sphere around your body, with a cone shaped blindspot centered around the back of your neck. Additionally, you can see through objects, and see the flows of life energy and chakra with your eyes. With practice, you could see out multiple kilometers without any issue except the passive energy drain of the Byakugan. Grants just enough chakra to activate your eyes and keep them active for a bit of time.

Leave waypoints on any surface or object that you can instantly warp to at any time you wish, regardless of distance. Setting a waypoint takes roughly ten seconds per mark, and traveling takes ten seconds no matter what unless the marks are less than ten seconds apart- though both can be managed with extra training. You start with 10 waypoints at your disposal, and can gain more with training and dedicated effort.

Build, design, and modify any and all technology related to cryogenics- stasis chambers, ice guns, freeze rays, ice grenades, cold guns (yes, that's a different thing), subzero power armor, even an air conditioning unit that works in the middle of an Arizona summer!

The most generic powerset in existence- super strength, super speed, super durability, and flight. You're no Superman right off the bat, but you're definitely Super. Just... median level, instead of at the pinnacle of the charts.

See the future and maybe even say a bit about it. You may look into what is yet to come a give hints as to what is yet to be. These are never very precise, get even less helpful the further out you go, and very much can be changed. It isn't even up to you to change them- happenstance from you moving through the world may render a prophecy invalid just as much as deliberate action. Still, this is a glimpse at the future and that can be very useful

You don't have a minimap, you've got the mac daddy map. This helpful tool maps the area around you, in 3D, for a very large range. You can zoom, shift, route, identify creatures, determine hostility, and in general get a massive overview of the current area all within your eyeballs. Just try not to focus too hard on the map over what is literally in front of you- walking into a tree once is embarassing enough.

You can cure almost anything short of literal, actual death. Though only mostly dead is fair game. Spend energy to heal. Bigger injury, more energy to heal. Simple! Now tell your tank to stop standing in fire.

You can make robots! You start with small, simple things, but as you make more things and get farther in the tree you can make greater and greater things. From a roomba to a maidbot to a YoRHa No.2 Type B to Glados to a Metal Gear- as long as it's a robot you can make it! The tech tree starts unlocked to the level of your Mind stat, with E being the every bottom with Roombas. Only includes the technological bits of robots that are partly flesh, such as Evangelion. You're going to have to get something else to help if you want that.

Call upon Heaven and it shall answer. As long as you're not one of those horrible sinners, like a demon. If you are, reroll this. If you aren't then you may temporarily summon a heavenly being to assist. Generally you'll get low level flunkies, angels up to four wings, unicorns, and the like according to your current need. If you are facing something truly evil, or in the process of defending against such, then even higher angels may be summoned, up the the six winged seraphim themselves.

(Tech) Allows you to design, modify, and build technology and technological constructs related to Mechs and large piloted mechanical armors and their construction. At this level, you can create proper combat-ready mechs, such as sleek and agile mechs that can briefly fly, or ones that are less mobile and more armored. Modular ones that can be easily repaired. You can also design and build weaponry and modules that only work for your mechs and nothing else, based on your other abilities and traits.

Once the silent, sleeping matron of Azafure, she awoke to devastating results. A generous feminine figure with one eye sitting atop a floating crag of stone. She is a neutral entity, neither kind nor cruel, but her fire can incinerate body and mind, suffient to match even the greatest of mages and destroy cities.

A Pillar Man well over ten thousand years old who once saw Rome in its prime. As an enhanced Pillar Man, he has the ability to manipulate his body at will- changing its shape, absorbing lesser beings for food, spinning his arms like drills, and using his Wind Mode to create massive tornadoes and bursts of razor sharp wind.

An Archangel Digimon with the appearance of a beautiful woman. Although an Angewomon's personality is generally gentle, it can never forgive someone who is crooked or evil, and cannot stay its hand from such a person until they repent. Close to a Goddess, Angewomon has ties to Fate as well as Holy power, and will always be there at the darkest hour. She has many paths to Evolution, some of which require another Digimon to be achieved. Treat her well.

A Fallen Angel Digimon with a noble presence and a feminine form. She owes her great power to the strength and purity of her Dark Side Power, and very few Tamers have raised one with ease. Her Darkness powers will burn through someone greatly, but her true strength lies in her Poison ability, converting an enemy's power directly into dark energy to obliterate them from within. Her evolutions are varied, and some may require another Digimon to achieve. Don't let her walk all over you. Unless you want to.

A mysterious child born with draconic traits. She is a painter, capable of using even the rarest of most obscure things to paint with. Give her a safe place and what she asks for and she will create paintings you may enter. Anything you find within is yours to keep... as long as you manage to get out.
A powerful tome that enables any reader to learn wind and lightning magic, with lists of spells, formulae, exercises, and rituals within that anyone may learn with time and effort.
A pair of excellent Byakugan eyes floating in a jar. If you find a good doctor they could transplant them into someone.

A set of voluminous robes that somehow never get caught on anything. They majestically flow as the wearer moves and are incredibly sensitive to magic, helping it flow or settle as needed. Greatly improves control of magic, especially when using it to craft.

The sword fit to cut through the bottom of Hell. A katana that rips more energy than intended from it's wielder in order to cut far more than intended. This is a sword that could carve through mountains, dragons, and Gods. Provided enough high quality energy it may even become stronger...
A rather fancy platinum necklace. When clicked the user teleports to any location they can see, though it costs the exact same amount of energy as sprinting there.

To give a Spark is to give a life. Granting this Spark to a mechanical object will turn it into a Transformer. It starts as a child would and gains the alternate form of a bipedal robot. It will see you as its parent and is loyal as any child is. This does mean you should be a good parent, because it can just leave you.

An oddly wet key. When turned as if opening a door it will open a portal to a large beach, complete with chairs, a bar, various activity stations, an assortment of food trucks, and a space to obtain further supplies. Everything on the beach is cleaned as soon as you leave and restocked daily. The food trucks also swap out daily, provide a randomized, if limited, selection of food. There are no visible staff, but orders are filled when you're looking away. Nothing costs money. Anybody may enter the beach once the portal is open and the portal only closes when you are outside of the beach and decide to do so.

A sword style created to emphasize acting like the rising sun. It focuses on endless simple movements and absolute relentlessness. The individual techniques are simple, but the final technique is doing all them in sequence, constantly, until the night turns to day. Particularly skilled users manifest an illusion of sunlight to accompany their attacks, which can be made real by channeling more energy into the style.

You're just charismatic as fuck- people think you're amazing, terrifying, cool, sexy, any way you want to present yourself. You have a way easier time convincing people of whatever you want them to believe you are. It wouldn't be hard to get celebrity discounts on anything with just a smile.

Gordon Ramsay wishes he was you. You're an undisputed master of the culinary arts in every facet- cooking, baking, frying, sous vide, some other french terms- all of it. You're better than most chefs could ever aspire to be- the kind of great that almost borders on the level of foodgasm ridiculousness of Shokugeki no Soma, but... not quite there yet. Keep at it. No one is walking away from your table unhappy.

You're an actor in so many ways that even Hollywood couldn't hold you. You're an undisputed expert at pretending to be someone else- a hero, a villain, a monster, a random side character, a spy, a stand-in for Tom Cruise- whatever it is, you can pretend to be it, and it'd take a real expert to see through the mask of your emotions and pretense.

You're one hell of a chemist, to the point that what you do borders on alchemy without quite breaking the line into true magic or absurdity. You can make any compound, any material, and chemical mixture and have it do exactly what you intend, where you intend, how you intend- within the bounds of physics, at least.

You've become a highly skilled practitioner of Total Concentration Breathing. You're fully able to keep the state up at all times with absolute ease, even while sleeping, fighting, or during daily life, and are now truly superhuman with how well your cells have acclimated to your efficient breathing style.

You may cast any and all abilities, spells, and effects at radically increased speed due to your internal energies flowing far, far faster than they normally would. If a normal person's energies flows like a stream or a creek, yours is a damn pressure washer.

You've become a natural prodigy of any martial arts form, even able to watch them on TV if you need to so you can learn their secrets. Along side that, you gain a form of battle intuition, able to see attacks coming a moment before they hit.

You are equally capable in a significant number of subjects. Not only do you have absolutely no problem picking up any discipline you wish, it becomes nearly trivial for any skill to reach the level of the highest skill you've rolled. Provided you can obtain the knowledge necessary to get the knowledge of that level.

Ride dragons! Not, not that way. Dragons are naturally inclined to like you, and instinctively know how to work with you in flight. You also suffer no problems from sitting on scales and know just how to craft the items required to saddle a dragon.

Your stamina pool is immensely deep and recovers at ridiculous speed- a marathon is a light jog that barely needs a moment's rest, and even the most intense workouts humanly possible only wind you for as long as it takes to get a swig of water.

A new Demon Lord rises. Fancy cape and horns optional, but that aura of command isn't. Denizens associated with darkness, evil, shadows, and various other things will instinctively recognize that you aren't someone they want to mess with. It's almost trivial to learn 'evil' magic, umbramancy, necromancy, anything dealing with the soul, etc. You know just how to craft a dungeon for a specific purpose, how to administrate, how to wage war, and everything else to do with running an authoritarian dictatoriship.

Steady, solid, unbreaking. You are like the Earth itself. Any item that relates to the earth, such as geokinesis, geology knowledge, or similar, gets a boost in power. In addition, you're much harder to knock off you're feet.

You aren't scary. Scary implies people can get used to you. Your existence is the shadow of death upon the world, the thing that all the living run from every heartbeat. There are vanishingly few that would stand against you and even an idle gesture can send a grown man crying. You may choose who this affects fully, but even at a vastly reduced power you're 'merely' scary.
You've got some muscle on you. A natural born lifter of heavy things. You're always going to be way above average, and hitting the peak won't even require any steroids!

Bigger and meaner. You are half some form of beast, but not just any example of a beast. The biggest, meanest example. You stand above all the others of your species, probably literally, being even stronger, faster, and tougher than they are. Choose which beast you are as well a how much it shows. This may be either minimal, just ears, or complete, being effectively a bipedal version of them. Also gain a good amount of height and sharper senses.

Your body is inexplicably heavier than it should be. Never in a way that causes actual issue, but you acts and move as if you have a weight many times what you should possess. Crack the floor with a heavy step or watch and laugh as grown men fail to pick you up.

Fix it anyway. Use it, abuse it, fix it back better. Whenever you utilize a machine you automatically know how best to clean and repair any wear and tear that use put it through. Upon completing this the machine inexplicably works just a bit better than it used to. This does not allow you to fix something broken, destroyed, or otherwise harmed outside the bounds of it's normal usage.

Really cold or really hot, but no matter what it hurts. Any attack you make may now also inflict Frostbite, an effect which chills the affected area until it dies and spreads like fire. It's short lived, but 'short lived' can skill kill a person if you hit them in the right spot. As a bonus, you're now immune to cold, ice, and similar under the Magic rank of this item.
Mister forty below. Control ice and snow over a very large area with a good amount of precision.
Blindness not included. Control earth, rock, and the like over a very large area with a good amount of precision.

Summon or create Earth Elementals such as crystal golems, metal golems, gem golems, etc. Each one can use B rank or lower earth-based magic or effects. The power of the elementals depends on your own expertise and power. The conjured Elementals will vanish if you stop supplying them with energy, though with practice you can form elementals with set durations or even permanent summons. Summoned elementals are not considered Familiars.

Through physical contact you may directly drain the energy of a target. If the target has multiple kinds of energy you choose which one to drain. With practice you may drain faster, more types at once, and at further distances.

You may focus on someone and read their mind. Only what they're currently thinking, but with training you require less focus and can read deeper. Particularly disciplined people may be able to resist the attempt entirely, and the mind is complex on the best of days. Delving deeper can be dangerous.

You may create binding vows with yourself or others, allowing you to sacrifice near about anything for greater power, or a new way of using your pre-existing power. Binding vows with other parties are enforced by the heavens, and anyone who breaks the promise suffers a penalty most dire. The more conditions you put upon yourself, the more powerful and versatile the resultant vow can make you... as long as you keep your own promises.

Eh, could be better. You may build machines dedicated to increasing the efficiency of any process you can think of. This starts out at automating what humans are doing at about the same speed to eventually replacing every step of a process with a machine that does everything more efficiently. Each thing you want to improve is it's own separate tree, but old designs can be altered or repurposed to jump forward along the tech tree.

Get angry. When activated you go absolutely crazy style. Gain significantly higher physical abilities at the expense of acting on instinct and your last thought before activating this ability. Whatever you want destroyed is probably going to be, but who knows where you'll wake up and what you've done in the meantime.

Affect you? Why would it? Your will is so absurd you can entirely ignore any effect that would alter your mind. Fear? Nothing scary. Confusion? No. Mind Control? Blocked. This doesn't stop natural emotions, only things others attempt to impose.

When you do anything which will kill someone or something you may instead choose to capture them in a token. While a token their personal time is completely paused, preventing them from taking any action or dying of injuries taken from before they were turned into a token. These tokens are physical objects marked with the appearance of who is captured on the front. They may be moved, stolen, sold, bought, traded, or any other method of transfer. Attempting to deliberately break the token will release whoever was captured in the exact state they were in upon being turned into a token.

Design, build, and modify any and all technology related to implants and augmentations- there's no limits on this but your imagination. With the right materials, you could make anything- nanomachines that make you nigh invincible, cyber legs that allow you to break the sound barrier, laser eyes capable of slicing buildings in half... the possibilities are limitless and only bound by the materials and time you have to make them.

Design, build, and modify any and all technology related to the art of defense- powered armor, shield generator, walls, reinforced chassis, anti-air defenses, so on and so forth. There's really no limit to any of this, you could defend against literally anything with the right time and materials.

The flames of the greatest beings in Hell now come at your command. Any pyrokinetic ability may use these, and you may additionally throw fireballs of this fire. Unlike normal Hell Flame, which punishes the sinner, these flames are crafted to take part in the war between Heaven and Hell. They burn eternally and seek out the souls of the living, annihilating the body and sending the soul directly to Hell regardless of any other factors.

The Holy Light of the greatest Heavens is granted unto you. Unlike normal Holy Light, this is used to take part in the war between Heaven and Hell. It strikes at the soul of those it hits, ripping the soul free of the body and sending them directly to Heaven, if they would already go there, or strips all sin and sends them into reincarnation, bypassing the Hells.

Summon or create Water Elementals such as ice golems, water golems, etc. Each one can use B rank or lower water-based magic or effects. The power of the elementals depends on your own expertise and power. The conjured Elementals will vanish if you stop supplying them with energy, though with practice you can form elementals with set durations or even permanent summons. Summoned elementals are not considered Familiars.

Design, build, and modify any technology related to the construction and maintenance of an Arcology- a self sufficient, self contained city capable of sustaining human life indefinitely. You can build construction drones, hermetically sealed environments, recyclers, upcyclers, farms, solar panels, airlocks, rocket boosters, etc etc.

Summon or create Nature Spirits such as dryads, ents, etc. Each one can use B rank or lower water-based magic or effects. The power of the elementals depends on your own expertise and power. The conjured Elementals will vanish if you stop supplying them with energy, though with practice you can form elementals with set durations or even permanent summons. Summoned elementals are not considered Familiars.

Acid rain ain't got nothing on this. You may summon a storm over an area that is intensely toxic. Anything living caught under the sort will shortly be killed, either through how acidic the rain is or how naturally poisonous. Structures will withstand it for longer, though that depends on what it's made of. Don't expect a wooden house to withstand the downpour for long. This takes an imense amount of energy, easily exhausting someone with even C rank Magic to keep up for one minute over a city sized area. Training may reduce the cost and increase the range you can summon the rain.

A breeding pair of thunderbirds, almost divine birds that can control weather and lightning. They have high speed flight, can fling lightning and manipulate clouds to their whims, and are also fierce predators capable of tearing a man in half with ease. The pair of thunderbirds in this instance are roughly twenty feet tall, with nearly forty foot wingspans.

A red knight wielding a massive greatsword, with extreme strength and speed. He is exceptionally skilled in all areas expected of a knight, as well as having a strong sense of honor. Once summoned, he is a shadow familiar, immortal in every way, but if damaged enough, must rest for 24 hours to recuperate before being summoned again.

A shrunk version of the Endbringer Behemoth, this tiny fellow may only have the approximate strength of a particularly aggressive chihuahua, if that chihuahua could drive a car, but he still retains his incredible dynakinetic powers. Rather than drawing energy from a collection of Shards, it draws energy from you, holding back most of its power based on your own ability. Can be convinced to stop sandbagging, if needed.

A master blacksmith exhibiting traits of a Misbegotten, skilled enough at his craft that Queen Marika the Eternal personally tasked him with creating a weapon that could slay a god... and he could definitely do it. He can upgrade and strengthen just about any forged weapon with ease, though he might be a bit sour about it.
A white, cat-like Exceed capable of sprouting wings to fly, predict the future, and change into human form once a year. She's also surprisingly good at fighting when in human form.

The master of the Grimm Troupe, a travelling Circus, Troupe Master Grimm is a large insectoid creature known as a Nightmare. Tall, androgynous, and friendly despite the name of his species, Grimm will protect his leader with great glee. With a Ritual, he can take the form of Nightmare King Grimm, one of the Gods living in Hollownest, able to walk through the world of dreams with little difficulty.

Obtain a breeding pair of every animal species that roamed the earth six thousand years ago before the Great Flood. Should the number of any one species drop below two members, a new breeding pair will spawn. They come somewhat conveniently on a giant ark big enough to hold all of them. They're pretty much just good for repopulating a dead world, or for food.

A six limbed Demi Elder Dragon. The Gore Magala has no sight and identifies threats through sounds, smell, and by sensing heat. It helps this by shedding scales, which break apart and linger like spores as it walks. These spores increase the heat sensing of the Gore Magala and also provide the vector by which it infects others with the Frenzy Virus. Once infected, smaller creatures become incapable of healing while larger creatures become immensely aggressive, short-tempered, and have increase strength and speed. Gore Magala are highly aggressive, but cunning and capable of holding grudges.

A sparkling crystal. Pushing energy into it will cause it to resonate with whoever is putting energy in, eventually manifesting one of the Rare Blades. Each Rare Blade is a person in their own right, with in built ideas, form, weapon, and values, though they don't recall anything from any life before their current one.

Once worn by a saint, this shroud has the effect of causing anything wrapped in it to 'return to normal'. In could be considered akin to an air purifier- preventing corruption, poison, or similar from affecting the whole body. Though particularly powerful or presistent effects may only be held at bay for so long.
It's time to stop! This indestructible Stop Sign can be slammed into someone or something to stop them in place entirely. Just be careful that you can actually handle the recoil.

A golden Serpent ring with ruby eyes, it represents the undead as a creature that devours prey larger than itself. With this ring, many trinkets may be obtained far more easily than usual, and one could say the wearer is more lucky.

A large box with a red button on the front. When the button is pressed it will summon a blue humanoid called Mr. Meeseeks. There is no limit to how many of these can be summoned at once. Each Mr. Meeseeks will assist with a single task, which they will ask for immediately, and then disappear. They have the knowledge to complete any task given to them, but are not all powerful nor exceptionally skilled. Surviving more than seven days, or being unable to complete the task they've been given, will result in them becoming increasingly violent and unstable.

A large metal can. The open top can intake anything, regardless of the size of the item, so long as that item is completely inanimate. Anything placed into the can will be reduced to it's base components, which can be pulled out of the bottom slot of the can.

A single pair of Sharingan, freshly unlocked, floating in a jar. With a skilled enough doctor they may be implanted, but must still be trained to be properly effective. Implanting them grants enough Chakra to properly use them.

A book bound to your soul, made from your own magics. It contains the full breadth of the Ice Magic attribute within its pages, but you must study and put effort into unlocking each spell and scrap of knowledge- anything you have not unlocked appears as blank pages. Also, it passively boosts your magical ability and learning rate. Just don't fall into despair, or demons may corrupt your book and therefore your soul.

A ball of obsidian about head sized. It floats in the air without utilizing any energy and emits a low hum that can be heard across an entire city. The sphere is completely indestructible and cannot be altered in any way. It may be left in one spot or connected to float above a specific object or creature.
Affection in a voucher. Rip it and the person you think about more or less entirely falls in love with you via retcon and causality bending. No side effects but your own guilt.

The power of the moon distilled and ritually altered, contained in a bottle. Pouring the water out over even highly powerful seals, bindings, curses, or similar will break them. Drinking it will dispel any similar effects active on the drinker. Particularly strong seals may take multiple bottles or even resist the effect entirely.

A cybernetic heart once belonging to Hsu Hao. It allows the user to create wind gusts by clapping, spawn bouncing fireballs by punching the ground, fire a chest laser, and also passively increases physical strength and durability to utterly superhuman heights. The stronger your base, the stronger the boost gets. Comes as a voucher that implants itself in whomever decides to tear it.

A blade created by the second Hokage, Tobirama Senju. Its handle is shaped like a vajra, and its blade is made entirely of highly concentrated lightning chakra. It can manipulate lightning, shock enemies, create paralyzing electric rings, suspend objects with magnetism, and cut through both solid objects and energy attacks with ease.

A large cylinder attached to an odd barrel. Rubicante is a flamethrower with infinite ammunition granted by the cylinder acting as a jet engine, taking in and superheating air. The flames of this weapon are impossible to extinguish without supernatural means- even diving completely into water won't put the flames out. It's range isn't very far, but it can shoot fireballs to extend that range a little. In an emergency the cylinder may be set to explode, which will destroy the weapon by annihilate everything within a wide area.

Be like water. You are an omnidisiplinarian- refined many different styles down into a single method of beating the everloving shit out of the other guy. You've got excellent discipline, can keep calm under immense pressure, breathe effectively, meditate properly, and in general are the near the pinnacle of using your body.

Marriage? You've got it. Not only are you near perfect at running a household, doing chores, cleaning, budgeting, and everything else that might possibly be required to serve as a husband or wife, but you're also utterly fantastic in bed. Anybody spending a night with you won't forget it- ever.

Your ninjutsu is formidable. You've graduated from learner to actual, with the skills to match. Infiltrate highly guarded areas, use kunai, shuriken, ninjato, and various other weapons, lie, sneak, pick locks, and anything else with enough skill to not bring shame to your teachers. Sure, you may not be the most amazing around, but you're still exceptionally effective.

If it goes onto a canvas, you're a master. Painting, sketching, drawing, and all similar things are skills you've sharpened to a razor's edge, more than sufficient to be sold for exceptionally high prices or shown in museum collections.

Take how long you'd naturally live. Now add a few zeroes. It doesn't matter if you have a racial roll the affects how long you should live- you're lasting a hundred times that no matter what. This doesn't protect against curses, stabbing, or anything else which would put a timer on your life, the only thing you can rely on is not dying of old age.

Magic effects are far less effective on you. Even things created by magic will be less effective, though less isn't none. Particularly powerful magic can bypass this- anything higher than your current Magic level ignores this resistance.

Need one? You are the Hero. Charismatic, friendly, approachable, unyeilding, unbreaking, powerful, and many other adjectives. You have a Quest. Whatever you decide it is. So long as you continue to work toward that Quest, or any random quests people send you on, you will get stronger, faster, and more skilled at a furious pace. Any trainable skill is automatically set to Fast. People will trust you with their troubles and expect you to be able to resolve them, which the world will accomodate. So long as you earnestly search for a solution, any problem may be solved- because you're the Hero and that what the Hero does.

You know exactly who to kill, what to destroy, and in general what to do to cause the maximum amount of chaos with the absolute least chance of getting caught. Not that people won't know it's you, just that somehow any form of law enforcement take an extra hour or so to get to you. Though if you want to wait for them...
Hurt me plenty. Any time you suffer injury you recover energy equivalent to the amount of damage you recieved. If you have multiple types of energy they all recover the same amount.

Just in case you lost the directions. You somehow automatically know exactly where to go in order to progress any quest, objective, or similar thing you want to work on. Doesn't come with a quest guide- remembering all your promises is up to you.

To the very limit. You have incredible, exacting precision in everything you do. Expend the perfect amount of energy, move in exactly the right way, or utilize a skill precisely. So long as it can be done with what you have, you can do it- and for minimal cost too.

Death is gonna be a little late today. When you die, really die and not any of that 'technically' die stuff, you keep on trucking until the sun next meets the horizon. If it's currently meeting the horizon you've got until the next time, but you'd better hope you don't die an hour before that.

Shake an old sinner's hand. When someone agrees to a deal that you have decided to officiate they are compelled to actually follow through- this can include supernatural effects even if no party has a way to enact that effect. It simply happens, as per the agreement. The terms must be clear and the intent is sacred, but so long as those two are met anyone can be compelled into anything- as long as they agree to the deal. The deal doesn't need to be with you, nor do you need to offer the deal yourself. So long as you are recognized as all parties as the officiator, the deal with benefit from this effect.

Summon things! Stay away from fighting! You've got a real talent for summoning creatures to do your dirty work. It costs less energy to summon and maintain things, and you learn how to do so with ease. If summoning is not a power native to the world, you automatically gain the ability to summon slimes formed entirely of your energy. Practice means you can make more slimes, larger slimes, or more powerful slimes, but it'll take great effort to bring forth anything other than a slime.
Tough? They can't even understand how tough you are. You're practically made of metal, able to shrug off incredible amounts of damage without stopping.

Telewhat? You've got a foot in the door when it comes to psionic abilities. Purely mental disciplines are far easier to learn and you've got just a touch of psionic power. Enough to maybe levitate a pencil, if you focus.

Your body is now the perfect vessel for anything. Demon? Sealed without problems. Angel? Locked away forever. Eldritch Abomination? No twisty dimensions can get it out. This does mean anything wanting a vessel to invade the planet is going to see you as the best option, but at least you won't suffer problems from channeling or hosting the power of something else.
Krakoooom! Create and control lava over a large area with a good amount of precision.
Tsu-tsu-tsunamiii! Create and control water over a wide area with a good amount of precision.

By focusing you may create a spread of armor across your body. It isn't any stronger than your bones, but forms in whatever shape you wish. Including into spikes, swords, or other weapons- so long as they're part of the armor itself. Yes, improving your bone strength improves the strength of the armor.

Your body is a swamp. Or a biochem lab. Or a really nasty dorm room. Either way, you've unlocked the secret to synthesizing, altering, and generating poison entirely from your body. This also provides immunity to any poison you produce, but none to any poison you don't already have. More poisons are added to your 'library' by ingesting them, though you start with a good couple of low level effects- light fever, general unwellness, stomach ache, and the like. The expelled poison may be from anywhere on your body, and you can mix it into your other abilities- such as breathing out a cloud with an air manipulation ability.

Know the difference between a villain and a supervillain? The more audacious, absurd, outrageous, or similar you are, the more likely it is to work. This doesn't mean you can't get foiled, but it's going to be from direct action on the part of someone else, not running out of gas, being unable to get through a door, static defenses, your copper gears failing because you got sold inferior copper, or similar.

Augment any and all attacks, abilities, spells, or effects to punch through defenses regardless of whether they should be able to or not. Break through anti-magic barriers with spells, punch through any amount of armor or walls with ease, strike directly at the core of an enemy without fail, even punch directly through incoming attacks like they aren't there. If you really want, you can even use Penetrate like X-ray vision... or a way to get through any condom. Your choice.

Activating this ability turns your entire body completely impermeable, causing you to go through literally everything. This means all senses stop working, you cannot breathe, and you will fall through the floor. Stopping this ability while in a solid rockets you back out at incredible speed. With training you can turn only part of your body impermeable.
Generate and control wood from any part of your body. It's still wood, and therefore vulnerable to fire and explosions.

When touching someone, you may force them to activate any ability they have. You are aware of the number of abilties they have, but not what they are or the actual strength of each ability. If you know one of their abilities, you may directly activate that, but otherwise the activation is random. The affected individual may fight against this, and individuals with strong wills can ignore this effect.

Just a little better magnification... You've got the schematics in your head to build things that really take a look at stuff. From microscopes, to macroscopes, to spectrograms, to X-rays. If it's used to get a better look, you know how to build it.

God isn't a pyromaniac, but Their angels sure are. The righteous fire of the angels now comes at your call. This fire doesn't burn very long and has trouble setting anything alight, but is heavily attracted to sin and will merrily burn on it until the sin is gone. Don't expect to do much damage to saints, but unleashing it in a slave market is a good way to get rid of slavers but leave the slaves just fine.
Blast people with beams! The beams deal no damage. The beams make people feel an emotion, forcefully overriding what they were feeling! Only until they get over it or recognize the false emotion.

You may generate a crystalline substance from any part of your body. It is colored however you wish and is rather durable. The crystals may spread across whatever you're touching, and while you cannot create more unless you are touching them you always retain telekinetic control of any crystal you've made. They'll degrade into dust in an hour or two unless you expend a significant amount of energy to keep it around. D rank magic is about enough to create a permanent crystal that could easily fit in the palm of a hand.

Generate a bow out of your energy. The more you've traveled the more powerful and ornate the bow is and the more you can customize it. It starts as a simple bow, but with travel it can become a compound or even a great bow. You may conjure arrows to use in the bow, also gaining more customization the more you've traveled. Does even more damage against man eating monsters, and exceptionally more against guests taking advantage of societal standards to stick around when they aren't wanted.

Put the laughter in slaughter! Whenever you deal damage, recover energy in correlation to how much damage you dealt. Recover stamina when blood, or equivalent fluid, splashes on you. As long as you keep killing, you can keep going!

Not only do you know who wants to kill you, you can even figure out who it's coming from. It won't highlight the person, so it's easy to miss who it is in crowds, but if someone can see you and wishes you ill, you'll get a heads up.
Accelerates your thought process. Doesn't make you any smarter.

Stoke the heart. You gain the ability to use Hellfire, erupting it out of any part of your body at will. Hellfire is a powerful, raging flame that easily sets anything alight and doesn't stop burning. More importantly- your heart has been turned into a vessel for this flame. Rev it up at will in order to start sending Hellfire into your veins, gradually increasing you speed, strength, and reflexes while turning your skin red. This also improves the power of your Hellfire. Hold this too long and you risk harming your body, or even turning into a demon.
Point an index finger and something and say "Bang" to fire an incredibly powerful force at them, more than capable of pasting even high level demons.

Slide into the TV and channel surf right to any other TV showing the same channel. Or jump into a camera to head over to any other camera on the network. So long as it shows or takes video and is connected to the same network, you can jump from one to the other. Be careful- something getting destroyed while you're in it is going to kick you out painfully.

Designate an ally. When you use this ability that allies stats are added to your own. You don't get any abilities out of it, but you do take their final stats once all buffs and other effects are finished. With training you may designate multiple allies.

Rot and corrosion leak from you. While this ability is active you may cover any part of your body and/or anything you're holding in a horrific crawling black and green substance. When this substance makes contact with living flesh is corrodes it, rendering healing much harder and making infection a certainty. Inanimate object begin to corrode, rust, or otherwise break down. You may dispell this effect at any point.

YOU AND ME! Activate this ability while staring at any thinking target within a generous area around you. You and that individual must now kill each other. No retreating, no exceptions. It happens right now, right here, in whatever state you're both in.

Line em up. The longer you move in a single direction the faster and more powerful and harder to hurt you get. This doesn't give you any more stamina, or any ability to actually handle moving at extreme speeds, but if you can manage that you'll end up unstoppable.
You may create, expel, and control acid. The power of it scales to your Might stat, while the amount scales to Magic. At start it can melt through most metals near instantly.

Call upon sand created from millions of flayed souls. It is hot enough to start fires if it lays on something, rips through flesh easily, and screams as it moves through the air. There is no limit to the amount you can summon of control, but pulling such a thing out of Hell is exceptionally difficult and costs a lot of energy. Hell will also reclaim the sand shortly after you have stopped manipulating it. Heavenly beings are harmed significantly more by the sin infused sand and holy protections will eventually fail against the storm.

Eh, close enough. You may now turn fully or partially into a Lunagaron. A Lunagaron is a wolf-like Fanged Wyvern that has a special organ which allows it to supercool the area around it. In extreme danger it can shut this organ off to swell their muscles and gain significantly increased strength. In this for you have significantly increased speed and strength, can cling to walls with your claws, are incredibly agile, and can create ice on yourself. Both in spikes and armor. As well as exhale freezing mist.

A mid level undead, the Soul Eater is a skeletal horse wrapped in a yellow-green aura that replaces it's skin and muscles. They aren't particularly intelligent, but are quite fast and have a large number of area effects. They consume the souls of those who die nearby in order to empower themselves, making them harder and harder to kill as more bodies stack up, and they automatically kill weaker opponents with their breath. Aside from their natural effects, they have no additional attacks.

Upper Moon Rank One. The strongest Demon bar Muzan himself. Kokushibo has spent lifetimes mastering the blade to the extent that he created and perfected the Moon Breathing Style. He is cold and aloof, only expressing joy at the idea of being properly challenged, happy to praise genuine ability and practice. He is so strong that only sunlight or the complete destruction of his body may kill him, though severe damage will cause him to change into more and more monstrous forms. As it is, he naturally has six eyes, fanned three aside on his face.
A golem created entirely of rock, possessing no internal organs whatsoever.  It has incredibly defenses and can self-repair using any rock. Also possesses great geokinetic abilities.

A Fanged Beast. The Rajang resembles a gorilla, having overly large arms in comparison to the rest of its body.  They're incredibly territorial and aggressive, able to live in a wide variety of environments without issue.  They have a particular affinity with lightning- able to shoot blasts or beams of such from their mouths. If angered above the usual, parts of their pelts will turn gold and they'll be even more aggressive than usual.

Eliza is an uncountably old woman who survived the ages by feeding blood to Sekhmet- the Parasite that has replaced her skeleton. By this point, its questionable if the two are separate at all. Regardless, Eliza is an extreme narcissist, with a sadistic and completely amoral personality. She will not hesitate to kill anyone in her way, nor is she above torture so long as it get her something in the bargain. She wields a staff and manipulates her cells to attack, altering her body freely to create weapons to attack with. She may also temporarily release Sekhmet, her Parasite skeleton that's slightly more sadistic and agressive than she is.
A Mega level Digimon and the Demon Lord of Lust. She is incredibly powerful and seductive, with a keen mind and many abilities related to darkness and rot. Also killer nails. Literally.

A Supreme Demon, sculpted from innumerable bodies thrown into the Ocean Styx. This massive creature rightfully bears the name 'leviathan' and is incredibly difficult to kill through the armored plating that covers most of its form. Though its heart protrudes out above its head, a tempting fleshy target. Getting there is a problem, as the Leviathan can strike quickly, swim, and shoot out Hell Energy in the form of projectiles from its mouth. Not particularly smart, and not going to make the church happy as a familiar, but still useful.

Also known as a Singularity. The Vernum Carnis is a 1 meter orb of an unkown mineral with a glowing red center. It floats without any form of propulsion, but is not capable of moving on its own. In fact, the orb itself isn't capable of much anything at all, having no ability to protect itself beyond being indestructible against conventional physical force. Instead, it acts as a central node, sending and receiving radio waves to other Carnis in order to control them. By itself it changes any nearby dead flesh into Crawl- meaty tendrils that act like vines and can spawn other Carnis.

A small swarm of Qurio- lamprey like flying leeches. They require a host to live, and naturally feed off of blood and lifeforce. They assault an ecosystem to feast, potentially destroying it entirely, before finding a host that they share their energy with. If the host isn't capable of managing this energy they'll go berserk, rampage, and eventually die- at which point the Qurio will attempt to find another host. Their bite punctures nearly every protective material and carries a disease which will sicken and potentially kill those that they attack.

A book bound to your soul, made from your own magics. It contains the full breadth of the Blood Magic attribute within its pages, but you must study and put effort into unlocking each spell and scrap of knowledge- anything you have not unlocked appears as blank pages. Also, it passively boosts your magical ability and learning rate. Just don't fall into despair, or demons may corrupt your book and therefore your soul.

Otherwise known as the Philosopher's Stone, the Uroboros virus is considered one of the end points of the Progenitor Virus. This strain has been modified to allow usage by almost anyone, rather than just someone with the correct genetic markers, and will result in vastly increased speed, strength, and the usage of black viral masses in the form of tentacles to attack. Can spread through the air, so be careful how you handle it.

A fancy red cloak. Definitely sentient. When worn it allows the wearer to fly or float and is capable of identifying and reacting to attacks- pulling the wearer out of the way. Can also be used to grab or wrap around enemies. Not immune to damage, but still very resistant to such. Try not to get on it's bad side.

Grimoire of the Witch of Izalith, one of the Four Lords and holder of the Flame of Life. Within are the secrets to Pyromancy, sending out fire to attack enemies and turning it inward to empower oneself. Even contains the beginnings of the attempts that would eventually result in the creation of the Demons and the Bed of Chaos. Though recreating those would take quite a lot of power over Life itself...
A jade amulet shaped like a four leaf clover on a golden chain. Brings good luck to the wearer.

An augment that replaces the spine. When activated it drastically speeds up the wearer, allowing them to move as if time is severely slowed. Though it can only work for a short period before requiring a cooldown.

A tome containing every single spell of the Restoration magic school found in Tamriel, though its initial pages only cover what can be found in Skyrim proper. The knowledge in its pages may be taught to anyone who reads the information inside. No, you cannot eat it to learn spells.

A ring that endlessly replicates itself, altered to replicate spears at the behest of Kratos and to the detriment of Heimdall. When someone wearing the ring holds out their hand, a golden spear will appear in it. They may use this spear as they wish, including throwing it, though shortly after leaving the hand the haft disappears to leave just the speartip. Tapping the haft of the spear on the ground will detonate any speartips currently out in a burst of wind.

A slightly rusted workbench suitable for creating, maintaining, and upgrading robot companions. It will give a listing of what it can make, as well as what materials it requires, and may be upgraded to unlock more advanced robots and upgrades. May be placed wherever is desired, but moving it afterward may prove difficult.

A ratty looking notebook. Inside the pages are the death dates, death locations, and soul status of every life within the current universe. The not yet dead will not have a death location, but will have the other two. Knowing the name and face of an individual means you can turn directly to their page, just a name means turning to a page with everyone who has ever had that name, and just a face turns to a page with everyone who has had approximately that appearance. The book is infallible under normal circumstances, though someone having the book falls outside of that. Don't mess around too much- the Reapers like their counts accurate.
Run fast! Fly with rocket boosters! Have plants grow anywhere you run! The Fairy Boots do it all, and are even really easy to dye!

A stone key with a sapphire gem. When used as if opening a door will open a portal to a mid sized grotto. The place is completely enclosed by stone, has a moderate lake taking up one end, and has no exits bar the portal. The lake itself is extremely magically potent and the grotto itself hums with energy. Any magic will be more powerful when used here, and anything which can use the lake water will be even more potent. Recovering magic is also accelerated in this place. The grotto does not reset on exit, so animals or plants may be raised in the grotto provided the necessary materials are brought it. The protal to the grotto closes upon your command.

Pierce, Gonryomaru. A rapier that can strike spirits and cleanse corrupt souls. That's... that's it. Getting Bankai allows you to call down storm clouds and pillars of lightning to make a badass arena though! Then call down lightning strikes by shifting the blade. Also can charge the blade by wrapping the lightning pillars around it, allowing lightning fast lightning strikes. Also comes with a small amount of spiritual energy.

A clipboard with a single page upon it. The page configures itself to be completely and totally understood by any who attempt to read it, and will even answer questions- adding more pages as necessary. Upon getting to the end, anyone may sign the waiver, at which point their autonomy, rights, and personhood are completely and irrevoably granted to the person who presented them the waiver. This is somehow considered entirely legal no matter where you are. The former person may be altered in any way, mentally, physically, or in soul, and cannot refuse, or even think to refuse, any command.

An incredibly durable and sharp katana. When someone is killed with this weapon, the katana may consume their corpse, allowing the wielder to summon a puppet of that person, wearing exactly what they were with whatever weapons they had, and control them. The puppet cannot gain experience or improve and has a ghost of the original person's personality, sufficient to fight upon being directed. Only eight corpses may be stored this way.

Six floating orbs each marked with a single word. They may be manipulated with just finger movements and can be thrown to cause effects upon hitting a target. Flame will incinerate the target, Storm creates a large whirlwind, Explosion... explodes, Ice freezes, Lightning unleashes a large electric shock, and Rot erodes what it hits. The orbs are resistant to damage and can be used to block attacks, including bullets.
The King of Beasts Transformation: Lionel

A belt that, when activated, transforms the wearer. It grants greatly increased speed, strength, regeneration, and senses of smell and sight. Additionally it causes the wearer's body to manifest traits of lions, including changing their hand to paws, with claws, changing their ears to that of a lion, and giving them a tail.
A fumo of a certain purple magician. Place it on a pillow to create an area that passively increases the ability to learn and retain magical information.

Now? Now you can pull off those crazy trick shots. No curving bullets or anything, just simple knowledge of recoil and an impressive ability to hit exactly where you're aiming. Very little can get by you without supernatural powers, and even those are going to be in trouble

Your knowledge of physics could easily rival some of the best learned individuals, and you can use that to do some extremely impressive things. Push forward the boundries of physics or simply push a massive building onto your foes by throwing a rock at the right place.

Hit things really, really hard. Blunt weapons may not be the weapon people think of when it comes to finesse or intelligence, but you prove them wrong. You know exactly how to strike to splatter a man across the next square mile or just into a nearby painting frame.

Not quite king, but close enough. Anything that could possibly be related to a trade you do as if you've gotten several years experience in doing it. Blacksmithing, Lockpicking, Data Administration, Spying, Woodworking, Electrician... you're a one person repository of all of it and more!

You're a master of managing things- delegation, finances, people, assets, tasks, attention, multiple problems at once. You can handle it all and keep on going. If you really wanted to, you could run an entire multinational company by yourself, or become a very effective ruler of a nation.

You're a master of communicating in all forms- body language, facial expressions, tones and words, emotions and physical actions. You can cold read better than the pros, sniff out lies from a mile away, and are so utterly understandable that you could make even a worm understand what you're trying to tell it.

James Bond who? You're an undisputed professional at the art of spycraft- any nation would fall all over themselves to have you on the roster. You can infiltrate, mask your emotions, disguise yourself, gather information, act, interrogate, read and manipulate others, and even fight effectively with knives, guns, and hand to hand combat.
If it isn't lethal it doesn't count. No matter how much damage you sustain, if it doesn't add up to being actively lethal you can still fight just as well as if you were completely uninjured.

Your quantum nature makes it quite literally impossible to bind you, hold you, or otherwise restrain you physically in any way- you just slip right out the moment someone tries, as if all of your molecules aligned just right to make whatever they used fall right off or right through you.

You have a powerful connection to your own morale and morals, hearing it as a voice that pushes you forward and urges you to keep going. It allows you to resist temptation and forge through extreme adversity without flinching. The stronger your Volition, the more you can withstand- though, ultimately, too much Volition might make you kind of a downer. Or a party pooper. It makes you a little too sane for fun, that is.
Reflexes so good you're reacting to things before anyone else sees them. With this you could dodge bullets or react to low level superspeed.

The aura of a ruler shines from you. People are significantly more likely to listen to you and take orders from you. Establishing yourself as the leader is simple, and followers of yours will carry out your orders without question. Also comes with a distinct weakness to guillotines.

Veins like wires. Electricity just loves to move through you. Not only is it harder to electrocute you, anything that involves lightning comes significantly easier and any lightning you throw out hits harder.

The Keeper of the Keys and the Gate grants you passage. Utilizing any form of movement technique is much easier and will never give you any complications. This protection extends to any vessel you are riding on- it may move through Hell, the Warp, and anything else without a single spot of trouble and arrive right on time.

When the inhuman prey upon the human, you are there with silver in hand and a prayer for protection. You have a sense for when and where the supernatural are making trouble for the innocent and when facing any supernatural entity in protection of the innocent you gain significant buffs to your speed, reflexes, and strength. Additionally it's far easier to remember or figure out the weakness of anything you're facing, to the point where you can create a weakness where none used to exist.

You know just the right way to squeeze out every bit of juice. Whenever you use anything that has some form of power or use limitation, you can stretch it's use for far longer than anyone expected. Make a day of fuel last three or a single battery last a month. This applies to any ability which costs anything, anything which requires some form of power or fuel, and anything that can overheat or suffers from being used too long. The item is not used at it's full potential while doing this, limiting it's output to a somewhat more than half of what it could do. You may choose to use it at full potential at the cost of comsuming the normal amount of fuel/power/etc.

You are a Pillar Man, an ancient superbeing akin to a vampire, but more potent due to having your cells partially unlocked from the Stone Mask. You have near total command over your physiology and shape, can directly absorb any and all other living beings into your body to digest at will, possess enhanced speed, strength, durability, and intelligence, and can even utilize particular quirks of your biology akin to elemental magic should you practice at it- superheated blood from your veins, high pressure air from your body, or even shining light from the reflections off of your crystalline bones. You are still weak to the sun, though, and will turn to stone under its light.

Slaanesh, Prince of Pleasure, Lord of Excess, She Who Thirsts, has granted unto you her blessing. Yes, exactly where and in what form you think it is considering those epithets. You are now startlingly more charismatic and are capable of feeling, identifying, and nudging other's emotions. Additionally, you gain power through excess. Excess of what? Anything! 'Enough' is a lie, and one you've broken. What you do to excess influences what power you get- an excessive amount of books improves Mind and Mana, excessively working out improves Might, and etc. No matter what- the powers from the Brand also improve. This does not pledge you to Slaanesh or invite her into the world.

Forward! To GLORY! You have a sense for opportunity- as long as it will grant you more fame or glory. Never miss a quest again...  as long as it makes more people know your name and cheer you on. Additionally ensures you know just what action is going to give you even more fame, though it doesn't give you the ability to survive it.

You have become a one tailed kitsune, a yokai of Japanese myth. You may freely change between fox form and humanoid form, and are now extremely attractive due to your spiritual nature. You gain enhanced strength, speed, stealth, and magical ability, and a focus towards using Foxfire, illusions, and shapeshifting. Additionally, all fire based and stealth or illusion based effects are enhanced. As you grow more powerful, you gain a new tail with each new peak of power or century of age, eventually capping out at nine tails. Should you remain in good moral standing, you may even become a divine messenger or a god in your own right.

You have become a bakedanuki, a yokai of Japanese myth. You may freely change between tanuki form and humanoid form, and are now extremely attractive due to your spiritual nature. You gain enhanced strength, speed, stealth, and magical ability, and a focus towards using illusions and shapeshifting via placing an enchanted leaf on your head. Additionally, all stealth and illusion based effects are enhanced. You also gain a strange affinity towards raucous singing, drumming, dancing, drinking, and pranking people.

Hit, Hit, Counter, Hit, Hit... Whenever you land one blow, more are soon to follow. As long as you've connected a clean hit you know exactly how to chain that into more and more hits. The chain doesn't end until you make a mistake or your opponent is dead.

In addition to air, you breathe in mystical energy of any type you currently have access to. This energy flows right into your body, empowering you and quickly filling your reserves. Of course, the energy has to be in the air in the first place, but in a place of great power? Have fun being next to invincible. Also makes you sparkle, just a little.
Make things combust by staring at them really hard. More targets takes more energy, bigger targets take more energy. With training you can modulate this to merely making things hotter.

A dark flame that burns significantly more intensely than normal fire and prevents natural healing while burning on something. It's harder to see than normal fire and doesn't cast anywhere near as much light, allowing for it to be more easily hidden. Any fire ability may now use this flame. Additionally, you may summon and control a large amount of this flame on it's own or imbune it into weapons to empower any injury they deal.

The flame wielded by the Godskin Apostles, bearing the power of Destined Death. This blackened flame burns away the very vitality of what it touches- everything dies after burning the same amount of time, no matter their power. In addition, the flames are ravenous, lasting far longer than they should. In this it may kill even the gods themselves. You may create and control this flame and use it with any other item which utilizes fire.

Grant unto another your blessing. You may bless them with greater physical power, greater magical power, or any Passive or Ability under A rank which you possess. Up to two blessings may be active on one person at one time and any number of people may have blessings at one time. You may bless a large group of people at once for twice the cost of blessing one person, so long as they are all wearing something that connects them and are in the same general area. They all recieve the same blessing, chosen why you apply it. More energy means the blessing lasts longer.
For a single heartbeat you transform yourself in a literal streak of light. As it happens, going lightspeed for a single second is quite a lot of distance.

You can freely change your entire body to whatever you want, though you're limited by the amount of material your body currently has. These changes are near instant and you instinctively avoid harming yourself.
Seen it? Poof! There. Instantly teleport yourself to any place you have personally seen. It takes more energy to go farther.
