You may emit any energy you have access to, or 'simple' energy with no special properties that is always present, in any way you wish. Beams, shockwaves, lasers, anything. Choose a color- the energy from this ability always manifests in that color. With training you may combine this with other abilities or take advantage of any unique properties of whatever energy you're using.

You may swap two stat values you possess. This is not limited to the Eight Ms, but anything you could represent statistically. In the beginning you may only swap simple, connected values, such as 'strength' and 'defense', but with training you can swap anything for anything else.

Double Cast. Triple Cast. Quadruple Cast. You may use any Ability multiple times at once. It starts at only using two instances, but can grow to be many more. Throw two fireballs or drop three lightning strikes.

Strength Sap lowers an enemy's power by a percentage between 25 and 50%, and in exchange grants you that strength. If you are damaged, it will allow you to heal, otherwise it can be used for a quick boost to strength and vitality. If you take too much strength, it will stop working.

Grants the power to become an Angel, a Messenger of God. You get the standard Angel package, two wings, decent enough holy power, increased strength, and a predisposition to follow the ideals of God. Luckily, without the loss of free will depending on scripture.

You become a Skill Thief, able to absorb any form of expertise from someone with the severity increasing through exposure. This can have multiple different methods of use, but the skill will recover provided it isn't completely drained from the target. It can allow you to overcome mind control abilities with the right knowledge, or become an expert swordsman, or even a doctor, computer hacker, or chess player. These boosts are permanent, but can only be used on skills and mental abilities.

You can teleport stuff! People, animals, bread, other assorted things, you can construct something to move it from one place to another without just physically picking it up and putting it somewhere else. A teleporter to the moon, a teleporter to the center of the earth, a teleporter that runs off of Australium, a teleporter that runs off of Element-115, or E99. If it teleports things, you can eventually build it.

This ability puts three additional mouths on the body, all of which can inject chakra into moldable clay. This ability grants you access to Chakra, specifically Explosion Release Chakra, and that chakra can then be used to create multiple different bombs, from C0 up to C4. C0 is a suicide technique.

When the Brimstone Crag was drowned by the Brimstone Elemental, even the very lava was affected. It got lighter... stronger. It sears flesh easily, preventing regeneration and continuing to eat at anything it comes into contact with for a short period after. You may summon this lava, but not control it without a separate lava control ability. Send flows across the ground or throw globs at whatever you wish. Be aware you resist, but are not immune to, the Brimstone Lava.
Shrink yourself down to 1/20th your usual scale and still attack with the exact same power and potency. With training, you could push yourself even further- though, try not to go subatomic.
Generate a hydra head and neck from your back. With practice you may manifest multiple. They're exceptionally large, easily enough to eat a person at base, but have no other special abilities.

You're one hell of a chlorokinetic- you can communicate with and control any and all plantlife in your sensory range, allowing you to create bladed leaves, armored bark, impaling roots, or even a whole variety of strange crossbreeds that shouldn't be naturally possible. Any existing plant is yours to command with impunity, though you'll require at least some existing vegetation to work with- even algae or seeds will do in a pinch.

Every defeated foe, killed enemy, slain creature, or otherwise accomplished task requiring effort and preparation grants you a slight boost in power in proportion to the enormity of the task- finishing long questlines and felling great foes grants much more power, chopping wood... not so much. All boosts are banked until they reach an accomplishment based threshold, at which point it spills over, granting you the total boost and allowing you to... level up. Duh. Each level up grants, at maximum, a full 10% boost to all stats.

Create and control any and all metals at will, allowing you to shape constructs and launch projectiles, or take existing metal in your environment as your own. Does not extend to magical or otherwise non-periodic metals. The more complex the structure of the metal, the more effort it takes. Increasing durability beyond the metal's usual norm also takes more energy.

Being in physical contact with someone allows you to nullify any powers they might have. This doesn't affect anything that comes about purely from skill or physical ability, and you must focus on doing so at first. With time you may have the effect automatically apply or even increase the range.

Summon or create air and sky elementals using your own energy. They can take the form of zephyrs, living storms, greater sprites, etc etc. Each one can use B rank or lower magic and similar effects. The power of the elementals depends on your own energy levels and power. The elementals vanish the moment you stop supplying energy, though with practice you can form elementals with set durations or even permanent summons. Summoned elementals are not considered Familiars.

The bell of the ferryman. Summon and ring it to call all the souls of the un-passed dead within the area to your position. By possessing a relevant object to a certain person, you may summon only them should you require their presence. The more powerful the soul, the more they can resist the bell if they so wish. You cannot command the souls called, but may interact with them all the same, or store them within the bell for later retrieval- 100 at first, more as you increase in strength.

A Conduit is an individual with an activated conduit gene- a gene you now have. Your body is significantly enhanced, especially in regards to healing, and you gain even faster healing when encountering oil or napalm. You may generate and control oil and napalm. Eventually, you may turn into smoke to teleport short distances, fly, or even create short lived creatures to fight by your side.

Gain the ability to transform into an adult Vaxasaurian- a massive bipedal sauropod-like alien with massive arms, tough skin, stumpy legs, and the ability to grow up to three times their original size while exponentially increasing in strength. It's also extremely durable, well armored, and capable of ripping entire buildings down with ease. You suffer from a lack of mobility, though.

All things return to crab. Now you can too! You may change your body, partly or fully, into the form of a Shogun Ceanatour- a massive crab with a blue carapace and a tendency to be incredibly aggressive. It'll be quite hard to get through your shell and the scything arms are killer. Plus you can spray water everywhere, if you really feel like it.

A humanoid mosquito bioengineered by Dr. Genus. She requires blood to survive, can control mosquitos (which she regards almost maternally), and doesn't care all that much about humans. Though she can get along, if she needs to. She is incredibly physically powerful, and can temporarily assume an even more powerful state, with powerful regeneration, but being injected with a significant amount of blood.

From your shadow or nearby shadows, summon a large deer shikigami capable of emitting a powerful healing aura of reverse cursed energy. It has little combat potential beyond its antlers, but its reverse cursed energy deals massive damage to cursed spirits and other creatures made of negativity and curses on contact. Scales with your energy levels.

Secondborn of Akatosh, Paarthurnax is a mighty dragon, capable of using the Thu'um, the ability to alter reality in localized instances via speech. Paarthurnax is able to teach this ability, though his peaceful nature prevents him from fighting in most circumstances.

The Doom and Terror of Modern Man. Once a powerful sorcerer, Nas'hrah has been reduced to an immortal floating head. Narcissistic, sadistic, and sociopathic, he looks down on everybody, frequently insulting them and considering only what they can provide to him. Despite that he is an immensely knowledgeable sorcerer familiar with blood magic and pyromancy. Promise him help and he may well pass on some of his knowledge.

Eyesmon is a Champion/Adult level Demon Dragon Digimon that grows more powerful the more information it stores inside of its body. Despite 'only' being a Champion/Adult Digimon, it is very powerful, and can even possess people to gain more information. This process can eventually kill the host, if intended. It will never miss anything in its sight, and its lasers can pierce through objects easily.

A metallic sphere roughly 30 cm in diameter that serves as a Von Neumann style factory core. It is capable of assimilating provided resources and information to grow into a sprawling expanse of assembly lines and conveyors, buildings and resource outposts and power plants. The more information and resources fed into it, the larger and faster it grows, and the more items and useable products it can create.

A book that preaches the worship of the Erdtree. Studying this book will grant knowledge of healing, granting boons which cause regeneration, conjuring waves of golden force, conjuring golden stars to assault foes, and temporarily manifesting aspects of a dragon to smack, crush, impale, or otherwise harm foes.

Reject your humanity! A stone mask that, when worn and blood dripped upon it, instantly impales the wearer in such a way as to remove their bodily limiters but leaving it weak to sunlight and powers that echo sunlight. In addition, anyone who has used the mask is inflicted with a desperate craving for blood, to the point where they would even attack family.
Flight! A rather snazzy looking gold ring that allows you to fly as fast as you could run.

The upgraded blade of Jetstream Sam. A High-Frequency blade capable of ignoring durability by directly slicing at the atomic level. The sheathe has been modified to act as a pistol, allowing iaido strikes enhanced by the energy generated from a gunshot.

A musket shaped gun. The normal firing mechanism is instead replaced with the scale of a topaz dragon. When fired, the weapon shoots a beam which degrades, rots, rusts, or otherwise renders the target closer to disintegration. Anything killed by this weapon will turn to dust.

A Sacred Gear holding a part of the dragon Vritra's soul. It takes the shape of a gauntlet on one's arm, allowing the user to create energy lines capable of grappling enemies, restraining them, and absorbing their power into the user or attached allies. It can also be used as a grappling hook, or used in tandem to transfer allied abilities over long distances. It can also drain one's own energy to fire out as magic bolts, though that strategy is risky and harmful. Manifests as a marble that grants the Sacred Gear to whomever swallows it.

A tome containing the magical secrets of Starscourge Radahn. Within are the gravity magics the man learned, enabling one to use gravity to push and pull, call down meteors, rip blades of rock from stone, and alter weight.

A book bound to your soul, made from your own magics. It contains the full breadth of the Wind Magic attribute within its pages, but you must study and put effort into unlocking each spell and scrap of knowledge- anything you have not unlocked appears as blank pages. Also, it passively boosts your magical ability and learning rate. Just don't fall into despair, or demons may corrupt your book and therefore your soul.

A wand crafted of snowflakes. It's cold to the touch and seems to continually replace what it loses. Using this to create or control ice empowers it, allowing whatever it is to do so more effectively.

A shard of the sun all in the palm of your hand. Daybreak is a long spear of burning light perfectly balanced for throwing. Focusing allows another copy of this weapon to be formed from the light around you, ensuring an infinite number can be thrown. When thrown it stick into a target and burns them with the fury of the sun for a few seconds before fading.

The personal research of Orbeck of Vinheim. Once an assassin, then an exile, yet always wishing to be a student and teacher, Orbeck assembled a number of simple spells, notes, and similar writings to enable anyone along the path toward utilizing Sorcery- magics that use the power of souls to attack, defend, and more. Fire soul arrows, quiet footsteps, camouflage the body, summon a blue sword, and more.

A set of twenty of Capusle Corps capsules. Each capsule is a small pill shaped device with a plunger on the top, capable of holding and immense amount of stuff. From small objects like flashlights to entire cars or even buildings. This set of them contains everything required to start and maintain a small settlement in hostile territory. Including all buildings, preserved food, vehicles, appliances, and everything else bar living creatures.

A book bound to your soul, made from your own magics. It contains the full breadth of the Water Magic attribute within its pages, but you must study and put effort into unlocking each spell and scrap of knowledge- anything you have not unlocked appears as blank pages. Also, it passively boosts your magical ability and learning rate. Just don't fall into despair, or demons may corrupt your book and therefore your soul.
A set of daggers crafted from the fangs of the dragon Kamish. Not only are they impossibly sharp and dangerous, but they take in the power of their wielder to become even more dangerous.

A twisted bow crackling with energy crafted from the corpse of the Storm Weaver. Firing the bow converts the arrows into multiple lightning strikes that emit from the ceiling of wherever you are, curving toward foes and ripping right through them. Should anything manage to survive a strike they are electrified, making moving painful.

An ominous jar filled with an endless amount of sticky tar looking liquid. It will respond to your commands, allowing you to create creatures of Grimm- monsters of darkness that attack sapients and are attracted to negative emotions. They'll follow your orders to the letter, and get stronger and smarter the longer they exist.

A winning token! This token may be exchanged to grant you any of the common magics from Fairy Tail, which means no Demon Slayer, Dragon Slayer, or ancient or lost magics. Which still leaves you with quite the large selection- from Requip to Gun to Solid Script. Don't worry- you'll also be given the items required to use the magic should you not already have them. Though they're bargin bin versions.

A golden lamp crafted by the God of Light. Within it rests the spirit Jinn, who may answer three questions not pertaining to the future every one-hundred years. These answers are always true, but specific- asking the wrong question may give an answer that implies something untrue. Summoning Jinn from the lamp entirely stops time for everyone but those with the lamp and Jinn. You may also speak with Jinn normally, who is exceptionally knowledgeable even without using her powers.

Reduce all of creation to ashes. The strongest fire Zanpakuto. Sealed it takes the form of a simple katana, but when released it turns the landscape into a blazing inferno and is covered in fire. The fire naturally present in it's unsealed state by itself is enough to destroy weaker opponents, and swinging it can reduce a human to nothing but ash without effort.

A small intricately detailed silver stopwatch. When activated the user's perception speeds up. This can be a small increase or so large an increase it feels like time is stopped. Note that the watch does not grant the ability to move fast enough to act normally under the sped up perception.

A heavy metal key that is always warm. When used as if opening a door, creates a path into a massive forge filled with indestructible tools, raw materials, and books on forging. Anything that could possibly be needed to make any item can be found somewhere within this building, and all the tools and materials are of the highest quality. The entrance remains open to anyone unless specifically closed and will disappear if the key owner leaves the space.

A large fan that, upon being prompted with a mental command, creates a massive amount of fire, wind, lightning, earth, or water. It takes a large amount of Chakra to use, which you gain with all secondary benefits.

A demon slaying art that focused on drawing out and utilizing the absolute limits of the human body. They focus on attacking extremely quickly, moving so fast it seems like teleporting to normal humans, and taking advantage of moving on walls and ceilings to obfuscate their attack pattern and confuse their opponents. At the high end, this art allows fighting demons on even ground as a normal human.

It'd take something magical to know you're around, and even then it may not work. There is almost no conventionally protected building you can't sneak in to without a trace, and even the few you can't would be lucky to figure out you were there. Static mystical or esoteric protections won't slow you down for long, but more active ones may prove a little tricky. You're so good you can outright disappear from someone's line of sight.

An ancient Hunter's Art. Shroud yourself in personally colored fog and then move so quickly almost nothing can track you. It can't go very far and strains the body severely, but very few would be able to accurately target someone using it.

The fighting style crafted by Kaolan Wongsawat. It combines boxing and Muai Thai in order to craft a style that allows the user to attack from nearly any position with devastating effect. Any moment of inattention on part of the opponent is potentially fight ending, especially when this style also focuses on sending out incredibly fast blows. The pinnacle technique of the style is the God Blow- a straight cross so fast that it is almost impossible to dodge.

Are you fighting to protect the weak? To right wrongs? To defeat evil? Then you have the power to give it a good fight. When acting as a Hero you will be given the physical parameters required to actually face whatever evil you are fighting against. This doesn't mean you are as strong as them, merely that you have a chance no matter how strong they are. This only considers the strongest single opponent and even if you're stronger than everyone you're fighting you'll still get a bit of a boost.

There is someone important in your bloodline. Who? Well, who knows? You're going to have to track down who it is, but once you figure it out you automatically gain access to whatever special abilities, techniques, or similar they may have had. This may be a bloodline currently active in the world, a long dead one, or even one not previously existing. It's your choice.

What is good in life but the joy of battle? Or any other challenge suitable for you. No matter where you are or what is happening, conflict will find you. They will always be something you can defeat, but it will still be difficult no matter how strong you get. The conflict isn't always physical, but anything you pride yourself on is a viable target for a challenge.

You're near impossibly lucky. Anything that could possibly be affected by random chance, and a few things that aren't, are going to go in your favor. Dodge attacks by tripping, win the lottery, find large amounts of money in the oddest places, and more! Doesn't affect your gacha rolls.

You have been blessed by Artemis, Goddess of the Hunt, Wilderness, Transitions, Nature, and a few other things. As such you are a natural at archery, will never get lost in the woods, have an instinctive sense of what things are safe to eat, and a similar instinctive sense of how to properly set up, and break down, a camp. Either using nothing but what is in the forest or in purchasing the right materials in the right quantities. Should you have magic, any that deal with transitioning are easier to learn- both in the sense of moving from one place to another and in changing the body. Especially male to female.
Isis, Mother of Horus, Goddess of Magic, Wisdom, and Kingship, has blessed you. Magic comes to you easily, tricking or misleading another is simple, and you carry with you the authority of a king.

You have been blessed by the goddess Izanami, creator of the Japanese archipelago and progenitor of gods. She gifts upon you dominion of Death, increasing your resistance to all curses and necrotic effects while also increasing your ability to cast and empower death and soul related effects. You gain increased skill and power with item and territory creation, and your progeny will naturally be inclined towards godhood.

You are curiously receptive to healing. Healing of any type (biological, mechanical, magical, etc) is far more effective. Even something as simple as properly bandaging an injury has an outsized effect on your ability to heal. This does not affect any natural ability to heal your body has- the effect must come from something outside of yourself.
Run like the wind? Don't mind if you do! You are naturally as swift and agile as the wind itself. While this doesn't grant any extra endurance, you still tire out far slower from movement.

Whether curse, mutation, virus, or some other effect, you are now a lycanthrope. An individual who is part human and part wolf. You may change into a wolf at any time, or change only parts of yourself, but the full moon calls to your blood and makes it difficult to resist changing under it's light. You have greatly increased healing, senses, strength, and speed as a wolf, and slightly lesser increases as a human. Silver, especially inherited silver, is poison and will harm you greatly at even the barest cut.

Tired of things breaking? Now it doesn't matter! Any item obtained through the gacha now comes with its own warranty! Anything that breaks or any familiar who dies, will be repaired, or healed, to a good as new state over a period of time related to their power. This process takes about a week per rank value (so an F item would take a week, a D two weeks, etc) and automatically starts as soon as something/someone is rendered broken, dead, or otherwise inoperable. This only applies to things which are not naturally consumable and do not already replace themselves.

The highest peak an undead may reach. Elder Liches are master spellcasters, easily raising and controlling world ending armies of undead, performing spells that strip bones, annihilate bodies, and even outright disintegrate enemies, and survive an absurd amount of damage. Not that they need to, as their soul containing phylacteries are guarded zealously and powerfully. With time and a little effort, you may obtain absurd martial abilities as well, using the tireless, unbreaking nature of your undead body to your advantage.

The Omnissiah blesses you! Machines are eager to please- battery drains slower, wear accumulates less quickly, and minor problems are simple to fix. You equally know the proper rites to repair anything- and no matter how silly the action or complex the required repair it works. AI, androids, and similar machines also like you far better on first meeting- enough that even hostile ones will hesitate. Usually. AM still hates you.
Emit and control a large amount of fire extremely precisely. Burn an entire area, compress fire into small strings, torch through metal, or more.

Touch something and you can set it on fire. Doesn't matter what it is or where it is- if you're touching it, it burns. This instantly completely engulfs it in flames, but doesn't provide any special ability to make that fire harm anything. With training you can set things connected to that thing on fire. And on. And on. Until you can set a city alight with a thought.

Control all ice with precision! Wihin a certain range. Unfortunately, you can't actually make ice. Though with training you can manipulate the temperature of ice, which is enough to freeze water and, in turn, technically create ice.

Ice in the veins. Your heartbeat is slower, your mind harder to shake, and any ice abilities you have are far easier to use. Additionally, the cold doesn't bother you and anyone attempting to harm you with ice had better have better than B rank Might or you'll just ignore it.

You may alter the properties of air. At first this is just the concentration of gasses within it, which you instinctively know, allowing you to create spaces of nothing but Carbon Dioxide to suffocate enemies (technically, let's not get into the nitty gritty of that) or spaces of pure oxygen fit to explode. With time you may be able to change even more interesting things...
Create and control electricity. Shoot lighting from your hands, call down thunderbolts, accelerate how fast your nervous system works, or do something even crazier!

You may now create curses. These start as general things, lower strength or speed or make moving harder and the like, but every roll you get enables you to create curses related to that thing. Get a Passive that makes you immune to fire and curse others to be weaker to it, obtain the ability to shoot lightning and make others more conductive, or attract lightning better, or even slow them by making their nerves slightly more resistant than normal. It's all up to how clever you are.

You may slip into a patch of shadow and emerge as a shadow monster. You have no set form, no organs, and grow bigger and stronger the darker it is. While you are composed of shadow, you are capable of affecting things physically, and they are capable of affecting you, in addition to the fact that light severely weakens you.

Control shadows! Generate shadows! Make shadows able to interact physically with the world! A shadow of a spear will cut just as well as one, while being basically weightless to boot! They can even resist natural light enough to not be too weakened by the sun, though unnatural or focused light can still cut through them. With time, you may be able to train enough to keep some shadows around even against that.

Scribe a circle of runes under a single target, then blast them with an immense pillar of holy energy. You are healed based on the amount of damage you did. Calling down this pillar is incredibly draining.

You may freely manipulate your own bones, rapidly generating them, altering them, and even shooting them out of your body. Once they leave your person you can no longer affect them, but so long as they touch you may create anything you desire. If you can see the bones of another individual you may heal or break them, but nothing more.
You heal absurdly quickly. Bones set and repair near instantly, large gashes close in seconds, and even removed limbs grow back in minutes.

At a touch you may place a mark on an object. That mark begins to charge, taking in any energy you feed it as well as any ambient energy it can obtain. With a thought you may detonate the mark, turning all the energy it accumulated into explosive force. You are always aware of any marks you have placed.
You may manipulate oil and anything created from oil. Including, but not limited to, plastic, asphault, glue, ink, and more. Wow, oil makes a lotta neat stuff, doesn't it?

By touching something or someone you may drain the vitality from it/them. This isn't a fast process, is easily interrupted, is hard to use against those stronger than you, and at first you only get a fraction of the vitality to you drain added to your own. With training you may resolve all of those problems, or even extend your range beyond touch!

You may increase or decrease the density of yourself and any object you are holding or wearing. This effect wears off over time, but may be extended but putting more energy into the ability. By default you can't increase or decrease things very much, but with training you could do quite a lot.

By pushing energy into the air you may 'jam' any magical effect that is occurring around you. This doesn't dispel it- merely makes it not work for however long you're around to maintain the jam. If someone is watching, or the magic is set up to do so, the jam can absolutely be noticed.

You may expend energy to create a repulsive force. This force can be directed in one area or erupt around your entire body. By default the force is incredibly powerful, easily sweeping away buildings, but you may power down, or power up, the effect. More powerful attacks take more energy, and while it doesn't take any time to charge up the backlash means there is a minimum of five seconds between use. More if you used a more powerful attack.

Define an area or period of time. Any training done in that area or during that time, for the purpose of training, is somehow better. This is not limited purely to physical gains- understanding techniques, memorizing information, or other things are also easier. Anyone may make use of this effect if you define an area, but a time period only affects yourself. The ability is completely ineffective in anything not 'training', so being jumped by someone hostile to you will not have that fight give the benefits.

Barrier! You may create translucent barriers that are near impossible to break. At first you can only make smaller sections, but with training you can make large domes. Anything that hits the barrier has damage reflected onto it equal to the amount of damage the barrier blocked. This does mean if they do break through, they don't take any damage above what it took to break the barrier- but they still take damage. Barrier may be improved by understanding how to block other effects- such as blocking psionic mind reading by understanding how it works, but it won't block magic mind reading until your understand that.

Green glow- good for the skin. Radiation and similar effects don't harm you. On the contrary- they heal you, improve your constitution, and in general are something you want more of. Just try not to take in too much. You're immune, everyone around you isn't.

Swords, axes, daggers, spears, clubs, tonfa, maces, cleavers, glaives, pikes, lances, and on and on. If the indended purpose is to hurt someone right in front of you, you've got a knack for making it. While these weapons may have some ability to harm another at range, their primary purpose is to be up close and personal. Doesn't include the ability to make any armor.
I have eyes everywhere... You gain the knowledge to create sensors. At first this is simple- tripwires and things, but eventually you could create world spanning suites that track every movement.

Design, build, and modify any and all technology related to physical defenses. Walls, armor, trenches, reinforcements, anti-air, so on and so forth. It doesn't let you do weird esoteric energy bullshit, but you can make a damn good wall and anti-air turret. With the right materials, you could build a defensive barrier that could keep out even gods.

I'm in. You may interface with machines telepathically. At first this is simple things- commanding a powered door to open or close or silencing an alarm. As you get stronger you can give far more complex commands, up to gaining full and complete control of any system you manage to get into.

Anything which has a distinct time limit may have that limit extended. Only thing you apply or that directly affect you at first, but eventually you can extend anything that expires after a specific period of time.

Tent not included. Select a spot. It can be a rather large one, suitable for one person to stay for an extended period of time. So long as you sit within that area you become more focused, deal more damage, and are harder to spot. This effect scales to the length of time you have stayed in that location uninterrupted, being reset when you leave. There is no maximum limit to the amount this may scale as long as you stay in the area.

When you touch anything which has the ability to process information, animals, computers, etc, you may 'network' it. This means that you may pull processing power from that thing to utilize for yourself, slowing whatever it is down while speeding yourself up. In animals, including humans and other sapients, this makes them dumber until the network stops. Marking something unwilling is difficult, but not impossible. Heavy use may damage yourself and whatever you are networking, but a constant low level boost won't cause issues.

BONES! You may create and control bones, though only bones you make with this ability. No animating someone's skeleton. Even turn them into bone minions with a little bit of work. Comes with a cool crown.

Hope you've got some Vibranium handy. Any time you touch a material you may make your body gain the properties of that material. Such as becoming durable and non-conductive as rock or speeding up your thoughts with gold. At first this is just the physical properties, but with some study and a bit of magic you could take on mystical properties as well. Such as silver's ability to purify.
YEET! Expend energy to launch anything you're holding. More energy = more speed. Bigger things need more energy to get going.

The spears of an undying warrior. You may conjure, fire, and control spears of energy. These spears cannot be dodged, but may be blocked. Against the truly depraved they move faster and you may create them faster.
Anything lower than two ranks of your level in that stat is incapable of affecting you unless you want it to. If you reach S in every stat this changes to anything lower than one rank of your level.

Jinx! You carry with you an aura of misfortune. Normally this doesn't matter, but when you focus on it you can inflict misfortune on your enemies within a small area. Nothing large at first- a trip or a weapon jamming, but with time you can improve your abilities, getting a larger range and inflicting even more dangerous misfortune.

You may offer someone else a contract, with anything as collateral. They get whatever you promised them- money, physical ability, gacha granted abilities, or even your own body parts- and you get to collar them as a servant for however long the contract is supposed to last. In situations where the reward would conflict with them being the servant, such as offering your own body to possess/use for a time, payment is suspended until the contract ends or before it begins. A servant may not refuse your orders, and may be summoned at any time, but the standard contract does include clauses preventing deliberately harming or abusing them. Don't mess with it- the penalty is nasty.

A glowing, sparking star in your soul. When you grasp it you may choose to change your body to any Race Change within the gacha. You may stay as that race for a day before you need to change back... but you can refuse, losing this ability in favor of the race you selected.

Set a geas on any target you touch, compelling them to obey the rules you define without question or resistance. The stronger the target, the harder it is to control them. The more dangerous the geas is to the target, the more difficult it becomes to place the geas. Should they somehow break the rule, they will be severely weakened both mentally and physically in proportion to the severity of the geas.

Summon or create Fire Elementals such as cursed fires, flame demons, living bonfires, etc. Each one can use B rank or lower fire-based magic or effects. The power of the elementals depends on your own expertise and power. The conjured Elementals will vanish if you stop supplying them with energy, though with practice you can form elementals with set durations or even permanent summons. Summoned elementals are not considered Familiars.

Wield the divine fury of a nine tailed kitsune, pale blue flames carrying the harsh burn of real fire and the festering sting of cursed fire while also being mutable enough to shape into illusions and mirages to fool your enemies into running headlong into danger. Your flames may even be convincing enough to mimic another person, if you wish.

Grant your allies percentages of your own physical stats or abilities, allowing you to gift 10% of your strength or the entirety of a physical ability. Should you bequeath your stats to others, the given stats will only return upon that person's death.

With your Dying Will! Lightning Flames have the ability of Hardening. Applying them makes things firmer and less likely to break. Harden a pocket of air into a shield or a paper into something that can cut through flesh. Your Will determines how strong they are, and they must be utilized through a ring capable of withstanding their strength. Such a ring is provided when you roll this, though if it's lost its up to you to find another.
This legendary dragon is a powerful engine of destruction. Virtually invincible, very few have faced this awesome creature and lived to tell the tale.

The Berserker class oni said to be the subordinate of Shuten Douji, but in reality is her sworn sibling. She is powerful and dangerous, more than capable of commanding a great and terrible army of oni in battle, and wields a massive bone sword that only an oni could hold in battle. Her Noble Phantasm is the Great Grudge of Rashoumon, allowing her to detach her right arm and use it as a weapon. Her second Noble Phantasm is Great Flame of Mount Ooe, allowing her to scorch her enemies to cinders in a tide of heat and fire. She is not dependent on you to exist, and you must put effort into maintaining your bond.

A shrunk version of the Endbringer Simurgh, this tiny fellow may only have the approximate strength of a particularly aggressive chihuahua, if that chihuahua could drive a car, but she still retains her incredible telekinetic powers. Rather than drawing energy from a collection of Shards, it draws energy from you, holding back most of its power based on your own ability. Can be convinced to stop sandbagging, if needed.

A Galvanic Mechamorph symbiote- or rather, a juvenile Galvanic Mechamorph that vaguely resembles a dog-sized slug entirely comprised of nanites. As a Galvanic Mechamorph, Ship is freely able to enter and upgrade any and all technology, and can even absorb and copy just about anything it has already fused with. There is very little that a Galvanic Mechamorph cannot fuse with, should it be technological in scope. Ship is very friendly, and acts almost entirely like a dog- though with the right command, it can and will enter its combat mode and rain hell upon your enemies. He's not particularly durable, though...

A First Era Sapphire and one of the most powerful seers of the Gem Empire. She is calm, cool, compassionate, and patient, and is incredibly quick to come up with plans. She can see the future with incredible clarity, allowing her to view the results of events long before they happen and thus appears to come across as cold and disillusioned. She also has powerful cryokinesis, the ability to float, and as a gem she naturally has physical capabilities that go far beyond the limits of humanity due to being a hardlight construct.

An aquatic, nymph-like Digimon said to cure all kinds of illnesses and wounds. She is capable of prophesizing calamities and plagues, and is highly compassionate even towards her enemies- refraining from causing excessive harm no matter what and usually capturing her enemies. She also conjures large shells to help protect young aquatic digimon. She must stay near the water or else she dries up.

The Empress of Light's blade. While it will work as a normal sword, it's true power comes from charging it with energy. This will summon an iridescent sword that floats at your back like a wing and automatically attacks your enemies- phasing through any obstacle in order to do so. Up to seven blades may be summoned, though each is harder than the last to bring out. They may be dismissed at will.

A Rare Blade with the element of Wind. She's obsessed with strength and fighting powerful opponents, but treats it as a form of training to make herself better. As a Blade, she can share a portion of her abilities with her Driver (wielder), though she requires her Driver's energy in order to use said abilities. The stronger the wielder and their bond, the stronger she gets.

A powerful Dullahan and one of the Devil King's generals. He is serious and prideful, well versed in inspiring fear in the masses. He doesn't like fighting weaklings, has a slight bit of honor remaining, likes animals, will strike women in combat, and is also a huge pervert. He posseses necromantic abilities, summoning undead knights to fight and can also curse others with ease. His armor resists holy magic and his undead body possesses great strength, but he is extremely weak to running water.

A absolutely massive anchor blessed by a princess. While it takes great strength to move and is completely incapable of hitting a critical it's weight ensures every blow jars an opponent, potentially making them stop what they were trying to do, and even if it doesn't it'll hit very hard. Call upon the blessing to unleash the power of Crushing Depths- forcing every opponent to feel the fear of the darkest depths of the sea and be crushed under it's weight.
A crooked staff carved from the bones of a great demon. It drink greedily of magic- everything cast from it takes twice the amount of energy, but is twice as powerful in exchange.

One of the spears possessed by Diarmuid. Gae Dearg serves to bypass and ignore any form of magical phenomena. Barriers are ignored, familiar bonds pause, and enhancements are made useless. This doesn't dispell it, though any active connection, channeled ability, or similar thing will be completely stopped. More emplaced protections will remain once the spear has been removed. This is a passive ability- it is always active and cannot be stopped.

The goo of the greatest of slimes. Consuming this grants you an increase in speed and ensures any liquid healing substance you consume fully clears all temporary negative effects from your person. Further- after having consumed such a potion the healing effect circulates for longer than it should, granting you continual regeneration based on the healing the substance is capable of. Goo from slimes will trigger this effect, and no matter what sort of slime will give you no negative effects. Slimes in the wild are initially neutral toward you.

A book bound to your soul, made from your own magics. It contains the full breadth of the Fire Magic attribute within its pages, but you must study and put effort into unlocking each spell and scrap of knowledge- anything you have not unlocked appears as blank pages. Also, it passively boosts your magical ability and learning rate. Just don't fall into despair, or demons may corrupt your book and therefore your soul.

A playing card depicting a woman breathing outward. When used it will completely cure the user of all ailments, injuries, diseases, and basically everything else that affects the body. Including low to mid level curses or other magical effects.

A flowing blue cloak. Terrible for handling the cold, but makes moving a breeze. Quite literally, anyone wearing this has floating jumps and significantly increased movement, especially over short distances.

Your Tokens are now physical objects, if they weren't already. They may be traded or given away, but not stolen, allowing whoever has them that roll on the gacha. Should you wish to, you may take out a token and flip it. If it lands on heads it becomes a token of the next level. On tails it disappears. Nothing may alter, assure, or otherwise affect the flipped coin- the chance will always be 50/50.

Don't tell Miyazaki. You are now the proud owner of a massive incredibly poisonous swamp and all the Hydra that live in it. They are massive, overwhleming creatures with multiple heads and a poisonous bite. They'll listen to you, as owner of their pond.

A sweetass fully built laptop with all the best stuff and loaded with all the information you could ever need. Just set it on a task and it'll have an answer in ten minutes or less. Though do be sure to be clear- it's still a computer.

A large completely automated factory capable of making droids. While it is currently set up to create the generic B1 Battle Droids, but can be altered to make other droid types. Droids that were created during the Clone Wars, such as Droidekas, B2 Battle Droids, and similar have their molds and specifications already within the computer. Any other droid type will require programming them in, but there is no limit to what may be produced. Somehow this facility always has enough resources to produce more droids, but at a much slower rate than it could if given material.

A Sacred Gear nestled into your soul. Twilight Healing grants incredible healing abilities, instantly able to repair serious injuries on a single person. With training the range can extend to heal multiple people at once or even fire arrows of healing to heal at extreme ranges. When in use it takes the form of two silvers rings, one on the ring finger of each hand. With luck, it can be further enhanced to achieve Balance Breaker- allowing the user to suffuse people with healing barriers.

A powerful high-tech revolver with a green interface. It comes with the ability to spawn up to four coins at a time, with a respawn timer of four seconds per coin. Hitting a midair coin with a shot from any supersonic ammunition will cause the shot to ricochet into the nearest enemy within 100 meters, striking a weakspot for massively amplified damage. Tossing multiple coins at once will cause the shot to chain between coins for even more damage, though the timing is precise. Each coin will lose the ability to deflect shots upon hitting a surface, but can be reactivated if struck into the air with any parry ability.

A single check good for one small favour* from whoever you give this to. The check is destroyed after use. (*favor may not necessarily be small and may involve conspiracies, organized crime, world ending plots, copious amounts of drugs and alcohol, several more steps than strictly necessary, and nobody being able to get their own damn supplies)

A fumo of a certain enigmatic gap yokai. Shake it forcefully to open a portal connecting you from your current location to any location you've been before in your local reality. Only makes one portal at a time.

Return to sender! A fancy looking hand mirror, about the size of a tennis racket, that reflects any magical attack the strikes it. The struck magic flies back according to how it struck the mirror, so you'd better have some good aim.

An ornately decorated indestructible tarot-style card that can absorb the essence of any of your Familiars, and allow anyone else to "install" that essence into themselves, granting them the abilities and some of the physicality and personality of the Familiar in question. The card resets to blank once the essence within is used up, at which point it must be recharged. Additionally, by spending a token of the same rank as what was used to acquire the Familiar Card, you may permanently imbue the essence of a random Gacha B-rank Familiar into the Familiar Card, at which point the card can no longer reset.
A single glowing gold seed. When planted and properly tended to it will grow into a golden apple tree, producing golden apples so long as it is healthy.

A ten ton, sealed and insulated crate of Element Zero- a highly reactive material created when solid objects are affected by the energy of a supernova. When electrically stimulated, Element Zero (aka Eezo) creates dark energy that can be manipulated into a mass effect field, allowing the user to raise or lower the mass of anything within that field. It can be used in weapons to accelerate grains of metal dust to near lightspeed, fling ships across the galaxy, or even be used in biotics to effectively grant superpowers to those implanted with Element Zero. It isn't actually an element, funnily enough. Who could have guessed.

A completely innocuous and absolutely not madness inducing fumo of Alice, the dear little girl. Shaking it allows you to redo your most recently made decision, placing you back to the moment you made it. Be careful- things may not be quite the same anymore. Use at your own risk.

A blue kite shield depicting the Triforce and Hylian Crest. It is made of metal and exceptionally durable, being able to take near any attack without breaking. It can even be used to deflect magic attacks, sending them back at the caster when blocked.

You're an expert at teaching others, the kind of teacher that could allow even the dumbest idiot in the world to master high level concepts within a month of effort. You can teach just about anyone anything, from math to science to art to combat. As long as you know your own source material, of course.

You may not be a legendary hero when it comes to polearm wielding... but you're the next best thing. Any mundane grandmaster of the art would fall before you, and you can use any polearm like it's part of your own body.

You are a person of focus. Committment. And sheer fucking will. Injuries no longer stop you, lethal wounds are ignorable, even the most godawful, difficult, violent, boring, dangerous, treacherous, or otherwise stressful situations are something you can force yourself through if you just buckle down and do it. Psychics and mind controllers have a very hard time doing anything to you.

Your ability to understand that which lies beyond the veil of reality and into the arcane and mystical is second to none for a mortal. You learn magic more easily, and esoteric concepts are far easier to picture and intuit. Might confer some eldritch madness.

The art of supreme control of nerve and muscles, allowing you to bend joints that otherwise rely on the motion of others, ignore intense pain at will, contort in near impossible ways, and add excessive amounts of force to ordinary strikes. To utilize Prana Bindu is to know that the action your mind imagines has already been completed, and allow you to do so even if it otherwise seems impossible.

You're really, really damn good at persuading people to do stuff- even the things they don't want to do. Dangerous things, illegal things, things that might just inconvenience someone really badly... a dangerous power if left unchecked. You could probably say whatever you want on TV and still get elected the leader of a nation.

WAHAHAHAA! Fire gathers around you! Fire abilities are stronger, its easier to set fires, easier to set things on fire, fire tends to act in a way not to hurt you if possible, and you're about as resistant to fire as if you were wearing a pretty good fire resistant suit.

Hmm... Knowledge based abilities work better. Its easier to remember just the thing you need, you can skip one step more in your logic than usual, and tech trees reveal themselves faster and with less investment.

You know exactly how the body works and how to alter it. While this knowledge doesn't grant you the ability to shapeshift, anything which allows you to alter your form or the forms of others comes exceptionally naturally to you. This also unlocks shapeshifting beyond what the ability may say it can do, enabling you to use whatever you have to the absolute best.

For some reason, everybody thinks they couldn't do it without you. While this doesn't prevent you getting fired for egregious errors, stopping work, or other grand acts, management will be convinced that whatever you do, in the way you do it, is in some way heavily responsible for things to keep running smoothly. Rules will be easily bent, and simple problems will be overlooked.

You gain access to Magic Circuits- the pseudo nervous system of the soul that converts life force into magical energy and grants the ability to perform magecraft. Magecraft is formulaic and almost program-like in its execution, but has an incredibly broad range of effects as a result. You start with a completely average number of 20 Magic Circuits of average quality. Every duplicate of this item doubles your Magic Circuit quantity and quality. You may also gain more by acquiring explicitly magical Passives, though it will be at a much slower pace.

Body and weapons as one. Whatever weapon you're holding benefits from your own stats, and you benefit from its stats. This only lasts as long as you are holding the item, but with this a simple iron longsword could break the heavens themselves provided you're that strong yourself.

The Black Goat with a Thousand Young has blessed you. You come off as maternal in nearly all situations, any pregnancy you have or cause will be easy and produce a healthy powerful child, and anyone without a mother is unusually drawn to you. Anyone that identifies themselves as your child you know the exact location of at all times. Should someone identify as your child, but not be your actual blood, you may adopt them through a ritual you are aware of, granting them a power you know and officially changing their body to be your actual child.

Qualification? Eh, You've got it. Anything which requires any form of qualification acknowledges you as having met the requirement. Door that only opens for a specific bloodline? Yeah, you got it. Blood sealed passage? Easy. Fingerprint scanning gun? You're in the system.

You have been blessed by the goddess Amaterasu, supreme ruler of the universe and goddess of the sun. She gifts upon you dominion of Sunlight, increasing your resistance to all curses and dark based effects while also increasing your ability to cast and empower light, life, and fire related effects. You gain increased skill and power with item and territory creation, and your progeny will naturally be inclined towards godhood.

Oh. Oh boy. Fate has rewitten and now you've got your very own hentai going. Expect to come across all manner of erotic images, lustful women (and men if you like), and basically every sex set up known to man. Somehow, no matter what happens, you always come out on top. Or bottom, if you're into that. Point is- it doesn't matter if you accidentally open the door while the girls are changing, stumble into that hot MILF who makes you feel her up, or anything else. You'll never face any meaningful backlash or problems.

Somehow, everybody just likes you. Even people you've personally done wrong understand that sometimes things just happen that way. While nobody is instantly friends with you, they'll never truly hate you and you are always capable of improving the relationship

Army? Alright, who's first? The more enemies you face, the more powerful you become. Just a few guys isn't going to be much of a boost, but there isn't any upper limit to how powerful you can get. Just be aware that as the enemies dwindle, so does your power.

Well look at that, you have a handy connection to the Omni Gacha itself. The primodial chaos from before all time (and nobody can prove otherwise) now obeys your command. A little. Mostly because it happens to really like biomancy. This connection changes your body in various ways, but mainly just makes you seem like a tasty snack for anything that happens to like eating souls. Fortunately, you can manipulate biology in a vast multitude of ways. It's even psychic, so ignores anti-magic and the like.

You are an advanced model of android with built in augments for combat and general use. While you can no longer recover energy by resting naturally, you can charge yourself by consuming fuel in any form, or by plugging into a wall outlet. In addition, your mind works better due to being entirely digitized and you have an easier time progressing through any Tech Tree you happen to earn. Should you wish, you may also improve your body once you have access to an appropriate workshop and the right tools and materials.

You've got life! Or at least you're quite full of it. Mundane diseases or illnesses will never touch you, healing is faster and with less complications, and you're going to set the new age record for whatever species you are.

Speak an old sinner's name. Any time anyone speaks your name while intending to speak of you, you suddenly know their exact location. To a sufficient level to teleport, cast spells that can target a location or person without needing to be near them, identify the place on a map, or provide GPS coordinates.

Heavy is the crown. Those under you are far more loyal and giving, even willing to throw themselves into certain death if you call for it, but in turn they shall demand stability and plenty. Rule what you control well and there shall never be a group of more loyal companions, rule poorly and someone is going to invent the guillotine.

Diseases, poisons, and all things vile now improve your immune system- as long as you can survive them. The stronger, more exotic, or otherwise lethal the affliction, the stronger you wind up afterwards- with enough practice, you'll become well and truly immune, without any of the nasty side effects that some of those poisons or diseases would have afflicted you with.

You're a natural warlock- one who takes patronage from any manner of higher beings in return for great and often terrible powers. You have an advanced ability to make deals that work out in your favor, even with higher beings, and can often bargain out of the truly awful recompense in favor of something far less likely to cost your soul. You additionally gain affinity for dark, unholy, demonic, eldritch, or generally considered "evil" spells, magics, and effects.

You are a Dread Knight, a high level undead with enhanced melee and martial combat capabilities. You have enhanced strength, unlimited stamina, and the ability to feed on the life energies of your foes. You may charge your weapons with necromantic energies and have enhanced affinity with all necromantic, dark, and direct martial combat abilities and effects. You also have a natural set of armor created of dark energies to shield you from the sun and most physical attacks. You are, sadly, weak to holy and light based effects, and being caught out in direct sunlight will weaken you without your armor on.

You are a Roc, a legendary bird of prey capable of lifting and killing elephants with ease. You can shift between forms at will, and gain access to massive strength, high flight speed, razor sharp claws, and a physicality that no ordinary human could damage with sword or spear. You're also roughly five stories tall, with a wingspan more than twice that. Additionally, your nature as a Roc grants you a high affinity with wind based effects and magics.

You may sacrifice your own unspent tokens in order to grant copies of any one of your rolls to a person of your choice. Each level of token covers the three ranks of items that token may be rolled for- a One-Star token can copy anything from ranks F-D, a Two-Star anything from E-C, so on and so forth. To grant someone a duplicate of your roll, simply take the appropriate rank of token and place it against their body as if putting a coin into a coin slot while focusing on the item in question. You may not use this for any physical objects, though. At that point just give them the object directly, as long as it is capable of being gifted.

Your fists are strong as mythril, and might actually be made of the stuff. All of your strikes hit much, much harder and any B-rank or lower effects involving your fists are enhanced three times over.

You have aerokinesis, granting you mastery over the wind and air around you, and indirectly all of the effects associated with the air- tornadoes, flight, wind blades, vacuum blades, pressure differentials, sandstorms, lightning, so on and so forth.

You have ferrokinesis, granting you mastery over all of the iron and iron derived substances around you. You're basically budget Magneto, just without the actual magnetism. Make blades, bullets, platforms, armor, spikes, so on and so forth.

Create pure, utterly perfect gems and crystals with your energy alone. The resultant crystals can be used for just about anything requiring high quality crystals- lasers, magic spells, jewelry, crystal healing, looking good on a shelf, so on and so forth. The higher quality the crystal, the more energy you need to expend. Yes, you can launch them, but it's kind of a waste to just throw away a priceless ruby as a bullet now isn't it?

You've grown a pair of large, hawk-like wings made almost entirely of hundreds of feathers that match your personal color aesthetic. Each feather can be controlled independently with extreme precision and speed, allowing you to use them like a rain of blades, pick up other people, fly at high speeds, slice through buildings, so on and so forth. Though if you run out of feathers you'll be kinda useless until you regather or regrow them all. If your wing stumps get burned, you may lose the ability to regrow your feathers entirely. While the feathers are extremely strong and sharp, they're still vulnerable to heat and other things that damage feathers.

Twist, distort, and warp the space at your fingertips to deal massive damage. With training, you may be able to create projectile distortions, beams, or even long ranged ripples in space akin to a massive space cutting blade.

You have the ability to sprout all manner of hooks, blades, and other sharp pointy metal bits from and inside of your body at will, and with great quantity. Each steel blade you create can be mostly independently controlled, and should you produce enough blades your entire human body becomes compacted into a fleshy basketball sized core inside of what's effectively an amorphous mecha made entirely of knives and hooks. You may shape your blade form to your whims, and form tentacles, claws, and even large animal forms with enough training. You're still vulnerable to magnets, rust, and anything that can manipulate steel, though.

The most generic form of telepathy in existence- no frills, no conditions, you can exchange thoughts with other people at will, either reading surface thoughts on a skim, or enabling a telepathic conversation. The more people you connect to or communicate with via telepathy, the more it strains your mind. You may also dive deeper into someone's mind or extend the range of your telepathy with some training.

Hunt them down. You've got a suite of abilities focused on finding and running down a target. Activating this increases strength, speed, and vastly increases senses. Additionally, you may lock on to a single target, allowing you to track them easily, use x-ray vision to see through things, and with training even transform your body to aid in your hunt.

Spend energy to increase any given Ability's power by a whole rank. The targeted Ability must be at A-rank or below. The stronger the ability, the more energy it takes to enable and maintain the boost. After the boost is canceled, the targeted Ability drops one rank below its base in power until you rest and regain your lost stamina.

Touch any target to copy one of their A-rank or below abilities with exact power and skill for the span of an hour. You may replace the copied ability at any time during that hour, but subsequent replacements do not reset the timer. After 1 hour, the mirrored ability fades and Mirroring Touch goes on a 1 hour cooldown period.

Thunder! You may transform either fully or partirally into a Kirin at will. A Kirin is an exceptionally large scaled horse with a large horn capable of emitting electricity. It uses this to surround itself with electricity as a defense mechanism and to send out blasts of lightning to attack.

Grant anyone you choose a lesser version of one of your own Abilities. The greater the difference in strength, the weaker the ability becomes to suit their body without breaking it. Each Ability can only be granted to one person at a time, and will remain locked off from your use until you retrieve your Granted ability.

Grants a form similar to a werewolf, a Loboan is a wolf humanoid Alien from the moon Luna Lobo, orbiting the planet Anur Transyl. They have jaws that can split into four seperate hinges, and are able to use sonic attacks and their own natural physicality to overpower their enemies. A loboan can survive in Lava, and has a durability level approaching bullet proof. This form also grants an enhanced sense of smell, and powerful reflexes. It'll probably make you popular with furries, and ladies.

Design, build, and modify any and all technology and constructs related to metals, alloys, and the processes of metallurgy- fabricators, ore purifiers, superconductor vats, so on and so forth. Can also be extended to weapons and armor as well, with some difficulty.

Design, build, and modify any and all technology and constructs related to fortifications. Self repairing walls, hidden turrets, proximity mines, missile batteries, laser cannons, spatial locks, so on and so forth. The only caveat is that it must be attached to a fortifiable structure- usually a building, but a case can be made for any enclosed structure including vehicles... with some difficulty.

A piece of the Authority of Sloth. You may generate and manipulate invisible hands from your body. They're strong, getting stronger the more magically powerful you are, and capable of doing anything a hand could do. They may also merge to form larger hands with greater strength. Only seven may be made at first, but training allows up to hundreds of small hands to be generate at once.

Create and expel a weak poison from any desired body part. While active, any poison you consume and survive will contribute to the strength of your own poison, and allow you to imbue their effects into your emanations. You also gain increased poison resistance while this ability is active. The poison you expel starts as a mild numbing agent and can scale up high enough to even kill gods at its most potent.

Allows you to summon Demons from the Underworld to serve under you and obey your commands, such as Demons, Succubi/Incubi, Taurus Demons, etc. As long as the Demon Servant you summon is equal to or weaker in power than an Rare Familiar. The demon servant you summon is bound to your will for as long as they are manifested in this world. And you need to constantly supply them with your energy to keep them summoned and allow them to use their abilities. If a summoned Demon Servant is killed, you can still choose to resummon the exact same ones, as they will reform back in the Underworld. You can further strengthen your demon servants by supplying them with more Magic. You can also summon them to the material realm permanently by performing a sufficient blood sacrifice according to the demons' tier; for an Elite Demon, the sacrifice of an Elite Target must be made. Permanent demons no longer need your energy to stay manifested.

Allows you to convert your blood into temporary gold coins that when struck by a sufficiently fast projectile, redirects the projectile to the weakspot of the nearest enemy, or simply at the enemy if it isn't reachable.

Midir, Descendant of Archdragons, was raised by the Gods of Anor Londo and put to work facing the Dark encroaching over the world. Over time he has become corrupted by it, losing his immortal scales, but is still a force to be reckoned with, with flame, powerful lasers, and the dark itself being his weapons. Perhaps he could be purified, and returned to complete lucidity, but until such a time he will still loyally follow commands.

A Pillar Man, Kars is a man that stands head and shoulders above normal humans even before factoring in his intelligence. Dangerous, sadistic, and downright monstrous, you can command his loyalty, but not his spirit. Should he find you wanting, he will try to remove you. The creator of Stone Masks, and Vampires themselves, he has pushed to find the complete potential of his body, striving to become an Ultimate Lifeform. But he is not there yet. Even without it, his biology is more than enough that simply brushing past someone could shear them to the bone.

A golem crafted in the image of one of Regigigas' dead brothers, Regice is a powerful though simple Pokemon, able to use ice to grow larger. Without much difficulty, it could become truly titanic if exposed to ice. Its own powers are varied, though predominantly it uses Ice. If it should 'die', it can be repaired with more ice.

Dromarch is a Blade- an artificial being that emanates from a Core Crystal and attaches to a single person, his Driver. He grants his Driver dual chakram and is aligned to elemental Water, allowing him to assist in healing, removing debuffs, and in attacking with cutting streams of water. His form is that of a white tiger, large enough to be ridden, and is capable of acting on his own. He is rather wise and respectful, refering to his Driver as "my lord" or "my lady" as appropriate. If killed he returns to his Core Crystal and may be brought out again later, though without any memory of his previous incarnation.

A Fanged Beast that resembles a gorilla, albeit one covered in heavy stone plating. This creature emits a sap from it's body that encourages plant growth, enabling a number of plants to take root and suvive on top of the stone that forms it's skin. In combat, this sap can harden to protect it's body or create clumped together dirt to act as shields or weapons. When enraged it constantly gets stronger until it's rage is sated and it starts every fight by covering it's arms with heavy clumps of dirt and stone- one drips magma and the other drips water.

Draedon's flying chair, used to cross great distances without issue in the man's workshop, is now yours to use. It is incredibly fast, able to fly up to the atmosphere in seconds, and across the world in less than minutes. Use it well.

An ornate, antique pocket watch containing three jewels studded into the face. By pressing the specialized button on the side, you may rewind time to the moment that you woke up that day, at the cost of one of the jewels going dark. Once all three jewels darken, the watch becomes nothing more than an ordinary watch, only good for telling time. To refill the device's charges requires a high level mastery of temporal magics and effects, plus the knowledge of a watchmaker to accurately take apart and repair the device's internals.

An exceptionally fancy wide brim hat. Wearing it nullifies sea-sickness, makes loading and unloading boats go significantly more smoothly, makes it easier to understand weather conditions, and generally enables you to be an extremely effective admiral of a fleet. Fleet not included.

A wooden cauldron that looks almost slapped together and plays host to a number of unidentifiable runes, apparati, and other instruments. Every day this well fills with enough liquid magic to entirely refill your reserves to full. Simply sticking a part of yourself in will absorb the magic. While the magic cannot be taken out of the well normally, it is possible to distill it with some research.

A heavy tome that is oddly hot to the touch. It contains the secrets of Fire Magic, and allows casting of such without any form of education, though the proper magical power must still be supplied. This brand of fire magic is focused on empowering your allies, hindering your enemies, placing down walls and traps of fire, and exploding the ever loving fuck out of things. Also summoning Fire Elementals.

An erie large whirlpool. Entering this will allow a group to travel to any destination in a connected body of water in a whirlpool at the cost of some of their number being consumed by the many creatures within it. As the owner, you and your allies are immune to the cost... just be aware that the creatures that live within the pool can get hungry if they aren't fed enough. Letting them stay hungry means they may decide to hunt on their own, and who knows where they'll show up.

The holy book of the Dragon Cult, formed when Godfrey the Golden defeated and befriended Lichdragon Fortissax. It teaches the secrets to the dragon's lightning, and further the red Ancient Lightning. Electrify your weapons, throw lances of lightning, and empower yourself and your allies by calling down bolts of lightning.

A tome containing every single spell of the Alteration magic school found in Tamriel, though its initial pages only cover what can be found in Skyrim proper. The knowledge in its pages may be taught to anyone who reads the information inside. No, you cannot eat it to learn spells.

The ancient blade of the Warrior Kings. Sento is an exceptionally well crafted katana that grants it's user telekinetic abilities and extrasensory perception. The spirits of the family maintain their hold on the blade and may possess the user or be summoned to fight alongside them for a short period of time.
You're damn good at item construction, and can create and modify a fair amount of enchanted or otherwise magical items on the fly based on your pre-existing magical talents.

You're one hell of a mathematician. Even some of the most complex mathematical formulas available in colleges can be easily solved with only a few seconds of thought, and you can do any amount of simpler calculations in your mind almost instantaneously- you're almost a computer by this point.

You're a master of any and all bladed weapons, a savant to the point that onlookers would tell tales of how you could slay a hundred men with but a single dagger. You could start a school if you wanted to, or a sect.

In any normal circumstance you might be considered the best doctor in the world- your skill at surgeries is second to none, and your knowledge of any and all medical procedures and diagnostics is equally as effective. Your medicinal skills allow you to create treatments that firmly land in the supernatural level of efficacy, and there's seldom a patient you can't treat- even the recently dead are yours to heal.

You're the expert aura farmer. Your moves are sick and stylish, you move through the world as if it bows at your feet, and all of your efforts come off as nearly effortless- your agility is second to none, your finesse equal in measure.

Any and all mundane weapons are yours to wield with fair amounts of ease- blades, blunt weapons, polearms, bows, crossbows, guns, shields, maces, whips- you're not a grandmaster at any of them, but you could beat just about any other practitioner of any given weapon in a fight. You're straight up John Wick-ing it.

A mutation that allows you to experience 'YOLO' without the consequences. It will revive you a single time on the event of your death, no matter what has killed you. Afterward, it cannot be used again without collecting it another time.

Your arcane connection to all things mystical is potent and deep, your reserves are immense and your potency multiplied exponentially. You gain the ability to overload spells to far greater power levels without suffering much, if any, backlash.

Your soul is immortal, if only just. As long as you have enough power to sustain your existence, your soul can never be killed. Harmed, severed, shattered, or reduced to a fraction of its former strength, sure... but as long as you have the power and will to keep living, your soul will never die.

The forth rank of Dead Apostle. At this point, the human is now a fledgeling vampire, still nearly half-human. A Nightkin is constantly cold and thirsty, and the sunlight gives them symptoms of anemia, but equally exceptionally powerful by normal standards. With time and blood, one may ascend to further ranks, growing farther from humanity but manifesting unique powers and growing stronger.

Well look at that, you have a handy connection to the Omni Gacha itself. The primodial chaos from before all time (and nobody can prove otherwise) now obeys your command. A little. Mostly because it happens to really like breaking shit. This connection changes your body in various ways, but mainly just makes you seem like a tasty snack for anything that happens to like eating souls. Fortunately, you can use telekinesis to crush your enemies, see them driven before you, and hear the lamentations of their women. It's even psychic, so ignores anti-magic and the like.

You are a high ranking demon- a Fiend with exceptional physical and magical strength. You have powerful affinities towards all things unholy, dark, infernal, and fiery, and have natural command over the flames of hell. However, you remain weak to all effects holy, divine, light, and related to exorcisms.

You have the gift of Nyarlathotep, granting you increased abilities and affinity with all things stealth related and deceptive. You become better at deception, obscuring things, acting, and inciting chaos via propaganda and whispers. You also become far better at shapeshifting and creating avatars with which to deal with lesser beings.

Your genes are highly variable and partially unstable, allowing you to turn Race changes on and off at will, dialing certain traits back and bringing others to the fore, and allowing you to hybridize forms with ease.

Summon or create Greater Earth Elementals such as diamond golems, magma elementals, living mountains, etc. Each one can use A rank or lower earth-based magic or effects. The power of the elementals depends on your own expertise and power. The conjured Elementals will vanish if you stop supplying them with energy, though with practice you can form elementals with set durations or even permanent summons. Summoned elementals are not considered Familiars.

Fuse with the earth to create a kaiju of rock, stone, or other things native to the earth around yourself. The armor may look like whatever you wish, but takes a lot of energy to form. Your body is the same underneath the armor, so a single piercing hit may be capable of killing you.

Conjure and manipulate virtual black holes- constructs that look and act similar to real black holes but are... a bit less dangerous. With enough training you could generate a real black hole and make it everyone's problem, with all the radiation and plasma and spaghettification that implies.

Grand sword of light stab down between any combatants you can see, including yourself. These swords reveal all- rendering any hidden foes fully visible- and prevent any further conflict for exactly ten minutes. Only you know the exact time they swords effect ceases, enabling you to have the first move.

A Kakuja is a full body covering of RC Cells capable of protecting the wearer and improving their abilities. It may appear as anything, but generally defaults to a red covering without any specific plates or gaps. Your Kakuja is perfectly suited to assisting you in combat in the way you desire- if you're a frontliner it will harden into plates and increase physical power more than usual, but if you enjoy casting or long range if could strike out as whips, large blades, or provide openings to breathe fire or similar.

Concentrate on a target energy signature and instantly teleport yourself within a short range of them. Any energy signature that is unique to an individual can be targeted, including ki, qi, chi, magic, chakra, aura, and others.
