While the teleport is instant, it takes a moment's focus to perform- usually with the aid of placing the index and middle finger to the forehead though training and concentration may make this redundant. This has no distance limit- it is only limited by your ability to sense energy.

A technique that may only be used when attacked. On the instant the enemy performs an attack create a reflective barrier which absorbs their attack and sends that power back manyfold against anyone intending the harm you at that moment. Enemies may dodge the attack by being focused on something other than attacking you at that moment.

Special Eyes! Your eyes now see through illusions and spot falsehoods. You can tell when someone is lying, as well as which of their words are a lie. The same is true of illusions- you may tell what is an illusion as well as what is under it.

Upon making eye contact with a person, or focusing on an unconcious or sleeping individual, you may hijack or ride along in their body. You see and feel everything they do, and you may either allow them to be fully aware of what is happening, supress their mind into an unthinking state, or render them fully unconciouss. They will remember everything done unless they are rendered unconcious. If you simply 'ride along' they will be unaware of you doing so. Particularly willful individuals may resist this or even throw you out of their mind.

SPEED. You may warp space around yourself and any vehicle you're in to ignore conventional acceleration and speed limits. Given enough time to charge up, or enough space to move, you can reach faster than light speeds. Though at the start it merely allows you to go very, very fast. Unfortunately, this doesn't come with any extra reflexes or inertia negation. You're good enough not to paste yourself against a wall, but you're not going to be turning very fast and stopping takes a bit of distance.

Create a space around you in which electronics and magic simply fail. Anyting more complex than a musket won't work with any consistency, failing in a convenient way as to render them inoperable. Exceptionally powerful, or exceptionally redundant systems, may still work, it isn't going to be anywhere near full power. There are no exclusions to this- everything you have is just as affected as everyone else's.

Truly heavenly boots. The Seraph Tracers are a pair of boots that provide immunity to damage from contacting hot liquids, such as lava, or minerals, immunity to being set on fire, the ability to walk on liquid, significantly increased ability to walk on ice, a speed boost when walking uninterrupted for several seconds, and the ability to manifest wings to fly with.

Any Ability or Skill you possess may be converted into a physical object you can use. You may bestow this object on another in a short ceremony, granting them the status of your knight and the ability to use, and improve, that Ability or Skill. These items may be taken back at any time through another short ceremony, still benefitting from all the improvements the knight gave them. You know where your knights are at all times, and they are inclined to listen to your orders, but are not required to. However, they may never knowingly use their granted ability to harm you or your interests.

With your Dying Will! Mist Flames have the ability of Construction. They can be used to generate illusions so real they effectively are real. Create grand scenes, falsify trails, or even replace organs with illusioned ones that act just as good as the real ones. Your Will determines how strong they are, and they must be utilized through a ring capable of withstanding their strength. Such a ring is provided when you roll this, though if it's lost its up to you to find another.

Just pop your soul out. This won't cause any problems whatsoever- Gacha guarantee! Seriously. You may now allow your soul to exit your body. This puts your body into a comatose state and allows you to wander around as, effectively, an extremely hard to detect ghost. Standard things to prevent ghosts won't work, but defenses specifically designed against astral intrusion will. While you are protected from possession during this, it only extends so far. Exceptionally powerful entities may possess you regardless, and it does nothing for more physical means of control, such as parasites or body puppeting.

Black Dragon of Calamity, Kalameet. Descendent of the Primordial Archdragons with obsidian scales born with a third eye that brings calamity. Kalameet is a malevolent dragon capable of minor telekinesis and resisting anything not sheer physical force. He isn't stupid, but don't expect him to like you or care much for following orders... so long as they don't involve destroying something.

A flirty fairy in green who is suprisingly knowledgeable. She is, in no way, actually a horrifically sadistic child of an elder god who wants nothing but chaos and terrible things. Isn't that right, gambler?

The Beast of the End, Puck is an artificial spirit who usually looks like a light grey cat. Rather happy-go-lucky and genial with those he likes, but hostile to those he doesn't know. He has amazing magical prowess, but is the absolute best at Fire Magic. However, he generally prefers to use his fire magic to create ice when attacking. Unfortunately, he has rather terrible mana efficiency, and will require a lot of outside mana to properly fight.

A solitary type of Grimm, the Wyvern was thought to be closer to a myth until it attacked Vale during the ill-fated Vytal Festival. As a Grimm, the wyvern can sense negative emotion, and this one is so powerful as to be able to spawn lesser Grimm from it's body by dripping Grimm sludge off itself. It is utterly massive, but often content with sleeping unless deliberately roused or it senses a citywide level of negative emotion. It will listen to you as if you were it's creator, but know it may make it's own plans and utterly hates life.

God of Dreams and Light. A Higher Being that created the Moth Tribe only to eventually be abandoned by them. The Radiance offers power and unity... at the cost of a mind incapable of thought. Initially she has a form only in dreams, but gaining followers will eventually allow her to manifest in reality. So long as you offer her followers and worship, she will have no problem assisting you, but beware- she is a jealous god and one who abhors the Void.

A Sacred Gear focused around the creation of swords- specifically, demonic swords. Any blade created will innately have an infernal aura, and may also be imbued with a variety of effects from consuming light, to projecting flames, to even projecting the pure concept of destruction. The user may even spawn blades from any surface within their range at will, at varying sizes, shapes, and attributes. Created swords depend on the user's will, power, and concentration to maintain their structure, and will break if they lose focus. When first acquired, takes the form of a small orb granting the Gear to whomever swallows it.

A large spike of rock atop which is a pool of water over which hovers a ring of fire above which is a ring of air. The Elemental Conflux is a meeting point of Air, Fire, Earth, and Water elementals, allowing each to be created from the energies it produces. These elementals are powerful users of their element, and may look like anything you desire.

A book bound to your soul, made from your own magics. It contains the full breadth of the Lightning Magic attribute within its pages, but you must study and put effort into unlocking each spell and scrap of knowledge- anything you have not unlocked appears as blank pages. Also, it passively boosts your magical ability and learning rate. Just don't fall into despair, or demons may corrupt your book and therefore your soul.

A collectible playing card featuring Wolverine. Pressing it against someone's chest allows you to grant them the regenerative powers of Wolverine for a short while. The card get progressively more damage each used, but naturally restores itself over time. At base you get about three uses a month, but investing in card repair can increase this.

A high tech chip developed to grant the powers of a vampire to anyone implanted with it. Those implanted gain access to greater strength, speed, regnerative ability, and may display a special supernatural power. However, they are weaker than a true vampire and still must drink blood to keep their existence stable. Removing the chip does not reverse this process.

Forged to be the peer of Mjolnir, the Leviathan Axe contains the screams of twenty frost trolls... more or less. It is a heavy weapon that remains permanently sharp and can manipulate ice along itself to lend greater strength and weight to it's blows. When thrown the axe may be telekinetically called back to the hand.

Tear this voucher while thinking of a person you've wronged to make them forgive you for what you did. The more severe the act, the less likely they are to forgive you, especially if they feel extremely strongly about it. Works best on anyone who had a positive opinion of you prior to the action.

An old fashioned key that, when used in any space large enough to accommodate a door, grants you access to an extradimensional slaughterhouse with attached meat market. The meat market will supply you with any amount of meat on demand- though anything not native to Earth or otherwise magical may take some time to source. Should you send any living or previously living being into the slaughterhouse section of the realm, their meat will be added to the offerings on display in endless quantity. You may also wander the endless facilities of the slaughterhouse... if you want to... for some reason... just don't get lost. Mind the safety paint.

A crystal key leading to a 100 cubic kilometer dimension that is entirely devoid of... anything but air and an invisible, indestructible floor. Should you wish, you may bring outside items in to customize the empty space to your liking, or just use it as a prison. The gateway outside is permanently open to you and your allies, and may be left at will.

A pair of gloves connected to a spindle of thread. The user of Cross Tail has extreme almost perfect telekinetic control of those threads through moving their hands, able to fashion the threads in spears, swords, axes, and shields or wrap it around themselves like armor or attach it to other things or lay it as an early warning system. These threads are supernaturally durable, but cannot emit more force than the human wielding them and are not naturally sharp. Provided another spindle, the thread may be swapped, but it takes a powerful thread to survive being used by this weapon.

An ornate ring with a blue gem. The wearer of this item can control any liquid around them with incredible precision, but cannot generate any liquid on it's own. It also cannot control the blood inside of someone's body.

A fumo of White Queen Node. When placed in an area, anything that requires a cooldown or otherwise needs time to become ready goes much faster. About five times faster in fact. Without harming the end product.
The Human Element! Make any vehicle you're driving purr, pulling out tricks it shouldn't logically be capable of and pushing it to the very limit... and just a bit beyond.

The Six Powers used primarily by Cipher Pol- deniable government agents. Soru, extreme speed across the ground, Geppo, the ability to kick off the air to fly, Shigan, granting the ability for a finger to hit as hard as a gun, Rankyaku, turning the leg into a blade, Tekkai, turning the body to iron, and Kami-e, granted immense flexibility. You are granted the knowledge of how to use each of the powers and how to combine them into the Rokuogan- a punch that sends shockwaves through the body of whoever is struck, bypassing all surface defenses.

Once a month, retroactively change reality such that you always happen to know a guy that can help with your current situation- car troubles, life troubles, magic troubles, anything really. You don't control who you get with the power, just that it focuses on pre-existing people that are not massively stronger than you first, and changes reality so you will have always known them well enough that they'll help you with your problems.

Every victory over someone else allows you to force the loser to grant you a reward proportional to the victory achieved. The closer or less important the victory, the smaller the reward, though should the victory be something grand and life shattering, you may ask for something equal to the value of their life or more.

Any ability, spell, or effect that generates constructs, matter, or objects is now far more efficient in expenditure, allowing you to almost literally make something out of nothing- not even your own energy.

The seamless merging of flesh and metal, the pinnacle of a bio-android. Your physical capabilities and energy reserves are augmented far beyond what's naturally possible, and your body will heal and repair itself automatically. Any and all technology related abilities and skills are boosted massively, and you gain the ability to interface with machines with ease.

RADIATION! Your body now accepts any form of radiation into itself and can use it to fuel improvement. This takes the form of healing yourself, improving strength, speed, and endurance, and making slow bodily alterations. The more radiation you intake, the more powerful you become. Special variants of radiation, such as Gamma Radiation, will always grant you their most beneficial effects and may improve things other than phsyical strength.
O. Generate and control Oxygen. The pure stuff. Yes, this means you can instantly make fires much worse. Along with everything else pure oxygen can do.

Your physical body is turned into that of a energy field. In this state you are effectively a collection of gasses which collectively form 'you' as a thinking entity. Physical force is mostly useless on you in this state, and you cannot generate much physical force, but anything which does not rely on your physical body still works. In this state you may cross over to the Void Dimension, a separate realm which underlies reality. You may look into the world from this place and exit it wherever you wish.

You have complete spatial awareness of everything within a 50 meter radius of your body, and can teleport freely up to 50 meters in any direction with complete impunity. Spamming teleports may induce vertigo, disorientation, and nausea.

Your soul breeds and absorbs curses into itself like no other. Any curse laid upon you gets assimilated over time and joins the seething negativity in your soul, allowing you to replicate or regurgitate it at will. The more powerful the curse, the more effort and time it takes to absorb. Sadly, does not apply to Omni Gacha curses.

Transform into, or become a hybrid of, a Caladrius- the white bird of healing. Whilst using its abilities, you gain slightly enhanced physicality and mobility, though your true strength is diagnosing illnesses on sight, and absorbing ailments into yourself via contact. Should you absorb an illness, you may also fly high into the sun's rays to purge it from your body. You also gain disease and curse resistance, and massively boosted holy and healing effects. Infernal and otherwise harmful abilities are likewise suppressed.

With your Dying Will! Storm Flames have the ability of Disintegration. Completely annihilate things! From things as a whole to just bits of things to even certain concepts within things. Your Will determines how strong they are, and they must be utilized through a ring capable of withstanding their strength. Such a ring is provided when you roll this, though if it's lost its up to you to find another.

Conjure, place, or launch energy fields that, when anything touches them, causes the moving object to slow down and come to a complete halt. Anything within the field of effect is slowed proportionally to how strong the target is in comparison to the user, and the amount of energy spent creating the field. The stronger the slowing effect, the more effort it takes to maintain.

A Sacred Gear focused around the creation of swords- specifically, holy swords. Any blade created will innately have an angelic aura, and may also be imbued with a variety of effects from consuming darkness, to projecting flames, to even projecting the pure concept of destruction. The user may even spawn blades from any surface within their range at will, at varying sizes, shapes, and attributes. Created swords depend on the user's will, power, and concentration to maintain their structure, and will break if they lose focus. When first acquired, takes the form of a small orb granting the Gear to whomever swallows it.

An infinitely renewing supply of high quality, extremely pure Dust. Upon first acquisition or upon restock, sign the shipping manifest on the lid with the type(s) of Dust you require, along with whether it comes in vials, crystals, or pre-integrated into weaponry or ammunition. Every restock contains 100kg of Dust.

An ornately decorated keycard that, when used in any space large enough to hold a set of double doors, opens a gateway to a pocket dimension containing an infinite, customizable space made entirely of apartments of varying sizes, shapes, and customization. Every apartment is fully stocked and furnished, and will replenish food and supplies daily. There's power, plumbing, wifi, a variety of other amenities found in high class apartments the world over, and room keys taped to each door. Upon entering, the gateway to the outside remains open for you and your allies, and the realm can be exited at will. Copies of the key may be handed out via the front desk in the foyer.

A hand sized pendant that allows for teleportation. When activated it makes an array on the ground and teleports anything within the array whever the user wishes. This array is normally centered on the user, but may be shifted to focus on others instead and be made smaller or larger. Teleporting using this device is hard on the body, especially when moving large distances, so rest between uses is often required. Though several short ranged teleports is possible without rest.

A gem socketed into a crown. When used this device will shine a light down and promptly shatter any magical equipment on anyone caught in the beam. Particularly powerful equipment may survive, though undoubtedly harmed and not fit for immediate use. The gem is destroyed in doing this, but regenerates over the course of a week.

Gain Journeyman level skill in every form of trade. This covers all trades within the current world you occupy but does not update if you find yourself in another world. Any job in which skill is aquired through apprenticeships, hands-on experience, or vocational training counts.

Any drawbacks faced from your abilities, spells, and effects are drastically reduced to almost not affect you at all. Your body also does not obey Newton's 3rd Law of Motion as much as it should, allowing you to put far more force into your attacks than you otherwise should be able to.

Well look at that, you have a handy connection to the Omni Gacha itself. The primodial chaos from before all time (and nobody can prove otherwise) now obeys your command. A little. Mostly because it happens to really like fucking with people. This connection changes your body in various ways, but mainly just makes you seem like a tasty snack for anything that happens to like eating souls. Fortunately, you can use telepathy to read, influence, control, manipulate, gaslight, and break other people's minds. It's even psychic, so ignores anti-magic and the like.

You hit. It doesn't matter what else is going on- you hit. Throw a nail into someones eye during a rainstorm across a packed football field. Fire a bullet into space and hit a guy a year later on a different planet. Anything you shoot, throw, toss, or any other verb related to sending a projectile toward a target hits exactly where you're aiming.

Somebody up there is pissed at you, specifically. No supernatural effect can touch you. Period. The results of those effects can, but if theres even a bit of magic or chakra or nen or cursed energy or anything but pure natural physics in something, you walk through it without even noticing. This extends to your clothes as well, though much degraded. Strong enough attacks will still harm those, even as you remain completely fine. Additionally- you can always increase your physical parameters. No matter how strong or fast, you can always go higher. This ability may be turned off, leaving the physical increases, though it takes a while to do so.

Androids are completely mechanical beings with the appearance of a human. They can be built to do anything a human can do and just as intelligent as a human. Or less. Or more. With this Tech Tree, it's all up to you. Create infiltrator units capable of seamlessly entering any building, assassination units that can kill anyone, an army of 'clones', or even android focused on... nightime activities. Creating androids, and anything required to build them, are included in this tree. It just might take a while if you have to pull the world a couple hundreds years into the future tech wise.

Upon touching someone you can begin to drain their luck. This isn't a fast process, but may be made faster with training and using more energy. The luck you gain is temporary and will eventually return to whoever you stole it from, but while you have it you'll have a surplus of good luck.

Summon or create Greater Fire Elementals such as inferno golems, sunfire elementals, living firestorms, etc. Each one can use A rank or lower fire-based magic or effects. The power of the elementals depends on your own expertise and power. The conjured Elementals will vanish if you stop supplying them with energy, though with practice you can form elementals with set durations or even permanent summons. Summoned elementals are not considered Familiars.

With your Dying Will! Sky Flames have the ability of Harmonization. While they do work as normal fire, they grant their user exceptionally powerful intution and the ability to create bonds that will never break. Using these flames in a team will ensure complete and total cohesion, enabling every member to support every other to their absolute best. Your Will determines how strong they are, and they must be utilized through a ring capable of withstanding their strength. Such a ring is provided when you roll this, though if it's lost its up to you to find another.

A gun that shoots laser beams! Roman Artillery: Pumpkin is a large gun that come with multiple different barrels and stocks to enable using it as a sniper, machine gun, or anti-material rifle. In it's latter form it may also be used as a rathe awkward sword. It requires no ammunition, but the power of it's shots grow in response to how much danger you're in. At base it's capable of killing a normal man without issue all the way up to massive lasers that can cleave great swathes of land. Though that second one risks breaking the weapon.

Well look at that, you have a handy connection to the Omni Gacha itself. The primodial chaos from before all time (and nobody can prove otherwise) now obeys your command. A little. Mostly because it happens to really like messing with fate. This connection changes your body in various ways, but mainly just makes you seem like a tasty snack for anything that happens to like eating souls. Fortunately, you can use divination to scout the future, read enemy intent, see possibilities beyond mortal ken, and seek out other living beings in your area. It's even psychic, so ignores anti-magic and the like.

Shift between four different forms that modify your appearance, stats, and general functionality. You have access to an attack, defense, recovery, and speed form, each one balanced around their particular attributes while lowering others. Attack form hits hard but has low defenses, Defense form tanks attacks but is slow and doesn't hit hard, Speed form is extremely fast but lacks attack and defense, and Recovery form allows for rapid healing and energy recovery at the cost of not being able to attack at all. You may also create your own forms with some practice.

Heal yourself and others at the cost of your material wealth. The equivalent of a dollar could repair scrapes and bruises, a hundred dollars could fix a broken arm, a king's ransom could cure even death. However- any monetary value gained via some kind of infinite money item does not count. It must be material that you have gained on your own terms, and it must have a meaning to lose that wealth. The more money you spend, the better the healing. Yes, you can use someone else's money if healing that person, if you want to pretend to be the United States healthcare system. You monster.

Temporarily enforce the concept of quantum tunneling on your body and anyone you wish to extend that effect to via touch. When active, you may pass through just about everything harmlessly- as if every subatomic particle in your body has perfectly aligned between the nanoscopic gaps in anything trying to touch you. Effectively just phasing, but even more untouchable because energy itself will pass through as well. With enough practice, you could even use it to teleport by quantum tunneling through spacetime itself.

Summon or create Greater Nature Spirits such as elder ents, forest elementals, living biomes, etc. Each one can use A rank or lower nature-based magic or effects. The power of the elementals depends on your own expertise and power. The conjured Elementals will vanish if you stop supplying them with energy, though with practice you can form elementals with set durations or even permanent summons. Summoned elementals are not considered Familiars.

With your Dying Will! These flames represent your personality and your determination and overall will! Also the desire not to die. It is separated into one of seven types, each with their own special ability and personality profile. You'll have to experiment to discover which one- either choose one or roll one in the gacha, but whoever rolled this is not aware of that choice until they uncover it.

Expend your own health, vitality, energy, or blood in order to store it as cash for the future. The longer this ability remains active, the more money you earn, at the cost of remaining sickly, weak, and otherwise unable to fight particularly well. You revert to normal upon deactivating this power. Banked health, energy, vitality, and blood is stored at a five to one ratio, meaning that a pint of blood will provide roughly five times its current real world market value to an account or holding vessel of your choice.

Infuse your voice with your abilities, allowing them to be cast instantly and without delay on anyone that hears your voice. Both abilities must be active at once in order to apply an effect to Diction. You could immolate enemies with your voice by activating Fire Manipulation, or drown them on dry land with Water Manipulation. The possibilities are almost endless.

Release and control a powerful acid from your body capable of melting both organic and inorganic materials alike. The more energy you put into it, the stronger the acid gets, until the point that even entire buildings are swept away in an instant.

Summon or create Greater Water/Ice Elementals such as iceberg golems, deep sea elementals, living whirlpools, etc. Each one can use A rank or lower water/ice-based magic or effects. The power of the elementals depends on your own expertise and power. The conjured Elementals will vanish if you stop supplying them with energy, though with practice you can form elementals with set durations or even permanent summons. Summoned elementals are not considered Familiars.

Create invisible barriers and forcefields that instantly reflect any and all kinetic energy that hits them. Any enemy that strikes a field will feel their strike with the exact strength they threw it with. The more energy you spend, the higher the energy threshold that the fields can handle before failing. With training, you may learn how to shape, reposition, and modify the fields for multiple purposes.

Design, build, and modify any and all technology related to medicines, drugs, and medicine as a practice. This includes treatments for any known disease, creating new treatments for uncurable diseases, finding out how to treat entirely new diseases, over the counter drugs, and medicinal street drugs.

Heal yourself and others by emitting an energy field that restores them to a prior healthy state. The more energy you spend, the larger and older the wounds you can heal without negatively affecting the target. If you overdraw too hard, you might accidentally start wiping memories- especially with head injuries. Be careful!

Design, build, and modify all technology and constructs related to the production, manipulation, and usage of various gels and viscous substances. Lubricants, engine grease, fire retardant, acid blobs, explosives, expanding foam gels, so on and so forth. The sky's the limit.

You are the master of all things swarming and skittering. You may take the traits of any arthropod on earth as your own, either by transforming into them, growing those traits for yourself, or exploding into a swarm of relevant arthropods. The more energy you spend, the more traits you can manifest at once, to the point that you could create an entire swarm of arthropod chimera from your own body.

Metaphorically bring the Tower of Babel down in a 1km radius around you, rendering all forms of communication outside of body language and caveman grunts largely impossible by scrambling what language everyone in that area understands- both written and spoken. The more energy you spend, the larger the area gets. With training you could leave the affected area up almost permanently.

You gain access to a pocket dimension/inventory space that allows you to fit a roughly infinite amount of stuff inside. Whilst tucked away in that space, every single item's monetary market value contributes to an increase in your relevant stats. Movement related items (bikes, sneakers, toy planes, whatever) increase your movement stats, magic items increase magic stats, so on and so forth. Items may also apply to multiple stats at a time. Every 100 USD equivalent results in a roughly 1% increase overall, on average.

A tome containing every single spell of the Conjuration magic school found in Tamriel, though its initial pages only cover what can be found in Skyrim proper. The knowledge in its pages may be taught to anyone who reads the information inside. No, you cannot eat it to learn spells.

Summon or create Greater Air/Sky Elementals such as thunderbirds, storm elementals, living hurricanes, etc. Each one can use A rank or lower air/sky-based magic or effects. The power of the elementals depends on your own expertise and power. The conjured Elementals will vanish if you stop supplying them with energy, though with practice you can form elementals with set durations or even permanent summons. Summoned elementals are not considered Familiars.

When you come to it and you can't go through it and you can't knock it down! You know that you found, THE WALL! THE WALL! THE WALL! NO MAN ON EARTH CAN MAKE IT FALL! Ahem. You're damn strong and durable, even at your weakest you'd be completely bulletproof up to tank shells and have magic resistance to match. The stronger you get, the more you can take straight to the face without flinching, moving, or even feeling it. The more damage you have to soak, though, the more tiring it gets.

You have a significant portion of the strength of a Titan, allowing you to move cities with your bare hands, carve mountains into nothingness by digging, even lift and throw entire islands should you wish. You may not be strong enough to lift the sky yet- but give it a while. You'll get there.

Your regeneration is now fueled by blood and sin instead of spending energy or intaking extra mass. The more blood you consume, and the more sin you absorb, the faster you regenerate. Should there be enough sin or blood to consume, you may end up being effectively immortal.

The barrier of your soul made manifest. Akin to a second skin over your body, your Aura allows you to take almost no damage from physical attacks while augmenting your physical stats to a high degree. Taking damage and engaging in superhuman feats will drain your Aura, though, with damage draining your reserves far faster than movement or combat. Once your Aura breaks, you're more or less out of the fight- stuck at an almost purely human level until your Aura recovers with rest and refocusing. Also comes with the chance of gaining a thematically appropriate Semblance.

Hit rock bottom and keep digging. You can pull up more energy whenever you need even if you otherwise run completely dry, but the more energy you pull, the more energy you lose later on. Pulling too much energy at once will knock you on your ass once you're out of combat, and possibly put you in a coma or kill you depending on the overdraw.

The fifth Angel, Ramiel. A giant blue crystal octahedron roughly 200 meters tall that hums with an angelic chorus. Within its repertoire is an uncommonly powerful AT Field, allowing it to shrug off even nuclear blasts with ease, a drill that can penetrate hundreds of meters of armor plate, and a positron cannon capable of reducing entire cities to rubble with relative ease. For convenience's sake, it has been modified such that it can shrink to a more human size, though this will limit its output significantly.

You are retroactively made the child of a god native to your reality- either via mythology, or actual presence. Whichever deity you choose is affected by whatever rolls you have beforehand. Being a demigod grants extra abilities based on whichever god you chose, as well as increased ability to perform magic and enact heroic feats of strength and skill.

Summon a blessed bow channeling the power of the Moon, the Hunt, and the Maiden. Any arrow loosed from this bow- physical or otherwise- is imbued with the silent light of the moon that brings a quiet, peaceful death. Should they be loosed on rapists or other unpleasant men, they will cause extra damage and occasionally deliver divine retribution via transfiguration into a stag. The bow is extra potent when protecting allies and used by hunters, and when used to hunt will imbue the arrows with magic that causes them to chase prey down until it is swiftly and mercifully ended.

You have the Level 5 Esper ability of Meltdowner, allowing you to manipulate the state of electrons and utilize them into abnormal quantum states- most often in the form of high energy particle beams capable of slicing through buildings with ease. You can utilize the same ability to create platforms, high energy barriers, flashbangs, and deflector shields against incoming energy attacks. However, it takes time and effort to aim, and while you could make up to twenty beams, you'll have to practice to try and utilize it in any direction other than shooting straight forward.

With your Dying Will! Rain Flames have the ability of Tranquility. These flames weaken anything they touch, making it easier to break, move slower, and otherwise work not as efficiently. Force a machine to stop, slow an enemies movements, or purge the effects of other things from the body- like poison or magical effects. Your Will determines how strong they are, and they must be utilized through a ring capable of withstanding their strength. Such a ring is provided when you roll this, though if it's lost its up to you to find another.

As long as this Ability is active, every 24 hours after activation you are completely cured of any and all ailments, status effects, wounds, curses, and other negative conditions you wish to remove up to and including SSS rank. This also extends to any ally you are touching at the time of the recovery, though theirs only extends to S rank.

You have the Level 5 Esper ability of Mental Out, allowing you to control the minds of anyone within a nearly city sized range. You can read thoughts, rewrite memories, implant behaviors, remotely control others, share senses, connect minds, put people to sleep, and more. Furthermore, your ability is actually an extremely specialized form of micro hydrokinesis, meaning that should you practice enough, you may learn how to actually manipulate water... somewhat poorly. As a Level 5, you are roughly as dangerous as a walking nuke.

With your Dying Will! Sun Flames have the ability of Activation. They improve the efficiency of things they're applied to. Ensure a machine runs smoothly, the body heal faster, or stimulate the body to become stronger and faster. Your Will determines how strong they are, and they must be utilized through a ring capable of withstanding their strength. Such a ring is provided when you roll this, though if it's lost its up to you to find another.

A book bound to your soul, made from your own magics. It contains the full breadth of the Light Magic attribute within its pages, but you must study and put effort into unlocking each spell and scrap of knowledge- anything you have not unlocked appears as blank pages. Also, it passively boosts your magical ability and learning rate. Just don't fall into despair, or demons may corrupt your book and therefore your soul.

No afterlife will take you when you die- Hell cannot grab hold, Heaven has closed their gates. Samsara is a distant fantasy, Elysium but an ephemeral hope. You remain in the moral realm as a soul, with all your powers and abilities intact, and with all the time in the world to bring yourself back from death.

The classic hero package made manifest- super strength, super speed, flight, super durability, maybe even an extra energy blast or something- but all stronger. Faster. Better. You're not just super- you're HYPER. The more stamina you exert, the stronger and faster you become- and you get the rocking physique to go with it.

Your right arm- specifically your hand- has within it the power of Imagine Breaker, that which defies all fantasy and reduces it back to reality. Any attack created through magical means loses all impact when touched by Imagine Breaker, anything created by supernatural means falls apart, and entire structures will crumble with sustained touch. Even god's fortune is negated while it's active, leaving you incredibly unlucky as a result. Should your arm get ripped off, a whole host of dragon heads will erupt from the stump, destroy what caused the damage, and return your arm to whole before you even know what happened. Fortunately: At least you can turn it off.

A book bound to your soul, made from your own magics. It contains the full breadth of the Dark Magic attribute within its pages, but you must study and put effort into unlocking each spell and scrap of knowledge- anything you have not unlocked appears as blank pages. Also, it passively boosts your magical ability and learning rate. Just don't fall into despair, or demons may corrupt your book and therefore your soul.

A key made of metal, dirt, stone, gems, and everything else that may be found within the Earth. It feels significantly heavier than it actually is. When used as if opening a door, will open a portal to an exact, untouched copy of Earth itself. No human hands have worked it, nor taken from its bounty. Be careful- the animals still exist and while they will never start out hostile and forgive more than they should, they are still wild and can harm you. The portal to this place remains open where you placed it until you deliberately close it and anyone may enter.

A book bound to your soul, made from your own magics. It contains the full breadth of the Spatial Magic attribute within its pages, but you must study and put effort into unlocking each spell and scrap of knowledge- anything you have not unlocked appears as blank pages. Also, it passively boosts your magical ability and learning rate. Just don't fall into despair, or demons may corrupt your book and therefore your soul.

With your Dying Will! Cloud Flames have the ability of Propagation. Anything affected by the flames gets bigger or increases in number. Extend the range of techniques, create more of something, or propagate an effect onto more people than it should reach. Your Will determines how strong they are, and they must be utilized through a ring capable of withstanding their strength. Such a ring is provided when you roll this, though if it's lost its up to you to find another.

You might as well have invented the concept of games. There is no game you cannot win, and no opponent under the heavens cannot be defeated in competition by your hands. You are, genuinely, the master of masters of all forms of gaming.

You rule over all things related to the sea- not quite a god, but just as good in most cases. Typhoons, water, and oceanic effects S-rank and below are boosted massively and become more efficient. All beings aligned to the sea- fish, elementals, fae, yokai, etc- recognize you as the monarch of all seas. You become immune to all water, storm, and oceanic type effects.

You are a Level 5 Esper with the ability Pyromaster. Your brain calculates so fast it warps reality, giving you command over every single bit of fire based phenomenon within your vicinity- including heat based phenomenon. You are, essentially, a walking nuke in the shape of a person. Summon massive explosions, hurl infernos, burn someone from the inside out, rip the heat energy out of someone and freeze them- the sky's the limit.

You can absorb the energy of anything and everything that comes into your body- thermal, kinetic, electric, radiation, exotic, so on and so forth. You have a very high absorption cap, but taking strong attacks may overwhelm your absorption speed and still damage you. If you absorb more than you can handle, it will have to be released in some manner or you may explode.

Conjure the Armageddon Blade, the sword that embodies Wrath against all of Creation. It is made of purest heat and flame, destruction and hatred made manifest. It amplifies all fire based effects five times over, can cut through entire worlds with ease, and can unleash the Flames of Armageddon- fires so hot that they embody oblivion, and anything burned by them ceases to exist, including existence itself. The strong you are, the stronger the flames get. With enough power, the flames you unleash can destroy the entire world. Use with caution.

A portal gun capable of traveling through the multiverse on a whim, as long as you keep it charged with portal fluid. It can go anywhere, and probably anywhen too if you're careful about it. It can be used as transport, a weapon, a shield, a distraction, and a cool prop on your wall if you want. Comes with six recharges of portal fluid and restocks once every six months.

You might as well have invented the concept of teaching. There is nothing you cannot create a lesson plan for, and no student under the heavens cannot be turned into the greatest of masters by your hands. You are, genuinely, the master of masters of the teaching art.

You rule over all things related to ice- not quite a god, but just as good in most cases. Storms, snow, and ice effects S-rank and below are boosted massively and become more efficient. All beings aligned to ice and cold- arctic creatures, elementals, fae, yokai, etc- recognize you as the monarch of all ice. You become immune to all ice, snow, and cold type effects.

You're a one in a trillion genius of magic to the point that even gods find your talent surprising. You have nigh endless energy to work with, and you can make spells on a whim, unravel enemy magics with ease, and create the kinds of magical structures and setups that even the highest of archmages would drool with envy over.

You are the undisputed favorite of Time itself, allowing you to ignore any and all time related effects below SS rank. Time stopping, time skipping, time reversal, time paradoxes- those are yours to command and more, and they cannot touch you. Time itself bends to your will, and all of your temporal abilities and effects are now boosted up to minimum S rank as a result.

You are a ten winged seraphim, one of the strongest Angels in existence. You wield incredible magical and physical power, and carry the weight of divine authority. All of your holy, light, and healing related abilities are boosted up to S rank if not yet that high, and you instinctively know how to use your holy light to create new effects and spells on a whim. You can no longer use any dark, infernal, unholy, or otherwise evil related magics.

You might as well have invented the concept of cooking. There is no ingredient you cannot prepare, and no being under the heavens cannot be satisfied or foodgasm'd by your dishes. You are, genuinely, the master of masters of the culinary arts.

You rule over all things related to fire- not quite a god, but just as good in most cases. Infernos, flames, and lava effects S-rank and below are boosted massively and become more efficient. All beings aligned to heat and fire- will o' wisps, elementals, fae, yokai, etc- recognize you as the monarch of all fire. You become immune to all fire, lava, and heat type effects.

You might as well have invented the concept of shooting. There is no target you cannot hit, and no enemy under the heavens cannot be gunned down or struck dead by your weapons. You are, genuinely, the master of masters of the art of shooting.

You might as well have invented the concept of leadership. There is no group you cannot lead, and no army under the heavens cannot be guided or rallied by your words. You are, genuinely, the master of masters of the art of leadership.

You rule over all things related to earth- not quite a god, but just as good in most cases. Earth, stone, and ground effects S-rank and below are boosted massively and become more efficient. All beings aligned to earth and stone- moles, elementals, fae, yokai, etc- recognize you as the monarch of all earth. You become immune to all earth, stone, and ground type effects.

You are a Level 5 Esper with the ability Hydromaster. Your brain calculates so fast it warps reality, giving you command over every single bit of water based phenomenon within your vicinity- including ice based phenomenon. You are, essentially, a walking nuke in the shape of a person. Summon tidal waves, hurl hurricanes, create icebergs, rip the water out of someone- the sky's the limit.

You are a Level 5 Esper with the ability Cryomaster. Your brain calculates so fast it warps reality, giving you command over every single bit of ice based phenomenon within your vicinity. You are, essentially, a walking nuke in the shape of a person. Summon blizzards, hurl icicles, create entire glaciers, freeze enemies solid in an instant- the sky's the limit.

You might as well have invented the concept of mechanics. There is nothing you cannot build, and no machine under the heavens cannot be replicated or improved by your hands. You are, genuinely, the master of masters of the art of mechanics.

You might as well have invented the concept of medicine. There is nothing you cannot heal, and no ailment under the heavens cannot be alleviated or cured by your hands. You are, genuinely, the master of masters of the medicinal art.

You are the prodigy of prodigies of any and all martial arts- you can perfectly learn and replicate any technique from a glance, your training gains are multiplied exponentially, your skills unmatched by all but the very gods themselves. You could punch out just about anyone, really.

You're just about impossible to kill- no matter what, anything that comes close to killing you gets adapted out, allowing you to continue your existence at the cost of temporarily becoming more and more mutated. Your body will always find a way to survive your current situation, no matter how it has to happen, either by spamming healing abilities or just making your biology extremely nonstandard- even instant death effects can't really kill you... probably.

You might as well have invented the concept of programming. There is nothing you cannot edit, and no creation under the heavens cannot be hacked or modified by your hands. You are, genuinely, the master of masters of the programming art.

You are the abyss from which no energy may escape- so long as you wish, you may absorb any and all energy that touches your body. Kinetic, electric, heat, radiation- all of it is yours to consume with a literally infinite capacity. Every star in the universe going supernova at once would be a light snack for your absorption. This doesn't mean you can use all that energy, though. Without practice, it's like trying to drain an ocean through a syringe.

You are the undisputed CEO of Sex itself- any partner, any race, any gender, any state of being is yours to pleasure thoroughly and without failure. The gods themselves bow before your unmatched prowess of the carnal arts. Frankly, if you really wanted to, you could dick the planet so deep it cums a new Krakatoa. Or just stick to having sex with your preferred partners, whatever works.

You are the No Life King, Vlad Dracula without being Dracula. Your body is an infinite well of the souls you've absorbed and the blood you've drunk, shadows and eyes and unkillable nature and all. You have great strength, mysterious vampiric abilities, and are generally nigh unstoppable to most things out there. You still can't cross running water, though.

You are a Level 5 Esper with the ability Electromaster. Your brain calculates so fast it warps reality, giving you command over every single bit of electrical phenomenon within your vicinity- including magnetic phenomenon. You are, essentially, a walking nuke in the shape of a person. Summon lightning, hurl railgun shots, create iron sand monstrosities, pretend to be Magneto- the sky's the limit.

Control, shape, and redirect gravitational forces on a massive scale. Create false singularities, lift entire cities into the sky, turn mountains upside down- hell, with enough practice and effort you could get a planet-wide antigravity field going... with all the consequences that would imply.

Store and unleash your own luck. Every 24 hours you go with this ability, you spend a day with mildly terrible luck but gain, instead, a single charge of extremely good luck. You can only stack seven charges, either to use day to day, or all at once. Upon spending a charge, you become just about the luckiest person in the world for about an hour- everything goes your way, lost things become found, bets pay out without fail, so on and so forth.

You are the most powerful telepath in the world, possessing psionic strength enough to create illusions, mask your presence, speak to and read the minds of anyone within 250 miles (or across the entire planet with Cerebro), link minds with others, mind blast enemies with psionic zip bombs, control minds, erase memories, communicate with just about any living being, astral project your spirit, and even use some low level E to D-rank telekinesis with some effort.

Your soul is a world unto itself- a vast and endless kingdom that you may shape to your will and enter as you please. Should you kill an enemy or happen upon a wandering lost soul, you may take them into your kingdom and retain them as citizens- either to dominate and use for their powers and energy, or to allow them a second chance. The choice is yours. At any point, any soul dominated beneath your will can be summoned as a physical soldier temporarily, or sacrificed to permanently absorb whatever powers and abilities they had in life. Every soul you consume makes you more powerful as a result.

Design, build, and modify any and all technology available to the hero Metal Knight, also known as Bofoi. This includes powerful mecha, weapons capable of stopping apocalyptic impacts, recon bots, construction robots, fortified bases, and more.

Open the gates of Heaven and bring forth the Heavenly Host. Entire armies of lower ranked angels are yours to command, with smaller companies or groups of higher ranked angels coming through with more effort- as long as the angel in question is S-rank or lower, they're entirely obedient to your call. The more angels you summon, or the more powerful the angel you summon, the more energy it takes to keep them around. Slain angels will return to the heavens and can be resummoned easily. Should you wish, you enact a long prayer ritual and sacrifice an equal value in items or power to permanently bind an angel as a Familiar.

Sound the horns that call forth the end of days, and summon the gate through which the armies of Heaven descend to fight at your command. The entire Heavenly Host appears, from the lowest of Angels to the highest of Seraphim, including Dominions, Principalities, Thrones, Cherubs, Archangels, and Ophanim. Save the world, end the world. To sound the horns is to bring about change that shakes all of creation.

You might as well have invented the concept of hand to hand combat. There is nothing you cannot defeat, and no foe under the heavens cannot be brought down or struck dead by your hands. You are, genuinely, the master of masters of all hand to hand combat.

You're the kind of magic talent that gets spoken of in legends, the world changing mage that only shows up once every several thousand years. Your reserves are unmatched, your talent immeasurable- you could learn magic so difficult it'd take most mages a century to even touch on and master it in less than a year.

You are the world's chosen Hero of Humanity. Your affinity with all powers light, holy, and generally considered "good" is increased massively, and your physicality is enhanced to truly legendary levels. All things divine, holy, and otherwise connected with the local religions view you more favorably, and are more likely to reward you for your service. Fighting for the sake of others additionally grants buffs to all of your stats depending on the stakes at hand and your own determination. Sadly, the weaker the divine in your world, the weaker you become- without any visible gods, you might as well just be a stronger than average guy.

You are an Archdemon- one of the strongest possible demons in existence, with hellishly powerful magic and strength. Your energy pool is vast and nigh limitless, your ability to use all unholy, dark, infernal, fiery, or otherwise evil effects mastered to the point of being second to none. You could make up demonic spells on the spot if you wanted, and you cannot die so long as you have enough energy to maintain your will to live. Should you wish, you may also take on a spiritual form- all of your physical power and health traded for even more magical power at the cost of becoming an incorporeal being for as long as you stay that way.

You are considered one of the Demon Kings of Hell- powerful beyond compare, to the point that the heavens themselves think twice before going against you. Your affinity with all things unholy, infernal, fiery, dark, and evil is truly beyond all but the mightiest of gods, and your strength could level mountains with a swipe of your wrist. All weaker demons bow before your power, and your vulnerability to holy and light base effects is far less than it would be were you a lesser demon. You may unleash your true form at will, gaining even more powerful physicality and magical power, at the cost of increased energy consumption- once you run out of power, you revert to normal.

You are Sköll, the wolf that devours the sun and child of Fenrir. You are immune to fire, and can wield the flames of the sun with ease by consuming the sunlight around you. You gain the most perfected form of lycanthropy- able to transform as you please with massively enhanced stats, magical ability, and a divine presence that causes weaker beings to bow before you. Your progeny will be inclined towards divinity, and may even be considered giants in the Norse way- even stronger than gods, on occasion.

You are a Level 5 Esper with the ability Aeromaster. Your brain calculates so fast it warps reality, giving you command over every single bit of wind based phenomenon within your vicinity. You are, essentially, a walking nuke in the shape of a person. Summon tornadoes, hurl solid wind constructs, suffocate people, fly at supersonic speeds- the sky's the limit.

You are the Darkness Devil- the embodiment of humanity's primal fear of the dark and everything lurking within it. As one of humanity's oldest fears, you are also one of its strongest devils, and have immense physical and magical strength- largely focused around manipulating the darkness around you, projecting invisible forces, shapeshifting, and manifesting other devils to do with as you please. You are weakened by light, though, and while you are extremely hard to kill... you're not immortal. Should you die on Earth or any normal living realm, you will return to Hell until you find a way out again.

Your eyes are special- you can see the lines of Death that crisscross all things. Should you follow any of those lines with the slightest of pressure- say, with a knife, or a pencil, or even your finger- the afflicted item will instantly be cut across that line and fall apart. With training, the eyes can even be trained to see the intersections of those lines. Stabbing the "weak points" where lines intersect allows you to precisely and instantly kill that item entirely, potentially causing it to separate along all the lines going through that point. This works on literally everything with a concept of death as life on Earth understands it.

Touch any target to store an ability of your choice within a metaphysical archive, from which you can freely pick and choose which ability you'd like to mimic. You may only mimic one ability at a time, but can use that ability with the exact same proficiency and skill as the person you copied it from.

Design, build, and modify any and all technology and constructs related to explosives. If it goes boom, you can do anything. Simple explosives, shields that explosively repel attacks, powered armor made entirely of detonating taser packs, explosives that turn areas to glass, hydrogen bombs, antimatter bombs, spacetime warping bombs, black hole bombs. There is no limit, as long as you have the materials to work with.

You are a necromancer beyond compare- no mere conjurer of skeletons or zombies, your risen undead can conquer entire nations on their own merit, with strength rivaling the greatest of heroes and magic outstripping the greatest of mages. All undead below S-rank are yours to command in a great and terrible army upwards of ten thousand strong- skeletons, zombies, vampires, ghouls, revenants, reapers, jiang shi, ghosts, banshees, so on and so forth. Stronger undead require stronger corpses and more energy, though.

The Chimera Ant King, Mereum is a young creature that gains power through collection and understanding. Originally selfish, haughty, and monstrous, he became a more gentle creature, willing to see merit in human life after losing several times in a match of Gungi. Young, unknowing of the world, and finding human behaviours foolish, Mereum fears only true death, and does not know how to empathize easily. When it comes to inequality, he wishes to crush it down, even if that means changing the world or taking it over himself.

Before there was time. Before there was anything. There was nothing. And before there was nothing, there were monsters. The Lich is an ancient existence created from a Catalyst Comet, an omen of great change, and represents the existence of Evil itself. A scholar, he dedicates himself to GOLB, hoping to honor the being of Chaos with the extinction of all life. Should he succeed, he will become depressed. A terrifyingly efficient teacher, it is wise to be wary around him, as he may decide your body is an adequate vessel.

Laevatein, a sword that feels like it's made of the Sun that shall strip the foundations of Gods. A construct created by the planet to wipe away Texture, this sword conceptually burns any life it touches to ash, and could clear a planet entirely, but will be especially effective against Gods. The weapon is made for a Giant, stupidly large, and difficult to wield. But you could drop it on someone if you wanted.

A Sacred Gear created by God to seal away the Great Dragon Albion, Divine Dividing's primary ability is to halve the power of any foe every ten seconds, and then absorb them. If they enemy has more energy than the user can safely contain, the power will instead be expelled from the wings Divine Dividing Manifests as. This can also be used on emotions, distance, or other vague concepts. Divine Dividing also has other abilities to unlock, should the wielder be able to convince Albion to allow their usage, or be in a situation that requires them. Try to be known for something dignified.

A twisted construct that sparks with cosmic energy, Heavenly Gale is an extremely powerful bow that fires things known as 'Exo Crystals', a crystal that will summon lightning bolts when fully charged. These crystals also home in on enemies doggedly, and will only be blocked if they hit something else. These crystals also carry a blight that will cause their body to break down, disabling all natural life regeneration through an exotic resonance that shreads their coporeal body.

The remains of the First Firmament made manifest into physical form. A blue gem of immense power, the Space Stone allows the user near unlimited control over space and distance, allowing teleportation across the universe and manipulation of local spatial fabric. Works best with the other Infinity Stones.

You might as well have invented the concept of blacksmithing. There is nothing you cannot forge, and no creation under the heavens cannot be replicated or improved by your hands. You are, genuinely, the master of masters of the blacksmithing art.

You might as well have invented the concept of bladed weapons. There is nothing you cannot cut, and no foe under the heavens cannot be decimated or split by your hands. You are, genuinely, the master of masters of all bladed weapons.

You might as well have invented the concept of pole weapons. There is nothing you cannot slash, and no foe under the heavens cannot be shattered or split by your hands. You are, genuinely, the master of masters of all pole weapons.

You might as well have invented the concept of blunt weapons. There is nothing you cannot crush, and no foe under the heavens cannot be crumpled or laid low by your hands. You are, genuinely, the master of masters of all blunt weapons.

The true, highest form of cyborg- the perfect melding of flesh and metal. All of your physical stats are massively boosted, your energy reserves become nigh endless, you may absorb energy from any and all technological sources, and all of your tech creation skills are made far more efficient and accessible. Your body reconfigures on a whim to emulate your Tech Trees, all technology becomes easier to understand, and any weaker machine bows to your will. Any technology you command may be assimilated with ease. Roll an additional 3 tech based 4-Star Tokens for your starting augmentations.

You are the Managarmr, the wolf that devours the moon, also known under the name of Hati Hróðvitnisson. Your jaws can rend the sky itself, destroying the moon for up to 12 hours at a time. You gain the most perfected form of lycanthropy- able to transform as you please with massively enhanced stats, magical ability, and a divine presence that causes weaker beings to bow before you. Your progeny will be inclined towards divinity, and may even be considered giants in the Norse way- even stronger than gods, on occasion.

You are the Midgard Serpent, the beast that encircles the world with its tail in its mouth, resting within the seas until Ragnarok comes. You may shift into a hybrid form or become the full world serpent at will, becoming gigantic and gaining titanic strength that leaves mountains flattened and continents shattered beneath your weight. Your venom is so potent that even gods cannot resist it, and can be delivered either in the form of a bite or by spraying the venom from your mouth. For mythological reasons, you may also pretend to be an extraordinarily heavy cat, if you wish.

You are a Nemean Lion, able to transform into both a hybrid state and full lion state at will. You are massive- building sized at the least, and possess great strength such that only the divine may harm you. No mortal weapon may pierce your hide, no blade can cut your fur. Your claws and teeth are shaper than any blade, and are the only things that may slash your own skin. You are not immune to blunt force, though, or being attacked from the inside- though it would take quite the hero to actually harm you.

You are the Nidhoggr, the dragon who gnaws at the roots of the World Tree. You may change between your normal and monstrous forms at will, and gain a taste for corpses- not living flesh, but a compulsion to gnaw on the bones of the evil dead. Your status as a dragon and your role in existence grants you wings, the ability to break through reality to gnaw on the roots of existence, and a somewhat dubious ability to resurrect yourself and the redeemed dead from beneath piles of corpses. You also have highly acidic poison, and are considered the progenitor of all serpents.

You have the heart of a Hydra. Whenever any part of your body is cut off, it grows back nigh instantly and without any problems whatsoever as long as the stump isn't cauterized by either fire or your own poison. You become highly venomous, and also may grow extra heads on a whim should you ever be decapitated repeatedly. Your venom and highly toxic blood can cause even gods to writhe about in mortal, mind shattering agony even if it can't outright kill them. You also gain quite a lot of durability and strength, but you're still weak to fire and cauterization in general.

You are the Ziz, a massive bird capable of blocking out the entire sun with its wingspan. You may freely shift between forms, and gain access to monstrous strength, high speed flight, and rule over all birds as the biggest and scariest bird of all. You are large enough that your ankles can rest on earth and your head will still touch the sky, that should you stand in ankle deep water an axe dropped at the surface takes seven years to hit the bottom. You have additionally been gifted with great wisdom and the ability to see the future with your divinely gifted might. Your body can block even the most powerful storms, and should you wish- those same winds are yours to create with a flap of your wings.

You embody the thought experiment of Schrodinger's cat in all its interpretations- as long as no one is directly observing you, then you are everywhere and nowhere, and exist in any state that you please from alive to dead. You will never stay injured, you can go anywhere and anywhen you please, and frankly you can do just about anything you want... within the bounds of your mortal shell, at least. You can even bring stuff with you, as long as you can keep ahold of it. Also comes with a cute pair of kitty ears.

Design, build, and modify any technology or constructs relating to the manipulation of time, and a little bit of space. Time stopping devices, aging grenades, time dilation rooms, stasis fields, FTL spacecraft, parallel timelines- as long as you have the very, very, very expensive materials necessary to build it, time is yours to command.

The essence of the red dragon Ddraig, modified and implanted into your soul. It takes the form of a scaled gauntlet with a green gem on the back. It's power is Boost. At base the gauntlets doubles your power every ten seconds. With training you can lower the time between Boosts, Boost others, apply the Boost to things other things, such as "the space between me and him" or "the effectiveness of these pills", and even more.

You might as well have invented the concept of item construction. There is nothing you cannot enchant, and no artifact under the heavens cannot be replicated or improved by your hands. You are, genuinely, the master of masters of item construction.

You might as well have invented the concept of charisma. There is nothing you cannot enamor, and no being under the heavens cannot be charmed or wooed by your actions. You are, genuinely, the master of masters of the charismatic art.

You are the supreme inventor in the universe, quite possibly the smartest of all beings when it comes to building, modifying, designing, or otherwise constructing tech or performing scientific advancements. Any and all Generic-label Tech Trees are now yours to draw from with ease, and each new Tech Tree gained only adds onto your newfound intelligence. You only gain truly new information from non-Generic Tech Trees now.

You rule over all things in the sky- not quite a god, but just as good in most cases. Wind, lightning, and weather effects S-rank and below are boosted massively and become more efficient. All beings aligned to the sky- birds, elementals, fae, yokai, etc- recognize you as the monarch of the skies. You become immune to all wind, lightning, and weather type effects.

You are a Majin- a pink skinned alien being with a physicality almost resembling bubble gum. You are largely amorphous, nearly impossible to kill with physical trauma alone, and are able to absorb other beings at will to take their strength, abilities, and even parts of their appearance and mannerisms. You may also fission your body into duplicates by separating out good and evil, or just make short-lived clones. You gain immense strength, flight, magic, and the ability to transfigure just about anything too weak to resist you into assorted forms of candy, which are your main source of nutrition. You may eat other foods, though.

You are a mastery of necromancy so powerful that your very existence swallows life like the moon eclipsing the sun. You are the true lord of death, able to cast vast and powerful and terrible death magics with ease, killing anything and everything and raising its lifeless corpse as your servant for all eternity. The dead are yours to command, the living are fuel for your armies. You are the undying Eclipse, devourer of life.

You rule over all water, and everything related to it. Flood the entire planet, create blizzards the size of nations, strike enemies down by ripping out their blood, create seas and rivers and ice caps and comets and icy moons... anything related to water is yours to command.

You hold the pinnacle of strength- physical power beyond measure and beyond limits. You could crush a star into dust, rip a black hole in half, literally punch a hole in the fabric of spacetime. Your body holds power that not even gods can match.

Design, build, and modify any and all technology related to the concept of mass destruction. Antimatter missiles, disintegration cannons, black hole bombs, generic doomsday devices, supervillain superweapons, the whole nine yards. The more Abilities, Passives, Races, or Skills you have, the wider the variety of items available to you- including things not gained from the gacha.

Invoke the wrath of those that dream in death. Any body of water you choose may be formed into a gateway to the deepest abyss, crawling with the most ancient horrors that mankind could never ken. From those waters, you may summon tentacles, claws, maws, fins, tendrils, and all sorts of eldritch body parts with which to annihilate your foes. The larger the body of water, the more destruction you may cause.

A primordial being that serves as the source of all chakra, born from a massive god tree that was planted with the intent of draining all the chakra from an entire planet. It can shatter mountains with ease, is largely unkillable, and possibly destroy the entire world if left unchecked. However, it doesn't have much of a personality or mind, and usually only reacts to the will of the one holding its reins. It's also kinda ugly, and looks like a weird one eyed snail thing with huge arms and a sort of plantlike texture. If nothing else, you can split its chakra up into nine different chakra beasts and create jinchuuriki with it?

The remains of the First Firmament made manifest into physical form. A purple gem of immense power, the Power Stone allows the user near unlimited strength and raw physical power, usually in the form of beams, shockwaves, enhanced musculature, and world ending strikes. Works best with the other Infinity Stones.

Your brain is a calculator beyond any supercomputer, you can compute trillions of calculations at once with ease and even calculate with such speed, precision, and force that the equations you solve have physical effects- you, alone, may solve for the source code of reality and wield it at your fingertips.

An existence defined as an Elemental created by the planet to serve as a sense of touch. You are effectively a greater fairy whose abilities cannot be duplicated via standard magecraft and can access both the usage of a Marble Phantasm to bend all of nature around you to your will. You are effectively immortal, an extension of the planet itself, and have almost no weaknesses to the point that conceptual weapons barely affect you. At night, you become quite literally unkillable as long as there is living nature around you. All other natural vampiric abilities are boosted to the extreme, though you are no longer able to improve yourself through training or effort.

You have the innate gift of using literally anything you touch- no matter what it is, ability, passive, spell, item, weapon, artifact, you always instantly meet any and all qualifications required to use it to its highest level and potential- including the skills necessary to get to that point.

You are the purest concept of destruction made manifest, anything and everything you choose to destroy will be erased from existence entirely without even atoms left to scatter. Space itself rends at your touch, and your existence may very well cause the end of the universe should you so choose to will it. Not great for starting a relationship, honestly.

You have nigh infinite computational power within your brain, such that the entire world becomes nothing but a series of numbers for you to calculate and recalculate, tune to your advantage. Angles and vectors are your playthings and structural weaknesses are yours to dig into. You could collapse buildings, survive great falls, fight like a trained assassin, manipulate the world economy- as long as you remain aware that your body is still a squishy pile of meat, of course.

You are magic incarnate, the truest user of all things magical in the universe. You may suppress all other magic use that you wish, learn any spell instantly, dominate leylines, gain unfathomable and nigh infinite power, and use the very cosmos itself as power for your arcane arts. None hold a higher mastery over the mystical and magical than you.

The remains of the First Firmament made manifest into physical form. An orange gem of immense power, the Soul Stone allows the user near unlimited control over the souls of the universe, manipulating and preserving them indefinitely for whatever purpose the user may need them for. Works best with the other Infinity Stones.

Your knowledge of all things related to life and biology is literally second to none. You, alone, understand how to form life from its most basic principles and how to modify biology to suit your whims just with the most simple of manipulations. The more you utilize this ability and the more your mind expands, the more knowledge you can access at will.

You are a demonic god- but more than that, you are a god of demons. You are, in effect, the supreme being of all things dark and infernal, sinful and fiery and evil. Any demons weaker than you bow at your mere presence and infernal beings leap to follow your orders. You are augmented in all regards to the level that a god requires- physically and magically, and have all of the dark, infernal, demonic, unholy, and otherwise evil or sinful magics you might ever want to cast.

You're completely immune to any kind of damage from any source classified as one of the four classical elements plus light and dark. Absolute zero has no effect, entire planets simply brush off of you, no wind in the universe could even ruffle your hair if you don't want. Spacetime effects, radiation, and other conceptual attacks will still hit you, though, as will physical attacks from living beings.

Imbue any object with the ability to ignore select laws of physics with a single touch. Its timing, duration, and effect may be tuned as you please, from unfolding across multiple dimensions to strike at the core of something vast and alien, all the way down to lowering the friction of your shoes so you can ice skate on concrete. Any attack tuned to its highest degree is almost completely inviolable, though the object carrying the charge can still be destroyed.

Manifest an eight spoked wheel behind your head. Every time you take damage from an attack, or interact with any phenomenon, the wheel turns and begins the process of breaking down and analyizing the effect in order to adapt to it. The more that attack hits you, the more the wheel turns. Additionally, the more esoteric the attack, the longer it takes to analyze. By the time you are fully adapted to that specific phenomenon, you may fully counter it either defensively or offensively- becoming immune to it, seeing things that otherwise could not be seen, or even manifesting a way to destroy it with a counterattack. High powered attacks may still kill you in one hit, though.

Design, build, and modify any and all technology and constructs related to the manipulation of dimensions and space. This includes pocket dimensions, teleporters, interdimensional portals, spatial barriers, parallel dimension generators, dimensional rams, etc etc. If you need to mess with spacetime hard enough to punch a hole into the next universe, you can do it.

A Longinus Sacred Gear capable of creating a special mist that blocks attacks and can send anything immersed within the mist to an artificial pocket dimension. The mist itself may also be used to reinforce any and all other dimensional spaces, even those created with entirely separate effects. Should the user become strong enough to spread the mist over entire countries, it could shunt anyone into any dimension the user chooses, including into the space between universes. With time and strength, it could destroy the world. Manifests as a marble that grants the Sacred Gear to anyone who swallows it.

A Daedric artifact belonging to the Daedric Prince Nocturnal. A key- sometimes a lockpick- capable of unlocking any lock whatsoever, including physical locks, portals, gateways, the doorway to the Ebonmere, and even your own hidden potential. Keep an eye on it. Sometimes Nocturnal likes it to get lost on purpose.

You know all there is to know about matter, creation, particles, and physics. Laplace's Demon shudders at your presence, and Maxwell's Demon weeps in envy. Your knowledge of the cosmos and everything in it allows you to construct, transmute, manipulate, and create matter in ways akin to the biblical god.
