The more intelligent you become with this ability, the more of that knowledge you can use at will.

Your Heart beats so loudly it sounds like the rumble of an engine, granting you an intimidating aura that can cause people to surrender. Combined with the knowledge of bluffing, and a lot of luck, you could cause almost all opponents to back down easily. It's not something you can train, though, and it's less effective the more brave you really are inside.
The speed of the gods, faster than light, faster than conception, faster than the universe itself. You are the fastest thing in existence, bar none.

You embody the fear of control or domination, allowing you to control anyone and everyone you consider to be lesser in rank than you- socially, politically, materialistically, physically- with no limits to the amount you can control. Once under your control, you can use your subordinates' abilities, borrow their senses, control animals, speak telepathically to your subordinates, and use powerful telekinetic force to crush or manipulate your foes. If you cannot imagine yourself superior to someone, you cannot control them. If someone proves themselves superior even under your reckoning, you cannot control them.

This Tech Tree allows the creation of things that push past the realm of Gods, allowing the use of divine energy to create constructs, weapons, and flying chairs that push the realm of science into absurdity. Blackhole bombs, chainsaws that use hard light to cut, powerful creatures called Exo Mechs, made to push into the realm of attempted perfection. There is very little you couldn't make with this tree.

You can create clones out of a mud-like substance that emits from your body. While you may only clone yourself twice, clones of yourself may also clone themselves endlessly without any degradation. All clones made have immensely lowered durability, and splatter away after taking incapacitating injury. Any clones of another person require you to be intimately familiar with their measurements, disposition, and abilities. Clones of others also retain their personality and biological abilities, though they will still listen to your orders.
Stop time at will, enabling you to act with impunity so long as you aren't fighting something that's immune to time stopping. Overuse may strain your heart and stamina.

The greatest Divine Beast of Sumer. The Bull of Heaven. A calamity that comes clad in storms and darkens the skies. Gugulanna can summon massive tornados, storm force winds, call down lightning, and is nearly unmatched in phyiscal strength. The destruction of a city is an afterthought, a country is easy, and a world might take some time.

A fragment of an avatar of the Crawling Chaos, forged and formed into an amorphous Familiar that can be reasoned with. Its only capability is to transform into any Familiar at or below S rank at will. When in base form it is without combat utility and is weaker than most humans, akin to a strange child. Though, when transformed it can perfectly mimic its chosen form to the full breadth of its abilities, memories, personality, and power. Should it die, it will reform within an hour.

You are an Endbringer, a Conflict Engine of unfathomable power. Your body warps into a chosen form of pseudo-organic crystalline substance in layers that increase in mass and density as they reach your core, spatially compacting tens of thousands of layers of planet sized mass in a much smaller body. While all of your abilities are massively enhanced by now effectively being an alien supercomputer wrapped in effectively a planet's worth of crystal body tissue, you are now far more vulnerable to abilities that warp spacetime, as they can cut right through the space folding nature of your body to strike your core directly.

You are the all consuming void- a silhouette in reality through which all things fall and can never escape. Your inside is infinite and your all absorbing- the sun itself could not kill you, nor a black hole, nor anything that resides in the universe. You can just absorb it all and eradicate it within the infinite, hungering void.

You rule over all earth, and everything related to it. Create mountains with a flick of your finger, move continents, shatter entire planets in half, call down meteors and asteroids, form crystals and gems and metals as you please... anything related to earth is yours to command.

Summon and control the Chains of Heaven, that which binds the gods in unbreakable bondage and which restraints the creatures of heaven without fail. The more divine your opponent, the stronger the chains are- though even the most infernal being will still be trapped as if they're normal steel chains.

The almighty pinnacle of martial arts, gifted by "God" and attuned with the flow of energy in the universe. A powerful form of combat capable of generating nuclear explosions capable of covering planets in scale, firing gamma ray bursts, time traveling, manipulating gravity, creating portals, even perfectly copying and replicating the skills, strengths, and abilities of your foes. Utilization of this martial art converts your body into something which resembles a humanoid, star filled void matching your normal silhouette.

You are the son of the God Emperor of Mankind- the true heir, with all his attributes and strengths. You possess massive intelligence and physical perfection, along with excessively powerful Psyker abilities and scientific knowledge. You could rip planets apart with enough training, or guide fleets across the entire galaxy. Fortunately, as long as you don't touch the actual universe of the God Emperor, your power derives from the Sea of Souls, not the Warp. Much, much safer that way.

You are the perfect host of the Phoenix Force- its will and your will are one, granting you access to everything it has to offer: Near omnipotent reality warping, cosmic flames, resurrection, immortality, teleporting across cosmic distances, temporal manipulation, cosmic storm creation, black hole creation, disintegration waves, you name it, it can do it. You are, in effect, the all powerful god of your universe.

You rule over all fire, and everything related to it. Burn entire biospheres to a crisp, summon volcanoes, strike enemies down with solar flame, forge stars and hang them in the night sky... anything related to fire is yours to command.

You may nullify anything you wish- reduce the amount of magic in an area to zero, stop all motion, turn off any and all abilities, reduce an enemy to a mere speck of what they were, stop someone from thinking. Anything and everything you want to nullify, you can. Sadly, you cannot nullify the absence of something.

You see and know Fate as if it were a tapestry that you, yourself, weave. With application of power, you may weave fates in and out of existence, picking and choosing as you please to enforce unassailable futures that guarantee your victory. Though the price for improbable futures is higher, it is still well within your grasp. Win at gambling, set up plots sixty steps in advance, control the battlefield to your whims, even have attacks align just so that they slip right through you without harm- fate is yours to weave, and you are its grand architect.

You are the divinity of undeath, that which profanes and corrupts the great cycle and manipulates the rotting, the desiccated, and the decaying as it pleases. You may manipulate corpses into any form, resurrect souls, create undead almost indistinguishable from their living selves, control legions upon legions of souls and the dead, and profane all in your path with necrotic and corrputive energies.

The great Vanishing Dragon, the White Dragon Emperor himself. A dragon capable of fighting on the level of the biblical god, with the ability to Divide an opponent's strength at will and absorb that halved power for himself. He can reflect incoming damage, utilize horrifically powerful venom capable of Reducing even gods down to nothing, and break down souls with said venom. He additionally has a smattering of secondary powers like telepathy, soul transferral, flight, and an immensely powerful Dragon Aura. He really hates being called the Butt Dragon.

A Longinus Sacred Gear capable of creating and enforcing choices and options as the user pleases. In a very real sense, it twists fate and causality around and changes the probability of any event to create utterly improbably circumstances. It is said that Telos Karma at its strongest can interfere with the history of the world itself, and its Balance Breaker controls fate to such a degree that not even gods can resist it fully. As it is without form, it manifests as a marble that bonds to whomever swallows it.

The generic time stopping stopwatch- stops time when the button is pressed, allows you to bring others in or dynamically change what objects are stopped in your local area, and restarts time when the button is pressed again. Try to remember that real life is not a hentai anime.

You alone understand the laws of the world- not just the laws of man and mortals, but the laws governing the entire universe and its most critical and fundamental of functions. You can manipulate those laws without changing them to produce nearly any outcome you might desire, and the more powerful your mind becomes the more knowledge you can access without burning your brain straight out of your ears.

Your body is an unnaturally powerful specimen far beyond what its physical limits should imply. Even an ordinary human with this level of power could demolish the military forces of the entire world with ease, to say nothing of what you, personally, could accomplish. In short, you're hundreds- possibly even thousands or millions of times more powerful and durable than your body should be.

You are the Star Man waiting in the sky. The more hope you have and inspire among the people around you, the stronger, faster, better you become. Inspire others to be better, convince the entire world that there's a hopeful future, and you'll be the hero that can lead them all into that bright tomorrow.

You're the ultimate arbiter of keeping people alive and kicking- healing and restoration are your forte and postponing death your hobby. The cessation of life, no matter for how long, is nothing more than a long nap to you, and even the most difficult of mythical poisons might as well be a bit of a sniffle when it comes to your treatment. You, alone, are the miracle healer that all others are compared to.

Design, build, and modify technology related to defense and protection, with efficacy reaching levels that are, frankly, absurd. You can make a bathing suit capable of protecting someone from being immersed in the sun, build a shield that could stop a black hole, create barriers that even gods cannot bypass. You are, effectlvely, the god of defense... with all the right materials and time to research, of course.

You rule the sky and all that's in it. Alter the weather to your will, fling lightning like it's going out of style, summon tornadoes to kill your enemies, make atmospheres for dead planets, lift cities into the sky on clouds harder than adamantite... anything related to the sky is yours to command. Also that extends to anything flying but it's mostly the weather stuff.

The great Welsh Dragon, the Red Dragon Emperor himself. A dragon capable of fighting on the level of the biblical god, with the ability to Boost his strength as he pleases, doubling in power with every Boost. He can transfer his Boosts to others, breathe horrifically powerful flames capable of scorching gods to the bone, and even ignore all defenses with Penetrate if he so chooses. He additionally has a smattering of secondary powers like telepathy, soul transferral, flight, and an immensely powerful Dragon Aura. He really hates being called the Boob Dragon.

A moon sized, eldritch mass of undead flesh and bone. It can read and control minds, extend country sized tentacles, control whole civilizations, rewrite DNA on the fly, and revive the dead. It can also move at FTL speeds via warping space around itself. At least it listens to you and your allies...

Your soul is a void that hungers eternally. Anything that tries to infiltrate or transgress upon your mind, soul, or body will be shredded down to its components and absorbed into the depths of your soul without mercy. Even the most basic telepathic probe will be shredded to pieces and consumed. Not even gods may attempt to inhabit your soul without your say so.

A legendary pokemon that controls antimatter and the reverse dimension, one of the first pokemon created by Arceus at the dawn of the universe. It's immensely powerful with more conventional abilities, but its true strength lies most in its manipulation of the reverse world- distorting, ripping, warping, condensing, and traveling the sea of infinite inversion with ease. Quite temperamental, especially with its creator.

You are an impossible hybrid birthed from the union of a Daemon and Seraphim, possessing immense power in your body and soul, and are utterly prodigal in all forms of Holy, Light, Dark, and Infernal magics, to the point that any abilities of those types you had before are massively strengthened and cost far less energy. Your own internal magic can be converted to Holy or Infernal as you please, and you are largely immune to the ill effects of either due to your constitution.

Create, control, and manipulate any vector through anything you touch- air, ground, water, energy attacks... anything really. Reverse attacks back where they came or stop them in their tracks, freeze things in place or send them to space, calculate the math for all kinds of vectors and then create esoteric effects that seemingly cut through reality itself. The sky's the limit.

Your telekinesis is quite possibly the strongest in the world, strong enough to create forcefields, bindings, crushing forces, city-wide events. You can move things both big and small, mountain sized or down to molecules, move with great force or great precision- there's really no limit to what you can move, as long as you have the imagination for it, and enough practice.

One of the strongest dojutsu in existence, allowing you access to the Six Paths technique- manipulating gravity via the Deva Path, cybernetic augmentations via the Asura Path, soul absorption via the Human Path, summoning monsters via the Animal Path, absorbing energy via the Preta Path, and utilizing the King of Hell via the Naraka Path. The Outer Path also allows one to preside over life and death, and summon the Gedo Mazo statue which can hold the power of the nine Tailed Beasts. Somewhat tertiary, you also have unparalleled sensory abilities with your eyes, and can clearly see the flows of all life energy around you.

All of space is yours to command. Warp space in any way you deem fit in order to produce effects such as telekinesis, inviolable walls, torn space, spatial rends, teleportation, pocket dimensions, physical distortion, portals, multidimensional hyperstructures, multiverse doorways, and more. With enough practice, you can even manipulate the time aspect as well.

Your rage is righteous and unending, your will is unstoppable and unyielding, and your rage gives you strength that not even the greatest of gods could strike you down. You, alone, stand at the pinnacle of all that is- able to best the creator of the universe should your wrath reach a height beyond height, strength beyond strength. Reach heaven though violence.

A legendary pokemon that controls space itself, one of the first pokemon created by Arceus at the dawn of the universe. It's immensely powerful with more conventional abilities, but its true strength lies most in its manipulation of space- distorting, ripping, warping, condensing, and traveling the fabric of space with ease. Quite temperamental, especially with Dialga.

The Dragon King, known as such for his actions in slaughtering many dragons in revenge for their actions against humans. Previously a doctor, he now wishes nothing more than to kill all Dragons. He is not unreasonable, though he is introverted and very confident in his powers, and can absorb any and all forms of normal magic. He is also skilled with almost all forms of magic known to Earthland.

The key to a mansion that sits at the direct center of all that exists and does not- the boundary of all things where not even Outer Gods may touch due to it sitting within its own dimension. You may use the key to enter the mansion through any door and exit anywhere in any reality. The mansion is maintained at all times via retroactive causality, and stays perfectly capable of sustaining entire cities worth of beings with its stores should you choose.

The mystical vessel housing the Time Stone, allowing the user to manipulate time around them should they learn how to manipulate its power correctly. They may stop time, time travel, create time loops, and more- though the more influence they exert, the more the backlash may affect both them and reality itself.

You are an alien that absorbs the light from a yellow sun in order to gain phenomenal physical power- super strength and speed, flight, durability, heat vision, ice breath, x-ray vision, super hearing, super smelling, and occasionally a bevy of random other powers that don't really come up a lot. You do acquire a weakness to the light of a red sun, though, and a blue sun will supercharge you at the cost of destabilizing your powers. The more sunlight you absorb, the stronger you become.

Manipulate the atoms around you with extremely high precision, allowing you to reconfigure matter with ease and control the periodic elements. You could rearrange the structure of just about anything you touch- turn water into wine, heal, destroy, turn a rock into a living dog, create new forms of matter and new elements. The possibilities are almost literally limitless.

Draedon is an amoral monster beyond compare. He is entirely devoid of humanity and compassion. With technology this incomprehensibly advanced, he stands at the precipice of apotheosis. He can fabricate such dreadful, synthetic nightmares at will. Though he does not have access to his original resources, it will not take him long to gain what he needs to begin construction of a new generation of Mechs. As your familiar, he will treat you fondly, and yet also as a science project for him to figure out. He can build just about anything as well, provided he has what he needs.

A legendary pokemon that controls time itself, one of the first pokemon created by Arceus at the dawn of the universe. It's immensely powerful with more conventional abilities, but its true strength lies most in its manipulation of time- distorting, stopping, looping, reversing, and traveling the flow of time with ease. Quite temperamental, especially with Palkia.

The Third True Magic, allowing one to completely convert their soul into higher dimensional planar being of infinite magic. The soul, when materialized via Heaven's Feel, allows one to exist without a physical body or anchor, and allows them to do just about anything due to having enough magic to overpower any rules in their way.

You have twelve save files that you may manually set and return to at any time you wish. They do not save automatically, nor can you save scum a quicksave, but you may still go back as far as your earliest save, should you wish. Upon loading, you will of course be reset to how you were when you made the save, and only your memories will carry over.

Exactly as the name implies- every single time you die, you respawn back in time to a random, uncontrollably set save point. There's no lag between death and respawn, and no limit to the amount of times it can happen, although where you respawn may not be where or when you want. You may die permanently, if you accept your death or have your existence/soul erased in the process, but otherwise nothing can truly kill you by any conventional means.

The goddess sealed in the moon, and a powerful member of the Otsutsuki clan. She possesses a wide bevy of powers- All-Killing Ash Bones, Gudodama, energy absorption, portal creation, dimensional manipulation, elemental manipulation, and all of the assorted absolute bullshit of the Rinne Sharingan and added Byakugan. She may or may not be a little inconsolable about her lost children too.

Your mind works on a level comparable to that of the Outer Gods- your understanding of the universe, magic, and all things esoteric is so great that you can speak reality into existence just by understanding what tones resonate at what level. You aren't quite an actual Outer God yet... but you're getting there.

You might not be immortal, truly, but being deathless is about the next best thing. You completely lack the concept of death, unable to truly die nor be taken by an afterlife, and even if you're scattered into nothing but ash in the wind, you would still be alive to some degree, and might even be able to reform... eventually.

The Second True Magic, allowing one complete access to the infinite expanse of parallel worlds and timelines. You may draw power from that kaleidoscope, travel freely through it, cut off timelines, seal them, view them, even utilize its infinite enormity in the creation of powerful magical artifacts.

The Mother of All Life. The Beast of Regression. So long as life exists upon the world, no power may kill Tiamat. With her comes the Sea of Life, the black mud from which all life sprung forth. Any who bathe in the mud are turned into a Child of Tiamat, given monstrous power and now serving Tiamat. Within her presence no life may be extended- all undead, ghosts, and dead and returned are instantly banished. Tiamat may shape new monsters endlessly from the Sea of Life and send them to assault her foes. As your familiar, you are her precious child- she may remake you however you wish and only asks that you never leave her as the rest of humanity did.

You possess quite literally infinite energy in every capacity no matter what type it is, and a massively boosted energy output to go with it- should you wish it, even the weakest of fire Abilities could match the output of a volcanic eruption or an inferno. Use this power responsibly.

No matter what it is, you can absorb and make use of it. Matter and energy are yours to intake, and not even the sun could meaningfully harm you at this point. The more you absorb, the more it bolsters your energy reserves.

The embodiment of ice and cold, all things sub-zero and frozen. Unleash ice on an Omega level scale, bringing things down to absolute zero on a whim and permanently costing the universe just a touch of thermal energy every single time you ice up.

The First True Magic, an ability that allows you to directly deny the Nothingness in reality to create anything- solid objects, artifacts, more magic, it even lets you resurrect the dead without issue.

The First Thinker and smartest being in three galaxies, arguably five. Creator of the Omnitrix and Ascalon. Give him a box of scraps and three hours and he could build just about anything he damn well pleased with very, very few limits. He's also kind of just a crotchety old grandpa who acts like he's a wise and powerful force of good that isn't also a petulant jerk sometimes. He's also like, a five inch tall frog alien.

A vast, living dimension based off of the view of Hell from the Divine Comedy. It views the suffering and torment of all beings inside of it as entertainment, and holds unfathomable amounts of ways to ensure that torment. It is divided into nine layers of increasing sin, each one full of environments, aesthetics, and creatures befitting those sins. For the purposes of not being too unwieldy to carry around, Hell resides as a subdimension of your current reality, one which you can communicate with telepathically and open portals to at will.
Freely manipulate time to your whims- fast forward, stop, rewind, travel, break... as long as you know what you want to do, you can do it. Time is yours to play with.

The true, production model Omnitrix- not a prototype, not an updated prototype, certainly not the Ultimatrix. The true, genuine Omnitrix as created by Azmuth himself, giving you access to well over a million different alien forms all specialized for different things- up to and including a being that can rebuild the Universe on a whim. Good thing it comes with a user manual.

Design, build, and modify any and all technology and constructs that the Warrior and Thinker Entities have come across in their incomprehensibly long existence- relics of dead worlds and their species. Create time bombs, multiversal portals, doomsday drivers, intergalactic FTL travel, etc etc. The edges of the universe are the limit.

Wield the authority of the End- point at anything and claim its life, or choose to resurrect it without issue. Life and death are yours to give out as you please, allowing you to kill things that cannot die and resurrect that which does not live.

A planet sized supercomputer that starts as a computer chip housing an artificial intelligence capable of absorbing energy and assimilating any and all matter into itself to improve its capabilities. The more it assimilates, the more powerful it becomes and the more it can replicate, including cybernetic clones of absorbed abilities. Unfortunately capable of being overloaded if hit by too much energy at once.

The immortality of the universe itself- you cannot be killed in any way that matters, not by anything that only exists within one universe. You can regenerate even from just a speck of the memory of an atom of your existence. Even Azathoth's own awakening would be hard pressed to kill you entirely.

Generate and control a physics defying material known as Dark Matter- not true dark matter, but material that can create 25,000 different types of energy and be used to fly, create explosions, create light rays, apply invisible pressure on others, create clones, duplicate one's body with a Dark Matter copy, survive even death should more Dark Matter still exist, bypass defenses, brute force telepathy, so on and so forth. It's not unbeatable... but it's damn hard to beat.

The Demon God King, an Aggregate form of King Solomon's Seventy Two Demon Pillars. Goetia himself desires to complete his Master's wish, preventing Humanity's struggling destruction through showing them an easier, more gentle path. After being overcome, he instead resolved to allow those humans he faced to burn their own path, regardless of the result. A genius of magic, despite being a Beast he is also the Grand Caster, able to learn or improve on any spell, and can manifest The Temple of Time, a location outside of time that one can recuperate in without issues. Acidic and prickly, Goetia can still acknowledge beauty in humans, enough to defend them to his last breath if needed.

The golden avatar of the Warrior Entity known as Zion. It's a powerful, human shaped being with immense strength, speed, and flight, plus the ability to fire off a huge variety of esoteric energy effects, regenerate, burn its own lifespan to predict the future, and also utilize its signature ability of Stilling- casting a golden light that effectively destroys everything in its path regardless of durability or shielding via wavelength cancellation. Should the avatar be destroyed, it will reappear within 24 hours.

The Beasts of Calamity symbolizing the seven Evils of Man, existences that represent the great Calamites humans can invoke upon themselves. By becoming a Beast, you acknowledge a love for Humanity, defined by yourself, and will resolve to save and destroy them in equal measure, forcing growth upon them. Through your Nega Ability, you can entirely negate a concept, such as Summoning, Genesis, Desire, the Messiah itself, Weapons, your own being, or various other abilities. You also gain the Crown of a Beast, growing several large horns.

The limiter on your body has broken, meaning that you no longer possess any kind of ceiling for your growth whatsoever- you become more physically powerful at an exponential rate, such that you could tear apart planets in a single strike with enough practice.

The ability to set a plan for any stated goal and know exactly what steps you must enact to achieve that goal with perfect clarity. The more complicated the goal, the more energy it takes to model that plan, and the more steps it takes. While the ability does help guide you through the path, ultimately it has blindspots and things it cannot accurately predict or model, making some of its uses rather suspect.

First you draw a circle, then you dot the eyes. Add a great big smile, and presto, it's Kirby! Kirby is everyone's friend, and incredibly powerful besides. Though he has the mind of a small child, he's always willing to do what's right.
A mechanical Outer God created with the "Ability to Change", ruler of Wonderland and a creature capable of enacting Change on a massive scale, to the point of threatening even other Outer Gods.

A dyson sphere city taking up much of what used to be the solar system, built upon an impossibly durable Megastructure to keep it from collapsing under its own gravity. It's largely inhabited by subspecies of highly adapted humans, transhuman cyborgs, and hostile security programs. You, as the owner of this token, may freely command the growth or destruction of the City as if you had Net Terminal Genes. Due to its sheer size, the city resides in a pocket dimension accessed via special key.

One of the greatest weapons in the universe in the shape of a sword. It harnesses the cosmic energy of a planetary alignment and has enough raw might to warp reality, teleport the user, create portals, seal away eldritch gods, and even destroy entire planets if one wishes.

There is nothing that can kill you. Not time, not age, not disease, not violence, not erasure- existence itself will end before you do. You, who are without death, can no longer be touched by it in the slightest. Fortunately... or unfortunately, you also can't even go insane.
Exclude yourself from anything on a conceptual level- an event, an attack's path, the laws of physics, the universe itself, the flow of time... anything, really.
Manipulate the luck of anything you target- yourself, your surroundings, other people, the world itself. The sky's the limit, as long as you have enough power.

The original Mad Djinn, Majin Buu is an innocent annihilator of the universe, able to depopulate planets or solar systems as easily as he enjoys candy. A high appetite, an innocent demeanor, and a very friendly personality belies one of the most dangerous creatures from his home. Near indestructible, his idea of play can range from simple games to stomping someone until they stop moving.
You Win. There is nothing that can stop you, though sometimes your victory may be tarnished by your own lack of effort in some regard.

Nothing short of you allowing someone to kill you will let you be harmed. The multiverse could collapse and all it would do is ruffle your hair. You're not quite immortal entirely, but you cannot be harmed as long as you do not wish it.

A spider-like entity that is the embodiment of the Oort Cloud- the ultimate being of its region of space and unequivocally one of the strongest creatures on any planet. It's capable of converting reality around it into crystals under, eating planets, and does not possess a concept of death as any life on Earth can understand. Frankly, it is a threat to the planet, the solar system, and history itself.

A small, handheld metallic device capable of erasing nine tenths of the universe on accident. It can delete literally anything- galaxies, planets, universes, entire timelines, gods- through violation of the conservation of mass, although it can backfire and kill you as well if your mind isn't powerful enough.

Create, modify, and design any and all technology relating to baking cookies, infinitely scaling in a wave of cookie based gray goo until the point that the entire universe is one perfectly optimized infinite cookie factory.

An all-powerful being of unmatched Spiral Energy mastery, dedicated to the preservation of the universe and all of existence by way of ensuring that Spiral Energy does not reach an infinite cascade point and thus collapse the entirety of the multiverse into an all consuming infinite black hole.

The filled Infinity Gauntlet containing all six of the Infinity Stones- Space, Time, Power, Soul, Mind, and Reality. You have command over the entirety of the universe with but a thought and a snap of your fingers. Wield responsibly. Or not.
YOUR DRILL IS THE DRILL THAT WILL PIERCE THE HEAVENS!

The Beholding. the fear of your secrets being known, of someone watching you. It has taken an interest in you, and thus you've gained the ability to compel answers out of anyone. However, this is just a signing bonus. Feed it, or it will feed on you. Feed it well, and you may be rewarded with further gifts from your new patron.

It Is Not What It Is. The fear of your senses being wrong, of lies told to you by others or yourself. It has taken an interest in you, and thus you've gained the abillity to make others hallucinate. Make them see or hear anything you desire. However, this is just a signing bonus. Feed it, or it will feed on you. Feed it well, and you may be rewarded with further gifts from your new patron.

I Do Not Know You. The fear of people or things that aren't quite right. It has taken an interest in you, and thus you've become not quite right as a result too. Your eyes may appear as glass, or maybe your joints move in a way they shouldn't, or maybe you have too many. Regardless of how exactly it manifests, this is just a signing bonus. Feed it, or it will feed on you. Feed it well, and you may be rewarded with further gifts from your new patron.

The Forever Blind. The fear you feel in a dark room alone, it's an old one, and it's taken an interest in you. You've gained the ability to summon a supernatural darkness that no one can see through, not even yourself, but you have an intuitive understanding of what's going on anyway. However, this is just a signing bonus. Feed it, or it will feed on you. Feed it well, and you may be rewarded with further gifts from your new patron.

Blood. The fear of being chased, hunted down. It has taken an interest in you, and thus you've gained the abilities of a predator. Sharp teeth, incredible stamina and speed, and the ability to see in the dark. However, this is just a signing bonus. Feed it, or it will feed on you. Feed it well, and you may be rewarded with further gifts from your new patron.

The Mother Of Puppets. The fear of spiders, yes, but also of being controlled, manipulated, caught in a web. It's taken an interest in you, and thus you've gained the ability to control the strings of others, compel them to do what you desire. However, this is just a signing bonus. Feed it, or it will feed on you. Feed it well, and you may be rewarded with further gifts from your new patron.

The Devastation. The fear of losing what, and who, you love. It has taken an interest in you, and thus you've gained the ability to conjure supernatural lightless flame. It doesn't warm, but it does burn, for it is only meant to destroy. Consequently, your body temprature has skyrocketed as well, but nothing dangerous to anything making physical contact with you, yet. However, this is just a signing bonus. Feed it, or it will feed on you. Feed it well, and you may be rewarded with further gifts from your new patron.

It will take some time and practice to be able to pick where you go, but the power of a Planeswalker is immense and they have access to anything that can be found amongst the vast multiverse. Work hard, choose wisely, and you'll have all the time in the world.

An engraved Cursed Technique that alters the body, allowing them to manifest and produce high volumes of water, which they can control completely with their Cursed Energy. This Innate Technique also has the opportunity to awaken the Domain Expansion, Horizon of the Captivating Skandha, a tropical island that can be used to relax, or overwhelm an enemy with an extreme amount of Sea Life, but that remains down to the user's capacity to awaken it.

The Straw Doll Technique is an innate technique based around Wara Ningyō, straw dolls and nails used for exorcising evil spirits and casting curses. Its primary ability is Resonance, focused around a piece of an opponent and used through the medium of a straw doll to reflect damage on them. Another ability is Hairpin, which allows the user to detonate their nails for additional range beyond their normal skills.

Allows the user to freely manipulate Cursed Tools telekinetically, starting with one item. With training, this can be expanded to any item that has Cursed Energy infused within it for long enough, even those made by the user such as rocks.

An Innate Technique designed to convert cursed energy into physical matter at what is considered an inefficient rate. This technique can be used in many different ways, from creating an extra bullet in the chamber of a gun, or constructing an object inside of someone, or even creating a pill that increases your own cursed energy. Liquid metals, bug armor, bullets, or weapons themselves, anything is possible with this technique, the right know-how, and enough cursed energy to make it a reality.
A six shot, pump action, 40mm double barreled shotgun with either 12 gauge shot or 40mm slug options. What could you possibly need to shoot that requires this? Every restock comes with six shells.

The Law of Cycles, the goddess of magical girls, the strongest magical girl in existence. Strong enough to rewrite an entire universe with her wish, an endless beacon of shining hope and love. A bit obsessed with her duty of saving magical girls from their horrible fates even outside of her role as the Law of Cycles. May or may not also have concerningly low self preservation skills and a lot of self sacrificing tendencies.

That which destroys natural order, the devil of the world. A Witch of untold power, evolved such that she no longer fits any definition of what came before. An existence capable of tearing down god in the name of Love, she who will never allow a self sacrificing duty to get between that and the happiness her love deserves. Is a complete and total self sacrificing hypocrite and also may or may not have clinical depression.

When they transform, always into a female form, all of those abilities are increased significantly. Every time you fight someone with a pair of testicles, you may only strike them in the balls. Nowhere else. Fate itself conspires that every hit you land will be straight to the balls.

You've got access to the right paperwork. For what? Anything. Grant yourself immortality, obtain whatever you like, ruin whoever you want- as long as the paperwork is filed, it'll happen. All of your rolls are now stored safely in rows inside of a token case. You are, unfortunately, partially untethered from reality. A 6.2 kg sphere of plutonium-gallium alloy inside of a half sphere of beryllium, with an additional half sphere and screwdriver to allow for a criticality experiment to take place. It may also be used as the core of a nuclear bomb. Why would you want this?
